text.body: <1.1> śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīnārāyaṇāya namaḥ || atha śrīviṣṇudharmottaraprārambhaḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1 || kṛtavarmā tathā bhojaḥ śveto māhiṣmatīpatiḥ || kulindaḥ sarvadamano mālaviścandravarddhanaḥ || 2 || vatsanābhaśca bāṇaśca nandīśo darasatpatiḥ || pratisāraścitradhanussarvo vāyurathastathā || 3 || draviḍaḥ kusumāpīḍa otraśca samarapriyaḥ || śambhuḥ kirātarājaśca auraso nandivardhanaḥ || 4 || vaṭumūlaśca tūneśaḥ śālvaśca janamejayaḥ || suhyarājo dadhīkarṇo bāhlīko damanastathā || 5 || hiraṇyanābhaḥ kausalyo dāśārho vijayastathā|| ete cānye ca rājānaḥ śataśo bahudakṣiṇāḥ || 6 || sampūrṇacandravadanā gajarājakaroravaḥ || upāsāṃcakrire vajraṃ sihāsanagatā nṛpāḥ || 7 || bahubhirbhūmipālaiśca tathā vajreṇa dhīmatā || yudhiṣṭhireṇa ca sadā śobhitā śuśubhe sabhā ||8|| rājānaste tato dṛṣṭvā ṛṣīndurlabhadarśanān|| brahmalokasthamātmānamamanyanta yaśobhṛtaḥ || 9 || ūcuste praṇayādvākyaṃ vajraṃ bhūrisahasradam || yathā tretāyuge rājandvāpare ca yathā nṛpāḥ || brāhmaṇā brahmakalpāśca tathaiva susamāgatāḥ || 1.1.10 || asmiṃstiṣye ca saṃprāpte tava rājanprasādataḥ || rājan kṛṣṇasagotro'si teneyante sabhā nṛpa || 11 || upāsyate mahābhāgairbrahmakalpaistapodhanaiḥ || ....... . . .. na tathā vīryanirjitā || 12|| bhaktyā yathā tu tasyaiva kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ || tena kṛṣṇena ye cakrurvyatītāḥ pūrvapārthivāḥ || 13 || varttatā tena kṛṣṇena te rājanmokṣamāpnuyuḥ|| atha tiṣyayugaḥ prāpto ghoraḥ paramadāruṇaḥ || 14|| durlabhaṃ darśanaṃ yatra nṛpasaṃghe mahātmanām || 15 || tasmāttvaṃ rājaśārdūla praṣṭumarho dvijottamān || vaiṣṇavānvividhāndharmānsarahasyānsasaṃgrahān|| 16|| ityevamukto vajrastaistyaktvā siṃhāsanaṃ tadā || vajraṃ tu prāñjaliṃ dṛṣṭvā sarva eva narādhipāḥ || 17 || varāsanānvihāyāśu tasthuḥ prāñjalayastadā || vajra uvāca || bhavadbhirnṛpaśārdūlāḥ prārthitā ye dvijāḥ śritāḥ || 18 || anugrahārthaṃ bhūpānāṃ jagato hitakāmyayā || bhavanto vaktumarhanti viṣṇudharmānsanātanān || 19 || tasmāttiṣyayuge nāsti bhavato darśanaṃ nṛpaiḥ || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || uttiṣṭha tvaṃ mahīpāla alaṅkuru svamāsanam || 1.1.20 || śravaṇepi vayaṃ tasya viśeṣeṇārthitā nṛpa || vajra te saṃśayānsarvāñchetsyatyeṣa mahāmuniḥ || 21 || ityevamuktvā vajraṃ te ṛṣayastapasi sthitāḥ || mārkaṇḍeyamathocuste brūhi dharmānmahīpate||22|| vaiṣṇavānvividhāndharmāṃllokānāmaghahāriṇaḥ|| tathā pārthivasaṃghasya saṃśayān manasi sthitān||23|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| brahmaṇyaḥ satyavān dhanyaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ|| yadyatpṛcchasi māṃ vajra tattadvaktāsmyasaṃśayam||24|| sihāsanastho bhava bhūmipāla kvaitrakārutva bhavantu sarve'pi tathā mahīpāḥ || sukhopaviṣṭairiha bhūmipālaiḥ svasaṃśayān brūhi yathāprakāmam || 25 || ityevamuktaḥ sa yadupradhāno bhṛguprabarheṇa maharṣimadhye || praṇamya viprānsa jagāma rājā siṃhāsanaṃ ratnasahasracitram || 26 || siṃhāsanasthe nṛpavaryamukhye siṃhāsanasthāḥ kṣitipapradhānāḥ || sarve babhūvuḥ praṇatāstathā ca śuśrūṣavo brāhmaṇamukhyavākyam || 27 || vajra uvāca || ācakṣva mahyaṃ bhṛguvaṃśacandra samudbhavaṃ tvaṃ jagato yathāvat || | śṛṇvaṃti me brāhmaṇasaṃghamukhyā nareṃdramukhyāśca vacastvadīyam || 28 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kathāprastāvanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <1.2> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya sarvabhūtaparāyaṇam || lakṣmīsahāyaṃ varadaṃ śeṣaparyaṅkaśāyinam || 1 || jagato'sya samutpattisthitināśaikakāraṇam || jñānajñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya saṃsthitam || 2 || vakṣyāmi jagatāṃ rājansamutpattiṃ nibodha tām || sarvapāpapraśamanīmāyuṣyāṃ svargadāṃ śivām || 3 || nārāyaṇo'sya jagataḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārapālanam || karoti jagatīpāla yasya sarvamidaṃ mahān || 4 || vedeṣu gīyate yo'sau puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ || anādinidhano dhātā tvanantaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 5 || yasyonmeṣastu divaso brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || nimeṣastu tathā rātristacca kalpaṃ prakīrtitam || 6 || puruṣatve tvanantasya na rūpaṃ nṛpa vidyate || na ca śabdo na ca ghrāṇaḥ sparśo vā pṛthivīpate || 7 || na tasya parimāṇaṃ vā na cādirnidhanaṃ kutaḥ || sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaḥ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ || 8 || sarvataḥ śrutimām̐lloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati || sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam || 9 || asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca || taṃ ca prāpya bhavantīha ye muktāḥ puruṣottamāḥ || 1.2.10 || sugatiryogasiddhānāṃ tasmātsarvasya sambhavaḥ || tasmādbhavati cāvyaktastasmādātmāpi jāyate || 11 || tasmādbuddhirmanastasmāttataḥ khaṃ pavanastataḥ || tasmāttejastatastvāpastebhyoṇḍamabhavatkila || 12 || aṇḍo hiraṇmayo rājaṃstasyāntaḥ svayameva hi || śarīragrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ kurute prabhuḥ || 13 || brahmā caturmukho devo rajomātrādhikaḥ sadā || śarīragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā sṛjatīdaṃ carācaram|| 14 || aṇḍasyāntarjagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || saptalokān sapātālānsaptadvīpārṇavāṃ mahīm || 15 || sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā sa bhagavān sāttvikīmāsthitastanum || kṣīrode keśavo bhūtvā śeṣabhogamayaḥ prabhuḥ || 16 || lakṣmīsahāyo lokāṃstu sarvānpālayate sadā || yoganidrāṃ samāsthāya sarvasattvaśarīragaḥ || 17 || śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi sarveṣāṃ sa hi paśyati || antakāle haro bhūtvā jagatsaṃharate punaḥ ||18|| tāmasīṃ tanumāsthāya līlayaiva mahāyaśāḥ || brahmāto sṛṣṭikāle tu jalamadhyagatāṃ mahīm || 19 || dṛṣṭvoddharati yajñātmā vārāhīmāsthitastanum || brahmāsya sarge paripālane ca viṣṇurmahātmā bhavatīha nityam|| saṃhārakāle ca haratvameti traidhaṃ vidhatte sa trikālayogāt || 1.2.20 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde hiraṇyagarbhotpattikathano nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <1.3> ||mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || brahmarātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ vibuddhe padmasambhave || viṣṇuḥ sisṛkṣurbhūtānāṃ jñātvā bhūmiṃ jalāntagām || 1 || jalakrīḍāruci śubhaṃ kalpādiṣu yathā purā || vārāhamāsthito rūpamujjahāra vasundharām|| 2 || vedapādyūpadaṃṣṭraśca caturvaktraścaturmukhaḥ || agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ || 3 || ahorātrekṣaṇo divyo vedāṅgaḥ śrutibhūṣaṇaḥ || ājyanāsaḥ sruvatuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān || || 4|| dharmaḥ satyamahāḥ śrīmānkarmavikramasatkṛtaḥ || prāyaścittamayo dhīraḥ prāṃśujānurmahāyaśāḥ || udgātraṃtro homaliṅgaḥ phalabījamahauṣadhiḥ || 5 || vāyvantarātmā mantrāsthirvikṛtaḥ somaśoṇitaḥ || vedaskaṃdho havirgandho havyakavyātivegavān || 6 || prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimānnānādīkṣābhiranvitaḥ || dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahākratumayo mahān|| 7 || upākarmeṣṭiruciraḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ|| māyāpatnīsahāyo vai mahāśṛṃṅga ivoditām ||6|| mahīṃ sāgara paryantāṃ saśailavanakānanām || ekārṇavajalabhraṣṭāmekārṇavagataḥ prabhuḥ || 9 || daṃṣṭrāgreṇa samuddhṛtya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || ādidevo mahāyogī cakāra jagatīṃ punaḥ || 1.3.10 || evaṃ jñātvā varāheṇa bhūtvā bhūtahitārthinā || uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī jalamadhyagatā purā || 11 || uddhṛtya bhūmiṃ sa vibhurmahātmā varāharūpeṇa jalāntarasthām || cakre vibhāgaṃ jagatastadīśo yathāyathā tacchṛṇu rājasiṃha || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmo'ttare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde varāhaprādurbhāvo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <1.4> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || jālāntaragate bhānau yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ || prathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate || 1 || trasareṇavo'ṣṭau vijñeyā likṣaikā parimāṇataḥ || tā rājasarṣapāstisrastāstrayo gaurasarṣapāḥ || 2 || sarṣapāḥ ṣaḍyavo madhye aṅgulaṃ ca tadaṣṭakam || dvādaśāṅgulikaḥ śaṅkustaddvayaṃ hasta ucyate ||3|| taccatuṣkaṃ dhanuḥ proktaṃ krośo dhanuḥsahasrikā || krośadvayaṃ ca gavyūtiḥ yojanaṃ taccatuṣṭayam || 4 || yojanānāṃ pramāṇena cāyutānāṃ śatatrayam || ayutānāṃ ca pañcāśaccheṣasthānaṃ manoharam || 5 || sa eva loke vārāhaḥ kathitaśca svayaṃ prabhuḥ || vārāharūpī bhagavāñchatarūpadharastathā ||6|| tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurbhaktaiḥ saha mahātmabhiḥ || loko'yamaṃḍasaṃlagnaśchatrākāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 7 || svayaṃ prabhurvītarajāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ || ekāntabhāvopagatāstaṃ prayānti hari janāḥ || 8 || sarvādhastādayaṃ lokaḥ kathitaste manoharaḥ || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || 9 || kālāgnirudralokastu kathyate'gnisamarcitaḥ || eka eva sa tatrāste svaprabhābhāsvarātmakaḥ || 1.4.10|| tasmātsamutthito vahnirjagatprāpte dinakṣaye || bhasmasātkurute sarvaṃ yacceṅgaṃ yacca neṅgate || 11|| tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ ||| pātālanāmā pātālaḥ prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 12 || yogamāyāṃ samāsthāya dvitīyāmāsthitastanum || sarvato bhagavānāste śeṣamūrtirjanārdanaḥ || ||13|| rukmabhaumaḥ sa pātālo dhṛto rudrasya tejasā || tasminsa bhagavānāste śeṣaparyaṅkamāsthitaḥ || 14 || nityaṃ tāladhvajo vāgmī vanamālāvibhū ṣitaḥ || dhārayañchirasā nityaṃ ratnacitrāṃ phaṇāvalīm || 15|| lāṅgalī musalī khaḍgī nīlāmbaravibhūṣitaḥ || stūyamānaḥ sa gandharvairnāgairṛṣivaraistathā| ||16|| tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || sutalasaṃjñaḥ pātāla śilābhāsaḥ samantataḥ ||17|| balistu bhagavāṃstatra bahistiṣṭhatisaṃyataḥ || ramyaṃ puravaraṃ tasya viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ svayam || 18 || nivāsaṃ devarājasya viśiṣṭaṃ tatpurottamam || sā vaiṣṇavī kalā proktā yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat || 19 || phaṇeṣu tasya viśrāntā militā ca śubhāśubhā || tatrāste sa mahābhāgaḥ śriyā paramayā yutaḥ||1.4.20|| tamupāsanti satataṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || tatrāste devadevasya mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇasya cāparā || 21 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || ābhāsatala ityeva pātālo nīlamṛttikaḥ || 22 || tṛtīyaḥ sa tu vikhyātaḥ surabhiryatra tiṣṭhati || digdhenavastathā tatra catasraśca tathā sthitāḥ || 23 || subhadrā vahnirūpā ca viśvarūpā tathaiva ca || rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā yābhirvṛtamidaṃ jagat || 24 || tāsāṃ kṣīreṇa sarvāsāṃ kṛtaḥ kṣīrārṇavaḥ prabho || pātālamadhye tasmiṃstu puraṃ viṣṇormanoramam|| || 25 || yatrāste bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śeṣaparyaṅkagastathā || agnijvālāparikṣiptaḥ saha lakṣmyā parantapa || 26 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || pītabhaumaścaturthastu gabhastitalasaṃjñitaḥ || 27 || tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurdevo hayaśirodharaḥ || śaśāṃkaśatasaṃkāśaḥ śātakauṃbhavibhūṣaṇaḥ || 28 || puraṃ tatraiva vikhyātaṃ garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ || prahrādasyāsurendrasya bāṣkaleśca mahātmanaḥ || 29 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || mahā taleti vikhyāto raktabhaumastupañcamaḥ || 1.4.30 || sarovaraṃ tasya madhye yojanānāṃ daśāyutam || jaṃgamājaṃgamaiḥ sarverjalajaiśca vivarjitam|| 31 || tatrārūpeṇa vasati kūrmarūpadharo hariḥ || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || 32 || ṣaṣṭhaścaiva mahārāja nāmnā bhīmatalastu saḥ || tatrāpi sarasī divyā yojanānāṃ śataṃ gatā || tasyāṃ ca vasate devo matsyarūpadharo hariḥ || 33 || saptamaḥ kṛṣṇabhaumastu nāmnā bhīmatalastu saḥ || tatrāste kapilo devo vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 34 || tatrāśmanagaraṃ nāma varuṇasya puraṃ smṛtam || tathā dānavavīrāṇāṃ nagarāṇi pṛthakpṛthak ||35 || virocanasya kumbhasya nikumbhasya harasya ca || śambarasya karālasya narakasya hayasya ca || 36 || hayagrīvasya sundasya ghasasya praghasasya ca || baleḥ puravaraṃ cātra yogīśasya tathāparam ||37|| yatrasthamenaṃ dadṛśe rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ || tathā puravaraṃ tatra viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ||38|| lakṣmīsahāyo yatrāste cāgneyāmbarasaṃvṛtaḥ || tisraḥ koṭyastu yatrāsya bhaktānāṃ sumahātmanām || 39 || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇāṃ pītavāsasām ||1.4.40|| nīlotpala savarṇānāṃ viṣṇoḥ sadṛśatejasām || viṣṇoḥ sutānāṃ hṛṣṭānāṃ satataṃ bhūrivarcasām|| 41 || tatrastho dṛṣṭavāndevo paulastyo rāvaṇaḥ purā || purī bhogavatī tatra tathā vāsukipālitā || 42 || nāgānāṃ ca purāṇyatra tathaiva ca pṛthakpṛthak || padmasya dhṛtarāṣṭrasya viraktasya kurostathā || 43 || takṣakasyailapatrasya tathā karkoṭakasya ca || dhanañjayasya śaṅkhasya tathaivāśvatarasya ca || 44 || kandalasya surāsasya sumukhasya gayasya ca || diśāṃ gajānāṃ ca tathā tatra sthānaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 45 || yeṣāṃ skaṃdhagatā bhūmiḥ saśailavanakānanā || virūpākṣasya nāgasya mahāpadmasya cāpyatha || 46 || tathā sumanasaścātra rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ || paścāyutaparīmāṇā bhūmiḥ sarveṣu pārthiva || 47 || pātāleṣu vinirdiṣṭā paṭhitāntaravartinī || aṇḍasyārdhamidaṃ proktamadhastāttu pramāṇataḥ || 48 || tisraḥ koṭyastu rājendra niyutāni tathā daśa || pañcānyāni mahīpāla bhūmi puṣṭyā mahānagha || 49 || pañcāyutaparīmāṇāḥ puṣṭirbhūmeḥ prakīrtitā || bhūmerathopariṣṭācca aṇḍasyārdhamathāparam || etāvadeva nirdiṣṭā bhūmipāla pramāṇataḥ || 1.4.50 || candrārkabhāsā rahitaṃ nṛvīra svayaṃ prabhedaṃ kathitaṃ mayaitat || pātālapūgaṃ vividhaṃ suramyaṃ śṛṇuṣva lokān gadato mamānyān || 51 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pātālavarṇano nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || <1.5> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhūrlokaḥ prathamo rājañśṛṇuṣva gadato mama || pātālena tu tattulyamūrdhvataḥ parikīrttitaḥ || 1 || vāyuskandhā vinirdiṣṭāste tu sapta mahātmabhiḥ || ekaikaṃ niyutāḥ paṃca yojanānāṃ prakīrtitam || 2 || paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭā manuṣyāḥ kinnarāstathā || yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācā bhūmigocarāḥ ||3|| sarva ete vinirdiṣṭā annādā bhūmigocarāḥ || vidyādharāṇāṃ prathamaṃ vāyumārgaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 4 || dvitīyaḥ siddhavidyānāṃ tṛtīyastu garutmatām || caturtho vāyumārgastu gandharvāṇāṃ prakīrttitaḥ || 5 || vināyakāḥ pañcamagā ṣaṣṭhe ca kariṇāṃ gaṇāḥ || yeṣāṃ śīkaratoyena cāvaśyāyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 6 || saptame ca mahābhāga siddhāstiṣṭhaṃti yādava || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ||7|| bhuvarloka iti khyāto yatra tiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ || manvantarādhikāreṣu ye bhaviṣyā mahīpate || 8 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || svarloko vasatiryatra prāyaśaḥ puṇyakarmaṇām || 9 || somapānāṃ ca devānāṃ śakrādīnāṃ mahīpate || maharlokasthitiryatra devatānāṃ mahātmanām || 1.5.10 || vinivṛttādhikārāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ nṛpasattama || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || 11 || janalokaḥ sthitiryatra gavāṃ pārthivasattama || tiṣṭhanti brahmaṇo rātryāṃ yatra jīvāḥ samantataḥ || 12 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || tapolokaḥ sthitiryatra prāṇeśānāṃ mahātmanām || 13 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || satyalokaḥ sthitiryatra brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 14 || ityete kathitāḥ sapta tava lokā mahātmanām || etāvāneva saviturvicaranti marīcayaḥ || 15 || eteṣu lokasaṃjñoktā tasmādeva manīṣibhiḥ || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || 16 || sthānaṃ rudrasya kathitaṃ rudratejovirājitam || brahmalokopariṣṭāttu rudraloko mahattamaḥ || 17 yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pañcabhirnibiḍaṃ matam || ādityamandiraṃ proktaṃ yadetaddivi dṛśyate || 18 || yadetaddṛśyate nīlaṃ tamastatpṛthivīpate || tamasastu pare pāre rudralokaḥ svayaṃ prabho || 19 || rudratvaṃ samanuprāptaistatra bhaktairmahānagha || krīḍannāste mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 1.5.20 || tasyopariṣṭādaparastāvadeva pramāṇataḥ || agamyassarvadevānāṃ viṣṇulokaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 21 || tasyopariṣṭādbrahmāṇḍaḥ kāñcano dīptisaṃyutaḥ || bhuvarloke tu vasatirvāmanasya mahātmanaḥ || 22 || svarloke vasatirviṣṇorvaikuṇṭhasya mahātmanaḥ || nṛvarāhasya vasatirmaharloke prakīrtitā || 23 || nṛsiṃhasya tathā proktā janaloke mahātmanaḥ || trivikramasya vasatistapoloke prakīrtitā || 24 || lokāḥ santānakā nāma satyaloke prakīrttitāḥ || eteṣu devaṃ paśyanti devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ || 25 || tapasā mahatā rājan bhaktāśca satataṃ prabhum || rudrasthānopariṣṭāttu viṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ mayoditam || 26 || na kaścidenaṃ śaknoti draṣṭuṃ devavaraṃ harim || na tatra sūryastapati candramā na virājate || 27 || tejasā tasya devasya sa tu deśo virājate || tasyopariṣṭādārabhya yāvadantaṃ mahīpate || 28 || proktaṃ varāhasthānasya tatra mānaṃ nibodha me || yojanānāṃ ca ṣaṭkoṭyastriṃśacca niyutānyatha || 29 || etāvaccaiva bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ parikīrtitā || etāvadeva candrasya talamuktaṃ samaṃtataḥ || 1.5.30 || eteṣu devaṃ paśyanti devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ || tapasā mahatā rājan bhaktāśca satataṃ prabhum || 31 || bāhyato'ṇḍaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tvadbhistu parivāritam || āpo daśaguṇenaiva bāhyatastejasā vṛtāḥ || 32 || tejodaśaguṇenaiva bāhyataḥ pavanena ca || vāyurdaśaguṇenaiva gaganena tathāvṛtaḥ || 33 || ākāśaṃ ca daśaghnena manasā bāhyato vṛtam|| manaśca buddhyā sakalaṃ vṛtaṃ rājan daśaghnayā||34|| ātmanā cāvṛtā buddhirdaśaghnena samantataḥ|| avyaktena tathaivātmā daśaghnenaiva cāvṛtaḥ ||35|| avyaktaḥ puruṣeṇātha tvanantenāvṛto'nagha || evaṃ vidhānāmaṇḍānāmavyaktaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 36|| tiryyagūrdhvamadhaḥ saṃkhyā vaktuṃ rājanna śakyate || anantatvātpradhānasya puruṣasya mahātmanaḥ ||37|| ekarūpāstathaivāṇḍāḥ sarva eva narādhipa || tulyadeśavibhāgaśca tulyajantava eva ca ||38|| deśedeśe samānā ye aṇḍeṣu nṛpasattama || sukhaduḥkhe same teṣāṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ||39|| sarvāṇḍānāṃ samā jñeyā kālasaṃkhyā narādhipa || pauruṣasya dinasyānte sarve hyaṇḍanivāsinaḥ || 1.5.40 || eko'pyananto rājendra nāntareva prakīrtitaḥ || ayaṃ mayokto nṛpa sanniveśaḥ saṃkṣepamātreṇa carācarasya || vyāsena caivaṃ parikīrtyamānaḥ samāpyate naiva kadācideva || 41 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde lokavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <1.6> || vajra uvāca || bhūmaṇḍalasya kṛtsnasya saṃsthānena ca bhārgava || vada pramāṇaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tattatra me saṃśayo mahān ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhūmaṇḍalasya rājendra madhye merurmahāgiriḥ || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi tasya madhye samantataḥ ||2|| jambūdvīpastu pañcāśatpramāṇena prakīrtitaḥ || yojanānāṃ tu niyutaṃ tasya pāraṃ mahīpate || 3 || lavaṇena samudreṇa tenāsau pariveṣṭitaḥ || lavaṇadviguṇenāpi śākadvīpena lāvaṇaḥ ||4|| veṣṭitaśca mahārāja śākadvīpo na saṃśayaḥ || kṣīrodena svatulyena kṣīrodo'pi ca veṣṭitaḥ || 5 || kṣīrodadviguṇenāpi kuśadvīpena yojanaiḥ || ājyodena kuśadvīpaḥ svatulyena ca veṣṭitaḥ || 6|| krauñcadvīpena cājyodo dviguṇena ca veṣṭitaḥ || krauñcadvīpaḥ svatulyena dadhimaṇḍodakena ca || 7 || dvīpena śālmalenātha dviguṇena ca veṣṭitaḥ || surodo dviguṇenātha gomedena ca veṣṭitaḥ || 8 || puṣkaradvīpamadhye tu dvīpasaṃsthānamaṇḍapaḥ || parvataḥ sumahām̐lloke vikhyāto mānasottaraḥ || 9 || niyutārdhaṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇena prakīrtitaḥ || nānāprakāraśikharastāvadeva samucchritaḥ || 1.6.10 || merostu pūrvadigbhāge mānasottaramūrdhani || purī śakrasya vikhyātā nāmatastvamarāvatī || 11 || pūrvadakṣiṇadigbhāge tathā vahneḥ prabhāvatī || yamasya dakṣiṇe bhāge nāmnā saṃyamanī purī || 12 || virūpākṣasya vikrāntā bhāge dakṣiṇapaścime || paścime ca tathā bhāge varuṇasya sukhaprabhā || 13 || śivā nāma purī vāyorbhāge vai paścimottare || vibhāvarī somapurī uttareṇa prakīrtitā || 14 || śarmadā ca purī śaivī bhāge pūrvottare smṛtā || puṣkaraśca svatulyena vṛtaḥ svādūdakena ca || 15 || svādūdakātparaṃ kṣoṇī kārtasvaramayī śubhā || yojanānāṃ pramāṇena sahasrāṇi tu viṃśatiḥ || 16 || daśa cānyāni rājendra pañca pañca prakīrtitā || samantatastvekaśilā devodyāne mahī śubhā || 17 || sthitastāṃ parivāryorvīṃ lokāloko mahīdharaḥ || ayutaṃ yojanānāṃ tu vistareṇocchrayeṇa ca || 18 || lokāloke mahīpāla lokapālāstvamī smṛtāḥ || prācyādiṣu mahāvīryāḥ kalpasthāyina eva te || 19 || sudāmā śeṣapādaśca ketumānsumahābalaḥ || hiraṇyaromā ca tathā vijñeyāśca digīśvarāḥ || 1.6.20 || arvāktasya mahīdhrasya candrārka grahatārakāḥ || prapatanti mahārāja na tu pāre kadācana || 21 || darbhodakasamudrastu lokālokaṃ samantataḥ || parivārya sthito rājannandhakāre mahārṇava || 22 || ekaṣaṣṭipramāṇena niyutāni samantataḥ || tasya pāre tato rājanbrahmāṇḍastu samantataḥ || 23 || ūrddhvenādhaśca viṣkambho yāvānaṇḍasya kīrtitaḥ || tāvadeva pramāṇena tiryakṣu parivāritaḥ || 24 || merumadhyātsamudrasya pāraṃ garbhodakasya tu || koṭitrayaṃ yojanānāṃ niyutāni tathā daśa || 25 || pañcānyāni ca rājendra pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam || tasya rāja... brahmāṇḍastu samantataḥ || 26 || ....tadadyardhaṃ dvitīyasya mahīpate | || etadeva tu nirdiṣṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ tattvacintakaiḥ || 27 || merostu pūrvadigbhāge madhye tu lavaṇodadheḥ || viṣṇuloko mahānproktaḥ salilāntara saṃsthitam||28|| svabhāsayātra devasya satataṃ nṛpa rājitam || tatra svapiti gharmānte devadevo janārdanaḥ || 29 || lakṣyīsahāyaḥ satataṃ śeṣaparyaṅkamāśritaḥ || ekādaśyāmāṣāḍhasya śuklapakṣe janārdanam || 1.6.30 || devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || abhiṣṭuvanti te gatvā satataṃ dinapañcakam || 31|| utsavaṃ caiva kurvanti gītanṛtyasamākulam|| tatastu caturo māsānyoganidrāmupāsate ||32|| suptaṃ ca tamupāsaṃte ṛṣayo brahmasammatāḥ || saśarīrāṇi śāstrāṇi bhaktāstaṃ devamānavāḥ ||33|| kārtikasya site pakṣe tadeva dinapañcakam || vibodhayanti deveśaṃ gatvā sendrā divaukasaḥ ||34|| devāstathaiva kurvanti tadāpi ca mahotsavam|| merostu pūrvadigbhāge madhye kṣīrārṇavasya tu ||35|| kṣīrāmbumadhyagā śubhrā devasyānyā tathā purī || lakṣmī sahāyastatrāste śeṣāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ ||36|| tatrāpi caturo māsān suptastiṣṭhati vārṣikān || astraiḥ sa kevalaistatra dṛśyate śāśvataḥ prabhuḥ || 37 || tasmiṃstathaiva digbhāge madhye kṣīrārṇavasya tu || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi maṇḍalaḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 38|| śvetadīpastu vikhyāto dvīpaḥ paramaśobhanaḥ || narāḥ sūryaprabhāstatra śītāṃśusamadarśanāḥ ||39|| tejasā durnirīkṣyāśca devānāmapi yādava || pañcakālavidhānajñāḥ pūjayanti janārdanam || 1.6.40 || pūjāṃ tu teṣāṃ śirasā sa tu devaḥ prayacchati || ihasthaiśca kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ pādataśca prayacchati||41|| ekāntabhāvopagatāstatra yānti hariṃ narāḥ || tatra gatvā na śocanti nivarttante na cāpyatha||42|| pūjayitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam|| ādityamaṇḍalaṃ bhittvā brahmāṇaṃ praviśanti te||43|| tato'niruddhaṃ deveśaṃ pradyumnaṃ cāpyanantaram || tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ tataḥ param || 44 || vāsudevaṃ ca saṃprāpya mucyante sarvavarttanaiḥ || śvetadvīpagatāstasmānna nivartanti karhicit ||45 || pūrvottare tu digbhāge madhye kṣīrārṇavasya tu || vaijayanta iti khyātaḥ parvataḥ sarvakāñcanaḥ || 46 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pramāṇena daśa smṛtaḥ || āyāmavistarocchrāyaiḥ pramāṇaṃ tasya kīrtitam ||47|| yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi pañca tasya guhā smṛtā|| ucchritā yojanaśataṃ tāvadeva ca vistṛtā || 48 || timireṇāvṛtā dvāri yojanānāṃ tathā śatam || svaprabhābharaṇā divyā tataḥ parataraṃ hi sā || 49 || nāmnā ca loke vikhyātā ṛṣibhistimirāvatī || tasyāṃ devavaro viṣṇuḥ svapannāste janārdanaḥ ||1.6.50|| tatrainamupatiṣṭhanti devyastisro mahīpate | || nidrā ca kālarātriśca lakṣmīśca varavarṇinī ||51|| upāsate ca taṃ devaṃ bhṛgvādyā paramarṣayaḥ || śarīradhāribhiścāstraistathā tatra ca sevyate ||52|| tasya suptasya vadanānniśvāsocchvāsataḥ kramāt || prajānāṃ paṅktayo hyuccairnipatanti patanti ca || 53 || tasyocchvāsaśca jantūnāṃ sambhavaḥ kathito nṛpa || niḥśvāsakāle ca tathā jantūnāṃ maraṇaṃ smṛtam || 54 || madhye dhṛtasamudrasya meroḥ paścimatastathā || yojanānāṃ tu niyutaṃ dvīpastu parimaṇḍalaḥ||55|| tatra govardhanasyoktā vasatiḥ sumahātmanaḥ || divyānāṃ tatra dhenūnāṃ vasatiśca tathā smṛtā || 56 || satataṃ kāmarūpeṇa bhābhiḥ sa ramate hariḥ || madhye dadhisamudrasya dvīpastāvatpramāṇataḥ || 57 || hemarūpadharo yatra nityaṃ vasati keśavaḥ || tatrasthamenaṃ paśyanti ṛṣayo bhūritejasaḥ || 58 || surāsamudramadhye tu dvīpaḥ paramavistṛtaḥ || tatra saṃkarṣaṇo devo vibhurāste surā'surāḥ || 59 || upatiṣṭhanti tatrainaṃ divyastisro manoramāḥ || kāntiśca madirā caiva tathā devī karīṣiṇī ||1.6.60|| tatrasthamenaṃ paśyanti prajānāṃ patayaḥ sadā|| kṣmāmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamidaṃ tavoktaṃ kṣmāpālavṛndāmbarapūrṇacandra || samāsato vyāsagirāmaśakyaṃ vaktuṃ mahendropi na varṣapūgaiḥ || 61 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dvīpavibhāgavarṇano nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <1.7> vajra uvāca || jambūdvīpasya saṃsthānaṃ vistareṇa mahāmune | || tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi yatra jāto'si bhārgava 41 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || avagāḍhāvubhayatassamudrau pūrvapaścimau || jambūdvīpe mahārāja ṣaḍime kulaparvatāḥ || 2 || himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca || meruśca śṛṃgavāṃścaiva sarve ratnākarāḥ śubhāḥ || 3 || madhye tu maṇḍalaḥ śailo nīlasya niṣadhasya ca || sauvarṇaḥ kathyate meruḥ pramāṇaṃ tasya me śṛṇu || 4 || caturāśītisāhasrāḥ kathitāścocchrayeṇa ca || adhastātṣoḍaśaivoktaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu vistṛtaḥ || 5 || vistāro dviguṇaścāsya bhūlagno maṇḍalaḥ smṛtaḥ || vṛndapuṣpanibhaścorddhvaṃ dvātriṃśaccaiva vistṛtaḥ || 6 || vistāro dviguṇaścāsya tatrādhikavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || merustu navatiḥ proktaḥ sahasraḥ pūrvato giriḥ || 7 || yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu mālyavān nāma nāmataḥ || ānīlaṃ niṣadhaṃ yāvatpaścimena tu tāvatā || 8 || tāvatpramāṇo nirdiṣṭaḥ pūrvato gandhamādanaḥ || merostūttarataḥ śvetaḥ pūrvato'nanta ucyate || 9 || dakṣiṇe ca tathā pītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paścimataḥ smṛtaḥ || antareṇa smṛto vipraḥ pūrvataḥ kṣatriyaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.7.10 || dakṣiṇena tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ paścimataḥ smṛtaḥ || tasmādudīcī viprāṇāṃ prācī syātkṣattrajanmanām || 11 || dakṣiṇā vaiśyajātīnāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ paścimā smṛtā || prācyāṃ mahendrasya purī merupṛṣṭhe'marāvatī || 12 || vahneḥ pradakṣiṇenoktā purī nāmnā sabhāvatī || yamasya dakṣiṇenoktā nāmnā saṃyamanī purī || 13 || proktā vai nairṛtī bhāge purī paścimadakṣiṇe || paścimena tathā ramyā sumukhā varuṇasya ca || 14 ||| anantaraṃ śivā nāma purī vāyoḥ prakīrtitā || uttareṇa purī ramyā somasyoktā vibhāvarī || 15 || anantaraṃ śivasyoktā nagarī śaṅkarī śivā ||| merupṛṣṭhe yathā devāḥ saṃśritāstu yathādiśam || 16 || vijñeyāste tu dikpālāstasyāṃtasyāṃ tathā diśi || devaḥ svāṃ nagarī nityaṃ mānasottaramūrdhani || 17 || meruntu paśyati vibhustatstho merugatāṃ purīm || udakśṛṅgavato'rdhe tu yāmyena kurusaṃjñitam || 18 || varṣantu kathitaṃ divyaṃ sarvopadravavarjitam || śṛṅgavacchvetayormadhye varṣaṃ jñeyaṃ hiraṇyabham || 19 || ramyantu varṣaṃ vijñeyaṃ madhyataḥ śvetanīlayoḥ || madhye niṣadhanīlābhyāṃ paścārdhe gandhamādanaḥ || 1.7.20 || ketumālaḥ smṛto varṣastvatīva sumanoharaḥ || madhye niṣadhanīlābhyāṃ pūrve mālyavato gireḥ || 21|| varṣo rudramukho nāma nityaṃ mudita mānavaḥ || meroścaturdiśaṃ nāmnā varṣo rājannilāvṛtaḥ || 22 || tasyāpi bhedāścatvāro nāmatastānnibodha me || bhadrāśvo jambumālaśca ketumānkuravastathā || 23 || jambūvṛkṣastu vikhyāto jambumāle tu yādava || yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu tatpūrvaṃ tasya kīrtitam || 24 || tatphalebhyaḥ prabhavati ramyā jāṃbūnadī śubhā || meroḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā svamūle sā ca naśyati || 25 || vṛkṣarājena tenedaṃ jambūdvīpaṃ pracakṣate || ilāvṛtastu prabhayā mero nityaṃ prakāśate || 26 || na tatra bhrājate sūryo na candro na ca tārakāḥ || meroḥ śarāvasaṃsthatvānnityameva tirohitaḥ || 27 || hemakūṭāduttarato harivarṣaṃ pracakṣate || hemakūṭāddakṣiṇatastathā kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam || 28 || himācalāddakṣiṇato varṣaṃ yādava bhāratam || karmabhūmirmahīpāla yatra vartāmahe vayam || 29 || bhārate'sminyugāvasthā keśavena vinirmitā || varṣe dve cātha saṃsthāne vijñeye dakṣiṇottare || 1.7.30 || varṣatrayaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ caturasraṃ tu madhyamam || dīrghaṃ tathaiva vijñeyaṃ varṣāṇāṃ ca catuṣṭayam || 31 || varṣāṇāṃ navasāhasro viṣkambhaḥ kathito nṛpa || yojanānāṃ pramāṇena kathitastattvadarśibhiḥ || 32 || viṣkambhaḥ parvatānāṃ tu sahasradvitayaṃ smṛtam || meroryojanasāhasro viṣkambhaḥ kathitastathā || 33 || yojanānāṃ tu niyutaṃ jambūdvīpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || yāmyottareṇa tasyedaṃ pramāṇaṃ te mayeritam || 34 || pūrvāpareṇa tasyāpi pramāṇaṃ śṛṇu pārthiva || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi dvātriṃśacca śatāni ca || 35 || bhadrāśvaketumālau dvau pratyekaṃ pārthivottama || yojanānāṃ sahasreṇa śatasāhasrakāni ca || 36 || navamerustathā prokto gandhamādanamānataḥ || merornavasahasrāṇi mālyavāṃśca nigadyate || 37 || meroryojanasāhasro viṣkambhaḥ kathitastathā || evamapyeṣa niyutaṃ jambūdvīpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 38 || himācale yakṣavarā niviṣṭā daityapradhānāḥ khalu hemakūṭe || gandharvamukhyā niṣadhe ca śaile nāgā niviṣṭāśca tathaiva nīle || 39 || śvete pitṝṇāṃ ca gatirniviṣṭā siddhāstathā śṛṅgavataśca pṛṣṭhe || sendrāstathā devagaṇāśca merau krīḍāvihāreṇa sadā vasanti || 1.7.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde jambūdvīpavarṇano nāma saptamodhyāyaḥ || 7 || || <1.8> || vajra uvāca || bhagavanbhārataṃ varṣaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || karmabhūmiṣu martyānāṃ varṣaṃ bhārgava bhāratam || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhāratasyāsya varṣasya nava bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || aṣṭabhirgiribhiśchannā yetvagamyāḥ parasparam || 2 || himācalādāsamudraṃ girayaste vyavasthitāḥ || yāmyottareṇa rājendra nāmatastānnibodha me || 3 || svamālī hemamālī ca śambhuḥ kārtasvarākaraḥ || vaiḍūryaparvataścaiva rājato maṇimānbhavaḥ || 4 || indradyumnaḥ kadetaśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān || rāgadveṣastathaivānyo gāndharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ || 5 || teṣāṃ tu navamo madhye dvīpo nāmnā tu madhyamaḥ || asminmanvantare kṣiptaḥ sāgaraiśca caturdiśam || 6 || vaiḍūryaparvataḥ pūrvamuttareṇa himācalāt || paścārdhe kāñcanagirerudageva ca lāvaṇāt || 9 || veṣṭitaḥ sāgaraḥ sarvo nānāsattvāśrayo nṛpa | || himālayaḥ sāgaraistu kṛto deśadvayastathā || 8 || lavaṇasyottare pārśve sāgarasya ca dakṣiṇe || purī laṃkā sanniviṣṭā yasyāṃ vai rāvaṇo hataḥ || 9 || lavaṇena ca saṃpṛktaḥ samudro lavaṇo yataḥ || himācalasya yo bhāgo varṣe'sminnṛpa bhārate ||1.8.1 0|| tatrāsti śailapravaro dvitīyo gandhamādanaḥ || śvetaśca parvataśreṣṭho mandaraśca mahāgiriḥ || 11 || ete śailavarā dṛṣṭā pāṇḍavaiśca mahātmabhiḥ || himācalasya madhye tu kailāso nāma parvataḥ||12|| himavatyeva vikhyāto naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ|| yatra sā badarī ramyā nānāśakunisevitā ||13|| uṣṇatoyavahā gaṅgā śvetatoyavahā parā || suvarṇasikatā rājaṃstāpasairupaśobhitā || 14 || ityete kathitā dvīpāḥ prādhānyena tavānagha || eteṣāmaṃtare dvīpāḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ ||15|| na te varṇayituṃ śakyā varṣāṇāṃ tu śatairapi || vivarjayitvā bharatasya varṣaṃ varṣeṣu sarveṣu nareṃdrasiṃha || nirāmayā vītabhayā manuṣyā varṣeṣu sarveṣu tathaiva coktāḥ || 16 || āyuḥpramāṇaṃ labhate hi rājandvīpeṣu sarveṣu naro mayoktam || kṛtvā śubhaṃ karma tu bhārate'smindvīpeṣu sarveṣu narāḥ prayānti || ||| 17 || vṛkṣeṣu teṣāṃ prabhavanti kāmāḥ striyaśca teṣāmapi rūpavatyaḥ || daṇḍaśca teṣāṃ ca na dāṇḍiko'sti sanmārgagāste'pi tathā ca rājan ||18|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bhāratavarṣavarṇanaṃ nāmā'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <1.9> || vajra uvāca || śrotuṃ janānihecchāmi sāgaradvīpavāsinaḥ || prādhānyena bhṛguśreṣṭha vistarādvistaro yataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pāñcālāḥ kuravo matsyā yaudheyāḥ savaṭaścarāḥ || kuntayaḥ śūrasenāśca madhyadeśajanāḥ smṛtāḥ || 2 || vṛṣadhvajāṃjanāḥ pannāḥ suhmā māgadhacedayaḥ || kāśayaśca videhāśca pūrvasyāṃ kośalāstathā || 3 || kaliṅgavaṅgapuṇḍrāṅgavaidarbhā mūlakāstathā|| vindhyāntanilayāḥ proktāḥ pūrvadakṣiṇataḥ smṛtāḥ || 4 || pulindāśmakajīmūtanararāṣṭra nivāsinaḥ || karṇāṭakā bhojakaṭā dakṣiṇāpathavāsinaḥ || 5 || ambaṣṭhā draviḍā nāgāḥ kāmbojāḥ strīmukhāḥ śakāḥ || ānantavāsinaścaiva jñeyā dakṣiṇapaścime || 6 || strīrājyaṃ saindhavā mlecchā nāstikyā yavanāstathā || paścimena ca vijñeyāḥ paṭumānauṣadhaiḥ saha || 7|| māṇḍavyāśca tuṣārāśca mūlikāśca mukhāḥ khaśāḥ || mahākeśā mahānāsā deśāstūrattarapaścime || 8 || lampagāstālanāgāśca marugāndhārajāhutāḥ || himavannilayā mlecchā hyudīcīṃ diśamāśritāḥ || 9 || trigartamīnakaulūtā brahmaputrāssatīgaṇāḥ || abhisārāśca kāśmīrāścodakpūrveṇa kīrtitāḥ || 1.9.10 || rājendrasāgaradvīpā pradhānā vasudhādhipāḥ || bhavate'haṃ pravakṣyāmi digdeśena nibodha tat|| 11|| pañcālanātho magadhādhipaśca kaliṅgarāḍ bhojakaṭeśvaraśca || anantakaḥ saindhavakastuṣāro madreśvaraścātha kulūtanāthaḥ || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde janapadavarṇano nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <1.10> vajra uvāca || niviṣṭānsāgare dvīpe saptāhaṃ kulaparvatān || nāmataḥ śrotumicchāmi tatprasūtāśca nimnagāḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ || vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptāsminkulaparvatāḥ || 2 || trisāmā ṛṣikulyāśca ikṣugā tridivālayā || lāṃgūlinī vaṃśadharā nadyastvetā mahendrajāḥ ||3 || kṛtamālā tāmraparṇī puṣpajā cotpalāvatī || śītodakā girivahā nadyo malayasambhavāḥ ||4|| tuṅgabhadrā suprakārā vāhyā kāverikā tathā || dakṣiṇāpathamadhyasthā sahyapādavinissṛtāḥ || 5 || ṛṣikā sukumārī ca mandagā mandavāsinī || nṛpamālā śirī caiva śuktimatpādanissṛtāḥ || 6 || mandākinī daśārṇā ca śoṇo devī ca narmadā || tamasā pippalā ceti ṛkṣavatpādaniḥsṛtāḥ ||7|| veṇā vaitaraṇī caiva narmadā ca kumudvatī || toyā setuśilā caiva vindhyapādavinissṛtāḥ ||8|| pārā carmaṇvatī pādā vidiśā veṇuvatyapi || siprā hyavantī kuntī ca pāriyātraviniḥsṛtāḥ || 9|| nadyaḥ pradhānāḥ kathitāstavaitāḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrā ṛṣisevitāśca || santīha nadyaśca sahasraśo'nyā vaktuṃ na śakyā yaduvṛndanātha | || 1.10.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde saptagiryudbhavanadīvarṇano nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1 0 || <1.11> vajra uvāca || himavatpādasambhūtāḥ puṇyā brahmanviśeṣataḥ || prādhānyena samācakṣva nadyaḥ pāpabhayāpahāḥ ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kauśeyavarṇasalilā kuśeśayavimiśritā || kauśikasya priyā nityaṃ kauśikī nimnagottamā || 2 || nimajjatpāpasaṃghaughanirmalīkaraṇe śubhā || niścarā nimnagā śreṣṭhā nityaṃ munijanapriyā ||3|| gajendrabhinnakūlā tu gaṅgātulyā ca puṇyataḥ || gandharvagaṇagītā ca gaṇḍakī gokulākulā || 4 || lokānāṃ pāvanāyālaṃ lokanāthena nirmitā || lokadṛṣṭimanohārī lohityaśca mahānadaḥ ||5|| divaḥ sevyā sadā viprairdivi devagaṇairyathā|| dṛṣadvatī samākīrṇā darśanīyodakā tathā || 6 || bahudā bahusattvā'tha menā ca pralayakṣamā || anavacchinnavāhā tu likhitasya ca bāhudā ||7|| dharmapradā sevakānāṃ dhūtapāpā mahānadī|| gomatī gokulākīrṇā gajendragaṇagāhitā || 8 || gandharvagītagaṃbhīrā gaṇayakṣagaṇairyutā || kuhūkadambakādambakekāravavināditā || 9 || kumudotpala kahlārakusumairākulodakā || devadevasya yā devī dayitā śaṅkarasya ca || 1.11.10 || devikā sā purā rājandevalokagatipradā || vistāritamahākūlā viṣamadvīpa vījitā || 11 || viṣṇulokapradā devī vitastāghavināśinī || candrabhāgā ca candrāṃśucāruśītajalāvilā || 12 || candralokapradā snāne cāmaratvapradāyinī || sarojākulatīrthā ca sarayūḥ saritāṃ varā ||13 || satataṃ sevitā sadbhiḥ somalokamabhīpsubhiḥ || indrebhasevitataṭā indraloka pradāyinī || 14 || indīvarākulajalā tathā devī irāvatī || viśiṣṭapāśavicchede vipāśā kuśalā tathā || 15 || tathaiva sarvapāpānāṃ vipākakāriṇī nṛṇām || vaśiṣṭhavidrutā devī śatadrurdrutagāminī || 16 || raudrāṇāmapi sattvānāṃ rudralokapradā śivā || kṛṣṇena kṛṣṇatoyā ca bālye pītapayodharā || 17 || yamasvasā ca yamunā yāmyaduḥkhavināśinī || saptaprakārā ca nadī tathā devī sarasvatī ||18 || tasyāḥ saptasu bhāgeṣu nāmāni śṛṇu me nṛpa || suprabhā kātarākṣī ca viśālā mānasahradā || 19 || sarasvatyoghanādā ca suveṇurvimalodakā || puṣkare naimiṣe caiva gayāyāṃ kośaleṣu ca || 1.11.20 || kurukṣetre kramājjñeyā gaṅgādvāre himācale || nadyastathaitā himavatprasūtāḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ kathitā nṛvīra || uktāśca nadyaśca sahasraśo'nyāḥ sarvāḥ pavitrā ṛṣivaryajuṣṭāḥ || 21 || varṣasya tasyāpi tathāntare'sminsaptaprakārā ca trimārgagāpi || dvīpaṃ praviṣṭā bharatasya rājan bhagīrathārādhitapadmajoktā || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍevajrasaṃvāde himavannadīvarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <1.12> ||vajra uvāca || bhāratasyāsya varṣasya bhede'sminnavame prabho || kimarthaṃ sāgaraḥ khātaḥ sa kṛtaḥ sagaraistathā||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhāratasyāsya varṣasya bhede'sminnavame nṛpa || navame ca diśāṃ bhāge pūrvasyāṃ diśi yādava ||2 || kośalo nāma viṣayaḥ prabhūtadhanadhānyavān || sphītagrāmaguṇāḍhyo'sti nityaṃ mudita mānavaḥ || 3 || payasvinyaḥ payasvinyo yatra sasyadharā dharā || mano'bhirāmā rāmāśca puruṣāḥ pauruṣāgragāḥ || 4 || vidagdhajanabhūyiṣṭhā sarvapuṇya samākulā || nagarairna viśiṣyante yatra grāmā manoharāḥ || 5 || gavāṃ praveśe sāyāhne yatra grāmeṣu bhāskaraḥ || dhūlipuñjaparikṣiptaḥ vanasānuvirājitaḥ || 6 || paścime prathame caiva yatra yāme virājitaḥ || rātrau brahmadhvanistatra tiṣṭhatīva nabhastalam || 7 || phalāvanataśākhāḍhyāśchāyādrumasamā kulāḥ || prapākūpataḍāgāḍhyā panthāno yatra yādava || 8 || vyādhitaskaradurbhikṣapararāṣṭrabhayāni ca || janā yatra na jānanti nākālamaraṇaṃ tathā || 9 || yūpacihnā mahī yatra devaveśmāvataṃsikā || yatrotpalasamākīrṇavaravāpīvibhūṣitā || 1.12.10 || udyāneṣu sadā yatra veṇugāndharvaniḥsvanam || śilīmukharavairmiśraṃ yātyasaṃbādhatāṃ guṇaiḥ || 11 || yasminna kaściccyavate svadharmāddīno jano yatra na cāsti kaścit || na netrahīno vikalendriyo vā vasundharā yatra yathārthanāmā || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kosalavarṇano nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || <1.13> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kosalāviṣaye sphīte tasminmanujapuṅgava || devānāmapyayodhyāsti tvayodhyānāmataḥ purī || 1 || prākāraparikhopetā sarayūtīraśobhitā || śobhitā bhavanairmukhyaiḥ suvibhabhaktamahāpathā || 2 || nityaprasannairmātaṅgairaṃjanācalasannibhaiḥ || devanāgakulotpannaiḥ śatasaṃkhyairvirājitā || 3 || nirmāṃsavakraisturagaiḥ sukarṇaiśca manojavaiḥ || dīrghagrīvākṣakūṭaiśca mahorujaghanairvṛtā||4|| padmagarbhasavarṇāṅgyaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ || saṃlāpollāsakuśalā yatra veśyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 5 || na tatpuṇyaṃ na sā vidyā na tacchilpaṃ na sā kriyā || ayodhyāṃ prāpya yasyārthī nirāśaḥ pratigacchati || || 6 || udyānaśatasaṃbādhā samājotsavaśālinī || arogavīrapuruṣā sarvatarkavivarjitā ||7|| vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgānāṃ śabdaiḥ satatanāditā || sadā prahṛṣṭamanujā bahuratnopaśobhitā || 8 || brahmaghoṣamahāghoṣā dvijavṛndopaśobhitā || sājyadhūmodgamāḍhyena vāyunā naṣṭakilbiṣā || 9 || sugandhidhūpavikṣepa surabhīkṛtamārutā || sugandhimanujākīrṇā nityamāpaṇavīthipu || 1.13.10 || yatra dīno jano nāsti malinaḥ kṛśito'pi vā || vedanindāparaḥ kṣudro bhinnaseturna nāstikaḥ || 11 || vistīrṇā daśa madhye ca yojanānāṃ mahāpurī || sarayūtīramāśritya yojanatrayamāyatā ||12|| manvantare'sminpunareva rājñā vinirmitā sā manunā nṛvīra || manvantaraṃ yena jagatsamagraṃ pālyaṃ yathāvadyaduvṛndanātha || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ayodhyāvarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <1.14> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vaivasvatena manunā yena sā nirmitā purī || sa tu kṛtvā ciraṃ rājyamikṣvākumabhiṣicya ca || 1 || puttre bhāraṃ samāveśya saśarīro divaṃ gataḥ || tatrasthaḥ pālayannāste trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 2 || tena manvantaraṃ sarvaṃ pālanīyamidaṃ jagat || ikṣvākustasya tanayaḥ pālayāmāsa medinīm ||3|| dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || sudarśaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nayāpanayakovidaḥ || 4 || brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca dīnānāthānukampakaḥ || daivamantraprabhūtsāha śaktibhiśca samanvitaḥ ||5 || ṣāḍguṇyavinmahotsāhaḥ smitapūrvābhibhāṣaṇaḥ || yuktadaṃḍo na nirdaṃḍo na ca daṇḍaratistathā ||6|| vedavedāṅgatattvajño yajñayājī taporatiḥ || akṣudralīlo'bhimataḥ sarvasattvo na hiṃsakaḥ || 7 || mānyo mānayatāṃ śakyaḥ sukhaḥ pūjyaprapūjakaḥ || kāmaḥ krodho mado māno lobho harṣastathaiva ca || 8 || nityaṃ śarīraprabhavā ripavastena ṣaḍ jitāḥ || sarvatra vidhinā dṛśyaḥ subhagaḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 9 || bahudhānyo bahudhano bahunāgāśvapūruṣaḥ || ayodhyānilayo nityaṃ devā rigaṇadarpahā ||1.14.1 0|| sa tadā pālayāmāsa putravatsakalāḥ prajāḥ || nādharmaḥ kaścidapyāsīttasminrājani mānavaḥ || 11 || dīno vā vyādhito vāpi svalpāyurvā ca duḥkhitaḥ || mūrkho vā mandarūpo vā durbhago vā nirākṛtiḥ ||12|| ekatra dehe sakalaṃ guṇaughaṃ draṣṭāhamityeva viśiṣṭabuddhiḥ || sasarja yaṃ rājavaraṃ mahātmā prajāpatiḥ sarvajagatpradhānaḥ ||13|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ikṣvākukulavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| |||14|| <1.15> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ikṣvākorabhavatputro vikukṣirnnāma dhārmikaḥ || kakutsthastanayastasya cānenāstasya cātmajaḥ ||1|| tasya putraḥ pṛthuḥ śrīmān viśvadāsastadātmajaḥ || tasya śrāvastako nāma śrāvastī yena nirmitā||2|| bṛhadaśvaḥ sutastasya kuvalāśvastadātmajaḥ || kuvalāśvo mahātejā dhundhumāratvamāgataḥ || dhuṃdhuṃ hatvā mahākāyamudake jalarākṣasam || 3 || vajra uvāca || kathaṃ dhuṃdhurmahātejāḥ kuvalāśvena ghātitaḥ || kaścāyaṃ dhuṃdhurityeṣa viśruto jalarākṣasaḥ || 4|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ekārṇave purā loke naṣṭasthāvarajaṅgame || 5 || naṣṭacandrārkapavane vinaṣṭagrahatārake || śeṣaparyaṅkamāsādya supto devo janārdanaḥ || 6 || nābhau tasya samutpannaṃ devasya kamalaṃ śubham || tatra jajñe svayaṃ brahmā devaḥ śubhacaturmukhaḥ||7|| tatrāste so'bhyasanvedānsupte deve janārdane || upāsāṃcakrire tasya vedā dehabhṛtastathā || 8 || vedabhyāsarate tatra svedabindurajāyata || sapadmapatramāsādya dvidhābhūtobhavannṛpa || 9 || rajastamomayau tasmājjātau daityau balotkaṭau || madhukaiṭabhanāmānau mahābalaparākramau || 1.15.10 || tatastau jahraturvedānbrahmaṇaḥ pāpaniścayau || saśarīreṣu vedeṣu hateṣvatha pitāmahaḥ || 11|| bodhayāmāsa deveśaṃ padmanābhaṃ sa cānaghaḥ || sa vibuddhastadā devaḥ kṛtvā hayaśirodharam || 12 || śaśāṅkaśatasaṃkāśaṃ nānābharaṇaśobhitam || dvitīyena śarīreṇa rasātalatalaṃ gataḥ || 13|| tenāśvaśirasā gatvā vedānādāya śāśvatān || pitāmahāya pradadau bhūya eva jagadguruḥ ||14|| tato hayaśirodhārī gatontardhānamīśvaraḥ || ājagmatustato deśaṃ dānavau madhukaiṭabhau ||15|| viṣṇuścakāra dehau dvau viṣṇurjiṣṇu riti smṛtau || madhunā yuyudhe jiṣṇurviṣṇurvai kaiṭabhena ca || 16 || tatastayoḥ suyuddhena tuṣṭo devo janārdanaḥ || uvāca tau mahākāyau dānavau madhu kaiṭabhau || 17 || varaṃ varayatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavantāvaparājitau || tāvabrūtāṃ tato devaṃ viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanam || 18 || putro'smākaṃ bhaveddeva mahābalaparākramaḥ || putre jāte tu yau tau dvau viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā purā || 19 || nihatau ca tadā vīrau hyudakaṃ ca samāśritau || medo mumucatustatra vyāptā yenābhavanmahī || || 1.15.20 || medinīti tataḥ khyātā loke'smiṃstattvacintakaiḥ || varāharūpeṇa tadā coddhṛtā vasudhā tataḥ || 21 || tenaiva devadevena pūrvasthāne nive śitā || sargaṃ cakre tato brahmā devadevasya śāsanāt || 22 || evaṃ tadā devavarasya yuddhe nipātitau tau madhukaiṭabhākhyau || devasya viṣṇoḥ sadanaṃ prayātau kṣīrārṇave tasya samīpagau ca || 23|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde madhukaiṭabhavadhopākhyānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <1.16> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhāratasyāsya varṣasya bhāge'sminnavame nṛpa || samudro vālukāpūrṇa ujjānaka iti śrutiḥ || 1 || tasya madhye samudrasya dhundhuprasthapateḥ sadā || saṃvatsarasya sonte tu mahocchvāsaṃ pramuñcati ||2|| yadā tadā bhūḥ skhalati saśailavanakānanā| prāṇino ye'lpasattvāśca te yānti yamasādanam || 3 || yadā vibuddho bhavati kiñciccheṣā mahī tadā || āhārārthaṃ karotyugraḥ pāpātmā jalarākṣasaḥ || 4 || etasminneva kāle tu cottaṅkastapyate tapaḥ || tapasonte mahātmānaṃ dadarśa madhusūdanam || 5 || tamuvāca harirdevo varaṃ varaya bhārgava | || uttaṃkaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam || 6 || uvāca varadaṃ devameṣa eva varo mama || yadahaṃ devadevasya dṛṣṭavāṃścaraṇāmbujau || 7 || śrībhagavānuvāca || avaśyaṃ te varo deyo mayā bhṛgukulodvaha || ajaraścāmaraścaiva matprasādādbhaviṣyasi || 8 || yatrecchasi jalaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati tathā tava || devatānāṃ mahatkāryaṃ tathaiva ca kariṣyasi || 9 || āśramasyāsya te bādhāṃ yaḥ karoti sadānagha || kuvalāśvena taṃ gatvā dhuṃdhu ghātaya mā ciram || 1.16.10 || ahaṃ cāsya pravekṣyāmi kuvalāśvasya vigraham || tejasā sa madīyena dhuṃdhumājau haniṣyati || 11 || na hyalpatejasā hantuṃ dhuṃdhuḥ śakyo bhṛgūttama || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etāvaduktvā bhagavān gato'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ || 12 || jagāma ca tathāyodhyāmuttaṃko'pi mahātapāḥ || pūjito bṛhadaśvena bṛhadaśvamabhāṣata || 13 || utaṅka uvāca || kathaṃ nidrāsi rājendra sukhaṃ paryaṅkamāsthitaḥ || dhundhoścaritamālokya baddhakakṣo bhavādhunā || 14 || vacanānmama rājendra dhuṃdhuṃ hantuṃ tavāsti bhoḥ || śaktiḥ kimudyamādrājñāṃ duṣkaraṃ te punaḥ katham || 15 || jahi dhuṃdhuṃ mahākāyaṃ nṛpate dvijabādhakam || śrutvā munivaco rājā kuvalāśvamabhāṣata || 16 || ahaṃ vanapravṛttastu tyaktadaṇḍastathaiva ca || jahi taṃ dānavaśreṣṭhaṃ tvamuttaṅkena pālitaḥ || 17 || evamuktaḥ pariṣvaktaḥ pitrā prakṛtivatsalaḥ || uttaṅkasahito gatvā yuddhāyodakarākṣasam || 18 || yuyudhe taṃ ca dharmātmā dhuṃdhuṃ tenaiva keśavaḥ || utaṅkānumate paścādbrahmāstreṇa jaghāna tam || 19 || hatvā taṃ rākṣasaṃ lebhe tridaśebhyastadā varān || kṛṣṇe bhaktiṃ sthitiṃ dharme vāsaṃ svarge tathākṣayam || 1.16.20 || madhukaiṭabhayoḥ putraṃ ghātayitvā narādhipa || dhundhumāratvamagamadaśobhata tathā purīm || 21 || tasminhate daityavare prasannā diśo babhūvurmuditāśca devāḥ || vinaṣṭavighnaṃ ca jagattadāsa rājā ca kīrtiṃ paramāmavāpa || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dhuṃdhumāropākhyānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <1.17> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhuṃdhumārāddṛḍhāśvastu haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ || nikuṃbhastasya tanayaḥ suhitaśca tadātmajaḥ|||||| bhṛśāśvastanayastasya māndhātā tasya cātmajaḥ|| daivena vidhinā rājā jātastasyaiva codarāt || 2 || purukutsaḥ sutastasya trasaddasyustadātmajaḥ || śambhustasyātmajaḥ śrīmānanaraṇyeti viśrutaḥ ||3|| rāvaṇena hato yo'sau trilokavijayī purā || dṛśadaśvaḥ sutastasya tasmādvasumanā nṛpaḥ || 4 || tasya putrastridhanvākhyaḥ tasmāttryyāraṇiḥ smṛtaḥ || tasya satyavrataḥ putraḥ triśaṅkuṃ yaṃ pracakṣate || 5 || hariścandraḥ sutastasya rohitāśvastadātmajaḥ || haritastatsuto rājā cañcurhārita ucyate || 6 || vijayastasya tanayaścālarkastasya cātmajaḥ || alarkasya vṛkaḥ putrastasmādbāhustu jajñivān ||7|| pānastrīmṛgayākṣeṣu sa bahuvyasanānvitaḥ || vyasane tasya saktasya narendrasyāribhistadā || 8 || haihayaistālajaṅghaiśca sarvamlecchagaṇāvṛtaiḥ || chalenāpahṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hṛtarājyo vanaṃ gataḥ || 9 || padbhyāmanuyayau tasya vanaṃ bhāryā guṇānvitā || gurviṇī prāgdadau yasyāḥ sapatnī tu garaṃ kila ||1.17.1 0|| tatassā sagaraṃ putraṃ suṣāva vanagā śubhā || jātaputro narapatiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kālakarmaṇā ||11|| anvāruroha taṃ rājñī yādavī dharmavatsalā|| saṃskṛtaḥ sarvasaṃskāraiḥ sagaraścyavanena ca ||12|| śāstragrāme dhanurvede nītaḥ pāraṃ tathā param|| sa yauvanamanuprāpya eka eva narādhipaḥ||13|| padātirbaddhanistriṃśaścyavanasya prasādataḥ || haihayāṃstālajaṅghāṃśca nijaghāna parantapaḥ||14|| tatastvayodhyāṃ saṃprāpya lebhe rājyamakaṃṭakam|| sagaro rājyamāsādya balena caturaṅgiṇā ||15|| vijitya sakalānmlecchānvaśaṃ cakre ca pārthivān || vijitya pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam || 16 || cyavanaṃ pūjayāmāsa satkāreṇa punaḥpunaḥ || cyavanenābhyanujñātaḥ sa cakre dārasaṃgraham || 17 || āsīdbhāryādvayaṃ tasya sagarasya mahātmanaḥ || sa tābhyāṃ sahito rājā putrārthaṃ taptavāṃstapaḥ ||18|| tapasonte haraḥ prāha rājānaṃ tapasā kṛśam || ekaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ putramekā te janayiṣyati ||19|| ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi dvitīyā janayiṣyati || evaṃ labdhavaro rājā sabhāryaḥ svapuraṃ gataḥ || 1.17.20 || putraṃ putrāṃśca dharmāpmā janayāmāsa vīryavān || karmaṇā caiva nāmnā ca rājaputro'samañjasaḥ||21|| pitrā vivāsito rājyātpaurāṇāmahite rataḥ|| tasya putroṃśumānnāma sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ || toṣayāmāsa pitaraṃ pituḥ pṛthvīpatiṃ ca saḥ || 22 || pautreṇa tenānaghaḥ sevyamānaḥ putrairmahāvīryaparākramaiśca || sa rañjayanrājavaro jitāriḥ śaśāsa pṛthvīṃ sakalāṃ mahātmā || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sagaropākhyānaṃ nāma sapta daśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <1.18> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sagarasya tu te putrāssaṃhatā vīryasaṃyutāḥ || saṃjātā daivayogena devabrāhmaṇakaṃṭakāḥ || 1 || teṣāṃ tu karmaṇodvignā devāḥ sarve pitāmaham || abruvansāgaraiḥ sarvairdeva bādhyāma saṃhataiḥ ||2|| evamuktastadā brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || uvāca devānsakalānsāgaraiḥ pratyamarṣitān || 3 || yastvasya jagato nāthaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ || vāsudevaḥ sa kapilaḥ surāstān ghātayiṣyati || 4 || evamuktāḥ surā stena yayuḥ sarve triviṣṭapam || etasminneva kāle tu sagaraḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || 5 || dīkṣito vājimedhāya vidhivadvedapāragaiḥ || turaṅgaṃ cārayāmāsuryajñiyaṃ tanayā mahīm || 6 || teṣāṃ cārayatāṃ so'śvaḥ kapilena tathā hṛtaḥ || kapilena hṛtaṃ nāśvaṃ te jānanti vimohitāḥ || 7 || anveṣanto'pi yatnena nāpuste turagaṃ yataḥ || pitre nivedya te sarve nicakhnuḥ pṛthivītalam || 8 || bhāratasyāsya varṣasya bhede'sminnavame nṛpa || samantatastataścakruḥ khātakarmabalānvitāḥ || 9 || vistarādyojanaśataṃ pātālatalagāminam || vaiḍūryapavartātpūrvamuttareṇa himācalāt || 1.18.10 || paścārdhe kāñcanagirerudageva ca lāvaṇāt || himācalaśca tairvīraḥ rājandeśadvaye kṣataḥ || 11 || himācalasya khaṇḍaśca khātasyāntaḥ praveśitaḥ || uttaraḥ sāgarastasmāddhima śailena durgamaḥ || 12 || evaṃvidhena khātena te praviśya pṛthakpṛthak || ekīkṛtā daivayogātkapilo yatra vai sthitaḥ || 13 || kapilasya samīpasthaṃ dadṛśuste turaṅgamam || turaṅgasahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kapilaṃ te tvamarṣitāḥ || 14 || kuddālalepikāhastāstasya jagmurvadhepsayā || tānbādhamānāndurbuddhīnsa dadarśa tadā ṛṣiḥ || 15 || cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭamātrāste bhasmībhūtāstu sāgarāḥ || narakaṃ ca gatāḥ sarve devabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakāḥ || 16 || vijñāya tanayānnaṣṭānnāradātsagaro nṛpaḥ || preṣayāmāsa satatamaṃśumantaṃ sa dhārmikam ||17 || aṃśumānapi saṃprāpya kapilaṃ munisattamam|| abhivādya mahātejāstuṣṭāva yadunandanaḥ || 18 || tasya tuṣṭo'tha turagaṃ dattavānkapilo muniḥ || aṃśumantaṃ tadovāca pitṝṇāṃ salilārthinām || 19 || pautraste bhavitā rājaṃstapasā tasya toṣitā || āgamiṣyati sā devī gaṅgā gaganamekhalā || 1.18.20 || tayā klinnamidaṃ bhasma sāgarāṇāṃ durātmanām || 21 || yadā bhaviṣyati tadā sāgarāḥ svargagāminaḥ || anyasyāpi yadā tvasthi gaṅgātoye patiṣyati || 22 || tasyāpi svarlokagatirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || evamuktoṃśumāñśīghraṃ cābhivādya jagadgurum || 23 || āgamya yojayāmāsa turageṇa pitāmaham || yajñaṃ samāpayāmāsa sagaro'pi mahīpatiḥ || 24 || evaṃ hi sāgarairmattaiḥ khātako nṛpasattama || yena klṛptamidaṃ dvīpaṃ sāgaraṃ nṛpa kathyate|| || 25 || lavaṇodātsamudrācca toyena nṛpa sāgaraḥ|| yadā pūrṇastadā jāto lavaṇodo narādhipa || 26 || kṛtsnaṃ ya evaṃ jayati sa samrāḍiti kīrtyate || tato gataḥ sa dharmātmā kālena mahatā divam || 27 || dilīpe bhāramāsajya jagāma tanaye svake || dilīpo'pi samādāya rājyaṃ putraṃ bhagīratham || 28 || jagāma tridivaṃ rājā vane taptvā mahattapaḥ || āsādya rājyaṃ sa bhagīratho'pi ānīya gaṅgāṃ tapasā ca bhūmim || 29 || saṃplāvayāmāsa jalena bhasma tatsāgarāṇāṃ yaduvṛndanātha || 1.18.30 || saṃplāvite bhasmani rājaputrā gaṅgājalaughena divaṃ prayātāḥ || svarlokamāsādya tathā'kṣayaṃ te vasanti hṛṣṭāstridaśaiḥ sametāḥ ||31|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sagaropākhyānaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <1.19> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || rājyaṃ prāpya mahātejā dilīpatanayo nṛpaḥ || narakasthān pitṝñśrutvā rājyaṃ nyasyāśu vṛddhaye ||1|| gaṅgāmārādhayāmāsa tapasā mahatā tadā || yamaiśca niyamai rājannaparṇāśanakaistathā || 2|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe bhṛśaṃ nṛpaḥ || atha gaṃgā mahādevī prasannābhūdgataklamā || 3 || bhagīratho'pi dharmātmā varaṃ lebhe kutūhalī || tato lekhanadī devī prāvocattaṃ bhagīratham || 4 || patantyā gaganātsoḍhuṃ mama vegaṃ vasundharā || 5 || na samarthā yadā tasmāttoṣayasvāśu śaṃkaram || sa hi śaktaḥ pataṃtyā me vegaṃ soḍhuṃ nareśvara||6|| evamuktvā yayau devī tadāntardhānamīśvarī|| bhagīratho'pi dharmātmā tapastepe sudāruṇam||7|| ārādhanārthaṃ devasya śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ|| tapaso'nte mahātejā dṛṣṭavāñjagadīśvaram||8|| devadeva uvāca|| tapasogreṇa te rājan prasanno'smi yathepsitam|| dadāmi te yato bhaktiṃ pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayaṃ yaśaḥ ||9|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| evamuktastu devena pūjayitvā maheśvaram || jagāma gaṅgāṃ manasā rājā pūrṇamanorathaḥ ||1.19.10|| śaṅkarādhiṣṭhitaṃ jñātvā nṛpateśca cikīrṣitam || papāta gananādgaṃgā tadā rājīvalocana ||11|| gaṃgāyāḥ patanaṃ jñātvā brahmā taṃ deśamāgataḥ || yamendravaruṇāndevānpuraskṛtyāmitaujasaḥ || 12 || ṛṣayo nāgagandharvavidyādharamahoragāḥ || suparṇakinnaragaṇāstathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 13 || vimānaśatasaṃbādhaṃ tadbabhūva nabhastalam || prakīryamāṇaṃ kusumairdevanāgavirājitam || suraprabhādurnirīkṣyaṃ tadābharaṇabhāsuram ||14|| sugandhi cāru pavanaṃ suratūryanināditam || nabhasastasya madhyena papāta gaganānnadī ||15|| viśāmi bhittvā pātālaṃ srotasā gṛhya śaṅkaram || ityevaṃ duṣṭabhāvā sā papāta haramūrdhani ||16|| jñātvā krūramabhiprāyaṃ devyā devaḥ pinākabhṛt|| jaṭākalāpe tāṃ devīṃ tiraścakre caturmukhaḥ ||17|| babhrāma sā tiro bhūtvā tatraiva tvaciraṃ nadī || tasyāḥ pataṃtyā ye kecidbiṃdavaḥ kṣitimāgatāḥ||16|| taiḥ kṛtaṃ pṛthivīpāla tadā vindusaraḥ śubham|| devopi dṛṣṭvā rājānaṃ kṣudhayā vyākulendriyam || 19 || tatyāja tāṃ tadā śīghraṃ jaṭāgreṇa maheśvaraḥ ||1.19.20|| dhṛtagaṃgo jagāmātha tato'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ || maheśvaraśirobhraṣṭā praviṣṭā ca saraḥ śubham || 21 || tasmādviniḥsṛtā bhūyaḥ saptadhā devanimnagā || hlādinī hrādinī caiva plāvinī ceti prācyagāḥ ||22|| sītāvaktraśca sindhuśca pratīcyabhimukhā gatāḥ || dakṣiṇena tathā gaṃgā bhagīrathapathānugā || kvacidvegena mahatā kvacinmandavisarpiṇī || 23 || kvacitphenākulajalā kvacidāvartamālinī || kvacidgambhīraśabdaughā niḥśabdā ca tathā kvacit || 24 || kvaciddhaṃsaravoddāmā cakravākayugā kvacita || ūrmimālākulajalā kusumotkaramaṇḍitā||25|| jalasattvaśatākīrṇā surasiddhasukhapradā || amṛtasvādusalilā harasaṃsarganirmalā || 26 || viṣṇupādaprahārotthā sarvapāta kanāśinī || evaṃ saṃprāpya sā viṃdhyaṃ praviṣṭā pūrvasāgaram || 27 || sāgareṇa samāsādya pātālaṃ bhīmadarśanam || plāvayāmāsa tadbhasma sāgarāṇāṃ mahātmanām||28|| bhasmani plāvite sarve gatāste sāgarā divam ||29|| evaṃ dharāṃ devanadī prayātā supuṇyatoyā ṛṣivaryajuṣṭā || mahānubhāvā nṛpa jahnukanyā niśreṇibhūtā tridivaprayāṇe ||1.19.30|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gaṅgāvataraṇanāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||19|| <1.20> vajra uvāca || bhāgīrathītvaṃ gaṅgātvaṃ devanadyā mayā śrutam || kirmarthaṃ jāhnavī loke kathyate sāgaraṅgamā || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pañcālākhyo'sti viṣayo madhyadeśe mahīpate | svadharmakarmaniratairyuto varṇāśramaiḥ sadā || 2 || mahodayaṃ puraṃ tatra kuśastambhena nirmitam || sarvaratnasamākīrṇaṃ kānyakubjeti viśrutam || 3 || tasminbabhūva bhūpālo jahnuḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || yasya kīrtimataḥ kīrtirbrahmāṇḍaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati || 4 || sa kadācinmahīpālo hayamedhamupāharat || dīkṣitasya narendrasya yajñavāṭaṃ tu nimragā || 5 || plāvayāmāsa vegena jalaughairyadusattam || 1|| plāvite yajñavāṭe tu rājā gaṅgāṃ tadābravīt || 6|| asya gaṅgai'valepasya sadyaḥ phalamavāpnuhi || pibāmi sakalaṃ toyaṃ tava sāgaravallabhe || 7 || evamuktvā papau rājā sarvaṃ bhāgīrathījalam || tapasā mahatā rājaṃstathā yogabalena ca || 8 || dṛṣṭvaiva gaṅgāṃ nistoyāṃ dīnairmunijanaistataḥ || prasāditastu gaṅgārthe tatyāja śravaṇena tām || 9 || duhitṛtve ca jagrāha rājā bhāgīrathīṃ tadā || tena sā kathitā loke jāhnavī yadunandana || 1.20.10 || atīva darpito rājā gaṅgāyāḥ sa yadā nṛpa || yaśo'rthaṃ plāvayāmāsa yajñavāṭaṃ tadānagha ||11|| evaṃ triloke nṛpa jahnukanyā proktā budhairviṣṇupadī pavitrā || himācalasyādripatestanūjā samudrapatnī varadā viśokā || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde jahnukanyopākhyānaṃ nāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <1.21> vajra uvāca || gaṅgā viṣṇupadī loke kimarthaṃ kathitā budhaiḥ || tanmamācakṣva tattvena bhṛguvaṃśavivardhana || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || svāyambhuventare pūrvaṃ catvāro devatāgaṇāḥ || jayākhyāścājitākhyāśca śukrākhyāśca prakīrtitāḥ || 2 || teṣāṃ babhūva devendro viśvabhuglokapūjitaḥ || āsaṃstasyā surā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || 3 || babhūva rājā teṣāṃ ca bāṣkalirnnāma nāmataḥ || yena vikramya śakrasya hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tadā balāt || 4 || hṛtarājyastu devendro brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || brahmāpi śakramādāya jagāma śaraṇaṃ harim || 5 || nivedayāmāsa tadā devadevāya śārṅgiṇe || bāṣkalervijayaṃ sarvaṃ brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || 6 || śrībhagavānuvāca || brahmanpratyāhariṣyāmi rājyamasya śatakratoḥ|| divi deveṣu dharmātmannivṛtto bhava mā ciram ||7|| ahaṃ vāmanarūpeṇa prayāsye bāṣkaliṃ nṛpam || māṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitaṃ tantu gatvā yācatu devarāṭ || 8 || lokatrayaṃ mama hṛtaṃ tvayā vikramya bāṣkale || tatrāgniśaraṇārthāya dīyatāṃ me kramatrayam || 9 || atīva hrasvagātrasya vāmanasyāsya mā ciram || evamuktastu śakreṇa tadā dātā kramatrayam || 1.21.10 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || ityevamukto devena brahmā svabhavanaṃ gataḥ || devo'pi vāmano bhūtvā prayāto yatra bāṣkaliḥ || 11 || bāṣkalirvāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ || nirīkṣya taṃ yathākāmamasurairbahubhirvṛtaḥ || 12 || etasminneva kāle tu śakrastaṃ deśamāyayau || pādyārghyācamanīyādyaiḥ śakraṃ saṃpūjya bāṣkaliḥ || 13 || kimāgamanakāryaṃ te tamuvāca prahṛṣṭavāk || atyāścaryamidaṃ manye tavāgamana kāraṇam || 14 || śakra uvāca || lokatrayaṃ me'pahṛtaṃ vikrameṇa tu bāṣkale || tatrāgniśaraṇārthāya dīyatāṃ me kramatrayam || 15 || atīva hrasvagātrasya vāmanasyāsya pārthiva || bhūmibhāge tu pārakye vastuṃ na tvahamutsahe||16|| bāṣkaliruvāca || kramatrayaṃ vāmanake devarāja kṛtaṃ śubham || tatrāssvamuditaḥ prāptaḥ sukhī surapate bhava || 17 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamukto bāṣkalinā tyaktvā rūpaṃ tu vāmanam ||16|| harirvicakrame lokāndevānāṃ hitakāmyayā || brahmalokaṃ tato gatvā..... || devasya vāmaścaraṇo niviṣṭo dānavālaye || 19 || tataḥ kramaṃ sa prathamaṃ dadau sūryye jagatpatiḥ || dvitīyaṃ ca dhruve devastṛtīyena ca yādava | || 1.21.20 || brahmāṇḍaṃ tāḍayāmāsa hyasaṃpūrṇena keśavaḥ || brahmāṇḍastāḍitastena chidratāmagamatprabho ||21|| brahmāṇḍabāhyatoyena śataghnenāmbhasāvṛtam || tenacchidreṇa tattoyaṃ viveśāṇḍaṃ mahīpate || 22 || aṃguṣṭhāgrakṣatādaṇḍādyatpraviṣṭaṃ jalaṃ śuci || prāptā devanadītvaṃ tu sā tu viṣṇupadī nadī || 23 || devanadyā tayā vyāptaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ nṛpa || vibhūtibhirmahābhāga sarvānugrahakāmyayā || 24 || vāmanena samākrāntāḥ sarve lokā yadānagha || asuraiste tadā tyaktā devānāṃ satyabāndhavaiḥ || 25 || pātālaśca yadā tena nākrāntaṃ harimedhasā || asuraistaistadā ghorairuṣyate yadunandana || 26 || devo'pi hṛtvā trailokyaṃ jagāmādarśanaṃ tadā || pātālanilayaścāpi sukhamāste sa bāṣkaliḥ || 27 || śakro'pi pālayāmāsa vipaścidbhuvanaṃ tadā || imaṃ trivikramaṃ nāma prādurbhāvaṃ jagadguroḥ || 28 || gaṅgāsaṃbhavasaṃyuktaṃ sarvakilviṣanāśanam || 29 || tenaiva devadevena prāpte vaivasvate'ntare || bhūyo lokāstrayaḥ krāntāḥ padā saṃyamino nṛpa || 1.21.30 || anena kāraṇenoktā gaṃgā viṣṇupadī nṛpa || yayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ||31|| gaṃgāsamutpattiriyaṃ mayoktā śrutvaiva yāṃ muñcati sarvapāpam || pāpairviśiṣṭo'pi naro nṛvīra sādhuvratastu tridivaṃ prayāti || 32 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde trivikramopākhyānaṃ nāmaikaviṃśa titamo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || <1.22> vajra uvāca || brahmanviṣṇupadī gaṃgā trailokyaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati || yathā tathā bhṛguśreṣṭha sarvameva prakīrtaya || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || praviśya devī brahmāṇḍaṃ viṣṇulokamupāgatā || brāhmīṃ sabhāṃ plāvayitvā tapolokamupāgatā || 2 || janalokaṃ gatā tasmānmaharllokaṃ tato gatā || svargalokaṃ samāsādya praviṣṭā candramaṇḍalam || 3 || candramaṇḍalavibhraṣṭā bhuvarlokamupāgatā || ākāśagaṃgā kathitā tatra sā rativardhinī ||4 || tasyāstu dṛśyate panthāḥ satataṃ vyomni nirmale || ākāśagaṃgāmadhye sā merau nipatitā girau || 5 || merumadhyādadṛśyantī dṛśyantī ca tathā kvacit || prayātā sarvavarṣāṇi dvīpāni ca mahāmate|||| sā tu devī jayā nāma kuruvarṣe hradāstu te || tebhyaḥ śāntā ca sādhvī ca dvidhā gaṃgā vinissṛtā || 7 || jyotsnā ca mṛgamandā ca smṛtā hairaṇvatī śubhā || puṇḍarīkā payodā ca ramye varṣe nigadyate || 8 | bhadrā ca kathitā devī gāndharvī ca mano'nugā || ilāvṛte tathā saiva proktā jāmbavatī śubhā || 9 || tasyāstīrabhavaṃ mūrdhni kanakaṃ dhāryate suraiḥ|| ketumāle ca kathitā nirmalā naḍvalā tathā || 1.22.10 || manasvinī jyotiṣmatī harivarṣe nigadyate|| tathā kimpuruṣākhye tu rambhā candravatī śubhā ||11||| indradyumnapayodā sā kāśaikā matipāvanī || manojavā tāmraparṇī gabhastimatimālinī || 12 || nāgadvīpe nāgavatī saumye somaprabhā tathā || rudralokaṃ tataḥ prāptā brahmalokaṃ tato gatā || 13 || gāndharvī caiva gandharvī vāruṇe varuṇahradā || hrādinī hlādinī caiva puṇyatoyā ca varṣiṇī || 14 || sītā cakṣuśca sindhuśca gaṃgā cāsminprakīrtitā || amarānniṣadhānsarvāndhīvarānṛṣikāṃstathā || 15 || oṣṭhaprāvaraṇānsaumyānkarṇaprāvaraṇāṃstathā |||| kālodarānvikarṇāṃśca hrādinī tu niṣevate || 16 || indradyumnasaraḥ puṇyamupacārādajāyata || tathā kharapadāndeśānvetraśaṅkupadānapi || 17 || tañjānakāmataṃ caiva hlādinī tu niṣevate || daradāñjahuḍāṃścaiva kāśmīrānnairasānkurūn || 18 || gāndhārāndaradābhīrānkuparvānbhīmarauravān || 53| śivaparvānindraparvānsindhutīrānniṣevate || 19 || devāndaityānkālakeyāngandharvānkinnarāṃstathā || vidyādharāṃstathā nāgānsuparvānsumanoharān || 1.22.20 || kalāpagrāmakāṃścaiva naranārāyaṇāśramam || kirātāṃśca pulindāṃśca mayasya nagarīṃ tathā || 21 || kutūnsabhāratāṃścaiva pulindām̐ścaiva bhāgaśaḥ || pāñcālānkāśayānvatsānmāgadhāṃstāmraliptakān || 22 || sahyottarāṃśca vaṅgāṃśca tathā śrāvastivāsina || aṅgānvaṃgānsapuṇḍrāṃśca gaṃgā bhāvayate śubhā || 23 || hrādinī hlādinī caiva pāvanī jāhnavī tathā || praviṣṭā sāgaraṃ pūrvaṃ dvīpesminnṛpasattama || 24 || sītācakṣuśca sindhuśca paścimaṃ nṛpa sāgaram || gaṅgāvyāptistava proktā jambūdvīpe mayānagha || 25 || lokeṣu ca tathā rājandvīpeṣvanyeṣu me śṛṇu || sukumārī kumārī ca sukṛtā sevinī tathā || 26 || ikṣuśca veṇukā nandā śākadvīpe ca saptadhā || śālmale tvatha gomede dvīpe puṣkarasaṃjñake || 27 || nadītvaṃ sā samutsṛjya codadhitvamupāgatā || tasmindvīpatraye nadyo na santi yadunandana ||28|| udakānyudbhidānyeva teṣu santi sahasraśaḥ || evaṃ bhūmitalaṃ plāvya pātālaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikam || 29 || ekībhūtā praviṣṭā sā bhogavatyāṃ samīpataḥ || śvetabhaumaṃ gatā tasmādraktabhaumaṃ tato gatā || 1.22.30 || śilābhaumaṃ gatā tasmādrukmabhaumaṃ tato gatā || rukmabhaumādapi gatā raudraṃ tejassudāruṇam || 31 || tato'pi vilayaṃ gatvā vārāhaṃ lokamāgatā || vārāhalokādbrahmāṇḍaṃ tadarthaṃ bhinna vāhinī || 32 || chidreṇa tena sā devī svāṃ yoniṃ punarāgatā || 33 || evaṃ narendreśa jagatsamagramākramya gaṃgā satataṃ sthitā yā || tasyāḥ prabhāvaśravaṇādaśeṣaṃ pāpaṃ narāṇāṃ samupaiti śāṃtim || 34 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gaṃgāvyāptirnāma dvāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || <1.23> vajra uvāca || bhagīrathasya rājarṣervaṃśamuttamapūruṣaṃ || tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi gaṅgā yenāvatāritā || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhagīrathasutaḥ śrīmānviśruto nāma dhārmikaḥ || viśrutasyātmajaḥ śrīmānnābhāga iti viśrutaḥ || 2 || ambarīṣastu nābhāgirayutāristadātmajaḥ || tatsuto ṛtuparṇaśca rājā nalasakho balī || 3 || śarvakāmaḥ sutastasya sudāsastasya cātmajaḥ || tasya mitrasahaḥ putraḥ tasya putrośmako nṛpa || 4 || mūlakastatsuto rājā mahābuddhirnareśvaraḥ || kṣatriyāṇāṃ vadhe ghore rāmeṇa vinipātitaḥ || 5 || purā pitṛvadhāmarṣādrāmo bhārgavanandanaḥ || triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ cakre niḥkṣatriyāmimām ||6|| bhagīrathakulotpannaṃ mūlakaṃ nāma jaghnivān || vajra uvāca || kathaṃ rāmeṇa vasudhā purā niḥkṣattriyā kṛtā || kimarthaṃ ca mahābhāga tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 7|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| somavaṃśasamutpanno yayātirnāma pārthivaḥ || tasyāpi saṃhataḥ putro babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ || 6 || sahasrajitsutastasya nabhajittasya cātmajaḥ || tasyāpi haihayaḥ putraḥ kuntistasyāpi cātmajaḥ || 9 || tasyāpi saṃhataḥ putro mahiṣmāṃ'stasya cātmajaḥ || māhiṣmatī kṛtā yena nagarī sumanoharā || 1.23.10 || bhadraśreṇyaḥ sutastasya durmadastasya cātmajaḥ || kanakastatsuto rājā kṛtavīryastadātmajaḥ ||1 1|| arjunastanayastasya saptadvīpeśvaro'bhavat|| dattātreyo'tha bhagavānviṣṇurūpānurūpadhṛk||12|| ārādhya tapasā yena prāptaṃ rājyaṃ sudurlabham || tathā bāhusahasraṃ ca matiṃ dharme tathottamām || 13 || adharme varttamānasya maraṇaṃ ca janārdanāt || yuddhena pṛthivīṃ jitvā dharmeṇaivānuraṃjayan || 14 || teneyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā sapattanā || saptodadhiparikṣiptā kṣātreṇa vidhinā jitā || 15 || pātālanagare śaile vasudhāyāṃ rasātale || tasya pārthivasiṃhasya cakraṃ na pratihanyate ||16|| dvīpeṣu sa hi sarveṣu khātaṃ khātamathā'karot || yūpacihnāni ca tathā khaḍgī śataśanī rathī || 17 || deśānanucaranyogātsadā paśyati taskarān|| sa eva paśupālobhūtkṣetrapālaḥ sa eva ca || 18 || sa eva vṛṣṭyā parjanyo yogitvādarjuno'bhavat || sa tu bāhusahasreṇa jyāghātakaṭhinatvacā || 19 || bhāti raśmisahasreṇa śāradeneva bhāskaraḥ || rākṣasā nirjitāstena tena baddhaśca rāvaṇaḥ || 1.23.20 || jitvā bhogavatī tena karkoṭakasutā hṛtā || tasya bāhusahasreṇa kṣobhyamāṇe mahodadhau || bhavanti līnā niśceṣṭāḥ pātālasthā mahāsurāḥ || 21 || mandarakṣobhacakitā amṛtotpādaśaṅkitāḥ || nataniścalamūrdhāno bhavanti ca mahoragāḥ || 22 || daśayajñasahasrāṇi teneṣṭāni mahīkṣitā || dvīpe dvīpe mahārāja dharmajñena mahātmanā || 23 || sarve yajñā mahārāja tasyāsanbhūridakṣiṇāḥ || sarve kāñcanavedīkāḥ sarve yūpaiśca kāñcanaiḥ ||24 || dvijānāṃ pariveṣṭārastasya yajñeṣu devatāḥ || svayamāsanmahārāja svayaṃ bhāgaharāstathā || 25 || tasya yajñe jagau gāthā nāradassumahattapāḥ || na nūnaṃ kārtavīryasya gatiṃ yāsyanti pārthivāḥ || 26 || yajñairdānaistapobhirvā vikrameṇa śrutena vā || 27 || pañcāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ sa mahīpatiḥ || saptadvīpeśvaraḥ samrāṭ cakravarttī babhūva ha ||28|| tasya rājñastu vasudhā bahupārthivasaṅkulā || bhārākrāntā vilulitā babhūva pṛthivīpate||29|| tasya rājño gatātaṅkairbahuputrairnarottama || tejoyuktaiḥ samākīrṇā vasudhā vasudhādhipa || 1.23.30 || bahunāgāśvasaṃkīrṇā bahugokulasaṅkulā || na śaktā nṛpate soḍhuṃ tejastadatimānuṣam || 31 || jvālāvalivapuḥ śrāntā khinnā nākamupāgatā || 32 || evaṃ prabhāve naradevanāthe pṛthvīṃ samagrāṃ paripālyamāne || bhāreṇa sannā pṛthivī jagāma mahendralokaṃ munidevajuṣṭam || 33 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'rjunopākhyānaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || <1.24> vajra uvāca || devakāryaṃ vinā viṣṇurnotpatsyati mahītale || kasminkārye babhūvāsau dattātreya iti śrutaḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śakreṇa ca yadā vṛtro hato vīryopabṛṃhitaḥ || 2 || tasminhate'sure tvaṣṭā viśvarūpamavāsṛjat || tapasyantaṃ ca taṃ gatvā jaghāna ca śacīpatiḥ || 3 || tasminhate brahmahatyā jagāma balasūdanam || brahmahatyābhibhūtastu rājyaṃ tyaktvā triviṣṭape || 4 || mānase bisatantustho babhūva sa purandaraḥ || rājā kṛtaḥ śakrahīnairdevaistu nahuṣastadā || 5 || so'kāmayata paulomīṃ śakrasya mahiṣīṃ priyām || kālālābhaparā prāha śakraṃ devī tathā śacī || 6 || apūrveṇa hi yānena samīpaṃ me sureśvara || ṛṣibhiḥ śibikāṃ yuktvā sa jagāma tadantikam || 7|| śibikāṃ vahamānaṃ tu mandaṃmandaṃ dvijottamam || pādena tāḍayāmāsa so'gastyaṃ pāpaniścayaḥ || 6 || agastyena tathā śapto bhava sarpo mahīpate || yudhiṣṭhireṇa saṃgamya śāpamokṣamavāpsyasi || 9 || evamukte tu muninā sarpatvaṃ sa jagāma vai || naṣṭe śakre ca patite nahuṣe pāpaniścaye || 1.24.10 || rajastamobhyāmākrāntā babhūvustridaśālayāḥ || tataḥ pravṛttā loke'sminnanāvṛṣṭiḥ sudāruṇā || 11 || durbhikṣamarakau cobhau viṣaṇṇāstridaśālayāḥ || naṣṭotsavamahāyajñaṃ nirvaṣaṭkāramaṅgalam || 12 || anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ babhūva vasudhātalam || kṣutkṣāmamānuṣaprāyaṃ vinaṣṭapaśusañcayam || 13 || kapālāsthisamākīrṇaṃ keśaśaivālasaṃkulam || snāyubhagnadvijagaṇaiḥ kravyādairatisaṃkulam || 14 || nirgandhikuṇapākīrṇaṃ śūnyaprāyaṃ vibhīṣaṇam || kṣutkṣāmabhūtasaṅghābhyāṃ vinivṛttavaṇikpatham || 15 || pranaṣṭakṛṣivārtaṃ ca dātṛbhiśca vivarjitam || narake'pi mahāghore nirākrandairjanaiyutaiḥ || 16 || durlabhānnaṃ nirānandaṃ skandhāsaktakumārakaiḥ || itaścetaśca yāsyadbhirdānavairatisaṃkulam || 17 || śuṣkatoyāśayaṃ bhīmaṃ nāmaśeṣamahāpagam || tasminkāle mahāghore cotsṛṣṭaniyamā dvijāḥ || 18 || āryāvartaṃ parityajya mlecchadeśamupāśritāḥ || bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ parityajya kurvāṇāḥ prāṇadhāraṇam || 19 || prāṇadhāraṇasaktānāṃ kṣudhāvyākulacetasām || teṣāṃ brahma tadā naṣṭaṃ dhāvatāṃ ca itastataḥ || 1.24.20 || tadā naṣṭeṣu deveṣu mlecchībhūtamidaṃ jagat || mlecchībhūte jagatyasminsvadhāsvāhāvivarjitāḥ || 21 || yathā martyāstathā jātāḥ sarve te devatāgaṇāḥ || kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhaistridaśaiḥ prārthitaśca janārdanaḥ || 22 || śakrārthaṃ tridaśā gatvā trailokyahitakāmyayā || 23 || tānuvāca harirdevaḥ sarve gacchantu mānasam || bisataṃtugataṃ śakraṃ tasmāllapsyatha mā ciram || 24 || yajatāṃ so'śvamedhena māmeva surasattamāḥ || ahameva kariṣyāmi vipāpmānaṃ biḍaujasam || 25 || tatkṛtā brahmahatyāṃ tu caturdhā sa kariṣyati || 26 || amedhyakṣepake vahnau pādenaikena yāsyati || tathā caikena pādena hyaśucikṣepake jale || 27 || pādenaikena ca tathā sarvakāle drumacchidam || rajasvalāṃgaṃ pādena tathā caikena yāsyati|| 28 || ahamaṃśena yāsyāmi bhūtalaṃ surakāraṇāt || naṣṭe ca bhūtale dharmaṃ sthāpayiṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ || 29 || etatsarvaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ devadevena śārṅgiṇā || cakrussuragaṇāḥ sarve rājyaṃ cāvāpa vṛtrahā || 1.24.30 || śakreṇa nityaṃ bisatantugena dhyāto mahātmā hariraprameyaḥ || hatvāpi kāmena sa vipramukhyaṃ lebhe trilokīṃ punareva tasmāt || 31 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vṛtravadhopākhyānaṃ nāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || <1.25> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || brahmaṇo'triḥ sutaḥ śrīmānprabhāvādbrahmaṇā samaḥ ||| prabhākarastasya sutaḥ pitāmahasamo guṇaiḥ ||1|| svarbhānunā hate sūrye patamāne divo mahīm || tamobhibhūte tapasā prabhā yena vivardhitā || 2 || svastyastviti sa hovāca patamānaṃ divākaram || vacanāttasya brahmarṣeḥ sa papāta divo mahīm ||3|| atriśreṣṭhāni gotrāṇi yaścakāra mahāyaśāḥ || yajñeṣvatrivanaṃ yaśca surairyasya prakīrtitam || 4 || tasya putratvamāpannau janārdanamaheśvarau || dattātreyo'tha durvāsā loke khyātimupāgatau || 5|| dattātreyatvamāsādya bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || vedānadhyāpayāmāsa brāhmaṇāṃścaritavratān ||6|| teṣu naṣṭeṣu vedeṣu kriyāsu ca makheṣu ca || cāturvaṇye samākīrṇe dharme śithilatāṃ gate || || 7 || abhivardhati cādharme satye naṣṭe'nṛte sthite || prajāsu śīryamāṇāsu dharme cākulatāṃ gate || 8 || sayajñāḥ sakriyā vedāḥ pratyānītā hi tena vai || cāturvarṇyamasaṃkīrṇa kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā ||9 || durbhikṣamarakau naṣṭau tasmiñjāte mahītale || pravavarṣa ca devendraḥ sahasranayanaḥ kṣitau ||1.25.1 0|| bhūya eva jagadvṛttaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ jagatpate || pranaṣṭakaluṣe loke sanmārgastheṣu rājasu || 11 || yajatsu vipramukhyeṣu tapasyabhirateṣu ca || vārtāsakteṣu vaiśyeṣu śuśrūṣuṣvantyajeṣu ca || 12 || muditeṣu ca lokeṣu trailokye devasādgate || viṣṇorbhāge kṣitigate kārtavīryārjunastadā || 13 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi kṛtavānduścaraṃ tapaḥ || prayāgavanamāsādya dattātreyāśramaṃ prati ||14|| ārādhayāmāsa tadā dattaṃ śuśrūṣayā nṛpa|| tena dattavaraścakre sarājyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam ||15|| āryāvarteṣu nirmlecchā kṛtā tena vasundharā || tasminrājani dharmajñe daityairdevanipātitaiḥ || 16 || saṃprāptairbhūmipālatvaṃ vasudhā bhārapīḍitā || nākapṛṣṭhaṃ yayau śīghraṃ śakradarśanalālasā || 17|| vajra uvāca || āsādyalokaṃ tridiveśvarasya bhāreṇa khinnā vasudhā narendraiḥ || kiṃ tatra cakre vada tanmamādya dṛṣṭvā kṣitiṃ yacca cakāra śakraḥ ||18|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dattātreyopākhyānaṃnāma pañcaviṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||25|| <1.26> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || nākapṛṣṭhagatā bhūmirdadarśa madhusūdanam || ratnāsanagataṃ vīraṃ śriyā paramayā yutam || 1 || upāsyamānaṃ tridaśairbhāsayantaṃ sabhāṃ śubhām || ādityairvasubhiḥ sādhyairviśvedevairmarudgaṇaiḥ ||2 || rudrairbhṛgvaṅgirobhiśca nāsatyaiśca mahātmabhiḥ || ṛṣibhiḥ sūryasaṃkāśaistapasā dyotitaprabhaiḥ || 3 || gandharvairapsarobhiśca stūyamānaṃ sahasraśaḥ || kirīṭottamasaṃcchannaṃ hārakeyūrabhūṣitam || 4 || ratnāṅgadakṛtoddyotaṃ ratnagarbhasamaprabham || haricandana digdhāṃgaṃ nīlāmbaradharaṃ harim || 5 || tiryaglalāṭakenā'kṣṇā tṛtīyena virājitam || paśyantaṃ sarvalokasya satataṃ dharmakarmaṇī || 6 || viṣṇoracintyamaṅgaṃ tattrailokyasyaiva kāraṇam || gobrāhmaṇahitāsaktaṃ dadarśa vasudhā tadā || 7 || sandhyāsaha samāsīnaṃ śriyā caiva janārdanam || taṃ vavande vasumatī daityabhārabharārditā || 8 || pādyārghyācamanīyādyaiḥ śakro'pi vasudhāṃ tadā || pūjayitvā sukhāsīnāṃ papracchāgamanakriyām || 9 || pṛṣṭā śakreṇa sā devī vaktuṃ samupacakrame || 1.26.10 || pṛthivyuvāca || antarikṣaṃ divaṃ yacca tathaivā'haṃ jagatpate || tavāyattā mahābhāga tvaṃ hi deveśvaro vibhuḥ || 11 || tvayi bhāraṃ samāsajya vedābhyasanatatparaḥ || sukhamāste praśāntātmā brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || 12 || tvayi bhāraṃ samāsajya devadevo'pi śaṅkaraḥ || āste tapasyabhirataḥ kailāse parvatottame || 13 || tvayi bhāraṃ samāsajya sukhaṃ svapiti keśavaḥ || kṣīrodaśayane nityaṃ śeṣaparyaṅkamā sthitaḥ || 14 || pitāmahasya yattejaḥ keśavasya śivasya ca || sthitaṃ tatsakalaṃ tubhyaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvamayo'rihā || 15 || tvayā vinihato vṛtro balaścāpi niṣūditaḥ || tvayā ca nāśitaḥ pākastvayā daityā niṣūditāḥ || 16 || brahmaṇyastvaṃ śaraṇyastvaṃ praṇatārtivināśanaḥ || sahasranayanaḥ śrīmānvajrapāṇirjagatpriyaḥ || 17 || tejasā tapasā yajñaiḥ śrutena ca damena ca || tvatto viśiṣṭaṃ loke'sminna paśyāmi śacīpate || 18 || vedeṣu sarahasyeṣu gīyase tvaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || vedāḥ pravṛttā yajñārthaṃ tadarthaṃ kratavastathā || 19 || ye hatā dānavā yuddhe tvayā śakra punaḥpunaḥ || ta ime nṛṣu sambhūtāḥ kārtavīryaṃ samāśritāḥ || 1.26.20 || te'dya jātā mama vibho pīḍayanti ca māṃ bhṛśam || sā'haṃ bhārasamākrāntā tvāmadya śaraṇaṃ gatā || 21 || || śakra uvāca || jānāmi bhārakhinnāṃ tvāṃ daityebhyo varavarṇini || teṣāṃ gatvā vadhopāyamahaṃ praṣṭāsmi vedhasam || 22 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityevamuktvā tridaśapradhānaḥ pṛdhvīsameto guruṇā ca rājan || yayau sabhāṃ devavarasya tasya pitāmahasyāpratimasya vīraḥ || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pṛthvīśakralokagamanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || cha || || <1.27> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || te sametāḥ samāsādya pitāmahasabhāṃ śubhām || padmāsanagataṃ tatra dadṛśuḥ padmasambhavam || 1 || padmapatrasavarṇāṃgaṃ padmabodhasamaprabham || caturvaktraṃ caturvedaṃ caturāśramapūjitam || 2 || cāturvarṇyadharaṃ devaṃ cāturhotrapravartakam || kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāntaṃ prabhuṃ prabhavatāmapi || 3 || svayaṃbhuvamacintyaṃ ca sargasaṃhārakārakam || taṃ samāsādya jagatī śakraśca guruṇā saha || 4 || vavanduste mahābhāgaṃ tuṣṭuvuśca jagatprabhum || śakrādaya ūcuḥ || namaste devadeveśa sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇa || vedamūrte tadādhāra yajña yajñāṃga yajñapa || 5 || yajñayone jagadyone sarvasattvābhayaprada || prajāpatipate deva jagadbīja namo'stu te || 6 || svayambhuve svayaṃ kartre sarvabhūtāntarātmane || sarvabhūtavareṇyāya sarvabhūteśvarāya ca || 7 || acintyāyā'prameyāya prakāśāya mahātmane || tvamasya jagato nāthastvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 8 || tvayā vinā jagatyasminnānyatkiñcana vidyate || indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca tebhyaḥ parataraśca yat || 9 || vyaktāvyakto jagannātha tvamevaikaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || tvaṃ tapāṃsi variṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi niyamāni ca || 1.27.10 || kalāḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca kālasyāvayavāśca ye || kālacakraṃ jagaccakraṃ tvamekaḥ puruṣottamaḥ||| 11|| tvameva varado dātā devaḥ śubhacaturmukhaḥ || tvattaḥ prasūtau loke'smindharmarudrau jagatpate || 12 || bhṛgvaṃgirā marīcistu pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || atriścaiva vaśiṣṭhaśca tvayā sṛṣṭā jagatpate || 13 || sanatkumāro bhagavānsanakaśca sanandanaḥ || ākṛtiśca ruciḥ śraddhā tvayā deva vinirmitā || 14 || pūrvātte vadanājjātamṛgvedamamṛtaprabham || dakṣiṇādvadanājjātaṃ yajurvedaṃ tathaiva ca || 15 || paścimādvadanājjātaṃ sāmavedaṃ tathā tava || uttarādvadanājjātamatharvāgirasaṃ śubham || 16 || brāhmaṇāste mukhājjātā bāhubhyāṃ kṣattriyāstathā || ūrudvayāttathā vaiśyāḥ padbhyāṃ śūdrāstathaiva ca || 17 || vidyuto'śanimeghāśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca || tvattaḥ prabho prasūtāni praviśanti tathā tvayi || 18 || svayambhūrbhagavānviṣṇurdevadevaḥ sanātanaḥ || nāmamātravibhedena mohayasyakhilaṃ jagat || 19 || tvattejasā mayā daityā ye yuddhe vinipātitāḥ || te kṣitau kṣattriyā jātāḥ pīḍayanti tathā kṣamām || 1.27.20 || teṣāṃ bhāreṇa khinneyaṃ tvatsakāśamupāgatā || vasudhā vasudhāpāla tāṃ trāyasva namo'stu te || 21 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evaṃ pitāmaho devaḥ stutaḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā || guruṇā ca sametena pūjayāmāsa tāvubhau || 22 || pūjayitvā ca vasudhāṃ śakraṃ vacanamabravīt || vrajadhvaṃ devadevasya śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ || 23 || bhuvaścikīrṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayata mā ciram || upāyaṃ kṣatriyavadhe yuṣmākaṃ kathayiṣyati || 24 || ityevamuktāstu pitāmahena jagmustadā rudrasadaḥ pratītāḥ || śakro'tha devī ca vasundharā ca guruḥ surāṇāñca sa dharmaśīlaḥ || 25 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde brahmalokagamanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || <1.28> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || rudralokamathāsādya dadṛśustryambakaṃ tadā || vahnipuñjaprakāśena jaṭābhāreṇa rājitam || 1 || sūryabhāsā tṛtīyena nayanena ca śobhitam || bhālacandreṇa śubhreṇa jaṭāmaṇḍalaśobhinā ||2|| vyālayajñopavītaśca nāgeśvarakṛtāṃśukam || nīlakaṇṭhaṃ viśālākṣadanticarmottaracchadam|| || 3 || umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam || nandinānugataṃ vīraṃ pramathaiśca sahasraśaḥ || 4 || nānāvaktraśirogrīvairnānāyudhavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇataḥ prāha śakrastu guruṇā saha || 5 || śakra uvāca || namo'stu devadeveśa praṇatārtivināśana || nīlakaṇṭha mahābhāga hyumābhūṣaṇatatpara || 6 || gaṅgātaraṅganirdhautajaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍita || śaśāṅkaśatasaṃkāśa sūryakoṭisamaprabha || 7 || vāmanairjaṭilairmuṇḍaiḥ pramathairīḍyase sadā || taiśca sārdhaṃ mahādeva ramase'mitavikrama || 8 || ghoraṃ hi brahmacaryaṃ te yathā nānyasya kasyacit || tava liṅgārcanaratāḥ pūyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||9 || smaranti ye tvāṃ satataṃ te hi yānti parāṃ gatim || viṣṇoracintyabhāgo'si prajāsaṃharaṇe kṛte || 1.28.10 || sarvadevamayo dhātā sarvadevamayo'pi ca || sarvadevavareṇyastvaṃ sarvabhūtavibhāvanaḥ ||11|| sarvāmaragururdevaḥ sarvabhūteśvareśvaraḥ || sarvadevo mahāyogī mahājayo mahābalaḥ || 12|| mahābuddhirmahāvīryo mahātejā mahāyaśāḥ|| catuṣpātsakalo dharmo vāhanaste mahāvṛṣaḥ || 13 || śmaśāne vasatirnityaṃ citādhūmasamākule || nṛtyadbhūtākule bhūmerbhūtiśvetānulepanaḥ || 14 || bhūkhārkavarcaḥsalilayajamānenduvāyavaḥ || mūrttayaste smṛtā deva yābhirvyāptamidaṃ jagat || 15 || tvayā vinā jagatyasminnānyatkiñcana vidyate || daityabhārābhitaptāṅgāṃ pālayasva namo'stu te || 16 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktastu śakreṇa devaḥ śakramabhāṣata || kārtavīryamahaṃ tvājau kartā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm || 17 || na śaktastridaśaśreṣṭha yataḥ smartāsmi tadvadham || viṣṇudattavaro rājā so'vadhyo mama vāsava || 18 || tameva prārthayiṣyāmi vadhaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ || sarve yāta svakaṃ sthānaṃ tvahamapyamareśvaram || 19 || candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ yāsye varadamīśvaram || viṣṇuścārdhena bhāgena dattātreyo'bhavatkṣitau || 1.28.20 || tena dattavaro rājā pālayatyakhilāṃ mahīm || 21 || ityevamuktastridaśeśvarastu devena sākṣāttripurāntakena || jagāma śīghraṃ svapuraṃ praviṣṭo mahīṃ samādāya guruñca rājan || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde haradarśanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || <1.29> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || gate sureśvare deve śakre ca sapurohite || jagatyāñca prayātāyāṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 1 || aṅguṣṭhamātrako bhūtvā gaṅgātoye nyamajjata || so'vagāhya svalokasthāṃ gaṅgāṃ sarvagatāṃ nadīm || 2 || tayohyamānaḥ prayayau vistīrṇaṃ candramaṇḍalam || navayojanasāhasro viṣkambho yasya kīrtitaḥ || 3 || vistārāddviguṇaścaiva pariṇāhaḥ samantataḥ || toyasāramayaṃ piṇḍa pitṝṇāṃ dhāmamadhyagam || 4 || prajānāṃ bhāvanaṃ sarvaṃ cādhāraṃ jagatāmapi || śarīriṇāṃ śaroreṣu rasaṃ pañcātmakaṃ smṛtam || 5 || ālambakaṃ kledakaṃ ca tathā caivāvabodhakam || saṃghātakaṃ tarpakañca dehināṃ dehagocaram || 6 || manaḥsarvendriyāṇāñca sarveṣāṃ nāthakaṃ tathā || oṣadhīśaṃ jagadyonimamṛtādhāramavyayam || 7 || yaṃ pibanti sadā devāḥ pitaraścāmṛtārthinaḥ || yaścakṣurdevadevasya viṣṇorvā sa prakīrtitaḥ ||8|| havyakavyāśano devo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ || praviśya maṇḍalaṃ tasya devadevo maheśvaraḥ ||||| tasya yadvyāpakaṃ tejaḥ sūkṣmamannarasaṃ hi tam || aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ yaṃ budhāḥ ke śivaṃ viduḥ || 1.29.10 || cakṣurgolakamadhyasthā dṛkśaktiriva yaḥ sthitaḥ || candragolakamadhyasthaḥ puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ smṛtaḥ || 11 || karmasākṣī sa lokānāṃ sa cādhāraḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ || ādityaraśmayaścaṃdre tamaḥsaṃmūrcchitaṃ kṣitau || 12 || kṣapayiṣyaṃti yannaiśaṃ śītāṃśustasya tejasī || yasya rūpamanirdeśyaṃ yasya tejaḥ suduḥsaham || 13 || taṃ tu devavaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva tripurāntakaḥ || īśvara uvāca || agnīṣomamayaṃ caitajjagadetatprakīrtitam || agnīṣomau jagannāthau devadevo janārdanaḥ || 14 || tasyāgneyī tanuryā ca so'haṃ sa ca divākaraḥ || saumyā tu yā tanustasya sa bhavān sa pitāmahaḥ || 15 || tvayedaṃ dhāryate sarvaṃ nānyatpaśyāmi kāraṇam || tvadbimbe nirmale pṛthvī saśailavanakānanā 1||| śaśākṛtiḥ sadā dṛśyā śaśalakṣmā'si cānagha || tenaiva kāraṇena tvamucyase mṛgalāñchanaḥ || 17|| śaśī śaśatvasaṃbandhātsaumyatvātsoma ucyate || śītāṃśutvācca śītāṃśuḥ niśeśe tvadvirājanāt || 18 || nakṣatranāthastatsvāmyādrājatvāttvaṃ dvijeśvaraḥ || vasanti te pitṛgaṇāḥ pitṛnāthastato bhavān || 19 || bahvarthaścandra ityeṣa dhāturukto manīṣibhiḥ || śuklatve hyamṛtatve ca śītatve hrādane'pi ca ||1.29.20|| tena te candratākhyātā satataṃ dharmavatsala || sarve cāhlādamāyanti dṛṣṭe tvayi mahādyute || 21 || prajākāryaṃ tvadāyattaṃ tatkuruṣva jagatprabho || dattātreyatvamāsādya tvayā dattavaro nṛpaḥ ||22|| kārtavīryārjuno nāma dānavāstamupāśritāḥ || sarve kṣattriyatāṃ prāpya tadvadhe yatnavān bhava ||23|| tvayā dattavaraṃ hantuṃ nānyaḥ śaknoti kaścana|| avaśyaṃ ca tvayā kāryaṃ devakāryaṃ sadā vibho || 24 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śaṃkareṇaivamuktastu pratipūjya ca śaṃkaram || uvāca devadeveśaṃ praṇatārtiharaṃ haram || 25 || candra uvāca || iyaṃ śaṅkara saumyā me tanuḥ suvihitā tava || tasmādarkasthitāṃ gaccha sā te kāmaṃ kariṣyati || 26 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityevamuktastripurāntakārī somena rājñā parameśvareṇa || saṃpūjya devaṃ prayayau sa śīghraṃ tejomayaṃ maṃḍalamāśu rājan || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde candramaṇḍaladarśanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || <1.30> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sa dadarśa tato gatvā vipulaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam || candramaṇḍalamānena mānaṃ yasya ca saṃskṛtam || 1 || yattatprajvalitaṃ piṇḍaṃ piṇḍitasya vibhāvasoḥ || devadevasya yaddhāma vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ || 2 || tasya dharmaḥ paraṃ piṇḍaṃ brahmāṇḍāntaradīpanam || āgāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jaṭharasthaṃ hutāśanam || 3 || pañcadhā'vasthitaṃ dehe sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ smṛtaḥ || ālocakaḥ pācakaśca rocako gañjakastathā || 4 || bhrājakaśca tathā devaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā || yanmayaṃ dehināṃ cakṣuryaścakṣurdakṣiṇastathā || 5 || sa vai
