devātidevasya vāsudevasya kīrtitaḥ || agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyaṅnityaṃ yatropatiṣṭhate || 6 || yasya dattaṃ sadā tejaḥ sarveṣāmeva tejasā || yasmādambudharotpattiryasmādvarṣaṇasambhavaḥ ||7 || yasmātpravartate sarvaṃ kālacakraṃ tathaiva ca || auṣadhīnāṃ paraḥ pākaḥ paraṃ yasmānna vidyate || 8 || tanmaṇḍalamathāsādya kṛtvā rūpaṃ tu taijasam || viveśa maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā tanmadhyaṃ śaṅkarastadā || 9|| so'ṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ dṛkśaktimiva veṣṭitam || taijasaṃ dṛṣṭavān rudraḥ tuṣṭāva ca mahādyutiḥ || 1.30.10 || rudra uvāca || tvāṃ namasyāmi deveśa tejasāṃ tu paraṃ nidhim || ārādhyastvaṃ vareṇyastvaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ || 11 || svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ tathā bhavān|| anantaścāprameyastvaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatarastathā || 12 || mayā samarpitaṃ tejaḥ sakalaṃ tvayi bhāskara || mattastvaṃ na hi bhinno'si na ca devājjanārdanāt ||13|| ahaṃ viṣṇurbhavān viṣṇurbrahmā viṣṇuḥ prabhākara || asmākaṃ sakalaṃ dhāma tvayi tiṣṭhati bhāskara || 14 || dhāmakāryaṃ hi kriyate yenāsya jagataḥ sadā || prajānāṃ tu prasavanātsaviteti nigadyase || 15 || rasānāñca tathā dānādravirityabhidhīyase || ādityastvaṃ tathā dānānmitrastvaṃ maitrabhāvataḥ ||16 || puṣṇāsi sakalām̐llokāṃstena pūṣā nigadyase || dhāraṇācca tathā dhātā yamanādaryamā tathā || 17 || aṃśustvamaṃśudhāritvādvisargādvaruṇastathā || bhavaḥ saubhāgyavācyatvāttvaṣṭā sarvakriyākṛteḥ || 18 || sarvajantusamatvācca vivasvānabhidhīyate || kramaṇācca tathā viṣṇurīśatvādindra ucyate || 19 || tasmāttvayā prajākāryaṃ kartavyamavicāritam || sthāvarairjaṃgamasthairvā bhūmirbhārābhipīḍitā || 1.30.20 || kadācijaṅgamairbhūmiḥ sūryabhāreṇapīḍitā || kadācitsthāvarairadya bhāradvitayapīḍitā || 21 || arjune nṛpatau vṛddhiḥ parā bhāskara śākhinām || daityāḥ kṣattriyatāṃ prāpya pīḍayanti ca medinīm || 22 || sūrya uvāca || tava darśanakāmena prāgeva na kṛtā mayā || sthāvarairjaṅgamaiḥ sarvāṃ prakṛtisthāṃ vasundharām || 23 || yathā pūrvaṃ tathā'dyāhaṃ kariṣyāmi maheśvara || sāmprataṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā cārjuneneva pādapān ||24|| sarvānvināśayiṣyāmi śāsanena tathārjunam || vasiṣṭhādyojayiṣyāmi tatoṃśena vasundharām||25|| bhṛguvaṃśe kariṣyāmi tato niḥkṣattriyāṃ prajām || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityevamuktastripurāntakārī sūryeṇa sadraśmivirājitena || jagāma dhāma svamasau bibheti yatsarvalokāñjagatāṃ pradhānaḥ || 26 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ādityadarśanaṃ nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 30|| <1.31> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dvijarūpamathāsthāya devadevo'pi bhāskaraḥ || māhiṣmatīṃ yayau śīghraṃ nagarīṃ ratnamālinīm||| sa tatra dadṛkṣe vīraṃ kārtavīryārjunaṃ nṛpam || yajamānaṃ sudordaṇḍaṃ kalpavṛkṣamivāparam ||2 || pūjitaḥ kṛtavīryeṇa brāhmaṇo nṛpamabravīt || 3 || brāhmaṇa uvāca || mahāśanaṃ māṃ jānīhi brāhmaṇaṃ kṣudhayārditam || prayaccha tasya me tṛptiṃ tvameko haihayottama || 4 || arjuna uvāca || kenā'nnena bhavattṛptiḥ kimannaṃ vidadhāmi ta || tanmamā''cakṣva bhagavan succhaṃdenaiva mā ciram || 5 || brāhmaṇa uvāca || ādityaṃ māṃ vijānīhi sthāvarānbhoktumudyatam || prayaccha tāni sarvāṇi mama pārthivapuṃgava || 6 || arjuna uvāca || sthāvaraṃ bhūgataṃ dātuṃ śaktirnā'sti mamā'nagha || kathaṃ hi sthāvarā dagdhuṃ śakyā mānuṣyatejasā || 7 || āditya uvāca || rathasthaḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha śarānmuṃca yadṛcchayā || teṣvahaṃ prajvalanrājanbhakṣayiṣyāmi pādapān || 8 || tāvadeva tvayā kāryaṃ nṛpate śaramokṣaṇam || yāvanna prajvaliṣyāmi mukteṣvapi śareṣvaham || 9 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā gate sūrye kalpayitvā rathottamam || cikṣepa sa śarānrājā yatra tatra drumotkaram ||1.31.1 0|| te kṣiptā haihayeśena śātakauṃbhojjvalāḥ śarāḥ || jajvalannṛpaśārdūla jvalayaṃto vane drumān ||1 1|| duṃdubhisvananirghoṣo visphuliṃgagaṇākulaḥ || ālolārcirmahāvegaḥ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ||12|| nirdahanvṛkṣapuṃjāni taptakāṃcanasuprabhaḥ || jvālāmālī tadā bhāti sarvataḥ pāvakaḥ kṣitau||13|| vaneṣu dahyamāneṣu tāpatṛṣṇārditā mṛgāḥ || jalāśayeṣu citreṣu gatacchāyāgnikeṣu ca || 14 || dadāhāgnistadā vṛkṣānyāvadicchā jagatpateḥ || babhūvā'tha praśāṃtārciḥ kṛtvā laghvīṃ vasuṃdharām|| 15|| na jajvāla tathā vahniḥ kārtavīryaśareṣvapi || kṛtakāryaṃ tadā gatvā kārtavīryo divākaram || 16 || vinivṛtya rathaṃ paścādyāvanmāhiṣmatīṃ purīm || sa gacchanneva dadṛśe vasiṣṭhaṃ sarvatejasam || 17|| tena śapto vane dagdhe svakīye nṛpapuṅgavaḥ || yasmāttvayā vanaṃ dagdhaṃ mama pārthivaśāsana || 18 || tasmācecchidyate bāhūn brāhmaṇaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ || tena śāpena viprasya rāmaḥ kṣatriyanandanaḥ || 19 || tasya bāhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ ciccheda bhṛgunandanaḥ || 1.31.20 || vajra uvāca || rāmastu kasminsa babhūva vaṃśe kathañca rājñastu mahābalasya || ciccheda dordaṇḍavanaṃ nṛvīraḥ sarvaṃ mamā''cakṣva bhṛgupradhāna || 21 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vanadāho nāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || <1.32> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || sarvadevātidevasya brahmaṇastanayo bhṛguḥ || paulomyāṃ janayāmāsa cyavanaṃ bhagavānbhṛguḥ ||1|| yayātijā sukanyāpi cyavanādbhṛgunandanāt || ātmavānaṃ dadhīcañca janayāmāsa dhārmikau ||2 || ṛṣipatnī mahābhāgā cā''tmavānasya nāhuṣī || aurvaṃ saṃjanayāmāsa ṛcīkāparasaṃjñitam || 3 || yena krodhābhibhūtena dṛṣṭo'gnirvaḍavāmukhaḥ || tasya satyavatī bhāryā kauśikī gādhijā śubhā || 4 || tasyāṃ sañjanayāmāsa putrāṇāṃ śatamūrjitam || jamadagniśca vatsaśca teṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamāvubhau || 5 || strīṇāṃ caruviparyāsājjamadagnirajāyata || 6 || vajra uvāca || kathyatāmme yato brahmanvāḍavasya ca saṃbhavaḥ || saṃbhavaṃ jamadagneśca śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 7 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhṛgūṇāṃ haihayānāñca vairamāsītsudāruṇam || dhanahetostadā pāpairhaihayairbhṛgavo hatāḥ || 8 || ye'pi garbhagatā bālāste'pi taiviniṣūditāḥ || garbheṣu hanyamāneṣu ṛṣiḥ paramaduḥkhitaḥ || 9 || aruṇaṃ dhārayāmāsa garbheṣṭaṃ dīptatejasam || pūrṇe kāle tadā bāla ūruṃ bhittvā vyajāyata || 1.32.10 || jātamātrastu cukrodha devatānāṃ mahātapā || haihayairhanyamānānāṃ bandhūnāṃ sumahātmanām || 11 || bhavadbhirna kṛtaṃ trāṇaṃ tasmātsarvāñśapāmyaham || taṃ kruddhaṃ pitaro hantuṃ vārayāmāsurojasā ||12|| krodhaḥ putra na kartavyaḥ sa hi śatrurnṛṇāṃ sadā || vayaṃ sarve jitakrodhāḥ kṣatriyairvinipātitāḥ ||13|| asmākaṃ na vadhe śaktāḥ kṣatriyā haihayādhipāḥ || evamuktaḥ pitṛgaṇairṛcīkastānathā'bravīt || 14 || na hi me śāmyati krodho yuṣmannidhanakāritaḥ || tasmāddevagaṇānsarvānnihaniṣyāmi tejasā ||15|| etasminneva kāle tu mahītoyasamākulā || jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam || || 16 || śrībhagavānuvāca || devānprati samutpannaṃ krodhamaurvasya yacchubham || taṃ praviśya grasiṣyāmi toyaṃ sarvaṃ vasundhare||17|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| ityevamuktvā vasudhāmaurvaṃ krodhaṃ samāviśat || bhūtvā ca vaḍavāvaktrastaccharīrādvinissṛtaḥ || 18 || na trātāro bhaviṣyanti putra sarve divaukasaḥ || krodhaścā'yaṃ tava vṛthā na bhaviṣyati putraka || 19 || evamuktastu bhṛguṇā ṛcīkā'gnimabhāṣata || pūrvottare samāsādya samudre vasa putraka || 1.32.20 ||| pibam̐statra sadā vegamambhasāṃ sumahādyute || asmākaṃ tu kule bhāvī kṣatradharmā dvijottamaḥ || 21 || kṣatriyāṇāṃ samucchedaṃ yaḥ kariṣyatyanekaśaḥ ||| evamuktastu pitrā vai pibanmāsāṣṭakaṃ jalam || 22 || caitramāsaṃ samārabhya nityamāste sukhī jale || pītaṃ māsāṣṭakaṃ toyaṃ jaṭhare bhasmasādgatam ||| || 23 || kṛtkṛtya māsām̐ścaturaḥ śiśirākhye mahītale || nityaṃ himoghaṃ sṛjati tasmādapi samīraṇaḥ ||24 || himācale pātayati pravāho nāma pārthiva || eṣā toyāddhimotpattirhimatau yasya saṃbhavaḥ || 25 || vṛddhikṣayavihīnasya kathitaṃ tava dhārmika || 26 || utpattireṣā tava vāḍavāgneḥ proktā mayā bhūmipatipradhāna || śrutvā'pi yāṃ muñcati mohajālaṃ saṃsārajāteśca yathā prabuddhaḥ || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇu dharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vaḍavāgnyutpattirnāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || <1.33> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || aurvasya bhāryā dharmajñā nāmnā satyavatī śubhā || vane paryacaradbhaktyā gādhijā bhṛgunandanam || 1 || tasyā paramayā bhaktyā bhartā toṣamupāgataḥ || uvāca tāṃ varārohāmṛcīko bhṛgunandanaḥ || 2 || || ṛcīka uvāca || || varaṃ varaya suśroṇi yatte manasi vartate || toṣito'haṃ tvayā bhadre vane śuśrūṣayā vada || 3 || satyavatyuvāca || mātuḥ prayaccha me putraṃ bhagavanvīryavattaram|| putraṃ mama ca dharmajñaṃ yutaṃ brāhmaṇatejasā || 4 || ṛcīka uvāca || carudvayaṃ kariṣyāmi māturarthe tathā tava || yasya saṃprāśanātputraṃ tvaṃ caiva janayiṣyasi || 5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā tadā cakre ṛcīkastu carudvayam || ekasminsakalaṃ kṣātraṃ tejaścakre savaiṣṇavam || 6 || śvaśrvarthe taṃ caruṃ kṛtvā dvitīye sa nyaveśayat || brāhmaṃ raudrañca yattejaḥ patnyarthe kṛtavāñcarum ||7|| ṛcīka uvāca || ayaṃ prāśyastvayā bhadre tvayaṃ mātrā carustava || aśvatthāliṅganaṃ kāryaṃ mātrā tatra tadā śubhe || 8||| tathaivaudumbarasyā'pi tvayā rājīvalocane || 9 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktā tato gatvā mātre sarvaṃ nyavedayat || 1.33.10 || tatastāmabravīnmātā gādheḥ patnī yaśasvinī || dhruvaṃ bhagavatā putrastava putracikīrṣayā || 11 || śreṣṭhena tejasā yuktaścarureṣa kṛtaḥ śubhe || tasmāccaruviparyāsaṃ madarthe kuru mā ciram||12|| aliṅgane viparyāsaṃ drumayoḥ kriyatāṃ tathā || sā māturvacanaṃ sarvaṃ cakre gauravayantritā ||13|| sagarbhāṃ sa gate kāle bhartā vacanamabravīt || 14 || ṛcīka uvāca || dhruvaṃ caruviparyāso drumayośca tvayā kṛtam || yena tvamasitāpāṅgi yuktā kṣatriyatejasā || 15 || brāhmeṇa tejasā yuktaṃ kṛtavānasmi te carum || mātuste cārusarvāṃgi tathā kṣattriyatejasā || 16 || kṛtaṃ caruviparyāsaṃ sā vipraṃ janayiṣyati || kṣatradharmarataṃ putraṃ vipraṃ tvaṃ janayiṣyasi ||17|| satyavatyuvāca|| māturmatātkṛtamidaṃ bhagavankṣantumarhasi || kṣatradharmarataḥ putro na me bhavitumarhati || || 18 || ṛcīka uvāca || evamastu na te putraḥ kṣatradharmā bhaviṣyati || pautrastvavaśyaṃ bhavitā bhāvyarthavidhicoditaḥ || 19 || satyavatyuvāca || sarveśvaratvaṃ bhagavankimarthaṃ pautrasya me kṣatriyabhāvamugram|| nivartituṃ necchasi mātulena vadasva tanme yadi te na guhyam || 1.33.20 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde caruviparyāso nāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || <1.34> ṛcīka uvāca || brahmaṇo'triḥ sutaḥ saumyaḥ sutastasyā'pi candramāḥ || somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhaputraḥ purūravāḥ || 1 || śrutāyustanayastasya putrastasyāpi nagnajit || tasyā'pi kāñcanaḥ putraḥ suhotrastasya cā''tmajaḥ || 2 || tasya jahnuḥ smṛtaḥ śrīmānyena gaṅgā tu jāhnavī || suvratastanayastasya cālarkastasya cātmajaḥ || 3 || tasya putro balākaśca kuśikastasya cā''tmajaḥ || mahodayapuravare sa tu nityaṃ kṛtālayaḥ || 4 || etasminneva kāle tu śvasuraḥ cyavanastava || svavaṃśasaṃkaraṃ buddhvā kuśikebhyo mahāyaśāḥ ||5|| kuśikānāṃ samucchityai kuśikaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau || pūjitaḥ kuśikenāpi kuśikaṃ vākyamabravīt||6|| rājanvakṣyāmi kāryaṃ te yadi śuśrūṣasenagha || sabhāryeṇa ca kartavyaṃ rājañchuśrūṣaṇaṃ tvayā ||7|| kuśika uvāca || svamevedaṃ tava gṛhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vasa bhārgava|| śaktitastava śuśrūṣāṃ kariṣye bhāryayā saha||8|| ṛcīka uvāca|| gṛhoṣitaṃ taṃ cyavanaṃ śuśrūṣuranahaṃkṛtaḥ || pūjayāmāsa satataṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhibhiḥ||9|| bahusaṃkhyāndinagaṇāṃścyavano nāvabuddhyati || nirāhāraḥ sabhāryastaṃ paryupāste mahīpatiḥ || 1.34.10 || akāle prāśayatyannaṃ kadācidapi dularbham || kṛtamityeva tadrājā nivedayati satvaram ||11|| kadācidbahu bhuṅktennaṃ na bhuṅkte divasānbahūn || dhanena ca tadīyena tarpayāmāsa vai dvijān || 12 || kadāciddīpayatyeva vahniṃ tātagṛhodbhavam || kadācicca rathe yuktaṃ sabhāryo rājapuṅgavam || 13 || rājamārge pratodena tudanyati yathecchayā|| tasyā'sau hitamevedaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā || 14 || samācarati yatnena bhārgavapriyakāmyayā || yadā na vṛjinaṃ kiṃciddṛṣṭavāṃstasya bhārgava || 15 || tadā tasya varaṃ prādādvaraṃ yanmanasepsitam || 16 || cyavana uvāca || vara varaya bhadraṃ te prasanno'haṃ tavānagha || nirvyājaṃ te'nayā rājassevayā'naghayā sadā || 17 || kuśika uvāca || yadi me tvaṃ prasanno'si bhṛgūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana || vaṃśo brāhmaṇatāṃ yātu varametadvṛṇomyaham || 18 || cyavana uvāca || etadeva dhruvaṃ bhāvī nanmāṃ varayase nṛpa || asmadvaṃśānuvaṃśasya brāhmaṇyaṃ te bhaviṣyati||19|| tava vaṃśakṛto'smākaṃ kṣatradharmmo dvijottamaḥ|| bhaviṣyati narendrendra caitatsuviditaṃ mama || 1.34.20 || etajjñātvā samutsedhaṃ cikīrṣuḥ svakulasya te || vikāraiḥ krodhanārthaṃ te gṛhe'hamavasaṃ ciram || 21|| vikāraṃ na tato dṛṣṭaṃ mayā bhāvyarthacoditam || tasmānmātusvayā prāptaṃ varametatsudurlabham ||22|| kuśāsyanāmā putrastu bhavitā'ti svadhārmikaḥ || tasyāpi bhavitā putro gādhirityeva viśrutaḥ || 23 || viśvāmitraḥ sutastasya brāhmaṇyamupalapsyati || kṛtvā vairaṃ vasiṣṭhena tapasā mahatā nṛpa || 24 || strīṇāṃ caruviparyāsādviśvāmitrasya saṃbhavaḥ || asmadvaṃśānubhavitā nirvṛtto bhava pārthiva || 25|| yatte vināśitaṃ dagdhaṃ bhavitā tadviśeṣavat || bhāryayā sahitaścaiva jarāhīno bhaviṣyasi ||26|| evamuktvā gate vipre rājā pūrṇamanorathaḥ || uvāca sumukhīṃ bhadre jarāśoka vivarjitām ||27 || etatsunetre cyavasya vākyaṃ kasyā'sti śaktirbhuvi mānavasya || kartuṃ mṛṣā tena varorumadhye pautrastavogro bhavitā nṛloke || || 28 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kuśikavarapradānaṃ nāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || <1.35> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktā satyavatī kāle pūrṇe dvijottamam || janayāmāsa dharmajñaṃ jamadagniṃ tapodhanam || 1 || tataśca janayāmāsa vātsyaṃ bhṛgukulodvaham || tatoṣṭanavatiṃ putrāngotrakārānpṛthakpṛthak || 2 || gādherapi tadā bhāryā janayāmāsa putrakam || viśvāmitramiti khyātaṃ yutaṃ brāhmaṇatejasā || 3 || jito yuddhe vasiṣṭhena manyunā yaḥ sa pārthivaḥ || brāhmaṇyaṃ tapasā lebhe dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ ||4|| rājā prasenajinnāma sutāṃ tasyā'tha reṇukām || patnyarthe pratijagrāha jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || 5 || sā taṃ vanagataṃ bhaktyā nityaṃ paryacaradvane || kadācidatha gharmartau madhyaṃ prāpte divākare || || 6 || krīḍārthaṃ prāsyati ciraṃ jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || kṣiptāḥkṣiptāḥ śarāstena reṇukā cārulocanā ||7 || ānayāmāsa dharmajñā bharturvacanakāriṇī || athā'rkatāpasaṃtaptā dahyamānāṃghripaṅkajā || 8 || puṣpitasya ca vṛkṣasya chāyāmāsādya viṣṭhitā || viśramya tu muhūrtaṃ sā bharturninye śarottamam ||9|| tāṃ prāptāṃ kupito bhartā jamadagnirabhāṣata || krīḍato me śarairbhadre vighnaṃ kiṃ kṛtavatyasi ||1.35.1 0|| na bibheṣi ca māṃ bhadre tvatha vāpyavamanyase || 11 || reṇukovāca || arkāgnitāpasaṃtaptā kṣaṇamātraṃ mahāvrata || apārayaṃtī viśrānto tasmāttvaṃ kṣantumarhasi || 12 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || reṇukāyā vacaḥ śrutvā jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || jātaroṣastadā sūrye sāyakānkṣeptumudyataḥ || 13 || etasminneva kāle tu viprarūpo divākaraḥ || śīghramāgamya tejasvī jamadagnimabhāṣata || 14 || sūrya uvāca || || svabhāva eṣa me brahman yadahaṃ dahanātmakaḥ || vartataśca svabhāvena na me tvaṃ kroddhumarhasi || 15 || putraste'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi tvasyāmeva dvijottama || surakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi lokānāñca hitaṃ mahat || 16 || iyañca patnī dharmajñā reṇukā tava sāṃpratam || chatropānahametanme gṛhṇātu varavarṇinī || 17 || tasyā'nukampayā chatraṃ tathā brahmanmupānahau || mayā sṛṣṭau jagatyasminnityameva bhaviṣyataḥ || 18 || chatropānahayordānaṃ loke śreṣṭhaṃ bhaviṣyati|| chatropānahadānena naraḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati || 19 || evamuktastu sūryeṇa jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || saṃpūjya sūryaṃ jagrāha savituḥ sakalaṃ vacaḥ || 1.35.20 || tataḥ sūrye gate devī sūryaputrā purā satī || putraṃ kanīyasaṃ rāmaṃ janayāmāsa reṇukā || tamanvāvasuṣeṇaśca vasurviśvāvasustathā || 21 || teṣāṃ jaghanyajo rāmo viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk || 22 || aṃśena jāte bhuvi devadeve sunirvṛtā bhūmiratho babhūva || hṛtāñca mene ditijaprajātāṃ pīḍāṃ nṛṇāṃ svasya ca sā dharitrī || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmotpattirnāma pañcatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || <1.36> mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || atha bālyaṃ samuttīrṇo rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥ || śuśrūṣamāṇaḥ pitaraṃ nityamāste mahāyaśāḥ || 1 || etasminneva kāle tu rāme vanagate tadā || ājagāma mahātejā rājā citrāṅgado vanam || 2 || vihartuṃ saha rāmābhirdevarājasamadyutiḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā reṇukā cakre spṛhāṃ bhogeṣu bhāminī || 3 || jagāma manasā taṃ sā rājānaṃ kāmasannibham || tasminneva kṣaṇe sā tu bhraṣṭā brāhmaṇatejasā || 4 || gataśriyaṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || putrānuvāca tānkrodhāddhanyatāṃ jananīṃ svakāṃ || 5 || te vicārya tataḥ sarve māturgauravamuttamam || naiva cakruḥ piturvākyaṃ tāñchaśāpa sa bhārgavaḥ || 6 || yūyaṃ tiryaksadharmāṇo naṣṭasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatha || idhmabhāramupādāya rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ || || 7 || athā''śramamanuprāptaḥ pitā taṃ samacodayat || jahīmāṃ mātaraṃ kṣudrāṃ rāma mā tvaṃ ciraṃ kṛthāḥ || 8 || evamuktaḥ sa pitrā tu tadvākya samanantaram || śiraściccheda tīkṣṇena rāmaḥ paraśunā tadā || 9 || tutoṣātha pitā tasya tato dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || | 1.36.10 || jamadagniruvāca || svacchandamaraṇaṃ putra tuṣṭe tvaṃ mayi lapsyase || yāvacca vaiṣṇavaṃ tejastvayi tiṣṭhati putraka||11|| tāvadaiva na te yuddhe kaścijjetā bhaviṣyati|| bhaviṣyati ca dharmātmā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || raghuvaṃśe samutpanno viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk || 12 || yadā sameṣyate tena tadā vaiṣṇavatejasā || kṛtakarmā vimuktastvaṃ sa ca yukto bhaviṣyati || 13 || tataḥ paraṃ tvayā putra na kāryaṃ śastradhāraṇam || ārtatrāṇamṛte vīra strībrāhmaṇakṛte'tha vā || yathepsitaṃ cā'pyaparaṃ varaṃ varaya putraka || 14 || rāma uvāca || guruśreṣṭha samutthānaṃ jananyāḥ kathayāmyaham || asmṛtiñca tathā tasyāṃ bhrātṝṇāñca tathā 'smṛtim ||15|| jamadagniruvāca || evamastu mahābhāga tapasā mahatā tathā || samārādhaya deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam||16 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamukte samuttasthau reṇukā cāruhāsinī || rāmasya bhrātaraḥ sarve muktaśāpāstathaiva te ||17|| pitrā rāmastathoktastu himavatyacalottame || tapastepe mahātejā rudrārādhanakāmyayā || 18 || etasminneva kāle tu devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ || saiṃhikeyabhayatrastāḥ śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 19 || || devā ūcuḥ || || bhagavan devadeveśa praṇatārtivināśana || saiṃhikeyairvayaṃ sarvaiḥ sthānebhyastvavaropitāḥ || 1.36.20 || saiṃhikeyānathā''śritya daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || sarve vasanti satataṃ teṣāṃ yatnaṃ vadhe kuru || 21 || || mahādeva uvāca || || śṛṇvantu devatāḥ sarvā dānavā devakaṇṭakāḥ || rāmeṇā''haṃ vadhiṣyāmi narabuddhyā yatastu tān || 22 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu devadevaḥ pinākabhṛt || āhūya bhārgavaṃ rāmamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 23 || mahādeva uvāca || saiṃhikeyāndurācārānasurāñjahi putraka || samarthastānbhavānhantuṃ nā'nyaḥ kaścana vidyate || 24 || rāma uvāca || astragrāmaṃ samagraṃ me prayaccha bhagasūdana || yena tānsudurācārānghātayiṣyāmi dānavān || 25 || mahādeva uvāca || kiṃ tavāstrairbhūguśreṣṭha viṣṇustvaṃ nāsi mānuṣaḥ || vyastrasyā'pi na te śaktā yoddhuṃ pramukhatastava ||26|| rāma uvāca || ghātayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvānsaiṃhikeyāndurāsadān || tripurāre mahābhāga tvadājñāparibṛṃhitaḥ || 27 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityevamuktastripurāntakena rāmastrinetrapratima prabhāvaḥ || ādāya tīkṣṇaṃ paraśuṃ jagāma yatra sthitāste ca ripupradhānāḥ || 28 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmasya maheśvarādeśo nāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || <1.37> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu kāṣṭhodarkāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || babhūvuḥ sumahotpātāḥ saiṃhikeyaniveśane || 1 || cacāla śabdaṃ kurvāṇā mahī savanakānanā || papāta mahatī colkā madhyenā''dityamaṇḍalāt || 2 || aparvaṇi śaśāṅkārkau saṃchannau tamasā tathā || pravṛṣṭāśca tathā raktaṃ bhūri meghā bhayāvaham || 3 || śastrāṇi mumucurdhūmamasakṛdaśruvāhanāḥ || indracāpasavarṇena pariveśena bhāskaraḥ || 4 || pariviṣṭa ubhe sandhye candraśca sakalāṃ niśam || saiṃhikeyo vipatnyopi sālvasya sumahātmanaḥ || 5 || ākramyajanmana kṣatraṃ ketustasthau mahāgrahaḥ || vavustīkṣṇā mahāvātāḥ kṣobhayanto diśo daśa || 6 || bhānuścā''sītkabandhāṅgo mṛgāścāsannasasvanāḥ || nyalīyanta dhvajāgreṣu dānavānāṃ durātmanām ||7|| kravyādapakṣisaṃghātā hyapasavyaṃ bhayānakāḥ || śuṣkendhanasamṛddho'pi na jajvāla hutāśanaḥ ||8|| vapūṃṣi dānavendrāṇāṃ na prākāśaṃta yādava || uṣṇaśītaviparyāsa ṛtūnāmapyadṛśyata || 9 || prasusravurdrumā raktaṃ vyaśīryanta ca bhūṣaṇāḥ || kharā goṣu vyajāyanta mārjārā mūṣikāsu ca || 1.37.10 || akāle puṣpitā vṛkṣā akāle phalitā drumāḥ || vinā varṣaṃ mahānadyaḥ pratīpaṃ jagmurojasā || 11 || bhayānakāñjātabhayaḥ sughorānutpātasaṃghānprasamīkṣya rājā || sālvaḥ samāhūya bhṛgostastanūjaṃ daityaiḥ sameto'tha cakāra mantram || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāda autpātikaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || <1.38> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || ratnacitrāṃ suvipulāṃ samāsādya sabhāṃ tadā || siṃhikātanayaḥ sālvaḥ śukraṃ vacanamabravīt || 1 || sālva uvāca || dṛśyanta ete bhagavannutpātā ghoradarśanāḥ || ācakṣāṇā mahāyuddhaṃ vināśamapi dāruṇam || 2 || ripuṃ na caiva paśyāmo yena yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || sarvajñatvādbhavānvetti tannaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām || 3 || śukra uvāca || ārādhya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tapasā siṃhikā purā || tridaśebhyo hyavadhyatvaṃ svasutānāmalabdha sā || 4 || varadānakṛtotsāhairbhavadbhirvidyayā mama || nirjitāstridaśāḥ sarve śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 5 || tena yuṣmadvadhārthāya viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk || jamadagnisuto rāmaḥ preṣito raṇakarkaśaḥ || 6 || sadā devo mahātejā mānuṣaṃ sa tu sāmpratam || manuṣyācca bhayaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhyasvā'surasattama || 7 || sālva uvāca || bhagavansarvadevānāmīśvaro madhusūdanaḥ || tasmātparataraṃ devaṃ nā'nyaṃ kañcana śuśruma || 8 || kimarthaṃ sa mahātejāḥ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ || ājñākārī bhṛguśreṣṭha saiṃhikeyaṃ jighāṃsati ||9|| śukra uvāca || yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati dānava || abhyutthānamadharmasya tadā''tmānaṃ sṛjatyasau ||1.38.10|| kadāciddaityadeveṣu kadācinmanujeṣu ca || kadācidatha tiryakṣu jñātvā kāryabalābalam || 11 || yadā bhavati deveṣu devavacceṣṭate tadā || tiryakṣu ca yadā devastiryagvacceṣṭate tadā || yadā bhavati mānuṣye tadā bhavati martyavat|| mānuṣyaṃ rūpamāsādya tapasā tripurāntakam||13|| ārādhayāmāsa haraṃ svadehe paramaṃ nṛpa || sa tu devavarasyājñāṃ puraskṛtya mahātapāḥ || 14 || yuṣmadvadhārthamāyāti rāmeṇa kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ || tasmācchakreṇa saṃdhānaṃ bhavato mama rocate || 15 || triviṣṭapañca devānāṃ bhavatvasurasattama || pātālanilayā yūyaṃ nivasadhvaṃ gatajvarāḥ || 16 || ahaṃ nivārayiṣyāmi śaṃkareṇa ca bhārgavam || anyathā niviśadhvaṃ ca manuṣyeṇa nirākṛtāḥ || 17 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktāstu śukreṇa buddhvā daiteyadānavāḥ || ūcurvākyaṃ susaṃrabdhāḥ śukraṃ bhṛgukulodvaham ||18 || daityā ūcuḥ || ekatrā'dhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || yadyasmātpratiyudhyeta na bhīstatrā'pi vidyate ||19|| te kathaṃ mānuṣādbhītā nākaṃ tyakṣyāma śatrave || śaṃkaraṃ taṃ vijeṣyāmo yenā'sau preṣito dvijaḥ || 1.38.20 || śukra uvāca || ekatra piṃḍitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || ekatra bhagavānviṣṇurjagataḥ so'tiricyate || 21 || sa na śakyo yudhā jetuṃ naiva devo maheśvaraḥ || te yūyaṃ prākṛtīṃ buddhiṃ tyaktvā sarve mahāsurāḥ || saṃdhiṃ kuruta devena śakreṇā'mitraghātinā || 22 || śakrakārye sadodyukto devadevo janārdanaḥ || yena daityā vinihatāḥ pūrve pūrvatarāśca ye || 23 || śaṃbaro namuciḥ śambuḥ kārtavīryaḥ kṛtāgamaḥ || hiraṇyakaśipuḥ keśī hiraṇyākṣo madotkaṭaḥ || 24 || madhuśca kaiṭabhaścaiva viṭo dhūmo'ti'kopanaḥ || hayagrīvo nisundaśca sundaścandrārkalocanaḥ || 25 ||' candrārkamardanaścaiva candrahartā raṇapriyaḥ || sūryaśatrurjitāmitro yajñahā yajñatāpanaḥ || 26 || meghanādo mahāromā meghavādo bhayānakaḥ || daśagrīvaḥ śatagrīvo mahāgrīvaśca dānavaḥ ||27|| kālakaḥ kālakeyaśca kālanemi sulocanaḥ || kālaśca kālakalpaśca makarākṣo janāntakaḥ || 28 || antaḥ keśamano bhīmo devāntakanarāntakau || krodhahā bahunetraśca mahākālo jalāntakaḥ ||29|| ekalavyaḥ sa cādhāro durmukho durdharo vaḍiḥ || indutāpanarambho ca raṇacaṇḍaharapriyau || 1.38.30 || kirīṭī gajavaktraśca mahāsālo vilohitaḥ || hrādānuhrādaprahrādavṛkṣarakṣaradāruṇāḥ || 31 || śatabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva kūpanaśca mahāsuraḥ || vipracittiḥ śivaḥ śaṅkarayaḥ śaṅkustathaiva ca || 32 || ayaḥśirā aśvaśirā bhīmadakṣo guhāśayaḥ || vegavānketumānugraḥ sogravigro mahāsuraḥ || 33 || puṣkaraḥ puṣkalaścaiva sālvośvapatireva ca || kumbho nikumbhaḥ śatadā saṃgraho gaganapriyaḥ || 34 || ete cā'nye ca vikhyātā daiteyā samaroddhatāḥ || sarve labdhavarāḥ śūrāḥ sarve ca gatamanyavaḥ || 35 || sarvaistridaśarājyāni kāritāni baloddhataiḥ || te hatāstena devena vāsavapriyakāmyayā || 36 || kecinmanuṣyarūpeṇa tiryagrūpeṇa cā'pare || kecicca devarūpeṇa nihatā bhūritejasā || 37 || sālva uvāca || jānāmi tasya māhātmyaṃ devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || ahaṃ svamaraṇaṃ matvā tena yotsyāmi bhārgava || 38 || viśiṣṭānmaraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na hīnādvijayo raṇe || viṣṇoḥ karavinaṣṭānāṃ bhūyo rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 39 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityevamuktastvasurādhipena bhṛgupradhāno bhagavān sa śukraḥ || jñātvā sa daityānsakalānvinaṣṭāñjagāma kāṣṭhāmaparāmabhīṣṭām || 1.38.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajra saṃvāde śukrasālvasaṃvādo nāmā'ṣṭātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||38|| <1.39> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā gate śukre gaviṣṭho vākyamabravīt || rājañchukrasya vacanaṃ kriyatāmavicārayan||1|| svapnā hi sumahāghorā dṛśyante bhayavardhanāḥ |' bhavatāṃ hi vināśāya rātryante satataṃ vibho ||2|| bhavānsvapne mayā dṛṣṭo rakta sraganulepanaḥ || uṣṭreṇa śiśumāreṇa varāheṇa tathā vrajan||3|| tailāktāścāpare daityāḥ kharayānamupāśritāḥ || patantaḥ parvatā dṛṣṭā rājam̐ste bhayakāraṇam||4|| kecitkṛṣṇāṃbaradharāḥ kecitkṛsarabhojinaḥ|| kecitpaṅkagatā dṛṣṭāḥ kecidbhasmaśayā gatāḥ||5|| kecidvivastrayā nāryā kṛṣyante dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || kācidraktāmbarā nārī nīyate dakṣiṇāṃ diśam||6|| kecinnṛtyanti bhūpālā hasanti ca tathā'pare || kecinmuṇḍā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kecitkāṣāyavāsasaḥ || 7|| caṇḍālaskandhagāḥ kecitkecitkiṃśukasaṃsthitāḥ || gajāśvapattisainyena sarveṇa ca bhavānyutaḥ || 8 || vāpīṃ sukaluṣāṃ prāpya nimagno gomaye hrade || rājaśrīśca mayā dṛṣṭā śakrāliṅganatatparā || 9 || tasya me rocate sandhistava śakreṇa pārthiva || prāṇānrakṣata bho rājañjīvanbhadrāṇyupāśnute || 1.39.10 || sālva uvāca || yadaiva bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śrutaḥ śatrurmayā'nagha || tatraiva deva tacchrutvā rājyaṃ tyaktaṃ tathā mayā || 11 || iṣṭaṃ yajñaistapastaptaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtamakaṇṭakam || mūrdhni sthitamamitrāṇāṃ suhṛdaḥ paripālitāḥ || 12 || dhṛto bhṛtyajanaḥ sarvaḥ kṛtakṛtyāstato vayam || govindānmaraṇaṃ prāpya bhūyo rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 13 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityeva vākyaṃ tu niśamya rājño mene tadāyuktatamaṃ gaviṣṭhaḥ || tūṣṇīṃ babhūvā'tha suniścitātmā mene ca daityānsamare vinaṣṭān || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde svapnādhyāyo nāmaikonacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || <1.40> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etasminneva kāle tu sālvasya ca mahātmanaḥ || śīrṣamātrāvaśiṣṭastu dadṛśe cāgrajasya ca || 1 || rāhurityeva vikhyātaḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ nṛpaḥ || yathārhaṃ pūjito rājñā niṣaṇṇo vākyamabravīt || 2 || rāhuruvāca|| na hi me rocate vairaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā|| yasya krodhādanaṅgohaṃ jātaḥ parabalārdanaḥ||3|| prasādācca tathā yasya grahatvamupalabdhavān || kimanyaiḥ kīrtitaistasya karmabhiste'surātmaja || 4 || sālva uvāca || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi kathaṃ tena mahātmanā || anaṃgastvaṃ kṛto vīra graheśaśca kathaṃ kṛtaḥ || 5 || rāhuruvāca || amaratvamabhīpsaṃtaḥ purā devā savāsavāḥ keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 6 || devā ūcuḥ || bhagavan devadeveśa jagatāmārtināśana || nirviśeṣā vayaṃ martyaistrātā tatrāstu no bhavān || 7 || śrībhagavānuvāca || kṣīrodamathane yatnaṃ tridaśāḥ kartumarhatha || dānavaiḥ sahitā bhūtvā tataḥ śreyo'pyavāpsyatha || 8 || rāhuruvāca || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve devadevena śārṅgiṇā || dānavaiḥ sahitā bhūtvā mamanthurvaruṇālayam || 9 || sāhāyyamakarotteṣāṃ tatra karmaṇi pārthiva || vinā viṣṇusahāyena na śaktāḥ sasurāsurāḥ || 1.40.10 || anantaḥ sa tato bhūtvā cāṃśaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasya ca || utpāṭya maṃdiraṃ dorbhyāṃ cikṣepa payasāṃ nidhau || 11 || akūpāre tato bhūtvā kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ || mandaraṃ dhārayāmāsa kṣīrābdhigatamañjasā || 12 || svanaiva tejasā nāgaṃ tathā saṃyojya vāsukim || cakre sa netratāṃ tatra tatra karmaṇi dānava || 13 || tato mamanthuḥ sahasā samudraṃ devadānavāḥ || yato mukhaṃ tato daityā yataḥ pucchaṃ tataḥ surāḥ || 14 || vāsukerabhavaddaityā mathyamāne mahodadhau || mukhaśca nāgarājasya kareṇa dhṛtavānsvayam || 15 || ākāśābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā devadevo janārdanaḥ || mukhe niḥśvāsavātena saviṣeṇa hi bhūpate || 16 || anyathā daityasaṃghānāṃ vināśamabhaviṣyata || himācalābhāḥ kāllolāḥ kṣīrābdhergaganaspṛśaḥ || 17 || utpeturmathyamānasya balibhidevadānavaiḥ || 18 || śṛṅgāṇi nipatanti sma mandarasya mahodadhau || ratnacitrāṇi ramyāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 19 || drumāśca śataśaḥ peturmṛgāḥ petuḥ sahasraśaḥ || trailokyaṃ pūrayannādai rarāsa payasāṃ nidhiḥ || 1.40.20 || kṣīrakallolavasanaḥ śvetameghakṛtāṃśukaḥ || rājate mandarādrissa nānādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ || 21 | calanmeghāṃśuko ghūrṇannatyarthaṃ vāyupūritaiḥ || guhāmukhaiḥ sapraṇataṃ girirmattairivārṇavaḥ ||22 || nirjharāśrurmahānādaḥ śṛṅgocchritamahābhujaḥ || aniśaṃ sa giriśreṣṭhaḥ sthānahānyeva roditi || 23 || devopabhogyānsakalānmahānta iti cintayan || vādyatsu devavādyeṣu nṛtyatīva sa mandaraḥ || 24 || evaṃ hi mathyamānasya kṣīrābdheḥ sumahātmanaḥ || prādurbhūtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ kālānalasamaprabham || 25 || yena prodbhūtamātreṇa viṣaṇṇā devadānavāḥ || tatpapau bhagavāñchaṃbhustrailokyahitakāmyayā ||26|| viṣe kaṇṭhamanuprāpte nīlakaṇṭhatvamāgataḥ || dhārayāmāsa tatkaṇṭhe śobhārthaṃ suravāritaḥ || 27 || tataścandrakalā jātā trailokyasyaiva sundarī || jaṭājūṭena tāṃ cakre devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 28 || raśmijvālāvalīpuñjavibhāsitajagattrayam || vaiḍūryakaustubhaṃ jātaṃ yaṃ babhāra hṛdā hariḥ || 29 || vātaraṃho mahākāyaḥ śaśāṅkasadṛśacchaviḥ || uccaiśravāhayo jātassa ca devānupāśritaḥ || 1.40.30 || tataḥ surā samutpannā sā ca pītā mahāsuraiḥ || tatastvapsaraso jātā devarāmā manoramāḥ || 31 || devī lakṣmīstato jātā rūpeṇā'pratimā śubhā||32|| yasyāḥ śubhau tāmarasaprakāśau pādāmbujau spṛṣṭatalāṅgulīkau || jaṅghe śubhe romavivarjite ca gūḍhāsthikaṃ jānuyugaṃ suramyam || 33 || suvarṇadaṇḍapratimau tathorū cābhogyaramyaṃ jaghanaṃ ghanaṃ ca || madhyaṃ suvṛttaṃ kuliśodarābhaṃ valitrayaṃ cāru śubhaṃ dadhānam ||34 || uttuṅgamābhogi samaṃ viśālaṃ stanadvayaṃ cārusuvarṇavarṇam || bāhū suvṛttāvatikomalau ca karadvayaṃ padmadalāgrakānti || 35 || kaṇṭhañca śaṅkhāgranibhaṃ suramyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ samaṃ cāru sirāvihīnam || karṇau śubhau cāruśubhapramāṇau sampūrṇacandrapratimañca vaktram || 36 || kundendutulyā daśanāstathoṣṭhau pravālakānāṃ pratipakṣabhūtau || spaṣṭā ca nāsā cibukaṃ ca ramyaṃ kapolayugmaṃ śaśitulyakānti || 37 || unnidranīlotpalasannikāśaṃ trivarṇamākarṇikamakṣiyugmam || śiroruhāḥ kuñcitanīladīrghā vīṇeva vāṇī madhurā śubhā ca || 38 || vastre susūkṣme vimale dadhānā candrāṃśutulye'timanobhirāme || śrotradvayenāpyatha kuṇḍale ca saṃtānakānāṃ śirasā ca mālām || 39 || gaṅgāpravāhapratimañca hāraṃ kaṇṭhena śubhraṃ dadhatī suvṛttam || 40 || tathāṅgadau ratnasahasracitrau haṃsasvanau cā'pyatha nūpūrau ca ||1.40.40|| kareṇa padmaṃ bhramaropagītaṃ vaiḍūryanālañca śubhaṃ gṛhītvā || svarūpamūḍheṣu surāsureṣu dṛṣṭiṃ dadau cārumanobhirāmā ||41|| sā devasaṃghānasurāṃśca dṛṣṭvā dadarśa devaṃ jagatāṃ pradhānam || devāsurebhyastvatiriktarūpaṃ sūryāyutābhaṃ bhuvaneṣvajeyam ||42 || unnidranīlanalinadyuticāruvarṇaṃ saṃtaptahāṭakanibhe vasane vasānam || dṛṣṭvaiva jātapulakodgamamātrakampā kṣīrābdhijā madanabāṇavaśaṃ jagāma || 43|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde samudramathane lakṣmīsamudbhavo nāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||40 || <1.41> rāhuruvāca || sā kāmabāṇābhihatā samīkṣya madhusūdanam || svayaṃ vṛtavatī nāthaṃ bhartāramaparājitam ||1|| prakṛtissā vinirdiṣṭā puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || tayā viyujyate nā'sau kadācidapi śatruhā ||2|| śaṃkaraḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ prakṛtiḥ pārvatī smṛtā || puruṣaḥ pākahā proktaḥ prakṛtiśca tathā śacī ||3| hutāśanaśca puruṣaḥ svāhā ca prakṛtiḥ smṛtā || yamaśca puruṣaḥ prokto dhūmorṇā prakṛtiḥ smṛtā || 4 || virūpākṣaśca puruṣaḥ prakṛtirnirṛtiḥ smṛtā || varuṇaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto gorī ca prakṛtistathā || 5 || vāyuśca puruṣo jñeyaḥ prakṛtiśca tathā śivā || puruṣaśca dharmo vṛkṣastadviśvaprakṛtiḥ smṛtā || 6 || candramā puruṣaḥ prokto jyotsnā ca prakṛtistathā|| dharmaśca puruṣaḥ proktaḥ prakṛtiśca karīṣiṇī|| 7 || yajñaśca puruṣaḥ prokto dakṣiṇā prakṛtistathā || divasaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto prakṛtiśca tathā niśā || 8 || ākāśaḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ prakṛtiśca tathā mahī || oṃkāraḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ sāvitrī prakṛtiḥ smṛtāḥ ||9|| prakṛtiḥ sā śubhā lakṣmīrviṣṇuḥ puruṣa ucyate || sā sadehā videhā sā saguṇā nirguṇā ca sā || 1.41.10 || tayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || sā kāntiḥ sā dhṛtiḥ sā śrīḥ sā prabhā ca sanātanī || 11 || sā nidrā sā śubhā vāṇī sā ca devī sarasvatī || ratiḥ prītiḥ kṣitirdyauśca sā gaṃgā sā sarasvatī || 12 || tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirvapuḥ prajñā svadhā medhā sarasvatī || saiva nadyaḥ śubhā sarvāḥ saiva devī vanaspatī || 13 || sā vāstudevatā dīkṣā sā bhaktirvaiṣṇavī smṛtā || buddhirlajjā dhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ sudhā śobhā jayā tvirā || 14 || sinīvālī kuhū rākā tvevaṃ cānumatiḥ śubhā || kātyāyanī bhadrakālī suprabhā vijayā tathā || || 15 || aditirditirdanuḥ kālā snāyuḥ siṃhikā muniḥ || kadrū krodhā tvirā prāvā vinatā surabhiḥ khagā || 16 || kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā kṣamā śraddhā kriyā ratiḥ || anasūyā satī bhūtirvibhūtirvāruṇī tathā || 17 || arundhatī vasurjāmī lobhā bhānurarundhatī || saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā tathaiva ca || 18 || mṛgā ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā yuvā tviḍā || bhūtā ca kapilā daṃṣṭrī saramā suramā tathā || 19 || rājaśrīrbhūmipālānāṃ brahmaśrīstadvidāṃ śubhā || puṣpaśrīḥ kānanānāṃ sā jayaśrīrjayināṃ raṇe || 1.41.20 || svargaśrīḥ svargatānāṃ sā dīkṣā sā yajñayājinām || buddhirbuddhimatāṃ devī kṣamā devī kṣamāvatām || 21 || śikhā vahnau prabhā sūrye jyotsnā candre prakīrtitā || kāntistārāgaṇasyoktā sā siddhiḥ sarvakarmaṇām || 22 || sahasranetrajā dṛṣṭiḥ sahasranayanasya sā || upatyakā parvatānāṃ phalaśrīḥ sā ca śākhinām || 23 || mahodadheśca sā velā nakṣatrāṇāñca kṛttikā || dhanurlatā ca mantrāṇāṃ hetīnāṃ cāpyaserlatā || 24 || gāndhārī sarvavidyānāṃ vṛṣṭiḥ sā jagatītale || kārṣakāṇāṃ tathā sītā sasya śobhā mahītale || 25 || madalekhā ca nāgānāṃ bhogināñca phaṇāvalī || ratnāvalī ca śeṣasya dhṛtirbhūmaṇḍalasya sā || 26 || sā sthitā satataṃ candre bilve nīlotpale vṛṣe || kuñjare turage siṃhe khaṅge ca vimale śubhe || 27 || cāmare vyajane chatre bhṛṃgāre gomaye vane || sahasrakiraṇe sūrye śakre vaiśravaṇe yame || 28 || kamale rajate hemni śaṃkhe bhadrāsane śubhe || gomūtre sarpiṣi kṣīre dadhi kṣīraphaleṣu ca || 29 || varuṇe ca jalādhyakṣe samudreṣu jaleṣu ca || kusumeṣu ca śukleṣu prāsādeṣu siteṣu ca || 1.41.30 || hutāśane prajvalite pārthive cāruśobhite || ratneṣu ca vicitreṣu tathaivāmalakeṣu ca || 31 || yathā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ devadevena śārṅgiṇā || tathā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ rājan kṣīrābdhikanyayā || 32 || svāyaṃbhuve'ntare devī bhṛgoḥ sā duhitā smṛtā || svārociṣe tathā jātā saiva devī hutāśanāt || 33 || auttamasyāntare jātā salilādvimalācchubhā || tāmasasyāntare rājan bhūtalātsā samutthitā || 34 || bilvātsamutthitā devī raivatasyāntare tathā || utphullakamalodbhūtā cākṣuṣe'pi tathāntare || 35 || vaivasvate'ntare jātā tathaivā'mṛtamanthanāt || kṣīrābdhijātāṃ tāṃ prāpya hṛdayena janārdanaḥ || 36 || dadhāra durdharāṃ devīṃ trailokye tamṛte prabhum || ādāya sā'mṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ śubhamarkakamaṇḍalum || 37 || etasminnantare jāto vaidyo dhanvantaristathā || amṛte jātamātre tu daityasaṃghāḥ samākulāḥ || || 38 || dhanvantarimathonmathya paribhūya ca devatāḥ || amṛtaṃ ca samādāya jagmurdaityā niveśanam || 39 || hṛtāmṛtāndevagaṇānvipānānāśvāsya devo bhuvanasya goptā || sthāne ca vinyasya girīndramukhyaṃ jagāma devo'suranāthaveśma || 1.41.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'mṛtamanthanaṃ nāmaikacattvāriṃśatattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || <1.42> || rāhuruvāca || || babhūva nārī kalyāṇī sa devo madhusūdanaḥ || anirdeśyavayorūpā sarvalakṣaṇapūjitā || 1 || samāṃgulitalau ślakṣṇau raktatuṃganakhā śubhau || vibhṛte caraṇau śubhrau gūḍhagulpho manoharau || || 2 || jaṃghe manohare śubhre spaṣṭe lomavivarjite || gṛhasaṃdhyasthike ślakṣṇe jānunī ca tathā śubhe || 3 || ūrū karikarākārau kadalīdalakomalau || ghanamābhogi jaghanaṃ madhyaṃ kuliśasannibham || 4 || trivalītripathādhārinābhīpuṣkaramaṃḍitam || gūḍhasphike same pārśve samaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ manoramam || 5 || samau susaṃhatau pīnau komalāvagracūcukau || ābhoginau maṇḍalinau stanau kanakasannibhau || || 6 || mṛṇālasadṛśau bāhū karau komalakomalau || kambutulyaṃ śubhaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ connatā ca kṛkāṭikā || 7 || mukhaṃ pūrṇendusaṃkāśaṃ dvijāḥ kundasamaprabhāḥ || adharau vidrumākārau nāsā spaṣṭamanoramā || 8 || madhūkapuṣpasaṃkāśau kapolau lalitāvubhau || bhrūyugmaṃ kāmacāpāntasadṛśaṃ sumanoharam || 9 || nātipralambau śravaṇau nātyacārū ca kuṇḍalau || cibukaṃ ca manohāri lalāṭaṃ śaśisuprabham || 1.42.10 || kṛṣṇamadhye suraktānte nayane śvetabhūmike || nīlotpaladalākāre dīrghe cā'timanorame || 11 || kokilā'likulākāraṃ bhinnāñjanacayaprabham || keśapāśaṃ tathā kiṃciddadhāra kuṭilaṃ śubham || 12 || candraraśmiprakāśena vastrayugmena bhūṣitā || 13 rūpeṇāpratimā rājansarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā || yatrayatra padanyāsaṃ karoti gajagāminī || 14 || tatra tatraiva vasudhā sapadmevopalakṣyate || yatrayatrā'timadhurāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kṣipati bhāmini || 15 || sitāsitotpalaistatra kiratīva vasuṃdharām || yatrayatra sthitā bhāti deśe kanakavarṇinī || 16 || tatra tatraiva sauvarṇaṃ sā karoti nabhastalam || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṃgī manmathāviṣṭacetasaḥ || 17 || prahlādarahitāḥ sarve babhūvurdānavāstadā || pādayoḥ pṛthivīṃ tasyā dhṛtiṃ devīṃ ca jaṅghayoḥ ||18|| jānubhyāṃ ca tathā kṣāntiṃ kāntimūruyuge śubhe || āyatiṃ niyatiṃ lakṣmīṃ velāṃ tu jaghane tathā ||19|| madhye vāhāṃ satīṃ pṛṣṭhe pārśvayośca sudhāṃ mukhe || ratiṃ prītiṃ kucayuge kaṇṭhe vāṇīṃ tathaiva ca || 1.42.20 || jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva karayorbhujayostathā || śobhāṃ prabhāṃ vakṣasi ca śriyaṃ devīṃ manoramām || 21 || arundhatīṃ ca cibuke jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatīm || jyotsnāṃ kapolayordevīṃ nidrāṃ netrayuge tathā || 22 || keśapāśe tathā rātriṃ diśaṃ śrotrayuge tathā || bhadrakālīṃ lalāṭe ca nāsāyāṃ ca tathā śacīm || 23 || sarvāṅgasandhigā nadyo lomasvatha vanaspatim || pārśvayoḥ parvatāścaiva daityeśaḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 24 || dṛṣṭavānstrītanuṃ tatra prahlādo'rikulāntakaḥ || viśvarūpadharāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahlādastāśca yoṣitam || 25 || viṣṇuṃ matvā viśālākṣīṃ jñātvā caivā'mṛtārthinīm || kāmārttadaityānumataḥ prahlādo daityasattama || 26 || pradadāvamṛtaṃ tasyai praṇipatya prasādya ca || strīrūpamāsthitaidevaistrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 27 || strīceṣṭamabhavatsarvaṃ tasminkāla upasthite || uvāca sā strī prahrādaṃ daitya tvamamṛtaṃ vinā || 28 || brāhmamekamaha saumya jīvitānna vimokṣyase || yoddhumabhyuditā daityadevairditijakāraṇāt || 29 || na prabodhyāstamoyuktāstvayā daitya janārdanā || bhaktosi me sadā vatsa sadaiva vijitendriyaḥ || 1.42.30 || tena te darśitā saumya prakṛtiryā parā mama || ityevamuktvā prahlādaṃ somamādāya satvarā || 31 || kāmārttānditijām̐styaktvā jagāma suramandiram || strīrūpaṃ tatra saṃtyajya devarūpamupāśritaḥ || 32 || pāyayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ surānsarvānsamāhitān || mayā'pi madhye devānāṃ pītaṃ tatsūryarūpiṇā || 33 || ādityarūpe daityo'yaṃ jñāto'haṃ śaśibhāskaraiḥ || niveditaśca devāya tenā'pi laghukāriṇā || 34 || cakreṇa pātitaṃ vatsa sabhujaṃ mastakaṃ mama || amṛtaprāśanātprāṇairna viyukto'smi dānava || 35 || na me kaṇṭhādadhobhāgamāgataṃ mama cakriṇā || śiracchinnaṃ mahārāja tatra prāṇāstataḥ sthitāḥ || 36 || śirasaśchedanāddīnaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā madhusūdanaḥ || jātānukampo bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 37 || pītāmṛtasya daityasya maraṇaṃ nā'sti karhicit || mama hastavinaṣṭānāṃ gatirbhavati śobhanā || 38 || amaratvaṃ tvamāsādya varaṃ varaya kāṃkṣitam || tato mayokto bhagavānpraṇamya madhusūdanaḥ || || 39 || labheyātāṃ hi somārkau matto deva parābhavam || pūjāñca prārthaye lokādgrahatvañca janārdana || 1.42.40 || evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānmāmuvāca tadā hariḥ || grahatvaṃ bhavitā daitya pūjāṃ caivopalapsyase || 41 || parvakāle ca saṃprāpte candrārkau chādayiṣyati || 42 || tamo mūrttiradṛśyaśca viparītaṃ cariṣyasi|| bhūmicchāyāgataścandraṃ candrago'rkaṃ ca dānavaḥ ||43|| yasyodayiṣyasi yadā tadā bhāgamavāpsyasi || snāne jāpye tathā home dāne śrāddhe surārcane || 44 || puṇyaḥ sa kālo bhavitā nityamevā'sureśvara || evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata ||45|| pīta śeṣamathādāya saumaṃ suragaṇeśvaraḥ || suraloke sannihitaṃ cakāra balavṛtrahā||46|| macchīrṣapātābhivivṛddhakopā hṛtā'mṛtā daityagaṇāḥ samastāḥ || vyarthabhramā devagaṇānnihantuṃ sannaddhasainyāḥ prayayustadānīm ||47|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'mṛtavibhāgo nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||42 || <1.43> || rāhuruvāca || balibāṇamahākūrma śambarāvartabhīṣaṇam || anuhrādamahāgrāhaṃ kālakeyamahājalam || 1 || hiraṇyākṣamahāratnaṃ prahrādācalaniścalam || tathā namucikallolaṃ hrādasaṃhrādaśabdavat ||2|| hiraṇyakaśipūdyotaṃ kālanemibalāhakam || amṛtāharaṇakṣubdhaṃ tadā daityamahārṇavam || 3 || kṣubdhaṃ daityārṇavaṃ śrutvā nirgataṃ samarāya ca || niryayustridaśāḥ sarve sannaddhā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 4 || tataḥ pravartate yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ bhīrubhayaṃkaram || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca parasparavadhaiṣiṇām||5|| pātyamāneṣu śastreṣu kavaceṣu mahātmanām|| devānāṃ dānavānāñca hyutpeturjvalanārciṣaḥ ||6|| gajavājikhurakṣuṇṇamuttasthau sumahadrajaḥ || yugāntānaladhūmābhaṃ trailokasyeva dahyataḥ || 7 || tasminpravṛtte rajasi ghore bhīrubhayaṃkare || nirmaryādamabhūdyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha||8|| tato daityasamutthena tathā devodbhavena ca || rudhireṇa mahī vyāptā praśāntañca rajaḥ kṣaṇāt||9|| dhvaje cchatre rathe nāge cāmare vyajane haye|| sarvatra dṛśyate daityaraktaṃ lākṣārasaprabham ||1.43.10 || tasminyuddhe mahāraudre daityadānavanāśane || babhramuḥ kuñjarā mattā mahāmātrapracoditāḥ ||11|| hatairvīraistathai vā'nyaiḥ kuñjarāḥ parvatopamāḥ || kurvantaḥ svānyanīkāni dṛśyante śataśo raṇe || 12 || chinnadantā bhinnadhvajā vihastacaraṇāstathā || śailābhāpatitāstatra śobhayanto raṇājiram || 13 || babhramuḥ sādibhirhīnā hayāḥ sūryahayopamāḥ || mṛtāśca śataśastatra dṛśyante vikṛtānanāḥ || 14 || āgulphamavasīdanti daityāḥ śoṇitakardame || rathibhirnihatā nāgā nāgaiśca nihatā rathāḥ || 15 || hayāśca viddhā nāgaistu sādibhiḥ kuñjarā hatāḥ || rathasādigajārohairnihatāśca padātayaḥ ||16|| pattinā mahatā sādī kuñjaro ratha eva ca || tataḥ prāvartata nadī rudhiraughataraṅgiṇī ||17|| astragrāhā dhanurmīnā cakrakūrmā mahāsvarā || chatrahaṃsā nāgavatī keśaśaivalaśādvalā || 18 || daityaśīrṣopalā raudrā tathā bhīrubhayāvahā || bāhusarpā mahāvartā śarāṇāṃ harṣavarddhinī || 19 || apāragamyā pattīnāṃ phenapuñjasamākulā || tasminyuddhe mahāghore tumule lomaharṣaṇe || 1.43.20 || ākīrṇā vasudhā bhāti vadanaiḥ kamalopamaiḥ || vivṛttaiśca mahādaṃṣṭairdānavānāṃ mahātmanām || 21 || bāhubhiścāṅgadaiścaiva raktacandanarūṣitaiḥ || hastihastairmahāprāsairasibhiśca mahādhanaiḥ || 22 || tālavṛntaistathā chatraiścāmarairyaṣṭibhistathā|| mukuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalaiścaiva śuśubhe bhūrvibhūṣitā ||23|| tataste dānavāḥ kruddhāḥ svayuddhena dievepsavaḥ || abhidravanti deveśaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ puraṃdaram||24|| daityānāṃ patatāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahrādaṃ devasūdanam|| pratyudyayau gajenā ''jau devarājo mahābalaḥ || 25 || hutāśano'pi namucimanuhrādaṃ tathā śaśī|| varuṇaśca tathā bāṇaṃ yamo devastathā balim ||26|| hiraṇyakaśipuṃ rudro vāyurvṛtrāsuraṃ raṇe || virūpākṣaṃ tathā śaṃbhurhiraṇyākṣaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ ||27|| anye ca daityāḥ śataśaḥ saṃyuktā devatāgaṇaiḥ || dvandvayuddhasahasreṣu teṣvavartata dānavaiḥ || 28 || prāyaśo vijitā devā yayurbhagnā diśo daśa || dānavāśca jayaṃ labdhvā devānanuyayurbalāt ||29 || te bhagnāstridaśāḥ sarve dānavaiścāpyabhidrutā || trāṇārthamatha saṃprāptā naranārāyaṇāśramam || 1.43.30 || devānāmabhayaṃ dattvā naranārāyaṇau tadā || śaṃkhacakrāyudhadharau yuddhāya samavasthitau || 31 || naranārāyaṇau dṛṣṭvā tatkṣubdhaṃ daityasāgaram || sarvāyudhavisargeṇa tayoryuddhaṃ vyavasthitam || 32 || gajābhrajālasaṃchannaṃ śaradhāraughavarṣaṇam || calankhaḍgalatāvidyuddaityadurdinamābabhau || 33 || tataḥ śarai rukmavibhūṣitāgraiḥ sunetrapuṃkhairjvalanārkavarṇaiḥ || bibheda gātrāṇi naro ripūṇāṃ jahāra śīrṣāṇi sakuṇḍalāni || 34 || nārāyaṇopyuttamavīryatejāścakreṇa cakre ditinandanānām || vidārayāmāsa mahānubhāvastasminraṇe ghoratare tadānīm || 35 || vīryaṃ tayorapratimaṃ nirīkṣya te dānavā bhagnanikṛttayodhāḥ || hatāmṛtā jīvitamātraśeṣā vegena yātā varuṇādhivāsam ||36 || labdhvā jayaṃ devapatirmahātmā prahrādamājau ca tathā vijitya || saṃpūjayāmāsa mahānubhāvau dharmātmajau tāpasasaṃghamukhyau || 37 || saṃpūjya tau dharmasutau jitārirdevaiḥ prahṛṣṭairanuyāsyamānaḥ || jagāma nākaṃ tridaśapradhānaḥ sukhī babhūvātha gatajvaraśca || 38 || evaṃ prabhāvo bhagavānsa viṣṇurvairaṃ na me rocati tena nityam || sandhiṃ kuruṣvā''tmahitāya rājañchakreṇa tenāriniṣūdanena || 39 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārka ṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāhuvākyena devadānavayuddhavarṇano nāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || <1.44> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || evamuktastadā sālvo rāhuṇā bhīmavikramaḥ || jagāda bhrātaraṃ vākyaṃ sārabhūtamahetumat || 1 || sālva uvāca || asāre graha saṃsāre nitye satatayāyini || bhavakṣaye matiḥ kāryā rujopakaraṇeṣu vā || jantavastrividhā loke tridhā yeṣāṃ viceṣṭitam || 2 || tāmasārājasāścaiva sāttvikāśca graheśvara || bhavakṣaye ye vimukhā bhavopakaraṇeṣu ca || 3 || lokadvitayavibhraṣṭāstāmasāste prakītitāḥ || bhavakṣayamatibhraṣṭā bhavopakaraṇe sthitāḥ || 4 || rājasāste vinirdiṣṭā madhyasthāḥ sarvajantuṣu || bhavopakaraṇe daitya matiyerṣāṃ na vidyate || 5 || bhavakṣaye matiryeṣāṃ sāttvikāste prakīrtitāḥ || tāmasatvānmayā daitya matiḥ pūrvaṃ bhavakṣaye || 6 || na kṛtā tena tapyāmi rājyatantramanuṣṭhitam || manvantare'pi sampūrṇe mṛtiryeṣāṃ grahottama || 7 || udvijantyeva te mṛtyormahanmṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam || avaśyaṃ daitya marttavyaṃ sarveṇeha śarīriṇā || 8 || so'haṃ mokṣaparibhraṣṭaḥ kāmaye keśavādvadham || iṣṭaṃ yajñaistapastaptaṃ ripūṇāṃ mūrdhani sthitam || 9 || marttavye ca dhruve gamānmaraṇaṃ kāmayāmyaham || saṃprāpya keśavānmṛtyuṃ gatiṃ prāpsyāmyanuttamām || 1.44.10 || bhūyo rājyamavāpsyāmi nākabhraṣṭo grahottama || vivāsya vāsavaṃ svargātparibhūya punaḥpunaḥ || 11 || kathaṃ sandhiṃ kariṣyāmi tenā'haṃ jīvitapriyaḥ || praṇāmaṃ deva rājasya keśavānmaraṇaṃ varam |||12|| samīkṣya sādhu paśyāmi keśavānmaraṇaṃ raṇe || śakreṇa kṛtasandhānaṃ pātālanilayaṃ tathā || 13 || tyakṣanti māṃ daityagaṇā vṛddhaṃ patimivā'ṅganāḥ || divi bhūmau tathā svarge pātāle gagane jale||14|| dehināṃ mṛtyurabhyeti tasya nā'sti palāyanam || sarve kṣayāntā nicayāḥ patanāntāḥ samucchrayāḥ||15|| saṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṃ hi jīvitam || avaśyabhāvinyarthe'sminsarveṣāṃ graha sarvadā || 16 || puṇyabhājo hi maraṇaṃ saṃgrāme yadi jāyate || so'haṃ kṣatriyadharmeṇa saṃpūjya samare harim || 17|| tasmānmṛtyumanuprāpya gatiṃ prāpsyāmi śobhanām|| naivedyaiḥ puppadhūpādyairna tathā pūjito hariḥ ||18|| toṣamāyāti daityendra sa dharmeṇa yathā nṛṇām || bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena yadvācyaṃ suhṛdā hitamicchatā ||19|| tadukto'smi tvayā nātha devāttanme na rocate || sa tvaṃ gaccha mahābhāga dividraṣṭāsi māṃ punaḥ || 1.44.20 || dehāntaramanuprāptaṃ graha divyena cakṣuṣā || ||mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| ityeva sālvasya niśamya vākyaṃ kālānurūpaṃ ca tathā viditvā|| na kiñciduktvaiva jagāma rāhurdivaṃ mahātmā jagatāṃ pradhānaḥ ||21|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sālvavākyaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || <1.45> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || rāhau divamasaṃprāpte sālve rājñi sabhāṃ gate || rāmeṇa preṣito dūtaḥ saṃprāptastvakṛtavraṇaḥ || 1 || sa praviṣṭaḥ sabhāṃ ramyāṃ sālvarājñā ca pūjitaḥ || pādyārghyācamanīyādyairniṣaṇṇo vākyamabravīt || 2 || akṛtavraṇa uvāca || dūto'haṃ preṣitaḥ sālva rāmeṇā'kliṣṭakarmmaṇā|| śrutvā rāmasya vacanaṃ tataḥ kuru yathepsitam ||3|| āha tvāṃ bhārgavo rāmastryambakeṇa visarjitaḥ|| tvayā yuddhāya daityendra saṃgrāme kriyatāṃ kṣaṇam||4|| vivāsya vāsavaṃ svargāddevāñjitvā sadā''have|| anayasyā'sya ghorasya phalaṃ prāpnuhi durmate ||5|| nāhaṃ pramatte viśvaste praharāmi kadācana|| tena te preṣito dūtastasmādyuddhe sthiro bhava ||6|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktastadā sālvo brāhmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt || nā'haṃ rāmakṛte brahmansannahyāmi kadācana || 7 || kintu sainyena sarveṇa sannaddhena varūthinā || mahādevaṃ vijeṣyāmi yena rāmo visarjitaḥ || 8 || sannaddhasainyasahitaṃ mahādevajayaiṣiṇam || yadi māṃ yotsyate rāmo hantāsmi tamahaṃ mṛdhe || 9|| sa tvaṃ gaccha yathākāmaṃ rāmāya vinivedaya || etadvacanamādāya sālvasya sa mahātmanaḥ || 1.45.10 || jagāma rāmaṃ dharmajñaṃ sālvavākyaniveditaḥ || gatvā śaśaṃsa rāmāya saiṃhikeyaviceṣṭitam || 11 || tena vākyena rāmo'pi roṣāddaityapuraṃ yayau || rāmadūte gate tasmin daityānsālvaḥ pracodayat || 12 || sannahyadhvaṃ vijeṣyāmaḥ sagaṇaṃ bhagasūdanam || tataste dānavāḥ sarve sālvavākyapracoditāḥ || 13 || sannaddhā svagṛhebhyastu rājadvāramupāgatāḥ|| kuñjarāṇāṃ ninādena śaṅkhabherīraveṇa ca||14|| rājadvāre mahāñchabdastumulaḥ samapadyata|| hutvā hutāśanaṃ snātaḥ sālva saṃpūjya ca dvijān || 15 || āruroha gajaṃ mattaṃ śailāgraṃ savitā yathā || 16 || vinirgataṃ daityapatiṃ samīkṣya daityeśvarāḥ kālasamānadarpāḥ || ūcustadā taṃ samareṣvajeyama jayasva śambhuṃ yudhi saṃpragṛhya ||17|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrabhārgavarāmayuddhe sālvaniryāṇaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 || <1.46> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vyaspandatā'tha sālvasya rājanbāhuradakṣiṇaḥ || hadayañca tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ nayanañcāpya dakṣiṇam ||1|| śūnyacittaśca vimanāḥ kampate ca muhurmuhuḥ | papāta nāyakaścā'pi kirīṭāttārakaprabhaḥ||2|| ākramanti gajāḥ pādaṃ tathā vāmena dakṣiṇam || kareṇa veṣṭayanti sma tathā dantamadakṣiṇam || madaṃ tyajanti ye mattāsturagāśca muhurmuhuḥ || 3 || saṃspṛśanti tathā vāmaṃ pārśvaṃ prothena vāmunā|| vṛkāḥ śṛgālāḥ śārdūlā viḍālā gardabhāḥ śaśāḥ ||4|| vāmībhūtvā dānavānāṃ yānti dakṣiṇatastataḥ || eṇā varāhāḥ pṛṣato yānti teṣāñca vāmataḥ||5|| dīptāyāṃ diśi vāśanti mṛgāsteṣāmapasvanam || tailapaṅkaguḍāṅgāracarmakeśatṛṇāni ca|6|| dānavānāṃ prayātānāṃ saṃbhavantyagratastathā || evaṃvidhā durnimittā jātāḥ sālvasya paśyataḥ ||7|| matiḥ suniścitaivā''sīnmaraṇaṃ prati yādava || sa yayau saha sainyena mahatā caturaṅgiṇā||| kailāsaparvataṃ yoddhuṃ mahādevena śūlinā || 9 || yuddhotsuke daityapatau prayāte vyadṛśyatāgrecaracaṇḍavegaḥ || rāmaḥ pravālāruṇakomalena dīptapratāpena virājamānaḥ || 1.46.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sālvasenādurnimittadarśanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||46|| <1.47> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vahnijvālāgravarṇena jaṭājūṭena rājitam || gaganārddhamivā''rūḍhaṃ nidāghe ravimaṇḍalam || 1 || ādhāraṃ sarvadevānāṃ tapasā dyotitaprabham || sevamānamavasanaṃ pītagātramarindamam || 2 || ekamekākinaṃ vīraṃ sahasraśatamaṇḍitam || piṇḍitaṃ sakalaṃ dhāma brahmakṣatriyatejasām || 3 || kṛṣṇājinottarāsaṅgabhrājamānaṃ baloddhatam || snigdhayā rañjitamiva prāyeṇa pārvatīdṛśā || 4 || virājamānaṃ dordaṇḍarukmadaṇḍena bhāsvatā|| paraśvadhena tīkṣṇena vimalākāśavarcasā || 5 || tapasvinamanādṛśyaṃ yamakālāntakopamam || kampamānaṃ padanyāsairvasudhāṃ sakalāṃ tathā ||6|| muṣṇantaṃ sarvatejāṃsi prabhāte ravimaṇḍalam|| prāṃśuṃ kanakavarṇāṅgaṃ sitayajñopavītinam ||7|| gaṅgāyāḥ pravaheṇaiva meruśṛṃgaṃ virājitam|| tejasā dahanākāraṃ prajāsaṃhārakārakam || 8 || viṣamaṃ pramatheśasya tṛtīyamiva locanam || aprasahyamanāvāryaṃ durlaṅghyaṃ jīvitacchidam || 9 || kāleneva bhujaṃ savyaṃ daityahetoḥ prasāritam || rāme dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāpte dānavānāṃ samantataḥ || 1.47.10 || hāhākāro mahānāsīttamekaṃ nighnatāṃ raṇe || śastradhāraṇavibhraṣṭabrāhmaṇyaṃ svapathāccyutam || 11 || ghātayadhvaṃ durācāramenamūcuḥ parasparam || evamādravatāṃ teṣāṃ bahūnāmātatāyinām || 12 || jagrāha vegaṃ sarveṣāṃ marutāmiva parvataḥ || sa hanyamāno nārācaistomarairmuśalaistathā ||13|| gadābhirasibhiḥ pāśairbhuśuṇḍībhirayoguḍaiḥ || paṭṭiśairbhindipālaiśca hutaiḥ śūlaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ||14|| na vivyathe hyameyātmā dharādhara ivā'nilaiḥ ||15|| saṃveṣṭitaṃ sarvata eva sainyairadṛṣṭayuddho'pi raṇe mahātmā|| daityārṇavaṃ goṣpadatulyamātramamanyatā''jau raṇacaṇḍavegaḥ ||16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde yuddhe bhārgavarāmadarśanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 || <1.48> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || siṃhikāputrasainyena hanyamānastadā raṇe || gocarābhyāgatānsarvānrāmo ninye yamakṣayama || 1 || tena kṛttāḥ paraśunā yathā paraśunā mṛgāḥ || āliṅgya śerate kṣoṇīṃ dānavāste madoddhatāḥ ||2|| tīkṣṇadhārāgraduṣprekṣyakuṭhāracchinnamastakaiḥ || ātatāra tadā bhūmiṃ kuśairvedimivādhvare || 3 || paraśvadhāgrasaṃbhinnadaityadehasamudbhavam || prasusrāva tadā raktaṃ yenā''sītkardamaṃ mahat || 4 || te hanyamānā rāmeṇa rāmamevā'bhidudruvuḥ || paripūrṇe yathā kāle śalabhā jātavedasam || 5 || rāmasya pramukhe daityāstadā tiṣṭhanti ye nṛpa || nimeṣāntaramātreṇa te prayānti yamakṣayam || 6 || kuñjarasturagaḥ pattirnājau yādava dṛśyate || dvitīyaṃ pradadau yasya prahāraṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ || 7 || ekaprahārābhigatāndānavānparvatopamān|| apaśyāma raṇe tatra brahmaṇā sahitā vayam ||8|| rāmeṇa hanyamānānāṃ dānavānāṃ muhurmuhuḥ || ārāvaḥ śrūyate ghoro vanānāmiva dahyatām || 9 || ākramya padbhyāṃ tarasā rathasthānāmathāharat || śīrṣāṇi tena tīkṣṇena tathā paraśunā raṇe || 1.48.10 || rāmeṇā''kramyamāṇeṣu ratheṣu rathayūthapāḥ || bhūmau niviṣṭamūrddhānastatyajurjīvitaṃ hayāḥ || 11 || niṣpipeṣa rathasthānāṃ dārayankuñjarānraṇe || babhrame tatra tatraikaḥ kālotsṛṣṭa ivāntakaḥ || 12 || vicchindanyodhaśīrṣāṇi raṇe rāmo rathādratham || vrajanbhāti viśālākṣo vṛkṣādavṛkṣamivā'ṇḍaja || 13 || sa śarāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ śoṇitena samukṣitaḥ || rarāja rāmaḥ samare raśmimāniva bhāskaraḥ || 14 || daityabāhuvinirmuktānāyudhāñchataśastathā || paraśvadhāgreṇa raṇe ciccheda raṇakarkaśaḥ || 15 || teṣāṃ saṃchidyamānānāṃ prādurāsīddhutāśanaḥ || yena tāneva tarasā kṣitau cakre sa bhasmasāt || 16 || bahutvāddaityayodhānāṃ rāmassaṃchādito raṇe || hetipuñjena mahatā śailābhena na dṛśyate || 17 || hetipuñjaṃ vidhūyogramabhrapuñjaṃ yathā raviḥ || punardarśanamāyāti saṃharttā daityatejasām || 18 || brahmā suragaṇaiḥ sārddhamṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ || pūjayāmāsa tadyuddhaṃ sādhuvādena yādava || 19 || dṛṣṭavantaśca dhanuṣā yuddhāni ca muhurmuhuḥ || tathaivā''ścaryabhūtāni lokānāṃ khaḍgacarmaṇā || 1.48.20 || apūrva eṣa saṃgrāmo rāmasya bahubhiḥ saha || paraśvadhāyudhasyogra iti devāstathā'bruvan || 21 || pūjyamānaḥ sa rāmo'pi devapuṣpotkaraistadā || ciccheda yudhi daityānāṃ śirāṃsi śataśo raṇe || 22 || daityaśoṇitadigdhāṅgaṃ bhārgavaṃ laghuvikramam || alātacakrapratimaṃ tadā paśyati yādava || 23 || bhramatā'nena raudreṇa raṇe kālāgnivarccasā || kṛtāḥ samaraśauṇḍena bhīmā rudhiranimnagāḥ || 24 || paraśvadhāgravikṣepagatajīvitakuñjaraiḥ || pādopalaiśca samare pratastāra sa bhārgavaḥ || 25 || dantidantapadanyāsaprāptaṃ kuñjaramastakam || vinighnansa gajārohācchyenavadvicaran laghu || 26 || āruhya kuṃjarañcaikaṃ kuñjarātkuñjarāntaram || apaśyāma raṇe rāmaṃ vicarantaṃ yathāsukham || 27 || bhūyo bhūmigato rāmaḥ kuñjarāṇāṃ paraśvadhā || cakāra kadanaṃ ghoraṃ pralayāgnirivotthitaḥ || 28 || chinnāgrahastānviradāndviradāñchoṇitokṣitān || kṣitau gatā na paśyāmaḥ śyāmīkṛtadigantarān|| 29 || evaṃ hi yudhyatā tena raṇe kālāgnivarcasā || hatāni dānavendrāṇāṃ prayutānyarbudāni ca || 1.48.30 || yeṣāṃ prahāraṃ saṃsoḍhuṃ neyaṃ śaktā vasundharā || teṣāṃ prahārabhinnāṅgo naiva rāmo vyakampata || 31 || dṛṣṭvā prahāravaiklavyaṃ nihatāṃśca mahāsurān || pradudruvurdaityagaṇāḥ sālvaṃ śaraṇamāhave || 32 || alpāvaśiṣṭānditijānpranaṣṭānsaṃvīkṣya sālvaḥ svahite niviṣṭān || rāmaṃ yayau tena gajena yuddhe rāmādraṇe yuddhamabhīpsamānaḥ || 33 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 sālvasainyavadho nāmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 || <1.49> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || tataḥ sālvo mahātejāḥ kuñjareṇa tarasvinā || arpayāmāsa dharmajña reṇukānandavardhanam || 1 || stabdhakarṇo vivṛttākṣaḥ kṛtvā kuṇḍalinaṃ karam || grīvāṃ sañcālayannāgo yayau gajamadoddhatam || 2 || dṛṣṭvaivāpatatastasya vegaṃ rāmo'pi taṃ gajam || huṃkāramātreṇa raṇe stambhayāmāsa vegitam || 3 || stambhayāmāsa nāgendraṃ śailendraśikharopamam || tasthau sa puratastasya sālvasya samarapriyaḥ || 4 || paraśuṃ rudhirāktāṅgaṃ sakalaṅkamalaṃ kare || dhārayan viṣṇuvadyāti sakalaṃ kamalaṅkare || 5 || dantinā dantinaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ rāmasyā''roḍhumicchataḥ || jahāra vegavānvegaṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || 6 || sālvasāyakasaṃghātavimukhīkṛtavikramam || rāmaṃ raṇe daityagaṇāśchādayanti varāyudhaiḥ || 7 || mahatā so'strapuṃjena rāmaḥ saṃchādito raṇe || nimīlitākṣaścikṣepa sālvāya paraśuṃ tadā || 8 || āgacchamānaṃ vegena sālvastaṃ paraśuṃ raṇe || āyudhairvārayāmāsa na śaśāka ca śatruhā || 9 || sa sālvāyudhasaṃghātaṃ bhaṅktvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ || jahāra śīrṣaṃ sālvasya mukuṭottamabhūṣitam || 1.49.10 || rāmo'pi bhūtalātprāpya gadāṃ hemavibhūṣitām || āvidhya nijaghānograṃ sālvaṃ kuñjarasaṃsthitam || 11 || dvāvaṅkuśadharau śreṣṭhau dvau ca carmāsidhāriṇau || patākādhāriṇaṃ caikaṃ gajasya jaghane sthitam || 12 || dehaṃ ca tasya sālvasya patākāṃ ca manoramām || etadādāya sakalamājagāma vasundharām || 13 || siṃhanādena rāmasya vitrasto gajayūthapaḥ || ārttanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā pradudrāva narādhipa || 14 || rāmakarmaṇi vṛtte tu bhūtalātparaśuṃ raṇe || jagrāha vegāvānvegāddānavāntacikīrṣayā || 15 || dṛṣṭvā saparaśuṃ rāmaṃ sālvaṃ ca vinipātitam || hataśeṣāstu te daityāḥ praviṣṭā varuṇālayam ||16|| etasminneva kāle tu devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ || āyodhanamupājagmuḥ puraskṛtya pitāmaham || 17 || praṇāmamakarotteṣāṃ rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ || pūjayitvā tu te rāmaṃ yayurdevāḥ svamālayam || 18 || śakro'pi labdhvā tridivaṃ rāmabāhuprasādhitam || vijahāra divaṃ rājanpālayāno jagattrayam || 19 || rathena siṃhayuktena mahādevo'pi bhārgavam|| ādāya prayayau śīghraṃ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam || 1.49.20 || snehena cā'sya gātrāṇāṃ cakre sammārjanaṃ haraḥ || yenā''sīdbalavān rāmo nirvraṇaśca mahāśayāḥ || 21 || gatavraṇaṃ śriyopetaṃ jayaṃ labdhvā hyupasthitam || rāmaṃ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śaṃkaro vākyamabravīt| 22 || śaṅkara uvāca || rāmarāma mahābhāga tvayā'haṃ paritoṣitaḥ || tasmāttavā'haṃ dāsyāmi cāstragrāmaṃ hyanuttamam || 23 || astrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe śaktastvameko bhuvi bhārgava || tava dhairyamanaupamyaṃ tava sattvamanuttamam || 24 || astrayogamihasthastvaṃ kṛtvā putra śanaiḥśanaiḥ || sarvāstravittato rāma gantāsi pitaraṃ svakam || 25 || yaścaiva paraśurdivyaḥ pitrā dattastavā'nagha || adya prabhṛti te kṣiptaḥ karaṃ bhūyaḥ sameṣyati || 26 || upalakṣaṇametacca tathā tava bhaviṣyati || chetsyāmi te saṃśayāṃśca nirvṛto bhava putraka || 27 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityevamuktaḥ paripūrṇakāmo rāmo mahātmā jitasainyanāvaḥ || uvāsa tatra pramathaiḥ sametaḥ sarvāṇyathāstrāṇyanuśikṣamāṇaḥ || 28 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sālvavadho nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || <1.50> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || brahmāstraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramāgneyamatha vāsavam || astrañca nairṛtaṃ yāmyaṃ kauberamatha vāruṇam || 1 || vāyavyamatha saumyañca sauraṃ pārvatameva ca || cakrāstramatha vajrāstraṃ pāśāstraṃ sārpameva ca || 2 || gāndharvaṃ svāpanaṃ bhautaṃ tathā pāśupataṃ śubham || aiṣīkaṃ tarjanaṃ prāsaṃ bhāruṇḍaṃ nartanaṃ tathā || 3 || astrarodhanamādityaṃ raivataṃ mānavaṃ tathā || akṣisaṃtarjanaṃ bhīmaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ rodhanaṃ tathā || 4 || sauparṇamatha pārjanyaṃ rākṣasaṃ mohanaṃ tathā || kālāstraṃ dānavāstrañca astraṃ brahmaśirastathā || 5 || etānyanyāni cā'nyāni rāmo nivasane tataḥ || saprayogarahasyāni sasaṃhārāṇi cāpyatha || 6 || ājahāra mahādevātprasādasumukhāttataḥ || evaṃ hi vasataḥ kālo yayau rāmasya dhīmataḥ || 7 || haraprasādasaṃjātavisrambho bhṛgunandanaḥ || dhyānāsaktaṃ haraṃ devaṃ kadācidatha dṛṣṭavān || 8 || dhyānaprasaktaṃ sa haraṃ samīkṣya rāmastu saṃjātakutūhalena || visiṣmiye dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ sa cetasā yādavavaṃśacandra || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṃḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde astra pradānaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || <1.51> ||mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite || nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣininādite || 1 || gaṃgānirjharasaṃjāte satataṃ cārunisvane || devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ paryapṛcchata bhārgavaḥ || 2 || rāma uvāca || devadeva mahādeva gaṃgālulita mūrddhaja || śaśāṃkalekhāsaṃyukta jaṭābhārātibhāsvara || 3 || pārvatīdattadehārdha kāmakālāṅganāśana || bhaganetrāntakācintya pūṣṇo daśanaśātana || || 4 || tvattaḥ parataraṃ devaṃ nā'nyaṃ paśyāmi kañcana || pūjayanti sadā liṃgaṃ tava devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 5 || stuvanti tvāmṛṣigaṇā dhyāyanti ca muhurmuhuḥ || pūjayanti tathā bhaktyā varadaṃ parameśvara || 6 || jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārapālane || tvāmekaṃ kāraṇaṃ manye tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 7 || kaṃ tvaṃ dhyāyasi deveśa tatra me saṃśayo mahān || ācakṣva tanme bhagavanyadyanugrāhyatā mayi || 8 || prasādasāṃmukhyatayā mayaitadvisrambhamāsādya jagatpradhāna || bhavantamīḍyaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā pṛcchāmi saṃjātakutūhalātmā || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde paraśurāmopākhyāne śaṃkaragītāsu rāmapraśno nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 || <1.52> || śaṃkara uvāca || tvaduktoyamanupraśno rāma rājīvalocana || tvamekaḥ śrotumarho'si matto bhṛgukulodvaha || 1 || yattatparamakaṃ dhāma mama bhārgavanandana || yattadakṣaramavyaktaṃ paraṃ yasmānna vidyate || jñānajñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya cāśritam || 2 || tvāmahaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ cintayāmi janārdanam || etadrāma rahasyaṃ te yathāvatkathitaṃ vacaḥ || 3 || ye bhaktāstamajaṃ devaṃ na te yānti parābhavam || tamīśamajamavyaktaṃ sarvabhūtaparāyaṇam || 4 || nārāyaṇamanirdeśyaṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇam || sarvataḥ pāṇipādantaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || 5 || sarvataḥ śrutimām̐lloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati || sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam || 6|| asaktaṃ sarvataścaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca || bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraścara eva ca || 7 || sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntikaṃ ca yat || avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam ||8|| bhūtavartiṃ ca tajjñeyaṃ graśiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca || jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotiḥ tamasāṃ paramucyate ||9|| anādimatparaṃ brahma na sattannā'saducyate || prakṛtirvikṛtiryo'sau jagatāṃ bhūtabhāvanaḥ||1.52.10 || yasmātparataraṃ nāsti taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || icchāmātramidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 11 || yasya devādidevasya taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || yasminsarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaḥ sarvaṃ sarvataśca yaḥ || 12 || yaśca sarvamayo nityastaṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || yogīśvaraṃ padmanābhaṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ jagatpatim || 13 || jagannāthaṃ viśālākṣaṃ cintayāmi jagadgurum || śuciṃ śucipadaṃ haṃsaṃ tatparaṃ parameṣṭhinam || 14 || yuktā sarvātmanā''tmānaṃ taṃ prapadye prajāpatim || yasminviśvāni bhūtāni tiṣṭhanti ca viśanti ca || 15 || guṇabhūtāni bhūteśe sūtre maṇigaṇā iva || yasminnitye tate tantau dṛṣṭe khagiva tiṣṭhati || 16 || sadasadgrathitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvāṃge viśvakarmaṇi || hariṃ sahasraśirasaṃ sahasracaraṇekṣaṇam || 17 || prāhurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ yaṃ viśvasya parāyaṇam || aṇīyasāmaṇīyāṃsaṃ sthaviṣṭhañca sthavīyasām || 18 || garīyasāṃ gariṣṭhañca śreṣṭhañca śreyasāmapi || yaṃ vākeṣvanuvākeṣu niṣatsūpaniṣatsvapi || 19 || gṛṇanti satyakarmāṇaṃ satyaṃ satyeṣu sāmasu || caturbhiścaturātmānaṃ sattvasthaṃ sāttvatāṃ patim ||1.52.20|| yaṃ divyairdevamarcanti guhyaiḥ paramanāmabhiḥ || yamananyo vyapetāśīrātmānaṃ vītakalmaṣam || 21 || iṣṭvānantyāya govindaṃ paśyatyātmanyavasthitam || purāṇaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto brahmā prokto yugādiṣu || 22 || kṣaye saṃkarṣaṇaḥ proktastamupāsyamupāsmahe || yamekaṃ bahudhātmānaṃ prādurbhūtamadhokṣajam || 23 || nānyabhaktāḥ kriyāvanto yajante sarvakāmadam || yamāhurjagatāṃ kośaṃ yasminsannihitāḥ prajāḥ ||24|| yasmiṃllokāḥ sphurantīme jāle śakunayo yathā || ṛtamekākṣaraṃ brahma yattatsadasataḥ param || 25 || anādimadhyaparyantaṃ na devā narṣayo viduḥ || yaṃ surāsuragandharvāssaṃsiddharṣimahoragāḥ||26|| prayatā nityamarcanti paramaṃ duḥkhabheṣajam || anādinidhanaṃ devamātmayoniṃ sanātanam || 27 || apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || ativāyvindrakarmāṇaṃ cā'tisūryāgnitejasam || 28 || atibuddhīndriyagrāmaṃ taṃ prapadye prajāpatim || yaṃ vai viśvasya karttāraṃ jagatastasthuṣāṃ patim || 29 || vadanti jagato'dhyakṣamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam || yasyāgnirāsyaṃ dyaurmūrdhā khaṃ nābhiścaraṇau kṣitiḥ || 1.52.30 || candrādityau ca nayane taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || yasya trilokī jaṭhare yasya kāṣṭhāśca vāhanāḥ ||31|| yasya śvāsaśca pavanastaṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || viṣaye vartamānānāṃ yaṃ taṃ vaiśeṣikairguṇaiḥ || 32 || prāhurviṣayagoptāraṃ taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || paraḥ kālātparo yajñātparassadasataśca yaḥ || 33 || anādirādirviśvasya taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham || padbhyāṃ yasya kṣitirjātā śrotrābhyāñca tathā diśaḥ ||34|| pūrvabhāge divaṃ yasya taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham|| nābhyāṃ yasyāntarikṣasya nāsābhyāṃ pavanasya ca || 35 || prasvedādambhasāṃ janma taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham ||36|| varāhaśīrṣaṃ narasiṃharūpaṃ deveśvaraṃ vāmanarūparūpam|| trailokyanāthaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ rāma nityaṃ manasā nato'smi||37|| vāktrādyasya brāhmaṇāssaṃprasūtā yadvakṣasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ saṃprasūtāḥ || yasyoruyugmācca tathaiva vaiśyāḥ padbhyāṃ tathā yasya śūdrāḥ prasūtāḥ ||38|| vyāptaṃ tathā yena jagatsamagraṃ vibhūtibhirbhūtabhavodbhavena || devādhināthaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ rāma nityaṃ manasā nato'smi||39|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrībhārgavarāmapraśne śaṅkaragītāsu dhyeyanirdeśonāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ52| <1.53> rāma uvāca || varāhaṃ narasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ ca maheśvara|| tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi prādurbhāvānmahātmanaḥ ||1|| śaṅkara uvāca|| aditiśca ditiścaiva dve bhārye kaśyapasya ca || aditirjanayāmāsa devānindrapurogamān ||2|| ditiśca janayāmāsa dvau putrau bhīmavikramau || hiraṇyākṣaṃ durādharṣaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tathā || 3 || tato'bhiṣiktavāñchakraṃ devarājye prajāpatiḥ || dānavānāṃ tathā rājye hiraṇyākṣaṃ balotkaṭam || 4 || abhiṣicya tayoḥ prādātsvargaṃ pātālameva ca|| pātālaṃ śāsati tathā hiraṇyākṣe mahāsure ||5|| dharādhārā dharāṃ tyaktvā khamutpetū rayātpurā|| pakṣavanto mahābhāga nūnaṃ bhāvyarthacoditāḥ || ||6|| dharādharaparityaktā dharā calanibandhanā || yadā tadā daityapuraṃ sakalaṃ vyāptamambhasā || 7 || dṛṣṭvaiva svapuraṃ vyāptamambhasā ditijottamaḥ || sainyamudyojayāmāsa jātaśaṅkaḥ surānprati || 8 || udyuktena sa sainyena daityānāṃ caturaṃgiṇā || vijitya tridaśāñjanye ājahāra triviṣṭapam || || 9 || hṛtādhikārāstridaśā jagmuḥ śaraṇamañjasā || devarājaṃ puraskṛtya vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum || 1.53.10 || tridaśāñcharaṇaṃ prāptā nhiraṇyākṣavivāsitān|| saṃyojyā'bhayadānena visasarja janārdanaḥ || 11 || visṛjya tridaśānsarvāñcintayāmāsa keśavaḥ || kinnu rūpamahaṃ kṛtvā ghātayiṣye surārdanam ||12|| tiryaṅmanuṣyadevānāmavadhyaḥ sa surāntakaḥ || brahmaṇo varadānena tasmāttasya vadhepsayā ||13|| nṛvarāho bhaviṣyāmi na devo na ca mānuṣaḥ || tiryagrūpeṇa caivāhaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi taṃ tataḥ || 14 || etāvaduktvā saṃgena nṛvarāho'bhavatprabhuḥ || cūrṇitāñjanaśailābhastapta jāmbūnadāmbaraḥ || 15 || yamunāvarttakṛṣṇāṅgaḥ tadāvartatanūruhaḥ || tadogha iva durvāryyastatpitrā tejasā samaḥ || 16 || tatpravāha ivākṣobhyasta tpravāha ivaughavān || tatpravāhāmalatanustatpravāhamanoharaḥ || 17 || sajalāñjanakṛṣṇāṅgaḥ sajalāmbudasacchaviḥ || pītavāsāstadā bhāti savi dyudiva toyadaḥ || 18 || urasā dhārayanhāraṃ śaśāṅkasadṛśacchaviḥ || śuśubhe sarvabhūtātmā sabalāka ivāmbudaḥ || 19 || śaśāṅkalekhāvimale daṃṣṭre tasya virejatuḥ || meghāntaritabimbasya dvau bhāgau śaśino yathā || 1.53.20 || karābhyāṃ dhārayanbhāti śaṅkhacakre janārdanaḥ | candrārkasadṛśe rāma pādacārīva parvataḥ || 21 || mahājīmūtasaṃkāśo mahājīmūtasannibhaḥ || mahajīmūtavadvegī mahābalaparākramaḥ || 22 || dānavendravadhākāṅkṣī hiraṇyākṣasabhāṃ yayau || hiraṇyākṣo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛvarāhaṃ janārdanam || 23 || dānavām̐ścodayāmāsa tiryagjātamapūrvakam || gṛhyatāṃ vadhyatāṃ caiva krīḍārthaṃ sthāpyatāṃ tathā || 24 || ityevamuktaḥ saṃrabdhaḥ pāśahastām̐stu dānavān || jighṛkṣamāṇāṃścakreṇa jaghāna śataśo raṇe || 25 || hanyamāneṣu daityeṣu hiraṇyākṣo'tha dānavān || codayāmāsa saṃrabdhānvarāhādhikakāraṇāt || 26 || coditā dānavendreṇa dāna vā śastrapāṇayaḥ || pravavarṣustathā devaṃ śastravarṣeṇa keśavam || 27 || daityāḥ śastranipātena devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || naiva śekurvṛthā kartuṃ yatnavanto'pi nirbhayāḥ || 28 || hanyamāno'pi daityendrairdānavānmadhusūdanaḥ|| jaghāna cakreṇa tadā śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||29|| hanyamāneṣu sainyeṣu hiraṇyākṣaḥ svayaṃ tataḥ || utthāya dhanuṣā devaṃ pravavarṣa surottamam || 1.53.30 || hiraṇyākṣastu tāndṛṣṭvā viphalām̐śca śilī mukhān || śilīmukhābhānsaṃpaśyansamapaśyanmahadbhayam || 31 || tato'strairyuyudhe tena devadevena cakriṇā || tānyasya phalahīnāni cakāra bhagavān svayam || 32 || tato gadāṃ kāñcanapaṭṭanaddhāṃ vibhūṣitāṃ kiṃkiṇijālasaṃghaiḥ || cikṣepa daityādhipatiḥ sa ghorāṃ tāṃ cā'pi devo viphalīcakāra || 33 || śaktiṃ tataḥ paṭṭavinaddhamadhyāmulkānalābhāṃ tapanīyacitrām || cikṣepa daityassa varāhakāye huṅkāradagdhā nipapāta sā ca|| || 34 || tatastriśūlaṃ jvalitāgraśūlaṃ sa śīghragaṃ devagaṇasya saṃkhye || daityādhipastasya sajarja vegādavekṣitaḥ so'pi jagāma bhūmim || 35 || śaṅkhasvanenā'pi janārdanaśca vidrāvya daityānsakalānmahātmā || sakuṇḍalaṃ daityagaṇādhipasya ciccheda cakreṇa śiraḥ prasahya || 36 || nipātite daityapatau sa devaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ śakrapitāmahābhyām || mayā ca sarvaistridaśaiḥ sametaijargāma kāṣṭhāṃ manasā tvabhīṣṭām || 37 || śakropi labdhvā tridivaṃ mahātmā ciccheda pakṣāndharaṇīdharāṇām || rarakṣa cemāṃ sakalāṃ trilokīṃ dharmeṇa dharmajñabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ || 38 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsu nṛvarāhaprādurbhāve hiraṇyākṣavadho nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || <1.54> || śaṅkara uvāca || hiraṇyākṣe hate daitye bhrātā tasya mahātmanaḥ || hiraṇyakaśipurnāma cakārograṃ mahattapaḥ || 1 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca || japopavāsanirataḥ snānamaunāśritavrataḥ || 2 || tapaḥśamadamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa cā'nagha || brahmā prītamanāstasya svayamāgatya bhārgava || || 3 || vimānenā'rkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā || ādityaissahitaḥ sādhyaissahito marudaśvibhiḥ || 4 || rudrairviśvasahāyaiśca yakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ || digbhirvidigbhiśca tathā khecaraiśca mahāgrahaiḥ ||5 || nimnagābhiḥ samudraiśca māsartvayanasaṃdhibhiḥ || nakṣatraiśca muhūrttaiśca kālasyāvayavaistathā || 6 || devarṣibhiḥ puṇyatamaiḥ siddhaiḥ saptarṣibhistathā || rājarṣibhiḥ puṇyatamairgandharvairapsarogaṇaiḥ || 7 || carācaraguruḥ śrīmānvṛtaḥ sarverdivaukasaiḥ || brahmā brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho daityaṃ vacanamabravīt || 8 || brahmovāca || prītosmi tava bhaktasya tapasā'nena suvrata || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi || 9 || hiraṇyakaśipuruvāca || na devāsuragandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ || na mānuṣāḥ piśācā vā hanyurmāṃ devasattama ||1.54.10|| ṛṣayopi na māṃ śāpaṃ kruddhā lokapitāmaha || śapeyustapasā yuktā varametadvṛṇomyaham || 11 || na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa giriṇā pādapena ca || na śuṣkena na cā''rdreṇa vadhaṃ me syātkathañcana || 12 || bhaveyamahamevārkaḥ somo vāyurhutāśanaḥ || salilaṃ cā'ntarikṣañca nakṣatrāṇi diśo daśa || 13 || ahaṃ krodhaśca kāmaśca varuṇo vāsavo yamaḥ || dhanadaśca tathādhyakṣo yakṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣādhipaḥ || 14 || brahmovāca || ete divyavarāstāta mayā dattāstavādbhutāḥ || sarvānkāmānimām̐stasmātprāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || śaṅkara uvāca || evamuktvā sa bhagavāñjagāmā''kāśameva hi || vairājaṃ devasadanaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam || 16 || tato devāśca nāgāśca gandharvā munayastathā || varapradānaṃ śrutvaiva pitāmahamupasthitāḥ || || 17 || devā ūcuḥ || vareṇā'nena bhagavānvadhiṣyati sa no'suraḥ || tannaḥ prasīda bhagavanvadho'pyasya vicintyatām || 18 || bhagavānsarvabhūtānāṃ svayambhūrādikṛtprabhuḥ || sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānāṃ cā'vyaktaḥ prakṛtirdhruvaḥ || 19 || śaṅkara uvāca || sarvalokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ || provāca varado vākyaṃ sarvāndevagaṇāṃstataḥ || 1.54.20 || brahmovāca || avaśyaṃ tridaśāstena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam || tatastasya vadhaṃ viṣṇustapaso'nte kariṣyati || 21 || śaṅkara uvāca || evaṃ śrutvā surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ paṅkajajanmanaḥ || svāni sthānāni divyāni jagmuste vai mudānvitāḥ || 22 || laghumātre vare tasminsarvāḥ so'bādhata prajāḥ || hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo varadānena darpitaḥ || 23 || āśrameṣu mahātmāno munīndrānsaṃśitavratān || satyadharmaratāndāntāndurādharṣobhavaṃstu saḥ||24|| devāstribhuvasthāṃśca parājitya mahāsuraḥ|| | trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya svarge vasati dānavaḥ || 25 || yadā varamadonmatto hyāvāsaṃ kṛtavān divi || yājñiyānkṛtavāndaityānayājñeyāśca devatā || 26 || ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāstathā'śvinau || bhṛgavo'ṅgirasaḥ sādhyā marutaśca savāsavāḥ || 27 || śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumupatasthurmahābalam || devaṃ brahmamayaṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmabhūtaṃ sanātanam || 28 || bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya prabhuṃ lokaparāyaṇam || nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ devāḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||29|| devā ūcuḥ|| trāyasva no'dya deveśa hiraṇyakaśiporvadhāt || tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo devo brahmādīnāṃ surottama || 1.54.30 || protphullāmalapatrākṣa śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkara || kṣayāya ditivaṃśasya śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ bhavasva naḥ || 31 || śrībhagavānuvāca || bhayaṃ tyajadhvamamarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmyaham || tathaiva tridivaṃ devāḥ pratipadyata mā ciram || 32 || eṣo'muṃ sabalaṃ daityaṃ varadānena darpitam|| avadhyamamareṃdrāṇāṃ dānavendraṃ nihanmyaham || 33 || śaṅkara uvāca || evamuktvā sa bhagavānvisṛjya tridiveśvarān || nārasiṃhaṃ vapuścakra sahasrāṃśusamaprabham || 34 || prāṃśuṃ kanakaśailābhaṃ jvālāpuñjavibhūṣitam || daityasainyamahāmbhodhi vaḍavānalavarcasam || 35 || sandhyānuraktameghābhaṃ nīlavāsasamacyutam || devadāruvanacchannaṃ yathā meruṃ mahāgirim || 36 || saṃpūrṇavaktradaśanaiḥ śaśāṅkaśakalopamaiḥ || pūrṇaṃ muktāphalaiḥ śubhraiḥ samudramiva kāñcanam || 37 || nakhairvidrumasaṃkāśairvirājitakaradvayam || daityanāthakṣayakaraiḥ krodhasyaiva yathāṅkuraiḥ || 38 || saṭābhāraṃ sakuṭilaṃ vahnijvālāgrapiṃgalam || dhārayanbhāti sarvātmā dāvānalamivācalaḥ || 39 || dṛśyādṛśyamukhe tasya jihvābhyuditacañcalā || pralayāntāmbudasyeva cañcalā tu taḍillatā || 1.54.40 || āvarttibhirlomaghanairvyāptaṃ vigrahamūrjitam || mahākaṭitaṭaskandhamalātapratimekṣaṇam || 41 || kalpāntameghanirghoṣajvālāniḥśvāsamārutam || durnirīkṣyaṃ durādharṣaṃ vajramadhyavibhīṣaṇam || 42 || kṛtvā mūrtiṃ nṛsiṃhasya dānaveṃdrasabhāṃ yayau || tāmbabhañja tu vegena daityānāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ|| 43 || bhajyamānāṃ sabhāṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhena mahātmanā || hiraṇyakaśipū rājā dānavānsamacodayat || 44 || sattvajātamidaṃ ghoraṃ cāpūrvaṃ punarāgatam || ghātayadhvaṃ durādharṣaṃ yena me nāśitā sabhā ||45|| tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || āyudhairvividhairjaghnurdevadevaṃ janārdanam || 46 || nānāyudhasahasrāṇi tasya gātreṣu bhārgava || viśīrṇānyeva dṛśyante mṛlloṣṭānīva parvate || 47 || daityāyudhānāṃ vaiphalyaṃ kṛtvā hatvā ca dānavān || karapādaprahāraiśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 48 || jagrāha vegāddaiteyaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tataḥ || nṛsiṃhahetorvikrāntamastravarṣamahāmbudam || 49 || vegenotsaṃgamāropya kadalīdalalīlayā || dārayāmāsa daityeśaṃ vakṣatsthalamahāgirim || 1.54.50 || kṛtvā tamasubhirhīnaṃ daityeśaṃ keśavaḥ svayam || asurāṇāṃ vināśaṃ ca kruddho naraharirvyadhāt || 51 || hatvā'suraṃ śoṇitabinducitraṃ saṃpūjya devāḥ saha vāsavena || jagmussvadhiṣṇyāni mudā sametā devopyathāntarhitamūrtirāsa || 52 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsu narasiṃhaprādurbhāvo nāma catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 || <1.55> śaṅkara uvāca || hate hiraṇyakaśipau dānave devakaṇṭake || hataśeṣāstu daiteyāḥ pātālatalamāśritāḥ || 1 || pātālatalasaṃstheṣu dānaveṣu mahāyaśāḥ || prahrādapautro dharmātmā virocanasuto baliḥ || 2 || ārādhya tapasogreṇa varaṃ lebhe pitāmahāt || avadhyatvamajeyatvaṃ samareṣu surāsuraiḥ || || 3 || varalabdhaṃ baliṃ jñātvā punaścakrurditeḥ sutāḥ || prahṛṣṭā daityarājānaṃ prahrādānumaterbalim || 4 || saṃprāpya daityarājyaṃ tu balena caturaṃgiṇā || jitvā deveśvaraṃ śakramājahārā'marāvatīm || 5 || sthānabhraṣṭo mahendro'pi kaśyapaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || kaśyapena tadā sārdhaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 6 || brahmaṇā'bhihito devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ harim || amṛtādhmātameghābhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 7 || devo'pyabhayadānena saṃyojya balasūdanam || uvāca vacanaṃ kāle meghagambhīrayā girā||8|| śrībhagavānuvāca|| gaccha śakra bhaviṣyāmi trātā te balasūdana || devarūpadharo bhūtvā vañcayiṣyāmi taṃ balim ||9 || śaṅkara uvāca || evamuktastadā śakraḥ prayayau kaśyapāśramam|| ādideśā'dittergarbhaṃ cāṃśenā'tha ca sarvadā ||1.55.1 0|| garbhastha eva tejāṃsi dānavebhyaḥ sa ādade || tataḥ kālena suṣuve aditirvāmanākṛtim || 11 || yasmiñjāte suragaṇāḥ praharṣamatulaṃ gatāḥ || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstraikālyāmaladarśinaḥ || 12 || etasminneva kāle tu hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ || balirdaityapatiḥ śrīmānspāligrāmamupāśritaḥ || 13 || vāmaskandhe tamādāya tasya yajñe bṛhaspatiḥ || anayadbhṛguśārdūla nūnaṃ tasyaiva māyayā || 14 || yajñavāṭaṃ sa saṃprāpya yajñaṃ tuṣṭāva vāmanaḥ || ātmānamātmanā brahmanbhasmacchanna ivā'nalaḥ || 15 || praveśayāmāsa ca taṃ balirdharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || dadarśa ca mahābhāgaṃ vāmanaṃ sumanoharam || 16 || saṃyuktasarvāvayavaiḥ pīnaiḥ saṃkṣiptaparvabhiḥ || kṛṣṇājinajaṭādaṇḍakamaṇḍaluvirājitam |||17|| vikramiṣyanyathā vyāghro līyati sma svavigrahe || vikramiṣyam̐stathaivorvīṃ līnagātraḥ svavigrahe || 18 || etanminneva kāle tu hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ || tasmāttu prārthayadrājandehi mahyaṃ kramatrayam || 19 || evamuktastu devena balirdaityagaṇādhipaḥ || pradadāvudakaṃ tasya pāvayasveti cābravīt || 1.55.20 || anyacca yadabhīṣṭaṃ te tadgṛhāṇa dvijottama || pratijagrāha ca jalaṃ pravātyeva tadā hariḥ || 21 || udaṅmukherdaityavarairvīkṣyamāṇa ivāmbudaḥ || ākramattu harirlokāndānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 22 || abhidravanti vegena nānavaktraśirodharāḥ || garuḍānanāḥ khaḍgamukhā mayūravadanāstathā || 23 || ghorā makaravaktrāśca kroṣṭuvaktrāśca dānavāḥ || ākhudarduravaktrāśca ghora vṛkamukhāstathā || 24 || mārjāraśaśavaktrāśca haṃsakākānanāstathā || godhāśalyakavaktrāśca ajāvimahiṣānanāḥ || 26 || siṃhavyāghraśṛgālānāṃ dvīpivānarapakṣiṇām || hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrāṇāṃ bhujagānāṃ samānanāḥ || 26|| pratigrahajalaṃ prāpya vyavardhata tadā hariḥ || udaṅmukhairdevagaṇairīkṣyamāṇa ivāmbudaḥ || 27 || vikramantaṃ hariṃ lokāndānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || matsyakacchapavaktrāṇāṃ dardurāṇāṃ samānanāḥ || 28 || sthūladantā vivṛttākṣā lamboṣṭhajaṭharāstathā || piṅgalākṣo vivṛttāsyā nānābāhuśirodharāḥ || 29 || sthūlāgranāsāścipiṭā mahāhanukapālinaḥ || cīnāṃśukottarāsaṃgāḥ kecitkṛṣṇājināmbarāḥ || 1.55.30 || bhujaṅgābharaṇāścānye kecinmukuṭabhūṣitāḥ || sakuṇḍalāḥ sakaṭakāḥ saśirastrāṇamastakāḥ || 31 || dhanurbāṇadharāścā'nye tathā tomarapāṇayaḥ || khaḍgacarmadharāścā'nye tathā parighapāṇayaḥ || 32 || śataghnīcakrahastāśca gadāmuśalapāṇayaḥ || aśmayantrāyudhopetā bhiṇḍipālāyudhāstathā || 33 || śūlolūkhalahastāśca paraśvadhadharāstathā || mahāvṛkṣapravahaṇā mahāparvatayodhinaḥ || 34 || kramamāṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśamupāvarttanta sarvaśaḥ || sa tānmamarda sarvātmā tanmukhāndaityadānavān || 35 || sarasīva mahāpadmānmahāhastīva dānavān || pramathya sarvāndaiteyānhastapādatalaistataḥ ||36 || rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahābhīmamājahārā''śu medinīm|| tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare || 37 || paraṃ prakramamāṇasya nābhideśe vyavasthitau || tataḥ prakramamāṇasya jānudeśe vyavasthitau || 38 || tatopi kramamāṇasya padbhyāṃ devau vyavasthitau || jitvā sa medinīṃ kṛtsnāṃ hatvā cāsurapuṃgavān || 39 || dadau śakrāya vasudhāṃ viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ || svaṃ rūpañca tathā''sādya dānavendramabhāṣata || 1.55.40 || śrībhagavānuvāca || yajñavāṭaṃ tvadīye'sminsāligrāme mahāsura || mayā niviṣṭapādena māpiteyaṃ vasundharā || 41 || prathamaṃ tu padaṃ jātaṃ naurbandhaśikhare mama || dvitīyaṃ meruśikhare tṛtīyaṃ nā'bhavatkvacit || 42 || tanme varaya daityendra yanmayāptaṃ pratigraham|| baliruvāca || yāvatī vasudhā deva tvayaiva parinirmitā || 43 || tāvatī te na saṃpūrṇā devadeva kramatrayam || na kṛtaṃ yattvayā deva kutastanme maheśvara || 44 || na ca tadvidyate deva tathaivā'nyasya kasyacit || śrībhagavānuvāca || na me tvayāpūryate me dānavendra yathāśrutam || 45 || sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ vasa tatra susaṃyataḥ || mayaiva nirmitā tatra manasā śobhanā purī ||46|| jñātibhiḥ sahadharmiṣṭhairvasa tatra yathāsukham|| tatra tvaṃ bhokṣyase bhogānviśiṣṭānbalasūdanāt ||47|| avāpsyasi tathā bhogām̐lokādvidhivivarjitān|| prākāmyayuktaśca tathā lokeṣu vihariṣyasi ||48|| manvantare dvitīye ca mahendratvaṃ kariṣyasi || tejasā ca madīyena śakratve yokṣyase bale || 49 || tava śatrugaṇānsarvānghātayiṣyāmyahaṃ tadā || brahmaṇyastvaṃ śaraṇyastvaṃ yajñaśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ || 1.55.50 || tapasvī dānaśīlaśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || tasmādyaśobhivṛddhyarthaṃ mayā tvamabhisandhitaḥ || 51 || devarājādhikānbhogānpātālastho'pi bhokṣyase || sannidhānaśca tatrāhaṃ kariṣyāmyasurādhipa ||52|| mayā ca raṃsyase sārdhaṃ spṛhaṇīyaḥ surairapi|| śakratvaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā bhāvye sāvarṇike'ntare || 53 || sarvasaṃdhivinirmukto mayaiva saha raṃsyase ||54|| śaṅkara uvāca || ityevamuktvā sajalāmbudābhaḥ prataptacāmīkaradhautavastraḥ || adarśanaṃ devavaro jagāma śakraśca lebhe sakalāṃ trilokīm || 55 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śaṃkaragītāsu vāmana prādurbhāvo nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 || <1.56> rāma uvāca || tasya devātidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi divyā ātmavibhūtayaḥ || 1 || śaṅkara uvāca || na śakyā vistarādvaktuṃ devadevasya bhūtayaḥ || prādhānyataste vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā dvija ||2 || sarge brahmā sthitau viṣṇuḥ saṃhāre ca tathā haraḥ || varuṇo vāyurākāśo jyotiśca pṛthivī tathā || 3 || diśaśca vidiśaścā'pi tathā ye ca digīśvarāḥ || ādityā vasavo rudrā bhṛgavoṃ'girasastathā || 4 || sādhyāśca maruto devā
