viśvedevāstathaiva ca || aśvinau puruhūtaśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 5 || parvatodadhipātālā lokā dvīpāśca bhārgava || tiryagūrdhvamadhaścaiva tviṅgitaṃ yaśca neṅgate || 6 || saccā'sacca mahābhāga prakṛtirvikṛtiśca yaḥ || kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ vayasāṃ yonayastathā || 7 || vidyādharāstathā yakṣā nāgāḥ sarpāḥ sakinnarāḥ || rākṣasāśca piśācāśca pitaraḥ kālasaṃdhayaḥ | |8 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca dharmadvārāṇi yāni ca || yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham||9|| jarāyujāṇḍajāścaiva saṃsvedajamathodbhijam || ekajyotiḥ sa marutāṃ vasūnāṃ sa ca pāvakaḥ||1.56.1 0|| ahirbudhnyaśca rudrāṇāṃ nādaivāśvinayostathā || nārāyaṇaśca sādhyānāṃ bhṛgūṇāñca tathā kratuḥ ||11|| ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇurāyuraṅgirasāṃ tathā || viśveṣāñcaiva devānāṃ rocamānaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ ||12|| vāsavaḥ sarvadevānāṃ jyotiṣāṃ ca hutāśanaḥ || yamaḥ saṃyamaśīlānāṃ virūpākṣaḥ kṣamābhṛtām || 13 || yādasāṃ varuṇaścaiva pavanaḥ plavatāṃ tathā || dhanādhyakṣaśca yakṣāṇāṃ rudro raudrastathāntaraḥ || 14 || anantaḥ sarvanāgānāṃ sūryastejasvināṃ tathā || grahāṇāñca tathā candro nakṣatrāṇāñca kṛttikā || 15 || kālaḥ kalayatāṃ śreṣṭho yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yugam || kalpaṃ manvantareśāśca manavaśca caturdaśa || 16 || sa eva devaḥ sarvātmā ye ca deveśvarāstathā || saṃvatsarastu varṣāṇāṃ cāyanānāṃ tathottaraḥ || 17 || mārgaśīrṣastu māsānāṃ ṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ || śuklapakṣastu pakṣāṇāṃ tithīnāṃ pūrṇimā tithiḥ |||18|| kāraṇānāṃ vadhaḥ prokto muhūrttānāṃ tathā'bhijit || pātālānāṃ sutalaśca samudrāṇāṃ payodadhiḥ || 19 || jambūdvīpaśca dvīpānāṃ lokānāṃ satya ucyate || meruḥ śiloccayānāṃ ca varṣeṣvapi ca bhāratam || 1.56.20 ||| himālayaḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ jāhnavī saritāṃ tathā || puṣkaraḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā || 21 || gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ|| ṛṣīṇāñca bhṛgurdevo devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ||22|| tathā brahmaṛṣīṇāñca aṃgirāḥ parikīrtitaḥ || vidyādharāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ devaścitrāṃgadastathā ||23|| kaṃbaraḥ kinnarāṇāṃ ca sarpāṇāmatha vāsukiḥ || prahrādaḥ sarvadaityānāṃ rambhā cāpsarasāṃ tathā || 24 || uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ dhenūnāṃ caiva kāmadhuk || airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgādhipaḥ || 25 || āyudhānāṃ tathā vajro narāṇāñca narādhipaḥ || kṣamā kṣamāvatāṃ devo buddhirbuddhimatāmapi || 26 || dharmāviruddhaḥ kāmaśca tathā dharmabhṛtāṃ nṛṇām || dharmmo dharmabhṛtāṃ devastapaścaiva tapasvinām||27|| yajñānāṃ japayajñaśca satyaḥ satyavatāṃ tathā || vedānāṃ sāmā vedaśca aṃśūnāṃ jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ || 28|| gāyatrī sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ vācaḥ pravadatāṃ tathā || akṣarāṇāmakāraśca yantrāṇāñca tathā dhanuḥ||29|| adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ || cetanā sarvabhūtānāmindriyāṇāṃ manastathā || 1.56.30 || brahmā brahmavidāṃ devo jñānaṃ jñānavatāṃ tathā || kīrtiḥ śrīrvāk ca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā tathā kṣamā || 31 || āśramāṇāṃ caturthaśca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇastathā || skandaḥ senāpraṇetṝṇāṃ sadayaśca dayā vatām || 32 || jayaśca vyavasāyaśca tathotsāhavatāṃ prabhuḥ || aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ tathā yavaḥ || 33 || mṛtyuḥ sa eva mriyatāmudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām || jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścaiva dyūtaṃ chalayatāṃ tathā || 34 || mānaśca sarvaguhyānāṃ ratnānāṃ kanakaṃ tathā || dhṛtirbhūmau rasastejastejaścaiva hutāśane || 35 || vāyuḥ sparśaguṇānāṃ ca khañca śabdaguṇastathā || evaṃ vibhūtibhiḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati bhārgava || 36 || ekāṃśena bhṛguśreṣṭha tasyāṃśatritayaṃ divi || devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva brahmā cā'haṃ ca bhārgava || 37 || cakṣuṣā yanna paśyaṃti vinā jñānagatiṃ dvija || jñātā jñeyastathā dhyātā dhyeyaścokto janārdanaḥ || 38 || yajño yaṣṭā ca govindaḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca || annamannāda evoktaḥ sa eva ca guṇatrayam || 39 || gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayatyojasā vibhuḥ || puṣṇāti cauṣadhīḥ sarvā somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ || 1.56.40 || prāṇināṃ jaṭharastho'gnirbhuktapācī sa bhārgava || ceṣṭākṛtprāṇināṃ brahmansa ca vāyuḥ śarīragaḥ || 41 || yathādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam || yaccandramasi yaccā'gnau tattejastatra kīrtitam || 42 || sarvasya cā'sau hṛdi sanniviṣṭastasmātsmṛtirjñānamapohanañca || sarvaiśca devaiśca sa eva vandyo vedāntakṛdvedakṛdeva cā'sau || 43 || iti śrīvipṇudharmo'ttare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsu vibhūtivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 56 || || cha || <1.57> || rāma uvāca || || ārādhyate sa bhagavānkarmaṇā yena śaṅkara || tatsamācakṣva bhagavansarvasattvasukhapradam || 1 || || śaṅkara uvāca || sādhu rāma mahābhāga sādhu dānavanāśana || yanmāṃ pṛcchasi dharmajña keśavārādhanaṃ prati || 2 || divasaṃ divasārdhaṃ vā muhūrttamekameva vā || nāśaścā'śeṣapāpasya bhaktirbhavati keśave || 3 || anekajanmasāhasrairnānāyonyantareṣu ca || jantoḥ kalmaṣahīnasya bhaktirbhavati keśave || || 4 || nā'dhanyaḥ keśavaṃ stauti nā'dhanyorcayati prabhum || namatyadhanyaśca hariṃ nā'dhanyo vetti mādhavam || 5 || manaśca taddhi dharmajña keśave yatpravartate || sā buddhistadvratāyaiva satataṃ pratitiṣṭhati || 6 || sā vāṇī keśavaṃ devaṃ yā stauti bhṛgunandana || śravaṇau tau śrutā yābhyāṃ satataṃ tatkathāḥ śubhāḥ || 7 || avehi dharmajña tathā tatpūjākaraṇātkarau || tadekaṃ saphalaṃ karma keśavārthāya yatkṛtam || 8 || yato mukhyaphalāvāptau karaṇaṃ saprayojanam || manasā tena kiṃ kāryyaṃ yanna tiṣṭhati keśave || 9 || buddhyā vā bhārgavaśreṣṭha tayā nāsti prayojanam || rogaḥ sā rasanā vā'pi yayā na stūyate hariḥ || 1.57.10 || gartau brahmavratau karṇau yābhyāṃ tatkarma na śrutam || bhārabhūtaiḥ karaiḥ kāryaṃ ki tasya nṛpaśordvija || 11 || yairna saṃpūjito devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ || pādau tau saphalau rāma keśavālayagāminau || 12 || te ca netre mahābhāga yābhyāṃ saṃdṛśyate hariḥ || kiṃ tasya caraṇaiḥ kāryaṃ kṛtasya nipuṇairdvija || 13 || yābhyāṃ na vrajate jantuḥ keśavālayadarśane || jātyandhatulyaṃ taṃ manye puruṣaṃ puruṣottama || 14 || yo na paśyati dharmajña keśavārcāṃ punaḥpunaḥ || kleśasaṃjananaṃ karma vṛthā tadbhṛgunandana || 15 || keśavaṃ prati yadrāma kriyate'hani sarvadā || paśya keśavamārādhya modamānaṃ śacīpatim || 16 || yamañca varuṇañcaiva tathā vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum || devendratvamatisphītaṃ sarvabhūtismitaṃ padam || 17 '| haribhaktidrumātpuṣpaṃ rājasātsāttvikaṃ phalam || aṇimā mahimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ laghimā tathā || 18 || īthitvañca vaśitvañca yatra kāmāvasāyitā || ārādhya keśavaṃ devaṃ prāpyante nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 19 || hatapratyaṅgamātaṅgo rudhirāruṇabhūtale || saṃgrāme vijayaṃ rāma prāpyate tatprasādataḥ || || 1.57.20 || mahākaṭitaṭaśroṇyaḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ || akalaṅkaśaśāṅkābhavadanā nīlamūrdhajāḥ || 21 || ramayanti naraṃ svapne devarāmā manoharāḥ || sakṛdyenārcito devo helayā vā namaskṛtaḥ || 22 || vedavedāṅgavapuṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || ṛṣitvamapi dharmajña vijñeyaṃ tatprasādajam || 23 || ramante saha rāmābhiḥ prāpya vaidyādharaṃ padam || anyabhāvatayā nāmnaḥ kīrtanādapi bhārgava || 24 || ratnaparyaṅkaśayitā mahābhogāśca bhoginaḥ || vījyante saha rāmābhiḥ keśavasmaraṇādapi || 25 || saugandhike vane ramye kailāsaparvate dvija || yadyakṣā viharanti sma tatprāhuḥ kusumaṃ nateḥ || 26 || ratnacitrāsu ramyāsu nandanodyānabhūmiṣu || krīḍanti ca saha strībhirgandharvībhiḥ kathāśruteḥ || 27 || catussamudravelāyāṃ meruvindhyapayodharām || dharāṃ ye bhuñjate bhūpāḥ praṇipātasya tatphalam || 28 || tasmāttavā'haṃ vakṣyāmi yadyadācarataḥ sadā || puruṣasyeha bhagavānsutoṣastuṣyate hariḥ || 29 || pūjyaḥ sa nityaṃ varado mahātmā stavyaḥ sa nityaṃ jagadekavandyaḥ || dhyeyaḥ sa nityaṃ sakalāghahartā caitāvaduktaṃ tava rāma guhyam || 1.57.30 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkara gītāsu bhaktiphalapradarśanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 || <1.58> || śaṅkara uvāca || ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ dayā bhūteṣvanugraham || yasyaitāni sadā rāma tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 1 || mātāpitṛgurūṇāñca yaḥ samyagiha varttate || varjako madhumāṃsasya tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 2 || varāhamatsyamāṃsāni yo nātti bhṛgunandana || virato madyapānācca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 3 || na dhārayati nirmālyamanyadevoddhṛtaṃ tu yaḥ || bhuṃkte na cānyanaivedyaṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 4 || avaiṣṇave devadhṛtaṃ nirmālyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati || naivedyaṃ vā mahābhāga tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 5 || bibharti mūrdhni nirmālyaṃ keśavārcādhṛtaṃ tu yaḥ|| anivedya na cāśnāti tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 6|| parapīḍākaraṃ karma yasya nā'sti mahātmanaḥ|| saṃvibhāgī ca bhūtānāṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 7 || śṛṇute sarvadharmāṃśca sarvāndevānnamasyati || anasūyurjitakrodhastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 8 || tīrthopavāsasevī ca dvijātigaṇasevakaḥ || pūjako viṣṇubhaktānāṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 9 || pañcarātravido mukhyānyastu saṃpūjayetsadā || devavadbhṛguśārdūla tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 1.58.10 || pitṛdevārcanarataḥ svadāranirataḥ sadā || ṛtukālābhigāmī ca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ||11|| nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tathā yaśca gāyati tanmanāḥ || satataṃ kalyamutthāya tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ||12|| pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena japyahomādikaṃ sadā|| yaḥ karotyamitaprajñastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 13 || mitrasvāmigurudroho yasya nā'sti mahātmanaḥ || paradāradhanecchā na tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 14 || rājā śāstropadeśena rājyaṃ yaśca praśāsati || rājadharmaratirnityaṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ||15|| yā tu nārī patiprāṇā patibhaktā pativratā || tasyāḥ sutoṣo bhagavām̐stoṣamāyāti keśavaḥ||16|| agnihotraparo vidvānyajñairnityamatandritaḥ || yastu tarpayate devāṃstasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ||17|| svavarṇāśramadharmasthaḥ pūjayanmadhusūdanam || kālaṃ nayati yo brahmam̐stasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ||18|| sopavāsastu pakṣānte dvādaśyāṃ vā bhṛgūttama || baudhe'hni śravaṇarkṣe vā tṛtīyāyāntu vā punaḥ || sopavāso'rcayati yastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 19 || puṣpaṃ vinā hariṃ prāpya phalī ratnaṃ kṣumāpi vā || nivedayati yaḥ kṛṣṇe tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ||1.58.20|| kṛṣṇe paśyati yatsarvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarvatra paśyati || mahātmā buddhisampannastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 21 || tatkathāyāñca ramate tatkathāṃ yaḥ karoti ca || tanmanāstadgataprāṇastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ||22|| sarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || sarvabhūtānukampī ca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 23 || apraṇamya kriyāṃ kāṃcidyastu nā''rabhate harim || asaṃbhinnārthamaryādastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 24 || nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ kṣuta praskhalanādiṣu || yaḥ karoti mahābhāgastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 25 || navaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ nivedya madhusūdane || paścādbhuṅkte svayaṃ yaśca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 26 āpadyapi ca kaṣṭāyāṃ deveśaśapathaṃ naraḥ || na karoti hi yo brahmaṃstasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 27 || devāduddhṛtya nirmālyaṃ chāyāṃ nākramate ca yaḥ || dhūpāgnibhasma ca tathā tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ||28|| dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjitāmarcā yaśca bhaktyābhinandati || svayaṃ saṃpūjayedyastu tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 29 || nityaṃ saṃpūjayedyastu devadevasya bhaktitaḥ || yathāśaktyā mahābhāga tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 1.58.30 || na rāma vividhairdānairna ratnadhanasaṃcayaiḥ || toṣamāyāti deveśo bhaktyā tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 31 || dānairbhṛguśreṣṭha bahuprakāraistīrthopavāsavratadarśanaiśca || tathā na toṣaṃ bhagavānprayāti bhaktyā yathā tadgatamānasānām || 32 || etāvaduktaṃ tava rāma guhyaṃ na deyametadbhuvi matsarāṇām || na tarkaśāstrākulamānasānāṃ nā'vaiṣṇavānāṃ na ca nāstikānām || 33 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bhaktilakṣaṇo nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||58|| <1.59> śrīrāma uvāca|| upoṣitena yeneha yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ prayacchati || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi gadataste vṛṣadhvaja || 1 || śaṃkara uvāca|| pūjitaḥ prayataiḥ snānaiḥ sopavāsairdine raveḥ|| saṃvatsaraṃ mahābhāga dīrghamāyuḥ prayacchati || 2 || somavāre mahābhāga cārogyaṃ saṃprayacchati || tathā bhaumadine rāma vaiśvaryaṃ saṃprayacchati || 3 || vāsare somaputrasya sarvānkāmānprayacchati || abhīṣṭāñca tathā vidyāmākhaṇḍalagurordine || 4 || saubhāgyamatulaṃ loke bhārgavāhni prayacchati || tathā śanaiścarasyāhni ripūnsarvānvyapohati || 5 || kṛttikāsu tathā'bhyarcya yajñānprāpnotyanuttamān || prājāpatye tathā'bhyarcya prajāṃ prāpnoti śobhanām || 6 || vindate brahmavarcasyaṃ mṛgaśīrṣe'rcayanharim || raudrakarmatvamāpnoti siddhiṃ raudre samarcayan || 7 || cyutaḥ sthānamavāpnoti pūjayānaḥ punarvasau || puṣye saṃpūjito devaḥ puṣṭimagryāṃ prayacchati ||8 || aśleṣāyāṃ tathā'bhyarcya śriyaṃ vindati mānavaḥ || pitṛprasādamāpnoti pitrye saṃpūjanharim || 9 || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti phālgunīṣvarcayaṃstathā || tathaiva cottarāyoge gatiṃ vindati śobhanām || 1.59.10 || haste saṃpūjayandevaṃ gajānprāpnotyanuttamān || citrāsu ca tathā'bhyarcya vastrāṇyāpnoti mānavaḥ || 11 || āpye samarcayandevaṃ ratnabhāgī bhavennaraḥ || tathottarāsvāṣāḍhāsu kīrtiṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm || 12 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti śravaṇe'bhyarcayanharim || dhaniṣṭhāsu tathā vittamārogyaṃ vāruṇe tathā || 13 || āje paśūnavāpnoti gāvaśca tadanantaram || pauṣṇe śīlamavāpnoti cāśvānprāpnoti cā'śvine || 14 || dīrghajīvitamāpnoti bharaṇīṣu mahābhuja || pratipadyarthamāpnoti kupyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamama || 15 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoni tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayan || paśūm̐ścaturthyāmāpnoti pañcamyāṃ śriyamuttamām || 16 || ṣaṣṭhayāṃ prāpnotyathā''rogyaṃ saptamyāṃ suhṛdastathā || aṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā bhṛtyānnavamyāṃ ca tathā yaśaḥ || 17 || karmasiddhimavāpnoti daśamyāṃ pūjayanharim || ekādaśyāṃ pūjayānaḥ śrībhāgī sa sadā bhaveta || 18 || abhīṣṭāṃ gatimāpnoti dvādaśyāṃ pūjayanharim || trayodaśyāṃ pūjayāno rūpaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam || 19 || na durgatimavāpnoti pūjayānaścaturdaśīma || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pañcadaśyāṃ mahāmune || 1.59.20 || ityetaduktaṃ tava mānavānāṃ kāmyaṃ phalaṃ samyagupoṣitānām || deveśvaraṃ pūjayatāṃ yathāvatparaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ vareṇyam || 21 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrīśaṃkaragītāsūpavāsaphalo nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 || <1.60> || rāma uvāca || upavāsāsamarthānāṃ kiṃ syādekamupoṣitam || mahāphalaṃ mahādeva tatsamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||1|| || śaṅkara uvāca || yā rāma śravaṇopetā dvādaśī mahatī ca sā || tasyāmupoṣitaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam || 2 || prāpnotyayatnāddharmajña dvādaśadvādaśīphalam || dadhyodanayutaṃ tasyāṃ jalapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ dvije || 3 || vastrasaṃveṣṭitaṃ dattvā chatropānahameva ca || na durgatimavāpnoti gatimanyāñca vindati || 4 || akṣayyaṃ sthānamāpnoti nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge budhavāro bhavedyadi || 5 || atyantaṃ mahatī nāma dvādaśī sā prakīrtitā || snānaṃ japyaṃ tathā dānaṃ homaṃ śrāddhaṃ surārcanam || 6 || sarvamakṣayyamāpnoti tasya bhṛgukulodvaha || tasmindine tathā snāto yatra kvacana saṃgame || 7 || sa kratusnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam || śravaṇe saṃgamāḥ sarve phalapuṣṭipradāḥ sadā || 8 || viśeṣāddvādaśīyukte budhayukte viśeṣataḥ || yathaiva dvādaśī proktā budhaśravaṇasaṃyutā || 9 || tṛtīyā ca tathā jñeyā sarvakāmasamanvitā || yathā tṛtīyā dharmajña tathā pañcadaśī śubhā || 1.60.10 || tryahaḥspṛśe'pi divase copavāse mahāphalaḥ || keśavābhyarcane rāma dānajapyādikeṣu ca || 11 || rāma uvāca || tryahaḥspṛgdivasaḥ kīdṛkkadā bhavati vā prabho || tasya me saṃśayaṃ brūhi devadeva vṛṣadhvaja || 12 || śaṃkara uvāca || divā vinirgatā yatra vyatītā syāttithirdvija || rātri śeṣe tathāveśya bhaviṣyā spṛśatī tithiḥ || 13 || tithitritayasaṃsparśādahorātre bhṛgūttama || tryahaspṛksa vinirdiṣṭaḥ puṇyaḥ paramapāvana || 14 || tatropoṣya śiraḥsnātaiḥ karttavyaṃ devatārcanam || japaṃ homaṃ tathā dānaṃ kāmayadbhirmahatphalam || 15 || karmaṇāṃ pariśeṣāṇāmakarmmaṇyaṃ hi taddinam || bhojyaṃ trimadhuraṃ rāma brāhmaṇām̐statra bhojayet || 16|| mahatpūrṇā bhavatyekā paurṇamāsī dvijottama || pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tasyāṃ sopavāso janārdanam |||37|| yaḥ pūjayati dharmajña tena saṃvatsaraṃ hari || pūjitaḥ paurṇamāsīṣu bhavatīti ha niścayaḥ || 18 || tasyāṃ dānaṃ svalpamapi mahadbhavati bhārgava || dānaṃ japyaṃ tato homo yaścānyatsukṛtaṃ bhavet || 39 || rāma uvāca || saṃvatsare paurṇamāsī mahatpūrvā vṛṣadhvaja || kathaṃ jñeyā jagannātha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1.60.20 || śaṃkara uvāca || yasyāṃ pūrṇeṃdunā yogaṃ yāyājjīvo mahābalaḥ || paurṇamāsī tu sā jñeyā mahatpūrvā dvijottama || 21 || ādityagrahaṇe rāma grahaṇe vā niśābhṛtaḥ || upavāsādavāpnoti sarvakilviṣanāśanam || 22 || snānaṃ dānaṃ tathā japyaṃ cā kṣayyaṃ parikīrttitam || śrāddhañca bhārgavaśreṣṭha vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ tathā || 23 || rāma uvāca || nakṣatraṃ devadeveśa tithiñcātra vinirgatām || dṛṣṭvā yathāvatkartavyaṃ tithiṃ śaṅkara jānatā || 24 || śaṅkara uvāca || sā tithistadahorātraṃ yasyāmevodito raviḥ || tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhirna kāraṇam ||25|| śuklapakṣe tithirjñeyā yasyāmabhyudito raviḥ || upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ || 26 || yaśca vā yujyate rāma niśīthe śaśinā saha ||27|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍemārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsūpavāsavidhirnnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||60|| <1.61> rāma uvāca || tasya māyāśarīrasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || prāpnuvanti kathaṃ sthānaṃ nityamakṣayyamavyayam || 1 || śaṅkara uvāca || akhaṇḍakāriṇo rāma viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || prāpnuvanti paraṃ sthānaṃ nityamakṣayyamavyayam || 2 || rāma uvāca || akhaṇḍakārī bhagavankathaṃ bhavati śaṅkara || etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi devadeva vṛṣadhvaja || 3 || śaṅkara uvāca || pañcakālavidhānajñastatkarmakaraṇe rataḥ || akhaṇḍakārī bhavati rāma dānavanāśana || 4 || rāma uvāca || bhagavanpañca ke kālāḥ kathaṃ teṣāṃ tathā vidhiḥ || etanme devadeveśa kautūhalamapānuda || 5 || śaṅkara uvāca || rāmābhigamanaṃ pūrvamupādānamataḥ param || ijyāsvādhyāyakālau ca yogakālastathaiva ca ||6|| teṣāṃ pratyekaśo vakṣye vidhiṃ te bhṛgunandana || tannibodha mahābhāga prayatenāntarātmanā || 7 || rāma kalye samutthāya dantadhāvanapūrvakam || snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāśāstraṃ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ || 8 || yaśceha bhagavanmantraṃ paṭhandevagṛhaṃ viśet || pravindyādrāma jānubhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ śirasā tathā || 9 || oṃkāraṃ sanamaskāraṃ prayujya susamāhitaḥ || yogakālaṃ tu sandadhyādupādadhyādanantaram||1.61.10|| rāmābhigamakālaṃ tu tatra mantraṃ tathārpayet|| bhagavato baleneti vīryeṇaitena tejasā||11|| suprakīrtitatoyena vediṃ prakṣālayedbudhaḥ || sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ tāmrīṃ mṛnmayīmāyasīṃ tathā||12|| śilāṃ candanajāṃ vāpi devadārubhavāmathā| śiṃśapākṣoṭasaralakadambārjunajāmathā| ||13|| sālvāśvakarṇajāṃ rāma tvāyāmena tathaiva ca || vāmapravāṇāṃ prakṣālya pūrṇakumbhānnavāṃstataḥ||14|| kalpanīyāstu kalaśāścatvāro bhṛgunandana|| sauvarṇā rājatāstāmrā athavāpi ha rītijāḥ||15|| pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca tvarghyaṃ snānīyameva ca || pādyātpādyaṃ tu dātavyaṃ snānīyātsnānameva ca||16|| tathāpyācamanīyākhyāddeyamācamanaṃ bhavet || dānaṃ praṇayanaṃ prītirvisargaṃ vistaraṃ tathā ||17|| tarpaṇaṃ cārhaṇaṃ caiva tvarghyādetāni kārayet || dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ tato japtvā samāhitaḥ || 18 || tataḥ pavitramantreṇa vedimabhyukṣayeddvija || ātmānaṃ ca tathā bhogānkuryānmārgatrayaṃ tataḥ||19|| vidyā jñānaṃ tataḥ karma brahmacakraṃ tathaiva ca || mārgatrayañca kartavyaṃ nāmārghyakalaśānsadā || 1.61.20 || pāṇimārgaṃ kūrcamārgaṃ madhumārgaṃ tathaiva ca || uśīramūlajaṃ kūrcaṃ jīva nnopālasambhavam ||21|| jīvaśca maraṇaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ bhṛgunandana || pratisnānaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ samānānāṃ kramādbhavet||22|| tathaiva pādapīṭhānāṃ prabhāvena mahābhujaḥ || āsanānyatha kāryāṇi ratnacitrāṇi bhārgava || 23 || sauvarṇānyatha raupyāṇi tāmraśailamayāni ca || tatastvāvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ tato'bhi gamanaṃ tataḥ ||24|| namaskārastataḥ kāryaḥ praṇītena tataḥ punaḥ || brahmaśvakrāmanau mantraṃ prabhavenāpi yena ca||29|| tato japtvā mahābhāga praṇavena nivedayet || āsanairarcayeddevaṃ tataḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 26 ||| arghyābhiradbhiśca tato bhogaiḥ sarvairanantaram || pādyapratigraheṇātha pādyābhiścāpyanantaram || || 27|| pādukābhistato rāma devadevaṃ samarcayet || tatastvācamanīyārthaṃ devadevapratigraham || 28 || devamācamanīyañca pādapīṭhāṃstathaiva ca || dantakāṣṭhaṃ tato dadyājjihvānirlekhanaṃ tataḥ || 29 || gaṇḍūṣaṇaṃ tato dadyānmukhaprakṣālanaṃ tathā || bhūyastvācamanaṃ deyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ cāpyanntaram || 1.61.30|| puṣpaṃ dīpamalaṅkāraṃ dhūpaprakarameva ca | nivedya vidhivatsarvaṃ tataḥ paścānnivedayet || 31 || sevyāni rāma bījāni tvarhaṇīyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || madhuparkaṃ tato dadyāddadhi sarpistathā madhu || 32 ||| dadhyalābhe payaḥ kāryaṃ madhvalābhe tathā guḍam || ghṛtapratinidhirnāsti tatra yatnātsamarcayet || 33 || ekāṃgo vā samasto vā madhuparko vidhīyate || vyaṃgaṃ varjyaṃ prayatnena nityameva vijānatā || 34 || darpaṇaṃ tu tato dadyāttato nirbhartsanaṃ budhaḥ || tatastvācamanīyaṃ ca vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ ||39|| hastaniṣpuṃsanārthāya tato dadyāttu gaṃdhakam || tataḥ paśuṃ budhaḥ kuryyādyathāvanmādhupārkikam ||36|| mādhupārkikamaśvatthapatraṃ vā vinivedayet || ghṛtāvadyaṃ tato dadyāttāmbūlañcāpyanantaram || 37 || mātrāñca dakṣiṇārthāya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || maṃgalāni yathāśaktyā tato deve nivedayet ||38|| tato'bhigamakālantu saṃdadyātpuruṣottame|| upādānamatho dadyātkuryāccaiva visarjanam || 39 || tato'gniśaraṇaṃ gatvā vahniṃ saṃtarpadedbudhaḥ || brāhmaṇānāṃ yathāśakti dānaṃ dadyādanantaram || 1.61.40|| etanmayā te kathitaṃ samagraṃ yathānupūrvyābhigamasya kālam || gacchedupādānakṛtaprayatnastato yathāvadbhṛguvaṃśacandra || 41 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsvabhigamakālo nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||| <1.62> || śaṅkara uvāca || bhogānāmarjanaṃ kāryaṃ tato rāma svakarmaṇā || sthirāṇāmasthirāṇāṃ ca yathāvadbhṛgunandana || 1 || āsanādyāstu ye bhogāḥ kālenāpyavināśinaḥ || sthirāste rāma nirdiṣṭā pariśiṣṭāstathā carāḥ || 2 || puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ mūlaṃ tathā haritakaṃ śubham || udakaṃ cārcanīyaṃ syāttasminnahani bhārgav || 3 || upādānāya niṣkrānte kuṭumbinyatha satvaram || kuṭumbinī suprayātā dhautopaskarabhājanā ||4|| sādhyānāṃ rāma bījānāṃ paśośca sukṛtasya ca || śākānāṃ vyañjanānāṃ ca svarjitānāṃ gate'hani ||5|| śaktiṃ kuryātsadā tasya vahninopadamena ca || deśe śucau suprayātā susahāyaguṇānvitā || 6 || sarvaṃ prakṣālitaṃ kāryaṃ keśakīṭādivarjitam || bhūmāvanupaliptāyāṃ sthāpyaṃ rāma na kiñcana ||7|| sarvaṃ sādhyamathānnādyaṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam || nityaṃ paripacedrāma nāsvādyaṃ kenacit kvacit ||8|| upādānamathādāya praviśya ca gṛhī gṛham || śucau prakṣālitaṃ sarvaṃ copādānamupanyaset || 9 || suprakṣālya tathā bhāgaṃ pavitreṇa samutkṣipet || evaṃ kṛtvā hyupādānaṃ snāyāttu vidhinā tataḥ || 1.62.10 || dhautavāsā suprayataḥ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ || praviśya devatāveśma prāgvadbhṛgukulodvaha || 11 || namaskārādikaṃ sarvaṃ prayuñjīta samāhitaḥ || upādānānusaṃdhānaṃ tvādānaṃ cāpyanantaram || 12 || ijyākālasya dharmajña kuryātprayatamānasaḥ ||13|| āsannabhogaḥ prayanāntarātmā kuryādathejyāṃ raṇacaṇḍavega || krodhaṃ niyamyātmahite niviṣṭastadbhāvabhāvopahitaśca nityam || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śaṅkaragītāsūpādānakaraṇo nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāya ||62|| <1.63> || śaṅkara uvāca || pādapīṭhāntakaṃ karma kṛtvā prāguktamañjasā || nivedya darpaṇaṃ deve tato mātrāṃ nivedayeta || 1 || bījaistu paridhānārthaṃ prayataḥ susamāhita || tailamudvartanaṃ caiva camasīṃ cāpyanantaram || 2 || tato niṣpuṃsanaṃ kṛtvā deyānyācamanāni ca || ropraṃ kālīyakaṃ caiva tathā vai bījapūrakam || 3 || varṇakaṃ tagaraṃ caiva priyaṅguṃ gaurasarṣapāḥ || sarvauṣadhīrvṛkṣabījaṃ sarvagandhāṃśca bhārgava||4|| ratnodakaṃ ca vividhaṃ snānīyamudakaṃ tathā || snānīyaṃ ca tato rāma susugandhaṃ ca dāpayet||5|| tataḥ sugharmaṇārthīyāḥ kalaśā sumanoharā || svalaṃkṛtā pradātavyā phalapallavapūritāḥ||6|| puṣpagandhayutā rāma pavitreṇa pavitritāḥ || śubhānāṃ tīrthasaritāṃ rāma puṇyajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ|| ||7|| yathāvibhavatasteṣāṃ bahutvamapi kārayet || tasminkāle tathā kārye kṣveḍitotkṛṣṭaniḥsvanam ||8|| jayaśabdaṃ ca vipulaṃ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritam|| udakagrahaṇārthīya tato dadyācca śāṭakam || 9 || tato rāma pradātavyaṃ dhautavāsāyugaṃ śubham || tatastu pūrṇakalaśamāsanānāṃ pradakṣiṇam ||1.63.1 0|| kṛtvā rāma kṣipedvedyāṃ puṣpapallavaśobhitam|| tatastvācamanīyaṃ ca pūrvavadvinivedayet||11|| maṅgalāni ca mukhyāni tato dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || satyāsanasthaṃ deveśamarcayiṣyāmyataḥ param || 12 || snānāsanāni tyajyantāmityevaṃ parikīrtayet || mārgatrayādathārabhya pādapīṭhāntakaṃ punaḥ || 13 || kartavyaṃ sakalaṃ karma tvāvāhanavisarjanam || tato'nulepanaṃ dadyādvyajanena ca vījayet || 14 || tataśca vīṭakaṃ dadyāttathā kūrcaprasādanam || vastraṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ caiva puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca || 15 || veṣṭanaṃ ca srajaṃ caiva kaṅkaṇaṃ ca manoharam || tathā ramyaṃ pratisaraṃ supiṣṭaṃ ca tathāñjanam || 16 || darpaṇaṃ copacāraṃ ca pradīpaṃ dhūpameva ca || tathaivācamanīyaṃ ca gītavādyasvaraṃ tathā || 17|| puṇyāhajayaśabdaṃ ca stotrodīraṇameva ca || tathaivopānahau deye chatraṃ cāmarameva ca || 18 || yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ caiva patākāśca dhvajāni ca || bhogānāṃ pūraṇārthīyāṃ tato mātrāṃ nivedayet || 19 || bhogānāṃ sarjanaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktayā dvijottama || avidyamānā ye bhogā mātrāsveva prakalpayet || 1.63.20 || evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ sarvabhogaissamāhitaḥ || arcayenmadhuparkeṇa paśuyāgo na cedbhavet || 21 || paśuyāgābhigamane madhuparko vidhīyate || abhyarcya madhuparkeṇa tatastvanyena pūjayet || 22 ||| atrāsanānyapīcchanti kecidapyaparāṇi tu || ādau sthālīṃ ca tenātha pradadyādarhaṇīṃ tataḥ || 23|| annaṃ haritakopetaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vyañjanasaṃyutam || nivedya darpaṇaṃ dadyāttathā niṣpuṃsanaṃ tataḥ || 24 || kṛtvā hyācamanīyaṃ tu mātrāṃ ca tadanantaram || tatastu saṃvibhāgārthaṃ dātavyaṃ tvarhaṇaṃ tataḥ 9|| bhūyo nivedayedannaṃ pūrvavatsusamāhitaḥ || darpaṇaṃ ca tato dadyātpādyaṃ niṣpuṃsanaṃ tataḥ || 26 ||| dattvā cācamanīyaṃ ca śāṭakaṃ ca nivedayet || hastaniṣpuṃsanārthāya mātrāṃ ca tadanantaram || 27|| nivedya paścāttāmbūlaṃ devaṃ vahnau samarcayet || vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā kāryakārisamarpaṇam || 28 || atithīnāṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhartavyānāṃ ca bhārgava || tato'nuyāgakāle tu pavitreṇa samutkṣipet || 29 || āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ caiva sānnaṃ prayatamānasaḥ || upaviśya tataḥ paścātprabhavenāpyayena ca || 1.63.30 || idamagnetimantreṇa prācyāṃ grāsāṣṭakaṃ bhavet || tatastu prayato bhūtvā viśeddevagṛhaṃ tataḥ || 31 || ijyākālānusaṃdhānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ || kuryātsvanyāyakālasya copādānamanantaram || 32 || visarjanaṃ tataḥ kuryātprayatenāntarātmanā || ijyākālavidhistveṣa mayā te rāma kīrtitaḥ || 33|| bhagavānvāsudevastu devassaṃkarṣaṇastataḥ || pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca prabhāvo'yamudāhṛtaḥ ||34 || saṃkarṣaṇastathāvyakta ātmā pradyumna ucyate || devastattvagatassarvaṃ aniruddho mahāyaśāḥ || 35 || sa nāthassarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ|| puruṣo'pi tathā satya acyutaśca dvijottama || 36|| bhagavānvāsudevaśca tvavyayo'yamudāhṛtaḥ || catvāra ete dharmajña vāsudevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||37|| bhagavacchabdavācyāśca sarvabhūtabhavodbhavāḥ || yaḥ paraḥ puruṣo rāma vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 38 || bhagavacchabdavācyaśca sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ || śeṣatattvaṃ gataḥ sarvamaniruddho mahāyaśāḥ || 39 ||| sa nāthaḥ sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇaḥ || tadetatpaṭhyate sūkte pauruṣe dvijasattama || 1.63.40 || pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi || bhujiḥ prītistathaivārciḥ prāṇastarpaṇamarhaṇam || 41 || nivedanañcācamanamaṣṭadhā mantranirṇayaḥ || mantreṇa cārhaṇāntena pradadyādarhaṇaṃ punaḥ || 42 || tathaivācamanāntena deyamācamanaṃ bhavet || prāśanāntena mantreṇa tarpaṇaṃ vinivedayet || 43 || pratigraheṣu mātrāsu pādukāsu ca darpaṇe || chatre ca vālavyajane tālavṛnte tathaiva ca || 44 || upānatsu tathā yāne vāhaneṣu bhṛgūttama || abdhidhvajeṣu ca tathā patākāsu ca kīrtitāḥ ||45|| śeṣāṇāṃ kāmabhogānāṃ nityaṃ saṃkīrtayettu vai || sarvatraprīṇanaṃ kāryametāvānmantranirṇayaḥ ||46|| devānāṃ pādapīṭhānāṃ kalaśānāṃ tathaiva ca || vahnestathāsanānāṃ ca catuṣṭvaṃ vinivartate || 47 || kalaśāsanavahnīnāṃ saṃkaraṃ tu na kārayet || tathaiva padapīṭhānāṃ teṣāṃ cihnaṃ ca kārayet || 48 || prāpaṇe madhuparke ca mātrāsu ca bhṛgūttama || sumanastu sadā rāma yatnaḥ kāryaḥ samarcane || 49 || saumanasyaṃ paraṃ rāma devadeve niveditam || yasmāttu vartate tasmātproktāḥ sumanasaḥ sadā || 1.63.50 || māṃ trāsyati bhayādghorāttasmānmātrā prakīrtitā || prāpayiṣyati ca sthāne nityaṃ duḥkhavivarjite || 51 || yasmāttasmāddvijaśreṣṭha proktaṃ prāpaṇakaṃ sadā || paramaṃ yatparaṃ rāma madhusaṃjñaṃ taducyate || 52 || tadāpyate yadā tena madhuparkastadā smṛtaḥ || ijyāvidhāno'yamudīritaste samāsato bhārgavavaṃśacandra || ataḥ paraṃ rāma nibodha puṇyaṃ svādhyāyakāle gadato mamādya || 53 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsu ijyākā lavidhirnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 || <1.64> || śaṅkara uvāca || || ādau deśe tathā rāma prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ || svādhyāyenārcayeddevaṃ prayatenāntarātmanā || 1 || tāvatkāryaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha svādhyāyaṃ vidhivatsadā || yāvadastaṃ gato rāma savitā dīptadīdhitiḥ || 2 || tatastvastaṃ gate sūrye svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ || praviśya devatāveśma nairājyaṃ karma kārayet || 3 || pādapīṭhāntakaṃ karma kṛtvā prāguktamañjasā || arghyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvā pādyaṃ ca bhārgava || 4 || sthālīmaklinnanaivedyādārabhyābhihitaṃ tataḥ || kartavyamanuyāgāntaṃ prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ || 5 || kṛtvānuyāgaṃ vidhivatpraviśya suramandiram || svādhyāyasyānusaṃdhānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ || 6 || yogakālamupādāya paścātkuryādvisarjanam || kṛtvā visarjanaṃ yuktastiṣṭhedyāmamatandritaḥ ||7 || yogādanantaraṃ svapyādevaṃ yuktasya bhārgava|| svayaṃ kālo'pi satataṃ yogamadhye'bhidhīyate || 8 || snānārhakatvaṃ yadi nāsti tasya yāme vibuddhastu tathā caturthe || yuñjīta yogaṃ ripukālabhūtaṃ yogena buddhiḥ samupaiti sargam ||9|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 śaṅkaragītāsu svādhyāyakālakathanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||| <1.65> śaṅkara uvāca || jānutulyaṃ mṛduśubhaṃ cailājinakuśottaram || śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ || 1|| caturṇāmāsanānāṃ ca baddhvā tatraikamāsanam || yogaṃ yuñjīta vidhivadyathāvadunupūrvaśaḥ || 2 || rāma uvāca || yogāsanāni catvāri bhagavankāni brūhi me || yeṣāmekamathāsthāya yogaṃ yuñjīta mānavaḥ || 3 || śaṅkara uvāca || svastikaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ paryaṅkaṃ kamalāsanam || yogāsanāni catvāri teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 4 || āsanne jānunī kṛtvā yathāvatsusamāhitaḥ || vāmaṃ kṛtvetare pāde vāmajaṅghorupīḍitam || 5|| svastikaṃ nāma tatproktamāsanaṃ prathamaṃ śubham || ūrū ca jānunī jaṅghe yatrāsanagataḥ samam ||6|| āsanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ tadviddhi manujottama || paryaṅke yogapaṭṭena badhnīyātpṛṣṭhayogataḥ || 7 || ākuñcya jānunī samyakpādaṃ kṛtvā ca bāhyataḥ || dakṣiṇaṃ vāmajaṅghāyāṃ paryaṅkāsanakāraṇam || 8|| āsane sarvatobhadre yadā bhavati mānavaḥ || ūrusthottānacaraṇastadā syātkamalāsanam || 9 || āsanasthasya karaṇaṃ nibodha gadato mama|| samānīyorumūlena hastau bhārgava tiryagau||1.65.10|| kṛtvottānau samau vidvānvāmasyopari dakṣiṇam|| aṅgulīcchādakaṃ vidvānaṅgulī nāṃ tu vinyaset || 11 ||| kiñcidākuñcitāṅguṣṭhau kartavyau ca tathā karau || uraścotthāpya vitataṃ kṛtvā rāma pariślatham || 12|| pṛṣṭhamākuñcayetskandhe dehamunnāmayetsudhīḥ || niṣkampāṃ sudṛḍhāmṛjvīṃ nātistabdhāṃ na kuñcitām || 13|| grīvāṃ vidhārayedyatnācchiraḥ kāryaṃ samaṃ sadā || saṃpasyannāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan || 14|| kiñcinnimīlite netre dantairdantānna saṃspṛśet || tālumadhyagatenaiva jihvāgreṇa samāhitaḥ || 19|| sa baddhakaraṇo vidvānabhyāsātpavanaṃ jayet || jitvā vāyuṃ yathāśakti yogaṃ yuñjīta buddhimān || 16 || ādau tu cintayetsthūlāṃ bhūmiṃ pañcaguṇānvitām || labdhalakṣo mahāyogī bhūmiyogaṃ samutsṛjet || 17 || tataścaturguṇaṃ dhyānaṃ kartavyamudake dvija || labdhalakṣa apāṃ yogī jalayogaṃ samutsṛjet || 18 ||| tatastu yogaṃ yuñjīta triguṇaṃ dvija tejasi || labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi vahniyogaṃ samutsṛjet || 19 || tatastu yogaṃ yuñjīta pavane dviguṇaṃ dvija |||| labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi vāyuyogaṃ samutsṛjet || 1.65.20 ||| tatastvekaguṇaṃ yogaṃ yuñjīta gagane budhaḥ || labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi manoyogagatirbhavet || 21 || manasaścandramāḥ proktaḥ prathamaṃ candramaṇḍale || ūrdhvalakṣaṃ budhaḥ kṛtvā candramaṇḍalamadhyage || 22 || aṅguṣṭhamātre puruṣe lakṣabandhaṃ tu kārayet || śaśāṅkaśatasaṃkāśe sarvālaṅkārabhūṣite||23|| labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi buddhiyogagatirbhavet|| buddhiśca bhagavānsūryaḥ prathamaṃ sūryamaṇḍale||24|| samagrameva saṃpaśyeddhyānayogena buddhimān|| sūryamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śatasūryasamaprabham||25|| aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || cintayetprayato nāma tatparaḥ susamāhitaḥ || 26 ||| labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi nityamātmānamātmanā || ātmasthameva saṃpaśyeddhyānayogena bhārgava || 27 || aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ sūryabimbagataṃ yathā || dhyānayogena saṃpaśyettathā paśyettathātmani || 28 || adhomukhe hṛtkamale karṇikāyāṃ bhṛgūttama|| labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi avyaktaṃ cintayetpadam||29|| bahirantaśca sarvatra tejasā tatra cintayet || naivārkeṇa na candreṇa sarvaṃ vyāptamaśeṣataḥ || 1.65.30 ||| labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi puruṣaṃ cintayetparam || śūnyaṃ tu puruṣaṃ dhyānaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 31 |||| sākāre baddhalakṣastu śūnyaṃ śaknoti cintitum || anyathā tu sukaṣṭaṃ syānnirālambasya cintanam || 32|| cittavṛttinirodho hi duṣkaraḥ pratibhāti me || tatra yatnaḥ sadā kāryo vijaye pavanasya ca || 33 || cittavṛttinirodhena pavanasya jayena ca || upāsanāyā śūnyasya niṣphalatvaṃ vidhīyate || 34 || arūpagandhamanasaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam || sarvendriyaguṇaṃ rāma sarvasthaṃ sarvagaṃ ca yat ||35|| taṃ dhyāyanpuruṣaṃ tasya dhyānaṃ śūnyaṃ prakīrtitam || tasya svarūpaṃ vijñāya rāma śūnyamupāsataḥ || 36 || sarvabandhanamuktasya niṣphalatvaṃ vidhīyate || akhaṇḍakāriṇastvevaṃ nityaṃ bhṛgukulodvaha || 37 || saṃvatsaraśate pūrṇe satribhāge mahābhuja || niṣphalatvaṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavati bhārgava || 38 || rāma uvāca || saṃvatsaraśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tribhāgasahitaṃ vibho || ajīvato niṣphalatvaṃ kathaṃ bhavati śaṅkara || 39 || śaṅkara uvāca || akhaṇḍakārī bhavati yadyekamapi janmani || janmakramādavaśyaṃ hi rāma janmanijanmani || 1.65.40 || pūraṇīyaṃ satribhāgaṃ dhruvaṃ tena samāḥ śatam || anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim || 41 || akhaṇḍakāriṇo rāma pravṛttasya dvijanmanaḥ || avaśyameva tatsthānaṃ yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 42 || rāma uvāca || akhaṇḍakāritā proktā tvayā deva dvijanmanām || śūdro vā yadi vā nārī kathaṃ sthānamavāpnuyāt || 43 || śaṅkara uvāca || akhaṇḍakāriṇī patnī prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || śūdraḥ svakarmanirataḥ keśavārpitamānasaḥ || 44|| jātyantaramathāsādya bhaktiyogena bhāvitaḥ || akhaṇḍakārī bhavati tataḥ prāpnoti tatpadam || 49 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ||| etāvaduktaṃ devena tryambakeṇa mahātmanā || tadā tuṣṭena rāmāya rahasyamṛṣipūjitam || 16|| etadbalivihīnāya na tu vācyaṃ yadūttam || na nāstikāya mūrkhāya tarkaduṣṭāya vā tathā || 47|| etattu śṛṇvate vācyaṃ śiṣyāya ca sutāya ca || yo vā dadyānmahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saśailavanakānanām || 48 || etadguhyaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || āyuṣyaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca kaliduḥsvapnanāśanam || 49|| adhyetavyamidaṃ samyagvacanaṃ śaṃkarasya ca || sarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 1.65.50 || etāvaduktaṃ tripurāntakena tuṣṭena rāmasya mahābalasya || mayā tathā te'bhihitaṃ narendra dhāryaṃ tvayedaṃ satataṃ yathāvat || 91 || iti viṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śaṅkaragītāsamāptirnāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||| <1.66> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ||| || kailāsaśikhare ramye rāmasya ramatastadā || ājagāma haraṃ draṣṭuṃ devadevaḥ purandaraḥ || 1 || sa samāsādya deveśaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam || uvāca vacanaṃ samyaṅmudā rāmasya sannidhau || 2 || śakra uvāca || tvatprasādena deveśa mayā prāptaṃ triviṣṭapam || rāmeṇa ghātitāḥ sarve yathā me devaśatravaḥ || 3 || avadhyāstridaśānāṃ ye varadānabaloddhatāḥ || naravadhyāḥ kṛtāste hi brahmaṇā sumahātmanā || 4 || pātālanilayā deva avadhyā devatāgaṇaiḥ || bādhante naravadhyā me lokānāṃ ca jagatpate || 5 || tāṃśca ghātaya deveśa rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evaṃ kariṣyatītyuktvā visṛjya tridaśeśvaram || 6 || uvāca vacanaṃ rāmaṃ bhārgavaṃ purataḥ sthitam || śaṅkara uvāca || gaccha bhārgava pātālaṃ pātālanilayāñjahi || 7 || śakraśatrūndurācārānnaravadhyānmahāsurān|| vaiṣṇavaṃ cāparatnaṃ te mayā nyastaṃ pituḥ kare ||8|| tadādāya śaraistīkṣṇairjahi tānrāma dānavān || akṣayaṃ tūṇamādāya śarapūrṇamidaṃ tathā || 9 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ||| evamuktvā dadau cāsya tūṇamakṣayasāyakam || dattvā ca bhagavānāha rāmaṃ parabalārdanam || 1.66.10 || śaṅkara uvāca || tūṇametatpradātavyaṃ tvayāgastyāya bhārgava || cāparatnaṃ ca rāmāya kṛte karmaṇi suvrata || 11 || agastyo'pi mahātejāstūṇamakṣayasāyakam || rāghavāyātiyaśase rāmāyaiva pradāsyati || 12|| rāmasaṃdarśanādūrdhvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ śastradhāraṇam || rāmasaṃdarśane rāma tava tejo hi vaiṣṇavam || 13 || rāmaṃ pravekṣyati tadā surakāryārthamūrjitam || yāvattvaṃ tejasā yukto vaiṣṇavena paraṃtapa || 14 || tāvacchatrugaṇānsarvānsamareṣu vijeṣyasi || sthātuṃ na śaktāstava daityasenā astāyudhasya pramukhe dvijendra || ādāya cāpaṃ yudhi vaiṣṇavaṃ tattūṇaṃ tathemaṃ jahi devaśatrūn || 19 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare mā0 saṃ0 prathamakhaṇḍe rāmaṃ prati śaṅkarānuśāsane ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||| <1.67> rāma uvāca ||| vaiṣṇavaṃ cāparatnaṃ tatkimarthaṃ bhavatā kare || nyastaṃ ca tanme bhagavaṃścāparatnaṃ ca kīdṛśam || 1 || śaṅkara uvāca || māyā hi vaiṣṇavī rāma yayā saṃmohitāḥ purā || devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva gatvāntaḥ praṇatāḥ sthitā || 2 || yajatāṃ paramādhāraṃ devaṃ kamalasaṃbhavam || bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya prabhuṃ lokanamaskṛtaḥ || || 3|| devā ūcuḥ || vāsudevasya devasya mahādevasya cāpyatha || antaraṃ jñātumicchāmaḥ kaḥ kasmādatiricyate ||4 || śaṅkara uvāca || evamuktassuraiḥ sarvairṛṣibhiśca pitāmahaiḥ || vihasyovāca tānsarvāṃstayorgatvā parasparam || 5 || brahmovāca || janayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve virodhamṛṣibhissaha || virodhe tu samutpanne tayoryuddhaṃ upasthite || 6 || jñāsyadhvamantaraṃ devāstayornāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || śaṅkara uvāca || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve sārdhamṛṣigaṇaistadā || 7 || āvayorjanayāmāsurvirodhaṃ bhṛgunandana || viṣṇorādhikyamanvicchaṃstasya māyāvimohitāḥ || 8 || kṛtavānasmi daivena deva vākyena vigraham || prabhāvadarśanārthāya tvāvayorvigrahe tadā || 9 || āsannamabhavadyuddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaram || āvayorbhṛguśārdūla tadā yuddhe upasthite || 1.67.10 || ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || devā brahmarṣayaścaiva tathā rājarṣayo'malāḥ ||1 1 || sarveṣāṃ samavetānāmāvayoryuddhasaṃgare || uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 12 || brahmovāca || na kartavyaṃ jagannāthau yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam || yuṣmadyuddhena sakalaṃ naśyatīdaṃ jagattrayam || 13 || gṛhītaṃ cāparatnaṃ yatsvayaṃ devena cakriṇā || tadāropayatāṃ śūlī śūlicāpaṃ janārdanaḥ || 14 || jñāsyāmi cāntaraṃ devau cāpāropaṇakarmaṇā || śaṅkara uvāca || evamukte mama karāddhanurjagrāha keśavaḥ || āropituṃ na me śaktiḥ sarvayatnena cābhavat || 15 || tataśca gatamohena mayā jñāto maheśvaraḥ || jñātvā visṛṣṭacāpena stutaśca bhagavāṃstadā || 16 || namo'stu te devavarāprameya namo'stu te sarvaguṇāntarāya || namo'stu te devagaṇārcitāya namo'stu te sarvaguṇottarāya || 17 || unmeṣamātreṇa tavāprameya dinaṃ samagraṃ prapitāmahasya || nimeṣamātreṇa niśā pradiṣṭā yasyāṃ samādāya jagatsa śete || 18 || na kāraṇaṃ vedmi taveśa sṛṣṭau saṃhārakāryaṃ ca tathā na vedmi || ādyaṃ na madhyaṃ na tathaiva cāntaṃ tvameka īśaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || 19 || sarveṣu bhūteṣu tathā sthitastvaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni tathā taveśa || bhūtāntarastho'pi na bhūtasaṃstha āścaryametanmama devadeva || 1.67.20 || bhūtāntarasthopi na bhūtanāthaḥ bhūtārjitaiḥ karmabhirāpyase tvam || karmāṇi sarvāṇi jagattrayasya dharme sadā yanmahadadbhutaṃ tat || 21 || gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca raso'psu deva vāyau yathā sparśaguṇastvadīyaḥ || rūpaṃ tathāgnau gagane ca śabdo guṇā samagrāstava bhūtasaṃghe || 22 || manogatastvaṃ ca tathā vitarko buddhau gatastvaṃ ca viniścayo'tra || cidrūpamātmanyatha devadeva avyaktasaṃsthasya guṇatrayastvam || 23 || tvameva bhūtāni ca tadguṇāśca mūrtervibhinnosi na bhūtabhinnaḥ || tattvāni sarvāṇi ca tadvyatītaḥ tvameva devaḥ puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ || 24 || tavecchayā syātsakalā trilokī tavecchayā deva tathā vinaśyet || itthaṃvidhasyānagha karmaṇaste stutiḥ kathaṃ syātparamasya dhāmnaḥ || 25 || evaṃ stuto devavaro mayāsāvuvāca māṃ devagaṇasya madhye || yo'haṃ sa devaḥ parameśvarastvaṃ yo'haṃ sa devaḥ prapitāmahaśca || 26 || āśritya mūrtitritayaṃ mayedaṃ karmatrayaṃ śaṅkara sādhyate vai || utpattināśau paripālanaṃ ca kālatraye śaṅkara devakāryāt || 27 || mūrtirmamogrā jagatāṃ taveyaṃ saṃhārakāryārthamudīrṇadarpā || tprabhurbhavaḥ kāraṇakāraṇānāṃ pūjyaśca sarveśvara sarvadevaiḥ || 28 || ye tvāṃ namasyanti jagatpradhānaṃ bhaktiṃ parā ye ca vahanti tubhyam || bhaktyā ca nityaṃ tava pūjayanti sthānaṃ hi teṣāṃ sulabhaṃ madīyam || 29 || madīyametadbhuvi cāparatvaṃ pradīyatāṃ bhārgavanandanāya || ṛcīkaputrāya guṇādhikāya tasmātsamādāsyati tasya putraḥ || 1.67.30 || sa tena cāpena nihatya śatrūnkṛtvā ca laghvīṃ vasudhāṃ sureśa || taccāparatnaṃ bhuvi rāghavāya pradāsyate rāma iti śrutāya ||31|| kṛtvā sa rāmopi hi tena karma pradāsyate tadvaruṇāya cāpam || tasmātsamādāsyati phālguno'pi devārthakāryaikaratirmahātmā || 32 || svaṃ cāparatnaṃ janakāya dehi nimītināmnā bhuvi śabditāya || tenāpi cāpena sa tatprasūto rājā mahatkarma kariṣyatīti ||33|| ...duktvā bhagavānmahātmā jagāma kāṣṭhāṃ manasastvabhīṣṭām || mayā tathā te bhuvi cāparatne dvijapradhāna kṣitipeṣu datte || 34 || yadvaipṇavaṃ cāpavaraṃ pituste nyastaṃ kare vāsukitulyarūpam || taddevakāryeṇa vinā na śakyaṃ kenāpyadhijya yudhi rāma kartum || 35 || ajñātavasturacitaṃ surakāryadakṣaṃ govindabāhuviṭapāśrayalabdhamānam || nyastaṃ purā pitṛkare tava yuddhaśauṇḍa cetthaṃ mayā harivacaḥ prasamīkṣya rāma ||36|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 vaiṣṇavadhanuḥprādurbhāvo nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 || <1.68> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || evamuktastadā rāmo devadevena śambhunā || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ pārvatīṃ varadāṃ tathā || 1 || pramathaiśca pariṣvaktassotkaṇṭhenāntarātmanā || jagāmāśramamuddiśya pituḥ parabalārdanaḥ || 2 || so'cireṇaiva saṃprāpya dadarśāśramamaṇḍale || vayovṛddhaṃ tapovṛddhaṃ pitaraṃ dīptatejasam || 3 || so'bhivādya pituḥ pādau mātuśca paravīrahā || bhrātṝṇāmānupūrvyeṇa dharmanityo jitendriyaḥ || ||4 || taiśca mūrdhanyupāghrātaḥ sāntvitassa mahātapāḥ || sa matprasādaṃ pṛṣṭaścetyuktvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||5|| ākhyātavām̐stataḥ paścātpātālagamanaṃ tadā || āsannaṃ devakāryaṃ ca cāparatnaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam || 6 || jamadagnirmahātejāḥ śrutvā rāmavacastadā || cāparatnaṃ ca rāmāya pradadau devapūjitam || 7 || dattvovāca sa taṃ rāmaṃ hutāśanasamaprabham || paścimena samudreṇa praviśya varuṇālayam||9 || saṃpūjya varuṇaṃ rāmastasyaivānumate tadā|| śakraśatrūndurācārānpātālanilayañjahi || anena cāparatnena vaiṣṇavena mahābala || daiteyānsamare hatvā gatvā ca varuṇālayam|| 1.68.10 || praṣṭavyo varuṇo devastvayā dharmānsanātanān || sa putra varuṇāddharmāñchrutvā rāma yathāvidhi || 11 || āgacchethā yathākālaṃ matsamīpaṃ mahābhuja || evamuktastadā rāmaḥ pitrā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 12 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhrātṝnabhivādya yathāvidhi || jagāma varuṇāvāsaṃ rāmo vaiśvānaradyutiḥ || 13 || sa praviśya samudreṇa mahādevaprasādataḥ || tato'śma nagaraṃ rāmo dadarśa puramuttamam || 14 || mano'bhirāmaṃ sphaṭikāśmacitraṃ turaṅganāgendrakulākulaṃ ca || vibhūṣitaṃ pannagadaityanāthairudyānavāpīśata saṃkulaṃ ca || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmasyāśmanagaradarśanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 68 || <1.69> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tasminpuravare ramye ratnacitrasabhāgatam || ratnāsanagataṃ vīraṃ cārukuṇḍalalocanam || 1 || snigdhavaiḍūryasaṃkāśaṃ śuklāmbaravibhūṣitam || hārabhārārpitatanuṃ cārukesaradhāriṇam || 2 || pravālamaṇimuktāḍhyaṃ gambhīraṃ bhujagāśrayam || kirīṭottaṃsasaṃchannaṃ yādogaṇasamāśrayam || 3 || ādityamudakāvāsamaṃbhasāṃ patimūrjitam || lokanāthaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || 4 || viṣṇorbhāgaṃ viśālāṃsaṃ viśālākṣaṃ mahābhujam || sevyamānaṃ mahābhāgaistridaśairbrāhmaṇaistathā || 5 || daiteyaiśca mahābhāgairbhīmairbhīmaparākramaiḥ || sundopasundaśakrākṣaśambarāmarakaṇṭakaiḥ || 6 || hayagrīvamahāgrīvadaśagrīvasurāntakaiḥ || bhīmabhīmākṣanarakavikaṭotkaṭamāraṇaiḥ || 7 || atikāyamahākāyabhīmakāyabaloddhataiḥ || nāgaiśca sumahākāyairmahābhogairjagaddhitaiḥ || 8 || nāgarājñā vāsukinā śaṅkhena kuruṇā tathā || mahāpadmena padmena karkoṭakadhanaṃjayaiḥ || 9 || airāvatena nāgena takṣakeṇa balena ca || kaṃbalāśvatarābhyāṃ ca hyāryakeṇa mahātmanā || 1.69.10 || bālavyajanahastāstamupavījanti nimnagāḥ || gaṅgā ca sarayū rājan vitastā yamunā tathā || 11 || irāvatī candrabhāgā narmadā ca mahānadī || payoṣṇī brāhmaṇī gaurī vipāśā devikā tathā || 12 || śatadruḥ kampanā sindhustathā cānyāssahasraśaḥ || sevyamānastathā kūpaistaḍāgaiśca savigrahaiḥ || 13 || sarovaraissāgaraiśca samudraiśca yadūttama || taṃ dṛṣṭvā varuṇaṃ rājansa vavande bhṛgūttamaḥ ||14|| pūjayāmāsa ca tathā varuṇo'pi bhṛgūttamam || pādyārghyācamanīyādyairāsanenodakena ca || 15|| āsīnaśca tadā rāmo daiteyānāṃ vadhe vṛtaḥ || mahādevavacassarvaṃ varuṇāya nyavedayata || 16 || sa ca tenābhyanujñāto yayau daityapuraṃ mahat || varuṇo'pi mahātejā rāmavākyena yādava || 17 || saṃvādayāmāsa tadā rāmaṃ raṇakṛtakṣaṇam || tadā varuṇadūtebhyo daiteyāḥ śrutavistarāḥ || 18 || niṣkramya nagarādrājam̐ścaturaṅgabalānvitāḥ || susannaddhāḥ pratīkṣanto rāmamadbhutavikramam || 1 9|| dadṛśuśca mahābhāgaṃ varacāpadharaṃ tadā || mṛtyorbhujamivodagraṃ lokākarṣaṇatatparama | || 1.69.20 || dīptāṃśujālaṃ raṇacaṇḍavegaṃ dhanurdharaṃ kālabhujaprakāśam || mahānubhāvaṃ samareṣvajeyaṃ lelihyamānaṃ bhujagendrabāhum ||23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 varuṇādidarśanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||69|| <1.70> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sannaddhaṃ dānavagaṇaṃ patākāśatasaṃkulam || nānāprakāravāditraṃ siṃhanādabaloddhatam || 1 || dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahātejāḥ sajjaṃ cakre mahaddhanuḥ || śaraissaṃchādayāmāsa daityasainyaṃ mahābalama || 2 || abhracchāyeva saṃjajñe rāmamuktaiśśilīmukhaiḥ || tiryagūrdhvamadhaścaiva śarairvyāptaṃ samantataḥ || 3 || cāpamaṇḍalamadhyasthaḥ parivepīva bhāskaraḥ || dṛṣṭamātreṇa sainyānāṃ cakṣūṃṣyapaharadraṇe|| 4 || śarāndhakāre magnāste dānavā duṣṭacetasaḥ || rāmasandarśanādeva dṛṣṭe'rke kauśikā yathā || 5 || sa dānavānāṃ vyasṛjanrāmo bhāti śilīmukhān || sadānavānāṃ madhuvatkusumānāṃ śilīmukhaḥ || 6 || śarāndhakāre mahati magno matimatāṃ varaḥ || māyāṃ kṛtvā tadāgneyīṃ taṃ dadāha śarotkaram || 7 || śarāndhakāragahanānniṣkrāntāste diteḥ sutāḥ || bhārgavaṃ koṣṭakīkṛtya raṇe bibhidurañjasā || 8 || pracaṇḍairardhanārācairvatsadantaissacūcukaiḥ || varāhakarṇairbhallaiśca kṣurapraiścaṭakānanaiḥ || 9 || tomarairbhiṇḍipālaiśca pāṣāṇairlaguḍaiśśubhaiḥ || khaḍgaiḥ prāsaistathā cakrai'rgadāmusala kampanaiḥ || 1.70.10 || parighairāyasaiśśūlaistriśūlaiśśaktibhistathā || sa bādhyamāno'pi raṇe daityanāthāyudhotkaraiḥ || 11 || na vivyathe mahātejā hutāhutirivānalaḥ || yadā śastraprahāraistaṃ na śekussamare dvijam || 12 || hantuṃ daityavarā yuddhe cakrurastraṃ tadā mahat || ayaśśaṅkurmahātejā rājā daityagaṇasya yaḥ || 13 || sametairdānavaissārdhaṃ rāmaṃ raṇakṛtakṣaṇam || śaraiḥ saṃchādayāmāsa divyāstrapratimantritaiḥ || 14 || astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya dānavendrasya bhārgavaḥ || ciccheda saśaraṃ cāpaṃ rukmadaṇḍaṃ tathā dhvajam || 15 || sāratheśca śiraḥ kāyācchirastrāṇavibhūṣitam || etatkṛtvā raṇe karma dakṣiṇena sa pāṇinā || 16 || jagrāha paraśuṃ tīkṣṇaṃ daityakāyavidāraṇam || padbhyāmākramya vegena samare rathakūbaram || 17 || nirjīvānpādavegena kṛtvā turagasattamān || gadayā ca rathasthasya dānavendrasya saṃyuge || 18 || jahāra saśirastrāṇaṃ śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam || ayaḥśaṅkau hate daitye bhārgavaṃ samare tadā || 19 || sarve daityagaṇāḥ kuddhāśchādayāmāsurañjasā || astrapuñjaṃ raṇe cchitvā teṣāṃ bhṛgukulodbhavaḥ || 1.70.20 || raṇe ciccheda gātrāṇi śirāṃsi ca mahātapāḥ || kṣaṇamātreṇa rāmo'pi daityadehasamākulām || 21 || śoṇitaughanadīṃ cakre keśaśaivālaśādvalām || bāṇamīnāṃ cāpanakrāṃ chatrahaṃsāvalīṃ tathā || 22 || pretalokārṇavagamāṃ bhīrukalmaṣavarddhinīm || hastiśīrṣopalāṃ raudrāṃ cārutatpucchapannagāma || 23 || evaṃ vidhe'pi saṃvṛtte raṇe karmaṇi dānavāḥ || taṃ rāmamakṣataṃ dṛṣṭvā hataśeṣāḥ pradudruvuḥ || 24 || mayatāraprabhṛtayaḥ puraṃ ca viviśustadā || palāyamānānsamare na jaghāna sa bhārgavaḥ ||25|||| kiñciccheṣeṣu daityeṣu vinivṛttastadā raṇāt || hatadaityāyutagaṇo rāmo'śmanagaraṃ yayau || 26 || rāmapraveśe nagaraṃ varuṇasyājñayā tadā || patākādhvajasaṃbādhaṃ kṛtaṃ devairviśeṣavat||27|| nāgaiśca dānavaiścaiva siktaṃ candanavāriṇā|| dhūpapuñjasamutkṣiptaṃ kusumotkaramaṇḍitam||28|| tataśca sumahātejā varuṇastu vinirgataḥ|| putrapautraiḥ parivṛto rāmapragrahaṇakāraṇāt||29|| saṃpūjyamānaṃ varuṇo rathamāropya ca svakam || praveśayāmāsa puraṃ bahutūryapuraskṛtam || 1.70.30 ||| rāmapraveśe ca tadā nṛtyanto'psarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || gandharvamukhyā gāyanti saṃstuvanti ca bandinaḥ || 31 || sa praviśyātha nagaraṃ varuṇasya tathā gṛham || uvāsa tatra dharmātmā varuṇena supūjitaḥ || 32 || dharmāṇāmāgamaṃ kṛtvā varuṇātsasutāttadā || 33 ||| evaṃ sa rāmaḥ paravīraghātī saṃprāpya yādogaṇanāthaveśma || uvāsa putrairvaruṇasya sārdhaṃ saṃpūjitastena jaleśvareṇa || 34 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe ayaśśaṅkuvadho nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 || <1.71> || vajra uvāca ||| || yatsa śuśrāva dharmātmā varuṇādbhṛgunandana || tanmamācakṣva tattvena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || jamadagnisuto rāmo varuṇasya gṛhoṣitaḥ || kadācidvaruṇaṃ devamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 2 ||| rāma uvāca || namaste devadeveśa surāsuragaṇārcita || gobrāhmaṇahitāsakta yādogaṇajaleśvara || 3 || tvaṃ tasya devadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || ayanamṛṣibhiryena viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 || tvamevedaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamañca yat || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca tvaccharīre samāśritāḥ || 9 || tvamindrastvaṃ ca dhanadastvamīśastvaṃ samīraṇaḥ || tvamagnistvaṃ yamaścaiva sarvādhārastvamacyutaḥ || 6 || devānāmīśvaraścaiva nāgānāmīśvarastathā || sāgarāṇāṃ ca sarasāṃ saritāṃ ca mahābhuja ||7|| kūpavāpītaṭākānāṃ śaucasya paramasya ca || viṣṇorvāmasya netrasya śaśāṅkasya mahātmanaḥ || 8 || tvanmayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ deva tvanmayāssarvatārakāḥ || tvameva saritāṃ nāthassamudro yādasāṃ patiḥ || 9|| ādhārassarvaratnānāṃ vidyānāṃ ca jagatpate || tvanmayo dehināṃ prāṇo jīvo rudhirasaṃjñakaḥ || 1.71.10|| rāmastvaṃ prāṇināṃ deva sarvadevamayo vibhuḥ || bhavatā saṃyatā pāśairdānavā deva dāruṇaiḥ || 11|| pātāladvāramāśritya bhavāṃstiṣṭhati nirbhayaḥ || merupṛṣṭhe ca bhagavanpurī te devanirmitā ||12|| tṛtīyā ca mahābhāga mānasottaramūrdhani || puratraye tvaṃ vasasi prākāmyena jaleśvara || 13|| sarvatra pūjyase devaissarvabhūtabhavodbhava || ādhārastvaṃ hi tapasāṃ śaucānāṃ bhuvanasya ca ||14|| trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ deva prakṛtirvikṛtiśca te|| mamāpi sumahābhāga prasādasumukho hyasi||15|| tasmānme bhagavaṃśchindhi saṃśayānmanasi sthitān || varuṇa uvāca || yatrāsti te saṃśayamastradhāriñchettāsmi te tatra na saṃśayo'tra || yathā mameśastripurāntako'sau tathā bhavānme raṇacaṇḍavega|| |||16|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śrīparaśurāmavaruṇakṛtastotro nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||71|| <1.72> rāma uvāca|| snigdhavaiḍūryasaṃkāśa yādogaṇajaleśvara || tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi kālasaṃsthā mahābhuja || 1 || varuṇa uvāca || anādinidhanaḥ kālo rudrassaṃkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || sarvabhūtasamatvācca sa tu rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||2 || anādinidhanatvena sa mahānparameśvaraḥ || nimeṣādapi sūkṣmatvātsūkṣmasūkṣmataro hyati || 3 || tasya sūkṣmātisūkṣmasya kālasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || durvibhāvyā mahābhāga yogināmapi sūkṣmatā || 4 || padmapatrasahasraṃ tu sūcyā vai bhidyate yadā || samakālaṃ tu tadbhinnamabudho manyate janaḥ || 5 || kālakrameṇa tadbhinnaṃ sā tasya dvija sūkṣmatā || tasya sṛkṣmātisūkṣmasya na cātisahate dvija|| 6 || nāmasaṃkhyā budhairjñeyā grahagatyanusārataḥ || tatra tārāgrahāḥ pañca dvau ca jñeyau mahāgrahau || 7 || upagrahau ca dvau jñeyāvevaṃ proktā nava grahāḥ || bhaumajñajīvabhṛgujasaurāstārāgrahāssmṛtāḥ || 8 || candrādityau tathā rāma vijñeyau dvau mahāgrahau || upagrahau ca dvau jñeyau rāhuḥ ketuśca bhārgava || 9 || caṇḍārkagatyā kālasya paricchedamukho yadā || tadā tayoḥ pravakṣyāmi gatimāśritya bhārgava || 1.72.10 || bhagaṇena samagreṇa jñeyā dvādaśa rāśayaḥ || triṃśāṃśaśca tathā rāśerbhāga ityabhidhīyate || 11 || ādityādviprakṛṣṭastu bhāge dvādaśake tathā || candramāssyāttadā rāma māsārdhena na saṃśayaḥ || 12 || bhāgadvādaśakenaiva tithyāṃtithyāṃ krameṇa tu || candramāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣānte sūryeṇa saha yujyate || 13 || sannikarṣādathārabhyaṃ sannikarṣamathā param || caṇḍārkayorbudhairmāsaścāndra ityabhidhīyate || 14 || sāvane ca tathā māsi triṃśatsūryodayāssmṛtāḥ || ādityarāśibhogena sauro māsaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 15 || sarvarkṣaparivartaiśca nākṣatro māsa ucyate || tithinaikena divasaścāndramāne prakīrttitaḥ || 16 || ahorātreṇa caikena sāvano divasassmṛtaḥ || ādityabhāgabhogena sauro divasa ucyate || 17 || candranakṣatrabhogena nākṣatro divasassmṛtaḥ || māne māsastu nākṣatraḥ saptaviṃśatibhirdinaiḥ || 18 || pariśeṣeṣu māseṣu māsastriṃśaddinaḥ smṛtaḥ || saureṇābdastu māsena yadā bhavati bhārgava || 19 || sāvanena tu mānena divasaṃ kena pūryate|| ūnarātrāśca te rāma proktāssaṃvatsareṇa ṣaṭ || 1.72.20 || saurasaṃvatsarasyānte mānena śaśijena tu || ekādaśātiricyante dināni bhṛgunandana || 21 || samādvaye sāṣṭamāse dinaṣoḍaśakānvite | nāḍīcatuṣṭayānte tu tasmānmāso'tiricyate || 22|| sa cādhimāsakaḥ proktaḥ kāmyakarmasu garhitaḥ || yadā cāndreṇa mānena pūrṇassaṃvatsaro bhavet || 23|| tadā nākṣatramānena sa māso vārṣiko bhavet|| evaṃ kālasya sūkṣmasya proktaṃ mānacatuṣṭayam || 24|| yenayena ca mānena yadyatkāryaṃ nibodha tat || 29 || abdāyanaṃ tu grahacārakarma saureṇa mānena sadā vyavasyet || satrāṇyupāsyānyatha sāvanena loke ca yatsyādvyavahārakarma || 26 || syātpūrvakālakṣayapūraṇābhyāṃ cāndreṇa mānena yugaṃ ca rāhoḥ || nakṣatrasatrāṇyayanāni cendormānena kuryādbhagaṇātmakena ||27|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 varuṇaṃ prati paraśurāmapraśne'rkādimāsavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72|| <1.73> varuṇa uvāca || laghvakṣarasamā mātrā nimeṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || ataḥ sūkṣmataraḥ kālo nopalabhyo bhṛgūttama ||1|| nopalabhyaṃ yathā dravyaṃ susūkṣmaṃ paramāṇutaḥ|| dvau nimeṣau truṭirjñeyā prāṇo daśatruṭiḥ smṛtaḥ||2|| vināḍikā tu ṣaṭprāṇāstāḥ ṣaṣṭirnāḍikā matā || ahorātraṃ ca tāṣṣaṣṭyā nityametaiḥ prakīrtitam || 3 || triṃśanmuhūrtāśca tathā ahorātreṇa kīrtitāḥ || tatra pañcadaśa proktā rāma nityaṃ divācarāḥ ||4|| uttarāṃ tu yadā kāṣṭhāṃ kramādākramate raviḥ|| tadā tathā bhavedvṛddhirdivasasya mahābhuja||5|| divasaśca yathā rāma vṛddhiṃ samadhigacchati || tadāśritamuhūrtānāṃ jñeyā hānistadā tathā || 6 ||| dakṣiṇāṃ ca yadā kāṣṭhāṃ kramādākramate raviḥ || divasasya tadā hānirjñātavyā nityameva tu || 7 || kṣīyante dinahānau tu tanmuhūrtāstathaiva ca || rātryāśritāśca vardhante rātrivṛddhau tathātathā || 8|| yadā meṣaṃ sahasrāṃśustulāṃ ca pratipadyate || samarātrirdinaḥ kālo viṣuvacchabdavācakaḥ ||9|| tatra dānaṃ svalpamapi mahadbhavati bhārgava || śrāddhaṃ japyaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ yaccānyatsukṛtaṃ bhavet || 1.73.10 || sūryasaṃkramaṇasyānte sauro māsassamāpyate || sauramāsadvayaṃ rāma ṛturityabhidhīyate || 11 || ṛtutrayaṃ cāyanaṃ syāttaddvayaṃ ca samā smṛtā || devatānāmahorātraṃ sa ca rāma prakīrtitaḥ || 12 || meṣādiṣaṭkage sūrye teṣāṃ divasa ucyate ||| tulādiṣaṭkage sūrye teṣāṃ rātriḥ prakīrtitā || 13|| pitṝṇāṃ cāṃdramāsena ahorātrobhidhīyate || kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamīmadhye teṣāṃ rātryudayaḥ smṛtaḥ || 14 || śuklapakṣāṣṭamīmadhye teṣāmastamayastathā|| ardharātraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ samudāhṛtaḥ||15|| kṛṣṇapakṣāvasāne ca teṣāṃ madhyāhna ucyate || kṛṣṇapakṣakṣaye tasmātteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ pradīyate || kṛṣṇapakṣakṣaye śrāddhaṃ yaśca nityaṃ kariṣyati || satataṃ tarpitāstena bhavanti pitaro'vyayāḥ || 16 || samā śatairdvādaśabhirdivyaistiṣyayugaṃ smṛtam || dviguṇaṃ dvāparaṃ jñeyaṃ tretā triguṇamucyate || 17 || caturguṇaṃ kṛtaṃ proktaṃ piṇḍitaṃ cābdasaṃkhyayā || caturyugaṃ sahasrāṇi rāma dvādaśa kīrtitam ||18|| ataḥ paraṃ yugāvasthāṃ nibodha gadato mama || catuṣpātsakalo dharmastathā brahmottaraṃ jagat || 19|| śvetavarṇo harirdevo jñānanityāśca mānavāḥ || catvāryabdasahasrāṇi teṣāmāyuḥ prakīrtitam || 1.73.20 || samānavīryyāśca narāstatra nāstyadharottaram || tripādavigraho dharmo rāma tretāyuge tadā || 21 || keśave raktatāṃ yāte narā daśaśatāyuṣaḥ || yajñe śubhe pravartante nityaṃ hiṃsātmakeṣu |ca || 22 || jagatkṣatrottaraṃ caiva tadā bhavati bhārgava || dvipādavigraho dharmaḥ pītatāmacyute gate || 23 ||| samāḥ śatāni catvāri tadā jīvanti mānavāḥ|| yuddhaśauṇḍā mahotsāhā lokā vaiśyottarāstadā ||24 || jāyante śāstrabhedāśca matibhedāstathaiva ca || svalpamāyurnṛṇāṃ buddhvā viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk || 29 || ekameva yajurvedaṃ caturdhā vyabhajatpunaḥ || tasya śiṣyapraśiṣyāśca vedamekaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 26 || śākhābhedasahasreṇa vibhajanti dvijottamāḥ || ekapādasthite dharme kṛṣṇatāṃ keśave gate || 27 || dharmabhede samutpanne devatānāmaniścaye || na vidyate tadā rāma āyuṣastu viniścayam || 28|| garbhasthāśca mriyantetra bālyayauvanagāstathā || śūdrottarastadā lokastiṣye bhavati bhrārgava || 29 || surapratiṣṭhā dharmaśca tadā bhavati bhūtale || pāpiṣṭho vardhate rāma dharmiṣṭhaḥ kṣīyate tadā || 1.73.30 ||| rājānaḥ śūdrabhūyiṣṭhāścaurāścārthopajīvinaḥ || brāhmaṇāssarvabhakṣyāśca bhavanti bhṛgunandana || 31 || dharmaniṣṭhaściraṃ rājā na tadā rāma jīvati || tasminkāle sukṛtināṃ bhaktirbhavati keśave || 32 || teṣāmalpena kālena toṣamāyāti keśavaḥ || dhanyāḥ kaliyuge rāma tapastapsyanti mānavāḥ || 33|| tapasālpena te siddhiṃ prāpsyantīti ca niścayaḥ || caturyugaikasaptatyā manvantaramihocyate || 34|| kalpastu rāma vijñeyo manavastu caturdaśa || ādimadhyāntarāleṣu manūnāṃ bhṛgusattam || 39 || kṛtamānapramāṇena sandhirbhavati mānada || caturyugasahasraṃ tu kalpamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 36 ||| kalpaśca divasaḥ prokto brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || tāvatī ca niśā tasya yasyāṃ śete sa bhārgava||37|| evaṃvidhairahorātrairdinamāsādisaṃkhyayā|| pūrṇaṃ varṣaśataṃ sarvaṃ brahmā bhārgava jīvati||38|| brahmāyuṣā paricchinnaḥ pauruṣo divasaḥ smṛtaḥ || tāvatī ca niśā tasya yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || 39 || evaṃ vidhā ye divasā vyatītā na cāgatā ye ca mahānubhāva || anādisattvātparameśvarasya hyānantyabhāvāśca tathā tvasaṃkhyā || 1.73.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare pra0 mā0 saṃ0 varuṇarāmasaṃbhāṣaṇe kālasaṃkhyāvarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 || <1.74> vajra uvāca || yadetaduktaṃ rāmasya varuṇena mahātmanā || etacchrutvā tu me jātassaṃśayo bhṛgunandana || 1 || asmiṃstu bhārate varṣe parikṣīṇe yuge tathā || avasthā yā bhavedbrahmastanme vyākhyātu marhasi || 2 || ||mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || yugeyuge parikṣīṇe varṣe yādava bhārate || saṃgrāmeṇa vinaśyaṃti prāyo varṇottamā janāḥ || 3 || vajra uvāca || asmāccaturyugādbrahmanyadatītaṃ yugatrayam || teṣvahaṃ śrotumicchāmi saṃgrāmaṃ bhṛgunandana || 4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || āsītkṛtayugasyānte viprāṇāṃ kṣattriyaissaha || vaiśyānāṃ ca saśūdrāṇāṃ yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam || 5 || varṇatrayaṃ tatra raṇe kṣatriyairvinipātitam || tataśca brāhmaṇāḥ kecitkṣattriyānevamabruvan || 6 || alpairbhavadbhiḥ kāryeṇa vayaṃ kena vinirjitāḥ || tānabruvanmahābhāgāḥ kṣatriyāssatyasaṃgarāḥ || 7|| eko'smākaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhassenānīriti viśrutaḥ || sarvaśastrāstrakuśalo vayaṃ tasya mate sthitā || 8 || bhavatāṃ bahucittatvādvayaṃ tasmātpadepade || jayāmo vipulaṃ sainyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 9 || kṣatriyairevamuktāste brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratāḥ || śaśāṅkaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurdvijeśaṃ somamañjasā || 1.74.10 || sa tānuvāca dharmātmā somo rājā dvijottamān || prayāge bhārgavo vidvānbrāhmaṇassaṃśitavrataḥ || 11 || śūra ityeva vikhyāto nityaṃ vasati dhārmikaḥ || pramatirnāma tasyāsti putro dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 12|| sarvaśāstrārthakuśalo dhanurvedaparāyaṇaḥ || viṣṇurmānuṣyamāpanno yuṣmatkāryārthasiddhaye || 13 || kṛtvā senāpraṇetāraṃ taṃ tu kṛṣṇājinadhvajam || nirmaryādānraṇe sarvānkṣattriyāṃstānvijeṣyatha || 14 || somasya vacanaṃ sarvairevamuktairdvijaiḥ kṛtam || prāyaḥ kṣattriyahīneyaṃ laghvī vasumatī kṛtā || 15 || ādau kṛtā kṣattrabalairviṭchūdradvijavarjitā || evaṃ kṛtayugasyānte yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam || 16 || tathā tretāyugasyānte rākṣasairyuddhakarkaśaiḥ || rāṣṭraṃ rāṣṭamathāsādya pārthivāssagaṇā hatāḥ || 17 || rājā bhīmaratho nāma viṣṇurmānuṣyarūpadhṛk || divodāsānvayaṃ jāto nijaghānātha rākṣasān || 18 || pūrvaṃ tretāyugasyānte mahāvijayakāṅkṣibhiḥ || rākṣasaiḥ kṣatriyā yuddhe keśavena ca te hatāḥ || 19 || tathaiva dvāparasyānte vāsudevārjunau raṇe || cakraturvasudhāṃ laghvīṃ naranārāyaṇau nṛpa || 1.74.20 || dvāparedvāpare rājaṃstathaiva madhusūdanaḥ || ekameva yajurvedaṃ caturdhā vyabhajatpunaḥ || 21 || dvāparesminnṛpātīte vasiṣṭhakulavardhanaḥ || pārāśarasutaśśrīmānviṣṇurdvaipāyanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 22 || prakāśo janito yena loke bhāratacandramāḥ || parīkṣitputraṃ rājyasthaṃ rājānaṃ janamejayam || 23 || vaiśampāyana ityeva śiṣyo vyāsasya viśrutaḥ || ākhyāsyati mahā''khyānaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham || 24 || dharme cātheṃ ca kāme ca mokṣe ca yadunandana || pradīpabhūtaṃ sarvatra budhabuddhivivardhanam || 29 ||| yatra viṣṇukathā devyāḥ śrutayaśca sanātanāḥ || tacchrotavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa paraṃ padamabhīpsatā || 26 ||| bhāratātpāraṇaṃ prāpya narakaṃ tu na gacchati || na cetsyādyadi bhūpāla mahāpātakasaṃyutaḥ || 27 ||| daśabhiḥ pāraṇaiḥ sthānaṃ prāpnoti jagataḥ pateḥ || keśavasya mahābhāga nirmitaṃ yena bhāratam || 28 || vyasya vedaṃ caturdhā tu viṣṇurdvaipāyano muniḥ | śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsa nāmatastānnibodha me || 29 || ṛgvedamatha pailaṃ tu sāmavedaṃ tu jaiminim || atharvaṇaṃ sumantuṃ tu yajurvedaṃ mahāmunim || 1.74.30 ||| adhyāpayāmāsa tadā vaiśaṃpāyanasaṃjñakam || vākovākyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca sūtaṃ bhāratameva ca || 31 || aṅgāni vedāścatvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ || · dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca vidyāstvetāścaturdaśa || || 32 | śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ jyotiṣāṃ gatim || chandoviśeṣaḥ ṣaṣṭhaśca ṣaḍaṅgo veda ucyate || 33 ||| sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ pañcarātraṃ śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā || kṛtāntapañcakaṃ viddhi brahmaṇaḥ parimārgaṇe || 34 || saṃsārakṣayahetvarthe bhāvopakaraṇeṣu ca || sottarā vaiṣṇavā dharmāssārametatprakīrtitam || 39 ||| etāvāneva sakalo vidyāgrāmastaveritaḥ || vidyāḥ praśastāścaitābhyaḥ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || 36 || yosau vyāsasya śiṣyobhūdāraṇeyaḥ sutaḥ śukaḥ || tenaiva devadevena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 37 || tretāyuge caturviṃśe bhṛguvaṃśodbhavena tu || vālmīkinā tu racitaṃ svameva caritaṃ śubham || 38 || rāmākhyānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śrotṝṇāṃ viṣṇulokadam || vartamāne kaliyuge kṣīṇe nṛpatisattam || 39 || kalkī viṣṇuyaśo nāma bhaviṣyati jagatpatiḥ|| ghātayiṣyati sarvānsa mlecchānparabalārdanaḥ||1.74.40|| mlecchākrāntāṃ vasumatīṃ kṛtvā mlecchāvivarjitām || dharmasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā svasthānamupayāsyati || 41 ||| prajāsu dharmayuktāsu tatassaṃpatsyate kṛtam || ityevaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuryuge kṣīṇe'bhi jāyate || 42 ||| dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya nityameva yadūdvaha || prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi samatītānyanekaśaḥ || 43 || bhaviṣyati tathā tasya yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate ||44||| etattavoktaṃ hi narendracandra kṣīṇe yuge yadbhavatīha loke || ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha prabrūhi kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan||49|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 yugāntavarṇano nāma catussaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 || <1.75> vajra uvāca || manvantare parikṣīṇe yādṛśī dvija jāyate || samavasthā mahābhāga tādṛśīṃ vaktumarhasi || 1 ||| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || manvantare parikṣīṇe devā manvantareśvarāḥ || maharlokamathāsādya tiṣṭhanti gatakalmaṣāḥ || 2 || manuśca saha śakreṇa devāśca yadunandana || brahmalokaṃ prapadyante punarāvṛttidurlabham || 3 || ṛṣayaśca tathā sapta tatra tiṣṭhanti te sadā || adhikāraṃ vinā sarve sadṛśāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 4 || bhūtalaṃ sakalaṃ vajra toyarūpī maheśvaraḥ || ūrmimālī mahāvegaḥ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati || 9 || bhūlokamāśritaṃ sarvaṃ tadā naśyati yādava || na vinaśyanti rājendra viśrutāḥ kulaparvatāḥ || 6|| mahendro malayassahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣavānapi || vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca mālyavāngandhamādanaḥ || 7 ||| himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca || śvetaśca śṛṅgavānmerurna vinaśyanti parvatāḥ || 8 || śeṣaṃ vinaśyati jagatsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yat || naurbhūtvā tu satī devī tadā yadukulodvaha || 9 || dhārayatyatha bījāni sarvāṇyevā viśeṣataḥ || bhaviṣyaśca manustasyāṃ bhaviṣyā ṛṣayastathā || 1.75.10|| tiṣṭhanti rājaśārdūla sapta ye prathitā bhuvi || matsyarūpadharo viṣṇuḥ śṛṅgī bhūtvā jagatpatiḥ ||11|| ākarṣati tu tāṃ nāvaṃ sthānātsthānaṃ sa līlayā || karṣamāṇantu tāṃ nāvaṃ devadevaṃ jagatpatim||12|| stuvanti ṛṣayaḥ sarve divyaiḥ karmabhiracyutam || ghūrṇamānastadā matsyo jalavegormisaṃkule || 13 || ghūrṇamānāṃ tu tāṃ nāvaṃ nayatyamitavikramaḥ || himādriśikharaṃ nāvaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ || 14 || matsyastvadṛśyo bhavati te ca tiṣṭhanti tatragāḥ || 19 || kṛtatulyaṃ tadā kālaṃ tāvatprakṣālanaṃ smṛtam || āpassāmyamatho yānti yathāpūrvaṃ narādhipa || ṛṣayaśca manuścaiva sarvaṃ kurvanti te tadā || 16 || manvantarānte jagatāmavasthā mayeritā te yaduvṛndanātha | ataḥ paraṃ yattava kīrtanīyaṃ samāsatastadvada bhūmipāla||17|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 manvantaravarṇano nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||75|| <1.76> vajra uvāca || brāhmasya divasasyānte yādṛśī dvija jāyate || jagato'sya samāvasthā tādṛśīṃ vaktumarhasi || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vṛtte prakṣālane rājankalpasyānte caturdiśam || uttiṣṭhaṃti tadā ghorā divi sapta divākarāḥ || 2 || te tu pītvā jalaṃ sarvaṃ śoṣayanti jagattrayam || vināśe sarvabhūtānāmayoguḍasamā tadā || 3 || bhūmirbhavati bhūpāla dagdhāssarve ca jantavaḥ || vinaṣṭakilbiṣāssarve jīvamātrāvaśeṣakāḥ || 4 || janalokamathāsādyatatra tiṣṭhanti nirbhayāḥ|| bhūrbhuvassvarmahaścaiva tadā naśyanti pārthiva||5|| janalokādayo lokā na tu naśyanti pārthiva|| tato'rkāste tu naśyanti saṃhitā rudratejasā || 6|| uttiṣṭhanti mahāraudrāstato divicarā ghanāḥ || kecidañjanapuñjābhāḥ kecidgajakulopamāḥ || 7 || kecitpuravarākārāḥ keciddhāridrasannibhāḥ|| haritālāñjanaprakhyāstathā hiṅgulakaprabhāḥ||8|| śukapatranibhāḥ kecitkecinnīlotpalaprabhāḥ|| vidyunmālā vinaddhāṅgā garjanto'tha balāhakāḥ || 9 || ākramya gaganaṃ rājanpūrayanti mahītalam || gaṅgāpravāhapratimairdhārāpātaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 1.76.10 || tatassamudrā bhūpāla velodbhedataraṅgiṇaḥ || chādayanti mahīṃ sarvāṃ dagdhāṃ sūryagabhastibhiḥ || 11 || tatassaṃvartako vāyurghanānārujati kṣaṇāt || tato vāyuṃ samādāya svaśarīre pitāmahaḥ || 12 ||| svapityekārṇave loke naṣṭasthāvarajaṅgame || naṣṭacandrārkapavane grahanakṣatratārake || 13 || suptvā yugasahasraṃ tu devadevo jagatpatiḥ || punarvibuddhaḥ kurute sṛṣṭiṃ prāgvatpitāmahaḥ || 14 || sṛṣṭiṃ karoti dharmajña kalpekalpe punaḥpunaḥ || pitāmahasya rātryante tasmāddhi sṛjati prajāḥ||19|| jantūnāṃ jananādrājañjana ityabhidhīyate ||16|| etāvaduktaṃ tava bhūmipāla kalpe gate yadbhavatīha loke || ataḥ paraṃ sarvayadupradhāna vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan || 17 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 kalpāntavarṇano nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 || <1.77> vajra uvāca || mahākalpakṣaye brahmansamavasthāṃ vadasva me || bhavāñjñānanidhiḥ sphīto yathā brahmā pitāmahaḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| pūrṇe saṃvatsaraśate saṃhṛtya sakalaṃ jagat | śete brahmā mahārāja prāgvadekārṇave tadā | 2 | saṃnyasya dehaṃ yogena puruṣaṃ pratipadyate || mokṣasthānamanuprāpte devadeve pitāmahe || 3 || ye gatā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ mucyante sarva eva te || aṇḍasyābhyantaraṃ sarvaṃ tadāmbhobhiḥ prapūryate || 4 ||| śarīradhāriṇassarve tadā naśyanti pārthiva || antargatena toyena bhinnamaṇḍe jagatpate || 5 || pūrṇe brahmāyuṣi tadā bāhyasthe'mbhasi līyate || evaṃ sā jagadādhārā dhārā toye pralīyate || 6 || jyotiṣyāpaḥ pralīyante jyotirvāyau pralīyate || khe vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti manasyākāśameva ca || 7 || manaḥ pralīyate buddhau buddhiścātmani līyate || avyakte līyate cātmā avyaktaḥ puruṣe pare || 8 || anantāni tathoktāni yānyaṇḍāni mayā purā || sarvāṇi tāni saṃhṛtya samakālaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 9 || prakṛtau tiṣṭhati tadā sā rātristasya kīrtitā || brāhme samāśate pūrṇe punareva jagatpatiḥ || 1.77.10 || sarvaṃ vidhatte dharmajña yathāpūrvamudāhṛtam || avyaktādikrameṇātha vidhāyāṇḍaṃ maheśvaraḥ || 11 || aṇḍe śarīre bhavati svayaṃbhūramṛtadyutiḥ || svayaṃ sa eva dharmajña brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || 12 || sarveṣvaṇḍeṣu dharmajñassamakālaṃ jagatpatiḥ || svayaṃ śarīre bhavati prākāmyānmanujeśvara || 13 || brahmāyuṣonte jagatāmavasthā mayeritā te yaduvṛndanātha || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 mahākalpavarṇano nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| || 77 || <1.78> || vajra uvāca || saptamaste mahābhāga jātasya divasastvayam || vartate brahmaṇo brahmam̐statra manvantarakṣaye || 1 || kathaṃ kālastvayā nītaḥ purā kalpakṣaye tadā || etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ samaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || naugatena mayā nītaḥ kālo manvantarakṣaye || bhūyobhūyo mahābhāga devadevaprasādataḥ || 3 || kalpakṣayanuprāpya dāhakāla upasthite || janalokagatenātha kālo nītassa vai mayā || 4 || dāhakāle tadā vṛtte pralayāmbhodhisaṃplave || janalokādahaṃ bhraṣṭaḥ patito dharaṇītale || 5 || nūnaṃ tasyaiva devasya sā māyā bhīmavikramā || ekārṇave bhūmitale patitasyāpi me nṛpa || 6 || jīvitaṃ na paribhraṣṭaṃ nūnaṃ tasya prasādataḥ || tadāhaṃ naṣṭavijñānaḥ patitoṃ'bhasi dāruṇe || 7 || ūhyamānombukallolairitaścetaśca yādava || apaśyamāno jagatīṃ saśailavanakānanām || 8 || nirvedaṃ jīvite dīrghe tadā bhūtosmi śatruhan || so'hamārto'tha nirviṇṇastasmiṃstūdakasaṃplave || 9 || paśyāmi jalamadhyasthaṃ vipulaṃ vaṭapādapam || mahāśākhaṃ ghanacchāyaṃ snigdhapallavaśobhitam || 1.78.1 0 || tamahaṃ bāhubhirgatvā tasminnyagrodhapādape || śākhāsaktaṃ tu paśyāmi savitāraṃ tathojjvalam || 11 || divyaṃ paśyāmi paryaṅkaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam || paryaṅke tatra paśyāmi bālaṃ kamalalocanam ||12|| atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam || padmapatrābhacaraṇaṃ tadākārakaraṃ tathā || 13 || alaṅkṛtaṃ cābharaṇaiḥ śikhaṇḍaikavibhūṣitam || ekaṃ sāhasramadhyasthaṃ bhrājamānamiva śriyā || 14 || sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā bālaḥ smitapūrvamuvāca ha || yadi śrānto'si dharmajña vigrahaṃ vadanena me || 15 || praviśya viśramasvādya yāvadvā rucitaṃ tava || evamuktasya sañjātā vrīḍā yadukulodvaha || 16 || tato'hamavaśastasya praviṣṭo nṛpa vigraham || jagatīṃ tatra paśyāmi saśailavanakānanām || 17 || yathāpūrvaṃ mahābhāga nagarākāraśālinīm || devadaityoragākīrṇāṃ samudravarabhūṣaṇām || 18 || nṛparāṣṭrasamākīrṇāṃ vaṇigbhirupaśobhitām || dvijādhyayanasaṃghuṣṭāṃ varṇāśramasamākulām ||19|| saritparvatavṛkṣāḍhyāṃ yajñotsavasamākulām || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kautukaṃ jātaṃ tasya bālasya karmaṇā||1.78.20|| draṣṭumicchāmi tasyāntaṃ bhramamāṇastatastataḥ || yadā nāsādayāmyatra tasya bālasya ceṣṭitam ||21|| pūrṇe yugasahasre'pi tamevāhaṃ tadā śiśum || saṃprāptaḥ śaraṇaṃ rājannahaṃ bhāvyarthena coditaḥ || 22 || tato'haṃ vadanāttasya nirgataśśaśisannibhāt || yadā tasyodare'paśyaṃ trailosya sacarācaram ||23 || tathā paśyāmi sakalaṃ bahirbhūmipasattama || tato'haṃ patitastasya pādayossumahātmanaḥ||24|| tatasso'ntarhito bālassaha tenaiva śākhinā|| evaṃ mayā tasya niśā narendra saṃprāpya puṇyaṃ jaṭhare hi nītā| mahāśarīrasya mahānubhāva mahāprameyasya pitāmahasya||29|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmoṃtare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 bālaprabhāvakathano nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||78|| <1.79> vajra uvāca ||| || kastvasau bālaveṣeṇa kalpānteṣu punaḥpunaḥ || dṛṣṭo'pi na tvayā jñātastatra kautūhalaṃ mahat ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhūyobhūyastvasau dṛṣṭo mayā devo jagatpatiḥ || kalpakṣaye na vijñātastanmāyāmohitena vai ||2|| kalpakṣaye vyatīte tu taṃ tu devaṃ pitāmahāt || aniruddhaṃ vijānāmi pitaraṃ te jagatpatim || 3 || vajra uvāca || jñātavānasi taṃ devaṃ kathaṃ devātpitāmahāt || durvijñeyaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam || 4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || māyayā mohitastasya bālasyāmitatejasaḥ || dṛṣṭvodare jagatkṛtsnaṃ vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ || 9 || gatvāhaṃ brahmasadanaṃ pṛṣṭavām̐staṃ pitāmaham || ekārṇave mayā loke devadeve jagatpatau || 6 ||| dṛṣṭo bālo mahātejāstasyāhamavaśastataḥ || praviṣṭo jaṭhare tasya deva sarvaṃ carācaram || 7 || mayā dṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ na ca jānāmi bālakam || dhruvaṃ taṃ bhagavānvetti sarvajñatvājjagadguruḥ || 8|| evaṃ pṛṣṭo mayā brahmā māmuvāca jagadguruḥ || mārkaṇḍeya vijānāmi hyaniruddhaṃ jagadgurum || 9|| tvaṃ ca taṃ vettha tattvena na ca kalpakṣaye mune || tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tasya jaṭhare bhuvanaṃ mune || 1.79.10 || tathā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tasya jagadyonermahātmanaḥ || madīyasya dinasyānte kadācidbhṛgunandana || 11 || ekārṇave tadā loke naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame || nāgaparyaṅkaśayane paśyāmi puruṣaṃ tadā || 12 || tasminkāle na jānāmi tamahaṃ tena mohitaḥ || tataḥ pṛcchāmi taṃ devaṃ ko bhavāniti vismitaḥ || 13 ||| sa māmuvāca prahasanmamedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || na tu māṃ vetsi tattvena jagatāmīśvareśvaram || 14 ||| mayāpyuktaḥ sa deveśo mamedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || . vṛthā pralayamadhye te matsamīpe viśeṣataḥ || 15 |||| vipratyayaśca yadi te praviśya jaṭharaṃ mama || trailokyamakhilaṃ paśya saṃhṛtaṃ yanmayā svayam || 16 || evamuktassa tu mayā tadā kenāpi hetunā || praviśya jaṭharaṃ me sa kṣaṇamātrādvinirgataḥ || 17 || nirgamya māmabravīcca dṛṣṭaṃ tribhuvanaṃ mayā|| tavodare jagannātha tvaṃ ca paśya mamodare||18|| evamuktvā sa suṣvāpa bhogibhogāsane tadā|| ahamapyavaśastasya praviṣṭo jaṭharaṃ tadā ||19|| paśyāmi jagatīṃ brahmansaśailavanakānanām|| sasamudrasariddvīpalokapātālabhūṣitām||1.79.20|| dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pṛthivīṃ tasya tathā jaṭharasaṃsthitām || nirgamiṣyanna paśyāmi śarīraṃ tasya bhārgava ||21 ||| antarikṣaṃ prapaśyāmi nirālambaṃ paribhraman || paribhramaṇakhinno'smi tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 22 || tatastu tasya paśyāmi randhrahīnaṃ tu vigraham ||| tasya dehādvinirgantuṃ śaktināsīttathā ca me ||23|| randhrahīnānmahābhāga tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || tato'haṃ gatavānbrahmanraṃndhraṃ prāptaṃ mayānagha || 24|| bālāgrādapi sūkṣmaṃ tattato'haṃ tena nirgataḥ || padmanālena niṣkrāntaṃ paśyāmyātmānamātmanā || 29 || nābhisarasi tatpadmaṃ jātaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ || śeṣaratnārkaśaivāli vikāsitadalaṃ mahat || 26 || tato'haṃ padmajanmeti loke khyātimupāgataḥ |||| nābhijātaṃ ca yatpadmaṃ tasya devasya bhārgava || 27|| tanmahāmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ merustasya ca karṇikā || tatrāhaṃ tasya saṃbhūto devadevasya cakriṇaḥ||28|| devassa viṣṇurjagatāmadhīśaḥ sarveśvaraḥ sarvajagatpradhānaḥ || y bālarūpī bhavatāntakāle dṛṣṭo'sya sarvasya carācarasya || 29|| evaṃ hi tasyodarasaṃsthitena mayoṣitaṃ jātakutūhalena || tasyaiva māyāparimohitena kalpāntakāleṣu sadā narendra || 1.79.30 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 padmanābhopākhyāno nāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 ||| <1.80> vajra uvāca || brahmaṇo'sya samutpattimārabhya sumahādyute || kālasya gatimicchāmi śrotuṃ bhṛgukulodvaha||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| svenāhorātramānena brahmaṇo'sya jagatpateḥ|| samāṣṭakaṃ gataṃ rājanpañcamāsāstathaiva ca|| || 2|| ahorātracatuṣkaṃ ca vartamānadinādgatam || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 3 || manavaḥ ṣaḍ gatāssapta sandhayaśca tathā gatāḥ || saptaviṃśadvyatītāśca tathaiva ca caturyugāḥ || 4 || yugatrayaṃ tathātītaṃ vartamānacaturyugāt || saṃvatsarāṇāṃ daśakaṃ tathā kaliyugādgatam || 5 || vātāśvameghakāle'sminsaha yakṣeṇa yādava || bhaviṣyāṇāmatītānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ bhūridakṣiṇa || 6 || anādimattvātkālasya saṃkhyāṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate || gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsavaḥ || 7 || śakyā gaṇayituṃ rājanna vyatītā pitāmahāḥ antavattāṃ budho buddhvā sarvasya jagatīpate || 8|| tanmārgaṃ parimārgante yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || vajra uvāca || kiyatkālaparīmāṇaṃ mayā śāsyā vasundharā||9|| parikṣitā ca dharmajña tanme brūhi bhṛgūttama|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| adyaprabhṛti rājendra samā pañcāśakaṃ gate||1.80.10|| parīkṣiti mahārāje divaṃ prāpte kurūddhahe || parīkṣiddhīne lokesminprāṇituṃ tvaṃ tu śakyase || 13 || mahāprasthānamāviśya nāgalokaṃ gamiṣyasi || svargate tvayi rājendra parīkṣiti tathā nṛpe || 12|| rājā nāgapure bhāvī pārīkṣijjanamejayaḥ || mathurāyāṃ tathā bhāvī tava putro'calo nṛpaḥ || 13 ||| nagaraṃ khāṇḍavaprasthaṃ bhayādivinivarjitam || pālayiṣyati dharmātmā putraste bhīmavikramaḥ || 14 || dānavendro mayaḥ pūrvaṃ phālgunena prayāsyatā || mahāprasthānamityukto rājaṃstvatpriyakāmyayā || 15|| yāvadvajro mahīṃ bhuṅkte khāṇḍavaprasthamāśritaḥ || tāvatsabheyaṃ saṃrakṣyā tvayā maduparodhataḥ||16|| seyaṃ saṃrakṣyate tena pratijñāya dhanañjaye || tvayi nākamanuprāpte sabheyaṃ mayaśāsanāt || 17 || himācalaṃ tu neṣyanti yatra bindusaraṃ saraḥ || rākṣasāḥ kiṅkarā nāma yattasmānnirmitā purā || 18 || uktaṃ hi te kālagataṃ mayaitadāyuḥpramāṇaṃ ca tathā tavoktam || ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan || 19 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 yānakālavarṇano nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 || <1.81> vajra uvāca || tvayoditānāṃ dharmajña samāsena pṛthakpṛthak || kālasyāvayavānāṃ ca śrotumicchāmi devatāḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pauruṣaṃ yadahorātraṃ śrutavānasi yādava || kālātmā puruṣastasya sarvabhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 2 || kalpasya daivataṃ brahmā yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || kramānmanvantarāṇāṃ tu manavastu caturdaśa || 3 || svāyambhuvastu prathamo manuḥ svārociṣastathā || vaivasvato'tha sāvarṇirbrahmaputrastathaiva ca || 4 || dharmaputro rudraputro dakṣaputraśca yādava || raucyo bhautyaśca viśvātmā manavastu caturdaśa ||5|| vajra uvāca|| ya ete bhavatā proktā manavaśca caturdaśa || nityaṃ brāhme dine prāpte eta eva kramāddvija ||6|| bhavantyutānye dharmajña etanme cchindhi saṃśayam || athavā varttamāne'sminbhavatā mama kīrtitāḥ || 7 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || eta eva mahārāja manavastu caturdaśa || kalpekalpe tvayā jñeyā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||8|| ekarūpāstrayaḥ kalpā jñātavyāssarva eva hi || kvacitkiṃcidvibhinnāśca māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ ||9 || jñātavyamekarūpatvamabdānāṃ ca tathā tvayā || kalpekalpe mahārāja manūnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 1.81.10 || vajra uvāca || kalpānāṃ janasādṛśye yuktinaivopapadyate || kadācidapi dharmaja tatra paśyāmi kāraṇam || 11 || ekasminnantare muktiṃ kalpekalpe gate dvija || prabhaviṣyajjagacchūnyaṃ kālasyāderabhāvataḥ || 12 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || jīvasyānyasya sargeṇa nare muktimupāgate || acintyaśaktirbhagavāñjaganpūrayate sadā || 13 || brahmaṇā saha mucyante brahmalokamupāgatāḥ || sṛjyante ca mahākalpe tadvidhāścāpare janāḥ || 14 || te prāptāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yeṣāṃ janma na vidyate || samajīvapramāṇāśca sarve kalpāstathā nṛpa || brahmaloke viṣṇuloke rudraloke ca ye gatāḥ || 15 || viṣṇulokāssubahavo rudralokāstathaiva ca || śvetadvīpagatā ye ca teṣāṃ janma na vidyate || 16 || na tu sarveṣu rājendra teṣu muktiḥ prakīrtitā || brahmalokopariṣṭācca ye lokā raudravaiṣṇavāḥ || 17 || mayoditāstayorgatvā punarjanma na vidyate || mahākalpakṣaye jīvāḥ sarve taṃ parameśvaram || 18 || prāpyāpi vinivartante vinā jñānena yādava || bhūya eva tadā lokānsarge sṛjati tānprabhuḥ || 19 || kalpamadhyre tu kalpānte jñānojjhitakalevarāḥ || prāpnuvanti paraṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 1.81.20 || jīvabījānyasargeṇa tatsthānaṃ parameśvaraḥ || prapūrayati dharmajña rājankenāpi hetunā || 21 || vajra uvāca || kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye yo bhedo bhṛgunandana || tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra me kautukaṃ mahat || 22 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye śṛṇu bhedaṃ narādhipa|| samatīte yathā kalpe ṣaṣṭhe manvantare gate || 23 || saptamasya caturviṃśe rājaṃstretāyuge tadā || yadā rāmeṇa samare sagaṇo rāvaṇo hataḥ ||24|| rāmeṇaiva tadā rājankumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ || vartamāne tu yadvṛttaṃ kalpe yadukulodvaha || 29|| rāmasya caritaṃ baddhaṃ tadā vālmīkinā śubham || atītakalpe yadvṛttaṃ mayā tatkāmyake vane || 26 || yudhiṣṭhirāya kathitaṃ dharmaputrāya pārthiva || kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye bheda eṣa taveritaḥ||27|| teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ ca tathā tathā rājannanukramam || brahmajanmanisargāśca tathā tasya pṛthagvidhāḥ || 28 || kārtikeyasya lakṣmyāśca tathā devasya śūlinaḥ || evamādyāḥ prabhedāstu tvayā jñeyā nu pārthiva || kalpādīnāṃ mahārāja cānyatrāpi yadūdvaha || 29 || sādṛśyabhedāviha bhūmipāla kalpasyakalpasya mayoditau te || yugādibhinnasya ca daivatāni vakṣyāmyatastāni nibodha rājan ||1.81.30|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 kalpasādṛśyo nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 || <1.82> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ||| || bhagavānvāsudevaśca tathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || pradyumraścāniruddhaśca kṛtādīnāṃ ca daivatāḥ || || 1 || tathā khaṇḍayugānīha dvādaśoktāni bhūpate|| ṣaṣṭhābde ca vivartante pañcābdāni pṛthakpṛthak || 2 || teṣāṃ tava pravakṣyāmi daivatāṃstu pṛthakpṛthak || viṣṇurbṛhaspatiśśakro vahnistvaṣṭā tathaiva ca || 3|| ahirbudhnyaśca pitaro viśvedevā niśākaraḥ || indrāgnī caiva nāsatyau bhagaścaiva mahābalaḥ || 4 || iti dvādaśa te proktā mayā khaṇḍayugeśvarāḥ|| atha ṣaṣṭyabdanāmāni nibodha gadato mama || 9 || vartamāne tathā kalpe ṣaṣṭhe manvantare gate|| tasyaiva ca caturviṃśe rājaṃstretāyuge tadā || 6 ||| yadā rāmeṇa samare sagaṇo rāvaṇo hataḥ || lakṣmaṇena tathā rājankumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ || 7 || māghaśuklaṃ samārabhya candrārkau vāsavarkṣagau || jīvayuktau yadā syātāṃ ṣaṣṭyabdādistadā smṛtaḥ || 8|| prabhavo vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodaśca prajāpatiḥ|| vaiṣṇave tu yuge pañca proktāssaṃvatsarāśśubhāḥ | 9 aṅgirā śrīmukho bhāvo yuvā dhātā tathaiva ca|| abdo jīvayuge pañca yeṣāmādyāśśubhāstrayaḥ||1.82.10|| īśvaro bahudhānyaśca pramāthī vikramo vaśaḥ|| śakrābdāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭā yeṣāmādyāvubhau śubhau||11|| vahnissvabhānustaraṇo vāridaśca tathā'vyayaḥ || āgneyāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭā dvitīyaṃ teṣvaśobhanam || 12 || sarvajitsarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtiḥ kharaḥ || tvāṣṭre pañca་ yuge teṣāṃ dvitīyaṃ tu śubhapradam || 13 ||| nandano vijayaścaiva jayaḥ kāmaśca durmukhaḥ || āhirbudhnye yuge pañca yeṣāmādyā hitāstrayaḥ ||14 || hemamālī vilambī ca vikārī śarvarī plavaḥ || paitrye pañcayuge teṣāṃ pañcamaśca śubhapradaḥ || 19|| śokakṛcchubhakṛtkrodhī viśvāvasuparāvasū || vaiśve pañca śubhā vaiṣāmabdau rājandvipaṃcamau ||16|| plavaṅgaḥ kīlakassaumyassomo rodhakṛdeva ca || saumye pañca śubhāveṣāṃ prathamānantarāvubhau ||17|| dhāvanaṃ mathanaṃ vīraṃ rākṣasaṃ cānalaṃ tathā || indrāgnidaivate pañca sarve eva śubhapradāḥ ||18|| piṅgalaḥ kālayuktaśca siddhārtho raudradurmatī || āśvine'pi yuge pañca
