caturthasteṣu śasyate ||19|| dundubhyaṅgārakau raktaḥ krodhaścāpi kṣayastathā || bhāgye pañca śubhāssarve viśeṣeṇa tu pañcamaḥ || 1.82.20 ||| ataḥ paraṃ cāravaśāddevācāryasya pārthiva || dvādaśābdādhipāṃstubhyaṃ kathayāmi phalānvitān || 21 || āgneyakṣage jīve varṣaṃ syādvahnidaivatam || ahitaṃ tadvinirdiṣṭaṃ godvijāgnyupajīvinām ||22|| saumyaraudropage jīve saumyavarṣamudāhṛtam || ītayassakalā yatra cānāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ tathā || 23 || adityapuṣyage cābdo vijñeyo guru daivataḥ || śubhaṅkarī hito loke kṣemārogyasubhikṣadaḥ || 24 || sārpapaitryopage jīve paitryaṃ varpamudāhatam || hārdaṃ vṛṣṭipradaṃ loke śivasaubhikṣyakārakam || 25 || phālgunīdvayahastasthe varṣaṃ bhāgyamudāhṛtam || cauraprābalyakaṃ ghoraṃ nārīdaurbalyakārakam || 26 || citrāsvātigate jīve tvāṣṭraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ || śūkadhānyakṣayakaraḥ śibidhānyavivardhanaḥ || 27 || indrāgnidaivataṃ jīve viśākhāmaitrasaṃsthite || yajñakriyāpravṛttānāṃ hitaṃ muditamānavam || 28 || jyeṣṭhāmūlagate jīve śāktamabdamudāhṛtam || śūkadhānyakṣayakaraṃ bhūtānāṃ bhayavardhanam || 29 || āṣāḍhādvayage jīve vaiśvadevamudāhṛtam || nāśubhaṃ na śubhaṃ loke rājñāṃ vigrahakārakam || 1.82.30 || viṣṇuvāsavasaṃsthe tu vaiṣṇavaṃ parikīrtitam || kṣemasaubhikṣadaṃ loke pāṣaṃḍiparipīḍanam || 31 || proṣṭhapadādvayagate jīve vāruṇasaṃsthite || pūrvadhānyapradaṃ tvājaṃ paścāddhānyavināśanam || 32 || pauṣṇāśviyāmyage jīve varṣaṃ syādaśvidaivatam || suvṛṣṭikṣemadaṃ loke sarvātaṅkavivarjitam || 33 || caitraśuklasamārambhe jagatāṃ jagadīśvara || sarvaṃ cakre tadā rājam̐statastasminsadā dine || 34 || saṃvatsareśaḥ kriyate brahmaṇā tu sadā grahaḥ || nāgo yajñaśca dharmajña gandharvaśca tathaiva ca || 35 || sapta cchinne tu yaḥ śleṣaḥ kalipātasamāgaṇe || ādityādissa boddhavyo grahaḥ saṃvatsarādhipaḥ || 36 || ādityena sahānanto nāgo bhavati bhūmipa || citrāṅgadaśca gandharvo dīrghabhadro niśācaraḥ ||37|| saumyena vāsukirnāgaḥ pūrṇabhadro niśācaraḥ || citrasenaśca gandharvaḥ samāścāmī prakīrtitāḥ ||38|| bhaumena takṣako nāgo maṇibhadro niśācaraḥ || tadā citraratho nāma gandharvaścābhiṣicyate || 39 || budhena nāgaḥ kārkoṭo yakṣabhadro niśācaraḥ || tumbururnāma gandharvaḥ samāsvāmyabhiṣicyate||1.82.40|| jīvena nāgaḥ padmastu dīrghabāhurniśācaraḥ || gandharvaśca mahātejāstathā śāliśiraḥ prabhuḥ || || 41 || mahāpadmastu śukreṇa nāgo bhavati bhūpate || nāradaścaiva gandharvo mahābāhurniśācaraḥ || 42 || saureṇa nāgaḥ śaṅkhastu mahākarṇo niśācaraḥ || ūrṇāyuścaiva gandharvaḥ samāsvāmyabhiṣicyate || 43 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi samārūpaṃ mahīpate || grahasvāmibhavaṃ tubhyaṃ śeṣāssarve tadāśrayāḥ || 44 || tīkṣṇārkastvalpamatsyaśca gatamegho'tibhāskaraḥ || bahunāgavyādhigaṇo bhāskarābdo raṇākulaḥ||45|| bahuvarṣo'tisasyaśca gavākṣīrapradāyakaḥ|| candrābdaḥ kāmināmiṣṭaḥ cityaṅkitamahītalaḥ || 46 || agnitaskararogāḍhyo nṛpavigrahadāyakaḥ || gatasasyo bahuvyālo bhaumābdo bālahā bhṛśam ||47|| viprakṣatriyasasyānāṃ janānāṃ ca kalābhṛtām || buddhiprado'bdo bauddhastu bahusasyākaraḥ kṣitau || 48 || bahuyajño'tisasyaśca gogajāśvahitastathā || bahuvṛṣṭipradaḥ saumyo jīvābdo dvijapuṣṭidaḥ || 49 || sasyāḍhyo dharmabahulo gatātaṃko bahūdakaḥ || kāmināṃ kāmadaḥ kāmaḥ sitābdo nṛpaśarmadaḥ || 1.82.50 || durbhikṣamarakānrogānkaroti pavanastathā || śanaiścarābdaḥ śokāṃśca vigrahāṇi ca bhūbhujām || 51 || krameṇa parivarttante pañca yādava vatsarāḥ || teṣāmadhipatīnvakṣye nāmāni ca phalāni ca || 52 || pañca bhakte tu yaccheṣaṃ tiṣṭhedabdagaṇe gate || saṃvatsarādyaḥ saṃjñeyo nityaṃ saṃvatsaro budhaiḥ || 53 || ādyaḥ saṃvatsaro nāma dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ || iḍākhyaśca tṛtīyo'tra caturthaścānuvatsaraḥ || idvatsarākhyaḥ kathitaḥ tathā caivātra pañcamaḥ || 54 || saṃvatsaro'gniḥ parivatsaro'rka iḍābhidhāno bhagavāñchaśāṅkaḥ || brahmā svayaṃbhūranuvatsaro'pi idvatsaraḥ śailasutāpatiśca || 55 || vṛṣṭiḥ samākhye kathitā dvitīye prabhūtatoyā kathitā tṛtīye || paścājjalaṃ muñcati yaścaturthaḥ svalpodakaṃ paṃcamamabdamuktam || 56 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 sa0 abdaphalanirdeśo nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 || <1.83> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || uttaraṃ tvayanaṃ divyaṃ paitryaṃ syāddakṣiṇāyanam || vasantaścāgnidaivatyaḥ śākro grīṣma udāhṛtaḥ || 1 || vaiśvadevī tathā prāvṛṭprājāpatyā śaratsmṛtā || hemanto vaiṣṇavaḥ prokto mārutaḥ śiśiraḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 || tvāṣṭraścaitrastu vaiśākho māsaścaivāgnidaivataḥ || jyeṣṭhaśśākrassmṛto māsa āṣāḍho vaiśvadaivataḥ ||3|| śrāvaṇo viśvadaivatya ājo bhādrapadastathā|| aśvayuktāśvino māsa āgneyaḥ kārttikaḥ smṛtaḥ 4||| mārgaśīrṣastathā saumyaḥ pauṣasyājjīvadaivataḥ|| paitryo māsassmṛto māghaḥ phālguno bhagadaivataḥ||5|| māseṣu māsadaivatyā śuklapakṣāḥ prakīrttitāḥ|| vakṣyāmi kṛṣṇapakṣāṇāṃ daivatāni tavānagha || 6 || caitro yāmyassmṛto rājannāgneyaścāpyanantaraḥ || jyeṣṭho raudraḥ smṛtaḥ pakṣastvāṣāḍhaḥ sārpa ucyate || 7 || paitraśca śrāvaṇo māsaḥ sāvitraścāpyanantaraḥ || maitraścāśvayujo māsaḥ śākraścāpyagnidaivataḥ || 8 || tathā ca nairṛtaḥ saumyaḥ pauṣaḥ syādviṣṇudaivataḥ || vāruṇaśca tathā paitraḥ phālgunaḥ pauṣṇa ucyate || 9 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yaddevo yadgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ || agnirarkassmṛtassomo varuṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||1.83.10|| aṅgārakaḥ kumāraśca budhaśca bhagavānhariḥ || bṛhaspatissmṛtaḥ śakraḥ śukro devī ca pārvatī || 11 || prajāpatiśśanaiścāro rāhujñeṃyo gaṇādhipaḥ || viśvakarmā smṛtaḥ keturye grahāste puraḥ smṛtāḥ || 12 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava nakṣatradaivatāḥ || kṛttikā cāgnidaivatyā rohiṇyarkeśvarā smṛtā || 13 || indvarkṣaḥ saumyadaivatyo raudrī ārdrā tathā smṛtā || punarvasustathādityo puṣyaśca gurudaivataḥ || 14 || āśleṣā sarpadaivatyā maghā ca pitṛdaivatā || bhāgyāśca pūrvaphālgunya āryamāśca tathottarāḥ || 15 || sāvitraśca tathā hastaścitrā tvāṣṭrī prakīrtitā || svātiśca vāyudaivatyā nakṣatre parikīrtitā || 16 || indrāgnīdaivatā proktā viśākhā yadunandana || maitramṛkṣamanūrādhā śākraṃ jyeṣṭhā prakīrtitā || 17 || tathā nairṛtyadaivatyo mūlañca tadudāhṛtam || āpyastvāṣāḍhapūrvāḥ syuścottarā vaiśvadaivatāḥ || 18 || brāhmī caivābhijitproktā śravaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ || vāsavaṃ ca tathā ṛkṣaṃ dhaniṣṭhā procyate budhaiḥ || 19 || tathā śatabhiṣakproktaṃ nakṣatre vāruṇaṃ nṛpa || ājaṃ bhadrāpadāpūrvā āhirbudhnyaṃ tathottarā || 1.83.20 || pauṣṇaṃ ca revatī cārkṣamaśvinī cāśvidaivatam || bharaṇyaśca tathā yāmya proktāste ṛkṣadaivatāḥ || 21 || brahmā prajāpatirviṣṇuryamassomastathaiva ca || kumāro munayassapta hyaṣṭau ca manavastathā || 22 || piśācaśca tathā dharmo rudrāścaikādaśa smṛtāḥ || ādityā dvādaśa tathā kāmadevastathaiva ca || 23 || yakṣāśca pitaraścaiva pratipatprabhṛtirnṛpa || tithīśvarāstathā proktā karaṇānnāmataḥ śṛṇu || 24 || tithyardhabhogi karaṇaṃ sadā bhavati pārthiva || sthirāṇi teṣāṃ catvāri sapta viddhi carāṇi ca || 25 || ante kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ dvitīye śakuniḥ smṛtaḥ || prathame pañcadaśyardhe kṛṣṇe proktaṃ catuṣpadam || 26 || tasyaiva cāpare rājannāgākhyaṃ karaṇaṃ matam || śuklapratipadārdhe tu kiṃstughnaṃ karaṇaṃ matam ||27|| etāni rājanproktāni sthirāṇi karaṇāni tu || kalirdharmastathā sarpo yeṣāṃ vāyuśca daivatama||28|| śuklapratipādārdhe tu dvitīye yadunandana||29|| pañcamyāṃ ca tathā hyardhe tvaṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā pare || dvādaśyardhe tathā pūrve paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā pare||1.83.30|| kṛṣṇapakṣacaturthyāṃ tu prathame'rdhe tathaiva ca || saptamyāṃ cāpare tvardhe hyekādaśyāṃ tathādyake||31|| karaṇaṃ tu bavaṃ nāma kathitaṃ śakradaivatam || dvitīyārdhe tathādye tu pañcamyarthe tathā pare || 32 || naktasyardhe tathā pūrve dvādaśyardhe tathā pare || kṛṣṇapratipadādyārdhe caturthyardhe tathā pare||33|| aṣṭamyardhe tathā pūrve hyekādaśyāṃ tathāpare || bālavaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ brahmadaivatam || 34 || śuklapakṣe dvitīyārdhe ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathame tathā || navamyardhe tathaivānte trayodaśyāṃ tathādyake || 35 || kṛṣṇapratipadārdhe tu pañcamyāṃ prathame tathā || dvitīyārdhe tathāṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ prathame tathā ||36|| kaulavaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ mitradaivatam || ādye śuklaṃ tṛtīyārdhe ṣaṣṭhyardhe ca tathā pare || 37 || kṛṣṇadvitīyāprathame pañcamyardhe tathā pare || navamyardhe tathā pūrve dvādaśyardhe tathā pare ||38|| tautilaṃ nāma karaṇamāryamṇaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ || ante śuklatṛtīyārdhe saptamyāṃ prathame tathā||39|| daśamyardhe tathaivānte caturdaśyāṃ tathādyake || kṛṣṇapakṣadvitīyānte ṣaṣṭhyardhe prathame tathā||1.83.40|| navamyāṃ ca tathaivānte trayodaśyāṃ tathādyake|| garābhidhānaṃ karaṇaṃ pṛthivīdaivataṃ smṛtam||41|| śuklapakṣacaturthyardhe saptamyāṃ ca tathā pare || ekādaśyāṃ tathā pūrve caturdaśyāṃ tathā pare || 42 || kṛṣṇatṛtīyāprathame ṣaṣṭhyardhe ca tathā pare || daśamyardhe tathā pūrve trayodaśyāṃ tathā pare || 43 || vaṇijaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ śrīdevamabhidhīyate || śuklapakṣe caturthyante hyaṣṭamyāṃ prathame tathā || 44 || ekādaśyapare cārdhe paurṇamāsyāṃ tathādyake || ante kṛṣṇatṛtīyārdhe saptamyāṃ prathame tathā || 45 || dvitīye ca daśamyardhe caturdaśyāṃ tathādyake|| viṣṭirityeva karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ mṛtyudaivatam || 46 || sarvakarmasu rājendra sarvadā garhitaṃ ca tat || caturviṃśatyahorātre rājanhorāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 47 || graheśadevagandharvanāgayakṣeśvaraprabhāḥ || sūryodayādathārabhya dinapādyāḥ krameṇa tāḥ||48|| ṣaṣṭhakrameṇa ca tathā kramaṃ tāsāṃ nibodha me|| arkaśukrarkṣarātrīśa saurajīvakujeśvarāḥ || 49 || sarvāsāṃ ca tathā kālaṃ rāhurbhuṅkte mahāgrahaḥ || kulikaśca tathā nāgo yakṣaḥ padmo'tiviśrutaḥ || 1.83.50 || aṅgāraparṇaśca tathā gandharvaścābhidhīyate || kulikasya tu yā velā sā varjyā sarvakarmasu || 51 || tasyāṃ bhukte bhavedvyādhirviṣaṃ bhuktaṃ na jīryate || pratyakṣamapi tārkṣyasya tasyāṃ daṣṭo na jīvati || 52 || bhuktaṃ tasyāṃ tu bhaiṣajyaṃ na tu kāryakaraṃ bhavet || sā tu kulividā jñeyā mantriṇā bhiṣajā tathā || 53 || avijñāya tu tāṃ velāṃ trayaste rājapuṅgava || vaiphalyakaraṇānmūḍhāḥ prāpnuvantyayaśo mahat||54|| pratyekasyaiva velāyāṃ rāhorbhāgaṃ nibodha me || ekaikā tu bhaveddhorā sārdhaṃ vighaṭikāśatam ||55|| vināḍikāḥ saptaṣaṣṭyā raveḥ ṣoḍaśa kīrttitāḥ || horākulikavelastu śeṣaḥ kālo ravessmṛtaḥ || 56 || svahorānte tathā velāścatasrastu vināḍikāḥ || rāhoścakrasya kathitāḥ śeṣaḥ kālaḥ sitasya ca ||57|| saumyahorāsamārambha capakau dvau prakīrtitau|| horā kulikavelā tu śeṣaḥ kālo budhasya ca || 58 || ekasaptatimullaṅghya horāyāṃ tu niśābhṛtaḥ || aṣṭau tu kulikasyoktāḥ śeṣaḥ kālo niśābhṛtaḥ || 59 || ṣaḍaśītimatikramya caṣakānravijasya tu || yaccheṣastadvinirdiṣṭaḥ kālastu kulikasya ca || 1.83.60 || saptasaptatyatikramya sārdhāṃstu caṣakāngurau || rāhostu caṣako horā śeṣakālo gurormataḥ ||61|| bhaumahorāsamārambhe dvātriṃśattu vināḍikāḥ || velā tu kulikasyoktā śeṣaḥ kālaḥ kujasya tu || 62 || jīvajñaśukrahorāsu sarvakarmāṇi kārayet || krūrāsu ca tathānyāsu na kiñcitkulikasya ca || 63 || ataḥ paraṃ muhūrtānāṃ daivatāni nibodha me || sarvarkṣāṇi vivartante hyahorātreṇa pārthiva ||64|| satataṃ te vinirdiṣṭā muhurtāstriṃśadeva tu || vajra uvāca || aṣṭāviṃśatiruktāni tvayā tāni mamānagha || 65 || triṃśanmuhūrtāśca kathaṃ ta eva dvijasattama || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dinarātryossamāraṃbhe hyardhaṃ bhavati pārthiva || 66 || tayormadhye ca satatamabhijiccābhidhīyate || tayordvitvānmayā triṃśanmuhūrtā vihitāstava || 67 || nakṣatrairdaivataisteṣāṃ devatāḥ parikīrttitāḥ || kevalaṃ kramahāniśca kramasteṣāṃ nibodha me || 68 || raudrassārpastathā maitraḥ paitro vāsava eva ca || āpyo vaiśvastathā rājankeśvaraḥ śakradaivataḥ || 69 || aindrāgneyau nairṛtastu vāruṇaśca mahīpate || āryamṇastu tathā bhogyo muhūrttāstu divācarāḥ || 1.83.70 || raudrā'jadevohirbudhnyāḥ pauṣṇaścāśvina eva ca|| yāmyo'gnidaivataścaiva brāhmassaumyastathaiva ca || 71 || ādityo jīvadaivatyo vaiṣṇavaḥ sūryadaivataḥ || tvāṣṭraścaivātha vāyavyoḥ muhūrtā rātricāriṇaḥ || 72 || ahnaḥ pañcadaśo bhāgo rātreśca yadunandana || muhūrtasaṃjñaḥ kathito munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || 73 || mahākalyādathārabhya kālāvayavadaivatāḥ || uktāstava muhūrtāśca teṣāṃ kāle svake'rcanam || 74 || mahāphalaṃ hi nidiṣṭaṃ syādviyoge viśeṣataḥ || svakāle devatāḥ pūjyāḥ sopacārairviśeṣataḥ || tasyāssakāśāddharmajña kāmayadbhirmahatphalam || 75 || kāle svake yaḥ prayatastu bhaktyā devānyathāvatsamupaiti rājan || saparyayā tasya diśanti devāḥ phalānabhīṣṭānnṛṣu lohitākṣa ||76|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 kālāvayavadaivatānāṃ māhātmyavarṇano nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 || <1.84> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || lagnāni dvādaśoktāni dinarātreṇa nityaśaḥ || yatrādityaḥ sthito rāśau tadādyāni narādhipa || 1 || meṣo vṛṣotha mithunaḥ kulīrassiṃha eva ca || kanyā tulā tathā kīṭo dhanvī makara eva ca || 2 || kumbho mīnaśca rājendra lagnā dvādaśa kīrttitāḥ || kujaśśukro budhaścandraḥ sūryaścāndrissitastathā || 3 || bhaumo jīvaśca sauraśca śanirjīvistathaiva ca || meṣādīnāṃ krameṇoktāḥ prabhāvaḥ pṛthivīpate ||4 || lagrasyārdhaṃ smṛtā horā tayorviṣamarāśiṣu || ādityacandrau candrārkāvīśvarau samarāśiṣu || 5 || lagnatribhāgo dreṣkāṇaḥ kramātteṣāṃ tatheśvarāḥ || lagneśaḥ paṃcameśaśca navameśastathaiva ca ||6|| meṣādyāḥ kathitā nityaṃ meṣasiṃhadhanurdharāḥ || makarādyāstathā proktā vṛṣakanyāmṛgāstathā||7|| tulādyā mithunastaulī kumbhaśca vasudhādhipa || kulīrādyāḥ kulīraśca kīṭo mīnastathaiva ca ||8|| ādyuktarāśiprabhṛti gaṇanīyā navāṃśakāḥ|| rāśīnāṃ tu yathoktānāṃ kramānnava naveśvarāḥ || 9 || svarāśitastathārabhya krameṇaiva naveśvarāḥ || rāśīśvareśvarāḥ proktā rāśīnāṃ dvādaśāṃśakāḥ || 1.84.10 || paṃca bhaumasya saurasya paṃca triṃśāṃśakā matāḥ || jīvasyāṣṭau vinirdiṣṭāḥ sapta proktā budhasya tu || 11 || śukrasyoktāstathā pañca rāśau viṣama saṃjñake || ādyāstu pañca śukrasya tatassapta budhasya ca || 12 || jīvasyāṣṭau tathā proktāḥ pañca saurasya cāpyatha || kujasya tu tathā pañca rāśau tu samasaṃkhyake || 13 || lagnaṃ ca horā ca tathā drikāṇaṃ navāṃśakaṃ dvādaśabhāgasaṃjñam || triṃśāṃśakaṃ cāpyatha ṣaṣṭhamatra ṣaḍbhedamāhurmunayaśca lagnam || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 sa0 ṣaḍ lagnavarṇano nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||84|| <1.85> vajra uvāca || śubho vāpyaśubho vāpi kathaṃ kālo mahītale || jñāyate bhārgavaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kṛttikā yāmyavāyavye nāgavīthyuttarottare || gajavīthīhyudaṅmadhye prājāpatyādayastrayaḥ ||2|| airāvaṇe hyudagbhāge ahorātracatuṣṭayam|| madhye vare tathā vīthī phalgunī ṛkṣayordvayoḥ ||3 || madhyemadhye tu govīthī ajādyaṃ bhacatuṣṭayam || madhyayāme jaradgaḥ syāttritayaṃ śravaṇādikam || 4 || yāmyottareṇa tu mṛgā hastacitre prakīrtite || ajādakṣiṇamadhye tu viśākhā maitrayossmṛtāḥ ||5|| āvikāyāmyayāmye tu śakrādyaṃ bhacatuṣṭayam || vaiśvānarapathaṃ prāhustamevātyantadāruṇam ||6|| udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca cāreṇa ca tathā grahāḥ || uttarāsu śubhāḥ proktā dakṣiṇāstvaśubhāvahāḥ ||7|| suprabhāraśmimantaśca nāgavīthyāṃ yadā grahāḥ || na tadasti śubhaṃ loke yatra paśyanti mānavāḥ || 8 || viraśmayo vivarṇāśca vaiśvānarapathāśritāḥ || na tadasti śubhaṃ rāma yanna kuryurjagattraye || 9 || rohiṇīśakaṭaṃ bhindyurgrahā yadi bhavettadā || nāśaḥ prajānāṃ kūraśca viśeṣeṇātra lakṣyate||1.85.10|| saurārasūryāḥ krūrāstu tathā kṣīṇaśca candramāḥ|| kūrairyukto budhaścaiva rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca||11|| śeṣāssaumyagrahāḥ proktā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || rohiṇī kṛttikā pitryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ maitrameva ca||12|| pīḍayanto grahā hanyurdiśaṃ varuṇapālitām|| pūrvasyāṃ diśi dṛśyante sarvatārāgrahā yadi || 13 || prācyānāṃ tu tadā rājñāṃ bhavetpīḍā sudāruṇā || madhye ca yadi dṛśyante madhyadeśanivāsi nām || 14 || vāruṇyāṃ yadi dṛśyaṃte tāṃ diśaṃ pīḍayanti ca || hīnādhikaṃ carantaśca vyabhre vā'darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||15|| dhūmāyanto jvalanto vā vedayanti mahadbhayam || ekāntaritanakṣatragatāḥ syuścedgrahā divi || 16|| mālānāma bhavedyogo madhyadeśakṣitīśahā || prāsaścakraṃ dhanurvajraṃ sasyānāṃ kṣudravṛṣṭidāḥ || || 17|| grahā bhayāvahā nityaṃ śṛṅgāṭakapurogamāḥ || bhaveyurekarkṣagatāstribhirūrddhvaṃ yadā grahāḥ || 18|| vināśāyaiva lokānāṃ vijñeyāssumahīkṣitām || ekena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ grahābhyāṃ sahito guruḥ || 19 || śanaiścaro vā dṛśyeta tadā durbhikṣamādiśet || citrāyāṃ lohito yatra mūle devagurustathā || || 1.85.20 || bhārgavaśca śraviṣṭhāsu tadā ghoraṃ bhayaṃ bhavet || kṛttikāsu śanaiścārī viśākhāsu bṛhaspatiḥ || 21 || sthitau prajānāṃ pīḍāyai vṛṣṭimantardivaṃ bhavet || prāgdvāreṣu caranbheṣu sauro vakrabhiyādyadi || 22 || pṛthivīṃ pīḍayetsarvāṃ pūrvadeśaṃ viśeṣata || raudre haste tathaivāpye āhirbudhnye śanaiścaraḥ || 23 || yadodayaṃ prapadyeta tadā naśyanti pārthivāḥ || saumye tvāṣṭre śraviṣṭhāsu sthite saurai mahīkṣitaḥ || 24 || sarvapīḍāṃ samarhanti yayā yānti yamāntikam || pūrvāṃ parāśāṃ saṃprāpto bhṛgujīvau parasparam || 25 || saptamarkṣagatau syātāṃ tadatra devo na varṣati || aparvaṇi śaśāṅkārkau tvaṣṭānāma mahāgrahaḥ || 26 || āvṛṇoti tamaḥ śyāmaḥ sarvalokavipattaye || udayāstamaye bhānoścandrasya ca yadā bhavet || 27 || pariveṣastadā rājā kṣipraṃ vadhamavāpnuyāt || sakalaṃ cedahassūyo rātriṃ cetsakalāṃ śaśī || 28 || pariveṣī bhavedrājā tatrāpi vadhamarhati || dvisūrye gagane vṛddhiṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ vinirdiśet || 29 || dvicandre brāhmaṇānāṃ tu cādhikyaṃ pralayāya tu || udayāstamayau yatra somārkau raktamaṇḍalau || 1.85.30 || na cātrābhrāṇi dṛśyante tanmahābhayalakṣaṇam || candramā janmanakṣatraṃ parityajati yasya tu || 31 || śyāvo rūkṣopasavyaṃ tu tasya vidyādupadravam || atyantā darśane rāhostathā cātyantadarśane || 32 || prajāpīḍā vinirdeśyā vyādhidurbhikṣataskaraiḥ || yannakṣatragato rāhurgrasate candrabhāskarau || 33 || tajjātānāṃ bhavetpīḍā ye narāśśāntivarjitāḥ || grahopasṛṣṭe nakṣatre grahaṇaṃ tu yadā bhavet || 34 || tadā pīḍā vinirdeśyā sainikānāṃ nṛpaissaha || gṛhīto rāhuṇā candraḥ sūryo vā gaganāccyutaḥ || 35 || ulkāni hanyāttatrānyo rājā rājyaṃ kariṣyati || gṛhītau pariveṣe tau yadā candradivākarau||36|| samantātpīḍyate deśaḥ śastrakopaśca jāyate || meghaissaṃchādyate rāhustvativarṣati vā yadā || 37 || akālajaistadā rājño bhayaṃ vidyādupasthitam || yanna kṣatrāgate sūrye chidraṃ vai saṃprapadyate || 38 || tajjātaḥ pārthivaḥ kṣipraṃ yamalokaṃ gamiṣyati || tāmrakuṅkumarūkṣābho ghṛtahāridrasannibhaḥ || 39 || bandhujīvanibho bhānuḥ śiśirādyeṣu śasyate || asvacchavarṇaḥ paruṣo vepanaḥ khaṇḍamaṇḍalaḥ ||1.85.40|| sacchidre rajasā dhvasta ulkādyupahatopi vā || maṇḍalādanyasaṃsthānaṃ meghaiścāyudhasannibhaiḥ||41|| udayāstamaye cchannaḥ pārthivānāṃ na śasyate|| pakṣādau cāpasaṃsthāne yuddhaṃ śaśini nirdiśet||42|| lābhasteṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ yatra dṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ tataḥ || samakoṭiviśālaśca kiṃcidvāpyuttaronnataḥ || 43 || māsādau candramāḥ śasto vāma eva viparyayaḥ || maṇḍalenāntarīkurvañśṛṅge sā yadi vā spṛśet || 44 || tārāgrahaṃ tadā kuryādbhayaṃ janapade śaśī || śuklapakṣasya yā vṛddhirloke kṣemasubhikṣadā||45 || sā sitetarapakṣasya pṛthivyāṃ naiva gamyate || śravaṇebhyudito bhaumaḥ puṣye vakramiyādyadi || 46 || prājāpatyuditaścandro nāśāya syānmahīkṣitāma || gatāgataṃ yadā kuryānmaghāmadhyena lohitaḥ|| 47 || tadā bhavatyanāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṇḍyo rājā vinaśyati || phalgunyorudayaṃ kṛtvā vakraḥ syādvaiśvadaivake||48|| prajāpatye pravāsaśca trailokyaṃ tatra pīḍyate || dhruveṣu vaiṣṇave mūle śākre ca vicarankujaḥ || 49 || ghorāṃ karotyanāvṛṣṭiṃ kṛttikāsu maghāsu ca || kārttike'śvayuje pauṣe cāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe budhaḥ ||1.85.50|| dṛṣṭo loke bhayāya syānmāghavaiśākhayostathā || akasmādyatra dṛśyeta divā devapurohitaḥ||51|| rājā vā mriyate tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati || ahassarvaṃ yadā śukro dṛśyate'tha mahāgrahaḥ || 52 || tadā tvagnyādibhirgrāmānbādhate nagarāṇi ca || kārttike tu yadā māsi kurvāte'stamayādayau || 53 || tadahnāṃ navati pūrṇaṃ bhuvi devo na varṣati || śanaiścaro deśapīḍāṃ deśanakṣatrapīḍane || 54 || dhruvaṃ karoti rājendra nityaṃ cāravaśena tu || saptāhāntargatā ye vai divyapārthivanābhasāḥ || grahoparāge tīvrāssyurutpātāḥ svaphaleṣu te || 55 || ekasminyadi māse syādgrahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ || brahmakṣatravirodhāya viparītavivṛddhaye || 56 || yasmindṛśyeta nakṣatre viśākhāyāṃ pradhūpavat || taddeśajātā pīḍā syādbudhaketumahāgrahāḥ || 57 || ulkādyabhihate sūrye ketubhirvā vidhūmite || agastye vā dhruve vāpi prajāpīḍāṃ vinirdiśeta || 58 || ulkayābhihatā rūkṣā sphuraṇā rajasā yutāḥ || ṛṣayassapta lokānāṃ vināśāya ca bhūbhṛtām || 59 || kṛttikābhissahodeti śāṃkarī diśamāśritaḥ || kumārīprītito hanyālloke nṛpakumārakān || 1.85.60 || samāgame grahāṇāṃ tu candramāḥ śasyate hyudak || nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca rājendra dakṣiṇena na śasyate || 61 || rāhuḥ ketuḥ kujaḥ śakraścandreṇa sahayāyinaḥ || budho jīvaśca sauraśca nāgarā raviṇā saha||62|| yāyinā vijite paure rājñāṃ syādyāyināṃ jayaḥ || yāyigrahe paurajite purā rājñāṃ jayo mṛdhe || 63 || paureṇa vijite paure pauraiḥ paurakṣayaṃ vadet || yāyinā yāyini hate yāyibhyo yāyināṃ kṣayaḥ || 64 || grahāṇāṃ cedbhavetsāmyaṃ sāmyaṃ rājñāṃ vinirdiśet || jayājayau narendrāṇāṃ nirdeśyo grahavadbudhaiḥ || 65 || grahārūḍhaścyutassthānātsphureṇa vijito grahaḥ || vijito jayaliṅgaiśca kṛṣṇaḥ śyāmadyutistathā || 66 || udaṅmārgagatiḥ snigdho vimalo vimalaprabhaḥ || bṛhadrūpotiśukraśca vijayī kathito grahaḥ || 67 || na deyametaccapalasya loke na nāstikasyādhamapūruṣasya || guhyaṃ munīnāmapi pārthivendra mayeritaṃ kālaviniścayaṃ te||68|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 grahaśubhāśubhaparijñānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśī titamoyāyaḥ || 85 || <1.86> vajra uvāca || pratideśaṃ mahābhāga kathaṃ prāptamupadravam || vijñāyate dvijaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kṛttikāṃ rohiṇīṃ saumyaṃ madhyadeśasya nirdiśet || pīḍite tritaye'tasminmadhyadeśaḥ prapīḍyate || 2 || ārdrāṃ punarvasuṃ puṣyaṃ pūrvadeśasya nirdiśet || pīḍite tritaye tasminpūrvadeśaḥ prapīḍyate || 3 || āśleṣāṃ tu maghāṃ pūrvāṃ cāgneyyāṃ diśi nirdiśet || pīḍite tritaye tasminnāgneyī pīḍyate'tha dik || 4 || āryamṇamatha hastaṃ ca tvāṣṭraṃ syāddiśi dakṣiṇe || pīḍite tritaye tasminpīḍyate dakṣiṇā ca dik || 5 || svātiṃ viśākhāṃ maitraṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ diśi nirdiśet | pīḍite tritaye tasminpīḍyate nairṛtī ca dik || 6 || vāyavyāṃ diśi nirdiṣṭā vaiśvavaiṣṇavavāsavāḥ | pīḍite tritaye tasminvāyavī pīḍyate ca dik || 7 || vāruṇaṃ cājadaivatyaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ tathottare || pīḍite tritaye tasminnuttarā dikprapīḍyate || 8 || revatī cāśvinī yāmyamaiśānī dik prapīḍitā || pīḍite tritaye tasminnīśānī dik prapīḍyate || 9 || ādityo bhṛgujo bhaumo rāhussauro niśākaraḥ || budho bṛhaspatiścaiva prācyādīśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || || 1.86.10 || vidhvastavapuṣaste ca grahayuddhe parājitāḥ || nīcāḥ pitṛgṛhasthāśca svāṃ diśaṃ pīḍayanti te || 11 || vajra uvāca || svadeśapīḍanaṃ kuryānnakṣatraḥ pīḍitaḥ katham || sarvametanmamācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 12 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śanaiścarārkau cāreṇa vakreṇāṅgārako grahaḥ || uparāgeṇa rāhuśca ketuścādhūmanodayaiḥ || 13 || udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca jīvaśukraśaśāṅkajāḥ || saṃcchādanena ca śaśī hyagastyaścaiva yogataḥ || 14 ||| tathā yasmim̐śca nakṣatre divyapārthivanābhasāḥ || dṛśyante tu mahotpātāḥ svāṃ diśaṃ saṃprapīḍayet || 15 || deśeṣu sarveṣu mayeritaṃ te śubhāśubhaṃ yādava mukhyanātha || ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan ||16|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 pratideśapīḍāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītamo'dhyāyaḥ ||86 || <1.87> || vajra uvāca || śubhāśubhaparijñānaṃ bhagavanpuruṣaṃ prati || tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| janmāśritastriṣaṣṭhaśca saptamo daśamastathā || ekādaśaḥ śaśī yeṣāṃ tadā teṣāṃ śubhaṃ bhavet||2|| janmanyatha caturthe ca sāṣṭame daśame tathā || ekādeśe budho yeṣāṃ teṣāmapi śubhaṃ vadet || 3 || dvipañcamagato jīvassaptamo navamastathā || ekādaśastathā hyeṣāṃ teṣāmapi śubhaṃ vadet|| || 4 || ṣaṣṭhasaptamagaḥ śukro daśame na ca śobhanaḥ || dvādaśaśca tathā hyeṣāṃ teṣāṃ pīḍāṃ vinirdiśet || 5 || tṛtīye daśame ṣaṣṭhe tathā caikādaśe śubhā || saurāratīkṣṇakiraṇā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ śubhaṃ vadet || 6 || yasminhi jananaṃ yasya janmarkṣaṃ tasya tatsmṛtam || caturthaṃ mānasaṃ tasmāddaśamaṃ karmasaṃjñitam || 7 || saṃgātakaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ syādviṃśaṃ syātsāmudāyikam || vaināśakaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ karmarkṣaṃ yattrayodaśam || 8 ||| ṣaṇṇakṣatrastu puruṣassarvaḥ prokto mahīpate || rājā ca navanakṣatro nakṣatratritayaṃ śṛṇu || 9 || nityamabhyadhikaṃ ṣaḍbhyaḥ pārthivasya nṛpottama ||| deśābhiṣekanakṣatrau jātinakṣatrameva ca || 1.87.10 || jātyāśritāni vakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇi tavānagha || pūrvātrayamathāgneyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prakīrtitam || 11 ||| uttarātritayaṃ puṣyaṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ prakīrttitam || pauṣṇaṃ maitraṃ tathā pitryaṃ prājāpatyaṃ viśāṃ smṛtam || 12 || ādityamāśvinaṃ hastaḥ śūdrāṇāmabhijittathā || sārpaṃ viśākhā yāmyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ ca narādhipa || 13 || pratilomabhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitam || īhāde hyarthahānissyājjanmarkṣe copatāpite || 14 || karmarkṣe karmaṇāṃ hāniḥ pīḍā manasi mānase || mūrttidraviṇabandhūnāṃ hānissaṃghātike hate || 15 || saṃtapte sāmudāyarkṣe mitrabhṛtyārthasaṃkṣayaḥ || vaināśike vināśassyāddehadraviṇasaṃpadām || 16 || pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe rājyabhraṃśaṃ vinirdiśet || deśarkṣe pīḍite pīḍāṃ deśasya ca purasya ca || 17 || pīḍite jātinakṣatre rājño vyādhiṃ vinirdiśet || 18 || graharkṣajātā samavāpya pīḍāṃ pūjā tu kāryā vidhinā svakena || tataśśubhaṃ vindati rājasiṃha vidhūtapāpaḥ puruṣassadaiva ||15 iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0pratipuruṣaśubhāśubhanirdeśonāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87 || <1.88> vajra uvāca || grahāṇāṃ bhṛguśārdūla nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || pūjane vidhimācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || grahassādhipatiḥ kāryo nityaṃ maṇḍalake budhaiḥ || nakṣatraścandrasahitastathā sādhipatirnṛpa || 2 || saṃkhyātā tārakāstasya yathāvanmanujeśvara || teṣāṃ tārakasaṃkhyānaṃ nibodha gadato mama || 3 || raudraṃ puṣyaṃ tathā tvāṣṭraṃ vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā || pauṣṇaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha kathitaṃ tvekatārakam||4|| dvitāraṃ phalgunīyugmaṃ tathā bhādrapadādvayam|| ādityaṃ ca tathā mūlaṃ caindrāgnaṃ cāśvinaṃ tathā||5|| tritāraṃ bharaṇī saumyamaindraṃ brāhmaṃ savaiṣṇavam || catustāramathāṣāḍhe dve maitraṃ yadunandana || 6 || pañcatāraḥ smṛto hastaḥ prājāpatyaṃ ca vāsavam || sārpaṃ pitryamathāgneyaṃ ṣaṭtāraṃ parikīrtitam || 7 || ādityamaṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmavarṇaṃ narādhipa || śvetaṃ candramasaḥ kāryaṃ raktaṃ kāryaṃ kujasya ca || 8 || nīlaṃ budhasya karttavyaṃ pītavarṇaṃ bṛhaspateḥ || śvetaṃ śukrasya karttavyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saurasya pārthiva || 9 || ākāśavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ ketordhūmaprabhaṃ tathā || raktavarṇaṃ kṛttikānāṃ phalgunīdvitayasya ca || 1.88.10 || hastasya ca sapauṣṇasya maitrasya ca narādhipa || pītaṃ puṣyasya keśasya śākravāḍavayostathā || 11 || śvetaṃ saumyasya raudrasya āpyavāruṇayostathā || ādityasārpapitryāṇāṃ brāhmavāyavyayostathā || 12 || proṣṭhapādadvayasyātha śvetamevābhidhīyate || vicitravarṇaṃ tvāṣṭrasya vaiśvadevasya cāpyatha || 13 || āśvinasya tathā kāryaṃ nityameva narādhipa || kṛṣṇaṃ yāmyasya mūlasya pālāśaṃ śravaṇasya ca || 14 || viśākhāyāṃ pītaraktaṃ karttavyaṃ nṛpamaṇḍalam ||15|| yathoktavarṇena narendra kṛtvā pūrvaṃ grahasyānagha maṇḍalaṃ svam || ṛkṣasya vā pūjyatamasya rājanpūjā vidheyā tadanantaraṃ ca || 16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṃḍe mā0sa0 graharkṣamaṇḍalanirdeśonāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||88|| <1.89> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śakṛnmūtraṃ tu saṃgṛhya śvetasya vṛṣabhasya ca || śvetagoḥ payasā sārdhaṃ snātavyaṃ kuśavāriṇā ||1 || janmanakṣatrapīḍāyāṃ tasmāddoṣā dvimucyate || śirīṣacandanāśvatthatāṭanāgāmbubhirnaraḥ || 2 || snānaścenmānase tapte tasmāddoṣo vimucyate || siddhārthakānpriyaṅguṃ ca śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm || 3 || snātavyamambhasi kṣiptvā karmarkṣe nṛpa pīḍite || priyaṅgubilvasiddhārthayavāśvatthasurāhvayān || 4 ||| candanodakasaṃyukte snāne sāṃghātike hate || sarvagandhodakaiḥ snānaṃ tathā siddhārthakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 5 || pīḍite sāmudāyarkṣe puṃsāṃ kalmaṣanāśanam || vṛṣaśṛṅgoddhṛtamṛdā tathā bilvodakaiśśubhaiḥ || 6|| śatapuṣpāsasomāhvaiḥ snānaṃ vaināśike bhavet || pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe sarvaratnodakaistathā || 7 ||| pīḍite deśanakṣatre mṛdbhissnānaṃ vidhīyate || mṛttikāśca pravakṣyāmi gadataḥ śṛṇu me nṛpa || 8 || nadīkūladvayānmadhyātsaṃgamātsarasastaṭāt || aśva sthānādgajasthānādgosthānādgirimastakāt || 9 || sarpasthānātsavalmīkādrājasthānādvarālayāt || gajaśṛṅgoddhṛtāṃ caiva vṛṣaśṛṅgoddhṛtāṃ tathā||1.89.10||| sarvabījodakasnāto jātinakṣatrapīḍane || mucyate kilbiṣādrājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 11 || idamāpaḥ pravahataḥ snānamantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||12|| snātastathaivaṃ nṛpacandra paścātsnānaṃ prakurvīta grahopadiṣṭam || pīḍākarasyātha tatastu kāryaṃ nakṣatrayāgābhihitaṃ yathāvat || 13 || pūjā grahendrasya narendracandra pīḍākarasyātha tatastu kāryā || taṃ pūjayeccāpyatha candrayuktaṃ tataḥ sa doṣānsakalāñjahāti | | 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā 0 saṃ0 nakṣatrasnānaṃ nāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 89 || <1.90> || vajra uvāca || grahāṇāṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || pūjāvidhimahaṃ tvattaḥ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || grahaṃ vāpyatha nakṣatraṃ yaṃ pūjayitumicchati | | upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā kṛtvā tasyātha maṇḍalam||2|| maṇḍale kalpitaṃ vāpi svayaṃ daivavidā nṛpa || pūjyasnānena vidhivatsnātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 3 || vidhinopasamādāya prayato jātavedasam || atha vopasamādāne kṛte tatra purodhasā || 4 || prāktantre ca kṛte tatra cakṣuṣpatre yathāvidhi || maṇḍalātpaścime bhāge prāṅmukhaḥ prayataśśuciḥ || 5 || maṇḍalasya tu śaucārthaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet || abhyukṣya pañcagavyena maṇḍalaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ || 6 | | arghyādikalpanāṃ kuryātpādyāntāṃ tadanantaram || jīvādānaṃ tataḥ kuryājjīvasyāvāhanaṃ tataḥ || 7 || pūjyasyāvāhanaṃ kuryāttato'rghyaṃ vinivedayet || pādyaṃ nivedayetpaścādāsanaṃ ca nivedayet || 8 || dattvaivācamanīyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ nivedayet || tato'nulepanaṃ dadyāttato dadyādvibhūṣaṇam | | 9 || tato yajñopavītaṃ ca tataḥ pratisarāñśubhān || vastraṃ tathā patākāṃ ca puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ tathaiva ca || 1.90.10 || dīpaṃ ca dattvā naivedyaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca pārthiva || tato'gnihavanaṃ kuryādyasya yasya yathā bhavet || 11 || kṛtvaivottaratantraṃ ca dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ || taduktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇḍale pratipādayet || 12 || hoturvastrayugaṃ deyaṃ gaussuvarṇaṃ tathaiva ca || grāhyaṃ kālavidā tacca yaddattaṃ grahamaṇḍale || 13 || yathāśakti ca dātavyā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dakṣiṇā || visarjanaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ tato brāhmaṇabhojanam || || 14 | | bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu pramārṣṭirmaṇḍale bhavet | | arghyapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ jale prakṣipya pārthiva || 15 || ambunā tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūjā syāttadanantaram|| 16 || pūjāvidhiste gadito mayādya samāsataḥ pārthivasaṃghamukhya | | ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvākhilarājasiṃha || || 17 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ 0 graharkṣapūjāvidhivarṇanaṃ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ | | 9 0 || <1.91> vajra uvāca || grahāṇāṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha nakṣatrāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || snānāni śrotumicchāmi tatpīḍāśamanānyaham || 1 | | mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || mañjiṣṭhāṃ mātuluṃgaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ raktacandanam || pūrṇakumbhe kṛte tāmre sūryasnānaṃ vidhīyate || 2 | | uśīraṃ ca śirīṣaṃ ca padmakaṃ candanaṃ tathā || śaṃkhe nyastamidaṃ snānaṃ candradoṣanivāraṇam || | | 3 || khadiraṃ devadāruṃ ca tilānyāmalakāni ca | | pūrṇakumbhe kṛte raupye bhaumapīḍāvināśanam || 4 || nadīsaṃgamatoyāni tanmṛdā sahitāni ca || nyastāni kumbhe māhīye budhapīḍāvināśanam || 5 || gorocanaṃ nāgamadaṃ śatapuṣpā śatāvarī || vinyasya rājate kumbhe śukrapīḍānivāraṇam || 6 || tilānmāṣānpriyaṃguṃ ca gandhapatraṃ tathaiva ca || nyastaṃ kārṣṇāyase kumbhe saurapīḍānivāraṇam || 7 || gugguluṃ hiṃgulaṃ tālaṃ śubhāṃ caiva manaḥśilām || śṛṃge ca māhiṣe nyastaṃ rāhupīḍāvināśanam || 8 || varāhanirhṛtāṃ rājanparvatāgramṛdaṃ tathā || chāgaṃ kṣīraṃ khaḍgapātre ketupīḍāvināśanam || 9 || grahasnānamidaṃ proktamṛkṣasnānamataḥ śṛṇu || yena samyakprayuktena mucyate kilviṣānnaraḥ || || 1.91.10 || vaṭāśvatthaśirīṣāṇāṃ patrāṇi tu tilaissaha || sarvagandhopapannāni kṛttikāsu vidhīyate || 11 || sarvabījodakasnānaṃ rohiṇīṣu praśasyate || sarvaratnodakasnānaṃ mṛgaśīrṣe vidhīyate || 12 || vacā ca gandhā kāntābhiḥ snānaṃ raudre prakīrtitam || goṣṭhamṛdgomayasnānamāditye pāpanāśanam || 13 || sarvauṣadhyaḥ pañcagavyaṃ tathā gaurāśca śālayaḥ || siddhārthakāssarvagandhāṃstiṣyasnāne śubhapradāḥ || 14 || valmīkāgramṛdā snānaṃ tathā sārpe śubhapradam || satilaṃ devanirmālyaṃ snānaṃ śastaṃ maghāsu ca || 15 || phalgunīṣu ca pūrvāsu śāḍvalaṃ lavaṇaṃ ghṛtam || uttarāsu tathā snānaṃ śimbimustāpriyaṃgubhiḥ || 16 || haste snānaṃ praśaṃsanti parvatāgrasaromṛdā || citrāsu devanirmālyaṃ svātau puṣpairjalodbhavaiḥ || 17 || viśākhāsu praśaṃsanti raudracandanapadmakaiḥ || nadīkūladvayānmṛdbhirmaitre snānaṃ prakīrtitam || 18 || jyeṣṭhodakena jyeṣṭhāsu suvarṇasahitaṃ hitam || sarvamūlajalaiḥ snānamāpye muktāphalodakaiḥ || 19 || vaiśvadeve praśaṃsanti padmakośīracandanaiḥ || sarvauṣadhaiścābhijiti śravaṇe saṃgamodakaiḥ || 1.91.20 || nadīvāpījalayutairvāruṇe tu praśasyate || āje śrīvāsakaṃ snānaṃ kāntā puruhitaṃ hitam || 21 || āhirbudhnye tathā snānaṃ padmakośīracandanaiḥ || kuṅkumāgurukarpūraiḥ sahitaṃ pāpanāśanam || darbhermūlayutaiḥ pauṣṇe haridrādvayacandanaiḥ || 22 || nāgāśvagandhā madavantikā ca kṣaudrānvitā cāśvinake pradiṣṭā || surāhva kāṣṭhaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca snānaṃ vacābhiḥ sahitaṃ ca yāmyam || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 grahanakṣatrasnānavidhivarṇanaṃ nāmaika navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 || || cha || <1.92> || vajra uvāca || || prāktantrottaratantrau dvau sarveṣāmagnikarmaṇām || tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || uddhṛtyorvīmayīṃ śuddhe deśe vediṃ ca kārayet || prāgudakpravaṇāṃ śuddhāmāyāmātpadasaptakam || 2 || pūrvabhāge ca vijñeyā vistarātpadapañcakam || paścime ca tathā bhāge vistarātsyāccatuṣṭayam || 3 || āgāradeśe ca tathā vistṛtā sā padatrayam || pūrvabhāgādatikramya paścātpadacatuṣṭayam || 4 || yāmyenottarataścaiva vijñeyaṃ tu padaṃ padam || āgārātpaścime bhāge vedī jñeyā padadvayam || 5 || vedimevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā snātvācamya prayatnataḥ || sauvarṇānrājatām̐stāmrānathavāpi mahīmayān || 6 || sūtrārghyamālyairgandhaiśca saphalaiḥ pallavairyutān || pūrṇodakumbhāṃścaturo vidikṣu sudṛḍhaṃ nyaset || 7 || vedyāmullikhanaṃ kāryamaindrībhirnṛpasattama || udumbarasya śākhābhiḥ prāgagrābhiḥ samantataḥ || 8 || śuṣkendhanasamṛddhastu tataḥ kāryyo hutāśanaḥ || na dhamettālavṛntena na śūrpeṇa na vāsasā || 9 || mukhenopadhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata || parisamuhya paryukṣya pariṣicya paristaret || 1.92.10 || hutāśanaṃ bodhayitvā bhūyaścāvāhayedbudhaḥ || vakṣyāmi bodhane mantraṃ tathā cāvāhane nṛpa || 11 || udbuddhyāgne bodhayanti devatāstāssavāsavāḥ || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skando vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ || 12 || varuṇo vāyurākāśaṃ candrādityau prabhākarau || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstrailokyāmaladarśanāḥ || 13 || vedāśca vedamātā ca sāvitrī pāpanāśinī || oṣadhyo'tha vaṣaṭkāro mantrāśca vividhāstathā || 14 || kālasyāvayavāssarve diśaśca vidiśastathā || udabuddhya yajamānasya sarvānkāmānprayaccha vai || 15 || omāvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ hutāśanam || jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam || 16 || vedamūrtiṃ tadādhāraṃ sarvadevamukhaṃ vibhum || piṅgekṣaṇaṃ piṅgajaṭaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum || 17 || śukayānagamaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || sarvagaṃ varadaṃ bhānuṃ jaṭharasthaṃ ca dehinām || 18 || tejomūrttiṃ durādharṣaṃ saptajihvaṃ mahābalam || saptārciṣaṃ saptarṣikaṃ ca samitsaptakamacyutam || 19 || viṣṇoraṃśamanirdeśyaṃ bhāvanaṃ jātavedasam || pāvanaṃ puṣṭidaṃ saumyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhūtivardhanam || 1.92.20 || taddattamāhutigaṇaṃ saṃpratīccha jagadguro || tena bhāvaya deveśa yathāhaṃ devatāgaṇān || 21 || yājakaṃ yajamānaṃ ca puṣṭyā vibhaja sarvaśaḥ || idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pragṛhyatām || 22 || evamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā pādyārghyaṃ vinivedayet || vedyāmeva na tau deyau vahnau yadukulodvaha || 23 || gandhapuṣpādikaṃ deyaṃ sakalañjātavedasi || dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sanaivaidyaṃ vedyāmeva nivedayet || 24 || tatastu prastaredvedimakṣatāgraiḥ kuśairdvija || upamūlādadholūnaiḥ prāgagraiḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ || 25 || pūrve ca prāgdakṣiṇataḥ paścāccaivāpasavyataḥ || uttareṇa tataḥ kuryātprastarasya samāpanam || 26 || mūlacchinnantu dātavyaṃ prastare bhūbhṛtāṃ vara || oṣadhyaḥ phalavantyaśca parvavatyastathaiva ca || 27 || darbhābhāve praśaṃsanti tisrastatra ca varjayet || rājasīravarūkaṃ ca paribādhamathotkaṭam || 28 || viṣṇurmanasā pūte sto mantreṇānena suvrata || dārbhaṃ pavitramutsajya tābhyāṃ ca tadanantaram || 29 || devova ityathaitena utpūyamudakaṃ śuci || sruksruvāvatha pālāśau śamīnyagrodhasaṃbhavau || 1.92.30 || udumbaramayau tāmrau rūpyarukmamayau tathā || ājyasthālī ca kartavyā taijasadravyasambhavā ||31 || māheyī vāpi bhūpāla nityasarvāgnikarmasu || hastamātraḥ sruvaḥ kāryo sruva bāhusamaṃ tathā||32|| aṅguṣṭhamadhyapratimaṃ homasthānaṃ sruvasya tu|| ājyasthālyāḥ pramāṇantu yathākāmantu kārayet||33|| grāmaṃ pṛścāpayosīti mantreṇājyaṃ narādhipa|| ājyasthālyāḥ payotpūtaṃ pañcānāmiti pañcakam || 34 || paṭhangṛhṇīta rājendra arjetyagnāvadhiśrayet || ājyasyātha pavitreṇa kārya mutplavanaṃ dvija || 35 || agnirjihveti satataṃ havirasyutpavanāntaram || akṣīṇantu na kartavyaṃ satataṃ pārthivottama || 36 || śubhābhyāṃ sruksruvau rājanpratyuṣṭamiti bhāvaya || pavitrasyāgradarbheṇa āyurityeva mānada || 37 || pratimārṣṭi bhuvaṃ paścāccakṣurityeva pārthiva || pratimārṣṭi sruvaṃ tām̐śca darbhānvahnāvathotsṛjet ||38|| darbhotsarge paṭhenmantramimaṃ pārthivasattama || divi śilpamavatataṃ pṛthivyāḥ kakṣibhiḥ śritam || 39|| tena sahasrakāṇḍena dviṣantaṃ tāpayāmasi || dviṣantastapyatāṃ coktvā kṣipeddarbhānhutāśane ||1.92.40|| idhmadvayaṃ tato deyaṃ yājñiyadrumasambhavam || palāśaḥ khadiro bilvaḥ śamyaśvatthavaṭāstathā ||41|| udumbaramapāmārgaḥ phalguśca kramukastathā || candanaṃ devadāruśca drumā dvādaśa yājñiyāḥ ||42|| caturgṛhītaṃ vinyasya sruci pūrvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || idhmadvaye prajvalite saumyabhāge narādhipa ||43|| prajānāmpataye tvādāvāhutiṃ manasā nyaset || caturgṛhīte mūrddheti deyā dakṣiṇato bhavet|| ||44|| yuktaḥ parastādityādi pañcakaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || santatīśca jayādyāstāstathā rāṣṭrabhṛto nṛpa ||45|| vārtraghnau cājyabhāgau ca dātavyau pārthivottama || athaudumbarapatrāṇāṃ vedau dakṣiṇato nṛpa || 46 || sañcaye padmapatrāṇāmathavāpi mahīpate || āvāhanaṃ tu kartavyaṃ devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 47 || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam || jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam ||48|| caturvedaṃ caturvaktraṃ cāturvaṇyaprabhuṃ prabhum || caturāśramagoptāraṃ varadaṃ bhūtabhāvanam || 49 padmayoniṃ jagadyoniṃ yajñayoniṃ jagatpatim || ātmayonimanādhṛṣyaṃ yajñavāhaṃ jagatpatim || 1.92.50 || yajñeśaṃ yajñamūrtiṃ ca trailokyasyaikakāraṇam || sarvagaṃ varadaṃ saumyaṃ paramaṃ parameśvaram || 51 || bhūtabhavyabhavaṃ nāthaṃ yogajñeyaṃ sanātanam || āgaccha bhagavanbrahmanyajamānasya vṛddhaye || 52 || idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpaṃ cedaṃ pragṛhyatām || brahmaliṅgāṃstato mantrāñjapedbhaktyā samāhitaḥ || 53 || āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa brahmaṇo'rghyaṃ nivedayet || śannodevīti pādyaṃ ca prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ || 54 || hiraṇyagarbheti tathā dadyādācamanaṃ budhaḥ || dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa hyāsanaṃ vinivedayet || 55 || gandhaṃ puṣpamalaṅkāraṃ vastraṃ dhūpaṃ sadīpakam || naivedyaṃ ca tathā deyaṃ sāvitreṇa narādhipa || 56 || prāktantrametaduktaṃ te mayā sarvāgnikarmasu || prāktantre tu kṛte kāryaṃ homamantramayāsakam || 57 || evaṃ kāryaṃ mahīnātha sarveṣvevāgnikarmasu || 58 || homasya vihitasyānte tantraṃ kāryamathottaram || mahākalpasya kalpasya tathā manvantarasya ca || 59 || yugasyātha samāyāścāyanasya hi tathaiva ca || ṛtormāsasya pakṣasya grahanakṣatrayostathā || 1.92.60 || titheśca karaṇasyātha muhūrtasya ca pārthiva || varttamānasya sarvasya deyasyādhipatirbhavet || 61 || iha gāva ayaṃ yajña ānaḥ prajāstathaiva ca || dhṛtiṃ caivopadhṛtiṃ ca ihābhāgaṃ tathaiva ca || 62 || deyaṃ caturgṛhītena homadravyeṇa pārthiva || tvanno agne varuṇasya sa tvaṃno agna eva ca || 63 || ayāścāgnestathaiveti tathā vyāhṛtayo nṛpa || tvanno agneti ca tato hotavyamṛktrayaṃ punaḥ || 64 || nyūnaṃ tateti rikteti nyūne caivātiriktakam || samaṃ same tathā hutvā hotavyamṛktrayaṃ tataḥ || 65 || anājñātaṃ yadājñātaṃ sviṣṭiścāpyatha pārthiva || manorjyotistathaivātra trayastriṃśattathaiva ca || 66 || yanme ca manasā cchidraṃ viśvakarmā tathaiva ca || ayāścāgnestathā rājantvanno agne tathaiva ca || satvanno agne ityevaṃ hutvā pārthivasattama || 67 || āśrāviteti mantreṇa deyā pūrṇāhutirbhavet || 68 || iṣṭo hi yajño bhṛgubhirmaṃtreṇānena pārthiva || ājyasthālīṃ sruksruvau ca darbhaistu parimārjayet || 69 || tām̐śca darbhānkṣipedvahnau prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ || pūrṇamityeva ca sruvā kāryaṃ saṃvīkṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 1.92.70|| yathādiśaṃ mahīpāla tathā kuryādvimocanam || tato visarjanaṃ kāryaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 71 || bhagavandevadeveśa jagatāmārtināśana || vrajasva pūjāmādāya punarāgamanāya ca ||72|| yajamānasya śāntyarthaṃ sarvasya jagatastathā || ārogyadhanadhānyena yajamānaṃ ca vardhaya ||73|| hutāśanasya karttavyaṃ tato rājanvisarjanam || dravyabhuktvaṃ vareṇyastvaṃ praṇatārtivināśanaḥ ||74 || vrajasva pūjāmādāya punarāgamanāya ca|| śāntyarthaṃ yajamānasya rāṣṭrasya ca vivṛddhaye ||75||| gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya jayāya ca mahīpateḥ || pūrṇapātramathādāya vācyaṃ svastyayanaṃ tataḥ ||76|| tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā yathā proktā mayā purā || etaduttaratantraṃ tu proktaṃ sarvāgnikarmaṇām||77|| vidhānametatkathitaṃ tavādya sarvāgnikarmasvanaghopayogi|| ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi rājaṃstanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa ||78|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde agnikārye prāktantrottaratantravidhirnāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||92|| <1.93> vajra uvāca || vistarācchrotumicchāmi grahanakṣatrapūjanam || tvatto'haṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kalpite maṇḍale snātaḥ prāktantre ca tathā kṛte || maṇḍalasya tu śaucārthaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet || 2 || payaḥ kāñcanavarṇāyā nīlāyāśca tathā ghṛtam || dadhi vai kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam ||3|| gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet || athaitāni samastāni kapilāyāssamāharet || 4 || gāyatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ rathe akṣeti gomayam || āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi || 5 || tejosi śukramityājyaṃ sāvitreṇa kuśodakam || aghamarṣaṇamantreṇa saṃyojya praṇavena tu || 6 || maṇḍalābhyukṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sāvitryā tadanantaram || pūrṇaṃ kṣīrākṣatopetaṃ sarṣapātaṇḍulairyutam || 7 || śaṅkhe rajate tāmre vā kuryādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || rathe akṣeti mantreṇa draviṇena tathaiva ca || 8 || pādyasya kalpanā kāryā drupadāyāstathaiva ca || hiraṇyavarṇetyārabhya ṛktrayeṇa tathaiva ca || 9 || āpo hiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śannodevīti pārthiva || jīvadānaṃ tato deyaṃ maṇḍale nṛpapuṅgava || 1.93.10 || arghyodakaṃ pavitreṇa tatra mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || agnerāyurasītyevamanuvākaṃ narādhipa || 11 || jīvasyāvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ taṃ ca vakṣyāmyataḥ param || omāvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ jīvaṃ sarvagataṃ vibhum || 12 || pañcadhāvasthitaṃ dehaṃ pañcadhāvasthitaṃ punaḥ || pañcādhāvasthitaṃ bhūyaḥ pañcadhāvasthitaṃ tataḥ || 13 || vāyavyena tu bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitassadā || āgneyena tu bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitastathā || 14 || bhūtātmakena tu tathā pañcadhāvasthitaṃ prabhum || vāruṇena ca bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitaṃ sadā || || 15 || maṇḍale'sminnadṛśyastvaṃ praviśādya namostu te || jīvasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā yathāvatpārthivottama || 16 || vakṣyāmyāvāhanādhyāyānpūjyasyāvāhanaṃ bhavet || tadviṣṇoḥ paramityevamarghyaṃ deyaṃ narādhipa || 17 || dhuvā dyauriti mantreṇa hyāsanaṃ vinivedayet || āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ pādyaṃ ca vinivedayet || 18 || arghyodakādācamanaṃ gāyatryā vinivedayet || dadhi kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva madhuparkaṃ nivedayet || 19 || tatra maṃtratrayaṃ jñeyaṃ dadhi krāvṇeti pārthiva || tejosi śukramityeva madhuvātā ṛtāyate || 1.93.20 || madhuparkikamaśvatthaṃ tato mātrāṃ nivedayet || sahiraṇyaṃ bījapātraṃ draviṇena sadaiva tu || 21 || paśuḥ kalau na kartavya ityāha bhagavānbhṛguḥ || rathe akṣeti mantreṇa dātavyamanulepanam || 22 || vibhūṣaṇaṃ ca tenaiva tataḥ parataraṃ nṛpa || yajñopavītaṃ tu navaṃ tathā pratisaraṃ śubham || 23 || vastraṃ patākāṃ ca tathā sāvitreṇa nivedayet || puṣpaṃ puṣpavatītyeva dhūpaṃ dhūrasi cāpyatha || 24 || dhūpamantramidaṃ cānyaṃ nibodha gadato mama || vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ || 25 || āhvānaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām || tejosi śukramityeva dīpaṃ dadyānmahīpate || 26 || hiraṇyagarbhetyaṣṭarcaṃ deyaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayet || nibodha gadato mantramannapānanivedane || 27 || tuṣṭipuṣṭikaraṃ hṛdyamāhāraṃ sarvadehinām || gṛhāṇa varadācintya pānaṃ bhaktyā mayoditam || 28 || pānenānena paramā tṛptirastu tavānagha || tṛptastarpaya kāmaistu yajamānaṃ namo'stu te || 29 || anuktamaṃtraṃ śrutvā'tha grahebhyo yaḥ prayacchati || sāvitraṃ tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ mantraṃ pārthivasattama || 1.93.30 || tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā rājendra dakṣiṇām || sāvitreṇa tu mantreṇa tataḥ kāryaṃ visarjanam || 31 || imāṃ pūjāṃ samādāya mayā bhaktyā niveditām || punarāgamanāyeha vrajadhvaṃ nākamuttamam || 35 || ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva praśamaṃ yāntu sarvaśaḥ || rakṣā cā'stu śivaṃ cāstu yajamānasya sarvataḥ || 33 || gavāṃ śivaṃ cāstu tathā dvijānāṃ rājñāṃ śivaṃ cāstu tathā prajānām || ātaṅkahīnaṃ jagadastu sarvaṃ doṣāḥ praṇāśaṃ sakalāḥ prayāntu || 34 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 grahapūjāvidhānaṃ nāma trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 93 || <1.94> || vajra uvāca || || ekaikasyedamuktaṃ te vidhānaṃ dvijapūjane || sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane vidhānaṃ mama kīrtaya || 1 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ekaikasyedamuktaṃ te vidhānaṃ rājasattama || sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane maṇḍalasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu || 2 || ādāveva naravyāghra yāgaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param || prāgāyataṃ tu kartavyamādau lekhādvayaṃ nṛpa || 3 || tasyopari tathā kāryamaparaṃ tūttarāyatam || evaṃ kṛte yadutpannaṃ madhye tu caturasrakam || 4 || tato grahebhyaḥ kartavyaṃ tathā lekhācatuṣṭayam || tacchaktibhyaḥ prakartavyaṃ tathā rekhyā catuṣṭayam || evaṃ kṛte sambhavati bhagaṇaṃ dvādaśakṣayam ||5|| trayodaśaṃ tathā tasya dhruvasthānaṃ tu madhyamam || 6 || prācyāṃ diśi mahīnātha meṣaṃ tu parikalpayet || tadādyā gaṇanā kāryā pariśeṣeṣu rāśiṣu ||7|| rekhāvidhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ śobhārthaṃ parikalpayet || rāśisthānāni sarvāṇi rāśivarṇena rañjayet||8|| rāśi varṇānyatho vakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || aruṇaśca sitaścaiva haritaḥ pāṭalastathā ||9|| āpāṇḍuśca vicitraśca kṛṣṇaśca kapilastathā || piṃgalaḥ karburo babhrurmalinaśca yathākramam ||1.94.10|| meṣādīnāṃ vinirdiṣṭā varṇāḥ pārthivasattama|| ākāśavarṇaṃ karttavyaṃ dhruvasthānaṃ tathaiva ca ||11|| dhruvasthāne mahīnātha devatāsaptakaṃ nyaset || maṇḍalaiśśuklavarṇaistu digvibhāgaṃ nibodha me||12|| dhruvasya maṇḍalaṃ madhye prāgbhāge maṇḍalatrayam || maṇḍalaṃ gaganasyātra bhāge prāguttare bhavet ||13|| prāgbhāge ca tathā rājanmaṇḍalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtam || prāgdakṣiṇe tathā bhāge diśaṃ pūrvāṃ prakalpayet ||14|| bhāge vai nerṛte kāryaṃ bhuvo bhūpāla maṇḍalam || śeṣasya ca tathā kāryaṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi maṇḍalam || 15 || digadhastāttathā tasya maṇḍalaṃ paścimottare || grahaścāravaśādrājanyasminrāśau vyavasthitaḥ || 16 || maṇḍalaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ tasminneva yathāvidhi || nyāsaṃ kāryaṃ grahendrāṇāṃ devatābhiḥ sahānagha ||17 || ādityātsaptame rāśau ketoḥ kāryaṃ tu maṇḍalam || rāśau suvarṇe tadvarṇaṃ yasya syānmaṇḍalaṃ nṛpa ||18|| utpādyaḥ paridhistasya raṃgenānyena pārthiva || gandhacūrṇayutā raṅgāḥ karttavyā bhūtimicchatā ||19|| rāśicakraṃ samagrantu rekhayā parivārayet || nakṣatrāṇāṃ tataḥ kāryo nyāsaḥ pārthivasattama||1.94.20|| rāśau rāśau yathāsthānaṃ rekhayā parivāritam || rāśau rāśāvato vakṣye nakṣatrāṇāṃ samāśrayam ||21|| aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikāṃśaṃ caturthakam || meṣarāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama || 22 || pādatrayaṃ kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇī sakalā tathā || ilvalānāṃ tathaivārdhaṃ jñeyaṃ vṛṣasamāśrayam || 23 || ilvalārddhaṃ tathaivārdrā hyadityāścaraṇatrayam || nityameva samuddiṣṭaṃ mithunasya samāśrayam || 24 || pādaṃ punarvasoḥ puṣyaṃ sārpaṃ karkaṭakāśrayam || pitryaṃ bhāgyaṃ tathāryamṇaṃ prathamaṃ caraṇaṃ tathā || 25 || siṃharāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama || pādatrayamathāryamṇaṃ hastaścitrārdhameva ca || 26 || kanyārāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama || citrārdhamatha vāyavyaṃ viśākhācaraṇatrayam || 27 || tulārāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || viśākhācaraṇaṃ maitraṃ śākraṃ vṛścikabhe smṛtam || 28 || mūlamāpyaṃ tathā pādaṃ vaiśvadevasya dhanvini || pādatrayaṃ vaiśvadevādrājanvaiṣṇavameva ca || 29 || dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ ca makare nityameva prakīrtitam || dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ śatabhiṣagajapāccaraṇatrayam || 1.94.30 || kumbharāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ satataṃ pārthivottama || pādamājasya sakalaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ narādhipa || 31 || pauṣṇantu kathitaṃ mīne munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ || bhacakrapūjane rājannakṣatrasya pṛthakpṛthak || 32 || rāśicakrasya bāhye tu hyekaikatārakaṃ nyaset || prāguktavarṇairbhūpāla nyāsaḥ kāryo yathāvidhi || 33 || tārācakrasya vinyāsaṃ rekhayā parivārya tam || nakṣatradaivatanyāsaṃ bahiḥ kāryaṃ samantataḥ || 34 || yathā nakṣatrasvāmī syādṛkṣavarṇaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || tasyāpi rekhā karttavyā vṛttā cāpyanu maṇḍalam || 35 || rekhābāhyena vinyāsaṃ digīśānāṃ tu kārayet || diśaśca pārthivaśreṣṭha yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 36 || svāśrayarkṣasamaṃ varṇaṃ digīśānāṃ tu kārayet || uttarāyāṃ ca karttavyaṃ dhanadasya ca maṇḍalam ||37|| rukmavarṇaṃ prayatnena diśo varṇamataḥ śuṇu || uttarā tu bhavecchuklā raktā prācī prakīrtitā || 38 || dakṣiṇā pītavarṇā syātkṛṣṇā jñeyā ca paścimā || padmavarṇā tathā jñeyā tāmrā syātpūrvadakṣiṇā || 39 || pālāśā ca vinirdiṣṭā tathā dakṣiṇapaścimā || nīlotpalasavarṇā tu vāyavyā parikīrtitā||1.94.40|| śuklavarṇā tathā jñeyā caiśānītattvadarśibhiḥ|| diṅmaṇḍalaṃ tu tadvidvām̐llekhayā parivārayet || 41 || vṛttayā veṣṭayedvṛttāṃ lekhayā caturasrayā || tanmadhye śaṅkhapadmādyairmaṅgalairupaśobhayet || 42 || lekhāvidhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ sarvatraiva prakalpayet || maṇḍalasya tu koṇeṣu hyudakkumbhānnavāndṛḍhān || 43 || phalapallavasaṃchannāngandhapuṣpādisaṃyutān || caturo vinyasedvidvānnityameva vicakṣaṇaḥ || 44 || lekhāsu vinyasedrājanpatākāśca dhvajām̐stathā || chatrāṇi ca savarṇāni grahendrāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 45 || sthānantu vijñāya yathāvadatra kāryaṃ yathā maṇḍalakapramāṇam || yathā mahattā nṛpa maṇḍalasya tathātathā vṛddhimupaiti kartā || 46 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 maṇḍalakalpanānāma caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||94|| <1.95> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || āvāhanānyato vakṣye sarveṣāṃ pārthivottama || sarvasyāvāhanasyānte śloko'yaṃ parikīrtyate || 1 || maṇḍale sampraviśyāsminmayā bhaktyā niveditam || idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 2 || dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagrahagaṇeśvaram || niruddhaṃ bhrāmyate yena bhacakraṃ vātarajjubhiḥ || 3 || ehi me dhruva deveśa keśavācintyavikrama || sarvagrahagaṇādhyakṣa sarvalokanamaskṛta || 4 || āvāhayiṣyāmyākāśaṃ vimānaśatamaṇḍitam || tṛtīyaṃ devadevasya padaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ || 5 || ehi me bhagavansaumya nirālamba nabhastala || aprameyātigambhīra nakṣatragrahamaṇḍita || 6 || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim || jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam || 7 || ehi sarvaprajādhyakṣa padmayone caturmukha || vedamūrte tadādhāra kālanirmāṇa tatpara || 8 || ūrddhvamāvāhayiṣyāmi hyanantāṃ mahatīṃ diśam || aprameyāṃ nirālambāṃ candrasūryāṃśuvarjitām || 9 || āgaccheha mahābhāge satataṃ siddhasevite || anante vipule devi nirmale hitakāriṇi || 1.95.10 || pṛthvīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvasattvahite ratām || dharāṃ bhūmiṃ kṣamāṃ kṣoṇīṃ varadāṃ bhūtadhāriṇīm || 11 || ehi me vasudhe devi vārāheṇa samuddhṛte || sarvabījadhare bhadre sarvabhūtāpahāriṇi || 12 || śeṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi mahīmaṇḍala dhāraṇam || phaṇāvalīratnajālamarīcivikasojjvalam || 13 || ehi śeṣa mahābhāga ehyanantādikeśava || āheyī tvaṃ tanustasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 14 || āvāhayāmyadhastāttu diśaṃ śeṣeṇa pālitām || nāgadaityoragagaṇaissatataṃ ca niṣevitām || 15 || ehi me ratnabāhulye nityaṃ śeṣeṇa pālite || gambhīre vipule bhīme bahusthānābhimaṇḍite || 16 || āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ deveśaṃ jātavedasam || vedamūrttiṃ tadādhāraṃ devadevaṃ hutāśanam || 17 || ehyagre sarvadeveśa sarvadevamukhācyuta || sarvatrastha mahābhāga sarvabhūtahite rata || 18 || āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ divākaram || tejomūrttiṃ durādharṣaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || 12 || ehi deva jagannātha ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ pate || trailokyamaṇḍaladvīpa sarvavyādhivināśana || 1.95.20 || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devamādityamudakeśayam || snigdhavaiḍūryasaṅkāśaṃ varuṇaṃ sumahādyutim || 21 || ehi deva jalādhyakṣa yādogaṇamaheśvara || nāgadaityoragagaṇaissatataṃ sevitānyuta || 22 || āvāhayāmyahaṃ candraṃ śītāṃśumamṛtaprabham || oṣadhīśaṃ dvijādhyakṣaṃ nayanānandakārakam || 23 || ehi me bhagavam̐ścandra ehi me mṛgalācchana || bhaktānukampinsatataṃ sarvanakṣatrapūjita || 24 || skandamāvāhayiṣyāmi ṣaṇmukhaṃ varadaṃ śiśum || devārisenāmathanaṃ pārvatyānandavarddhanam || 25 || ehi devatamārādhya mahiṣāsurataskara || kārtikeya jagannātha mayūravaravāhana || 26 || bhaumamāvāhayiṣyāmi tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam || rudramūrtimanirdeśyavaktraṃ rudhirasaprabham || 27 || ehi me bhagavanbhauma aṅgāraka mahāprabha || tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ bhūtalesmiñchubhāśubham || 28 || viṣṇumāvāhayiṣyāmi śaṅkhacakragadādharam || atasīkusumaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam || 29 || ehi me devadeveśa prajānirmāṇakāraka || nārāyaṇa suduṣpāra mahāśārṅgadhanurdhara || 1.95.30 || budhamāvāhayiṣyāmi bodhakaṃ jagadīśvaram || cāndriṃ grahagaṇādhyakṣaṃ tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam || 31 || ehi śītāṃśujācintya jagajjiṣṇo janārdana || mahābala mahāsattva mahābāho mahādyute || 32 || śakramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ suragaṇeśvaram || vajrapāṇiṃ mahābāhuṃ gobrāhmaṇahite ratam || 33 || ehi deva sahasrākṣa devāribalasūdana || airāvatasthadharmajña śacīhṛdayanandana || 34 || jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deveśvarapurohitam || bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadvācaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam || 35 || ehi jīva mahābhāgajīvabhūta mahītale || sasyavṛddhistavāyattā satataṃ bhūmivardhana || 36 || devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi pārvatīṃ varadāmumām || harasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ cārvaṅgīṃ bhūtivardhinīm || 37 || ehi devi jagannāthe menāhṛdayanandini || pavitre varade saumye nityaṃ bhaktajanapriye || 38 || śukramāvāhayiṣyāmi bhārgavaṃ jagadīśvaram || nityaṃ sarvajanādhyakṣaṃ tapasā dyotitaprabham ||39|| ehi śukra mahābhāga ṣoḍaśārcirvaraprada || prabhustvaṃ varadācintya varṣāvarṣasya nigrahe || 1.95.40 || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ prajādhyakṣamakalmaṣam || bhaktānukampinaṃ devaṃ prajānirmāṇakārakam || 41 || ehi deva prajādhyakṣa pūjānirmāṇakāraka || tvayi deva samāyuktaṃ prajānāmabhavodbhavam || 42 || ehi me bhagavanbrahmanprajāpatimahādyute || saurimāvāhayiṣyāmi śanaiścāriṇamacyutam || 43 || tapasvinamanādhṛṣyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || ehi tīkṣṇāṃśujācintya bhāvābhāvapradarśaka || 44 || tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ rājñāṃ bhūmau śubhāśubham || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ gaṇeśvaram || 45 || vipreśaṃ viprahartāraṃ pārvatīhṛdayapriyam || ehi deva gaṇādhyakṣa lambodara mahābhuja || 46 || kāryasiddhiḥ samāyattā tvayi sarveśa dehinām || rāhumāvāhayiṣyāmi daityeśaṃ grahatāṅgatam || 47 || keśavāptavaraṃ vīraṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam || ehyehi daityapravara varadācintyavikrama || 48 || tapomūrte durādharṣa viparītacarāmbare || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam || 49 || sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu sadā śilpapravartakam || ehi devavarācintya sarvaśilpapravartaka || 1.95.50 || tvayi sarvaiva sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāmāśritā gatiḥ || ketumāvāhayiṣyāmi ketuṃ sarvadivaukasām || 51 || brahmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || dhūmaketo ihābhyehi hutāśanasamaprabha || 52 || śikhākarālavikaca pūjitāghavināśana || vahnerāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayānagha || 53 || āvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ kṛttikāṃ devapūjitām || ehi sādhāraṇe devi jyeṣṭhadakṣasute śubhe || 54 || prajāpatestathā proktaṃ rohiṇyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva || āvāhayāmi varadāṃ rohiṇīṃ candravallabhām || 55 || ehi rohiṇi dharmajñe dhruvakarmasu śobhane || candrasyāvāhanaṃ proktamilvalāyā nibodha me || 56 || āvāhayāmi varadāmilvalāṃ śaśivallabhām || ehi me ilvale devi mṛdukarmasu śobhane || 57 || rudramāvāhayiṣyāmi trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam || ehi śaṅkara sarvātmanmahādeva gaṇeśvara || 58 || ārdrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ bāhusaṃjñikam || ehyārdre cārusarvāṅgi dāruṇe rudrasammate || 59 || āvāhayiṣyāmyaditiṃ tapasā dagdhakilviṣām || ādityāraṇi dharmajñe ehi devi mahāprabhe || || 1.95.60 || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi dharmajñaṃ tu punarvasum || punarvaso ihāgaccha carakarmaprasādaka || 61 || jīvasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ puṣyasyātha pracakṣate || puṣyamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ kṣiprasaṃjñikam || 62 || ehi puṣya mahābhāga poṣaṃ vardhaya sarvataḥ || sarpānāvāhayiṣyāmi trailokyāntaragocarān || || 63 || āyāntu sarvataḥ sarpāḥ saumyarūpā bhavantu ca || āvāhayiṣyāmyāśleṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ śrīvivarddhanām || 64 || āśleṣe tvamihābhyehi dāruṇe vijayaprade || pitṝnāvāhayiṣyāmi mūrtyamūrtidharānaham || 65 || āyāntu pitaraśśīghraṃ sudhākavyabhujo'vyayāḥ|| maghāmāvāhayiṣyāmi ugranakṣatramañjasā || 66 || ehi me subhage devi maghe'ghaviniṣūdane || bhagamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvaphalgunasaṃjñitam || 67 ||| ehi bhāgye mahābhāge ugrakarmaprasādike || āvāhayiṣyāmyaryamṇamādityaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim || 68 || aryamam̐stvaṃ samamyehi bhaktapātakanāśana || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cottarāphalgunīṃ śubhām || 69 || ehi tvaṃ subhage devi dhruve sarvāṅgasundari || āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ saviturdīptatejasaḥ || 1.95.70 || hastamāvāhayiṣyāmi sāvitraṃ kṣipramañjasā || ehi sāvitra dharmajña bhaktānāṃ pāpanāśana || 71 || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ tvaṣṭāramamitadyutim || ehi me bhagavam̐stvaṣṭaḥ prajāpālanatatpara || 72 || citrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi citrarūpāṃ manoharām || ehi me varade citre mṛdukarmaprasādhini || 73 || vāyumāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagaṃ dīptatejasam || deva vāyo tvamabhyehi sarvabhūtajagatpriya || 74 || svātimāvāhayiṣyāmi nityamuttaramārgagām || devi svāte tvamabhyehi carakarmasu śobhane || 75 || āvāhayiṣyāmīndrāgnī sahitau dīptatejasau || indrābhyehi jagannātha ehyagne vijayaprada || 76 || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi viśākhāṃ dīptatejasam || viśākhe tvamihābhyehi devi sādhāraṇe śubhe || 77 || mitramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ dīptāṃśumūrjitam || ehi mitra mahābhāga bhaktāghapralayaṅkara || 78 || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi hyanurādhāṃ varapradām || anūrādhe tvamabhyehi mṛdukarmasu śobhane ||79 || śakrasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ jyeṣṭhāyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva || jyeṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ śakradaivatam || 1.95.80 || jyeṣṭhe devi tvamabhyehi dāruṇe cārulocane || devamāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ nirṛtijaṃ prabhum || 81 || ehi deva virūpākṣa mahābalaparākrama || mūlamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ dāruṇaṃ mahat || 82 || ehi mūla mahābhāga bhaktānāmabhayaprada || apastvāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagā varadāḥ śivāḥ || || 83 || āpastvāyāntu varadāḥ pavitrā maṅgalāvahāḥ || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvāṣāḍhetisaṃjñitam || 84 || ehi tvamugre varade cāṣāḍhe pūrva pūrvake || viśvānāvāhayiṣyāmi devānadbhutatejasaḥ || 85 || āyāntu varadāḥ sarve viśvedevā mahābalāḥ || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi uttarāṣāḍhasaṃjñitam || 86 || ehi tvamuttarāṣāḍhe sarvakarmasu śobhane || brahmaṇa āvāhanaṃ proktamabhijiti śṛṇu he prabho || 87 || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi yattadabhijiducyate || ehi dhiṣṇyavariṣṭhāya kṣiprakarmaprasādhaka || 88 || viṣṇorāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ śravaṇasya nibodha me || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi śravaṇaṃ sarvakāmadam || 89 || || aśvattha tvaṃ samabhyehi carakarmaprasādhaka || vasūnāvāhayiṣyāmi devānaṣṭau varapradān || 1.95.90 || āyāntu varadā devā vasavaḥ pāpanāśanāḥ || dhaniṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ rāśivallabham || 91 || dhaniṣṭhe tvamihāgaccha carakarmaprasādhake || āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 92 || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi nāmnā śatabhiṣaṃ śubham || āgaccha tvaṃ śatabhiṣe carakarmasu śobhane || 93 || ajaikapādaṃ varadaṃ rudramāvāhayāmyaham || ahirbudhnya samabhyehi jaṭājūṭopaśobhita || 94 || dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deśe bhādrapadottare || ehi tvaṃ sumahābhāge mama bhādrapadottare|| ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi revatīṃ cārudarśanām || 95 || ehi revati dharmajñe mṛdukarmaprasādhake || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam || 96 || pūṣansamyagihābhyehi sarvakarmaprasādika || āvāhayāmyahaṃ devau nāsatyau sūryanandanau || 97 || āgacchetāṃ mahābhāgau varadāvaśvināvubhau || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cāśvinī sarvakāmadam || 98 || yamasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ bharaṇīmatha vai śṛṇu || ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cograṃ bharaṇisaṃjñakam || 99 || ehi tvaṃ devi bharaṇi subhage cārudarśini || śakrasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā nṛpa || 1.95.100|| prācīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryodayavibhūṣitām || ehi tvaṃ varade pūrve śubhakarmaprasādhike || 101 || vahnerāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā tava || diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi varadāṃ pūrvadakṣiṇām || 102 || vahnipriye samabhyehi varade pūrvadakṣiṇe || yamasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ yāmyāyāśca diśaḥ śṛṇu || 103 || ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || dakṣiṇe tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmasu śobhane || 104 || pūrvamāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ virūpākṣasya dhīmataḥ || diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ dakṣiṇapaścimām || 105 ||| ehi me nairṛtī devi satataṃ bhūtivardhini || āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 106 || diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi vāruṇīṃ varuṇīṃ śubhām || āgaccha paścime devi varade varuṇapriye || 107 || āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ vāyoścaiva mahātmanaḥ || āvāhayāmi vidiśaṃ vāyavyāṃ paścimottarām || || 108 || varade tvaṃ samabhyehi vāyavye paścimottare || āvāhayāmi dhanadaṃ devaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum || 109 || rājarāja samabhyehi sarvayajñadhanādhipa || diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi saumyāṃ dhanadapālitām || 1.95.110 || uttare tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmasu śobhane || devasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ tryambakasya mahātmanaḥ || || 111 || diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ prāguttarāmaham || ehi tvaṃ subhage devi satataṃ śivapālite || 112 || sarvānāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvakumbheṣu sāgarān || ratnādhyakṣāḥ samāyāntu catvāra iha sāgarāḥ || 113 || īśānyāṃ diśi yaḥ kumbhaḥ pūrvastasya tu sāgaraḥ || āgneyyāntu samāyātu dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇaḥ śivaḥ || 114 || paścimastu samāyātu kumbhe dakṣiṇapaścime || uttaraśca tathā'bhyetu kumbhe vai paścimottare || 115 || āvāhitānāṃ kartavyaṃ bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ || praṇāmamabhivādyaṃ ca tato mantramudīrayet || 116 || bhavatāṃ hi prasādena bhavatāṃ pratipūjanaiḥ || prayatiṣye yathāśaktyā tanme'nujñātumarhatha || 117 || yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kartuṃ kena śakyaṃ yathāvidhi|| yuṣmatpūjāvihīnena kuto labhyaṃ mahatpadam || 118 || tataḥ kartuṃ yathāśaktyā bhavatāṃ pratipūjane || varadāḥ prayatiṣyāmi tanmenujñātumarhatha || 119 || bhavatpūjāvidhāvasminbahuvijñaṃ sadaiva tu || svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya dikpālā dīptatejasaḥ ||1.95.120 || utsādayantu sakalānvighnānme samupasthitān || asmāddeśātpraṇaśyantu yajñaghnā brahmarākṣasāḥ || 121 || vināyakā vighnakarā mamogrā yajñadviṣo ye piśitāśanāśca || siddhārthakairvajrasamānakalpairmayā nirastāḥ svagṛhaṃ prayāntu || 122|| etāvaduktvā vikireta vidvānsiddhārthakāndikṣu tathā vidikṣu || rakṣohaṇaṃ cātra tathaiva maṃtraṃ vaktavyamuccairdvijapuṅgavena || 123 || sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane pradiṣṭaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ snānamadīnasattva || bījaiḥ samagraiśca tathaiva gandhairmṛdbhiśca ratnaiśca tathā jalaiśca || 124 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde graharkṣāvāhanamantrādhyāyo nāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 95 || <1.96> vajra uvāca || sarveṣāṃ tu samācakṣva gandhamālyaṃ tathaiva ca || dhūpaṃ brahmansanaivedyaṃ pānaṃ caiva pṛthakpṛthak || 1 || homadravyaṃ tathā mantraṃ dakṣiṇāśca bhṛgūttama || ekastvaṃ sarvavidbrahmanbrahmā vā jagatāṃ patiḥ || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devānāṃ ca mahīpate || sarvāsāṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ nityameva pṛthakpṛthak|| 3|| sūryāya kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ karpūraṃ śaśine tathā || bhaumāya candanaṃ raktaṃ cāguruṃ śaśijāya ca || 4 || jīvāya candanaṃ deyaṃ kuṅkumena vimiśritam || śukrāya candanaṃ śvetaṃ saurāya ca mṛgodbhavam || 5 || kuṅkumena yutaṃ dadyāddānavāya mṛgodbhavam || aguruṃ kuṅkumaṃ cobhau sudeyau dhūmaketave || 6 || kuṅkumaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu rohiṇīnāṃ mṛgodbhavam || ilvalānāṃ ca karpūraṃ raudre nāgamadaṃ tathā || 7 || ādityasya pradātavyāvubhau kuṅkumacandanau || uśīracandanau deyāvāśleṣāpaitryayostathā || 8 || priyaṅgucandanau deyau tathā bhāgyasya pārthiva || aryamṇaśca pradātavyau candanau śvetaraktakau || 9 || sāvitrasya pradātavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ pṛthivīpate || tvāṣṭrasya candanaṃ deyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ samṛgodbhavam || 1.96.10 || jātīphalayutaṃ deyaṃ vāyavyasya ca candanam || viśākhāyāḥ pradātavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ tathā || 11 || turuṣkasahitaṃ deyaṃ tathā maitrāya candanam || jyeṣṭhāyāśca pradātavyaṃ candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā || 12 || mūlāya śiṃśapāsāraṃ tathā deyaṃ mṛgodbhavam || āpyāya kuṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ dātavyaṃ candanaṃ bhavet || 13 || vaiśvadevāya mṛgajaṃ candanāguruṇī tathā || brāhmāya candanaṃ deyaṃ vaiṣṇavāyāguruṃ tathā ||14|| jātīlavaṅgau dātavyau supiṣṭau vāsavāya tau || vāruṇāya ca karpūramājāhirbudhnyayostathā || 15 || pauṣṇāya candanaṃ raktamāśvināya tathā sitam || yāmyāyāgurusaṃyuktaṃ tathā deyaṃ mṛgodbhavam || 16 || samānadevanakṣatraṃ kathitaṃ ca tathā diśam || uttarāyāstathā deye candanāguruṇī śubhe || 17 || sāgarāṇāṃ pradātavyaṃ sarveṣāmeva candanam || alābhe tu tathā deyaṃ sarveṣāmeva candanam|| 18 || maṅgalyaṃ tatpavitraṃ ca devānāṃ dayitaṃ ca tat || dhāryaṃ ca deyaṃ tadrājam̐statra lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā || 19 || yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayaitadṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna || taddevatāyāśca tadeva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti || 1.96.20 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde anulepakathano nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 96 || <1.97> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || savarṇāni graharkṣāṇāṃ diśāṃ ca jagatīpate || nityaṃ deyāni vāsāṃsi patākāśca vijānatā || 1 || bhūṣaṇāni ca deyāni kāñcanāni śubhāni ca || ratnacitrāṇi ramyāṇi yathāśaktyā narādhipa || 2 || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate || jātīpuṣpāṇi deyāni sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ || 3 || raktapadmāni sūryasya śvetapadmāni cendave || bandhūkāni ca bhaumāya budhāyendīvarāṇi ca || 4 || jīvāya yūthikā pītā sitāya ca tathā sitā || bāṇapuṣpāṇi saurāya rāhave pāṭalāni ca || 5 || tathā damanakaṃ deyaṃ ketave vasudhādhipa || kṛttikāsu ca deyāni rājanraktotpalāni ca || 6 || campakāni ca rohiṇyā ilvilāyāḥ sitotpalam || dhattūrakāṇyathārdrāyā ādityasya ca mallikā || 7 || campakānyeva puṣyasya jātī syātsārpapitryayoḥ || bhāgyasya kāntā dātavyā aryamṇaśca suvarcalā ||8 || sāvitratvāṣṭrayornityaṃ bandhūkakusumāni ca || vāyavyasya ca deyāni sindhuvārāṇi pārthiva || 9 || aindrāgnyasya ca deyāni kuraṇḍakusumāni ca || raktāśokasya puṣpāṇi tathā maitrasya pārthiva || 1.97.10 || campakāni ca śākrasya tathā deyāni bhūpate || mūlasya ca tathā deyaṃ rājankṛṣṇakuheṭakam ||11|| kahlārāṇi tathāpyasya vaiśvadevasya kubjakam|| brāhmasya jātīpuṣpāṇi vaiṣṇavasya ca campakam || 12 || pāṭalā vāsavasyāpi vāruṇasyotpalāni tu || arkapuṣpāṇyathāpyasya tathā deyāni pārthiva || 13 || āhirbudhnyasya deyāni dhattūrakusumāni ca || karavīrakapuṣpāṇi tathā pauṣṇasya pārthiva || 14 || cūtapuṣpāṇi deyāni āśvinasya narādhipa || nīlotpalāni yāmyasya tathā deyāni bhūpate || 15 || samānaveśanakṣatrakathitāni tathā diśām || uttarāyāśca deyāni nāgapuṣpāṇi pārthiva || 16 || sāgarāṇāṃ ca deyāni kamalāni mahīpate || uktālābhe pradeyāni savarṇāni narādhipa || svakālajāni puṣpāṇi sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ || 17 || yadyadrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna || taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti ||18|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde graharkṣaviśeṣapuṣpadeyādeyādhyāyo nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 97 || <1.98> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate || gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 1 || dhūpaṃ tvagururarkāya nameruṃ ca tathendave || bhaumāya gugguluṃ dadyātsarjaṃ dayādbudhāya ca || 2 || śilājatu tu jīvāya dātavyaṃ pārthivottama || śrīvāsakaṃ tu śukrāya nakhaṃ saurāya pārthiva || madaśca rāhave deyaṃ ketave ca vasā tathā || 3 || kṛttikānāṃ ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ rohiṇīnāṃ ca candanam || ilvalānāṃ ca karpūramārdrāyāṃ ca nakhaṃ tathā || 4 || punarvasoścāpyaguruṃ puṣyasya ca tathākṣatam || śrīvāsakaṃ ca sārpasya paitrasya ca tathā ghṛtam ||5 || priyaṅguṃ madhunā yuktaṃ bhāgyasya saghṛtaṃ bhavet || ghṛtena madhunā yuktamāryamṇasya śatāvarīm || 6 || kunduruṃ caiva hastāya tvāṣṭrāya ca palaṃ bhavet || vāyavyāya ca karpūramaindrāgnyāya misirbhavet || 7 || maitrāya kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ śākrāya mṛgajaṃ bhavet || śāṭīmūlaṃ ca mūlāya āpyāya naladaṃ tathā || 8 || gugguluṃ vaiśvadevāya brāhmāya ghṛtacandane || vaiṣṇavāyāguruṃ dadyādvāsavāya tathā palam || 9 || vāruṇāya tathośīramājāya ca palaṃ bhavet || ahirbudhnyāya dātavyaṃ devadāruṃ narādhipa || 1.98.10 || kaṅkolakāni pauṣṇāya āśvināya ca candanam || yamyāya guggulurdeyaḥ satataṃ bhūtimicchatā || 11 || karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva candanaṃ mṛgajaṃ tathā || turuṣkamaguruṃ kāntāṃ gugguluṃ ca kramāddiśām || 12 || prācyādīnāṃ mahīnātha sāgarāṇāṃ ca candanam || sarvābhāve ca dātavyāḥ sarveṣāmeva guggulum || 13|| vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ || āghrāṇaḥ sarvadevānāṃ guggulupravaraḥ śubhaḥ ||14|| dīpaścājyena dātavyaḥ sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ || tailena vā mahīnātha vasāḍhyena vivarjayet ||15|| yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna|| taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśāṃ tathā nātra vicāramasti||16|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde graharkṣadhūpadīpo nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 98 || || <1.99> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ narādhipa || dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ vinivedayet || 1 || guḍaudanaṃ guḍāpūpāḥ phalāni guḍapāyasam || nivedanaṃ tu sūryāya dhānyalāje madhūtkaṭe || 2 || sarpirdadhyodanaṃ caiva phalāni vividhāni ca || modakāni ca mukhyāni pāyasaṃ śaśinastathā || 3 || guḍaudanaṃ guḍāpūpā yāvakaṃ guḍapāyasam || kṛsaraṃ ca tathā deyaṃ bhūmiputrāya pārthiva || 4 || kṣīraudanaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ kṣīravṛkṣaphalāni ca || kṣīriṇyaśca tathoṣadhyo somaputrāya dāpayet || 5 || śimbidhānyavikārāṇi bilvānyāmalakāni ca || ghṛtaudanaṃ ca jīvāya dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 6 || dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca madhunā sarpiṣā yutam|| | utkārikaṃ modakāṃśca bhārgavāya nivedayet ||| 7 || māṣaudanaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ kṛsaraṃ dadhi yāvakam|| nivedayettu saurāya kulatthaṃ caṇakaiḥ saha||8|| plakṣaṃ dadhitthaṃ ca tathā palalaṃ caiva rāhave|| māṣaudanaṃ tathā deyaṃ yavāpūpāṃstathaiva ca||9|| tallopikāstathā matsyāḥ ketave kṛsaraṃ tathā || vasāsarpīṃṣi ca tathā deyāni manujeśvara || 1.99.10 || madhulāje kṛttikānāṃ kulmāṣaṃ dadhisarpiṣī || rohiṇīnāṃ ca bījāni dadhipiṣṭavṛṣāṇi ca || 11 || dadhyodakaṃ celvalānāṃ mṛgamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca || rudhiraṃ kṛsaraṃ cobhau raudrasya vinivedayet || 12 || punarvasoḥ pradātavyaṃ palalaṃ savilāyanam || pāyasaṃ ca sasarpiṣkaṃ tiṣyāya vinivedayet || 13 || piṣṭasarpāṇi sārpasya kṣaudraṃ dadhiyutaṃ tathā || tilaudanaṃ sapalalaṃ paitryasya vinivedayet || 14 || ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ ca bhāgyasya madhusarpīṃṣi cāpyatha || āryamṇāya tilāpūpānṣaṣṭikānnaṃ tathaiva ca || || 15 || priyaṃgutaṇḍulaiḥ siddhaṃ sāvitrāya ca pāyasam || tvāṣṭrasya caiva pīyūṣaṃ dvijā citrāṇḍajāstathā || 16 || vāyavyasya ca phalguni mūlakāni śubhāni ca || kulatthāni viśākhāsu yavāpūpāstathaiva ca || 17 || kulatthabhaktaṃ mitrāya dadhikṣaudrānvitaṃ tathā || ghṛtaudanaṃ ca śākrāya phalāni vividhāni ca || 18 || mūlāni ca vicitrāṇi tathā mūlaphalāni ca || āpyasya saktavo deyā madhumiśrodakaiḥ saha || 19 || saktavo vaiśvadevāya madhulāje tathaiva ca || brāhmāya pāyasaṃ deyaṃ saguḍaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 1.99.20 || dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca vaiṣṇavāya nivedayet || ghṛtodakaṃ ca śākāni vāsavāya nivedayet ||21|| paiṣṭaṃ biḍālaṃ śākāṃśca vāruṇāya tathā dadhi || ādāya māṃsamājaṃ tu vyāghraṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ dadhi ||22|| āhirbudhnyāya māṃsāni tathaiva ca rasaudanam || pauṣṇāya saktavo māṣā māṣayuktāśca saktavaḥ ||23|| aśvaṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ māṣānyāvakaṃ ca tathā dadhi || āśvinasyātha yāmyasya taṇḍulāni tilāni ca||24|| rājanpaiṣṭāśca paśavo māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā|| pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ pūrvasyāṃ vinivedayet||25|| āgneyyāṃ diśi rājendra kṛsaraṃ kṣīramiśritam|| dakṣiṇasyāṃ ca dātavyaṃ kṛsaraṃ tailamiśritam|ā26| nairṛtyāṃ ca pradātavyaṃ kṛsaraṃ matsyasaṃyutam| kulmāṣāṃścaiva matsyāṃśca paścimasyāṃ nivedayet ||27|| vāyavyāyāśca matsyāni tathā kṣīrodanāni ca || aiśānyāyāḥ pradātavyau ghṛtakṣīrodanāvubhau||28 || modakollopikāmiśrāḥ sāgarāṇāṃ balirbhavet ||29|| yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna || taddevatāyāśca tadeva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti || 1.99.30 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde graharkṣanaivedyadeyādeyavidhirnāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||99 || <1.100> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || pānāya dāpayetkṣīraṃ prītaye vāntarātmanaḥ|| gandhodakaṃ tathārkāya payaḥ somāya kīrtitam || 1 || bhūmiputrāya kharjūraṃ mārdvīkaṃ śaśijāya ca|| jīvāya ca tathā takraṃ śukrāyekṣurasaṃ tathā || 2 || māṃsapānaṃ tu saurāya rāhormīnarasaṃ tathā || chāgaṃ payaḥ pradātavyaṃ ketave manujeśvara || 3 || gandhodakaṃ ca kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ suvīrakam || ilvalānāṃ payaḥ proktaṃ raudreḥ khārjūramāsavam || 4 ādityāya tathā gauḍaṃ kṣīraṃ tiṣyāya dāpayet|| kṣīrameva ca sārpāya tathā pitryāya yādava ||5|| gandhodakaṃ ca bhāgyāya tathāryamṇāya kīrtitam|| sāvitrāya tathāyastu tvāṣṭrāya ca tathā payaḥ ||6|| vāyavyāya ca mārdvīkamaindrāgnyāya ca kāñjikam || mitrāya takraṃ deyaṃ ca śākrāya dadhi dāpayet || 7 || nārikelāmbu mūlāya tathāpyāya madhūdakam || khārjūraṃ vaiśvadevāya brāhmāya salilaṃ hitam || 8 || āmraiḥ pānaṃ vaiṣṇavāya jambubhirvāsavāya ca || vāruṇāya madhūkaiśca rasamājasya pārthiva || 9 || āhirbudhnyasya ca tathā rasameva bhavennṛpa || pauṣṇāya ca bhavecchāgaṃ cāśvināya ca māhiṣam || yāmyāya ca tathā deyaṃ svacchaṃ māṃsarasaṃ tathā || 1.100.10 || samānadevanakṣatraṃ kathitaṃ ca tathā diśām || uttarāyai pradātavyaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ narādhipa || 11 || sāgarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ satataṃ bhūtimicchatā || 12 || yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna || taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pratigraharkṣadeyādeyapāno nāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 || <1.101> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhuvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate || ghṛtāktairakṣatairhomaḥ kāryyaśca satilairbhavet ||1|| arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadiraścāpāmārgo 'tha pippalaḥ || udumbaraśśamīdūrvāḥ kuśāśceti yathākramam || 2 || samidarthaṃ praśasyante sūryādīnāṃ narādhipa || hotavyāssamidhaścaiva ghṛtāktā manujeśvara || 3 || tathā prādeśamātrāśca prāgagrā nityameva ca || ūrdhvaśuṣkāḥ sapatrāśca vitvacaśca vivarjayet || 4 || kṛttikānāṃ ghṛtenākto homaḥ pārthivasattama || rohiṇīnāṃ tathā bījairilvilānāṃ ca pāyasaiḥ || 5 || mākṣikaiśca tathārdrāyāmādityasya ca taṇḍulaiḥ || puṣyasya pāyasenāpi sārpa sya ca tathauṣadhaiḥ ||6|| tilaiḥ sataṇḍulairhomaḥ tathā paitryasya kīrtitaḥ || priyaṅgubhiśca bhāgyasya cāryyamṇasya tathākṣataiḥ || 7 || sāvitrasya tathā dadhnā citrāyā pāyasena ca || vāyavyasyākṣataiḥ kāryyā saghṛtairmanujeśvara ||8|| aindrāgnasya sadā kāryyo yāvakena tathaiva ca || masūraiścaiva maitrasya śākrasya caṇakena tu || 9 || mūlasyauṣadhibhiḥ kāryyastathaivāpyasya śālibhiḥ || vaiśvadevasya payasā tathā brāhmasya pāyasaiḥ || 1.101.10 || maṇibhistaṇḍulopetaiḥ śravaṇasya vidhīyate || nyagrodhodumbaraphalairvāsavasya vidhīyate || 11 || vāruṇasyodakaiḥ puṣpaistathā caivākṣataiśśubhaiḥ || ājasyājyena madhunā dadhnā ca nṛpasattama || 12 || vrīhībhiśca tathā kāryyāścāhirbudhnyasya pārthiva || phalaiśca sākṣataiḥ kāryyastathā pauṣṇasya pārthiva||13|| kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca āśvinasya vidhīyate || yāmyasya madhusaṃyuktaistilaiḥ pārthivasattama || 14 || ājya tilāśca tailaṃ ca kṛśaraṃ madhu pāyasam || dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ prācyādīnāṃ yathākramam || 15 || sāgarāṇāṃ ca payasā homaḥ kāryaḥ pṛthakpṛthak || uktālābhe ca sarveṣāṃ homaḥ kāryyasti lākṣataiḥ || 16 || saghṛtaiḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha dravyaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet || prabhoḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate || 17 || na sāmparāyikaṃ tasya bhavatīha sudurmateḥ ||18|| yadyadagrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna || taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti || 19 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde homadravyavibhāgo nāmaikottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 101 <1.102> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa homaḥ kāryo dhruvasya tu || ūrdhvo adhara ityeva dhruvāyāśca diśo bhavet || 1 || brahmayajñānamityeṣa brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || dyaustvā iti ca mantreṇa divaḥ kāryo mahīpate || 2 || pṛthivī divi cetyeva pṛthivyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ || praṇavena ca śeṣasya cādhastācca tathā diśaḥ || 3 || agnirmūrdheti mantro'yamagnaye parikīrtitaḥ || uduttamaṃ varuṇapāśaṃ mantroyaṃ varuṇasya tu || 4 || praṇavaśca kumārasya tadviṣṇorviṣṇave bhavet || trātāramindraṃ śakrasya devyāśca praṇavo bhavet || 5 || prajāpate na tvadetā mantro'yaṃ syātprajāpateḥ || vināyakāya praṇavo viśvakarmeti cāpyatha || 6 || mantraśca kathito rājansatataṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ || ākṛṣṇeti ca mantro'yamādityasya prakīrtitaḥ || 7 || imaṃ deveti somasya agnirmūrdhā kujasya tu || udbudhyasvā budhasyāpi mantraḥ prokto nareśvara || 8 || bṛhaspate ati yadaryo mantra ukto bṛhaspateḥ || annātparisrutetyevaṃ mantraḥ śukrasya kīrtitaḥ || 9 || śannodevīti saurasya kāṇḍātkāṇḍeti rāhave || ketuṃ kṛṇvanniti tathā mantra uktaśca ketave || 1.102.10 || agnirmūrddhā kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ prajāpate || madhuvvāteti mantro'yamilvalānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 11 || mṛḍano rudramārdrāyāḥ sutrāmāṇaṃ punarvasoḥ || tava śriyeti puṣyasya homamantro vidhīyate || 12 || namo'stu sarpebhyaśceti mantraḥ sārpasya kīrtitaḥ || ahaṃ pitṝniti tathā mantraḥ pitryasya kīrtitaḥ || 13 || sadāsugeti bhāgyasya tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || ete aryyamannityevamāryamṇasya ca nirdiśet || 14 || sāvitrasya ca sāvitrī tvāṣṭrasya ya ime tathā|| vāyuragreti ca tathā vāyavyasya narādhipa || 15|| indrāgnī rocanetyevamindrāgnasya prakīrtitaḥ|| 16|| mitrojaneti maitrasya homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || indraḥ sutrāma iti ca śākrasya vasudhādhipa || 17 || yante devīti nirṛtiṃ mūlasya ca tathā bhavet || śanna āpastathāpyasya homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 18 || viśvedevīti vaiśvasya tathā ca vasudhādhipa || brahmayajñānamityevaṃ tathā brāhmasya nirdiśet || 19 || vaṣaṭte viṣṇa ityevaṃ vaiṣṇavasya tathā bhavet || āme grahā bhavatyevaṃ vāsavasya prakīrtitaḥ || 1.102.20 || imaṃ me varuṇetyevaṃ vāruṇasya tathā bhavet || upaprāgetimantreṇa homamājasya kārayet || 21 || mantraścāhirivetyevamāhirbudhnyasya kīrtitaḥ || prayādamiti mantreṇa aśvinasya prakīrtitaḥ || 22 || yamo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ tathā yāmyasya kīrtitam || nakṣatradevatāhome mantrā ete prakīrtitāḥ || 23 || nakṣatradevatā tulyā digīśānāṃ tathaiva ca || praṇavena diśaḥ kāryastathā vaiśravaṇasya ca || 24 || sāgarāṇāṃ ca rājendra pṛthageva vijānatā || ekacakreti vā dvyarcaṃ grahāṇāṃ ca narādhipa || 25 || samāgneti tathā dvyarca nakṣatrāṇāṃ vidhīyate || 26 || etāvadukto nṛpavarya tubhyaṃ homāśrayo mantragaṇo grahāṇām || hutena yenānaghamānavānāṃ kāmānabhīṣṭānpradiśanti loke || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde homamantrādhyāyo nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 102 || <1.103> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || dakṣiṇārthe pradātavyaṃ sarveṣāmeva kāñcanam || 1 || raktāṃ vatsayutāṃ dhenuṃ dadyādarkāya pārthiva || śaṅkhaṃ dadyānnarendreṇa dakṣiṇārthaṃ niśābhṛtaḥ || 2 || raktavarṇohyanaḍvām̐śca dātavyaḥ kṣitijasya tu || kāñcanīṃ svāṃ pratikṛtiṃ bālakrīḍanakāni ca || 3 || budhāya rājandeyāni dakṣiṇārthe viśeṣataḥ || kṣaumaṃ dukūlaṃ kārpāsavāsāṃsi gurave tathā || 4 || sitavarṇaṃ ca turagaṃ bhārgavāya pradāpayet || kṛṣṇāṃ dhenuṃ savatsāṃ ca dadyātsūryasutāya vai || 5 || uṣṇīṣaṃ lohadaṇḍaśca dātavyo nṛpa rāhave || chāgaśca ketave deyaṃ kutapaṃ ca narādhipa || 6 || kṛttikānāṃ tu kanakaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || sarvabījāni deyāni rohiṇīnāṃ tathaiva ca || 7 || dogdhrīṃ dhenuñcelvalānāmanaḍvāhaṃ ca rāhave || ādityāya śubhaṃ vastraṃ puṇyāya kanakaṃ ghṛtam ||8|| sārpāya vṛṣabhaṃ dadyādrukmaśṛṅgaṃ mahīpate || pitryasya ca tilāndadyādvāyavyasya ca cāmaram ||9|| bhāgyasya deyā gandhāśca āryamṇasya ca kāñcanam || hastasya kuñjaraṃ dadyātkanakaṃ vā mahīpate ||1.103.10|| tvāṣṭrasya vṛṣabhaṃ dadyādaindrāgnasya narādhipa|| vastrāṇi caiva maitrasya śākrasya kanakaṃ tathā||11|| dadyānmūlasya mūlāni phalāni vividhāni ca || āpyasya dadhipātrāṇi śakaṭaṃ vāsavasya ca||12|| tathā candanakāṣṭhañca vāruṇasya pradāpayet || ajamājasya dātavyamāhirbudhnyasya caudanam || 13 || dhenuṃ pauṣṇasya turagamāśvinasya tathaiva ca || tiladhenuñca yāmyasya dadyātpāpāpanuttaye || 14 || kuñjaraṃ ca tathaivoṣṭraṃ rathaṃ śakaṭameva ca || hayamaśvataraṃ caiva narayānaṃ ca pārthiva || 15 || prācyādīnāṃ kramāddadyāddakṣiṇāśca narādhipa || sāgarāṇāṃ ca dātavyaṃ kanakaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam || 16 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāñca diśāśca manujeśvara || yaduktamatra taddeyaṃ devatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 17 || uktābhāve ca dātavyā dhenuḥ pārthivasattama || pratyekasya mahābhāga śubhā kāṃsyopadohanā || 18 || dogdhrī savatsā śīlāḍhyā vastraratnopaśobhitā || rukmaśṛṅgaiḥ khurai raupyairmuktālāṃgūlabhūṣitā || 19 || tato visarjanaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā nṛpa || dadhikṣīraghṛtaprāyaṃ tathā trimadhurānvitam || 1.103.20 || bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā pratyekasya narādhipa || yathāśaktyā mahārāja teṣāṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām || prayatastām̐śca yāceta pūjitānprīṇanaṃ budhaḥ || 21 || etāvaduktaṃ tava śāntikarma samastapāpapraśamāya rājan || karttavyametatprayatena śaktyā na vittaśāṭhyena na māyayā ca || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dakṣiṇādhyāyo nāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 103 || || cha || <1.104> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || evaṃ śāntyavasāne tu yajamānasya yājakaḥ || hṛdi vinyasya darbhāgrānsthitānsve dakṣiṇe kare || 1 || kuryātpratisarābandhaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || baddhapratisarasyāsya sarve naśyantu rākṣasāḥ || 2 || dhruvastvāmūrdhvataḥ pātu pūrvataḥ pātu bhāskaraḥ || bhaumo dakṣiṇataḥ pātu paścātpātu śanaiścaraḥ || 3 || uttareṇa budhaḥ pātu ketuḥ pātu tathā hyadhaḥ || pūrvadakṣiṇataḥ śukro dakṣiṇāparatastamaḥ || 4 || paścimottarataścandro jīvaḥ prāguttareṇa tu || uktasandhiṣu sarvāṇi nakṣatrāṇi tavānagha || 5
