|| svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya tava nityaṃ digīśvarāḥ || rakṣantu sarvaduṣṭebhyaḥ śakravahnipurogamāḥ || 6 || śātravāṇāṃ ca corāṇāṃ vyādhīnāṃ pātakasya ca || amaṅgalānāṃ ghorāṇāmariṣṭānāṃ tathaiva ca || 7 || dussvapnānāṃ ca ghorāṇāṃ cintitānāṃ tathā mṛṣā|| vajreṇa nāśanaṃ śakraḥ karotu balasūdanaḥ || 8 || daṇḍena nāśanaṃ nityaṃ vidadhātu yamontakaḥ || pāśena varuṇo devo gadayā ca dhaneśvaraḥ || 9 || grahasannāhasannaddho grahapañjaramadhyagaḥ || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ ||1.104.10|| sarvavyādhivihīnaśca kālakarṇīvivarjitaḥ || tathā tvaṃ bhava dīrghāyurgrahendrāṇāṃ prasādataḥ ||11|| rakṣantu te devagaṇāḥ samantrāḥ dharme matiṃ cāpi sadā diśantu || nāśaṃ tathā śatrugaṇasya cograṃ bhogānmanojñānvipulāśca lakṣmīm || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śāntyavasāne pratisarabandhāśīrvādonāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 104 || || <1.105> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || haviṣyāśī tatastiṣṭhedbrahmacārī ca tāṃ niśām || grahaśāntiriyaṃ proktā mayā kalmaṣanāśinī || 1 || anāvṛṣṭyāṃ prayoktavyā vṛṣṭikāmena bhūbhujā || ativṛṣṭyāṃ prayoktavyā vṛṣṭiṃ śamayatā tathā || 2 || yātrākāle tathā kāryyā ripūṇāṃ kṣayamicchatā || raṇakāle tathā kāryyā saṃgrāme jayamicchatā || 3 || kartavyā cābhicārārthaṃ śatrūṇāṃ manujeśvara || puṣṭikāmairnaraiḥ kāryyā vidyākāmaistathaiva ca || 4 || lābhārthaṃ ca tathā vaiśyaiḥ śūdrairdharmmaphalepsubhiḥ || rājyakāmena kartavyā rājaputreṇa pārthiva || 5 || tathā vandhanamokṣārthaṃ baddhena ca mahīpate || sthānacyutena kartavyā sthānalabdhimathecchatā || 6 || vyādhitena ca kartavyā vyādheḥ praśamamicchatā || mārake ca tathā kāryā mārakakṣayamicchatā || 7 || parābhicāraśaṅkāyāṃ grahaśāntiṃ prayojayet || divyāntarikṣabhaumānāmutpātānāṃ tathodbhave || 8 || grahādhīnāṃ narendrāṇāmucchrāyāḥ patanāni ca || bhāvābhāvau ca jagatāṃ grahāyattau narādhipa || 9 || brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjayiṣyatha || tasmātsarvaprayatnena nṛṇāṃ pūjyatamā grahāḥ || 1.105.10 || gurubhaktasya dāntasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca || pūjakasya grahendrāṇāṃ sadā sānugrahā grahāḥ ||11|| mānavasyāsvatantrasya gobrāhmaṇahitasya ca || māṃsabhakṣaṇahīnasya sadā sānugrahā grahāḥ || 12 || ye bhaktāḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam || nāsti teṣāṃ jagatyasmindoṣo grahakṛto nṛṇām || 13 || yathā bāṇaprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhaveta || tathā daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam ||14|| grahayāgavidhiṃ samyagyaścādhīte narādhipa || grahapākitaṃ caiva tasyāpi na bhaviṣyati || 15 || atīva vistareṇeyaṃ grahaśāṃtirudāhṛtā || dhanyā yaśasyā cāyuṣyā sarvakilbiṣanāśinī || 16 || prayuñjataḥ samyagimāṃ narendra na jātu loke bhayamasti kiñcit || ārogyamāsādya ciraṃ ca jīvetprāpnoti lakṣmīṃ sakalām̐śca bhogān || 17 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde grahaśāntiphalavarṇano nāma pañcādhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 105 || <1.106> || vajra uvāca || dhruvasyāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha brāhmaṇānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || sambhavaṃ śrotumicchāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca mānada|| 1 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāmena pūrvameva narādhipa || ādityastamasāṃ hantā tejasāṃ golakaḥ kṛtaḥ ||2|| tamomayo golakaśca rāhustena tathā kṛtaḥ || ammayāni tathānyāni golakāni narādhipa||| kṛtāni tena dharmmajña graharkṣāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || dhruvasthānaniviṣṭāśca tārakāśca caturdaśa || 4 || teṣāṃ nāmavibhāgaṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu pārthiva || uttānapādastasyātha vijñeyaḥ sottaro hanuḥ || 5 || yajño'dharastu vijñeyo dharmo mūrdhānamāśritaḥ || hṛdi nārāyaṇaḥ sādhyāvaśvinau pūrvapādayoḥ || 6 || varuṇaścāryamā tasya paścime caiva sakthinī || śiśnaḥ saṃvatsarastasya mitro'pānaṃ samāśritaḥ || 7 || pucchegniśca mahendraśca mārīcaḥ kaśyapo dhruvaḥ || dhuvasthāsnurgraharkṣāṇāmmeḍhībhūtaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 8 || dhruveṇa bhrāmyate sarvamāyattaṃ tridive dhruve || dhruvo hi bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ || 9 || śiśumāranibaddhānāṃ tārakāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || nāmadheyāni vijñāya dṛṣṭvā ca vimale'mbare || 1.106.10 || āyurabhyadhikaṃ jīvedvarṣāṇi tu caturdaśa || ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇādeva mucyate || 11 || āmmayānāṃ graharkṣāṇāṃ mūrcchitāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ || janayanti prakāśatvaṃ nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 12 || sphāṭikāni vimānāni tathā sukṛtināṃ nṛpa || nāke tārakabaddhāni ammayānīva yādava || 13 || graharkṣāṇi samastāni dhruvaśca bhagavāṃstathā || kalpasthāyīni rājendra nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || || 14 || teṣāṃ tadabhimāninyo devatā yadunandana || manvantarādau jāyante na bhavanti punaḥpunaḥ || 15 || auttānapādirdhamātmā dhruvasteṣvapi yādava || svāyambhuventare jātastiṣṭhatyābhūtasaṃplavam || 16 || tasya te janma vakṣyāmi sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || pūrvaṃ brahmā mahīpāla sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ || 17 || dvidhā kṛtvātmano dehamardhena puruṣo'bhavat || ardhena nārī tasyāsīdvirājamasṛjatprabhuḥ || 18 || virāḍasṛjatpuruṣaṃ puruṣo manurucyate || yasyaikasaptatiguṇaṃ manvantaramihocyate || 19 || priyavratottānapādau manoḥ putrāvubhau smṛtau || kṣatrapravarttakau tau tu pūrve manvantare smṛtau || 1.106.20 || uttānapādaputrastu dhruvo viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ || nibaddho bhrāmyate yatra marutāṃ jyotiṣāṃ gaṇaḥ || 21 || saptarṣi maṇḍalaṃ nityaṃ tasyādhastātprakīrtitam || marīciśca vasiṣṭhaśca aṅgirāścātrireva ca || 22 || pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kratussaptarṣayo'malāḥ || vaśiṣṭhamāśritā sādhvī teṣāmmadhyādarundhatī || 23 || tasyādhastādbhacakrañca tasyādhastācchanaiścaraḥ || tasyādhastāttathā jīvastasyādhastātkujaḥ smṛtaḥ || 24 || tasyādhastāddineśaśca tasyādhastācca bhārgavaḥ || tasyādhastādbudhaḥ proktastasyādhastācca candramāḥ || || 25 || prāgdakṣiṇagatiścaiva jyotiṣāṃ cakramucyate || sarve grahāḥ prāggatayastulyavegāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 26 || śīghratvenopacaryante yathā sannaṃ mahīpate || yathā yathā viśiṣṭāśca tathā mandāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || 27 || teṣāṃ te sambhavaṃ vakṣye prāpte vaivasvate'ntare || teṣāṃ jananasāhasrairatītaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || 28 || anādinidhanaḥ śrīmānviṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || sa eva devakāryārthaṃ bhūtvā dvādaśadhā purā || 29 || aditerjanayāmāsa hyātmānaṃ kaśyapātprabhuḥ || teṣāṃ tu madhyātsavitā ādityasya ca devatā || 1.106.30|| proktaṃ te saviturjanma śṛṇu candramasastataḥ || daśabhyaśca diśābhyaśca tathātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ || 31 || viṣṇurevābhavadrājanputra sa mṛgalāñchanaḥ || dākṣāyaṇī vasornāma patnī dharmasya viśrutā || 32 || janayāmāsa dharmajñaṃ vasumadhye niśākaram || śrīsahāyastathā jātaḥ somaścāmṛtamanthanāt || 33 || prākāmyena śaśāṅkasya janma te'bhihitaṃ tridhā|| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava bhaumasya sambhavam || 34 || āsīddaityo hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaparākramaḥ || sa vai kanyāmajanayadvikeśī nāma nāmataḥ || 25 || sā lebhe tasya keśām̐stāṃ vai sthāṇurakāmayat || tasyāṃ maithunasaktasya deveśasya pinākinaḥ || 36|| vahnisammbhavabhītena kṛto vighno hyathāgninā || praviṣṭaṃ maithunāgāraṃ vahniṃ dṛṣṭavatastadā || 37 || krodhāyāsodbhavaḥ svedo harasya samapadyata || ānanasvedajo bindurdevasyāmitraghātinaḥ || 38 || tasyāḥ papāta vadane sā papau tatprayatnataḥ || antarvatnyatha tenāsīnna śaśāka ca tejasā||39|| mohitā tasya bālasya garbhaṃ dhārayituṃ tadā|| utsasarjātha taṃ garbhaṃ dīptānalasama dyutim || 1.106.40 || taṃ dadhāra mahīpāla dharā devīsvarūpiṇī || saṃskāramakaroccāsya svayameva ca kaśyapaḥ || 41 || aṅgāranikaṭasthatvānnāmnā cāṅgārakaḥ kṛtaḥ || uktaṃ te janma bhīmasya budhasyātaḥ paraṃ śṛṇu ||42|| kaśyapasya dhanurnāma patnī trailokyaviśrutā || janayāmāsa tanayaṃ rajonāmeti viśrutam || 43 || so'kāmayata vai kanyāṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ || vāruṇīmiti vikhyātāṃ trailokyasyaikasundarīm || 44 || tatastapaśca tejaśca balaṃ vīryaṃ tathaiva ca || śulkārthaṃ sa dadau tasyai tānādāya varāṅganā || 45 || apsu līnā tadā jātā patasogreṇa dānavaḥ || tāmapsu līnāṃ vijñāya praviveśodakaṃ tadā || 46 || tasyāḥ sparśopalambhena dravībhūtaḥ sa dānavaḥ || dravatāṃ samanuprāptāṃ tāṃ vijñāya niśākaraḥ || 47 || mamantha sahasā toyaṃ putrārthī manujeśvara || mathyamāne jale tena tadā somena pārthiva || 48 || viveśa tejasi payo viṣṇurdevanamaskṛtaḥ || tataḥ kumārassañjāto budhastu grahabodhanaḥ ||49|| taddadhāra tadā tārā gurupatnī yaśasvinī|| yadā dhārayituṃ śaktā na bālaṃ tejasānvitam||1.106.50|| dākṣāyaṇī cotsasarja candrapatnī sutaṃ tadā || evaṃ janma budhasyoktaṃ jīvasyātaḥ paraṃ śṛṇu ||51|| surūpā nāma duhitā mārīcestu prajāpateḥ || dattā tvaṅgirase sā tu rūpayauvanaśālinī||52|| tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa devācāryaṃ bṛhaspatim || bṛhadvācaṃ mahābuddhiṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam || 93 || uktaṃ te janma jīvasya śukrasyātaḥ paraṃ śṛṇu | uṣā nāma tathā kanyā hiraṇyakaśipossutā || 54 || bhṛgupatnī viśālākṣī sarvalokaikasundarī || janayāmāsa dharmajñaṃ khyātamauśanasaṃ prabhum || 55 || sa jahārātha yogātmā dhanaṃ vaiśravaṇasya tu || hṛte vitte tu yakṣeśo jagāma śaraṇaṃ haram || 56 || tataḥ kruddho mahādevo bhārgavaṃ hantumudyataḥ || bhārgavo'pi ca yogena praviveśa haraṃ tadā || 57 || harodarasthastuṣṭāva devīṃ parvatanandinīm || tayoktastaṃ tu tatyāja tadā śiśnena śaṅkaraḥ || 58 || śukrastu nāma caivāsya tadā cakre jagadguruḥ || dhaneśatvaṃ dadau cāsya dhaneśena sahānagha || 59 || maitryaṃ cāsya dhaneśena tathā cakre trilocanaḥ || śanaiścarasya vakṣyāmi janmātaste nareśvara || 1.106.60 || brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putrastvaṣṭā nāma prajāpatiḥ || saṃjñāṃ tu janayāmāsa kanyāṃ trailokyasundarīm || 61 || tāṃ dadau savituḥ patnīṃ tasyāṃ sūryo mahātapāḥ || janayāmāsa dharmajñaṃ manuṃ vaivasvataṃ prabhuma || 62|| yamaṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva trailokyasyaikapālinīma || teṣu jñāteṣu putreṣu saṃjñā sā cārulocanā || 63 || bhartustejo'tidurdharṣamasahantī varāṅganā || sā tu cchāyāṃ samāhūya idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 64 || madrūpeṇa tvayā bhadre vastavyamavikārayā || pālanīyau ca me putrau tvayemau duhitā ca me || 65 || evamuktā yayau devī pitaraṃ varavarṇinī || pitrā nirastā bhartāraṃ gacchagaccheti bhāṣitā || 66 || uttarāṃstu kurūngatvā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī || cacāra śādvalāñchubhrānvaneṣūpavaneṣu ca || 67 || chāyāyāṃ ca tathārkopi saṃjñeyamiti cintayan || dvau putrau janayāmāsa sāvarṇaṃ tu śanaiścaram || 68 || vajra uvāca || kathaṃ tāmāptavānsaṃjñāṃ bhūya eva divākaraḥ || etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi bhṛguvaṃśavivardhana || 69 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || putrayoḥ sūtaputrām̐stu yathā chāyānuvartate || na tathā vartate devī saṃjñāsūteṣu bhāminī || 1.106.70 || tataḥ kadācittāṃ kruddhaḥ saṃtatarja tadā yamaḥ || taṃ śaśāpa tadā cchāyā pādaste patatāmayam || 71 || yamaḥ śaśaṃsa tatsarvaṃ pituḥ parabalārdanaḥ || śrutvā yamasya vacanaṃ yamaṃ provāca bhāskaraḥ || 72 || kṛmayo māṃsamādāya tathā yāsyanti bhūtalam || evaṃ śāmyecca śāpaste tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi || 73 ||| etacchrutvā piturvākyaṃ cakāra sumahattapaḥ || ārādhayāmāsa tadā devadevaṃ janārdanam || 74 || tasmātsa lebhe dharmātmā dharmarājatvamañjasā || sūryo'pyavindam̐stattvena putraśāpasya kāraṇam ||75|| krodhāviṣṭastadā chāyāṃ papracchāmitraghātanaḥ|| śaśaṃsa tasya sā sarvaṃ yathāvṛttamaninditā ||76|| śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasyāstvaṣṭurveśmāgamadraviḥ || na dadarśa ca tatrasthāṃ tāṃ bhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm || 77 || tvaṣṭrā cāśaṃsitaṃ tasya vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī|| asahantī tu tejaste kurūnāvasate śubhā || 78 || bhramimāveśya deveśaṃ tvaṣṭāpi jagatāṃ patim || tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre devasya savitustadā||79 || kīrṇe tejasi tadrūpaṃ bhṛśaṃ kāntataraṃ sthitam || śīrṇena tejasā cakraṃ tvaṣṭā cakre jagadguroḥ || 1.106.80 || sudarśanamiti khyātaṃ devasya harimedhasaḥ || kāntarūpastu savitā hayarūpadharastadā || 81 || uttarāṃstu kurūngatvā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm || svāṃ dadarśa tadā bhāryāṃ śītaladravyasaṃyutām ||82 || maithunārthī tu tāṃ devo jagāma tvaritastadā || vegavantaṃ tu samprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā turagamuttamam || 83 || vyaceṣṭata ca sā devī parapuṃsopaśaṅkayā || mukhe ca bhāvayāmāsa tāṃ sūryo dīptadīdhitiḥ || 84 || tasyā nāsāpuṭau pūrṇau tadā śukreṇa pārthiva || tathā tasyāstadā jātau nāsatyāvaśvināvubhau || 85 || bhūmau ca patitaṃ yacca tābhyāṃ śukraṃ vimarditam || tasmātsośvātsamutpannaḥ kumāraḥ sūryasannibhaḥ || 86 || tataḥ svarūpamāsthāya devadevo'pi bhāskaraḥ || svarūpiṇīmathādāya saṃjñāṃ tāṃ svagṛhaṃ yayau || 87 || nāsatyau devabhiṣajau kṛtavānaśvināvubhau || tato vimardanājjātaṃ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā divākaraḥ ||88|| revanteti tadā tasya nāma cakre jagadguruḥ || taṃ ca putramuvācāttha sūryo grahagaṇeśvaraḥ ||89|| yasmātso'śvātsamutpanno mattastva ddīptadīdhitiḥ || pūjāmāpsyasi so'śvebhyastasmānnityaṃ jagatpriyaḥ || 1.106.90 || ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti teṣāṃ vṛddhirbhaviṣyati || śanaiścarasya te janma mayoktaṃ nṛpasattama || 91 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rāhorjanma tathānagha || dākṣāyaṇī siṃhikākhyā bhāryā vai kaśyapasya tu ||92|| akāle varayāmāsa bhartāraṃ tapasānvitam || bhagavanputrakāmāhaṃ taṃ prayaccha mamānagha||93|| akālayañcāsaṃkruddhastāṃ jagāda sa kaśyapaḥ || daityadānavasaṃkāśaṃ putra tvaṃ janayiṣyasi||94|| rāhuṃ sā janayāmāsa varadānānmahātmanaḥ|| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ketoste janma pārthiva||95|| prajānāṃ mahatīṃ vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || kṣaye tāsāṃ tadā cakre buddhiṃ buddhimatāṃ varaḥ || 96 || kṣayaṃ cintayatastasya prajānāṃ manujeśvara || prādurbhūtā tataḥ kanyā mṛtyurnāmeti viśrutā || 97 || tāṃ jagāda tadā brahmā prajāḥ saṃhara śobhane || sā tathoktā tadā tena ruroda varavarṇinī || 98 || tadāśrubindubhirjātā vyādhayo'tha sahasraśaḥ || dṛṣṭvā vyādhīnsamutpannānsaṃhṛtyāśrūṇi bhāminī || 99 || suduścaraṃ tapastepe puṣkarāraṇyamāśritā || sthāneṣu ca tathānyeṣu bahūnvarṣagaṇāñchubhā || 1.106.100 || bhūyo jagāda tāṃ brahmā prajāḥ saṃhara śobhane || mayoktaṃ yatpurā bhadre tattathā na tadanyathā || 101 || tapasā te varaṃ grāhyaṃ tadācakṣva suśobhane || nṛṇāṃ nimittaṃ maraṇe loke yāsyati doṣataḥ || 102 || na kaściddoṣato mantā tvāṃ kadācidapi dhruve || evamuktā tadā tena brahmaṇā sā śubhānanā |103|| dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvāsaṃ mumoca varavarṇinī|| kṛṣṇasarpasamākārastasmātketurajāyata|104|| śikhidīptaśikho rājankālānalasamaprabhaḥ || dhūmaprabhasya tasyātha keturūpasya pārthiva || 105 || saṃjñāṃ cakāra sarvātmā devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ || dhūmaketurayaṃ nāmnā bhaviṣyati jagattraye || 106 || darśayiṣyati lokānāṃ tathaiva ca śubhāśubham || divyantarikṣe bhuvi caika eṣaḥ sandṛśyate dhūmaketurmahātmā || saṃsthānarūpaistu bahuprakāraiḥ śubhāśubhaṃ darśayanmānuṣāṇām || 107 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde grahasambhavonāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 || <1.107> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pūrvaṃ brahmā mahīpāla sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ || abhyayuṅkta tadātmānaṃ tasya yuktasya pārthiva || 1 || tato'sya jaghanātpūrvamasurāñjajñire sutān || asuḥ prāṇaḥ smṛto vipraistajanmānastato'surāḥ ||2|| yathā sṛṣṭāḥ surāstanvā tāṃ tanuṃ sovyapohata || avyaktaṃ tattvabahulaṃ tatastānsobhyayuñjata ||3|| tatastānyuñjamānasya priyamāsītprabhoḥ kila || tato mukhātsamutpannā divyatastasya devatāḥ || 4 || utpannā divyatastasmāddevāstena tataḥ smṛtāḥ || dhāturdevīti yatproktaṃ krīḍārthaṃ saṃvibhāvyate ||5|| tasmāddevyāntu tanvāyāṃ jajñire tasya devatāḥ || devāndṛṣṭvā tataḥ so vai tanumanyāṃ prapadyata ||6 || sattvamātrātmikāmeva tanuṃ tāṃ so'bhyayuñjata || piteva manyamānastānsutānpravyādha sa prabhuḥ || 7 || pitaro hyupapakṣābhyāṃ madhye rātryahnayoḥ purā || tasmātte pitaro devāḥ pitṛtvaṃ teṣu tatsmṛtam || 8 || yayā sṛṣṭāstu pitarastanuṃ tāṃ sa vyapohata || sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyaḥ saṃdhyā vyajāyata|||| tasmādahardevatānāṃ rātriḥ syādāsurī matā || tayormadhye tu pitaraḥ sā tanustu garīyasī || 1.107.10 || tasmāddevāsurāścaiva ṛṣayo mānavāstathā || yuktāste tāmupāsante tathā viṣṇoryadantaram || 11 || tasmādrātryahnayoḥ sandhāvupāsante dvijāstu tām || tato'nyasyāṃ punarbrahmā sa tanvāmupapadyata || 12 || rājasattvātmikāyāṃ tu manasā so'sṛjatprabhuḥ || manasā tu tatastasya prajānāñjajñire prajāḥ || 13 || manasā ca manuṣyāste jananātprathitāḥ prajāḥ || sṛṣṭvā punaḥ prajāḥ saumyasyāṃ tanuṃ so'vyapohata || 14 || sāpaviddhā tanustena jyotsnā sadyaḥ prajāyata || tasmādbhavanti saṃhṛṣṭā jyotsnāyā udbhave prajāḥ || 15 || tāmutsṛjya tato jyotsnāṃ tato'nyā prāviśatpunaḥ || mūrtiṃ rajastamāsaktāṃ tatastāṃ sobhyayuñjata || 16 || tato'nyāssāndhakāre tu kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ prajāḥ sṛjan || tāḥ sṛṣṭvā tu kṣudhāviṣṭā aṃgulyā dātumudyatāḥ || 17 || aṃbhāṃsyetāni rakṣāma uktavantastu teṣu ye || rākṣasāste smṛtāstasmātkṣudhātmāno niśācarāḥ || 18 || dhruvaṃ kṣaṇomi yembhāṃsi teṣu dṛṣṭvā parasparam || tena te karmaṇā yakṣā guhyakāḥ krūrakarmiṇaḥ || 19 || rakṣaṇe pālane cāpi dhātureva vibhāvyate || yakṣa ityeṣa dhāturvai kṣepaṇe sannirudhyate || 1.107.20 || rakṣaṇādrakṣa ityuktāḥ kṣapaṇādyakṣa ucyate || tāndṛṣṭvā tatkṣaṇenāsya keśāḥ śīryanta dhīmataḥ || 21 || te śīrṇā vyutthitā hyūrdhvamārohanta tataḥ punaḥ || sarpaṇāttu smṛtāḥ sarpāḥ pannatvātpannagāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 || bālātmānaḥ smṛtā vyālā hīnatvāccāhayaḥ smṛtāḥ || pannatvātpannagāścāpi sarpāste'pāyasarpaṇāt || 23 || teṣāṃ layāḥ pṛthivyāpaḥ sūryācandramasau ghanāḥ || tasya krodho'bhavaddhūmamagnigarbhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 24 || sa tānsarpānsamutpannānāviveśa viṣātmakān || sarpāndṛṣṭvā tataḥ krodhatkrodhātmāno vinirmame || 25 || gāṃ dhayantastato dṛṣṭvā gandharvā agniretasaḥ || dhaya ityeṣa dhāturvai pāne hyeṣa nirudhyate || 26 || pibanto jajñire vācā gandharvāstena te smṛtāḥ || karṇena kapilā bhūtvā piśācāḥ kapiśā hyalam || 27 || bhūtatvātte smṛtā bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ piśitāśinaḥ || aṣṭāsu tāsu sṛṣṭāsu devayoniṣu sa prabhuḥ || 28 || tataḥ svacchandato'nyāni vayāṃsi vayasā sṛjan || pakṣiṇaḥ sa tu dṛṣṭvā vai tataḥ paśugaṇānsṛjan || 29 || mukhato'jāḥ sṛjanso vai vakṣasaścā vayo'sṛjat || gāvaścaivodarādbrahmā punaranyām̐śca nirmame || 1.107.30 || pādato'śvāṃsturaṅgāṃśca rāsabhāngavayānmṛgān || uṣṭrāṃścaiva varāhāṃśca śvānānanyāṃśca jātayaḥ || 31 || oṣadhyaḥ phalamūlinyo romabhistasya jajñire || evaṃvidhauṣadhīḥ sṛṣṭvā nyayujatso'dhvareṣu tāḥ || 32 || asya tvādau tu kalpasya tretāyugamukhe purā || gaurajaḥ puruṣothāvirathāśvataragardabhāḥ || 33 || ete grāmyāḥ smṛtāḥ sapta āraṇyāḥ sapta cāpare || mahiṣo gavayoṣṭrāstu dvikhuraḥ śarabho dvipaḥ || 34 || markaṭaḥ saptamasteṣāmāraṇyāḥ paśavastu te || gāyatrīṃ ca ṛcaṃ caiva trivṛtstomaṃ rathantaram || 35 || agniṣṭomaṃ ca yajñānāṃ nirmame prathamānmukhāt || yajño'pi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ stomaṃ pañcadaśastathā || 36 || bṛhatsāma tathoktaṃ ca dakṣiṇātso'sṛjanmukhāt || sāmāni jagatī caiva stomaṃ saptadaśaṃ tathā || 37 || vairūpyamatirātraṃ ca paścimātso'sṛjanmukhāt || atharvamekaviṃśaṃ ca triṣṭubvairājameva ca || apturyāmaṃ ca yajñānāṃ cottarātso'sṛjanmukhāt || 38 || vidyuto'śanimeghāṃśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca || 39 || sṛṣṭvā catuṣṭayaṃ pūrvaṃ devarṣipitṛmānavān || tato'sṛjatsa bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || 1.107.40 || sṛṣṭvā yakṣapiśācāṃśca gandharvāpsarasastathā || narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥ paśumṛgoragān || 41 || avyayaṃ ca vyayaṃ caiva dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam || jarāyujaṃ cāṇḍajaṃ ca sasvedajamathodbhijam || 42 || bhūtagrāmaṃ saṃkṛtavāndevadevaścaturvidham || paśavaśca mṛgāścaiva vyālāścobhayatodataḥ || 43 || rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāṃśca manuṣyāṃśca jarāyujāḥ || aṇḍajāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarpānakrānmatsyāṃśca kacchapān || 42 || yāni caivaṃ prakārāṇi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || svedajaṃ daṃśamaśakayūkāmakṣikamatkuṇam|| 45 || ūṣmaṇaścopajāyante yaccānyatkiñcidīdṛśam || udbhijāstaravaḥ sarve bījakāṇḍaprarohiṇaḥ || 46 || oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntā bahupuṣpaphalopagāḥ || apuṣpāḥ phalavanto ye te vanaspatayaḥ smṛtā ||47|| puṣpiṇaḥ phalinaścaiva vṛkṣāścobhayataḥ śubhāḥ || pratānāścaiva vallyaśca vīrudhaḥ parikīrtitāḥ||48|| gucchagulmaṃ tu vividhaṃ tathaiva tṛṇajātayaḥ || bījakāṇḍaruhāṇyeva pratānā vallya eva ca || 49 || tamasā bahurūpeṇa veṣṭitāḥ karmahetunā || anusaṃjñā bhavantyete sukhaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ || 1.107.50 || ekadantāstu gatayo brahmādyāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ || ghore'sminbhūtasaṃsāre nitye satatayāyini || 51 || yaṃ tu karmaṇi yasminsa nyayuṅkta prathamaṃ prabhuḥ || tattadeva svayaṃ tejo yujyamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 52 || hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukrūre dharmādharme ṛtānṛte || tadbhāvitā prapadyante tasmāttattasya rocate || 53 || yadyasya sodadātsarge sa tattatsvayamāviśat || yathartuliṅgānyṛtavaḥ svayameva tu paryaye || 54 || svānisvānyabhipadyante tathā karmāṇi dehinām || lokānāṃ tu viśuddhyarthaṃ mukhabāhūrupādataḥ || 55|| brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ ca niravartayat|| āsyādvai brāhmaṇā jātā bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyāḥ śubhāḥ || 56 || ūrubhyāṃ ca viśaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ śūdraḥ padbhyāmajāyata || varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dharmaṃ cakre pṛthakpṛthak||57|| svadharme ca niviṣṭānāṃ sthānāni vyadadhātprabhuḥ || brahmalokaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śākraṃ kṣattriyajanmanām ||58|| mārutaṃ ca viśāṃ sthānaṃ gāndharvaṃ śūdrajanmanām || brahmacārivratasthānāṃ brahmalokaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 59|| prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ yathāvihitakāriṇām || sthānaṃ sapta ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathaiva vanavāsinām || 1.107.60 || yatīnāmakṛtaṃ sthānaṃ yatrecchāgāmināṃ sadā || kṛtvā sa sūtrasaṃsthānaṃ prajāgarbhaṃ tu mānasam || 61 || athāsṛjatprajākartṝnmānasām̐stanayānprabhuḥ || dharmaṃ rudraṃ manuṃ caiva sanakaṃ ca sanandanam || 62 || bhṛguṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca ruciṃ śraddhāṃ tathaiva ca || marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum || 63 || vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahābhāgaṃ nāradaṃ ca mahāmunim || svabhāskarānbarhiṣadaḥ agniṣvāttāṃstathaiva ca || 64 || kravyādāṃścopahūtāṃśca ājyapāṃśca sukālinaḥ || ādyā mūrtivihīnāśca trayasteṣāṃ gaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 65 || caramāste gaṇāsteṣāṃ kathitāstu samūrtayaḥ || mahābhūtaśarīrāṇi sṛṣṭavānsa tathaiva ca || 66 || evaṃ kṛtvā prajāsargaṃ cāṃguṣṭhāddakṣiṇāttataḥ || sasarja dakṣaṃ bhagavānvāmāṃguṣṭhāttathaiva ca || 67 || sasarja bhāryāṃ tasyaiva devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ || tasyāṃ tu janayāmāsa dakṣo duhitaraḥ śubhāḥ ||68|| dadau tāśca sa dharmātmā brahmaputrebhya eva ca || satīṃ dadau sa rudrāya rudrā yasyāḥ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ || 69 || asaṃkhyeyā mahāvīryā haratulyaparākramāḥ || yairvyāptaṃ bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ sūryasyeva gabhastibhiḥ ||1.107.70|| bhṛgave ca dadau khyātiṃ rūpe ṇāpratimāṃ śubhām || bhṛgurdhātāvidhātārau janayāmāsa sāyudhau || 71 || śriyaṃ ca janayāmāsa khacarām̐śca turaṅgamān || bhṛguḥ prādācchriyaṃ devīṃ rājannārāyaṇasya ca||72|| tasyāṃ saṃjanayāmāsa balonmādau madotkaṭau || meroḥ parvatarājasya dve kanye bhuvi viśrute||73|| dhāturvidhātuste datte āyatirniyatistathā|| āyatirjanayāmāsa prāṇaṃ yadukulodvaha||74|| niyatirjanayāmāsa mṛkaṇḍuṃ tapasāṃ nidhim|| vyatīte saptame kalpe mṛkaṇḍoḥ sumahātmanaḥ||| ||75|| ahaṃ putraḥ samutpanno manasvinyāṃ narādhipa || patnī marīcessaṃbhūtirdakṣasya tanayā śubhā ||76|| prajāpatiṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ janayāmāsa bhāminī || pūrṇamāsasya virajāḥ sudāmā tu tadātmajaḥ || 77 || lokālokaniviṣṭastu lokapālo mayeritaḥ || putraśca paurṇamāsasya sarveśo nāma cāparaḥ || 78 || janayāmāsa putrau dvau stambaḥ kaśyapa eva ca || tayorgotrakarau putrau jñeyau saṃnyāsaniścayau || 79 || smṛtimaṅgirasaṃ prādāddakṣaḥ pūrvaṃ prajāpatiḥ || sinīvālī kuhū rākā tathaivānumatiḥ śubhā || 1.107.80 || tasyāṃ saṃjanayāmāsa agniṃ ca bharataṃ tathā || bharatasya tathā putraḥ parjanya iti viśrutaḥ || 81 || hiraṇyaromā parjanya udīcīṃ diśamāśritaḥ || lokāloke'vatiṣṭham̐ste lokapālo mayeritaḥ || 82 || anusūyāṃ dadau dakṣaḥ tathātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ || tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa taporāśikaraṃ param || 83 || prītiṃ dakṣaḥ pulastyāya dattorṇāṃ jananīṃ dadau || pulastyā kṣamāṃm prādātkardamasya tu mātaram || 84 || kārdamiḥ śaṅkhapādaśca dakṣiṇāmāśrito diśam || lokālokaniviṣṭaste lokapālo mayeritaḥ || 85 || dakṣaśca sannatiṃ prādātkratave bhūritejase || ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇi vālakhilyā iti smṛtāḥ || 86 || janayāmāsa dharmajñānsarvāṃ stānūrdhvaretasaḥ || dakṣaḥ prādādarthevorṇāṃ vasiṣṭhāya mahātmane || 87 || tasyāmasya sutā jātāḥ sapta saptāśvavarcasaḥ || rajobāhurūrdhvabāhuḥ pavanaścānaghaśca yaḥ || 88 || sutapāḥ śaktirityete vāsiṣṭhāḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || ketumānsumahātejā rājasaśca tathā sutaḥ || 89 || lokālokanivāsī te pratīcyāṃ sa mayeritaḥ || svāhāṃ prādātsa dakṣo'pi saśarīrāya vahnaye || 90 || divyāntarikṣabhaumānāmagnīnāṃ jananīṃ prabhuḥ || svadhāṃ prādātpitṛbhyastu menāyā jananīṃ śubhām || 91 || himācalāya menāpi pitṛbhiḥ pratipāditā || caturdaśemāḥ kanyāśca dakṣo dharmāya vai dadau || 1.107.90 || kītirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā matiḥ || buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntiḥ tuṣṭiḥ siddhiścaturdaśa || 93 || kīrtiputro yaśodevo darpo lakṣmīsutaḥ smṛtaḥ || niścayaśca dhṛteḥ putro medhāputrastathā śrutaḥ || 94 || puṣṭirlābhaḥ sutaścaiva kāmaḥ śraddhāsutaḥ smṛtaḥ || kriyāyāstanayo devo matiputrastathā damaḥ || 95 || buddherbodhaḥ sutaḥ prokto lajjāyā vinayaḥ smṛtaḥ || vapuṣo vyavasāyastu kṣemaḥ śāntisutastathā || 95 || tuṣṭeḥ putrastu santoṣaḥ sukhaḥ siddheśca bhāsvaraḥ || kāmasya ca ratirbhāryā tatputro harṣa ucyate || 97 || evaṃ prajāvivṛddhyarthaṃ dakṣo dattvā'tha kanyakāḥ || īje kadācidyajñena hayamedhena pārthiva || 98 || tasya jāmātaraḥ sarve gatā yajñanimantritāḥ || bhāryābhiḥ sahitāḥ sarve rudraṃ devaṃ satīṃ vinā || 99 || rudro natiṃ na kurute bhāvyarthavinicoditaḥ || kadācidapi dakṣaśca tenāsau na nimantritaḥ || 1.107.100 || anāhūtāpi ca gatā paścāttatra satī śubhā || dakṣānna lebhe pūjāṃ sā tataḥ kruddhā śubhānanā || 101 || tatyāja dakṣasambhūtāṃ tāṃ tanuṃ himakandare || vinaṣṭāṃ tu satīṃ śrutvā devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk || 102 || śaśāpa dakṣaṃ dharmajñaṃ manuṣyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || dhruvasyānvayasaṃbhūto rājā trailokyaviśrutaḥ || 103 || tatrāpi vighnaṃ kartāsmi yajñakarmaṇyupasthite || bhṛguṃ marīcimatriṃ ca pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum || 104 || śaśāpa caivāṅgirasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahāmunim || satīmanupravṛttasya dakṣasyāsya prajāpateḥ || 105 || anuvṛttiḥ kṛtā yasmādbhavadbhirdharmakovidaiḥ|| tasmādvaivasvate prāpte śubhe manvantare dvijāḥ || 106 || brahmaṇo yajamānasya janma krūramavāpsyatha || dehatyāge kṛte rājansatī devī mahābalā || 107 || umeti viśrutā loke menāyāḥ samapadyata || himācalo'pi tāṃ devīṃ dadau śarvāya pārthiva || || 108 || tayā viyujyate nāsau kadācidapi viśrutā || tasyāṃ tu janayāmāsa devadevo'pi śaṅkaraḥ || 109 || vināyakaṃ kumāraṃ ca bhṛṅgeśaṃ sumahābalam || vighnānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca putraṃ rājye'bhyaṣecayat || 1.107.110 || vināyakaṃ mahādevo gajavaktraṃ manasvinam || devasenāpatiṃ śakraḥ kumāraṃ kṛtavām̐stadā || 111 || na tatyāja samīpācca bhṛṃgeśaṃ śaṅkarastadā || vaivasvatentare prāpte rājā dakṣo vyajāyata || 112 || dhruvasyānvayasambhūto mahābalaparākramaḥ || tatrāśvamedhe vitate anāhūtena śūlinā || 113 || yajño vidhvaṃsitastasya vīrabhadreṇa pārthiva || sa dakṣo janayāmāsa kanyāḥ pārthivasattama || 114 || tāsāṃ ca madhyātpradadāvaṣṭāviṃśatimindave || devatāstvabhimāninyo nakṣatrāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 115 || uktaṃ hi te ṛkṣa gaṇasya janma śubhāvahaṃ pāpabhayāpahaṃ ca || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tattvaṃ vadasvāyatalohitākṣa ||116|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 graharkṣādisaṃbhavādhyāyo nāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||107 || || <1.108> || vajra uvāca || || dakṣasya vaṃśaṃ sakalaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca saṃbhavam || tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || auttānapādirdharmātmā dhruvaḥ pūrvaṃ mayoditaḥ || dhruvastvajanayatsṛṣṭiṃ mahābalapagakramām || 2 || tasya prācīnagarbhastu putrastasyāpyudāradhīḥ || divaṃjayastasya sutastasya putro ripuḥ smṛtaḥ || 3 || ripoḥ putrastathā śrīmāṃścākṣuṣaḥ kīrtito manuḥ || ūrustasya sutaḥ śrīmānaṅgastasyāpyathātmajaḥ || 4 || atrirjagrāha taṃ putraṃ dattakaṃ tu yaśasvine || aṅgasya venaḥ putrastu nāstiko dharmavarjitaḥ || 5 || asacchāstrarato nityaṃ lokāyatikasattamaḥ || cakāra loke maryādāṃ dharmabāhyo narādhipaḥ || 6 || na yaṣṭavyaṃ na hotavyaṃ na deyaṃ dharmakāraṇam || ṛṣayastaṃ samāgamya kadācidvākyamabruvan || 7 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || pūrvapravṛttāṃ maryādāṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ kṛtām || lokāyatikavākyena na tvaṃ hantumihārhasi || 8 || karmaṇā sukṛteneha sukhaṃ jantu samaśnute || duḥkhaṃ jantuśca prāpnoti duṣkṛtena ca karmaṇā || 9 || ye yajante sadā devānguruśuśrūṣakāśca ye || viprapūjāratā ye ca tīrthayātrāratāśca ye | 1.108.10 || tapasvinaḥ satyaratā ye ca dāne sadā ratāḥ || samaśnuvanti bhūpāla paraloke sukhāni te || 11 || sa tvaṃ sukhaparibhraṣṭānnṛlokāngantumarhasi || vena uvāca || bhavatāṃ kiṃ pralāpena vṛthaiva dvijapuṅgavāḥ || 12 || ye mṛtāste mṛtāḥ sarve mṛtānāṃ sambhavaḥ kutaḥ || prāṇasya vāyubhūtasya niṣkrāntasya śarīrataḥ || 13 || bhūyaḥ śarīragrahaṇaṃ yuktyā naivopapadyate || tapāṃsi hāyanāścitrāḥ saṃyamo bhogavañcanā || 14 || agnihotrādikaṃ karma bālakrīḍeva lakṣyate || grāmyāṇāṃ mūḍhacittānāṃ sragviṇāṃ caiva yoṣitām || 15 || anyeṣāṃ caiva dhanināṃ dhūrterādi tsubhirdhanam || śāstrāṇyanekarūpāṇi grathitāni sahasraśaḥ || 16 || dehi nityaṃ yajasvaivaṃ devāste'nugrahīkṛtāḥ || dhanamāpsyasi śatrūṃśca vijeṣyasi sukhaṃ ca te || 17 || mugdhā evaṃ pratāryante dhūrtairdhanajihīrṣayā || yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ jīvennāsti mṛtyoragocaram || 18 || bhasmībhūtasya śāntasya punarāgamanaṃ kutaḥ || nāsti dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ na devā ṛṣayo na ca || 19 || mayāptaṃ bhuvi rājyaṃ ca bhogāścānye pṛthagvidhāḥ|| kathaṃ prāptaṃ hi tyakṣyāmi bhavatāṃ vacanena vai || 1.108.20 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etacchrutvā vacastasya venasya nṛpasattama || ṛṣayastamathocuste rājānaṃ duṣṭacetasam || 21|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || naitadaupayikaṃ vākyaṃ dhruvavaṃśodbhavasya te || pratyakṣaṃ karmaṇāṃ loke phalaṃ pārthiva dṛśyate || 22|| kāṅkṣyamāṇāñjanānpaśya bhojanācchādanaṃ param || sahasraṃbharakānanyānpaśya bhūpāla mānavān ||23|| śibikābhyastathaivānyāngacchamānānyathāsukham || kṣudhayā ca parītāṃśca śākocchiṣṭabhujastathā || 24 || kāṣṭhabhārasamākrāntānparibhūtānparaistathā || jugupsitām̐stathā dīnānbahuśalyānnarām̐stathā || 28 || paṅgūnanyānkubjakāṃśca kuṣṭhajvaravipīḍitān || raugairbahubhirākrāntānparibhūtānparaistathā||26|| tārkikānkṛpaṇāndīnānvyādhigrastānsukhacyutān|| iṣṭabandhuviyogārtānpaśya pāpena mānavān ||27|| ārogyarūpasattvaujodhanadhānyasamanvitān || dharmeṇa ca janānpaśya bandhubhṛtyasamanvitān||28|| rājamārgamimaṃ lokāstava karmānuvartate || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tatasteṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣīṇāmugracetasām || 29 || hastena hastaṃ saṃghaṭya prahasam̐stānuvāca ha || vena uvāca || śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā || 1.108.30 || nāpnuvanti janā viprāḥ prāpnuvanti svabhāvataḥ || svabhāvaśca vicitro'yaṃ saṃsārodvejakaḥ sadā || 31 || nātra pūrvakṛtaṃ karma dhūrtavādo yathā dvijāḥ || aśmānaḥ karmaṇā kena sūkṣmāścānye mahattarāḥ || 32 || vinyastāḥ karmaṇā kena surārcāpāpabhūmiṣu || pāṣāṇārcādidattena kathaṃ tuṣyanti devatāḥ || 33 || ke deśā na mayā dṛṣṭā nāpi pūrvaṃ pitāmahaḥ || nānyairjanyaistathā tāṃśca dhūrtavākyātpratīmahe || 34 || anyabhuktena cānyasya tṛptiścaiva kathaṃ bhavet || anyabhuktena cānyasya yadi tṛptirbhavi ṣyati || 35 || dadyātpravasite śrāddhaṃ na sa pathyaudanaṃ mahat || mṛtasya pakṣe dagdhasya bhasmībhūtasya vā punaḥ || 36 || sarvabhāvavinaṣṭasya kiṃ nu śrāddhaiḥ prayojanam || kṛpaṇairyaja dehīti dhanalubdhaiḥ prakīrtitam || 37 || dhanināṃ dhananāśāya satataṃ svārthatatparaiḥ || dharme niviṣṭāḥ puruṣā dṛśyante duḥkhajīvinaḥ || 38 || sukhānvitā hi dṛśyante pāpakarmaratāstathā || tasmāddharmeṇa kiṃ kāryaṃ sukhaṃ jīvettu paṇḍitaḥ || puruṣārthaḥ paraḥ kāmo dhanena ca tadāpyate ||39|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || pratyakṣameva paśyantaḥ pūrvajanmani mānavāḥ ||1.108.40|| paralokaṃ na paśyanti paśya devena vañcitāḥ || jātamātro yathā jantustanaṃ gṛhṇāti pārthiva || 41 || pūrvajanmāntarābhyāsaṃ vinā tatkasya ceṣṭitam || prāṇena vāyubhūtena janmanyasminyathā naraḥ || 42 || karoti dehagrahaṇaṃ janmāntaragatastathā || mahīvikāramaśmānaḥ karmajīvavivarjitān || 43 || sūkṣmatvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca teṣāmīśvarakāritam || mantreṇa nīyate śrāddhaṃ paralokagate jane || 44 || dṛṣṭaḥ pravāsino naiva tathā mantrasya pārthiva || prākāmyayuktā devāśca yuktā laghimanā tathā || 45 || jñānayuktāśca gṛhṇanti sarvatra viniveditam || dharmamāsevatāṃ nṛṇāṃ vipattiryā narādhipa || 46 || pūrvajanmakṛteneha sukṛtena ca karmaṇā || sutapteneha tapasā brāhmaṇairvasudhādhipa || 47 || śāpāni dīyamānāni pratyakṣaṃ kinna paśyasi || amoghāśāstathā viprāḥ sutaptatapaso nṛpa || 48 || kinna paśyasi loke'sminpratyakṣaṃ dharmadarśanam || bījāni bījakāleṣu yairevāptāni pārthiva || 49 || ta eva loke dṛśyante pratyakṣaphalabhāginaḥ || dṛṣṭvā mantraprabhāveṇa viprakarṣaṇatatparān || 1.108.50 viṣāpahāraṃ kurvāṇāndharmo'pyastīti cintaya || yeṣāmapi vacaḥ kṣudraṃ paralokaṃ na vidyate || 51 || te'pyudvijante pāpānāṃ tasmātpāpaṃ vivarjaya || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etacchrutvā tu vacanamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 52 || hṛtottarastadā dīno nottaraṃ pratyabhāṣata || cintayāmāsa manasā brāhmaṇairdharmatatparaiḥ || 53 || yadetaduktaṃ vacanaṃ mithyaitannātra saṃśayaḥ || abhiprāyaṃ narendrasya jñātvā brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ || ||54|| vinaṣṭaṃ menire sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || etasminnantare devairbrāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām || 55 || buddhirniveśitā tasya vināśāya durātmanaḥ || sarveśvaraḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvadṛksarvasādhanaḥ || 56 || prārthitaśca tadā viṣṇuḥ pṛthivīrājyakāraṇāt || devā ūcuḥ || dhruvavaṃśodbhavaṃ deva venaṃ bhūpālakilbiṣam || 57 || brāhmaṇā ghātayiṣyanti mantrapūtaiḥ kuśodakaiḥ || ūrū cāsya tataḥ kṣipraṃ mathiṣyanti samāhitāḥ || 58 || kuruṣva saṃbhavaṃ tatra lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || kṛtvā tu saṃbhavaṃ tatra pālayasva jagattrayam || 59 || āsthāya mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tvaṃ hi pālaya tāpataḥ || evaṃ kariṣya ityuktaṃ devadevena dakṣiṇa || 1.108.60 || devakrodhena saṃkuddhā nijaghnurbrāhmaṇā nṛpam || mantrapūtaiḥ kuśaiḥ sarvaistatastasya durātmanaḥ || 61 || ūrū mamanthuḥ sahasā tato'sya tanayo'bhavat || hrasvo'timātraṃ kṛṣṇāṃgo dāruṇo dāruṇākṛtiḥ || 62 || niṣīdeti tamūcuste brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || sarvabhūtaniṣādānāmṛṣivākyena pārthiva || 63 || niṣādavaṃśakartāraṃ venakalmaṣasambhavam || tato'sya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ mamanthuḥ sahasā dvijāḥ ||64 || tasmādasya suto jāto viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk || pṛthurityeva nāmānya cakruste dvijapuṅgavāḥ || tena jātena putreṇa venaḥ pāpādamucyata |||65 || satputralābhāttridivaṃ jagāma veno durātmā kṛtasarvapāpaḥ || dṛṣṭvāpi jātamṛṣayaḥ kumāraṃ saṃmenire lokamidaṃ kṛtārtham || 66 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pṛthūdbhavo nāmāṣṭottaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 108 || <1.109> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ādyamājagavaṃ nāma dhanurgṛhya mahāyaśāḥ || dṛṣṭvā jātaṃ pṛthuṃ devāḥ sarva eva savāsavāḥ || 1 || ājagmuḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamabhiṣektuṃ tadā pṛthum || taṃ cābhisiṣicurdevā ratnacitravarāsane || 2 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca candrādityau prabhākarau || diśaśca vidiśaścaiva lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ || 3 || sarve devagaṇāścaiva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || svaṃ svaṃ toyamupādāya samudrāśca narādhipa || 4 || sarāṃsi saritaḥ śailāḥ sarve tīrthavarāstathā || so'bhiṣiktastadā śrīmānvenaputraḥ parantapa || 5 || saṃvatsaraḥ kṛtastasya vṛddhagargo mahāyaśāḥ || sthitā śiṣyavarā nityaṃ tasyotpātanirīkṣaṇe || 6 || purohitaḥ kṛtastasya yājñavalkyo mahāyaśāḥ || ātharvagena yastasya sarvāndoṣānvyapohata || 7 || uśanāśca tathā mantrī kṛtastasya mahātmanaḥ || ṣāḍguṇyayogādyastasya sarvāndoṣānvyapohata || 8 || kamalābharaṇo nāma supratīkasutastadā || rājahastī kṛtastasya svayaṃ gargeṇa dhīmatā || 9 || śrīsutasturagaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śaśāṅkasadṛśacchaviḥ || maṅgalāśvaḥ kṛtastasya vṛddhagargeṇa pārthiva || 1.109.1 0 || svayaṃ devavaraistasya dattāni manujādhipa || chatraṃ savālavyajanaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca vasudhādhipa || 11 || tasya lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dadurdevā nareśvara || ityevaṃ cābhiṣiktastu pṛthurvainyo mahāyaśāḥ || 12 || vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena brāhmaṇairmantrapāragaiḥ || tasya paitāmahe yajñe hayamedhe purātane ||13|| āpturyāmasya sutye'hni sūto jātaḥ parantapa || sāmageṣvatha gāyatsu adhvare vaiśvadevike || 14 || māgadhaśca samutpannastasminneva mahākratau || pṛthostavārthaṃ tau devau coditāvṛṣibhistathā || 15 || ūcatustau tadā devānṛṣīṃśca praṇatau sthitau || karmabhistūyate sarvaḥ karma cāsya na vidmahe || 16 || karmaṇaścātyavijñānātstoṣyāvastatkathaṃ pṛthum || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| asmatprabhāvavijñātau stuvatāmavicārataḥ ||17|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| ṛṣibhistau niyuktau tu tuṣṭuvāte svakarmabhiḥ|| bhaviṣyatpṛthivīpālaṃ divya jñānau parantapa||18|| tayovairnyastu suprītaḥ pṛthuḥ prādātprajeśvaraḥ|| anūpadeśaṃ sūtāya magadhaṃ māgadhāya ca||19|| tato vainyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ prajāstāḥ saṃpradudruvuḥ|| tvanno vṛttaṃ dadasveti maharṣivacanāttadā || 1.109.20 || so'bhidrutaḥ prajābhistu prajāhitacikīrṣayā || dhanurādāya bāṇāṃśca vasudhāṃ mardayanbalī || 21 || tato vainyabhayatrastā gaurbhūtvā prādravanmahī || brahmalokādikām̐llokānna ca trāṇamavindata || 22 || sarvatraiva pṛthuṃ vainyamāttakārmukamacyutam || dadarśa sumahābhāgaṃ tejasā bhāskaraprabham || 23 || alabhantī tu sā trāṇaṃ venyamevānvapadyata || kṛtāñjalipuṭā devī pūjyā lokaistribhistadā || 24 || uvāca vainyaṃ nādharmaṃ strīvadhe paripaśyasi || kathaṃ dhārayitā cāsi mayā hīnāstvimāḥ prajāḥ || 25 || pṛthuruvāca || ekasyārthāya yo hanyādātmano vā parasya vā || ekaṃ jīvaṃ bahutve'pi kāmaṃ naivāsti pātakam ||26 || yasmiṃstu nihate bhadra edhante bahavaḥ sukham || tasminhate nāsti paraṃ pātakaṃ nopapātakam || 27 || so'haṃ prajānimittaṃ tvāṃ vadhiṣyāmi vasundharām || ātmānaṃ prathayitvā tu dhārayiṣye prajāstvimāḥ || 28 || vṛtyupāyaṃ na cedāsāṃ prajānāṃ tvaṃ vidhāsyasi || vidhāsyasi yadā bhadre tadā tvaṃ sukhamāpsyasi || 29 || pṛthivyuvāca || prajānāṃ jīvanopāyaṃ vidhāsyāmi nareśvara || vidhatsva vatsaṃ dharmajña kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā || 1.109.30 || samāṃ ca kuru sarvatra mama dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || yathā niṣyandamānaṃ vai kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvayet || 31 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tata utsārayāmāsa śilājālāni sarvataḥ || puthurvainyo mahātejāstena śailā vivarddhitāḥ || 32 || tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra grāmāśca nagarāṇi ca || kṛṣyādikaṃ ca sakalaṃ bhuvi karma pravartitam || 33 || tasyāḥ sasyāni sā dugdhā pṛthunā pṛthivī kṣitā || vatsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ kṛtvā manuṃ vai dakṣiṇe kare || 34 || tatastu ṛṣibhirdugdhā cchandaḥpātre vasundharā || vatsaḥ somobhavatteṣāṃ dogdhā caiva bṛhaspatiḥ || 35 || ūrjaṃ devagaṇairdugdhā rukmapātre vasundharā || vatsastu maghavānāsīddogdhā ca savitā tathā || 36 || sudhāṃ ca pitṛbhirdugdhā raupyapātre vasundharā|| antakaścābhavaddogdhā vatso vaivasvato yamaḥ ||37|| payaścaivāyase pātre dugdhā daityairvasundharā || dogdhā gaganamūrdhā sā vatsaṃ kṛtvā virocanam ||38|| alābupātre sarpaiśca viṣaṃ dugdhā dharā tathā || teṣāṃ ca vāsukirdogdhā vatsaścāsīcca takṣakaḥ || 39 || antardhānaṃ yadā yakṣe rāmapātre vasundharā || dugdhā rajatanābhena vatsaṃ kṛtvā dhaneśvaram||1.109.40|| kapāle rudhiraṃ dugdhā rākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ || hetiḥ prahetiśca tathā dogdhā vatsastathā'bhavat|| ||41|| dugdhā gandhānpadmapātre gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || vatsaścitrarathasteṣāṃ dogdhā vasurucistathā||42|| oṣadhyaśca tathā śailairdugdhā pātre śilāmaye|| vatsastu himavānāsīddogdhā merurmahāgiriḥ || 43 || palāśapātre vṛkṣaistu dugdhā puṣpaphalaṃ śubham || kāmadhukca tataḥ sālaṃ plakṣo vatsastu vai smṛtaḥ || ||44|| sarvakāmadughā dogdhrī pṛthivī bhūtabhāvinī || saiṣā dhātrī vidhātrī ca jananī bhāvanī tathā ||45|| carācarasya lokasya pratiṣṭhotpattireva ca || sarvabhūtahiraṇyā ca sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇī || 46 || vargadā medinī bhūmiḥ kṣamā kṣoṇī vasundharā || sarvabhūtaśarīrasthā sarvānugrahakāriṇī || 47 || manvantare'sminsaṃprāpte vainyena pṛthivīkṣitā || prathamaṃ vasudhā dugdhā tato dugdhā yathoditaiḥ || 48 || duhitṛtvaṃ gatā tasya pṛthivī tena cocyate || evaṃprabhāvaḥ sa purā pṛthurāsīnmahīpatiḥ || 49 || pitrā'parañjitāstasya prajāssenānurāñjanāḥ || prajānāṃ rañjanāttasya nāma rājeti kīrtitam || 1.109.50 || rājā bhojo virāṭ samrāṭ gopatiḥ pārthivastathā || sa evokto mahīnātha śabdaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ || 51 || namaskārastu kartavyastasya nityaṃ dvijottamaiḥ || vedakāmairvedavidbhiḥ prārthayadbhirmahadyaśaḥ || 52 || pārthivaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ prārthayadbhirmahadyaśaḥ || vṛttidātā tathā vaiśyairnamaskāryastathā pṛthuḥ || 53 || śūdrairapi namaskāryo dharmakāmairmahīpatiḥ || kṣemepsubhistathā dhyāne namaskāryaḥ pṛthurnṛpaḥ || 54 || yo hi yodho raṇe yāti kīrtayitvā pṛthuṃ nṛpam || sa ghorarūpātsaṃgrāmātkṣemī bhavati pārthiva || 55 || pṛthoḥ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ sarvatra vijayī bhavet || tasmāttasya namaskāraḥ sadā kāryo jayepsunā || 56 || vainyasya bhūpālavarasya rājañchrutvābhiṣekaṃ prayato manuṣyaḥ || pāpaṃ samagraṃ vijahāti śīghraṃ jayaṃ tathāpnoti yaśaśca loke || 57|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pṛthvabhiṣekādivarṇanaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 109 || <1.110> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || antardhānaḥ pṛthoḥ putro havirdhānastadātmajaḥ || prācīnabarhistatputraḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau || 1 || upayeme samudrasya lavaṇasya sa vai sutām|| suvarṇāyāṃ tu sāmudryāṃ daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ || 2 || sarve prācetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ || apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste'tapyanta mahattapaḥ || 3 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ || samudrageṣu daśasu tapasyatsu mahīruhāḥ || 4 || arakṣamāṇāṃ gāṃ vavrurbabhūvetthaṃ prajākṣayaḥ || na śakyo māruto vātuṃ vṛttaṃ khamabhavaddrumaiḥ || 5 || tadupaśrutya rājānaḥ sarve yuktāḥ pracetasaḥ || mukhebhyo vāyumagniṃ ca sasṛjurjātamanyavaḥ || 6 || nirmūlānatha vṛkṣāṃstānkṛtvā vāyuraśoṣayat ||7|| tānagniradahatkruddha evamāsīdrumakṣayaḥ || drumakṣayamatho dṛṣṭvā kiñciddagdheṣu śākhiṣu || upagamyābravīdetānsomo rājā pracetasaḥ || 8||| kopaṃ tyajata rājānaḥ sarve prācīnabarhiṣaḥ || kṛtā mahī vṛkṣaśūnyā śāmyetāmagnimārutau || 9 || ratnabhūtā ca kanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ varavaṇiṃnī || bhaviṣyaṃ jānatā hyeṣā dhṛtā garbheṇa vai mayā || 1.110.10 || māriṣā nāma bhavatāṃ patnyarthe pradadāmyaham || tataḥ somasya vacanājjagṛhuste pracetasaḥ || 11 || saṃhṛtya kopaṃ vṛkṣebhyaḥ patnīdharmeṇa māriṣām || manasā ca dadhustasyāṃ garbhaṃ sarve pracetasaḥ || 12 || daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ || bhavaśāpena saṃbhūto bhūyo dakṣaprajāpatiḥ || 13 || asṛjanmanasā dakṣaḥ prajāḥ pūrvaṃ caturvidhāḥ || notpadyante ca tāstasya apadhyātā hareṇa tu|| 14 || maithunena tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kartumicchanprajāpatiḥ || asiknīmavahadbhāryāṃ vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ || 15 || sutāṃ sumahatīṃ yuktāṃ tapasā lokadhāriṇīm || tasya putrasahasraṃ tu vīriṇyāṃ samapadyata || 16 || tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā mahātejā vivardhayiṣavaḥ prajāḥ | tānuvāca mahātejā brahmaputraḥ sa nāradaḥ||17|| kiṃ pramāṇaṃ tu medinyāṃ sraṣṭavyasya tathaiva ca|| ajñānāttu kathaṃ sargaṃ bhavantaḥ kartumudyatāḥ||18|| mahīmānamathānveṣṭuṃ gatā dakṣasutāstataḥ || lokālokasya parato garbhodasya tathopari ||19|| vāyumaṇḍalamāsādya bhramaṇānnāśamāgatāḥ || dakṣo'pi teṣu naṣṭeṣu vīriṇyāmeva dharmavit || 1.110.20 || sahasraṃ janayāmāsa putrāṇāmaparaṃ tataḥ || vivardhayiṣavaste tu śabalāśvāḥ punaḥ prajāḥ || 21 || pūrvamuktaṃ vacastadvai śrāvatā nāradena tu || anyonyamūcuste sarve samyagāha mahānṛṣiḥ ||22|| bhrātṝṇāṃ padavīṃ caiva gantavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| gate'pi haryaśvamārgeṇa prayātāḥ pṛthivīmimām || 23 || tameva vāyumāsādya vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīssamāḥ || tadāprabhṛti vai bhrāntā bhrāturanveṣaṇe ratāḥ || 24 || prayāto naśyati vibho tannaḥ kāryaṃ vijānatā || atha teṣu vinaṣṭeṣu dakṣaḥ kopasamanvitaḥ ||25|| śaśāpa nāradaṃ kruddhaḥ tulyaṃ janma na cāpsyasi || dehaṃ tyaktvā saśāpena tena dakṣasya nāradaḥ || 26 || bhūyo munisuto jātaḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ || aśvamedhaṃ ca vitataṃ dakṣasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ || 27 || vidhvaṃsayāmāsa haraḥ pūrvavaireṇa bhrāvitaḥ || dakṣo'pi śaptavānudraṃ śaptāste brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||28 || adyaprabhṛti yakṣyanti natvā sārdhaṃ divaukasaiḥ || janmāntare'pi vairāṇi vinaśyanti na pārthiva || 29 || tasmādvairaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācidapi kenacit || haryaśveṣvapi naṣṭeṣu mahātmasu purā tadā || 1.110.30 || asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa dakṣo duhitarastadā || ṣaṣṭiḥ kanyā rūpayuktāstapasā mahatā yutāḥ || 31 || dve dadau bāhuputrāya catasro'riṣṭanemine || dve prādātsa kṛśāśvāya daśa dharmāya cāpyatha || 32 || caturdaśa kaśyapāya cāṣṭāviṃśatimindave || pradadau bāhuputrāya suprabhāṃ bhāminīṃ tadā || 33 || manoramāṃ bhānumatīṃ viśālāṃ bāhudāmatha || dakṣaḥ prādānmahābhāgaścatasro'riṣṭanemine||34|| sa kṛśāśvāya ca prādātsuprabhāṃ ca tathā jayām || arundhatīṃ vasuṃ jāmiṃ lambāṃ bhānumirāvatīm ||35|| saṃkalpāṃ ca muhūrtāṃ ca sādhyāṃ viśvāṃ tathaiva ca || dadau sa daśa dharmāya mahātmā lokaviśrutaḥ||36|| aditirditirdanuḥ kālā danāyuḥ siṃhikā muniḥ || kadrūḥ krodhā irā prādhā vinatā surabhiḥ khagā || 37 || caturddaśaitāḥ pradadau kaśyapāya prajāpatiḥ || nāmabhiḥ pūrva vikhyātāḥ kṛttikādyāstathaiva ca || 38 || dadau nakṣatrayoginya aṣṭāviṃśatimindave || devatāstvabhimāninyo nakṣatrāṇāṃ mahīpate || 39 || etāvaduktaṃ tava dakṣavaṃśamṛkṣodbhavaṃ cāpyatha bhūmipāla || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vāsvāyata lohitākṣa ||1.110.40|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 dakṣavaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 110 || || <1.111> || vajra uvāca || || mahādevena ṛṣayaḥ śaptāḥ svāyaṃbhuve'ntare || teṣāṃ vaivasvate prāpte saṃbhavaṃ mama kīrtaya || 1 || dākṣāyaṇī ca tathā pra kīrtaya me vibho || ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathā vaṃśaṃ bhṛguvaṃśa vivardhana || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || manvantare'sminsaṃprāpte rājanvaivasvate purā || aśvamedhe tu vitate brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 3 || mahādevasya śāpena tyaktvā dehānsvayaṃ tataḥ || ṛṣayastu samudbhūtā drute śukre prajepsayā || 4 || devānāṃ mātaro dṛṣṭvā devapatnīstathaiva ca || skannaṃ śukraṃ mahārāja brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 5 || tajjuhāva tato brahmā tato jāto hutāśanāt || tato jāto mahātejā bhṛguḥ sa tapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 6 || aṅgāresvaṃgirā jātassabhāryo'tristathaiva ca || marīcibhyo marīciśca tato jāto mahātapāḥ ||7|| vasumadhyātsamutpanno vasiṣṭhaśca mahātapāḥ || bhṛguḥ pulomnaśca sutāṃ divyāṃ bhāryāmavindata || 8 || yasyāṃ tasya sutā jātā devā dvādaśa yājñikāḥ || bhuvano bhāvanaścaiva sujanyaḥ sujanastathā ||9|| kratuḥ suvaśca pūgaśca vyājaśca vyaśnujaśca ha || prasavaścāvyayaścaiva dakṣo dvādaśamastathā || 1.111.10 || ityete bhṛgavo nāma devā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ || paulomyajanayadvipra devānāṃ tu kanīyasam || 11 || cyavanaṃ tu mahābhāgamātmavantaṃ tathāpyasau || ātmavānātmajastvaurvo jamadagnistadātmajaḥ || 12 || aurvo gotrakarastasya bhārgavānāṃ mahātmanām || tatra gotrakarānvakṣye bhṛgordīptojasastvaham || 13 || bhṛguśca cyavanaścaiva ātmavāṃstu tathaiva ca || aurvaśca jamadagniśca vātsyo daṃbhirnaḍāyanaḥ || 14 || nāgāyano vahetiśca peluścerānuśātikaḥ || śaunakāyanajīvantiḥ kauyodhaḥ pārṣatistathā || 15 || vaihīnarirvirūpākṣo rohiṇyāyanireva ca || vaiśvānarirupārīrurvaśāvaṇirvṛkāsvakaḥ || 16 || viṣṇuḥ paureyavālākitaulikenāntabhāginaḥ || mṛta bhāgeyamarkaṇḍajihitodīdhinastathā || 17 || maṇḍūmāṇḍavyamaṇḍūkasphenasāṅkṛtinastathā || sthālipiṇḍiḥ śilāpattiḥ śārkarākṣistathaiva ca ||18|| sṛkāyaṇo devamatiḥ ṣāṇḍharāyiḥ sigālavaḥ || sakṛtvaścātakiḥ kāyiryājño dārbhistrilāyaniḥ || 19 || gārgyāyaṇo hvāyanaśca ṛṣirgehāyana stathā || goṣṭhyāyano vāhyāyano vaiśampāyana eva ca || 1.111.20 || vaikarṇeyiḥ śārṅgaravo yājñeyirbhrāṣṭakāyanaḥ || lalāṭirlakuṭiścaiva lākṣmyāyāḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ || 21 || ūlumbiḥ śailukiḥ koṣṭistathānyaḥ paippalāyaniḥ || satyāyanirmālayaniḥ koṭāliḥ kaucahastikaḥ || 22 || śokriḥ śaukliḥ sa kaucākṣiḥ kausiścāndramasistathā || jaikahihmirjihvaśūnyavāpayaleḍhikavairiṇaḥ || 23 || śāradvatikare nityau loṣṭhākṣiścala vairiṇaḥ || nāgāyaniścānumatiḥ paurṇabhāgadhikāśikṛt || 24 || samākhyātāstathaiteṣāṃ pañca tu pravarā matāḥ || bhṛguśca cyavanaścaiva ātmavānastathaiva ca ||25|| aurvaśca jamadagniśca pañcaite pravarā matāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 26 || vājyāvājyo na vaivāhyā jñeyāstripravarāstu te || bhṛguśca jamadagniśca tathaivorvaśca pārthiva || 27 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu cānyānbhṛgūdvahān || jamadagnirvidaścaiva paulastyo vaijabhṛttathā || 28 || prācīnayogyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ krauñcāyanastathā|| ṛṣibhayaścājātaśca ekāyanavaṭāyanau || 29 || ātreyo'bhimataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ || bhṛguśca cyavanaścaiva hyātmavānastathaiva ca || 1.111.30 || paramparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || ṛgvedīyā mārgapathe grāmāyaṇirathāyaniḥ || 31 || āpastambistathā tālvirnekaṭhiḥ kaṇṭhireva ca || ārṣṭiṣeṇo gārdabhiśca kārddamāyaṇireva ca ||32 || aśvāyanirathānnāpi paṃcārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 33| yovirādho vītahavyo nāsāthaścaṇḍamo damaḥ || jīvaṃtyāyanimaudgaśca viliścaiva khalistathā || 34 || bhāvilirbhāgavittiśca kauśāmbeyirvṛkāścakiḥ || vāleyiḥ samadā geyirgaurakṣitirathaiva ca || 35 || gaurgajiśca savaṃśālastathā pauṣṇāyano muniḥ || romādaśca tathaiteṣāmārṣeyāḥ pravarā matāḥ || 36 || bhṛguśca vītahavyaśca tathā caiva sadevasaḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||37|| khālāyaniḥ śākaṭākhyo maitreyaḥ sātayastathā || droṇāyano naukmāyana āśiṣiśca pikāyaniḥ || 38 || homajihvistathaiteṣāmārṣeyāḥ pravarā matāḥ || bhṛguścaivātha vadhnyaśvo divodāsastathaiva ca ||39|| parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || sakāyano yajñapacirmadhyagandhistathaiva ca || 1.111.40 || pratyūhaśca tathā śraubhyakṣokṣirvaikādaśāyaniḥ || tathā gṛtsamado rājañśunakaśca mahānṛṣiḥ || 41 || pravarastu yathoktānāṃ dvyārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || bhṛgurgṛtsamadaścaiva dvāvetau parikīrtitau || parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ ||42 || ete tavoktā bhṛguvaṃśa jātā mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ || yeṣāṃ ca nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ vijahāti jantuḥ || 43 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bhṛguvaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 111 || <1.112> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || marīcitanayā rājansurūpā nāma viśrutā || | bhāryā hyaṅgiraso divyā yasyāḥ putrā daśa smṛtāḥ || 1 || ātmā hyāyurmanurdakṣo madaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca || haviṣmāṃścāgaviṣṭhaśca ṛtaḥ satyaśca te daśa || || 2 || ityete'ṅgiraso nāma devā vai somapīthinaḥ || surūpā janayāmāsa ṛṣīnsarveśvarānimān || 3 || bṛhaspatiṃ gautamaṃ ca saṃvartaṃ ca mahāṛṣim || ayasyaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca utathyamuśijaṃ tathā || 4 || ityete ṛṣayaḥ sarve gotrakārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || teṣāṃ gotrasamutpannāngotrakārānnibodha me || 5 || utathyo gautamaścaiva tailajo'bhijitistathā || bauddhinaiṣiḥ salaugākṣiḥ kṣorojo ṭāṃkireva ca || 6 || rāhohakiḥ sauṣuriśca kairatiḥ śārilaumakiḥ || pauṇyajirbhānubhāvaśca ṛṣiścaiva baḍobaḍaḥ || 7 || karāṭakaśca mācīyaḥ upabindurathaiṣiṇiḥ || rauhiṇyāyanijārgāliḥ kroṣṭā caivāruṇāyaniḥ || 8 || somo ḍāyanikāśekaḥ kauṭilyaḥ pārthivastathā || gehiṇyāyanirauvāyurmūlayovāṃśureva ca||||||| tathā ca gulmayovāṃśu stambayoṣāṃśureva ca || kāvākṣiḥ puṣpadhaścaiva kṣīrakāraṇḍireva ca || 1.112.10 || kṣapādiśca kareriśca pārikārīrireva ca || ityārṣeyāstu sarveṣāṃ pravarāḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 11 || āṃgirāśca tathotathyo munirdīrghatapāstathā || parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ || 12 || uṣṭājiṣṭa ayasyaśca kakṣīvāngotamastathā || ārṣeyāḥ pravarāścaiva teṣāṃ ca pravarāñśṛṇu || 13 || aṃgiraśca tatotaśca uṣājiśca mahānṛṣiḥ || saumastambhirvitambhiśca sālubhirvālubhistathā || 14 || bhāradvājiḥ saubuddhiśca meghī devamatistathā || ādryayāyaṇasāviṣṭyau hyagniveśaḥ śalāthaliḥ || 15 || vāliśeyaniśśaikeyi vārāhirvākalistathā || śāṭiśca ṛṣivarṇaśca prāvāhiścāśvalāyaniḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ|| 16 || kāvākiśca sabhākāyistathā cāṃśumatiḥ prabhuḥ || bhāvīkaiyūrinaibhulviḥ puṣpānveṣī tathaiva ca ||17|| bādhyo vicchindiśāṭīkiḥ khāragrīvistathaiva ca || devādyārirdevasthānirharikarṇiḥ sabhrāṅgikaḥ || 18 || dhauvāyiḥ sābhimugriśca tathā gomadagandhikaḥ || mātsyakvāthaḥ sālaharo hyalo hārastathaiva ca || 19 || gāgodayiḥ kautapatiḥ kaurukṣetristathaiva ca || tāṭākirjainyadroṇiśca jaivālāyanireva ca ||1.112.20|| āpastadharmojadṛṣṭiḥ kārṣṇapiṅgalireva ca || paulaścaiva mahātejāḥ śaṅkalāyanireva ca || 21 || ārṣeyo nāmataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaro nṛpa || aṅgirāḥ pravarasteṣāṃ dvitīyaśca bṛhaspatiḥ || 22 || tṛtīyaśca bharadvājaḥ pravarāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ || 23 || kāṇāyanāḥ kaupayavāstathā vātsyaparāyaṇāḥ || bhrāṣṭrakṛd bhrāṣṭravindī ca nendrālissayakāyanaḥ ||24|| kroḍiḥ śākrī ca kārṣī ca tālakṛnmāthurāvatāḥ || lāpakṛdbhālavipreṣo markaṭaḥ pailukāyanaḥ || 25 || mṛtsaṃśaśca tathā cākrī gargaḥ śyāmāyanistathā || vālaliḥ sāhariścaiva pañcārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 26 || aṅgirāstu mahātejā devācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ || bharadvājastathā gargaścaityaśca bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 27 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || kapītaraḥ svastitaro darbhaḥ śaktiḥ patañjaliḥ || 28 || bhūyasī jalasandhiśca bindudaṇḍiḥ kuśītakiḥ || bhṛgustu rājakeśī ca śaumbāṭiḥ śāṃśibistathā || 29 || śāliśca śakalaḥ kāṇvo muniḥ kerīrayistathā || kādyo vādhyāyaniścaiva sāvasyāyanireva ca || 1.112.30 || tyārṣeyo nāmatasteṣāṃ pravaro bhūmipottama || aṅgirādamavāhyaśca tathā caivāpyatatkṣayaḥ || 31 || parasparamavaivāhyāḥ sarva eva prakīrtitāḥ || sakṛtiśca trimārṣṭiśca śedhūḥ śaipavireva ca || 32 || taṇḍiśca jānakiścaiva tailakādravya eva ca || nārāyaṇiścārṣabhiśca laukṣirgārgirhalastathā || 33 || gālaviścāpi tryārṣeyaḥ sarveṣāṃ pravarā matāḥ || aṃgirāḥ saṃkṛtiścaiva gaurivītistathaiva ca||34|| parasparamavaivāhyāḥ ṛṣaya parikīrtitāḥ || kāṇvāyano haritakaḥ kautsyaḥ pauṃgyastathaiva ca || 35 || hastidamo vātsyamālirmāndrirgālirgaveraṇaḥ || bhīmaveśaḥ śāṃkhyadarbhiḥ sarve tripravarā matāḥ || 36 || aṅgirāstu tamasyuśca purukutsastathaiva ca || kutsāḥ kutsairavaivāhyā evamāhuḥ purātanāḥ || 37 || rathītarāṇāṃ pravarāḥ tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || aṅgirāśca surūpāśca tathaiva ca rathetaraḥ || 38 || rathetarā avaivāhyā nitarāśca rathetaraiḥ || viṣṇuvṛddhiḥ śage madrirjatriṇaḥ kartriṇastathā || 39 || praḍivaśca mahātejāstathā caiva parāyaṇaḥ || tryārṣeyaśca matasteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ ||1.112.40|| aṅgirāśca virūpāśca pṛthudaśvastathaiva ca || parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ || 41 || sāntyamugdhirmahātejā hiraṇyastambimudgalo || tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaro nṛpa || 42 || aṅgirā gṛtsadaśvaśca mudgalaśca mahātapāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ || 43 || mohajihvo devajihvo agnijihvavirāḍayaḥ || apāneyastryagrayaśca vairiṇyāstāvimaudgalāḥ || 44 || tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ || aṅgirāścaiva tāviśca maudgalyaśca mahātapāḥ || || 45 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || uruṇḍaśca bhuruṇḍaśca tṛtīyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ || 46 || tataḥ prāgadhamo nārī markaṭo ramaṇaḥ śaṇaḥ || kāṇvamārkaṭayaścaiva tayā rāmavaṇo muniḥ || 47 || śyāmāyanastathaiteṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ || aṅgirāścājamīḍhaśca kāṇvaścaiva mahātapāḥ || 46 || paramparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || tittiriḥ kapibhūścaiva gārgyaścaiva mahānṛṣiḥ || 49 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || ārṣeyo nāmataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ||1.112.50|| aṅgirāstittiriścaiva kapibhūśca mahānṛṣiḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 51 || aṅgirāḥ sabharadvājo ṛṣirvāndanavastathā || 52 || bṛhaspatirmaitravacāḥ pañcārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || aṅgirāḥ sabharadvājastathā caiva bṛhaspatiḥ || 53 || ṛṣirmitravacaścaiva ṛṣirvāndatavastathā || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 54 || bhāradvājaḥ kaṭāśauṅgaḥ śaithireyastathaiva ca || ityete kathitāḥ sarve dvyāmuṣyāyaṇanotrajāḥ ||55|| pañcāgneyāstathāpyeṣāṃ pravarāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || aṅgirāḥ sabharadvājastathaiva ca bṛhaspatiḥ || 56 || sauṅgaśca śaiśaviścaiva pravarāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||57|| ete tavoktāṅgirasastu vaṃśe mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ || yeṣāṃ ca nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti || 58 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde aṅgiraso vaṃśānukīrtivarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 112 || <1.113> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrivaṃśasamutpannāngotrakārānnibodha me || karpūrāyaṇaśākheyāstathā śārāhaṇāśca ye || śaivālakī śaunavarṇiraghosaudrutayaśca ye || 1 || gauragrīvaḥ sakārañjiratha maitrāyaṇāśca ye || ātmayanyā vāmarathyā gaupanāstākibindavaḥ ||2|| hvānajidbāhurindroviraindrāliḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ || taileyaścaiva bauleyaścātrigauṇī matistathā || 3 || jalado bhagapādaśca sopuṣpiśca mahātapāḥ || chāndogeyastathaiteṣāmārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ ||4|| dhyārāśvāśca tathātriśca ṛcanānasa eva ca || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ||5|| dakṣirbaliḥ pālakṛcca aurṇanābhiḥ silirmiliḥ || bījavāpī śirīṣaśca mauṃjakeśagaviṣṭhirau||6|| balandhanasttathaiteṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ || atrirgaviṣṭhiraścaiva tathā pūrvātithiḥ smṛtāḥ||7 parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || ātreyānputrikāputrānata ūrdhvaṃ nibodha me ||8|| hāleyaśca savāleyo vāmamathyastathaiva ca || gotreyaścaiva gotreyāḥ tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 9 || atriśca vāmarathyaśca potriścaiva mahānṛṣiḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 1.113.10 || ityatrivaṃśaprabhavāstavoktā mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ || yeṣāṃ tu nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde atrivaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma trayodaśā'dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 113 || <1.114> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrerevāparaṃ vaṃśaṃ tava vakṣyāmi pārthiva || atreḥ somaḥ sutaḥ śrīmāṃstasya vaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ || 1 || viśvāmitrastu tapasā brāhmaṇyaṃ samavāptavān || tasya vaṃśamahaṃ vakṣye tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 2 || viśvāmitro devarātastathā cekitigālavau || vataṇḍaśca śalaṅgaśca tathā cāśvāta tāyanaḥ || 3 || śyāmāyano yājñavalkyo jābāliḥ saindhanāyanaḥ || dābhravyāśca kārīṣī ca sauśrutyā atha sauśrutāḥ || 4 || aulūṣā aupagavayaḥ pāṇyodarayamāñcayaḥ || kharabādhā vahalayaḥ pāṇatambaḥ sakauśikāḥ || 5 || tryārṣeyāḥ pravarāsteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitāḥ || viśvāmitro devarātaḥ uddālaśca mahāyakṣāḥ || 6 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || mārgamitrāstathādyāśca mādhucchandasa eva ca || 7 || tryārṣeyāḥ pravarāstvete ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || viśvāmitrastathā jyeṣṭho madhucchandāstathaiva ca || 8 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || dhanañjayaḥ kapardeyaḥ parikuṣṭaśca pārthiva || 9 || pāṇiniścaiva tryārṣeyāḥ sarva ete prakīrtitāḥ || viśvāmitro madhucchandastathā caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ || 1.114.10 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || kāmalāyanijāścaiva āśmarathyāstathaiva ca || 11 || bandhuliścaiva tryārṣeyāḥ sarveṣāṃ pravarā matāḥ || viśvāmitraścāśmaratho badhuliśca mahātapāḥ || 12 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || pūraṇāḥ paridhāvantaḥ dvyārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 13 || viśvāmitraḥ pūraṇaśca tayordvau pravarau smṛtau || parivartā avaivāhyāḥ pūraṇāśca parasparam || 14 || lohitā aṣṭakāścaiva tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || viśvāmitro lohitaśca aṣṭakaśca mahātapāḥ || 15 || aṣṭakā lohitairnityamavaivāhyāḥ parasparam || udareṇḍaḥ kanyakaśca ṛṣiścodāvahistathā ||16|| tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ || ṛṇavāngrathitaścaiva viśvāmitrastathaiva ca || 17 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || audumbariḥ śaiśiraṭirṛṣistārkṣāyaṇastathā || 18 || ṭaikāyanistaikāyanistārkṣāyaṇirathaiva ca|| kātyāyaniḥ karīrāmiḥ śālaṅkāyanilāvakī||19|| mauñjāyaniśca bhagavāṃstryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || kiliḥ kalistathā vidvānviśvāmitrastathaiva ca || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||1.114.20 || ete tavoktāḥ kuśikā narendra mahānubhāvāḥ satataṃ dvijendrāḥ || yeṣāṃ tu nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti || 21 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde viśvāmitravaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 || <1.115> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ kaśyapasya tathā kule || gotrakārānṛṣīnvakṣye teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 1 || āgrāyaṇā jhaṣagaṇā meṣakaurīṭikāyanāḥ || guruvrajī māṭharaśca gojāviratha lakṣmaṇaḥ || 2 || śālāhaleyāḥ korijyāścaukanyāścāsurāyaṇāḥ || mandānyāvai mṛgayano śrotaso bhausatāyanāḥ ||3|| devayātā gopayātā athocchāyatayaśca ye || tākayānāścitrahayā abhiryogā gadāyanāḥ || 4 || kātuvandirmahācakrirdākṣapāṇaya eva ca || grīvāyaṇā harkirayo hāstidāsāstathaiva ca || 5 || vātsyā vālinyakṛtahā hāstalāyanisastathā || āgrāyaṇaḥ pelumūlī rāśvatātāya nastathā || 6 || kauśītakāśca pākāntā agniśarmāyaṇāśca ye || maiṣayaḥ kaivameyāśca tathā caiva subabhravaḥ ||7|| prācīthayo jñānagayā āgrāvamatha eva tu || śyāmocarā naimiṣayaḥ tatsthā ye śādvalāyanāḥ ||8|| kāṣṭahāyananāmārīcā ḍaujihāyanahāstikāḥ|| vaikarṇeyāḥ kāśyapāśca śāmiśā hāritāyanāḥ ||9|| mātaṃgino babhrasavaḥ tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || vatsaraḥ kaśyapaścaiva nidhruvaśca mahātapāḥ || 1.115.10 || parasparamavaivāhyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ purikīrtritāḥ || raihāśca sāṃkhyamitrāśca yārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 11 || vatsāraḥ kaśyapaścaiva raihāścaiva mahātapāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyau gotrau dvau parikīrtitau || 12 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hyāmuṣyāyaṇagotrajān || ānuṣṭubho bhāktarayaḥ svātayo rājavallayaḥ || 13 || śaireśiro devahiśca sairandhī raupasīvakiḥ || sāluliḥ kāṭuviṅgākṣiḥ śataśaṃbhistathaiva ca || 14 || divā vasiṣṭhā ityete naktaṃ jñeyāśca kāśyapāḥ || tryārṣeyāśca tathā teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravarāḥ śubhāḥ || 15 || vatsāraḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca mahātapāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 16 || sā mātā baliputraśca bhaupyalo'tha jalatvaraḥ || muñjāmayūraḥ paryaśca so'ṣṭamo gardabhīmukhaḥ || 17 || hiraṇyabāhuḥ kairātaḥ ubhau kāśyapagobhilau || āhalo vṛṣakaṇḍaśca sṛketuśca tathottaraḥ || 18 || udakebhastṛṇo vatsyo mahākeralayaśca ye || śāḍīlavaiśānavasau drāvolevalayātavaḥ ||19 || paippalādiḥ pūrvavarirvīravitthā varīnikaḥ|| tryārṣeyopi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubha || 1.115.20 || asito devalaścaiva kaśyapaśca mahātapāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 21 || ṛṣipradhānasya tu kaśyapasya dākṣāyaṇābhyaḥ sakalaṃ prasūtam || jagatsamagraṃ yadusiṃhamukhya tatte ca vakṣyāmyahamuttaratra || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kaśyapavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 115|| <1.116> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vasiṣṭhavaṃśajānviprānnibodha gadato mama || ekārṣeyaśca pravaro vasiṣṭhānāṃ prakīrtitāḥ || 1 || vasiṣṭha eva vāsiṣṭhā avivāhyā vasiṣṭhajaiḥ || vyāghrapādā aupagavāḥ vaiklavā śādvalāyanāḥ || 2 || kāpiṣṭhalā kṣaiṭalomā āśvalāḥ sarvaṭākarāḥ || gopāyanā bodhayaśca dvākalpā apavāhyakṛt || 3 || bāliśeyā pāliśiṣyāstathomāṅkuravaśca ye || āyasthūṇāḥ śītavṛkṣāstathā brahmapurohitāḥ || 4 || lomātyāḥ svastikarāḥ māṇḍalirgautalistathā || vāhnehaṇḍiśca sumanā śvapādirviddhireva ca || || 5 || śaulirlolirbrahmabalo vailiśravasa eva ca || mauṇḍavo yājñavalkyaśca ekārṣeyāstathā nṛpa || 6 || vasiṣṭha eṣāṃ pravara avaivāhyāḥ parasparam|| śailālayo mahākarṇo kauravyaḥ kraivaṇistathā ||7|| kapiñjalo bālaśikhirbhāgavittāyanāśca ye || kaurāyaṇā lākahayā kaulakṛdbhāgurāyaṇāḥ || 8 || śākahavyāḥ kaśāpeyā atho ulvapayāśca ye || sāṅkhyāyanā anaḍuhā atho māṣaśirādhayaḥ || 9 || dāmakāyanā vāhayavo vākyayogorathastathā || ābāyanāśca ṛṣayo ye ca kroḍādanāyavāḥ || 1.116.10 || pralambāyanāśca ṛṣaya aupamanyava eva ca || sāṅkhyāyanāśca ṛṣayastathā ye ca daśerakāḥ |||| 11 || pādakāyana audgrāhā ṛṣayaścaiva lekhayaḥ || māleyā brahmavalayaḥ pūrṇāgāṃristathaiva ca || 12 || tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravarastathā|| bhago vasurvasiṣṭhaśca indraḥ sammatireva ca || 13 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || aupasvasthāḥ svasthalayo vālo hālo hayāśca ye || || 14 || madhyandinā akṣatayaḥ paippalā devicaṅkapī || traiśṛṅgā vanagā ālavāḥ kuṇḍināśca narottama || 19 || tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ || vasiṣṭhamitrāvaruṇau kuṇḍinaśca mahātapāḥ || 16 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || jātūkarṇā yavaścaiva pādapāśca tathaiva ca || 17 || tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravarastathā || jātūkarṇo vasiṣṭhaśca tathaivāntyaśca pārthiva || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 18 || vasiṣṭhavaṃśe'bhihitā mayaite ṛṣiprabarhā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ || yeṣāntu nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti ||19 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 vasiṣṭhavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||116 || <1.117> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā nimeḥ pūrvapurohitaḥ || 1 || babhūva pārthivaśreṣṭha yajñaistasya samantataḥ || śāntātmā pārthivaśreṣṭha viśaśrāma tadā purā || 2 || taṃ gatvā pārthivaśreṣṭho nimirvacanamabravīt || bhagavanyaṣṭumicchāmi tanmā yājaya mā ciram || 3 || tamuvāca mahātejā vaśiṣṭhaḥ pārthivottamam || kañcitkālaṃ pratīkṣasva tava yajñaiḥ samantataiḥ || 4 || bhṛśaṃ śrānto'smi viśramya yājayiṣyāmi te nṛpa || evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca vasiṣṭhaṃ nṛpasattamaḥ ||5|| pāralaukikakāryeṣu kaḥ pratīkṣitumutsahe || na yasya sauhṛdaṃ brahmankṛtāntena balīyasā || 6 || dharmakārye tvarā kāryā calaṃ yasmāddhi jīvitama || dharmamārgarato janturmṛto'pi sukhamaśnute || 7 || śvaḥkāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhne cāparāhṇikam || na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vāsya na vā kṛtam || 8 || kṣetrāpatyagṛhāsaktamanyatra gatamānasam || vṛkīvoraṇamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati || 9 || na kālasya priyaḥ kaściddveṣyo vāsya na vidyate || āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe prasahya harate janam || 1.117.10 || prāṇo vāyuścalatvañca vāyorviditameva ca || yatra yajjīvyate brahmankṣaṇamātraṃ tadadbhutam || 11 || so'haṃ sambhṛtasaṃbhāge bhavanmūlamupāgataḥ || na cedyājayase mahyaṃ yāsyāmyanyaṃ tu yājakam || 12 || evamuktastadā tena niminā brāhmaṇottamaḥ || śaśāpa taṃ nimiṃ krodhādvidehastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||13|| śrāntaṃ māṃ tvaṃ samutsṛjya yasmādanyaṃ dvijottamam || dharmajñaḥ sannarendrādya yājakaṃ kartumarhasi ||14|| nimistaṃ pratyuvācātha dharmakāryaratasya me || vighnaṃ karoṣi nānyena yājanaṃ ca tathecchasi || 15 || śāpaṃ dadāmi tasmāttvaṃ videho'dya bhaviṣyasi || evamukte tu tau jātau videhau dvijapārthivau || 16 || dehahīnau tayorjīvau brahmāṇamupajagmatuḥ || āgatau tau samīpe'tha brahmā vacanamabravīt ||17|| adyaprabhṛti te sthānaṃ nime jīvaṃ dadāmyaham || netrapakṣmasu sarveṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhaviṣyasi || 18 || tvatsambandhāttathā teṣāṃ nimeṣaḥ sambhaviṣyati || cālayiṣyanti tu yadā netrapakṣmāṇi mānavāḥ || 19 || evamukte manuṣyāṇāṃ netrapakṣmasu sarvaśaḥ || jagāma nimijīvaṃ tu varadānātsvayambhuvaḥ || 1.117.20 || vaśiṣṭhajīvaṃ bhagavānbrahmā vacanamabravīt || mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putro vaśiṣṭha tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 21 || vaśiṣṭha iti te nāma tatrāpi ca bhaviṣyati || janmadvayamatītaṃ ca tatrāpi tvaṃ smariṣyasi || 22 || etasminneva kāle tu mitraśca varuṇastathā || badaryāśramamāsādya tapastepaturavyayam || 23 || tapasyatostayorevaṃ kadācinmādhave ṛtau || puṣpitadrumasaṃchinne śubhe dakṣiṇamārute || 24 || urvaśyatha varārohā kurvatī kusumoccayam || sasūkṣmaraktavasanā tayordṛṣṭipathaṃ gatā || 25 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sumukhīṃ subhrūṃ nīlanīrajalocanām || ubhau cukṣubhaturvīryāttadrūpaparimohitau || 25 || skannaṃ retastayordṛṣṭvā śāpabhītā varāpsarāḥ || cakāra kalaśe subhrūstoyapūrṇe manorame || 27 || tasmādṛṣivarau jātau tejasāpratimo bhuvi || vaśiṣṭhaścāpyagastyaśca mitrāvaruṇayoḥ sutau || 28 || vaśiṣṭhastūpayemetha bhaginīṃ nāradasya tu || arundhatīṃ varārohāṃ tasyāṃ śaktimajījanat || 29 || śakteḥ parāśaraḥ putrastasya vaṃśaṃ nibodha me || yasya dvaipāyanaḥ putraḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurajāyata || 1.117.30 || prakāśo janito yena loke bhāratacandramāḥ || parāśarasya tasya tvaṃ śṛṇu vaṃśamanuttamam || 31 || kārdramayo vāhayāno jaimayo maimatāyanaḥ || gopāliḥ pañcamaścaiṣāṃ jñeyā kṛṣṇaparāśarāḥ || 32 || prārohayo bāhyatapāḥ pārṣayaḥ kautujātayaḥ || hāryaśviḥ pañcamaścaiṣāṃ jñeyā nīlaparāśarāḥ || 33 || kārṣṇāyaṇāḥ kāpisaudhāḥ kokeyasyā tayāstapāḥ || puṣkaraḥ pañcamaścaiṣāṃ jñeyā raktaparāśarāḥ || 34 || śraviṣṭhāyanā vārṣṇeyā dāseyāḥ ślokajāśca ye || iṣīkahastaḥ pañcamaśca ete śvetā parāśarāḥ || 35|| vaṭikā bādarāścaiva skambhanyāḥ krośakātayaḥ || kṣāmireṣāṃ pañcamaśca ete gauraparāśarāḥ ||35 || khalvāyaṇī vārṣpayaṇī tilvaṇo bailvayūthapaḥ || tāmireṣāṃ pañcamaśca ete dhūmraparāśarāḥ || 37 || parāśarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ || parāśaraśca śaktiśca vaśiṣṭhaśca mahātapāḥ || 38 || parasparamavaivāhyāḥ sarva eva parāśarāḥ || 39 || uktāstathaite nṛpa vaṃśamukhyāḥ pārāśarāḥ sūrya samaprabhāvāḥ || yeṣāṃ tu nāmnā parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti || 1.117.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde parāśaravaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 117 || <1.118> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ataḥ paramagastyasya vakṣye vaṃśodbhavāndvijān || āgastyeyaḥ karambho yaḥ kausalyākulajāstathā ||1|| svamedhaso mayobhuvastathā gāndhārakāyaniḥ|| paulastyāḥ pulahāścaiva kratuvaṃśabhavāstathā||2|| vārṣṇeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravarāḥ śubhāḥ || agastyaśca mahendraśca ṛṣiścaiva mayobhuvaḥ || 3 || parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || paurṇamāsāḥ pāraṇāśca tryārṣṇeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||4|| agastyaḥ paurṇamāsaśca pāraṇaśca mahātapāḥ || parasparamavaivāhyā paurṇamāsāśca pāraṇam || 5|| etaduktamṛṣīṇāṃ te vaṃśamuktamapūruṣam || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kiṃ tavānagha kathyatām ||6|| vajra uvāca || pulahasya pulastyasya kratoścaiva mahātmanaḥ || agastyasya tathā caikaṃ kathaṃ vaṃśaṃ taducyate || 7 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kratuḥ khalvanapatyo'sti rājanvaivasvatentare || idhmavāhaṃ sa putratve jagrāha nṛpasattama || 8 || agastyaputraṃ dharmajña āgastyātkratavastathā || pulahasya tathā putraḥ tiraścaḥ pṛthivīpate || 9 || teṣāṃ te janma vakṣyāmi uttaratra yathā vidhi || pulahastvaprajāṃ dṛṣṭvā nātiprītamanā hyabhūt || 1.118.10 || agastyajaṃ dṛḍhasyuṃ taṃ putratve kṛtavāṃstadā || paulahāśca tathā rājannāgastyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 11 || ete tavoktāḥ pravarā dvijānāṃ mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ || yeṣāṃ ca nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde agastyavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 118 || <1.119> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || asminvaivasvate prāpte śṛṇu dharmasya pārthiva || dākṣāyaṇyāśca sakalaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ vaṃśamuttamam || 1 || evaṃ tāni mahīdurgaśarīrāṇi narādhipa || arundhatyā prasūtāni dharmo vaivasvatentare || 2 || aṣṭau ca vasavaḥ putrā somapāśca vasostathā || dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānalānilau || 3 || pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || dharasya putrā'mbunimbaḥ kālaḥ putro dhruvasya ca || 4 || kālasyāvayavānāṃ tu śarīrāṇi narādhipa || muhūrtavarjaṃ kālāddhi prasūtānyaviśeṣataḥ || 5 || somasya bhagavānvarcāḥ śramastvāpasya kīrtyate || anekajanmā janavaḥ kumāraścānalasya tu || 6 || purojavāścānilasya pratyūṣasya ca devalaḥ || viśvakarmā prabhāsasya tridaśānāṃ sa vārdhakiḥ || 7 || jāmī duhitaraḥ proktā nāgavīthyādayo nava || laṃbāputraḥ smṛto ghoro bhānoḥ putraśca bhānavaḥ || 8 || graharkṣāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ cānyeṣāmapi tejasām || marutvatyāṃ marutvantaḥ sarve putrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 9 || saṃkalpāyāśca saṃkalpāstathā putrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || muhūrtāśca muhūrtāyāḥ sādhyātsādhyāsutāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.119.10 || mattonmattaśca prāṇaśca naropāṇaśca vīryavān || cittirnaro hayaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā || 11 || vibhuścāpi prabhuścāpi sādhyā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ|| viśvāyāśca tathā putrā viśvedevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 15 || kraturdakṣo vasuḥ satyaḥ kālaḥ kāmo dhunistathā || ūravānmanujo viśveromāyāśca hi te daśa || 13 || etāvaduktaṃ tava dharmavaṃśaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ pārthivasaṃghamukhya || vyāsena vaktuṃ na hi śaktirasti rājanvinā varṣaśatairanekaiḥ || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 dharmavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 119 || <1.120> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ kaśyapasya śṛṇu vaṃśaṃ narādhipa || yatra prāyeṇa saṃbhūtaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam || 1 || aditerdvādaśādityā devaputrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || dhātā putro'ryamā pūṣā śakoṃ'śo varuṇo bhagaḥ || 2 || tvaṣṭā vivasvānvaruṇo viṣṇurdvādaśamastathā || viṣṇoraṃśena saṃbhūtāḥ sādhyā devagaṇā nṛpa || 3 || ta eva tejaso'rdhena jātāścaivāditeḥ sutāḥ || naranārāyaṇau cobhau yau te rājanmayeritau ||4 || indrāviṣṇū tathaivoktā vādityeṣu narādhipa || manorantaramāsādya sarvatraiva janārdanaḥ || 5 || aṃśenaikena bhavati sagaṇaḥ somapāyinām || tasmingaṇe devavaro viṣṇurloka namaskṛtaḥ || 6 || tejasā'bhyadhiko naiko bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ || yasteṣāmārtiśamanaṃ karoti vasudhādhipa || 7 || karmāṇyatīteṣu tathāntareṣu vakṣye bhaviṣyeṣu tathā narendra || manvantarāṇāṃ parikīrtaneṣu śṛṇuṣva tāvadditivaṃśamugram || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārka ṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ādityotpattirnāma viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 120 || <1.121> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || ditiḥ putradvayaṃ rājañjanayāmāsa viśrutam || hiraṇyākṣaṃ ca durdharṣaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tathā || 1 || hiraṇyākṣo hato rājannṛvarāheṇa saṃyuge || hiraṇyakaśyapū rājannṛsiṃhena nipātitaḥ || 2 || hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādo'rikulāntakaḥ || kālanemiśca durdharṣo viṣṇunā ghātito yudhi || 3 || ārādhya keśavaṃ devaṃ prahlādaśca mahābalaḥ || prāptavāñjīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ brāhmaṃ dinamanuttamam || 4 || kālanemiśca durdharṣo mahābalaparākramaḥ || nihato vāsudevena nivṛtte tārakāmaye || 5|| prahrādasya sutaḥ śrīmānrājannāmnā virocanaḥ || virocanasutaḥ śrīmānbalirityeva viśrutaḥ || 6 || vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya baddho yo viṣṇunā purā || balerbāṇaḥ suto rājansmṛto bāhusahasravān || 7 || pituste śvaśuraḥ śrīmānpiturarthe tavānagha || vivāhaṃ kṛtavānkṛṣṇo nagare śoṇitāhvaye || 8 || yasminsa vai devavaraḥ prasahya skandaṃ ca rudraṃ ditijaiḥ sametam || raṇe vijigye nṛpatipradhāna sahānugaṃ vīryabalopapannam || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ditivaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121|| <1.122> vajra uvāca|| hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putro kālanemirmahāsuraḥ|| kathaṃ kṛṣṇena nihatastanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| yadā daityavadhe vṛtte daityāḥ pātālamāśritāḥ|| mayatārau samāśritya bhūyo devānpradudruvuḥ || 2 || tatra devagaṇāḥ sarve mayatārapuraḥsaraiḥ || dānavairnihatā yuddhe devācāryaṃ bṛhaspatim || 3 || saṃprāptāḥ śaraṇaṃ vipraṃ tānuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ || tārakaśca mayaścaiva mahābalaparākramau || 4 || yayurjetuṃ devagaṇām̐stāvimau codayāmyaham || evamuktvā devagaṇāndevācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ || tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ bahurūpaṃ hutāśanam || 5 || bṛhaspatiruvāca || tvamagne sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi pāvaka || vedāstvadarthaṃ jātāśca jātavedāstathā hyasi || 6 || tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ havīṃṣi mahādyute || tvaṃ sa deva carasyātmā viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 7 || tvaṃ mukhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvasyātmā tathā bhavān || ūṣmā tvaṃ dehināṃ dehe bhuktapītavatastathā||8|| yacchaktiḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvadīyā bhūtabhāvana|| prāptā tvayāhutiḥ samyagāditya mupatiṣṭhate || 9 || ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ || sarvadevavareśānaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 1.122.10 || trailokyasya samutpattāvekaḥ kāraṇatāṃ gataḥ || kālāgnirudro bhagavāñjagatsaṃhārakārakaḥ||11|| sthitau nimittaṃ ca bhavānsarveṣāṃ dehināṃ śamaḥ|| atīva durdharaṃ deva tava tejaḥ sudāruṇam ||12||| tejasā tena daityendrāñjahi mā tvaṃ ciraṃ kṛthā || sakhā ca te raṇe deva bhaviṣyati samīraṇaḥ ||13|| ityevamuktoṅgirasā mahātmā tatheti taṃ prāha nṛpendra pūjyam || jīvo'pi gatvā pavanaṃ jagāda deveśvarasyānaghasiddhimicchan||14|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'gnistotraṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||122|| <1.123> bṛhaspatiruvāca|| jagadāyurbhavānvāyo śarīrasthaḥ śarīriṇām| anantamūrtirdharmātmā devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||1|| acintyavīryaḥ puruṣaḥ sadādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ || sākṣibhūtaśca sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ śubhapāpayoḥ ||2|| ghrāṇastvaṃ dehināṃ dehe ceṣṭitañca tathā bhavān || bhavānrudro bhavānbrahmā bhavānviṣṇuḥ sanātana || 3 || tavāyattaṃ hi jagatāṃ varṣāvarṣaṃ śubhāśubhama || bhavānvisṛjate meghānbhavānsaṃharate punaḥ || 4 || bhavāndhārayate meghānvarṣamāṇām̐stathā divi || ādityaraśmipītasya meghodaragatasya ca ||5|| rasasya bhaṅktā satataṃ bhavāneva nabhastale || taḍillatānāṃ ca tathā bhavānkartā jagattraye|| 6 || ambhasāṃ bhedakāle tu sarvādhāraḥ samīraṇa || parasparaṃ hi bhavatastathā saṃghaṭanātprabho || 7 || garjitaṃ jāyate loke meghodara gataṃ mahat || balena tvatsamaṃ nānyaṃ bhūtaṃ paśyāmi bhūtale ||8 || tasmāttvaṃ kuru sāhāyyaṃ vedamūrtervibhāvasoḥ || 9 || etāvaduktoṅgirasā mahātmā tatheti taṃ prāha samīraṇo'pi || jagāma yuddhaṃ saha pāvakena daityeśvarāndevaripūnmahātmā || 1.123.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajra saṃvāde vāyustotraṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 123 || <1.124> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vāyvagnī sahitau gatvā mayatārapurogamān ||| jigyatuḥ samare daityānnānāpraharaṇodyatāna || 3 || vijitāste raṇe daityā mayatārapurogamāḥ|| tyaktadevālayāḥ sarve varuṇālayamāgatāḥ || 2 || etasminneva kāle tu hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutaḥ || kālanemiriti khyātaḥ śataśīrṣonudṛśyate||3|| śatabāhurmahākāyaḥ parvatākāradarśanaḥ|| brahmalabdhavaro raudro dagdhaśailasamacchaviḥ||4|| ekodaro dvipādaśca ekagrīvaḥ surāntakaḥ|| aṅgadī baddhamukuṭaḥ kuṇḍalāmbarabhūṣaṇaḥ|| sarvāyudhadharo raudro gadāpāṇirvibhīṣaṇaḥ || dattvā'bhayaṃ sa daityānāṃ tasmai meruṃ surālayam || 6 || gatvā vijigye tridaśānsthānebhyaścāvaropayat || trailokyamātmasātkṛtvā sukhamāste triviṣṭape || 7 || tasya te hyanugāḥ sarve lokāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ || tadājñākāriṇaḥ sarve tadbhāvasyānuvartakāḥ || 8 || pañca tatrābhyavartanta viparītena karmaṇā || vedo dharmaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ śrīśca nārāyaṇāśrayā || 9 || sarveṣāmanusandhānātsaroṣo dānaveśvaraḥ || vaiṣṇavaṃ padamanvicchanyayau nārāyaṇāntikam||1.124.10|| jñātvā daityamathāyāntaṃ devopi madhusūdanaḥ|| tārkṣyamāvāhayāñcakre āruroha ca taṃ hariḥ|| sa dadarśa hariṃ devaṃ tārkṣyasthaṃ daityarāṭ tadā|| sajalajaladanīlaṃ padmapatrāyatākṣaṃ khagapatimavarūḍhaṃ kalpavṛkṣopamānam|| halamusalagadābhiḥ śobhitaṃ devadevaṃ varapuruṣamajeyaṃ śārṅgacakrāsipāṇim||12|| iti śrī viṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kālanemyupākhyāne śrībhagavaddarśano nāma caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 124 || <1.125> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dṛṣṭvā sa purato devaṃ dānavānabhyabhāṣata || ayaṃ sa dṛśyate viṣṇurdānavā yena ghātitāḥ || 1 || kutṛṣṇayeva śakrārthe babhūva kila vāmanaḥ || yadā vañcitavānputraṃ bhrātṛvyasya baliṃ mama || 2 || nṛvarāhavapuḥ kṛtvā lokacittaharaṃ puro || hiraṇyākṣaṃ jaghānaiva pitṛvyaṃ mama vismitam || 3 || apūrvaṃ rūpamāsthāya narasiṃhasya dānavāḥ || pitaraṃ yo jaghānaiva hiraṇyakaśipuṃ raṇe|| 4 || varāharūpiṇānena pātālatalamāsthitāḥ || asambhāvyabhayenājau dānavā vinipātitāḥ || 5 || narāśva vapuṣā yena madhukaiṭabhayoḥ purā || pātālādāhṛtā vedāstatastau yudhi ghātitau || 6 || asyājñākāriṇo devā na saṃtiṣṭhanti śāsane || ayaṃ sa rakṣāṃ devānāmasmābhirviprakṛṣyatām || 7 || trailokye daityamudbhūtaṃ yuddhenaiva punaḥpunaḥ || devasādgama ityeva tena vadhyo'tha me ripuḥ || 8 || atītasyādya kālasya durnayasya kṛtasya ca || bhokṣyate'yaṃ phalaṃ daityāḥ sarve paśyantu mā ciram || 9 || ityetaddaityanāthasya vākyaṃ śrutvaiva dānavāḥ || jayaśabdaṃ tataścakruḥ siṃhanādaravaṃ tathā || 1.125.10 || vācaśca pratikūlāstāstena duṣṭena cetasā || tacchrutvā ca harirdevaḥ kruddho nāmedamabravīt || 11 || kimidaṃ garjase daitya śāradāmbudavadvṛthā|| prajāpikṛtaṃ setuṃ kathaṃ laṅghitumicchasi||12|| evaṃ kathatordevadaityayoḥ pārthivottama|| prāvartata raṇo ghoro gadāpātavibhīṣaṇaḥ||13|| dānavairdevadevo'pi kālanemipuraḥsaraiḥ|| saṃchādyate mahāstraughairmeghairiva nabhastalam||14|| saṃchādyamāno daityendrairdevadevo na vivyathe || yodhayāmāsa sa raṇe gadayā dānavānbahūn || 15 || tasya daityaprasaktasya kālanemirmahāsuraḥ || pātayāmāsa vegena gadāṃ garuḍamūrdhani || 16 || gadāghātena raudreṇa tena tārkṣyasya mānada || nāsā bhagnā vyathā jātā raktacchardiśca dāruṇā || 17 || vyathitaṃ garuḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā devena harimedhasā || kṣiptaṃ daityavināśāya tadā cakraṃ sudāruṇam || 18 || yattatsudarśanaṃ nāma sūryatejaḥsamudbhavam || vajranābhaṃ sahasrāraṃ kṣaraparyantamaṇḍalam || 19 || cyutaṃ cakrikarāccakraṃ kālanemiṃ mahāsuram || śīghraṃ viśirasaṃ cakre vibāhuṃ ca tathā nṛpa || 1.125.20 || vibāhuśirasaṃ kṛtvā devahastamupeyivān || vibāhuśirasaṃ kāyaṃ kṣaracchoṇitanirjharam || 21 || na papātāsya medinyāṃ yadā tārkṣyastato rayāt || urusā pātayāmāsa devānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā || 25 || patatā daityakāyena saśailavanakānanā || kampitā vasudhā sarvā patitāśca śiloccayāḥ || 23 || dānavendraṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā mayatārapurogamāḥ || tuṣṭuvurdevadevaśaṃ varacakrāsipāṇinam || 24 || tuṣṭāva ca tadā devo brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || stutaśca brahmaṇā devo lokapālānyathā purā ||25|| sthāneṣu yojayāmāsa yajñaṃ devamukhe tathā || jagāma brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ brahmalokaṃ tadā vibhuḥ ||26|| tatrātmānaṃ yajñamūrti mijyamānaṃ dvijottamaḥ || dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ tu jagrāha yajñabhāgaṃ mahātmanām || 27 || tatra pūjāmupādāya jagāma sa hiraṇvatīm || astrairanugatastatra suṣvāpa kila yogavit |||28|| evaṃ sa daityapravaro narendra kṛṣṇena cakreṇa purā nirastaḥ || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa ||29 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kālanemivadho nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 125 || <1.126> vajra uvāca || yaduktaṃ daityanāthena daityānāṃ kālaneminā || pātāladaityaśamanaṃ vapurdevasya cakriṇaḥ || 1 || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra me saṃśayo mahān || caritaṃ tasya devasya bhāvānvetti yathātatham|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || viṣṇunā tu balau baddhe pātālatalamāśritāḥ|| jaghnudaityagaṇā lokānbrāhmaṇāṃśca viśeṣataḥ||3|| | bhūtale hanyamāne tu yajñe nāśamupāgate || kṣutkṣāmastridaśairbrahmā daityahetoḥ pracoditaḥ||4|| brahmāpi codayāmāsa devadevaṃ janārdanam|| brahmaṇā codito devaḥ pātālagamanecchayā ||85|| cakāra rūpaṃ vārāhaṃ bhinnāñjanacayaprabham || śaśāṅkalekhādaṃṣṭrāgraṃ vajraprothakhuraṃ tathā ||6|| vajrasaṃhananaṃ bhīmaṃ trailokyakṣobhakārakam || pīnavṛttāyataskandhaṃ mahāpīnaśirodharam || 7 || vivṛttāsyaṃ mahākāyaṃ bhīmākṣaṃ bhīmanisvanam || āvarttiromasaṃghātaṃ tena vigrahamūrjitam || || 8 || sa samudreṇa pātālaṃ praviśya madhusūdanaḥ || daityānāṃ darśane tasthau mahābalaparākramaḥ || 9 || pātāle sūkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prothadāritabhūtalam || sumustagarbhakavalaṃ śuṃśukārakṛtānanam || 1.126.10 || paṅkānuliptasarvāṅgaṃ niryayurdānavāstadā || satataṃ mṛgayāśīlā jaghnustañca varāyudhaiḥ || 11 || sa hanyamāno daityāstraiḥ pṛṣatairiva parvataḥ || skandhakaṇḍūcchalenājau daityādhipaniveśanam || 12 || pātayāmāsa vegena mahādriśikharopamam || veśmanaśca nipātena devadevasya māyayā || 13 || hanyante dānavā ghorāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || te kṣayāddaityamukhyānāṃ daityamukhyakṣayaṅkarāḥ||14|| yathārthakṣayatāṃ jagmuḥ kṣaye raudra upasthite || kṣīyamāṇāḥ kṣayairdṛṣṭvā kṣatajotkṣiptamūrdhajān || 15 || kṣmātalasthānkṣatairgotraiḥ kṣaṇena kṣaṇadācarān || pradhānā daityamukhyā ye auraserana balena te ||16|| jagmurvarāyudhairdevaṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || sa hanyamāno daityendraiḥ prothena ditijottamān
