||17|| vidārayāmāsa raṇe daṃṣṭrāgreṇa tathāparān || evaṃ varāheṇa raṇe hatāndṛṣṭvā dite sutān || 18 || hariṃ vijñātavāndevaṃ prahrādo daityasattamaḥ || sa praṇamya hariṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva paravīrahā || 19 || taṃ jagāda mahātejā devadevo janārdanaḥ || anugrāhyo'si me daitya bhakto'si satataṃ yataḥ || 1.126.20|| tavājñālaṅghakā ghorā prāyeṇa nihatā mayā || tavājñākāriṇo daityā na me vadhyā diteḥ sutāḥ || 21 || śāsanaṃ pālaya mahyaṃ pātāle tvaṃ sukhī bhava || mārge sthāpaya daityām̐stvaṃ tvadājñāparibṛṃhitān ||22|| ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ daitya jīvaṃ tvaṃ na vimokṣyase || dharmiṣṭhānāṃ ca daityānāṃ sadā rājā bhaviṣyasi || 23 || madbhaktyā parayā vatsa putrastava virocanaḥ || mārgacyuto'pi na hataḥ kalpāyuśca tathā kṛtaḥ || 24 || balirvairocanaścaiva mayā baddhaḥ kṛte tava || kariṣyati sa śakratvaṃ prāpte sāvarṇikentare || 25 || bāṇaṃ ca tanayaṃ tasya mama vipriyakārakam || tvatkṛte na haniṣyāmi tasya cchetsyāmi dordrumān || 26 || chinnabāhurmayā yuddhe harasyānucaro balī || mahākāla iti khyāto kalpasthāyī bhaviṣyati || 27 || ekamekaṃ tu daityendra santāne satataṃ tava || nāhaṃ vadhiṣye dharmajña tvatkṛte vyetu te bhayam || 28 || bhavānbhaktastathā mahyaṃ bhakteṣvapi tathā mama || nāstyadeyaṃ mahābhāga tasmāttvaṃ gaccha nirvṛttaḥ || 29 || hataśeṣānupādāya daityānsatpathamāśritān || etāvaduktā prahrādaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ||1.126.30 || etadvārāhacaritaṃ tava rājasiṃha proktaṃ mayā sakalakalmaṣanāśakāri || udavṛttadaityaśamanasya ṛṣistutasya kaṇḍūvinodanahatāsurapuṅgavasya || 31 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pātāle varāhaprādurbhāvo nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 126 || <1.127> vajra uvāca || ditirvinaṣṭaputrā ca yaccakāra dvijottama || tanmamācakṣva saṃkṣepāttatra me saṃśayo mahān || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ditirvinaṣṭaputrā ca tapasā mahatā nṛpa || ārādhayāmāsa tadā bhartāraṃ kaśyapaṃ munim ||2 || ārādhitaḥ sutapasā cchandayāmāsa bhāminīm || vareṇa ca vacaḥ kāle putravyasanakarṣitām || 3 || kaśyapa uvāca || varaṃ varaya suśroṇi varado'hamupasthitaḥ || evamuktā varaṃ vavre devī putravinākṛtā || 4 || ditiruvāca || śakrahantāramicchāmi putraṃ brahmanyaśasvinam || yadi tuṣṭo'si me brahmaṃstaṃ prayaccha sutaṃ mama || 5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktastadā bhartā nātiprīto'bravīdvaram || evaṃ te bhavitā bhadre śuci tvaṃ cedbhaviṣyasi || 6 || pūrṇavarṣasahasraṃ ca nānyathā tadbhaviṣyati || evamuktvā tayā sārdhamuvāsa rajanīṃ dvijaḥ ||7|| tato jagāma dharmātmā tapase dṛḍhaniścayaḥ || ātasthau niyamaṃ devī sagarbhā ca ditistadā || niyamasthāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śakro vacanamabravīt|| 8 || śakra uvāca || ahaṃ devi kariṣyāmi tava śuśrūṣaṇaṃ sadā || sthitāyā niyame ghore tadanujñātumarhasi || 9|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bāḍhamastvityathoktastu tayā devaḥ purandaraḥ || tatrovāsa cchalānveṣī śuśrūṣurmātaraṃ sadā || 1.127.10 || tadābdaśeṣe kāle ca divā suptā'ditirnṛpa || madhyāhnasamaye rājanpādayoḥ kṛtamūrdhajā || 11 || tasyāḥ saṃprāpya tacchidraṃ vajrī parapurañjayaḥ || viveśa garbhamārgeṇa vivṛtena nareśvara || 12 || saṃpraviśyaiva taṃ garbhaṃ vajreṇa śataparvaṇā || kṛtavānsaptadhā vajrī bhāgaṃbhāgaṃ tataḥ punaḥ || 13 || ekaikaṃ saptadhā cakre garbho'pi prārudattadā || mā rudasveti taṃ vajrī prāha kārye svake sthitaḥ || 14 || etasminneva kāle ca daityendrajananī tadā || vibuddhā vārayāmāsa śakraṃ daśaśatekṣaṇam || 15 || vajragarbhāñjaliḥ śakro māturvacanayantritaḥ || niścakrāmodarāttasyāḥ saha bālairmahātmabhiḥ || 16 || taṃ jagāda ditiḥ śakraṃ prāñjaliṃ purataḥ sthitam || na te śakrāparādho'sti mama garbhanikṛntane || 17 || sarvopāyairniyantavyaḥ śatrurnayavidā sadā || mamāparādhādgarbho'yaṃ tvayādya bahudhā kṛtaḥ || 18 || bhavantu maruto nāma sarve devāḥ pṛthakpṛthak|| mā rudadhvamiti proktā yataḥ śakra tvayā sutāḥ ||19|| tataśca maruto nāma bhaviṣyanti jagattraye || tvatsahāyā bhaviṣyanti tvadājñāvaśavartinaḥ || 1.127.20 || na caitebhyo bhayaṃ kiñcitkadācitte bhaviṣyati || eṣāṃ nāmavibhāgām̐stu sthānāni ca tathā kuru || 21 || ekajyotiśca dvirjyotistricaturjyotireva ca || ekaśakro dviśakraśca triśakraśca mahābalaḥ || 22 || prathame pavana skandhe gaṇo'yaṃ surathaḥ smṛtaḥ || indraśca gavyo dṛśyaśca itaḥ pratiśirāstathā || 23 || mitaśca sammitaścaiva amitaśca mahābalaḥ || dvitīye pavana skandhe gaṇo nāma praghoṣaṇaḥ ||24|| ṛtajitsatyajiccaiva suṣeṇaḥ senajittathā || atimitro nāmitraśca pṛrumitro'parājitaḥ || 25 || tṛtīye pavanaskandhe gaṇaḥ santāpanaḥ smṛtaḥ || ṛteśca ṛtavāndhātā vidhātā dharaṇo dhruvaḥ || 26 || vidhāraṇaḥ caturthastu gṛhamedho gaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || idṛkṣaśca sadṛkṣaśca etādṛgamṛtāśanaḥ || 27 || krītanaḥ prasadṛkṣaśca sarabhaśca mahāyaśāḥ || gṛhe ca roṣaṇā nāma vāyuskandhe ca pañcame || 28 || dhartā durgadhva nirbhīmo hyabhiyuktiḥ kṛpā sahaḥ || ṣaṣṭhe tu pavanaskandhe sāsvī nāma gaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||29 || dyutirvapuranādṛśyo kāmo jayo virāṭ || prejeṣaṇo gaṇo nāma vāyuskandhe ca saptame || 1.127.30 || eṣāṃ nāmavibhāgantu dattvā sthānāni cācyutaḥ || jagāma svagṛhaṃ prītyā ditiśca svagṛhaṃ yayau || 31 || etattavoktaṃ marutāṃ nṛvīra janmottamaṃ pāpabhayāpahāri || yasmiñśrutenaiva janasya loke bhavantu vṛttyā na bhaviṣyatīha || 32 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 marudutpattirnāma saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 127 || <1.128> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || janayāmāsa rājendra danurdānavapuṅgavān || vipracittimukhānvīrāndaityapakṣamupāśritān || 1 || kālaṃ ca janayāmāsa kālakeyānsudāruṇān || daityapakṣāśritānkrūrānviruddhāndevatāgaṇe || 2 || danāyuṣāyāḥ putrastu vṛtro nāma mahāsuraḥ || viruddhastu sadā devairdaityapakṣamupāśritaḥ || 3 || siṃhikā janayāmāsa saiṃhikeyānmahāsurān || rāhusālvamukhānvīrānbahūnamitatejasaḥ || 4 || gandharvāpsaraso divyā munayastānnivodha me || citrasenograsenau ca ūrṇāyuranaghastathā || 5 || dhṛtarāṣṭraśca gopaśca sūryavarcāstathaiva ca || yugapastṛṇapaḥ pārṣṇirardhaścitrarathastathā || 6 || kaliḥ śāliśirāścaiva parjanyo nāradastathā || teṣāṃ caiva yavīyasyo divyāścāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ || 7 || anūcānānavadyā ca priyamukhyā gaṇeśvarī || miśrakeśī tathā cāpi parṇāśā puñjikasthalā || 8 || marīciḥ śucikā caiva vidyutparṇī tilottamā || āṭṭikā lakṣmaṇā kṣemā devī rambhā manoramā || 9 || āsitā ca subāhuśca suvratā suvapustathā || puṇḍarīkā sugandhā ca sudārā surasā tathā || 1.128.10 || hemā śaradvatī caiva prasūtā kamalā ca yā || sumukhī haṃsamārgā ca saurīyāpsarasaḥ smṛtāḥ || 11 || kadrūśca janayāmāsa nāgāstīvraparākramān || yeṣāṃ śeṣaḥ pradhānastu viṣṇurnāgavapurdharaḥ || 12 || yeneyaṃ dhāryate bhūmiḥ saśailavanakānanā || āheyī vāsudevasya pūrvaṃ mṛrtirmayeritā || 13 || ananta iti vikhyātā mahākalpavināśinī || mahākalpe mahāsattve svayaṃ bhavati sadā || 14 || tasyāṃśena samutpannaḥ śeṣo hi dharaṇīdharaḥ || tasyānujāṃste nāgendrānprādhānyena vadāmyaham || 15 || vāsukistakṣakaścaiva ailāpatro dhanañjayaḥ || airāvato mahāpadmaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau || 16 || śaṅkhapadmau mahāpadmo dhṛtarāṣṭrabalāhakau || nīlāśvaḥ puṣpadantaśca sumukho durmukhastathā || 17 || nahuṣaḥ kararomā ca kuruśca kulikastathā || krodhaśca janayāmāsa daśa kanyā narādhipa || 18 || pulahāya ca tā dattāḥ kaśyapena mahātmanā || mṛgā ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā manoharā || 19 || bhūtā ca kaśipā daṃṣṭrā sarasā surasā tathā || irā caiva tṛṇaṃ sarvaṃ janayāmāsa bhāminī || 1.128.20 || pañcaprakāraṃ dharmajña taṃ me nigadataḥ śṛṇu || vṛkṣagulmalatā valyastvaksāratṛṇajātayaḥ || 21 || antaḥsaṃjñā bhavanyetā ghoreṇa tamasā vṛtāḥ || eteṣāmabhimāninyo devatā yadunandana || 22 || janayāmāsa dharmajña irā dākṣāyaṇī śubhā || prādhā prasūtāpsarasastāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 23 || anavadyā anūkā ca sūnūkā karuṇapriyā || manūnā subhagā caiva sahajanyā ca menakā || 24 || ghṛtasthūlā ghṛtācī ca viṣūcī pūrvacityapi || pramlocītyapsarāścaiva nimlocantī tathaiva ca || 25 || anenaiva prasaṃgena tathānyāsāṃ mahīpate || janma te'psarasāṃ vakṣye tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 26 || sundopasundanāśāya nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || tilaṃtilaṃ samādāya sarvaratnaistilottamā ||27|| yasyāḥ pradakṣiṇājjātaścaturvaktraḥ pinākabhṛt || sahasranayanaḥ śrīmānvajrī śakraśca pākahā || 28 || śeṣairdevagaṇairdṛṣṭvā bhramadvaktraiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ || kṛte karmaṇi sā prāptā sūryalokaṃ varāṅganā || 29 || ekasthaṃ rūpasaundaryaṃ draṣṭumicchanpitāmahaḥ || ahalyāṃ nāma kṛtavāṃstrailokyasyaikasundarīm || 1.128.30 || gautamāya ca tāṃ prādādbrahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || yasyāḥ kṛte gautamena śakro nirvṛṣaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ ||31|| nārāyaṇorusaṃbhūtā tathā caivorvaśī śubhā || saṃtyaktamānasā vavre bhartāraṃ budhajaṃ nṛpam || 32 || | purūravasanāmānaṃ rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi || tenaiva sārdhamadyāpi divaṃ prāptā ca tiṣṭhati || 33 || āhūtya iti vikhyātā tathaivāpsarasaḥ śubhā || brahmaṇā manasā sṛṣṭā devarāmā manoramāḥ || 34 || manoḥ sutāḥ śaucavatyo vidyujjālarucaḥ smṛtāḥ || bhīravaśca sutā mṛtyorbhūmijātā bhuvaḥ smṛtāḥ || 35 || amṛtākhyāśca sambhūtāstathaivāmṛtamanthane || vahnijātā sudā nāma somādbhekurayāstathā || 36 || āyurvatyastathā proktāḥ sūryaraśmisamudbhavāḥ || yajñotpannāstathā nāma ṛksāmabhyastatheṣṭayaḥ || 37 || vāyūtpannā sudā nāma devarāmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || ityete bahusāhasrā vijñeyāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 38 || devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca patnyastā mātaraśca vai || sugandhāścāpyaniṣyandā sarvā hyapsarasaḥ śubhāḥ ||39 || tāsāmāpyāyate sparśādānandaṃ cāśnute mahat || vinatā janayāmāsa rudrānvai somapīthinaḥ || 1.128.40 || aṅgārakaṃ tathā sūryaṃ nirṛtiṃ ca khagaṃ tathā || ajaikapādāhirbudhnyadhūmaketu dhvajāstathā || 41 || havanaṃ nṛśvaraṃ svabhyaṃ kapālamatha kiṅkiṇīm || ekādaśaite kathitāstava rudrā mahābalāḥ || 42 || yeṣāṃ ca janayāmāsa dvau putrau yakṣarākṣasau || yayoḥ santānasaṃbhūtā rājanvai yakṣarākṣasāḥ || 43 || imaṃ ca vaṃśaṃ niyamena yaḥ paṭhenmahātmanāṃ brāhmaṇadevasannidhau || apatyalābhaṃ sa labhet puṣkalāṃ śriyaṃ tathā pretya ca śobhanāṃ gatim || 44 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kaśyapa sargo nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 128 || || cha || <1.129> || vajra uvāca || || urvaśī ca kathaṃ jātā budhajaṃ pārthivaṃ katham || patiṃ kṛtavatī devī mānuṣaṃ tatprakīrtaya || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sādhyau dharmasutau proktau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī || yau tau pūrvaṃ mahīpālau tāvubhau yadunandana || 2 || viṣṇoraṃśau mahāvīryau tapasyabhiratau sadā || tayostadāśramaṃ ramyaṃ sugandhiviṭapadrumam || 3 || badaryāśramamityuktaṃ mṛdusparśahimaṃ śubham || uṣṇatoyavahā gaṅgā śītatoyavahā parā || 4 || suvarṇasikatā ramyā kāñcanotpalamālinī || tatra sā badarī ramyā nityapuṣpaphalopagā || 5 || tatra tau muniśārdūlau ghoraṃ tapa upāśritau || bhavāya sarvalokasya sarvalokeśvarāvubhau || 6 || tayostapasyatorevaṃ mauneyāpsaraso daśa || tayostu tapasā vighnaṃ saṃbhūya kṛtaniścayāḥ || 7 || taṃ pradeśamanuprāptā nānābharaṇabhūṣaṇāḥ || pitāmahānna saumyo'sti kaścidrājañjagattraye || 8 || tāsāṃ darśanamāsādya naraḥ kāmavaśo bhavet || kusumāni vicinvatyo lalantyaśca yathāsukham || 9 || dṛṣṭā nārāyaṇenātha sarvā bālamṛgekṣaṇāḥ || tāsāmantargataṃ bhāvaṃ jñātvā vedavidāṃ varaḥ || 1.129.10 || jitakrodho mahātejā jitakāmo'rthadharmavit || ādāya sahakārasya rasaṃ madanadīpanam || 11 || ūrvościtreṇa cārvaṅgīṃ nirmame'psarasaṃ śubhām || ūrvoḥ kṛtā sā citreṇa citrākaraṇaśālinī ||12|| tasminneva kṣaṇe nārī babhūvāyatalocanā || na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī ||13|| tādṛgvidhā triloke'sminyādṛśī sā varāṅganā || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitāssarvā mauneyāpsaraso daśa || 14|| jagmuryathāgataṃ rājam̐stacchuśrāva purandaraḥ|| draṣṭuṃ kautūhalāttāṃ ca badaryāśramamāgataḥ || 15 || pādayornyapatadvajrī sādhyayordharmanityoḥ || dadarśa ca śubhāṅgīṃ tāṃ śriyaṃ devīmivāparām || 16 || tamuvāca hasansādhyastadā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || mamorujātā dharmajña urvaśīyaṃ bhavediti || 17 || nayasva tridivaṃ caināṃ bhavatvapsarasāṃ śubhā || evamukte mudaṃ prāpya abhivādya ca tāvṛṣī || 18 || anayattāṃ tataḥ svargaṃ devīṃ bālamṛgekṣaṇām || śiṣyatve pradadau tvenāṃ gandharvasya ca tumburoḥ||19|| tataḥ kadācicchakrasya nanarta puratastu sā || upadeśamatikramya tumbaroścāruhāsinī ||1.129.20|| tāṃ śaśāpa sa gandharvo mānuṣye vatsyase śubhe || devalokamimaṃ tyaktvā mānuṣeṇa sahānaghe || 21 || kañcitkālamupāsyaivaṃ mānuṣaṃ taṃ śucismite || āgamya tridive tāvattasmādabhyasyase tataḥ || 22 || tenaiva sārdhaṃ tridive raṃsyase tvaṃ śubhānanā || vaivasvatākhyasya manoryāvadantaramucyate || 23 || evaṃ hi śaptā nṛpavarya tena papāta rājanguruṇā nṛloke || uvāsa rājñā sahitā tu tasmātsvargaṃ samāsādya tathaiva tena || 24 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde urvaśīsaṃbhavo nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 129 || <1.130> vajra uvāca || nākaṃ tyaktvorvaśī brahmanbudhaputraṃ kathaṃ gatā || kva ca sā taṃ narendrendraṃ dṛṣṭavatyaparājitam || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || mano vaivasvatasyāsya dvāpare prathame purā || vṛtte devāsure yuddhe vṛtte cāmṛtamanthane || 2|| saṃgrāme kṛtakarmāṇaṃ tasminneva narādhipam || śakrasyārdhāsana gataṃ rūpeṇāpratimaṃ tadā || 3 || sampūjyamānaṃ tridaśairdadarśāyatalocanā || budhaputraṃ narendendraṃ tadā nārāyaṇātmajā || 4 || dṛṣṭvā babhūva cāsvasthā kāmamārgaṇatāḍitā || tataḥ prabhṛti bhavyeṣu merukuñjeṣu bhāminī || 5 || ākāraṃ gūhamānā sā kālaṃ nayati kāminī || cintayantī narendrendraṃ kandarpapratimaṃ sadā || 6 || na sā bhuṅkte na svapiti śrāntā svapiti vā yadā || tadā paśyati taṃ svapne nīlanīrajalocanā || 7 || manorathām̐śca kurute yām̐śca taṃ prati bhūmipam || 8 || tāni sā paśyati svapne kathañcitsvapnamohitā || kadācitkrīḍite rājñā kadācidanunīyate || 9 || suptā kadācidrājendra vadatī pratibuddhyate || kaṇṭhe gṛhītā sā rājñā tayā cāsau mahīpatiḥ || 1.130.10 || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu sā svapne nidrāmohamupāgatā || tathaiva bāhupāśena racitena vibudhyate || 11 || svapnasaṃsthaṃ yadā dṛṣṭvā mohamāyāti sā ciram || kṛtvā citragataṃ paṭṭe kadācicca nirīkṣate || 12 || evaṃ narendre gatasarvabhāvāṃ vijñāya tāṃ cārutarāṅgayaṣṭim || āpāṇḍurakṣāmakapolabhittiṃ dṛṣṭvaiva rambhāṃ tvaritaṃ jagāda || 13 || yatnena cārvaṅgi nigūhamānā bhāvaṃ mayā tvaṃ viditāsi subhrūḥ || tasminnarendre hṛdayaṃ tavedaṃ yo'sau mahātmā samareṣvajeyaḥ || 14 || purūravā nāma jagattraye'sminkhyātiṃ gataḥ saccaritairnṛvīraḥ|| rūpeṇa kāmaṃ vyatiricya bhāti śauryeṇa śakrādatiricyate saḥ || 15 || dāne samastasya ca nāsti kaścitsa tyepyanaupamyaguṇe nṛvīraḥ || devāsure'sminsamare hatāni tenāsurāṇāṃ niyutāni pañca || 16 || keśī viśālo madanastathogro mahābalastena tathāpi śastaḥ || candrasya pautraśca budhasya putro mātāpi tasyārkasutasya dhātrī || 17 || mānaṃ samutsṛjya viśālanetraṃ taṃ gaccha bāle nṛpatiṃ pratītam || tvadāptaye tasya ca nāsti yatnaḥ sudurlabhatvaṃ khalu devatānām || 18 || manorathānāṃ tvamagamyabhūmiryasmādviśālākṣi surāsurāṇām || mṛṇālaśayyā sutanu tvayeva saṃkleśitā candanapaṅkayuktā || 19 || tasyāṅkamāruhya bhavasva kānte vimuktatāpā tapanīyavarṇe || yāsyāma ehyehi nareśvarasya tasyāśu bho veśma varaprayoge || 1.130.20 || puraṃ pratiṣṭhānamiti pratītaṃ mātāmahādyatsamavāpa rājā || ityevamuktā tapanīyavarṇā tathyaṃ viditvā trapitā babhūva || 21 || uvāca rambhāṃ sakhi tathyamuktaṃ tvayā mataṃ taducitaṃ bhṛśaṃ me || yāsyāva adyaiva nareśvarasya tasyāntikaṃ bālamṛgābhanetre|| 22 || yadyadya taṃ nīlasarojanetraṃ sampūrṇacandrābhamukhaṃ narendram || paśyāmi nāhaṃ pṛthudīrghabāhuṃ tato gamiṣyāmyavaśāvasānam || 23 || pañcaiva kāmasya janaḥ pṛṣatkānyadāha rambhe tadalaṃ mṛṣaiva || mamāniśaṃ bāṇabharaistu vidhyanna śāmyate tvakṣinimeṣamātram || 24 || kāmāgnimadhye parivartamānaṃ na yāti bhasmatvamidaṃ śarīram || tasyaiva rājño vadanendunā tatsaṃrakṣyate me hṛdayasthitena || 25|| nayasva māṃ tasya viśālanetre samīpamadyaiva nareśvarasya || ityevamuktā karuṇaṃ hi rambhā pāṇāvupādāya viśālanetrām||26|| buddhyā samutplutya tato'ntarikṣaṃ jagāma rājño bhavanaṃ prahṛṣṭā || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde urvaśīrambhāsaṃvādo nāma triṃśaduttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ||130|| <1.131> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca urvaśī rambhayā sārddhaṃ jagāma tvaritaṃ tadā || kāmārttā siddhamārgeṇa sā dadarśātha nāradam ||1 || vrajantaṃ siddhamārgeṇa devalokādupāgatama || sampūjya nāradaṃ subhrūḥ prayayāveva satvarā|| vrajantaṃ siddhamārgeṇa devalokādupāgatam || sampūjya nāradaṃ subhrūḥ prayayāveva satvarā || 2 || tāmāha nārado rambhe keyaṃ te prasthitā sakhī || rambhā śāpabhayāttasyāḥ sarvameva nyavedayat || 3 || tāmāha nārado bhūyaḥ śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama || urvaśī gatabhāveyaṃ mānuṣaṃ taṃ nareśvaram || 4 || śāpena tumbarormohāducitaṃ tatra vatsyati || yathā śubhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ tvayā me vacanaṃ śubhe ||9|| samayenorvaśī tasya vasatvasitalocanā || samayaścānayā kāryo yo rājñastaṃ nibodha me || 6|| meṣadvayaṃ tu putratve purā kṛtavatī śubhā || tannityaṃ śayanābhyāśe sthāpanīyaṃ sulocane || 7|| āhāraṃ ghṛtamātraṃ ca kartavyamanayā tathā || na draṣṭavyastathā nagno rājā rambhe purūravāḥ ||8|| na kartavyamakāmāyāstathā tena ca maithunam || ekasminnapyatho bhagne samaye cārulocanā ||9|| yadi vatsyati rājānaṃ śilābhūtā bhaviṣyati || urvaśī rambhayā sārdhamevamastviti nāradam || 1.131.10 || uktvā saṃpūjya ca muniṃ pratasthe punareva ca || nārado vyagamadvipraḥ puraṃ vaiśravaṇasya ca || 11 |||| dadarśa ca pratiṣṭhānaṃ corvaśī rambhayā saha || prākāreṇārkavarṇena kāñcanena virājitam || 12|| caturbhirgopuraiśśubhrai rājataiśca virājitam || śobhanaṃ ca tathā ramyaṃ vidrumasya ca toraṇaiḥ || 13|| suvibhaktamahāraṇyaṃ mahārājapathaṃ śubham || parikhābhirvicitrābhiḥ padminībhiralaṃkṛtam || 14|| khamullikhadbhiḥ prāsādaiḥ pāṇḍurairupaśobhitam || śūrāḍhyajanabhūyiṣṭhaṃ divyaṃ puruṣasaṃyutam ||15|| vaṇigbhirupasaṃkīrṇa nānāpaṇyavibhūṣitam || airāvatakulotpannaiścalatparvatasannibhaiḥ ||16|| kuñjarairbahusāhasraissaṃyutaṃ sumanoharaiḥ || turagairvahnijātaiśca pavanasya samairjave || 17 || pānamattairnarairyuktamudyāneṣu tatastataḥ || śaṅkhabherīmṛdaṅgānāṃ paṭahānāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ ||18|| vividhānāṃ ca vādyānāṃ vāditraṃ sarvaveśmagam || brahmaghoṣaṃ mahāghoṣaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam ||19|| hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ sarvabādhāvivarjitam || padmakiñjalkavarṇābhiryutaṃ strībhiḥ sahasraśaḥ||1.131.20|| śyāmābhiśca mahārāja kāṇḍagaurībhireva ca || || nānāveṣadharairyuktaṃ nānādeśodbhavaistathā ||21|| narairanekarūpaiśca śilpajñaiśca hyanekaśaḥ || purasya tasya madhye sā dadarśa nṛpatergṛham |22 || madhye himācalasyeva kailāsaṃ parvatottamam || śrīmadbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ ramyairgṛhamedhaiḥ sahasraśaḥ||23|| sudhāvadātairvipulaiścandraraśmisamaprabhaiḥ || kvacidrātnaiḥ kvacidraukmaiḥ kvacidbhūpāla rājataiḥ ||24|| maṇividrumasopānairmuktājālavibhūṣitaiḥ || kvacicca puṣpadāmāḍhyairvaijayantīyutaiḥ kvacit || 25 || tasyāvidūre vipulaṃ vanaṃ caitrarathopamam || rājñaḥ krīḍāvanaṃ ramyaṃ dadarśa vipulekṣaṇā || 26|| drumairbahuvidhairyuktaṃ puṣpapūgaphalopagaiḥ ||| padminībhirvicitrābhiḥ krīḍāśailairmanoharaiḥ || 27 || prāsādaiśca tathā ramyai ramyairmaṇigaṇaistathā || tattu rambhāvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakhī vacanamabravīt || 28 || rājñaḥ krīḍāvane ramye gahane'sminsulocane || māyācchannā nivatsyāvo yāvadastamayaṃ raveḥ || 29 || tato gatvā narendraṃ taṃ coktvā tava cikīrṣitam|| ahaṃ tvāṃ tu nayiṣyāmi savidhe tasya bhūpateḥ || evamuktvā sakhī vākyaṃ nodayāmāsa corvaśī || 1.131.30 || krīḍāvanaṃ te ca tato'vatīrṇe taddevarāme sumanobhirāmam || krīḍāvane tatra tathorvaśī sā sūryāstakālaṃ manasā samaicchat || 31 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde krīḍāvanāvataraṇo nāmaikatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 131 || <1.132> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sūryāstamayamicchantī jñātvā rambhā tathorvaśīm || vinodārthaṃ hi tasyāśca darśayāmāsa tadvanam ||1|| cāruprasūnaṃ paśyemaṃ subhage campakadrumam || tvadgātravarṇasadṛśaiḥ samantātkusumaiścitam ||2|| imaṃ ca dāḍimaṃ paśya puṣpitaṃ vāmalocane || yo'yaṃ bibhartti kusumaistvadīyāmadharaśriyam||3|| paśya kāmaśarākāraṃ sahakāraṃ manoramam || yatra cātmasamutpannā rūḍhāstasya mahātmanaḥ || 4 || śriyaṃ kapolayostubhyamādadānairmanoramaiḥ || puṣpairupetā cārvaṅgi madhūkaṃ paśya śobhane||5|| tvatpayodharasaṃkāśai ramyairupacitaṃ phalaiḥ ||||| paśya tāladrumaṃ saumye manasaḥ prītivardhanam ||6|| stambhaistvadūrusaṃkāśaiḥ kadalīṃ paśya śobhane || suvarṇā cārusarvāṅgī nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || 7 ||| paśyāvimuktakalatāṃ kusumāḍhyāṃ manoharām || tvatkeśapāśasaṃkāśairbhramarairupaśobhitām || 8 || paśyemaṃ kundaviṭapaṃ tvaddantasadṛśaiḥ śubhaiḥ || samantācchobhitaṃ puṣpairviśālākṣi manoharaiḥ || 9 || paśya cotpalinīmetāmutpalairuśobhitām || tvannetrasadṛśaiḥ phullairmanohṛdayanandanaiḥ ||1.132.10 || nalinīṃ subhage paśya kamalaiḥ puṣpitairyutām|| tava niḥśvāsagandhāḍhyaiḥ sauvarṇairvajrakesaraiḥ||11|| rājahaṃsānimānpaśya nalinītīragocarān|| gamanaṃ sumanohāri tvadīyamiva śikṣitān || 12 || tvatkarāgravidhānsaumye dhārayadbhiśca pallavān || krīḍāśailamimaṃ paśya yuktaṃ vahuvidhairdrumaiḥ || 13 || krīḍāśaile cūtagataḥ kokilaḥ kāmavardhanaḥ || kūjatyayaṃ manohāri svanena sadṛśena te||14|| krīḍāśaile nadīṃ paśya niḥsṛtāṃ śītalodakām || tulyaṃ te manasā saumye vahantīṃ nirmalaṃ jalam||15|| bahvāścaryayutaṃ saumyaṃ darśanīyaṃ vanaṃ bahu || kiṃ nu paśya viśālākṣi sūryo'stamupagacchati||16|| tvāṃ tu kāmavaśāṃ jñātvā kṛpayeva divākaraḥ || saṃvṛttāṃśudharo devastvastamāyāti bhāmini |||17|| kaṭhorāṇyapi patrāṇi pallavānīva sundari || astatāpānuraktāni rājante śākhināṃ bhṛśam || 18 || girīṇāṃ śikharānraktānkarotyeva divākaraḥ || jagāmāstaṃ viśālākṣi kṛtakarmā dinakṣaye || 19 || sandhyākālena raktena pratīcī paśya śobhane || āliṅgamānāṃ sahasā kāminīmiva kāminīm || 1.132.20 || sāṃprataṃ niyamopetā dvijā dvijavarodbhave || sandhyākālamupāsante satāṃ mārgamanuvratāḥ || 21 || anuyātā raviṃ sandhyā gatamastamapi prabhum || sādhvīva vanitā kānte kṛlajātā manasvinī || 22 || yāsyamānaṃ sunāsoru tamasā paśya bhūtalam || bhṛṅgodaratamālānāṃ tulyena varavarṇini || 23 || vyāptaṃ hi tamasā sarvaṃ na virājati kiñcana || malinenāya tāpāṅgi jagatsarvaṃ samīkṛtam || 24 || asyāṃ hi sakhi velāyāṃ madanena vaśīkṛtāḥ || nīlāmbaradharāḥ kāntā yānti kāntānalaṅkṛtāḥ ||25|| paśyoditaṃ ca subhage subhagaṃ candramaṇḍalam || pānamattapurandhrīṇāṃ vadanena samatviṣam || 26 || kiñcidākramya gaganaṃ śvetatāṃ tu gataṃ sakhi || paśya candramasaṃ subhru nayanānandakārakam || 27 || jagato'sya tamo gatvā śaśāṅkaḥ sattvasannibhaḥ || virājatyamalaḥ saumye gagane sitasuprabhe||28|| kāmabāṇahatāyāste sadṛśaṃ gaṇḍayoḥ śriyā || bibhartyubhayataścandro jyotsnājālaṃ samutsṛjan || 29 || candrarājatakumbhena diśeyaṃ varavarṇini || jyotsnācchalena kṣmā devī rājatīva virājate || 1.132.30 || candramasyudite paśya phullāṃ kumudinīṃ śubhe || tvadīyahāsasaṃkāśaiḥ kusumairupaśobhitām || || 31 || virahī cakravāko'yaṃ raktāmutpalinīṃ śubhe || sitāmiva sudukhārto viśatyāyatalocane || 32 || candrakāntagṛhādasmāccandraraśmi samaprabhā || candraraśmiparāmṛṣṭāḥ patantyudakabindavaḥ || 33 || āliṅgitā candramasā jahau rāttristamaḥpaṭam || kāmineva viśālākṣi kāminī vasanaṃ śubhā || 34 || candrodaye candrasamānavaktre narendracandre pramadāvane'smin || paśya tvamāśaṃsa ca jīvitāśāṃ tvadbhāgyanunnaṃ sahasā praviṣṭam || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde upavane candrodayavarṇano nāma dvātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 132 || <1.133> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ityuktā rambhayā vākyaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānamāgatam || hṛṣṭā sasādhvasā devī babhūvātha tathorvaśī || 1 || atyāścaryamabhūddṛṣṭe rājñi tasyāḥ śubhānane || romāñcitatanutvaṃ ca saprasvedaṃ samābabhau || 2 || tāmuvāca tato rambhā śṛṇūrvaśi vaco mama | nehāgame'sya nṛpateḥ kāryamalpaṃ bhaviṣyati || 3 || rājā sukhāsahāyo'yaṃ praviṣṭo niśi kānanam || pracchanne śṛṇuvastāvadasya vākyāni bhūpateḥ || 4 || evamastvityuvācātha rambhāṃ nārāyaṇātmajā || māyācchannaśarīre te tataścāyayaturnṛpam || 5 || rājānaṃ cārusarvāṅgaṃ papraccha tu tadā sakhā || rājño bahumato nityaṃ guṇavām̐ścātidhārmikaḥ || 6 || sakhovāca || yataḥ prabhṛti rājendra tridivāttvamihāgataḥ || tataḥ prabhṛti cāsvastho mayā dṛṣṭo'si mānada ||7|| tadasvāsthyaṃ kāmakṛtaṃ jñātavānasmi te nṛpa || tanmamācakṣva te guhyaṃ na cennaravarottama || 8 || purūravā uvāca || tava guhyaṃ na me kiñcitkadācidapi vidyate || asvāsthyakāraṇaṃ saumya tava vakṣyāmyathātmanaḥ || 9 || nārāyaṇasutā kāntā rūpeṇāpratimā śubhā || urvaśīnāmataḥ khyātā mayā dṛṣṭā varāpsarāḥ||1.133.10|| yataḥ prabhṛti cārvaṅgī tataḥ prabhṛti me sakhe || kāmenāloḍyate cittaṃ na ca śāmyati me tathā || 11 || na copāyaṃ prapaśyāmi tasyā lābhe dvijottama || devatānāmapi śubhā durlabhā sā varāṅganā || 12 || evaṃ duḥkhaparītasya sakhe kālo gato mama || upabhuktā mayā svapne sādya cārvasitekṣaṇā || 13 || candrakāntagṛhe hyasminkāmamārgaṇatāḍitā || candrodaye cārumukhī trailokyasyaikasundarī || 14 || vinodanārthaṃ hi sakhe manaso'ti manoharam || candrodaye tataḥ prāptaṃ candrakāntaśilāgṛham || 15 || tadehi tvasti saumya praviśya ruciraṃ gṛham || vinodayāmi hṛdayaṃ manmathena vaśīkṛtam || 16 || sakhovāca || yathā dṛṣṭaṃ tvayā svapne tathādya bhavitā dhuvam || sāpi kāmaparītāṅgī tvāmupeśyati bhāminī || 17 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā viveśātha candrakāntaśilāgṛham || āsāñcakre tadā tasminmadanena vaśīkṛtaḥ || 18 ||| urvaśī rambhayā sārdhaṃ tacchrutvā harṣamāgatā || ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa rambhāpi nṛpatestadā || 19 || jayetyuktvā mahīnāthaṃ rambhā kāmavaśāttadā ||| babhūva puratastasya śobhayantīva tadgṛham || 1.133.20|| tāmuvāca tato rājā svāgataṃ te varānane || alaṅkuruṣva cārvaṅgi ratnāsanamidaṃ śubham || 21 || ratnāsanopaviṣṭāyāṃ tadāgamanavismitaḥ || tadā rājīvaraktākṣastāmuvāca varānanām ||22|| śakrasya nagaraṃ rambhe rājate nityaśastvayā || paurṇamāsyā yathā rātriḥ śaśāṅkeneva bhāmini || 23 || tvaṃ sabhāmaṇḍanaṃ tasya sacchiṣyā tvaṃ ca tumburoḥ || tvayābhibhūtāssakalāḥ striyaḥ suptāḥ suśobhane || 24 || tvayābhibhūtāḥ sakalāḥ striyaḥ svarge suśobhane || tava netrasahasreṇa paśyannapi tu pākahā || 25 || sarvatra cārusarvāṃgi na tṛpyati śubhānane || tanmamācakṣva subhage ihāgamanakāraṇam || 26 || rambhovāca || śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanmamāgamanakāraṇam || śrutvā tacca narendrendra kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama || 27 || nārāyaṇasutā devī tatra trailokyasundarī || urvaśī nāma cārvaṅgī bhūmipāla sakhī mama || 28 || sā tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahendrasya sadane kāmamohitā || na śarma labhate bālā hāheti vadatī muhuḥ || 29 || sā tvadarthamanaṃgena mārgaṇairbhṛśapīḍitā || lāvaṇya śeṣā saṃvṛttā dinaiḥ katipayaiḥ śubhā || 1.133.30 || kṣāmakṣāmakapolā sā tvatsamarpitamānasā || madanenābhitaptāṃgī mānamutsṛjya bhāminī || 31 || prasthitā sā mayā sārddhaṃ tava darśanalālasā || antarā nāradenoktā yatra tvaṃ prasthitā śubhe || 32 || tatra tvayā tu vastavyaṃ samayena varānane || meṣadvayaṃ tu putratve yattvayā parikalpitam || 33 || tattu te śayanābhyāśe sthāpayetsatataṃ yadi || sa rājā cārusarvāṅgi nagno nekṣeta bhāmini ||34|| maithunaṃ cāpyakāmāyā nāsau te kartumarhati || ghṛtāhārā tathā tatra vasa tvaṃ subhage sadā || 35 || ekasminnapyatikrānte samaye yadi pārthivam || na tyakṣyasi tadā saumye śilābhūtā bhaviṣyasi || 36 || etāni samayānyuktā nāradena sakhī mama|| tāni tvaṃ pratipadyasva bhajasva ca śubhānanām||37||| purūravā uvāca || rambhe tavādya vākyena amṛteneva bhāmini || mṛtyorvaśamanuprāpto jīvito'smi śubhānane || 38 || mamāpi tatkṛte rambhe madanaḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ || dunoti hadayaṃ subhrūrdivārātramatandritaḥ || 39 || sā tvaṃ jīvaya māṃ śīghraṃ darśayasva varāṅganām || sthāsyāmi samaye tasminyasminmāṃ vakṣyase śubhe || 1.133.40|| kṛtaṃ taṃ samayaṃ viddhi nāradena yadīritam|| anākrande nimagnasya mama kāmamahodadhau ||41|| plavo bhava viśālākṣi prāṇadā bhava sundari || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktā narendreṇa rambhā cāntardadhe tadā || 42 || urvaśīsahitā cātha darśayāmāsa sā nṛpam || jayetyuktvā narendraṃ tu tadā nārāyaṇātmajā || 43 || vrīḍitā puratastasthau tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prītimāpātha sa narendro mahādyutiḥ || 44 || pulakāṃcita sarvāṅgo varṇituṃ sā na śakyate || pāṇāvādāya trapitāmutsaṅge copaveśayat || 45 || ratnāsanaṃ tathā bheje rambhāpi sumanoharam || tataścovāca vacanaṃ rājā muditamānasaḥ ||46|| purūravā uvāca || kāmadevaḥ prasanno'dya mamorvaśi varāvane || adya vedūmyadhikaṃ subhrūḥ śakrādātmānamātmanā||47|| trailokyarājyalābhe'pi kutaḥ sā me śubhe ratiḥ || ājñākāritvamāsādya yā tavādya sulocane || 48 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evaṃ vadati bhūpāle yayau rambhā varānanā || kṣaṇena meṣasahitā punaḥ prāptā nṛpāntikam || 49 || meṣau dattvā narendrasya rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt || rambhovāca || yāsyāmi laṅkāṃ rājendra tatra prāṇeśvaro mama ||1.133.50|| matpratīkṣaḥ sthitaḥ śrīmāndhanadasyātmasaṃbhavaḥ || nalakūbaranāmāsau trailokyaviditaḥ prabho ||51 || yathā ceyaṃ sakhī mahyaṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ kurute śubhā || sakhījanasya svargyasya tathā kāryaṃ tvayānagha || 52 || purūravā uvāca || yatiṣye'haṃ tathā kartuṃ nirvṛtā bhava mānade || ratnānyetānyupādāya nirgacchasva yathāsukham || 53 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktā tato rambhā nṛpateḥ prītikāraṇāt || ratnānyupādāya yayau khena laṅkāṃ mahāpurīm ||54|| labdhvorvaśīṃ narendro'pi reme sa sahitastayā || yathā śacyā surārighno balavānpākaśāsanaḥ || 55 || saṃnyastabhāraḥ sa tu mantrimukhye reme tayā yādavasiṃhamukhya|| lakṣmyā sameto bhagavānananto yathā sa devo bhuvanasya goptā || 56 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde urvaśīpurūravaḥsamāgamo nāma trayastriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 133|| <1.134> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || prāsādeṣu vicitreṣu tathā maṇigṛheṣu ca || puṣpaveśmasu ramyeṣu tathā vastragṛheṣu ca || 1 || ratnaveśmasu mukhyeṣu tathā citragṛheṣu ca || parvatānāṃ ca durgeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca || 2 || padminīṣu ca phullāsu tathā cotpalinīṣu ca || śayyāsu ca parārdhyāsu puṣpaśayyāsu cāpyatha|| 3|| ramayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ tathā viraciteṣu ca || gṛheṣu bahuratneṣu dhūpodgāriṣu pārthiva ||4|| reme sa tu tayā sārdhaṃ mānaseṣu punaḥpunaḥ || ramayam̐stāṃ varārohāṃ na tṛpyati sa nityaśaḥ || 5 || niśāsu ca sacandrāsu candrakāntataraṃ mukham || papau tasyā yathākāmaṃ narendraḥ sa narādhipa||6|| niśāsu naṣṭacandrāsu tanmukho dyotitaprabhe || deśe tāṃ ramayāmāsa rājā rājīvalocanaḥ||7|| varṣayantī narendrasya sā tu kāmaṃ dinedine || adṛṣṭapūrveva śubhā bhavatyāyatalocanā ||8|| rājño dṛḍhaṃ sā dayitā tasyāśca dviguṇo nṛpaḥ || tayā'sau prīyate rājā tena sāpi varāṅganā || 9 || varacandanadigdhāṅgau nānābharaṇabhūṣitau || remāte dampatī hṛṣṭau nānāratnāvabhūṣitau || 1.134.10 || alaṅkaroti tāṃ rājā svayameva kadācana || tayā'laṃkriyamāṇaśca prītimāpnotyanuttamām || 11 || vareṣu tau vicitreṣu remāte muditau bhṛśam || keśānsaṃśobhayantau tau kusumaistu parasparam || 12 || urvaśyabhyuditaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā ca grathitaṃ punaḥ || dhārayāmāsa śirasā premṇā pārthivasattamaḥ|| 13|| patracchedena yām̐ścakre tilakānsa narādhipaḥ || tām̐śca sā dhārayāmāsa lalāṭe cāruhāsinī || 14|| evaṃ saṃkrīḍato rājñastayā saha sumadhyayā || babhūvustanayāḥ pañca nāmatastānnibodha me || 15 || āyurjyeṣṭhastato dhīmām̐stataścānyastvanāmayaḥ || ayutāyuścaturtho'bhūcchatāyuścaiva pañcamaḥ || 16 || evaṃ tasyāḥ prasūtā vai yāti kāle manohare || 17 || gandharvamukhyāstu tadā sametā tayā vihīnā bhṛśamutsukāstu || tadāgamāyātha surendraloke yatra tadā cakruradīnasattvāḥ || 18 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakāṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde urvaśīsambhogavarṇano nāma catustriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 134 || <1.135> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || urvaśyāgamane yatnaṃ cakruste mantramuttamam || gandharvastūgrasenākhyastadā mantramabhāṣata || 1 || ugrasena uvāca || samayevasthitā tasminnurvaśī cārubhūṣaṇā || vyutkrāntasamayaṃ sā tu rājānaṃ tyakṣyate ca tam ||2 || tamahaṃ vedmi samayaṃ tatra yāsyāmi cānagha || yuṣmatkāryaṃ kariṣyāmi sasahāyo na saṃśayaḥ || 3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā yayau tatra yatrāsau nṛpatiḥ sthitaḥ || rātrau jahāra meṣaṃ ca māyayā sa narādhipa || 4 || meṣaṃ jñātvā hṛtaṃ devī rājānamidamabravīt || meṣo hṛto mahīpāla kenāpyaddhā suto mama || 5 || dvitīyaśca hṛto rājam̐stamānaya sutaṃ mama || evamuktastayā rājā nagna evātha saṃbhramāt || 6 || utthāyānveṣaṇaṃ cakre meṣayoḥ puruṣarṣabha || athāpaśyata sā nagnaṃ rājānamasitekṣaṇā || 7 || saṃsmṛtya nāradavacastirobhūtā babhūva sā || gandharvāṇāṃ yayau sāpi samīpaṃ duḥkhitā tadā || 8 || svargaṃ prāpya viśālākṣī nityaṃ nṛpaparāyaṇā || kāmanunnaśarīrāpi kālaṃ nayati sundarī || 9|| ṛṣiśāpabhayādbhītā madanena vaśīkṛtā || nityamāsa varārohā niḥśvāsaparamā satī | 1.135.10 || aprāpya meṣayugalaṃ vinivṛtto narādhipaḥ || nāpaśyacchayane devīṃ sasmāra samayaṃ tadā ||11|| viditvā tyaktamātmānaṃ smṛtvā samayamātmanaḥ || kāmabāṇārdito rājā tathāpi vijane vane||12|| tāṃ mārgati varārohāmunmatta iva sarvataḥ || ekākī vijane rājā priyayā rahitastadā || 13 || vilalāpa mahāsattvaḥ kusattva iva kaścana || purūravā uvāca || kva gatāsi viśālākṣi vihāya vijanetra mām||14|| kathaṃ pravekṣyāmi puraṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ vinā tvayā || prāṇāstyaktvā gamiṣyanti śarīraṃ mama sundari || 15 || anugantuṃ śarīreṇa na śaknomi varānane || tvaṃ hi me capalāpāṅgi prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 16 || tvayā tyakto dhruvaṃ prāṇām̐styakṣyāmi varavarṇini || kvāsi kvāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kiṃ karomi vrajāmi kām || 17 || śaraṇaṃ kāmataptasya ko me saṃdarśayetpriyām || kaṃ svitpṛcchāmi vijane kasya sā viditā bhavet || 18 || kṣemo vā mama kasya syādyo me saṃdarśayetpriyām || priyāvirahitasyaiṣa niśāśeṣo gato mama || 39 || antardhānaṃ gatāstārā yathā devī mamorvaśī || devo'ruṇakarasparśācchobhāṃ tyajati candramāḥ || 1.135.20 || niśākṣaye kṣāmavapuryathāhaṃ tadvinākṛtaḥ || eṣā hyāvartate pūrvā sandhyā snātvā dvijātayaḥ || 21 || nūnaṃ niyamasaṃyuktāstiṣṭhanti vijitendriyāḥ || ayaṃ hyudayamāyāti savitā raktamaṇḍalaḥ || 22 || sarvasattvasamo devaḥ sarveṣāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ || uditaścāpyayaṃ sūryo vibhāti vimalembare || 23 || ekaṃ phullaṃ mahāpadmaṃ sarasīvāmale yathā || uditaṃ bhāskaraṃ jñātvā nalinīpadmalocanā || 24 || unmīlyālokate sarvaṃ vinā tena nimīlitā || tīkṣṇārkaḥ saṃpravṛtto'yaṃ divasaḥ kāmavardhanaḥ || 25 || naidāgho māṃ viśeṣeṇa santāpayati tāṃ vinā || kaṃ pṛcchāmi varārohāṃ saṃtaptakanakaprabhām || 26 || dṛṣṭā mayeti sā devī ko māṃ vakṣyati kānane || karīndrastvayamabhyeti tatkucābhau samudvahan || 27 || kumbhau kaṭhorau sumukhaṃ pṛcchāmyenaṃ mataṅgajam || tvaddantayugalaprakhyaṃ yadūruyugalaṃ hyabhūt || 28 || gatāṃ tāṃ yadi jānīṣe kathayasva mamorvaśīm || eṣa hastī gatastrāsātsiṃhasyāsya mahātmanaḥ || 29|| adattvaivottaraṃ mahyaṃ siṃhaṃ pṛcchāmyahaṃ vane || madhyastvadupamastasyāḥ kva sā samprati kesarin ||1.135.30|| urvaśī dayitā mahyaṃ yadi jānāsi kathyatām || adattvaivottaraṃ siṃhaḥ kathameṣa gato mama || 31 || dṛṣṭā kathaya he bimba devīṃ bimbaphalādharām || anenāpi na cākhyātā pṛṣṭena sudatī mama || 32 || mayūra yadi jānīṣe bālāṃ bālamṛgekṣaṇām || urvaśīṃ kathayasvādya kva priyā mama vartate || 33 || antaḥśarīraṃ kāmāgnirbahirdahati bhāskaraḥ || tāpārttā niḥśvasantyete siṃhā giriguhāgatāḥ || 34 || nirastajihvāḥ srastāṅgā vivṛtāsyā muhurmuhuḥ || yūthāni mahiṣīṇāṃ ca śerate nalinījale || 35 || sūryoddhatajalāsvanye paṅkaśeṣā su śerate || gaganaṃ cātakaścāyaṃ tṛṣṇārto lokate muhuḥ || 36 || su bhṛśaṃ toyapānārthī urvaśyarthe yathā tvaham || yāntyete padminī khaṇḍānkuñjarāstāparūṣitāḥ || 37 || suhastamuktaiśca jalaiḥ siṃcantyātmānamātmanā || mahādrumāṇāṃ skandheṣu viṣaṇṇāścāpare gajāḥ || 38 || tāpaṃ nayanti madhyāhne muñcantaḥ śīkaraṃ muhuḥ || śākhāparṇāntarāṇyete vihagāstāpatāpitāḥ || 39 || viśanti caiva trāṇārthaṃ madhyāhnasamaye bhṛśam || drumaśākhāgatā hyete vihagānāṃ ca bālakāḥ || 1.135.40 || raktāntacakrāḥ subhṛśaṃ viśantīha muhurmuhuḥ || tyaktāhārakriyāścaite mṛgayūthā mahāvane || 41 || drumacchāyāsu tiṣṭhanti romanthaṃ kurvuto muhuḥ || anveṣamāṇo dayitāṃ śrīto'smi vijaye bhṛśam || 42 || chāyāyāṃ viśramiṣyāmi śirīṣasyāsya sāmpratam || tadgātrasukumārāṇi puṣpāṇyasya vanaspateḥ || 43 || śirīṣavṛkṣo ramyo'yaṃ manohṛdayanandanaḥ|| kintu māṃ pīḍayatyeṣa śirīṣastadvinākṛtam || 44 || sūryaścāstamupāyāti kva gamiṣyāmi śarvarīm || astaṃ yātaḥ sahasrāṃśurniśā prāptā sudāruṇā||45|| rātrimenāṃ vivatsyāmi nyagrodhe'sminmahādrume || urvaśyā ṛddhiracite varaveśmani pārthivaḥ || 46 || sa krīḍati tayā sārdhaṃ sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ || nūnaṃ māṃ sa jano vetti pratiṣṭhānapure tu me || 47 || etāmavasthāṃ kaścinme na vijānāti sāmpratam || pauro jānapadaḥ kaścijjano me dayitaḥ sadā || 48 || nidre bhajasva mannetre dhruvaṃ svapne varānanāma || tāṃ tu prāpsyāmyahaṃ saumyāṃ manasaḥ prītivardhinīm || 49 || kathamabhyuditaścandraḥ pīḍāṃ janayate mama || tadvaktravijitaḥ pūrvaṃ vikarotyadhunā mayi || 1.135.50 || tuda candra yathākāmaṃ mama dehaṃ vinākṛtam || tvayā tu nāthaṃ saṃprāpya sāpatnyaṃ mama darśaya || 51 || hā hato'smi vinaṣṭo'smi urvaśyā rahito vane || candra pautre kuru dayāṃ darśayasva mama priyām || 52 || śaśāṅka deva śītāṃśo nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭimanohara || ākrandāmi tavādyāhaṃ darśayasva priyāṃ mama || 53 || atṛpta darśanasyaiva sā gatā sundarī mama || antardhānaṃ viśālākṣī tāṃ darśaya mamorvaśīm ||54 || kadā'dhararasaṃ tasyāḥ pāsyāmyamṛtasannibham || kadā draṣṭāsmi tāṃ bhūyaḥ kamalodarasannibhām ||55|| mṛṇālabāhuyugalāṃ padmavaktrāṃ kadā priyām || nīlotpalākṣīmāliṅgya tāpaṃ tyakṣyāmyanaṅgajam||56|| anaṅgaśaranunnasya bāle bhava gatirmama || dadasva darśanaṃ subhrūḥ kā mamānyā gatirbhavet ||57 || kāmamohagṛhītasya tvamevābhūrgatirmama || bhūyastvameva subhage gatirbhava mamānaghe || 58 || eṣā viralitā rātrirmama varṣaśatopamā || anveṣṭuṃ kva gamiṣyāmi nirghṛṇāṃ tāṃ mamopari || 59 || yasyāḥ kopaṃ na jānāmi svapne'pi varavarṇini || daivenopahatasyādya tyaktā sā subhagā gatā || 1.135.60 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evaṃ sa vilapanrājā tyaktāhāraḥ paribhraman | āsasāda kurukṣetraṃ dvādaśāhena pārthiva||61|| puṣkariṇyāstaṭaplakṣe puṣkarairupaśobhite | niṣasāda tadā śrāntaḥ kṣutpipāsāsamanvitaḥ|| vilalāpa sa tatrāpi madanena vaśīkṛtaḥ || 62 || kadā nu taccandramaso'nukānti mukhaṃ smitaṃ cāruvilocanāyāḥ|| unnāmya pāsyāmyadharaṃ tṛṣārto vārīva pānthaḥ pathi kṛcchralabhyam || 63 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde purūravāpralāpavarṇano nāma pañcatriṃśadu ttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 135 || <1.136> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || urvaśyapi varārohā madanenābhipīḍitā || jagāda nāradasyātha svāmavasthāṃ nṛpaṃ vinā || 1 || tatastāṃ nāradaḥ prāha subhage gaccha pārthivam || tasyāpyavasthā mahatī tvadvihīnasya sundari ||2 || ekāṃ rātriṃ narendreṇa sahoṣya varavarṇini || svargalokamupāgaccha śreyaḥ prāpsyasi vai tataḥ || 3 || nāradenaivamuktā sā sakhībhirbahubhirvṛtā || puṣkariṇyāstaruplakṣe yayau snātuṃ varānanā || 4 || etasminneva kāle tu nidrayopahṛto nṛpaḥ || apsarobhiravajñātastatra suṣvāpa pārthiva || 5 || adya yāsyāmi rājānamiti hṛṣṭā tadorvaśī|| krīḍantyatra jale tasminsakhīgaṇavṛtā tadā || 6 || tyaktanidro narendro'pi vilalāpa ciraṃ punaḥ || śuśrāva vilapantaṃ sā sakhībhiḥ sahitā nṛpam || 7 || darśayāmāma cātmānaṃ pārthivasya śubhā tataḥ || uvāca ca varārohā nāradoktamaśeṣataḥ || 8 || tatraivovāsa tāṃ rātriṃ saha tena varānanā || rātrikṣaye visaṃjñaṃ sā rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt || 9 || urvaśyuvāca || ārādhayasva gandharvānmohaṃ tyaktvā nareśvara || teṣāṃ prārthaya māṃ saumya tataḥ prāpsyasi mā ciram || 1.136.10|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā yayau svargaṃ rājā tatraiva pārthiva || tapaḥ sa vipulaṃ cakre tadgatenaiva cetasā ||11 || atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe sūryasyodayanaṃ prati || nāradaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā gandharvā darśanaṃ daduḥ ||12|| gandharvā ūcuḥ || varaṃ varaya rājendra yadicchasi mahābhuja || vayaṃ hi tava dāsyāmaḥ sarva evāmaraprabhāḥ || 13 || purūravā uvāca || bhavantaścetprasannā me yadi me rocate varam || urvaśī seha cārvaṅgī bhavadbhirmama dīyatām||14|| gandharvā ūcuḥ || sthālīṃ pūrṇāmimāṃ rājangṛhāṇāgnermahābhuja || asmādagniṃ tridhā kṛtvā yajasva vigatajvaraḥ || 15 || vedoktena vidhānena gandharvatvamavāpsyasi || tretāgnipūrvasya vidherasminmanvantare bhavān ||16|| bhavitā darśitā loke guruśca jagatīpatiḥ || gandharvatvamavāpyātha rājanprāpsyasyathorvaśīm || 17 || manvantaramimaṃ sarvaṃ rantā ca tvaṃ tayā saha || manvantare gate rājannurvaśyā sahito bhavān || 18 || pravekṣyati niśānāthaṃ somaṃ śītāṃśumujvalam || ādhāraṃ sarvalokasya pitṝṇāṃ sthānamuttamam || 19 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || agnisthālīṃ nṛpe dattvā gandharvāstridivaṃ yayuḥ ||| athā''jagāma taṃ deśaṃ bālamādāya corvaśī || 1.136.20 || urvaśyuvāca || tasminsamāgame saumya jāto'yaṃ tanayaḥ prabho || tamādāya pratiṣṭhānaṃ vraja pārthiva māciram || 21 || kṛtaṃ nāmāsya gandharvairviśvāyurati bhūmipa || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evaṃ dattvā nṛpe bālaṃ sā prayātā triviṣṭapam || 22 || ekākī cintayāmāsa budhaputropyanantaram || kinnu bālamupādāya gamiṣyāmi puraṃ svakam ||23|| athādāya gamiṣyāmi sthālīmetāṃ vibhāvasoḥ|| śvāpadebhyo bhayaṃ ghoraṃ bālasyeha bhaviṣyati || 24 || mayā vihīnasya bhayaṃ nāsti kiñcidvibhāvasoḥ || evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā bālamādāya satvaraḥ| || 25 || jagāma svapuraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ sasainyaścāgamatpunaḥ || sthālīṃ dadarśa hīnāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mohamupāgataḥ || 26 || tridivādetya gandharvā mūḍhaṃ pārthivasattamam || utthāpayitvā vacanamūcustaddhitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 27 || rājannasmiñchamīgarbhe praviṣṭaḥ sa hutāśanaḥ || asmāttvamaraṇiṃ kṛtvā janayasva hutāśanam || 28 || tridhā kṛtvā tu taṃ vīra yajasva vidhivattadā || tamiṣṭvā prāpsyase vīra gandharvatmasaṃśayam || 29 || tretāgniṃ te narendreha hoṣyanti satataṃ dvijāḥ || saptavarṣāṇi te'pyevaṃ yāsyatyasmatsalokatām || 1.136.30 || trayo'gnayaścopasadaṃ tava rājanprakīrtitāḥ || agnirāhavanīyastu vāsudevo narādhipa || 31 || dakṣiṇāgnistathā jñeyo nityaṃ saṃkarṣaṇo budhaiḥ || tathā ca gārhapatyo'gniḥ pradyumnaḥ paripaṭhyate ||32|| tathaivaupasado rājannaniruddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || tasmādeva varo viṣṇuścaturātmā narādhipa || 33 || phalābhisandhānahuto gandharvatvaṃ prayacchati || kāmaṃ vināgnihotreṇa huto rājañjanārdanaḥ || 34 || prayacchati paraṃ sthānamamṛtaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam || agnihotrādṛte rājangandharvatvaṃ na vidyate || 35 || suhutenāgnihotreṇa prāpyate saṃśayaṃ vinā || evamuktvā yayuḥ sarve gandharvāstridivaṃ tataḥ || 36 || rājāpyaraṇimādāya śamīgarbhādgṛhaṃ yayau|| tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra śamīgarbhāddhutāśanam||| janayanti dvijaśreṣṭhāstatra sannihitastvasau || 37 || eko'gnirāsīnnṛpavarya pūrvaṃ vaivasvatasyāsya tathāntare'smin || tridhākṛtastena mahānubhāva saṃmaṃtrivipraiḥ kratuśāstravijñaiḥ || 38 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tretāgnyutpattirnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 136 || <1.137> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tataḥ sa svapuraṃ prāpya cāgnyupāsanatatparaḥ || īje bahuvidhairyajñaiḥ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan || 1 || aśvamedhaśatairiṣṭvā vājapeyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || agniṣṭomaiścātirātrairdvādaśāhaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 2 || saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau || amānuṣairvṛtaḥ sattvaiḥ sa vijigye mahītalam || 3 || durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ vyādhirnābhavatkasyacitkvacit || sarvo dharmaparo lokaḥ sarva eva sukhī janaḥ || 4 || sarve caiva samṛddhārthāstasmiñjanapadeśvare || nāsītpaśuvadhārhāṇāṃ vadhastasminvṛthā tadā || 5 || sarvabhūtāni rājānaṃ bhāvenopagatāni tam || sarvasya ca jananyāsītsa rājā pitṛsannibhaḥ ||6|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ bhūpatiṃ svapne prasīdanti janāstadā || yadā niryātyasau rājā caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ ||7|| gṛhacaryāratā nāryastadā paśyanti taṃ sadā || puṣpaiścandanadhūpaiśca tathaiva vikiranti tam || 8 || urvaśī kṛtapuṇyā sā devī nārāyaṇātmajā || yayā krīḍitamasyāṅke vadantyevaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ || 9 || ayamāyātyasau rājā yadā śṛṇvanti yoṣitaḥ || gṛhakāryāṇyapi tyaktvā tadā yānti ,gavākṣakān || 1.137.10 || abhrāṇi śāradānīva bahucandrāṇi yoṣitām || mukhai rājanti veśmāni niryāte pṛthivīśvare || 11 || yā na paśyati taṃ yāntaṃ sā taṃ jñātvā tirohitam || muṣitaṃ caiva sā''tmānaṃ vetti nindati sā bhṛśam || 12 || yā ca paśyati taṃ yāntaṃ kandarpasadṛśaṃ nṛpam || tadgatena hradā sāpi śūnyā tiṣṭhati veśmani || 13 || yadā yajati yajñaiśca tadā śūnyā vasundharā || sarvā bhavati rājānaṃ tadā gacchati vai janaḥ || || 14 || yaśca yāti janastasya yajñe rājño mahātmanaḥ || kimicchakaistadā rājñā sarvaḥ saṃpūjyate tadā || 15 || sabhāsaṃsthasya vai rājñaḥ pratīhāro dine dine || udghoṣayati kāryārthī tasya rājye kathaṃcana || 16 || ityevaṃ śāsato rājyaṃ gataḥ kālo mahīpateḥ || sa kadāciddvijānāha darśayadhvaṃ mamorvaśīm || 17 || drakṣyase tāṃ svayaṃ rājanna vayaṃ darśayāmahe || tatasteṣāṃ dhane lobhaṃ cakre kāmanipīḍitaḥ || 18 || hriyamāṇe dhane vipraiḥ śaptaḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ || jīvitaścāparairviprairgataroṣairmahīpatiḥ || 19 || ātmānaṃ garhayitvā'sau labdhasaṃjño mahīpatiḥ || āyuṃ rājye'bhiṣicyaiva pratiṣṭhānapure svake || 1.137.20 || sāgnihotrastato rājā yayau nārāyaṇāśramam || tasyāśrame tapaścakre rājā saṃvatsaratrayam || 21 || tato nārāyaṇaḥ prāha taṃ nṛpaṃ tapasi sthitam || adya prāpsyasi tāṃ rājanyatkṛte paritapyase || 22 || saśarīro'dya gantāsi tridivaṃ rājasattama || evaṃ dvijendre vadati vimānaṃ pratyadṛśyata || 23 || urvaśyadhiṣṭhitaṃ ramyaṃ gandharvaiśca sahasraśaḥ || yasminyuktaṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ sahasraṃ candravarcasām || 24 || vimānādavaruhyātha gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || urvaśī ca vavandainamṛṣiṃ jvalanatejasam || 25 || anujñāto'tha ṛṣiṇā tadā rājā purūravāḥ || kṛtvāgnihotramātmasthaṃ vimānaṃ taṃ samāsthitaḥ || 26 || ṛṣiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tridivaṃ sa nṛpo gataḥ || saśarīro nṛpaḥ svargaṃ tadā prāpya sudurlabham || 57 || śakreṇābhyarcitaḥ kāle vijahāra yathāsukham|| devodyāneṣu sarveṣu urvaśyā sahitastadā || 28 || nāsau viyujyate sākṣātkadācidapi pārthivaḥ || amāvasyāmamāvasyāṃ niyataṃ candrabhāskarau || 29 || draṣṭuṃ yātau mahīpālamekarāśigatau sadā || urvaśyā sahitaṃ pautraṃ yadā paśyati candramāḥ ||1.137.30|| tadā sudhārasaṃ devaḥ snehātsravati mānada || sudhāmṛtarasaṃ taṃ ca pibanti pitaraḥ sadā || 31 || śrāddhakālastadāpyukto nṛṇāṃ nṛpavarottama || tadā śrāddhaṃ hi yaddattaṃ sudhārasavimiśritam || 32 || tadaśnanti mahīpāla pitaro'mṛtasannibham || amāvasyāmamāvasyāṃ tadā śrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ || || 33 || kuruṣva bhūmipaśreṣṭha sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi || ye'pi śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti tadā cānye narādhipa || 34 || teṣāmāyuryaśaḥ saukhyaṃ dāsyanti prapitāmahāḥ || devakāryādapi śreṣṭhaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ pracakṣate || 35 || pitaro nāma rājendra devānāmapi devatāḥ || rājyakāmaḥ svargakāmaḥ puṣṭikāmastathaiva ca || 336 || pitṝnsantarpayecchrāddhe candrasūryasamāgame || vasanti satataṃ rājanpitaraścandramaṇḍale || 37 || teṣāṃ māsamahorātraṃ vibhāgaṃ tatra me śṛṇu || kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī madhye teṣāmudayate raviḥ || 38 || śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tathaivāstaṃ teṣāṃ yāti divākaraḥ || amāvasyā tadā teṣāṃ madhyāhnaṃ jāyate nṛpa || tasmācchrāddhāni deyāni tasminkāle prayatnataḥ || 39|| etāvaduktaṃ nṛpavarya tasya dharmātmajasyā'pratimasya vṛttam ||| dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ca saubhāgyadaṃ pāpaharaṃ sukhañca || 1.137.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde purūravasaḥ svargaprāptirnāma saptatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 137 || <1.138> || vajra uvāca || vartante pitaraḥ svarge keṣāṃcinnarake tathā || narakasthāḥ phalaṃ dātuṃ kathaṃ śaktā vadasva me || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pitṝṇāṃ tu gaṇāḥ sapta nāmatastānnibodha me || trayo'mūrtimataścaiṣāṃ catvāraśca samūrtayaḥ || 2 || subhāsurā barhiṣado'gniṣvāttāstathaiva ca || trayo mūrtimataścaiṣāṃ catvāraścāpyamūrtayaḥ || 3 || kravyādāścopahūtāśca ājyapāśca sukālinaḥ || mūrtimantaḥ pitṛgaṇāścatvāraśca prakīrtitāḥ || 4 || subhāsvarā brahmasutāḥ somamāpyāyayanti ye || brahmalokacarā rājannityaṃ mūrtivivarjitāḥ ||5|| tathā barhiṣado nāma rājaputrā marīcinaḥ || āpyāyayanti te devām̐lloke somapade sthitāḥ || 6 || vibhrājaloke tiṣṭhanti agniṣvāttā narādhipa || pulastyasya ṛṣeḥ putrā bhaviṣyanti jaganti te || 7 || dānavānyakṣagandharvānpiśācoragarākṣasān || daityānbhūtapiśācāṃśca vidyādharagaṇāṃstathā ||8 || nāgānsarpānsuparṇāṃśca parvatānsaritastathā || kravyādām̐ścopahūtāṃśca ajyapām̐śca sukālinaḥ || 9 || brāhmaṇānkṣatriyānvaiśyānbhāvayantyantyajām̐stathā || kaverāṅgirasaścaiva kardamasya prajāpateḥ|| 1.138.10 || vasiṣṭhasya tathā putrāḥ krameṇaite prakīrtitāḥ || jyotirbhāsaḥ smṛtā loke ye ca lokā marīcinaḥ ||11|| tejesvino māna sāśca krameṇaite prakīrtitāḥ || ete śrāddhasya bhoktāro viśvedevaiḥ sadā saha || 12 || ete śrāddhaṃ sadā bhuktvā pitṝnsaṃtarpayantyataḥ || yatra kvacana dharmajña vartamānā hi yogataḥ ||13 || ete ca puṣṭyā viniyojayanti śrāddhasya dātāramadīnasattvāḥ || tṛptāstathaite viniyojayanti dātuḥ pitṝnsarvagatānmahīpa ||14|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pitṛsvarganarakanivāsahetunirṇayonāmāṣṭatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ |||138|| <1.139> || vajra uvāca || vaivasvate'ntare prāpte prathame bhṛgunandana || śrāddhaṃ pradarśitaṃ kena tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || hiraṇyākṣavadhe pūrvaṃ yadā tyaktvā dharādharāḥ || dharāṃ sapakṣā khagamāḥ khaṃ gatā manujeśvara || 2 || dharādharaparityaktā tadā calitabandhanā || dharā sthānāccyutā vegātpraviveśa rasātalam || 3 || hiraṇyākṣaṃ tadā hatvā nṛvarāho janārdanaḥ | prothena ca karābhyāṃ ca vidhārya vasudhāṃ balāt ||4 || saṃpūjyamānastridaśaiḥ praviveśa rasātalam || rasātalatalaṃ gatvā śeṣamūrtau svake sthitaḥ || 5 || daṃṣṭrāgreṇa samuddhṛtya mahīṃ dadhre tadā bhuje || vāmabāhuniviṣṭāṃtāṃ kṛtvā tridaśapuṅgavaḥ || 6 || ujjahāra mahātejā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || ratnajvālāvalīpuñjadurvibhāvyamukhāmbujaḥ || 7 || śeṣastuṣṭāva deveśaṃ tasminkāle jagadgurum|| puraṃdhriveśā vasudhā devaṃ tadbāhusaṃsthitā||8|| tadā tuṣṭāva bhūpāla ramaṇīyatamākṛtiḥ || uddhṛtya vasudhāṃ sthāne sthāpayitvā tathā svake||9|| jagāma bhūmau dharmajña varāhaṃ nāma parvatam || kalpārambhe varāhasya paramūrteḥ saśailatām || 1.139.10 || tāṃ samāsādya dharmātmā devaḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ || daṃṣṭāgralagnaṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare|| 11 || prasvedācca tilānkṛtvā darbhānromabhya eva ca || jalaprasravaṇābhyāśe tasmingirivare tadā || 12 || dakṣiṇāgrām̐stu vinyasya darbhāṃstānmadhusūdanaḥ || mṛtpiṇḍānsatilām̐steṣu dattavām̐strīnnarādhipa || 13 || dattvā ca gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ || pūjayitvā ca maryādāṃ kṛtavānsa narādhipa || 14 || adyaprabhṛti lokeṣu pretānuddiśya vai pitṝn || ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti teṣāṃ puṣṭirbhaviṣyati || 15 || śrāddhakāle tathā tena piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tathā || pitṝṇāṃ ye kariṣyanti teṣāṃ puṣṭirbhaviṣyati || 16 || pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ || pūjayā te bhaviṣyanti svayaṃ piṇḍeṣu nityadā || 17 || teṣāṃ trayaḥ pūjitāśca bhaviṣyanti tathāgnayaḥ || trayo lokāstrayo devāstathaiva ca yugatrayam || 18 || pūjitāśca trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || pūjitaistairbhaviṣyāmi caturātmā tathāpyaham|| 19|| pituḥ paitāmahaḥ piṇḍo vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || paitāmahaśca nirdiṣṭastathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1.139.20 || pitṛpiṇḍaśca vijñeyaḥ pradyumnaścāparājitaḥ || ātmā'niruddho vijñeyaḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ budhaiḥ||21|| śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ śakyaṃ vinā vaiṣṇavatejasā || evaṃ saṃpūjitastena caturātmā tvahaṃ sthitaḥ || 22 || bhaviṣyāmi pradāsyāmi tasya kāmānyathepsitān|| catvāraḥ pūjitā vedāścatvāraśca tathāgnayaḥ || 23 || catvāraśca yugāstena catasraśca diśastathā || catvāraśca tathā varṇāścatvāraśca tathāśramāḥ|| 24 || catvāro lokapālāśca bhaviṣyantīha pūjitāḥ || evaṃ kṛtvā sa maryādāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata || tataḥ prabhṛti loke'smiñchrāddhaṃ sadbhiḥ prakīrtitam ||25 || svargaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca yaśaḥ sukhāni rājyaṃ ca putrānatha bhūmipāla || striyaśca mukhyā vividhāṃśca kāmāndeveśvaraḥ śrāddhakṛto vidhatte || 26 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrāddhotpattirnāmai konacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 139 || <1.140> vajra uvāca || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi kathyamānamahaṃ tvayā || vidhiṃ śrāddhasya dharmajña tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vakṣyamāṇaguṇānviprānpūrvedyurupamantrayet || kartrā sametaistairbhāvyaṃ saṃyataiśca nimantritaiḥ || 2 || śrāddhāhe prayataḥ snātaḥ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ || śuklavāsāḥ samabhyarcya nṛvarāhaṃ janārdanam || 3 || āmaśrāddheṣu kāmyeṣu hutvā prathamapañcakam || madhyamaṃ pañcakaṃ hutvā paśuśrāddheṣvasaṃśayam || 4 || amāvasyāsu sarvāsu hutvā cottamapañcakam || hutvā ca pañcakānetānaṣṭakātritayaṃ kramāt || 5 || anvaṣṭakāsu ca tathā bhojayetprayato dvijān || dvau divye prāktrayaḥ pitre caikaikamubhayatra vā || 6 || udaṅmukhām̐śca pitrarthe snātānvidyādguṇa kramāt || tiladarbhāvakīrṇeṣu cāsaneṣūpaveśayet || 7 || pitṝnāvāhayāmīti svayamuktvā samāhitaḥ || āvāhayasveti tato dvijairukto'tha tanmanāḥ || 8 || apayāntvasurā dvābhyāṃ yātudhānavisarjanam || tilaiḥ kuryātprayatnena tvathavā gaurasarṣapaiḥ || 9 || ete pitara ityeva sarvāṃstānagna āvaha || āgneyantu tathodīrya etadvaḥ pitarastathā || 1.140.10 || kuśām̐stilāvamiśreṇa tathā gandhayutena ca || yāstiṣṭhanti dhārayanti amṛtāvāgiti tryṛcā || 11 || yanme māteti ca tathā pādyamarghyañca kārayet || nivedya vipreṣu tathā pādyārthaṃ prayataḥ kramāt || 12 || gandhairvastraiśca puṣpaiśca dhūpaiścāpyatha bhūṣaṇaiḥ || arcayedbrāhmaṇāñchaktyā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ || 13 || ādau samarcayedviprānvaiśvadevaniveśitān || niveśitām̐śca pitrarthe tataḥ paścātsamarcayet || 14 || vaiśvadevaniviṣṭānāṃ caramaṃ hastadhāvanam || visarjanaṃ ca nirdiṣṭaṃ teṣu rakṣā yataḥ sthitā || 15 || sarvamanyatpradātavyamādau teṣāṃ narādhipa || saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpaiśca brāhmaṇānprayatastadā || 16 || ādityā vasavo rudrā dvijānvīkṣya tato japet || agnau ca karavāṇīti tairuktaṃ ca kuruṣviti || 17 || paristīrya tato vahnimagnimuddhṛtya sarvataḥ || āhitāgnistu juhuyāddakṣiṇāgnau samāhitaḥ || 18 || anāhitāgniścaupasade agnyabhāve tathāpsu vā || somāyādau pitṛmate kavyavāhanāya cāgnaye || 19 || yamāya caivāṅgirase hutvā prayatamānasaḥ || ye māmakāśca pitara etadvaḥ pitarastathā || 1.140.20 || ayaṃ yajñastathaiveti eṣā vo gītirapyatha || prayatastanmanāḥ kṛtvā rājam̐ścaivābhimantraṇam || 21 || āmā supakveti tato ghṛtaṃ vāpyathavā payaḥ || niṣicya raupyapātreṣu rajatākteṣu bhāvataḥ || 22 || yathopapanneṣvathavā tūṣṇīmannaṃ nivedayet || namo viśvebhya iti ca satilenodakena ca || 23 || prāṅmukheṣu ca yaddattaṃ tadannamupamantrayet || udaṅmukheṣu yaddattaṃ nāmagotraprakīrtanaiḥ || 24 || mantrayetprayataḥ prājñaḥ svadhāntaiḥ susamāhitaḥ || yanme prakāmāhorātrairyadvā kravyāttathaiva ca || 25 || itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi cāpyatha || saptarcaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ śrāvayedagrato dvijān || 26 || dakṣiṇāgrāṃstato darbhāṃllūnāṃścaivopamūlataḥ || mantritānbrahmamantreṇa vikiretsusamāhitaḥ || 27 || piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryātteṣu darbheṣvasaṃśayam || madhvājyatilamiśreṇa cānne nāgryeṇa yādava || 28 || pitṛpiṇḍe bhavenmantraḥ pṛthivī darvirakṣitā || paitāmahe bhavenmantrastvantarikṣeti pārthiva || 29 || prapitāmahake mantraṃ dyaurdarviriti kīrtayet || ye tatra pitaraḥ pretā mantreṇānena dharmavit || 1.140.30 || sūtraṃ nivedayedbhaktyā kṣīrānnaṃ ca nivedayet || ūrjaṃ vahantīti tataḥ sānnaṃ dadyādathodakam || 31 || apasavyena piṇḍeṣu śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairbhakṣyaiśca bhojanaiḥ || 32 || pānaiḥ samarcayetpiṇḍānsādaraḥ prayataḥ sadā || yatkiñcitpacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ vā bhojyameva vā || 33 || anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ tasminnāyatane sadā || bhuktavatsvatha vipreṣu vidhiṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu || 34 || annaṃ satṛṇamabhyukṣya māmekṣiṣṭheti yatnataḥ || udaṅmukhānāṃ viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sodakaṃ tataḥ || 35 ||| annantu vikiredbhaktyā pitṛbhāgastu saḥ smṛtaḥ || praṣṭavyā brāhmaṇā bhaktyā bhūniviṣṭena jānunā || 36 || tṛptā bhavantaḥ saṃpanno bhavatāṃ kaścideva tu || tṛptāḥ smeti ca tairuktaḥ saṃpannamiti cāpyatha || 37 || dadyādācamanaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhānaḥ samāhitaḥ || yanme rāmaśca śakraśca iti kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāma||38|| pratyekaṃ tarpayedvidvāndakṣiṇābhiḥ svaśaktitaḥ || bhavanto'bhiramanviti vācyā viprāstvanantaram || 39 || tairukto'bhiratāḥ smeti dvijānāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ || devāśca pitaraśceti japenmantramatandritaḥ || 1.140.40 || pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotreṇa jalaṃ deyamanantaram || brāhmaṇānāṃ dvijairvācyaṃ cākṣayaṃ manujeśvara || 41 || tatastu prārthanā kāryā mantreṇānena bhūmipa || dātāro no'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca || śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahu deyaṃ ca nosviti || vājevājeti tūtthāpya kṛtvā caiṣāṃ pradakṣiṇām || 43 || jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā praṇipatya, visarjayet || apasavyena kartavyaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ narādhipa || 44 || brāhmaṇairnaiva vaktavyā yadi pṛṣṭā havirguṇāḥ || yāvadūṣmā bhavatyanne yāvadaśnanti vāgyatāḥ |||45||| tāvadaśnanti pitaro yāvannoktā havirguṇāḥ|| ucchiṣṭamārjanaṃ yāvanna kṛtaṃ nṛpasattama ||46|| tāvadaśnanti pitaraḥ svadhā rasavimiśritam || hastadattāni lehyāni lavaṇaṃ vyañjanāni ca||47|| dātāraṃ nopatiṣṭhanti bhoktā bhuṅkte ca kilbiṣam || sauvarṇarājatābhyāntu phalgupātreṇa cāpyatha || 48 || dattamakṣayatā yāti khaḍgenodumbareṇa vā || māṃsaṃ nāśnāti yaḥ paṅktyāṃ yathāvadviniyojitam||49|| sa pretya narakaṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 1.140.50 || śrāddhe dātā ca bhoktā ca maithunaṃ yadi gacchataḥ || tanmāṃsaṃ pitarastasya bhuñjate retasā yutam || evaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śūdreṇāpi narādhipa || 51 || mantravarjyaṃ hi śūdrasya sarvametadvidhīyate || vajra uvāca || yasya jīvetpitā śrāddhaṃ kasyāsau kartumarhati || 52 || tvameva saṃśayacchettā saṃśayaṃ chindhi me dvija || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || yeṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ pitā kuryātteṣāmeva sa kārayet || mantrahīnaṃ prakartavyaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ yathā vidhi ||53|| mātāmahānāṃ śrāddhaṃ tu mantrahīnaṃ ca kārayet || śrāddhaṃ ca suhṛdāṃ kuryātstrīṇāṃ cākṣayavācakam || 54 || vajra uvāca || pitā pitāmahaścaiva jīvetāṃ yasya dehinaḥ || tena śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||55|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| yeṣāṃ pitāmahaḥ kuryātteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ narādhipa || tena kāryaṃ mahāprājña yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 56 || vajra uvāca || pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ || yasya jīvanti kartavyaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ dvija || 57 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tena śrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ vidhilopaṃ tu yādava || pūjanīyāśca pitaraḥ pitāmahapituḥ svayam || 58 || vajra uvāca || jīvetpitāmaho yasya pituścaiva pitāmahaḥ || pitā pretastathā yasya tasya śrāddhavidhiṃ vada || 59 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa piturmanujeśvara || pituḥ pitāmahādūrdhvaṃ dvābhyāṃ piṇḍaṃ nivedayet ||1.140.60 || vajra uvāca || pitā pitāmahau pretau yasya syātāṃ dvijottama || pituḥ pitāmaho jīvettasya śrāddhavidhiṃ vada ||61|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pitre sapitre kṛtvā tu piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tataḥ || piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryātpitāmahapitāmahe||62|| vajra uvāca || pretaḥ pitā bhavedyasya pituścaiva pitāmahaḥ || tena kāryaṃ kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ||63|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| sa tu dattvā pituḥ piṇḍaṃ tataḥ ūrdhvaṃ pitāmahāt || dvābhyāṃ dadyātsadā piṇḍaṃ tvevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 64 || vajra uvāca || pretaḥ pitāmaho yasya pitā jīveddvijottama || pituḥ pitāmaho jīvettasya śrāddhavidhiṃ vada || 65 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dattvā pitāmahe piṇḍaṃ sa tūrdhvaṃ prapitāmahāt || piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāddvābhyānnityamatandritaḥ||66|| vajra uvāca|| saptārciṣamahaṃ mantraṃ śrotumicchāmi bhārgava || śrāddhakālepu niyataṃ rakṣoghnaṃ yasya kīrtitam||67|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pāpāpahaṃ pāvanīyamaśvamedhasamaṃ tathā || mantraṃ vakṣyāmyahaṃ tasmādamṛtaṃ brahmanirmitam || 68 || devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca || namaḥ svadhāyai svāhāyai nityameva bhavatviha ||69|| ādyevasāne śrāddhasya trivāraṃ tu japetsadā || aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyateddvijaiḥ satkṛti pūjitam ||1.140.70|| piṇḍanirvapaṇe cāpi japedetatsamāhitaḥ || pitaraḥ kṣipramāyānti rākṣasāḥ pradravanti ca ||71|| pitṝm̐śca triṣu lokeṣu mantro'yaṃ tārayatyuta || paṭhyamānaḥ sadā śrāddhe niyatairbrahmavādibhiḥ ||72|| rājyakāmo japedetatsadā mantramatandritaḥ || vīryasarvārthaśauryādiśryāyurbuddhivivardhanam || ||73|| prīyante pitaronena japena niyamena ca || saptārciṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham||74|| amūrtānāṃ samūrtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām|| namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhyānināṃ yogacakṣuṣām || 75 || indrādīnāṃ ca netāro dakṣamārīcayostathā || saptarṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tānnamasyāmi kāmadān ||76 || manvādīnāṃ ca netāraḥ sūryācandramasostathā || tānnamaskṛtya savārnvai pitṝnapsvarṇaveṣu ca || 77 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vāyvagnipitarastathā || dyāvāpṛthivyośca tathā namasye tānkṛtāñjaliḥ || 78 |||| devarṣīṇāṃ ca netāraḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtān || trātāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ namasye tānpitāmahān || 79 || prajāpatergavāṃ vahneḥ somāya ca yamāya ca || yogeśvarebhyaśca tathā namasye tānkṛtāñjaliḥ ||1.140.80|| pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu || svayambhuve namaskṛtya brahmaṇe lokacakṣuṣe ||81|| etattaduktaṃ saptārcirbrahmarṣigaṇapūjitam|| pavitraṃ paramaṃ hyetacchrīmadrakṣovināśanam|| 82 || etena vidhinā yuktaḥ trīṇyeva labhate naraḥ || annamāyuḥ sutām̐ścaiva vadanti pitaro bhuvi || 83 || bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ || saptārciṣaṃ japedyastu nityameva samāhitaḥ || saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet||84|| vajra uvāca|| brahmanmantraṃ samācakṣva sarvarakṣonibarhaṇam|| piṇḍanirvapaṇe yena mantraṇīyāḥ kuśottamāḥ || 85 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || nihanmi sarvaṃ yadamedhyavadbhaveddhatāśca sarve suradānavā mayā || ye rākṣasā yakṣapiśācaguhyakā hatā mayā yātudhānāśca sarve || 86 || etena mantreṇa susaṃyatātmā tilānkireddikṣu tathā vidikṣu|| yasmindeśe paṭhate mantra eṣa taṃ vai deśaṃ rākṣasā varjayanti || 87 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrāddhavivaraṇo nāma catvā riṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 140 || || cha || <1.141> || vajra uvāca || || kasmindeśe na kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhṛgukulodvaha || kiñca deyamadeyaṃ ca tanme brūhi dvijottama || 1 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || triśaṅkuṃ varjayeddeśaṃ sarvaṃ dvādaśayojanam || uttareṇa pataṅgasya dakṣiṇena ca kaikaṭam || || 2 || deśastraiśaṅkavo nāma vivarjyaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi || kāraskarāḥ kaliṅgāśca sindhoruttarameva ca || 3 || cāturvarṇya vihīnāśca ye ca deśā narādhipa || anyeṣvapi ca deśeṣu taddeśajanadarśanam || 4 || varjayecchrāddhakāle tu patitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || rajasvalāśca ṣaṇḍāśca śvānasūkarakukkuṭāḥ || 5 || yathā śrāddhaṃ na paśyanti tathā kāryaṃ vijānatā || rakṣārthaṃ cāpyathaiteṣāṃ guptiḥ kāryā nareśvara ||6|| tilāvikiraṇaṃ kāryaṃ yātudhānavināśanam|| piṇḍām̐śca go'javiprebhyo dadyādagnāvatha kṣipet||7|| madhyamaṃ putrakāmā vā patnī piṇḍaṃ ca bhakṣayet|| tīrthaśrāddhe sadā piṇḍānkṣipettīrthe vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 8|| dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā paitrī diksā prakīrttitā| piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kuśālābhe vicakṣaṇaiḥ|| 9|| kuśeṣu rājansarveṣu pavitre te pare mate|| sūtraṃ pradeyaṃ vāso'rthe kṣaumakārpāsasambhavam||1.141.10|| daśāṃ vivarjayetprājño yadyapyahatavastrajā|| kṣaumakārpāsajaṃ tyaktvā sūtramanyanna dāpayet || 11 || ghṛtena dīpo dātavyastvathavāpyauṣadhīrasaiḥ || vasāmedodbhavaṃ dīpaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 12 || candanāgurukarpūrakuṅkumām̐śca pradāpayet || aśvamedhasamā hyete pitṝṇāmanulepanāḥ || 13 || na dātavyaṃ manuṣyendra yadanyaccānulepanam || dhūpo guglujo deyastathā candanasārajam || 14 || aguruṃ ca sakarpūraṃ turuṣkaṃ ca pradāpayet || ato'nyadapi yatkiṃciddhūpārthe tadvivarjayet||15|| saghṛtaṃ gugguluṃ dhūpaṃ dhūpārthe yaḥ prayacchati aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya dhūpadātustathaiva ca||16|| jātyaśca sarvā dātavyā mallikāśvetayūthikā|| jalodbhavāni sarvāṇi kusumāni vivarjayet || 17 || yāni kaṇṭakijātāni na deyāni narādhipa || yāni kaṇṭakitāgrāṇi śuklāni surabhīṇi ca || 18 || tāni rājendra deyāni latājāni viśeṣataḥ || raktāni jalajātāni tathā deyāni yādava || 19 || vipulāṃ śriyamāpnoti pitṝnpuṣpaiḥ samarcayan || abhakṣyāṇi vivarjyāni śrāddhe nityamatandritaiḥ || 1.141.20 || bhakṣyeṣvapi na deyāni yāni tāni nibodha me || bhūstṛṇaṃ sumukaṃ śigruṃ pālakyaṃ taṇḍulīyakam || 21 || kūṣmāṇḍālābuvṛntākapippalīmaricāni ca || śrāddheṣu nāgaraṃ deyaṃ lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ tathā || 22 || saindhavavyatirekeṇa lavaṇāni na dāpayet || naktaṃ gṛhītamudakaṃ tathā palvalasambhavam || 23 || śrāddhakāle vivarjyaṃ ca māhiṣaṃ kṣīrameva ca || rājamāṣamasūrāśca caṇakā koradūṣakāḥ || 24 || varjyāścābhiṣavo nityaṃ śatapuṣpaṃ gavedhukam || karambhāṇi kusumbhaṃ ca paṭolaṃ bṛhatīphalam || 25 || karīrasurabhī cobhau pūtigandhi ca yadbhavet || jambīrajaphalaṃ varjyaṃ kovidāraṃ ca pārthiva || 26 || vastusaṃdarśanaṃ śastaṃ śrāddhe nityamarindama || kutapasya ca sānnidhyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇājinasya ca || 27 || kṛṣṇājinasya dānaṃ ca rajatasya viśeṣataḥ || kṛṣṇājinaṃ sakutapaṃ kṛṣṇāni ca tilāni ca || 28 || śrāddhakarmaṇi śastāni viṭpatistatsutastathā || somaḥ sadaiva māsānte raviṇā saha saṃgataḥ || 29 || āpaścaivauṣadhīścaiva tadā viśati pārthiva || amāyāṃ tu payaḥ pītvā bhuktvā caivauṣadhīḥ śubhāḥ || 1.141.30 || payaḥ kṣaranti yaddivyaṃ gāvo'mṛtarasopamam || tatpavitraṃ paraṃ rājankāpilaṃ cedviśeṣataḥ || 31 || havye kavye ca tadrājansomatulyaṃ prakīrtitam || tilairvrīhiyavairmāṣairadbhirmūlaphalena ca || 32 .|| priyaṅgubhistathā dāraiḥ śṛṅgāṭakaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || godhūmaiścekṣubhirmudgaiḥ sacīnacaṇakaistathā || 33 || śyāmākairhastiśyāmākairmadhūkairhavyadāḍimaiḥ || panasairnārikeraiśca kharjūrāmraphalaistathā || 34 || āmrātaiścāmranāraṃgairbilvairdīrghaiśca mūlakaiḥ || vidāryānirbharūṭaiśca viśeṣaśca varāṭakaiḥ || 35 || picukaiśca tathā kardairbadaraiḥ karakandubhiḥ || pālevatai rāṣṭrakaiśca akṣoṭaiḥ panasaistathā || 36 || kākolaiḥ kṣīrakākolaistathā piṇḍālukaiḥ śubhaiḥ || suvarcalāmadhūkaiśca vāstukena ca pārthiva ||37|| sitākhaṇḍaguḍairmukhyaiḥ phaṇitena ca saktubhiḥ || lājābhiśca sadānābhistrapusairvārucirbhaṭaiḥ || 38 || sarṣapārājaśākābhyāmiṅgudai rājajambubhiḥ || priyālāmalakairmukhyaiḥ phalgubhiśca tilolakaiḥ || 39 || vetrāṅkuraistāladarbhaiścukrīkākṣīrikādhavaiḥ || cocaiḥ samīcairlakucaistathā vai bījapūrakaiḥ || 1.141.40 || chatrāticchatrakṣīrākaiḥ kalaṇḍukakaśerukaiḥ || sujātakaiḥ padmaphalairbhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ susaṃskṛtaiḥ || 41 || rāgaṣāḍhavacoṇyaiśca trijātakasamanvitaiḥ || dattena māsaṃ prīyante śrāddhena pitaro nṛṇām || 42 || dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīnmāsānhāriṇena tu || aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākunena ca pañca vai || 43 || ṣaṇmāsāñchāśikenāpi sapta pāriśatena ca || tathāṣṭau chāgamāṃsena payasā pāyasena ca || 44 || vārāheṇa navaivāhū rauraveṇa tathā daśa || māsānekādaśaivāhurgavayena narādhipa || 45 || saṃvatsaraṃ tu gavyena payasā pāyasena ca || payovikāraiśca tathā hṛdyaiśca manujeśvara || 46 || pānakaiśca tathā hṛdyaistrisugandhaiḥ suśītalaiḥ||| vārdhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī || 47 || vajra uvāca || vārdhrīṇasamahaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || yasya māṃsena kathitā tṛptirdvādaśa vārṣikī || 48 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tripibantvindriyakṣīṇaṃ yūthasyāgrasaraṃ tathā|| raktaṃ varṇena rājendra chāgaṃ vārdhrīṇasaṃ viduḥ ||49|| kālaśākaṃ mahāśalkaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca || ānantyāya bhaveddattaṃ sarvaṃ ca madhusaṃyutam || 1.141.50 || khaḍgā viṣāṇaiḥ parivarjitā ye teṣāṃ hi māṃsena bhavatyanantam || śrāddhaṃ mahārāja tataḥ pradeyaṃ khaḍgasya māṃsena hitāya teṣām || 51 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 śrāddhahavirvarṇano nāme kacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 141 || cha || <1.142> || vajra uvāca || || śrāddhakālaṃ samācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara || kasminkāle kṛte śrāddhe prīyante pitaro nṛṇām || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śrāddhakālastvamāvasyāṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama || paurṇamāsī tathā māghī śrāvaṇī ca narottama ||2|| proṣṭhapadyāmatītāyāṃ tathā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī || āgrahāyaṇyatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇāstisro'ṣṭakāstathā ||3|| śākaiśca prathamaṃ kāryā māṃsaiśca tadanantarā || tṛtīyā ca tathā'pūpairnityameva vijānatā || 4 || anvaṣṭakāsu ca strīṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathaiva ca || aṣṭakāvidhinā hutvā krameṇaitāstu pañcakāḥ || 5|| mātre rājanpitāmahyai śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi || tathaiva prapitāmahyai viśvedevapurassaram ||6|| piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tāsāṃ ca pitṛvannṛpa|| bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu tatra karma nibodha me || 7 || prādeśamātrā rājendra caturaṃgulamāyatāḥ || tāvadeva samutsedhāḥ ṣaṭkarṣūstatra kārayet || 8 || pratyekakarṣumūle tu paristīrya hutāśanam || agnisomayamānāṃ ca yāgaṃ kṛtvā yathā purā || 9 || karṣutritayamūle tu puruṣāṇāṃ tu kārayet || piṇḍa nirvapaṇaṃ prāgvadekaikasminyathāvidhi || 1.142.10 || karṣūbhistritayaṃ tacca kṣīrānnādbhiḥ prapūrayet || karṣutritayamūle tu strīṇāṃ nirvapaṇaṃ bhavet || 11 ||| dadhnā māṃsena payasā karṣūṇāṃ caiva pūraṇam || annodakavimiśreṇa kāryaṃ manujapuṅgava || 12 || bhavantībhyo bhavatvetadakṣayaṃ parikīrtitam || etāni śrāddhakālāni nityānyāha prajāpatiḥ || 13 || śrāddhameteṣvakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || vṛddhau śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kurvannityaṃ vṛddhimupāśnute || 14 || vṛddhau samarcayedvidvānnityaṃ nāndīmukhānpitṝn || vṛdiśrāddheṣu kartavyāstilasthāne yavāstathā || 15 || karkandhudadhisaṃmiśrām̐stathā piṇḍām̐śca nirvapet ||| acchinnanābhyāṃ kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai putrajanmani || 16 || āśaucoparame kāryamathavā'pi narādhipa || vivāhadivase śrāddhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||17 || vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ vidhānena candre janmarkṣamāśrite || śrāddhaṃ prayatnātkartavyaṃ bhūtikāmena pārthiva || 18 || uttarādayanācchrāddhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ syāddakṣiṇāyane || cāturmāsyaṃ ca tatrāpi prasupte keśave hitam ||19 || proṣṭhapadyaparaṃ pakṣaṃ tathāpi ca viśeṣavat || pañcamyūrdhvaṃ ca tatrāpi daśamyūrdhvaṃ tato'pyati||1.142.20|| maghāyutā ca tatrāpi śastā rājaṃstrayodaśī || tatrākṣayyaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ madhunā pāyasena ca || 21 || sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ śrāddhamatra narādhipa || parānnabhojī tvapacaḥ śrāddhamatra tu kārayet || 22 || yastu śrāddhaṃ sadā kuryātso'śvamedhaphalo bhavet || nidrāṃ tyajati sarvātmā yasminkāle janārdanaḥ || 23|| tatra śrāddhamathānantyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || śrāddhaṃ saṃkramaṇe bhānoḥ kartavyaṃ pṛthivīpate || 24 || viṣuvaddvitayaṃ tatra ayane dve viśeṣataḥ || vyatīpāte tathā śrāddhaṃ jñeyaṃ bahuphalaṃ nṛpa || 25 || akṣayyaṃ ca tathā śrāddhaṃ vijñeyaṃ rāhudarśane || vrīhipāke ca kartavyaṃ yavapāke tathaiva ca || 26 || na tānadyurmahārāja vinā śrāddhaṃ kathaṃcana || āśvinasyāpare pakṣe prathame kārtikasya ca || 27 || pūrvāhne śuklapakṣasya śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || aparāhṇe tathā kāryaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe narādhipa || 28 || saṃdhyayorvarjastechrāddhaṃ tatra rātrau nareśvara || rātrāvapi ca kartavyaṃ yadā syādrāhudarśanam || 29 || akṣayyaṃ tatsamuddiṣṭaṃ yaddattaṃ rāhudarśane || ataḥ kāmyāni vakṣyāmi śrāddhāni tava pārthiva|| 1.142.30 || arogyamatha saubhāgyaṃ samare vijayaṃ tathā || sarvānkāmām̐stathā vidyāṃ dhanaṃ jīvitameva ca || 31 || ādityādidineṣveva śrāddhaṃ kurvansadā naraḥ || krameṇaitadavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || || 32 || svargaṃ hyapatyāni tathā brahmavarcasameva ca || raudreṇa karmaṇā siddhiṃ bhuvaṃ puṣṭiṃ tathā śriyam || 33 || sarvānkāmām̐śca saubhāgyaṃ dhanaṃ jñāti pradhānatām || rūpayuktām̐śca tanayānvāṇijyāddhanasaṃpadam || 34 || kanakaṃ suhṛdo rājyaṃ saphalāṃ ca tathā kṛṣim || samudrayānāllābhaṃ ca sarvānkāmām̐ntathaiva ca || 35 || śraiṣṭhyakāmāṃstathā sarvānbalamārogyameva ca || rūpyaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhaṃ gāśca turagām̐ścaiva jīvitam || 36 || kṛttikādibharaṇyantaṃ kramāttu bhagaṇe naraḥ || ekaikasminkramātkurvañchrāddhaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 37 || striyaḥ surūpāḥ svagṛhe kanyānāṃ ca tathā varān|| sarvānkāmānyaśaścaiva śriyaṃ dyūtajayaṃ kṛṣim || 38 || vāṇijyaṃ paśavaścaiva vājinaśca tathā sutān || suvarṇaraupyasaubhāgyaṃ prāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ kramāt || 39|| pratipatprabhṛti hyetadyāvadrājam̐strayodathī || caturdaśyāṃ tu kartavyaṃ ye narāḥ śastraghātitāḥ || 1.142.40 || śrāddhaṃ sadā pañcadaśīṣu kāryaṃ kāmānsamagrām̐llabhate manuṣyaḥ || tasmātprayatnena narendra kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ sadā pañcadaśīṣu tajjñaiḥ || 41 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde śrāddhakālavarṇano nāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 142 || <1.143> || vajra uvāca || || kasmai śrāddhaṃ na dātavyaṃ kena bhuktaṃ mahāphalam || bhavatīha dvijaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || anūḍhātanayo rājanyaśca paunarbhavaḥ sutaḥ || śūdrāpatirdurācāro vāṇijyāyudhajīvakaḥ || 2 || tathā vārdhuṣiko yaśca śūdrasya ca purohitaḥ || parvakārastathā sūcī yasya copapatirgṛhe || 3 || kṛtvā nakṣatranirdeśaṃ yaśca jīvati pārthiva || cikitsitena ca tathā yasya vṛttirnareśvara ||4|| vedavikrayako yaśca vedanindaka eva ca || tarkaśāstreṇa dagdhaśca nāstiko dharmavarjitaḥ || 5 || pitrā vivadamānaśca yaścaivopanayedbahūn || ayājyayājī stenaśca yakṣmī kitava eva ca || 6 || śvitrī ca yastathā kāṇo badhiro'ndhaḥ kuṇistathā || parapūrvāpatiścaiva grāmapreṣyo nirākṛtiḥ || 7 || avakīrṇī kuṇḍagolau kunakhī śyāvadantakaḥ || kanyādūṣyabhiśaptaśca mitradhukpiśunastathā || 8 || parivittiḥ parivettā tasya kanyāpradaśca yaḥ || yājakaśca tathā tasya somavikrayakastathā||9|| kūṭasākṣī ca vāgduṣṭaḥ paradāro vikarmakaḥ || tathā daivāpaviddhāgniḥ viruddhajanakastathā || 1.143.10 || yaśca hīnātiriktāṅgo duścarmā damakastathā || yaśca yuktastathā rājanpātakaiścopapātakaiḥ || 11 || dviṣanmitre ubhe caiva prayatnena vivarjayet || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi brāhmaṇānpaṅktipāvanān || 12 || brahmadeyānusantānaḥ tapasvī vijitendriyaḥ || pārago yajuṣāṃ yaśca sāmavedasya pāragaḥ || 13|| ṛgvedapārago yaśca bhṛgvaṅgirasapāragaḥ || atharvaśiraso'dhyetā trisuparṇasya pāragaḥ || 14 || triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnidharmaśāstraviśāradaḥ || purāṇapārago yaśca itihāsaviśāradaḥ || 15 || adhīte sottaraṃ yaśca viṣṇudharmamidaṃ śubham || vijānāti yathāvacca yaśca vyākaraṇaṃ nṛpa || 16 || jyotiṣaśca tathā vettā āyurvedasya ca dvijaḥ || tābhyāṃ vṛttiṃ na cetkuryādvṛttistābhyāṃ vigarhitā || 17 || āhitāgniśca yo vidvānsomapaśca dvijottamaḥ || guruśuśrūṣaṇaparastīrthapūtaśca yādava || gāyatrījāpanirato yogī dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 18 || yasyāpyanante jagatāmadhīśe bhaktiḥ parā yādava devadeve || tasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcitpātraṃ triloke puruṣapravīra || 19 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pātrāpātraparīkṣāvidhirnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 143 || <1.144> vajra uvāca || kasminbahuphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ deśe brāhmaṇapuṅgava || etatsarvaṃ samācakṣya bhavānbrahma ivāparaḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || gayāśīrṣavaṭe śrāddhamakṣayyaṃ parikīrtitam || yadarthameṣā carati gāthā loke purātanī || 2 || eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyekopi gayāṃ vrajet || yajeta vāśvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet || 3 || puṣkareṣvakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ prayāge naimiṣe tathā || vārāṇasyāṃ prabhāse ca kurukṣetre samantataḥ || 4 || sannihatyāṃ viśeṣeṇa rāhugraste niśākare || rāhugraste dinakare sannītyāṃ pārthivottama || 5 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā samāpnoti rājasūyaśataṃ naraḥ || aśvamedhasahasrasya samyagiṣṭasya yatphalama||6|| snāta eva tadāpnoti kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ sa mānavaḥ|| sarveṣu devalokeṣu kāmacārī virājate||7|| padmavarṇena yānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā || devarāmāgaṇāḍhyena vīṇāmurajanādinā || 8|| divyaśvetāśvayuktena kāmagena yathāsukham || ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatkrīḍatyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 9 || kṛtakṛtyaśca bhavati pitṝṇāmanṛṇastathā || śrāddhaṃ tathā pitṝṇāṃ ca nopayujyeta vai punaḥ || 1.144.10 || yatra kvacana gaṅgāyāṃ śrāddhasyānantyamucyate || yamasya bhaginī devī yamunā pāpanāśinī || 11 || yatra kvacana tasyāṃ hi śrāddhasyānantyamucyate|| pitṝṇāṃ duhitā rājannarmadā saritāṃ varā || 12 || tasyāstīre tathānantaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvatra pārthiva || akṣayyaṃ ca tathā śrāddhamamarāntikaparvate || 13 || varāhaparvate rājañchrāddhasyānantyamucyate || himavānparvataśreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkaraśvaśuro giriḥ || 14 || ākaraḥ sarvaratnānāṃ sarvasattvasamāśrayaḥ || tāpasānāmadhīvāsaḥ śrāddhaṃ tatrā'kṣayaṃ bhavet ||15|| evamādiṣu tīrtheṣu parvateṣu saritsu ca || sarovareṣu mukhyeṣu ṛṣīṇāmāśrameṣu ca||16|| nirjhareṣu tathāraṇye nadīnāṃ prabhaveṣu ca || saṅgameṣu ca mukhyeṣu pulineṣu viśeṣataḥ ||17|| udyāneṣu vicitreṣu saikateṣu sameṣu ca|| śādvaleṣu ca ramyeṣu girīṇāṃ kandarāsu ca || 18 || gahvareṣu nitambeṣu cchāyāyāṃ kuñjarasya ca || mahīgatāntaranyastagajacchāyāsu pārthiva || 19 || yaḥ kuryādaparāhṇe tu sakṛcchrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ || akṣayyamannapānaṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ copatiṣṭhate||1.144.20|| gomayenopalipteṣu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ gṛheṣu ca|| manojñeṣu vicitreṣu rucireṣūttameṣu ca||21|| devāyatanagoṣṭheṣu śrāddhaṃ bahuphalaṃ bhavet ||22|| tīrthāni yānīha narendracandra loke purāṇaiḥ parikīrtitāni || tīreṣu teṣāṃ vidhivatpradāya śrāddhaṃ na śocenmaraṇaṃ jitātmā || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare mārkaṇḍevajrasaṃvāde śrāddhadeśānukīrtano nāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 144 || <1.145> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pitṛbhiryāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || gāthāḥ pārthivaśārdūla kāmayadbhiḥ pure svake || 1 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ yo no dadyājjalāñjalim || nadīṣu bahutoyāsu śītalāsu viśeṣataḥ || 2 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ himamiśraṃ jalāñjalim || tilamākṣika saṃyuktaṃ yo no dadyātsamāhitaḥ || 3 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ yo no dadyācca bhaktitaḥ || pāyasaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca ||4|| dālbhya uvāca || patnyo nṛṇāṃ muniśreṣṭha yoṣitāṃ ca tathā narāḥ || tacchrotumicchāmi viprarṣe vidhavā strī na jāyate || 5 || upoṣitena yenāgrya patnyā na rahito naraḥ || pulasttya uvāca || aśūnyaśayanāṃ nāma dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu bho dvija ||6 || yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prayāti strī dvijottama || patnīvimuktaśca naro na kadācitprajāyate || 7 || śete jalanidhau kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ yadā dvija || aśūnyaśayanā nāma tadā śrāddhe hi sā tithiḥ || 8 || kṛṣṇapakṣadvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe munisattama || imamuccārayenmantraṃ praṇamya jagataḥ patim || 9 || śrīvatsadhāriṇaṃ śrīśaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha || śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkānta śrīdhāma śrīpate'cyuta || 1.145.10 || gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmada|| agnayo mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ || 11 || pitaro mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ || lakṣmyā viyujyate deva na kadācidyathā bhavān || 12 || tathā kalatrasaṃbandho deva me naiva bhidyatu || lakṣmyā hyaśūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā || 13 || śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathaiva madhusūdana || evaṃ prasādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyāstathā hareḥ ||14|| phalāni dadyācchāyāyāmabhīṣṭāni jagatpateḥ || naktaṃ praṇamyāyatane havirbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ || 15 || brāhmaṇāya dvitīye'hni śayyāṃ dayātsadakṣiṇām|| evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaṅnaro māsacatuṣṭayam||16|| tasya janmatraye dālbhya gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate|| aśūnyaśayanaścāsau dharmakarmārthasādhakaḥ ||17|| bhavatyavyākṛtaiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ || nārī ca dālbhya dharmajña vratametadyathāvidhi ||18|| yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate || vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ vā bhartṛvyaṅgyaṃ ca sattama||19|| nāpnoti janmatritayametaccīrtvā pativratā || 1.145.20 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde aśūnyaśayanadvitīyāvarṇano nāma pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 145 || <1.146> dālbhya uvāca || upavāsāśritaṃ samyaglokadvayaphalapradam || kathitaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'si mayā dvija || 1 || anyadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tadbhavānprabavītu me || saṃsārahetuṃ muktiśca saṃsārānmunisattama || 2 || pulastya uvāca || avidyāprabhavaṃ karma hetubhūtaṃ dvijottama|| saṃsārasyāsya tanmuktiḥ saṃkṣepācchrūyatāṃ mama || 3 || svajātivihitaṃ karma rāgadveṣavivarjitam || kurvataḥ kṣīyate pūrvamanyabandhaśca neṣyate || 4 || apūrvasaṃbhavābhāvātkṣayaṃ yāte tu karmaṇi || dālbhya saṃsāravicchedaḥ kāraṇābhāvasaṃbhavaḥ || 5 || bhavatyasaṃśayaṃ cānyacchrūyatāmatra kāraṇam || saṃsāravicyuterdālbhya samāsādvadato mama || 6 || gṛhītā karmaṇā yena puṃsā jātirdvijottama || tatprāyaścittabhūtaṃ vai śṛṇu karmakṣayāvaham || 7 || brāhmaṇakṣattriyaviśāṃ śūdrāntyānāṃ ca sattama || svajātivihitaṃ karma rāgadveṣavivarjitam || 8 || jātipradasyākṣayadaṃ tadevādyasya karmaṇaḥ || jñānakāraṇabhāvaṃ ca tadeva pratipadyate || 9 || pumām̐ścādhigatajñāno bhedaṃ nāpnoti sattama || brahmaṇā viṣṇusaṃjñena parameṇāvyayātmanā ||1.146.10|| etatte kathitaṃ dālbhya saṃsārasya samāsataḥ || kāraṇaṃ bhavamuktiśca jāyate yogino yathā || 11 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || iti dālbhyaḥ pulastyena yathāvatpratibodhitaḥ || ārādhayāmāsa hariṃ lebhe kāmām̐śca vāñchitān 12 || tathā tvamapi rājendra keśavārādhanaṃ kuru || ārādhya taṃ jagannāthaṃ na kaścidavasīdati || 13 || etanmayoktaṃ sakalaṃ tava bhūmipa pṛcchataḥ || anārādhyācyutaṃ devaṃ kaḥ kāmānāpnuyānnaraḥ || 14 || vajra uvāca || bhagavānavatīrṇo'bhūnmartyalokamihācyutaḥ || bhārāvatāraṇārthāya bhuvo bhūmipatirhariḥ ||15|| mānuṣattve ca govindo mama pūrvapitāmahaḥ || cakāra prītimatulāṃ pāṇḍuputraiḥ saha dvija ||16|| sārathyaṃ kṛtavām̐ścaiva teṣāṃ sarveśvaro hariḥ || nistīrṇo yena bhīṣmaugho kurusainyamahodadhiḥ ||17|| upakārī mahābhāgaḥ sa teṣāṃ sarvavastuṣu || keśavaḥ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ sutānāṃ janako yathā || 18 || dhanyāste kṛtapuṇyāśca te me pāṇḍusutā matāḥ || viviśurye pariṣvaṅgairgovindabhujapañjaram || 19 || rājyahetorarīñjaghnura kasmātpāṇḍunandanāḥ || saptalokaikanāthena ye bhavantyekaśāyinaḥ || 1.146.20 || ātmānamanugacchāmi bhagavangatakalmaṣam || jātaṃ nirdhūtapāpe'smin kule viṣṇuparigrahe || 21 || evaṃ devavarasteṣāṃ prasādasumukho hariḥ|| pṛcchatāṃ kaccidācaṣṭa kiñcidguhyaṃ mahātmanām || 22 || guhyāñjanārdanaṃ yām̐stu dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || papraccha dharmānakhilām̐stānsamākhyātumarhasi || 23 || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yadguhyaṃ madhūsūdanaḥ || teṣāmavocadbhagavāñchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 24 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bahūni dharmaguhyāni dharmaputrāya keśavaḥ || purā provāca rājendra prasādasumukho hariḥ| || 25 || śaratalpagatādbhīṣmāddharmāñchrutvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || pṛṣṭavānyajjagannāthaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 26 || pañcamenāśvamedhena yadā snāto yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || bhagavanvaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ kiṃphalāḥ kiṃparāyaṇāḥ || 27 || kiṃ kṛtyamadhikṛtyaite bhavatotpāditāḥ purā || yadi te pāṇḍavasneho vidyate madhusūdana || 28 || śrotavyāste mayā dharmāstatastānkathayākhilān || pavitrāścaiva ye dharmāḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanāḥ || 29 || tava vaktracyutā deva sarvadharmeṣvanuttamāḥ || yāñchrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ || 1.146.30 || surāpo vā kṛtaghnaśca mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || etanme kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sabhāmadhye surottama || 31 || vasiṣṭhādyairmahābhāgairmunibhirbhāvitātmabhiḥ || tato'haṃ tava deveśa pādamūlamupāgataḥ || 32 || dharmānkathaya tāndeva yadyahaṃ bhavataḥ priyaḥ || śrutvā me mānavāndharmānvāsiṣṭhānvā mahāphalān || 33 || parāśarakṛtām̐ścaiva tathā'treyasya dhīmataḥ || śrutvā śaṅkhasya gārgyasya likhitasya yamasya ca || 34 || jābāleśca
