mahābāhormunerdvaipāyanasya ca || umāmaheśvarāścaiva jātidharmāśca pāvanāḥ || 35 || guṇasya guṇabāhośca kāśyapeyāstathaiva ca || bahvāyanakṛtāścaiva śākuneyāstathaiva ca || 36 || agastyagītā maudgalyāḥ śāṇḍilyāḥ saurabhāstathā || bhṛgoraṅgirasaścaiva kaśyapoddālakoditāḥ || 37 || sumantā jaiminīyāśca pailasya ca mahātmanaḥ || vaiśampāyanagītāśca pippalādakṛtāśca ye || 38 || aindrāśca vāruṇāścaiva kauberā vātsyapoṇakāḥ || āpastambakṛtā dharmāstathā gopālakasya ca || 39 || bhṛgvaṅgiraḥkṛtāścaiva saurā hārītakāstathā || śrībhagavānuvāca || śṛṇu rājanmahābāho dharmātmankurunandana ||1.146.40|| dharmavṛddhikaraṃ vacmi vṛṣabhasya tu lakṣaṇam || ṛṣabhaḥ sa samudrākhyaḥ satataṃ kulavardhanaḥ || 41 || mallikāpuṣpacitraśca dhanyo bhavati puṅgavaḥ || kāmalairmāṇḍalaiścāpi citro bhavati bhogadaḥ || 42 || atasīpuṣpavarṇaśca tathā dhanyataraḥ smṛtaḥ || ete dhanyāstathā dhanyānkīrtayiṣyāmi te nṛpa || 43 || kṛṣṇatālvoṣṭha daśanā rūkṣaśṛṅgaśaphāśca ye || avyaktavarṇā hrasvāśca vyāghrabhasmanibhāśca ye || 44 || dhvāṅkṣagṛdhrasavarṇāśca tathā mūṣakasannibhāḥ || kubjāḥ kāṇāstathā khañjāḥ kekarākṣāstathaiva ca || 45 || viṣamaśvetapādāśca udbhrāntanayanastathā || na te vṛṣāḥ proktavyā na ca dhāryāstathā gṛhe || 46 || moktavyānāṃ ca dhāryāṇāṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 47 || svastikākāraśṛṅgāśca meghaughasadṛśasvanāḥ || mahāpramāṇāśca tathā mattamātaṅgagāminaḥ || || 48 || mahoraskā mahocchvāsā mahābalaparākramāḥ || śiraḥ karṇau lalāṭaṃ ca vāladhiścaraṇāni ca || 49 || netrapārśve ca kṛṣṇāni śasyante candramastviṣaḥ || cihnānyetāni śasyante kṛṣṇasya tu viśeṣataḥ || 1.146.50 || bhūmiṃ karṣati lāṃgūlātpraśastaḥ sthūlavāladhiḥ || purastānna tathā nīco vṛṣabhaśca praśasyate || 51 || śaktidhvajapatākābhā yeṣāṃ rājirvirājate || anaḍvāhastu te dhanyā ṛddhisiddhijayāvahāḥ || 52 || pradakṣiṇaṃ nivartante svayaṃ ye vinivartitāḥ || samunnataśirogrīvā dhanyāste kośavardhanāḥ || 53 || raktaśṛṅgāgranayanāḥ śvetavarṇā bhavantyapi || śaphaiḥ pravālasadṛśairnāsti dhanyatarastataḥ || 54 || ete dhanyāḥ prayatnena moktavyā yadi vā vṛṣāḥ || dhāritāśca tathā muktā dhanadhānyavivardhanāḥ || 55 || caraṇāni mukhaṃ pucchaṃ yasya śvetāni gopateḥ || lākṣārasasavarṇaśca taṃ nīlamiti nirdiśet || 56|| vṛṣa eva sa moktavyo na sandhāryo gṛhe bhavet || yadarthameṣā carati gāthā loke purātanī || 57 || eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet || yajeta vāśvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjeta ||58|| evaṃ vṛṣaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃprayuktaṃ gṛhodbhavaṃ krītamathāpi rājan || muktvā na śocenmaraṇaṃ mahātmā mokṣe vidhiṃ cāhamato vidhāsye || 59 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vṛṣalakṣaṇavarṇano nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 146 || <1.147> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || āśvayuk kṛṣṇapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ narādhipa || kārtikepyathavā māsi vṛṣotsargaṃ tu kārayet || 1 || grahaṇe dve mahāpuṇye tathā caivāyanadvayam || viṣuvaddvitayaṃ caiva mṛtāho bāndhavasya ca || 2|| mṛtāho yasya tasyārthe tasminnahani śaṅkaram || susamiddhe gavāṃ madhye paristīrya hutāśanam || 3 || payasā śrapayedvidvām̐ścaruṃ pauṣṇaṃ samāhitaḥ || pūṣā gā anvetu naśca pūṣṇe hutvā narādhipa || 4 || iha rāḍiti hutvā ca japedrudrānsamāhitaḥ || tathaiva pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ kūṣmāṇḍāni narādhipa || 5 || tataḥ koṣṇena vṛṣabhamayaskāraḥ suśilpavān || śūlena dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme cakreṇa nirdahet || 6 || aṅkitaṃ snāpayetpaścātsnāne tasya tathā paṭhet || hiraṇyavarṇeti ṛcaścatasro manujeśvara || 7 || āpo hi ṣṭheti tisraśca śanno devīti cāpyatha| vatsataryaścatasraśca taṃ vṛṣaṃ ca narādhipa||8|| alaṅkuryāttataḥ paścādgandhamālyaiśca śaktitaḥ|| kiṅkiṇībhiśca ramyābhistathā cīnāṃśukaiḥ śubhaḥ || 9 || tataḥ kartā japenmantramimaṃ prayatamānasaḥ || vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmaścatuṣpādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || vṛṇomi tamahaṃ bhaktyā sa me rakṣatu sarvataḥ ||1.147.10 || evaṃ yuvānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dadāmi gavāṃ patiṃ yūthapatiṃ sadharmam || anena sārdhaṃ carata prakāmaṃ yathā tathā prāpnuta vatsataryaḥ || || 11 || evaṃ yuvānaṃ gopatiṃ vo dadāmi anena krīḍantīścaratīḥ priyeṇa || sahāsmābhiḥ prajayā mā tanūbhirmā vadhāma dviṣataṃ somarājan || 12|| mantraṃ pitā vatsa iti pratītaṃ japeta karṇe vṛṣabhasya savye || pracālayettaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tatastu pūrvāṃ diśaṃ vatsataryaśca sarvāḥ ||13|| vāsoyugaṃ grahīturatha pradeyaṃ suvarṇayuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca kāṃsyam || śilpapradhānasya tathaiva satyaṃ deyaṃ yathā tuṣṭimupaiti rājan || 14 || viprāstathānnaṃ dadhisarpiṣā yutaṃ saṃbhojanīyāḥ payasā ca miśram || utsṛṣṭamātre vṛṣabhe vrajanti tṛptiṃ parāṃ tasya pitāmahā ye || 15 || yasmim̐staḍāge sa jalaṃ tṛṣārtaḥ pātuṃ samāgacchati tatpitṝṇām || divyāmbupūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ mahīpate lokaṃ paraṃ tṛptimantaḥ prayānti|| 16 || saridvarāṃ kāñcidathopayāti tṛṣṇānvitastasya pitāmahānām || tṛptiṃ vidhatte saritāṃ variṣṭhā sudīrghakālaṃ vimalāmbuvāhaiḥ || 17 || darpeṇa pūrṇaḥ saviṣāṇaghātairdharāṃ yadā dhārayate narendra || pitṝṃstadā tasya tadannakūṭaṃ dhruvaṃ sa yātīti na saṃśayo'tra || 18 || romṇāṃ ca tulyāni śatāni rājanbhoktā tathā tasya divaṃ prayāti || saṃvatsarāṇāṃ paripūrṇakāmaḥ saṃsevyamānastridaśāṅganābhiḥ || 19 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vṛṣotsargavarṇano nāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 147 || <1.148> || vajra uvāca || caritaṃ budhaputrasya mārkaṇḍeya mayā śrutam || śrutaḥ śrāddhavidhiḥ puṇyaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 1 || dhenvāḥ prasūyamānāyāḥ phalaṃ dāne tathā śrutam || kṛṣṇājinapradānaṃ ca vṛṣotsargastathaiva ca || 2 || śrutvā rūpaṃ narendrasya budhaputrasya bhārgava || kautūhalaṃ samutpannaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 3 || kena karmavipākena sa tu rājā purūravāḥ || avāpa tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyamapi cottamam || 4 || devāṃstribhuvana śreṣṭhāngandharvāṃśca manoramān || urvaśī saṃgatā tyaktvā sarvabhāvena taṃ nṛpam || 5 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śṛṇu karmavipākena yena rājā purūravāḥ || purūravā iti khyāto madreṣvāsīnmahīpatiḥ || 6 || cāśuṣasyānvaye jātaścākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ || sarvairnṛpaguṇairyuktaḥ kevalaṃ rūpa varjitaḥ || 7 || vajra uvāca || purūravā madrapatiḥ karmaṇā kena bhārgava || babhūva karmaṇā kena kurūpaśca tathā dvija || 8 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dvijagrāme dvijaśreṣṭho nāmnaivā''sītpurūravāḥ || nadyāḥ kūle mahārāja pūrvajanmani pārthivaḥ || 9 || sa tu madrapatirnāmnā yo'bhūdrājā purūravāḥ || asmiñjanmanyasau vipro dvādaśīṣu sadānagha || 1.148.10 || upoṣya pūjayāmāsa rājyakāmo janārdanam || cakāra sopavāsaṃ ca snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam || 11 || upavāsaphalaṃ prāpya rājyaṃ madreṣvakaṇṭakam || upoṣitastadābhyaṅgādrūpahīno'bhyajāyata || 12 || upoṣito narastasmātsnānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam || varjayettatprayatnena rūpaghnaṃ tatparaṃ nṛṇām || 13 || etatte kathitaṃ tasya yadvṛttaṃ pūrvajanmani || madreśvaratve caritaṃ śṛṇu tasya mahīpateḥ || 14 || tasya rājaguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samupetasya pārthiva || janānurāgo naivāsīdrūpahīnasya yādava || 15 || rūpakāmaḥ sa madreśastapase kṛtaniścayaḥ || rājyaṃ mantrigataṃ kṛtvā jagāma himaparvatam || 16 || vyavasāyadvitīyastu padbhyāmeva mahāyaśāḥ || ūrdhvaṃ saṃtīrya sa nadaṃ viṣayānte svakīṃ nadīm || irāvatīmiti khyātāṃ dadarśātimanoharām || 17 || tuhinagiribhavāṃ mahoghavegāṃ tuhinasagarbhasamānaśītalodām || tuhinasadṛśavarṇaphenayuktāṃ tuhinayaśāḥ saritaṃ dadarśa rājā || 18 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde madreśvarasya tapovana gamanaṃ nāmāṣṭacattvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 148 || <1.149> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sa dadarśa nadīṃ puṇyāṃ ramyāṃ haimavatīṃ śubhām || gandharvagaṇasaṃkīrṇāṃ nityaṃ śakreṇa sevitām || 1 || surebhamadasiṃdūrairyasyāṃ rājirvirājate || madhyena śakracāpābhā tasyāṃ majjati sarvadā || 2 || tapasviśaraṇāyātāṃ mukhyabrāhmaṇasevitām || dadarśa śītapānīyāṃ mahārājaḥ purūravāḥ || 3 || plutahaṃsāvalīchannāṃ kāśacāmaravījitām || sābhiṣekāmiva sa tāṃ paśyanprītiṃ parāṃ yayau || 4 || puṇyāṃ suśītalāṃ hṛdyāṃ manasaḥ prītivardhinīm || kṣayavṛddhiyutāṃ saumyāṃ somamūrtimivāparām || 5 || suśītaśīghrapānīyāṃ dvijapuñjaniṣevitām || sutāṃ himavataḥ śreṣṭhāṃ cañcadvīcivirājitām || 6 || amṛtasvādusalilāṃ tāpasairupaśobhitām || svargārohaṇaniḥśreṇīṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm || 7 || agryāṃ samudramahiṣīṃ mahiṣīgaṇagāhitām || hitāṃ sarvasya lokasya kasya nautsukyakāriṇīm || 8 || gokulākulatīrāṃ tāṃ ramyāṃ śaivālavarjitām || haṃsasārasasaṃghuṣṭairjalajaiḥ sevitāṃ śubhaiḥ || 9 || āvartanābhigambhīrāṃ dvīporujaghanasthalām || nīlanīrajanetrāṃ tāmutphullakamalānanām || 1.149.10 || himābhaphenavasanāṃ cakravākādharāṃ śubhām || balākāpaṅktidaśanāṃ calanmatsyāvalibhruvam|| 11|| svajaloddhatamātaṅgaramyakumbhapayodharām || haṃsanūpurasaṃghuṣṭāṃ mṛṇālavalayāvalīm || 12 || yasyāṃ rūpamadonmattagandharvānugataḥ sadā || madhyāhnasamaye rājankrīḍatyapsarasāṃ gaṇaḥ || 13 || tāmapsarovinirmuktānvahantī kusumāñśubhān || svatīradrumasaṃbhūtānnānāvarṇānsugandhinaḥ || 14 || taraṅgaśatasaṃkrāntasūryamaṇḍaladurdaśam || surebhajanitāghātavapradvayavibhūṣitām || 15 || śakrebhagaṇḍasalilairdevastrīkuca candanaiḥ || saṃyutaṃ salilaṃ yasyāḥ ṣaṭpadairupasevyate || 16 || yasyāstīrabhavā vṛkṣāḥ sugandhikusumānvitāḥ || tathā prakṛṣṭabhramarā bhramaraiste nirākulāḥ || 17 || yasyāstīre ratiṃ yānti sadā kāmavaśānugāḥ || tapodhanāśca ṛṣayastathā devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 18 || labhante yatplutāṅgāstu devebhyaḥ pratimānanāḥ || striyaśca nāke bahulāḥ padmendupratimānanāḥ || 19 || yā bibharti sadā toyaṃ devasaṃghairapīḍitam || pulindamṛgavṛndaiśca vyādhasaṃghairapīḍitam || 1.149.20 || satāmarasapānīyāṃ satārāgaganāmalām || sa tāṃ paśyanyayau rājā satāmīpsitakāmadām || 21|| yasyāstīraruhaiḥ kāśaiḥ phullaiścandrāṃśusannibhaiḥ || rājadbhirvivṛtākāśai ramyaistatkṣīrasaṃsthitaiḥ ||22|| yā ca sadā divi sevyati devairyā ca sadā bhuvi sevyati vipraiḥ || yā ca sadā sakalāghavināśaṃ bhaktajanasya karotyacireṇa ||23|| yā ca gatā saritāṃ hi kadambairyā ca nutā satataṃ hi mahīnaiḥ || yā ca yutā śatatoyakadamvairyā ca gatā satataṃ himahīnaiḥ || 24 || yuktāpi kesarigaṇaiḥ karivṛndayātā sannāgayuktasalilāpi suvarṇayuktā || sūryāṃśutāpaparivṛddhivivṛddhiśīlā śītāṃśutulyayaśasā dadṛśe nṛpeṇa || 25 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde irāvatīvarṇano nāmaiko napañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāya || 149 || <1.150> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ālokayannadīṃ puṇyāṃ tatsamīrahataklamaḥ || sa gacchanneva dadṛśe himavantaṃ mahāgirim || 1 || khamullikhadbhirbahubhirvṛtaṃ śṛṅgaiḥ supāṇḍuraiḥ|| pakṣiṇāmatha saṃcārairvinā siddhagatiṃ śubhām ||2 || nadīprapātasaṃjātamahāśabdaiḥ samantataḥ || asaṃśrutānyaśabdantaṃ śītatoyaṃ manoramam || 3 || devadāruvanairnīlaiḥ kṛtādhovasanaṃ śubham || meghottarīyaṃ taṃ śailaṃ dadṛśe sa narādhipaḥ || 4 || śvenameghakṛtoṣṇīṣaṃ candrārkamukuṭaṃ kvacit || himānuliptasarvāṅgaṃ kvaciddhātuvicitritam || 5 || candanenānuliptāṅgadattapañcāṅguliṃ yathā || śītapradaṃ nidāghe'pi śilāviṣamasaṃkaṭam || 6 || sālaktakairapsarasāṃ mudritaṃ caraṇaiḥ kvacit || kvacidaspṛṣṭasūryāṃśuṃ kvacicca tamasā vṛtam || 7 || darīmukhaiḥ kvacidbhīmaiḥ pibantamanilaṃ bahu || kvacidvidyādharagaṇaiḥ krīḍadbhirupaśobhitam || 8 || upagītaṃ tathā mukhyaiḥ kinnarāṇāṃ gaṇaiḥ kvacit || āpānabhūmau ca gaṇairgandharvāpsarasāṃ kvacit || 9 || gītādibhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ gandharvīṇāṃ manoharam || niruddhapavanairdeśairnīlaśādvalamaṇḍitaiḥ || 1.150.10 || kvacicca kusumairyuktaṃ cātyantaruciraiḥ śubham || tapasviśaraṇaṃ śailaṃ kāmināmapi durlabham || 11 || mṛgayūthānucaritaṃ dantibhinnamahādrumam || yatra siṃhaninādena trastānāṃ bhairavaṃ ravam || 12 || śrutvotpaśyati vibhrāntaṃ gajānāmākulaṃ kulam || tapaśca tāpasairyasya kūladeśeṣvalaṃkṛtam || 13 || ratnairyataḥ samutpannaistrailokyaṃ cāpyalaṃkṛtam || ahīnaśaraṇaṃ nityamahīnajanasevitam || 14 || ahīnaḥ paśyati girimahīnaṃ ratnasampadam || alpena tapasā yatra siddhiḥ prāpyeta tāpasaiḥ || 15 || yaśca darśanamātreṇa sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ || mahāprapātasaṃpātaprabhītakhagabandhubhiḥ | 16 || vāyunīta sadāvṛṣṭiḥ kṛtadeśaṃ kvacitkvacit || alabdhajaladaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ kvaciccātisamucchritaiḥ || 17 || nityārkatāpaviṣamairagamyairmanasā yutam || devadāru mahāvṛkṣapuñjaśākhānirantaraiḥ || 18 || samastabhuvanākāraiḥ pradeśairupaśobhitam || himacchannamahāśṛṃgaṃ prapātamitanirjharam || śabdalabhyāmbuviṣamaṃ himasaṃruddhakandaram || 19 || dṛṣṭvaiva tāṃ cārunitambabhūmiṃ mahānubhāvaḥ sa mahīndranāthaḥ || babhrāma tatraiva mudā sametaḥ sthānaṃ tataḥ kiñcidathā sasāda || 1.150.20 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde himavadvarṇano nāma pañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 150 || <1.151> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tasyaiva parvatendrasya pradeśaṃ sumanoharam || agamyaṃ mānuṣairanyairdaivayogādupāgataḥ || 1 || irāvatī saricchreṣṭhā yasmāddeśā dvinirgatā || meghaśyāmaṃ ca taṃ deśaṃ drumakhaṇḍairanekaśaḥ || 2 || sālaistālaistamālaiśca karṇikāraiḥ saśālmalaiḥ || nyagrodhaiśca tathāśvatthaiḥ śirīṣaiḥ śiṃśapādrumaiḥ || 3 || śleṣmātakairāmalakairharītakavibhītakaiḥ || ramyaiścandanavṛkṣaiśca kapitthai raktacandanaiḥ ||4|| vaṭamāhiṣakākṣoṭairaśvakarṇaistathārjunaiḥ || hastikarṇaiḥ sapanasaiḥ kovidāraiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ ||5|| devadārumahāvṛkṣaistathā kālīyakadrumaiḥ || padmakaiścandanairbilvaiḥ kuṭajairharicandanaiḥ || 6 || prācīnāgurukaiścaiva sthūṇikaiḥ samaśaṇḍikaiḥ || kharjūrairnārikeraiśca priyālvāmrātakeṅgudaiḥ ||7|| terumānairvaṭerbhanyaiḥ kāśmīraiḥ phalibhistathā || jātīphalaiḥ pūgaphalaiḥ kaṭphalairlavalīphalaiḥ || 8 || mandāraiḥ kovidāraiśca kiṃśukaiḥ kusumāṃśubhiḥ || palāśaiḥ śamisūllāsairvetasairamlavetasaiḥ || 9 || raktātiraṅganāriṅgairiṃgudaiḥ sapriyaṃgubhiḥ || raktāśokaistathā'śokairārukaiḥ sacirārukaiḥ||1.151.10|| mucukundaistathā kundairāṭarūṣaparūṣakaiḥ || kiṃkarātaiḥ kirātaiśca ketakaiśca saketakaiḥ||11|| śobhāñjanairañjanaiśca mukūlakanikocakaiḥ || supūrṇacāruvasanairdrumaiḥ śreṣṭhaistathāsanaiḥ || 12 || manmathasya śarākāraissahakārairmanoharaiḥ || pītayūthikayā rājañśvetayūthikayā tathā ||13|| jātyā campakajātyā ca tumburaiścāpyudumbaraiḥ || māṣaiścoccaissalakucaistilambalakuśambalaiḥ || 14 || tathā supuṣpāva raṇairvaraṇaiḥ kāmivallabhaiḥ|| puṣpākulaiśca bakulaiḥ pāribhadrakabhadrakaiḥ||15|| dhārākadaṃbaiḥ kuṭajaiḥ kadaṃbairgirikūṭajaiḥ|| ākrāntasarvakakubhaiḥ kakubhaiḥ kamanīyakaiḥ|| ||16|| karkandhubadarairnīpaiḥ dīpairiva mahojjvalaiḥ || raktaiḥ pālīvataiḥ śvetairdāḍimaiścaṇyakadrumaiḥ ||17 || pratānaiḥ pippalīnāṃ ca nāgavalyāśca bhāgaśaḥ || maricasya tathā gulmairnavamallikayā tathā || 18 || mṛdvīkāmaṇḍalairmukhyairatimuktakamaṇḍalaiḥ || trapusairvārukānāṃ ca pratānaiḥ saphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 19 || kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ pratānaiśca alābūnāṃ tathā kvacit|| cirbhaṭasya pratānaiśca paṭolaiḥ kāravellakaiḥ || 1.151.20 || karkoṭakaiḥ pratānaiśca vārtākairbṛhatīphalaiḥ || kahlārairmūlakairmukhyaiḥ śākaiśca vividhaistathā ||21|| suvarcalābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ sarṣapābhistathaiva ca || kākolīkṣīrakākolī chatrayā cāticchatrayā ||22 | kākamācīmahābaddhiśaśakarddalakandalaiḥ || tathā kṣīrikaśākena kālaśākena cāpyatha || 23 || śimbidhānyaistathā dhānyaiḥ sarvairniravaśeṣataḥ || oṣadhībhirvicitrābhidīpyamānābhireva ca || 24 || kandairvidāryā ca tathā tarūṭaiḥ svādusaṃyutaiḥ || suniṣaṇṇāśaṭīśeṣārājakṣayakavāstukaiḥ || 25 || āyuṣyābhiryaśasyābhirvarṇyābhiśca narādhipa || jarāmṛtyubhayaghnābhiḥ kṣudbhayaghnābhireva ca || 26 || saubhāgyajananībhiśca vṛṣyābhiścāpyanekaśaḥ || vetraveṇulatābhiśca tathā kīcakaveṇubhiḥ || 27|| kāśaiḥ śaśāṅkasaṃkāśaiḥ śaragulmaistathā kvacit || kuśagulmaistathā ramyairgulmaiścekṣumanoharaiḥ || 28 || kārpāsayā tuvaryā ca dukūlena śubhena ca || tathā ca kadalīkhaṇḍairmanohāribhiruttamaiḥ || 29 || tathā marakataprakhyaiḥ pradeśaiḥ śādvalānvitaiḥ || irāpuṣpasamāyuktaiḥ kuṅkumasya ca bhāgaśaḥ || 1.151.30 || tagarātiviṣāmāṃsīgranthiparṇīsurāgadaiḥ || suvarṇapuṣpaiśca tathā bhūmipuṣpaistathā paraiḥ || 31 || jambīrikābhūstṛṇaiśca sarasaiḥ sṛmukaistathā || śṛṅgaverājamodābhiḥ kuṭherakapriyālukaiḥ || 32 || jalajaiśca tathā padmairnānāvarṇaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || udayādityasaṃkāśaiḥ pūrṇacandranibhaistathā || 33 || tapanīyasavarṇaiśca atasīpuṣpasannibhaiḥ || śukapatranibhaiścānyaiḥ sthalapadmaiśca bhāgaśaḥ || 34 || pañcavarṇaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ bahuvaṇaistathaiva ca || duṣṭadṛṣṭyāhitamudaiḥ kusumaiścandrasannibhaiḥ || 35 || tathā vahniśikhākārai rājanraktotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || nīlotpalaiḥ sakahlārairdurjjātakakaśerukaiḥ || 36 || śṛṅgāṭakairmṛṇālaiśca kāvāṭai rākṣasotpalaiḥ || jalajaiḥ sthalajairmūlaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpairaśeṣataḥ || 37 || vividhaiścaiva nīvārairmunibhojyairnarādhipa || na taddhānyaṃ na tatsasyaṃ na tacchākaṃ na tatphalam || 38 || na tanmūlaṃ na tatkandaṃ na tatpuṣpaṃ narādhipa || nāgalokodbhavaṃ yacca nākalokodbhavaṃ ca yat || 39 || anūpabandhanotthaṃ ca tanna yatrāsti yādava || sadā puṣpaphalaṃ sarvamajasramṛtuyogataḥ || 1.151.40 || maheśvaraḥ sa dadṛśe tapaso'rthāya vo gataḥ || dadṛśe ca tathā tatra nānārūpānpatatriṇaḥ || 41 || mayūrāñśatapatrām̐śca kalavācakakokilān || tathā kādambakānhaṃsānkukkuṭāñjalakukkuṭān ||82|| kṛkarānbarkaśāñśyāmāṃstittirānsakapiñjalān || dhārtarāṣṭrānplavānmadgūnkalaviṅkāñchukānba kān || 43 || caṭakāṃścakravākāṃśca āṭakāṃṣṭiṭṭibhānsaṭān || putrapriyāṃllohapṛṣṭāngonandagirivartakān || 44 || pārāvatānkāmalāṃśca śārakāñjīvajīvakān || lāvavartakavattīrānraktadharmaprabhadrakān ||45|| tāmracūḍānvarṇacūḍānkoyaṣṭīnkhañjarīṭakān || ṛṣiputrānsahārītānkukkuṭānkāṣṭhakukkuṭān || 46 || laṭvām̐llaṭeṣūngokṣveḍāṃstathā kuṅkumacūḍakān || bhṛṅgarājāñchārapādānbhūliṅgānpiṇḍimālavān||47|| maṃjūlīyakadātyūhagopaputrāntsavañjulān || bhāradvājāṃstathā cāṣānsuvarṇānrajanīyakān ||48|| etāṃścānyāṃśca hi bahūnpakṣisaṃghānmanoharān || śvāpadānvividhākārānmṛgāṃścaiva mahāmṛgān || 49 || vyāghrānkesariṇaḥ siṃhānvīcinaḥ śarabhānvṛkān || ṛkṣāṃstarakṣūnbandhūkāngolāṅgūlānsavānarān || 1.151.50 || śaśām̐llokācchaśapalānmārjārānmāyavaḥ śunaḥ || mṛṣikānnākulānkācānsiṃhānnoḍrasuromakān || 51 || tathā mattāṃśca mātaṅgānmahiṣāngavayānvṛ ṣān|| caramānsṛmarāṃścaiva tathā gorānnakhānapi ||52|| urabhrāṃśca tathā meṣānsāraṅgānatha karkaśān || rurūnjamṛṣpadānṛṣpānmarkaṭānkarkaṭānmṛgān || nīlāṃścaiva mahānīlānkarālamṛgamārdakān ||53|| śvadaṃṣṭrānrāmaśarabhānkoḍakākapaśambarān ||54|| karālānkṛtamālāṃśca kālapucchām̐stathāruṇān || uṣṭrāngajānvarāhām̐śca turagānkharagardabhān|| 55 || etānpaśyansa madreśo viruddhāṃśca parasparam || aviruddhānvane tasminnirvṛtiṃ ca parāṃ yayau |||| 56 || tadāśramapade mukhyo babhūvātriḥ purā nṛpa || tatprasādātsadā yuktaṃ sthāvarairjaṅgamaistathā || 57 || hiṃsanti na tathā'nyonyaṃ hiṃsakāstu parasparam || kravyādāḥ prāṇinastatra sarve kṣīraphalāśanāḥ || 58|| nirmitāstatra ratyarthamatriṇā sumahātmanā || śilānāṃ nimnadeśeṣu tatra gāvaḥ svayaṃ nṛpa || 59 || payaḥ kṣaranti taddivyamamṛtasvādusannibham || kvacidrājamahiṣyaśca kvacidrājā ca bhāgaśaḥ || 1.151.60 || śilāḥ kṣīreṇa saṃpūrṇā dadhnā cānyatra yādava || sa paśyanparamāṃ prītimavāpa vasudhādhipaḥ ||61|| sarāṃsi tatra divyāni nadyaśca vimalodakāḥ || mṛṇālakāni divyāni śītalāni ca bhāgaśaḥ || 62 || kandarāṇi ca śailasya sukhasevyāni yādava || himapāto na tatrāsti samantātpañcayojanam || 63 || upatyakāsu śailasya śikhareṣu tu vidyate || tatrāpi rājañchikharaṃ parvatendrasya pāṇḍuram || 64 || himapātaṃ sadā tatra ghanāḥ kurvanti saṃhatāḥ || tatrāsti cāparaṃ śṛṅgaṃ yatra toyaṃ ghanā ghanāḥ || 65 || nityamevābhivarṣanti śilābhiḥ śikharaṃ kharam || tadāśramaṃ manohāri yatra kāmadharā dharāḥ || 66 || suramukhyopabho gyatvācchākhinaḥ saphalāḥ sadā| || sadopagītabhramaraṃ surastrīsevitāmaram || 67 || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ śailasyeva mahākaram || vānaraiḥ krīḍamānaiśca deśe deśe narādhipa||68|| haṃsapuñjāḥ kṛtāstatra candrabimbasamaprabhāḥ|| tadāśramasamantācca himasaṃruddhakandaram||69|| śailavāṭaiḥ parivṛtamagamyaṃ manujaiḥ sadā|| pūrvārādhitadeveśo mahārājaḥ purūravāḥ||1.151.70|| tadāśramamanuprāpto devadevaprasādataḥ|| tadāśramaṃ śramaśamanaṃ manoharaṃ manoharaiḥ kusumaśatairalaṃkṛtam|| kṛtaṃ ca tatsvayamatha cātriṇā śubhaṃ śubhapradaṃ taṃ dadṛśe sa madrarāṭ||71|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde maharṣyāśramavarṇanannāmaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||151|| <1.152> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| tatra yau tau mahāśṛṅgau mahāvarṣamahāhimau|| tṛtīyaṃ tu tayormadhye śṛṅgamatyantamucchritam || 1 || nityātapaṃ taptaśilaṃ sadā bhagativarjitam || tasyādhastāddakṣagaṇe deśe bhāge ca paścime || 2 || jātīlatāparikṣiptaṃ vivaraṃ cārudarśanam|| dṛṣṭvaiva kautukāviṣṭastaṃ viveśa mahīpatiḥ||3|| tamasā cātinibiḍaṃ nalvamātraṃ mahīpatiḥ|| nalvamātramatikramya svaprabhābharaṇojvalam |||| 4 || samucchritamathātyantaṃ gambhīraṃ parivartulam || na tatra sūryastapati na virājati candramāḥ || 5 || tathāpi divasākāraṃ prākāśyaṃ tadaharniśam || krośādhikaparīmāṇaṃ sarasā ca virājitam ||6|| samantātsarasastasya śailalagnā tu vedikā|| sauvarṇai rājatairvṛkṣairvidrumairapi śobhitā || 7 || nānā māṇikyakusumaiḥ svaprabhābharaṇojjvalaiḥ || tasminsarasi padmāni padmarāgacchadāni ca || 8 || vajrakesarajālāni sugandhīni tathāpyati || patrairmarakatairnīlavaidūryaiśca mahīpate || 9 || karṇikāśca tathāśeṣā jātarūpasya pārthiva || tasminsarasi yā bhūmirna sā kardamasaṅkulā || 1.152.10 || nānāratnairupacitā jalajānāṃ samāśrayā || kapardakānāṃ śuktīnāṃ śaṅkhānāṃ ca mahīpate || 11 || makarāṇāṃ ca matsyānāṃ paiṇḍānāṃ kacchapaiḥ saha || tatra maratakakhaṇḍāni vajrāṇi ca sahasraśaḥ ||12|| padmarāgendranīlāni mahānīlāni pārthiva || puṣparāgāṇi ramyāṇi tathā karketakāni ca ||13|| turūkasya ca khaṇḍāni tathā śepasya bhāgaśaḥ || gajāvarttasya mukhyasya rudhirākhyasya cāpyatha || 14 || sūryendukāntayoścaiva pīlorbhallātakasya ca || jyotīrasasya ramyasya śaṅkhakasya ca bhāgaśaḥ || 15 || masāragavalaṅkānāṃ sphaṭikasya tathaiva ca|| gomedapittakānāṃ ca dhūlī marakatasya ca || 16|| vaidūryasaugandhikayostathā rājamaṇernṛpa || khañjasya caiva mukhyasya tathā brahmamaṇerapi ||17|| muktāphalānāṃ mukhyānāṃ tārāvigrahadhāriṇām || sukhoṣṇaṃ caiva tattoyaṃ snānācchītavināśanam ||18|| vaidūryasya śilāmadhye sarasastasya śobhanā|| pramāṇena tathā sā ca dve ca rājandhanuḥśate||19|| caturasrā tathā ramyā tapasā nirmitātriṇā || biladvārasame deśe ketustatra hiraṇmayaḥ ||1.152.20|| pradeśaḥ sa tu rājendra dvīpe tasminmanohare || tathā puṣkariṇī ramyā tasminrājañchilātale ||21|| suśītāmalapānīyā jalajaiśca virājitā || ākāśavimalā rājaṃścaturasrā manoharā || 22 || tasyāstadudakaṃ svādu laghu śītaṃ sugandhi ca || na kṣiṇoti tathā kāyaṃ kukṣimāpūrayatyapi ||23|| tṛptiṃ vidhatte paramāṃ śarīre ca mahatsukham || madhye ca tasyāḥ sukṛtaṃ prāsādaṃ tapasā triṇā || 24 || rukmasetupraveśaṃ tatsarvaratnamayaṃ śubham || śaśāṅkaraśmisaṅkāśaṃ prāsādaṃ rājataṃ hitam ||25|| ramyaṃ vaidūryasopānaṃ vidrumāmalatārakam || indranīlamahācakrañjātarūpavibhūṣitam||26|| padmarāgamahāstaṃbhaṃ tathā marakatavedikam || vajrāṃśujālaiśchuritaṃ ramyaṃ dṛṣṭimanoharam ||27|| prāsāde tatra bhagavāndevadevo janārdanaḥ || bhogibhogāvalīsuptaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ || 28 || jānumākuñcitastvekaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || phaṇīndrasanniviṣṭāṃghri dvitīyaśca tathā nṛpa || 29 || lakṣmyutsaṅgagatāṃghristu śeṣabhogaprasāritaḥ || phaṇīndrabhogavinyastabāhukūrparaśobhitaḥ || 1.152.30 || svāṅgulīpṛṣṭhavinyasta devaśīrṣadharaṃ vibhum|| ekaṃ tu devadevasya dvitīyaṃ saṃprasāritam || 31 || samākuñcitajānusthamaṇibandhasuśobhitam || kiñcidākuñcitaṃ caiva nābhideśe karasthitam ||32|| tṛtīyaṃ ca bhujaṃ tasya caturthaṃ tu tathā śṛṇu || āttasantānakusumaṃ prāṇadeśānusarpiṇam ||33|| lakṣmyā saṃvāhyamānāṃghriḥ phullapadmanibhaiḥ karaiḥ || santānamālāmukuṭahārakeyūrabhūṣitam|| 34 || bhūṣitaṃ ca tathā devamaṅgulīyakaiḥ || phaṇīndraphaṇavinyastacāruratnaśikhojjvalam || 35 || ajñātavastucaritaṃ pratiṣṭhitamathātriṇā || siddhāntapūjyaṃ satataṃ samantātkusumārcitam||36|| divyagandhāvaliptāṅgaṃ divyadhūpena dhūpitam || gorasaiḥ saphalairhṛdyaiḥ siddhairupahṛtaiḥ sadā || 37 || saṃśobhitaṃ puraḥpārśvaṃ devamuttamaśīrṣakam|| tathā paścānmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vavande sa narādhipaḥ ||38|| jānubhyāṃ śirasā caiva gatvā bhūmiṃ yathāvidhi || nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tathā tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam || 39 || pradakṣiṇamatho cakre sa tūtthāya punaḥ punaḥ || ramyamāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrovāsāśrame nṛpaḥ || 1.152.40 || viśālāṃ hi guhāṃ kāñcidāśritya sumanoharām || tapaścacāra tatraiva pūjayāno janārdanam ||41|| nānāvidhaiḥ sadā puṣpaiḥ phalairmūlaiḥ sagorasaiḥ || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī vahnipūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 42 || devavāpījalaiḥ kurvansatataṃ prāṇadhāraṇam || sarvāhāraparityāgaṃ sa kṛtvā manujeśvaraḥ || 43 || anāśritaguhāśāyī kālaṃ nayati pārthivaḥ || tyaktāhārakriyasyāsya kevalāmbho'śinastathā || glānistasya samāyāti na śarīre tadadbhutam ||44|| evaṃ sa rājā tapasi prasaktaḥ sampūjayandevavaraṃ sadaiva || tatrāśrame kālamuvāsa kaścitsvargopame duḥkhamavindamānaḥ || 45|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde āśramavarṇano nāma dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 152 || <1.153> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || gatvāśramapade rājā tyaktāhāraparicchadaḥ || krīḍāvihārairgandharvaiḥ paśyatyapsarasassaha || 1 || kṛtvā puṣpoccayaṃ bhūri grathayitvā tathā srajaḥ || agre nivedya devāya gandharvebhyastathā dadau ||2 || puṣpoccayaprasaktānāṃ krīḍantīnāṃ yathāsukham || ceṣṭā nānāvidhākārāḥ paśyannapi na paśyati || 3 || kāścitpuṣpoccaye saktā latājālena veṣṭitāḥ || sakhījanena santyaktāḥ kāntena paramokṣitāḥ || 4 || makarandasamākrāntanayanāḥ kāścidaṅganāḥ || kāntaniḥśvāsavātena nīrajaskīkṛtekṣaṇāḥ || 5 || kāciduccitya puṣpāṇi dadau kāntasya bhāminī || kāntasaḍgrathitaistaiśca rarāja kṛtaśekharā || 6 || svayamuccitya saṅgranthya ramaṇakṛtaśekharā || kṛtakṛtyamivā''tmānaṃ mene manmathavardhinī || 7 || anyasmingahane kuñje viśeṣakusumā latā || kācidevaṃ raho nītā ramaṇena riraṃsunā || 8 || kāntasannāmitalatākusumāni vicinvatī || sarvābhyaḥ kācidātmānaṃ mene sarvaguṇādhikam || 9 || kvacitpaśyati bhūpālo nalinīṣu pṛthakpṛthak || krīḍyamānāstu gandharvaidaivarāmā manoramāḥ || 1.153.10 || kāciccātāḍayatkāntamudakena śucismitā || tāḍyamānā tathaivānyā kāntena ratimāyayau || 11 || kāntā tu tāḍayāmāsa jātakhedā varāṅganā || adṛśyata varārohā śvāsanṛtyatpayodharā || 12 || kāntāmbutāḍana bhraṣṭakeśapāśanibandhanā || śvāsākulamukhī bhāti madhupairiva padminī || 13 || svavaktrasadṛśaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃchannanalinīvane || channā kāciccirātprāptā kāntenānviṣya yatnataḥ || 14 || snātā śītāpadeśena kācitprauḍhāṅganā bhṛśam || ramaṇāliṅganaṃ cakre manobhi'laṣitaṃ ciram || 15 || jalārdraṃ vasanaṃ sūkṣmamaṅgalīnaṃ śucismitā || dhārayantī janaṃ cakre kācittatra samanmatham ||16|| gandhamālyaguṇaiḥ kācitkānttenākṛṣya cāmbhasi || truṭyatsragdāmapatitaṃ ramaṇaṃ prāhasacciram ||17|| kācinmagnasakhīdattajānudeśanakhakṣatā || sambhramātkāntaramaṇamagnā sāpi nyamajjata || 18 || kācitpṛṣṭhīkṛtādityā keśanistoyakāriṇī || śilātalagatā bhartrā dṛṣṭā kāmārtacakṣuṣā ||19|| hṛtamālyaṃ sulalitaṃ saṃkrāntakucakuṅkumam || ratāntaklāntakāntābhamabhavattatsarodakam ||1.153.20|| susnātadevagandharvadevarāmāgaṇena ca || pūjyamānaṃ sa dadṛśe devadevaṃ janārdanam || 21 || kvacicca dadṛśe rājā latāgṛhagatāḥ striyaḥ || maṇḍayantyaḥ svagātrāṇi kāntasanyastamānasāḥ ||22|| kācidādarśasuvyagrakarā dūtīmukhodgatam || śṛṇvatī kāntavacanamatiklāntamukhā babhau ||23 || kācitsatvaritā dūtyā bhūṣaṇānāṃ viparyayam || kurvāṇā naiva bubudhe manmathāviṣṭacetanā || 24 || vāyununnāṃtasurabhi kusumotkaramaṇḍite || kvacitpibantyo dadṛśe pradeśe nīlaśādvale ||29| pāyayāmāsa ramaṇaṃ svayaṃ kācidvarāṅganā || kācitpapau varārohā kāntapāṇi samarpitam||26|| kācitsvanetrasaṃkrāntanīlotpalayutaṃ vadhūḥ|| pītvā papraccha ramaṇaṃ kva gate te mahotpale||27|| tvayaiva pīte te nūnamityuktā ramaṇena sā || satyaṃ viditvā mugdhatvādbabhūva vrīḍitā ciram ||28|| kācitkāntārpitaṃ subhrūḥ kāntapītāvaśeṣitam || saviśeṣarasaṃ pānaṃ papau manmathavardhanam||29|| āpānagoṣṭhīṣu tadā tāsāṃ sa narapuṅgavaḥ || śuśrāva vividhaṃ gītaṃ tantrīsvaravimiśritam || 1.153.30 || pradoṣasamaye tāśca devadevaṃ janārdanam || rājansadopanṛtyanti nānāvādyapuraḥsarāḥ || 31|| yāmamātre gate rātrau vinirgatya guhāmukhāt || āyānti saṃyutāḥ kāntaiḥ svaṛddhiracitāngṛhān ||32|| nānāgandhārcitatalānnānāgandhasugandhinaḥ || nānāvicitraśayanānkusumotkaramaṇḍitān || 33 || evamapsarasāṃ paśyankrīḍitāni sa parvate || tapastepe mahārājaḥ keśavārpitamānasaḥ || 34 || tamūcurnṛpatiṃ gatvā gandharvāpsaraṇāṃ gaṇāḥ || rājansvargopamaṃ deśaṃ prāptastvamarimardana || 35|| vayaṃ hi te pradāsyāmo manasaḥ kāṅkṣitānvarān || tānādāya gṛhaṃ gaccha tiṣṭheha yadi vā punaḥ || 36 || purūravā uvāca|| amoghadarśanāḥ sarve bhavantastvamitaujasaḥ || varaṃ vitarādyaiva prasādaṃ madhusūdanāt || 37 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamastvityathoktastaiḥ sa tu rājā purūravāḥ || tatrovāsa sukhī māsaṃ pūjayāno janārdanam || 38 || priya eva sadaivāsīdgandharvāpsarasāṃ nṛpa || tutoṣa sa jano rājñastasyālaulyena karmaṇā || 39 || maghasya madhye sa nṛpaḥ praviṣṭastadāśramaṃ ratnasahasracitram|| toyāśanastatra uvāsa māsaṃ yāvatsitāntaṃ nṛpa phālgunasya || 1.153.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasamvāde jalakrīḍāvarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 153|| <1.154> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || phālgunāmalapakṣānte rājā svapne purūravāḥ || tasyaiva devadevasya śuśrāva gaditaṃ śubham ||1|| rātryāmasyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ mantriṇā tvaṃ sameṣyasi|| tena rājansamāgamya kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi || 2|| svapnamevaṃ sa rājarṣirdṛṣṭvā vipulavikramaḥ || pratyūṣakāle vidhivatsnātaḥ prāgvadatandritaḥ || 3 || kṛtakṛtyo yathākāmaṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam || svapnaṃ taddevadevasya nyavedayata dhārmikaḥ || 4 || tataḥ śuśrāva vacanaṃ devatārcāsamīritam || evametanmahīpāla nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |||| 5 || evaṃ prasādaṃ saṃprāpya devadevājjanārdanāt || kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mene sa narapuṅgavaḥ || 6 || kṛtadevārcano rājā tadā hutahutāśanaḥ || jagāda suhṛdāṃ teṣāṃ prasādaṃ madhusūdanāt || 7 || tamūcuśca tadā sarve rājānamaparājitam || vidadhātu prasannaste devadevo janārdanaḥ || 8 || aprasanne jagannāthe deśe'sminnṛpa kasyacit || na gatirvidyate rājaṃstvaṃ ca deśamihāgataḥ || 9 || sukhaṃ prāpnuhi bhadrante bhūya eva hitepsitān || sa sādayitvā te kāmāndevaḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ || 1.154.10 || evamuktvā narendraṃ taṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || jagmuḥ krīḍāvihārārthaṃ yathāpūrvamarindama || 11 || athājagāma taṃ deśaṃ brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ || trijagadyaśasāṃ sthānamatriḥ suragaṇārcitaḥ || 12|| tamāgataṃ munivaraṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā purūravāḥ || pādyārghyācamanīyādyairāsanenābhyapūjayat || 13 || sampūjya ca mahābhāgamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || 14 || yatte devagaṇairvandyau vanditau caraṇau mayā || śreyaḥ prasūtivṛkṣasya prarohastava darśanama || 15 || sarvapāpāntakaraṇaṃ sarvakalyāṇakāraṇam || kiṃ vā na labhyamastīha teṣāṃ dvijavarottama || 16 || amoghadarśane dṛṣṭe bhavatyamitatejasi || evamuktastadā rājñā saṃprasanno jagāda tam || 17 || śṛṇu rājanvaco mahyaṃ yatte vakṣyāmi suvrata || devadevasamādeśāddattaṃ te darśanaṃ mayā || 18 || suprasanno hi bhagavāndevaste madhusūdanaḥ || dvādaśīṣu sadā rājansopavāsena nityaśa || 19|| pūjito bhagavānviṣṇusttvayātīte tu janmani || rājasena tu bhāvena tvayā devaḥ samarcitaḥ || 1.154.20 || avaraṃ kāmamāśritya rājannihatakaṇṭakam || sāttvikena tu bhāvena pūjayitvā janārdanama || 21 || rājyaṃ madreṣu saṃprāptaṃ nipkaṇṭakamarindama || dvādaśyarcāprasannena devadevena cakriṇā || 22 || pradarśitamidaṃ sthānaṃ madīyaṃ svargasannibham || iha rājam̐stapastaptvā devadevaṃ janārdanam ||23|| ārādhya dṛṣṭavānasmi purā vararṣagaṇānbahūn || prāpyānujñāṃ hṛṣīkeṣāttatkṛte vivare śubhe ||24|| nityaṃ sannihitā rājaṃstasyaivārcā vinirmitā || niyogāddevadevasya pūjyate siddhamattamaiḥ || 25 || neyaṃ dṛṣṭā manuṣyendra manuṣyairna ca rākṣasaiḥ || piśitāśaistathaivānyairdṛṣṭapūrvā kathañcana || 26 || asminsvargopame deśe tvayā laulyena karmaṇā| ārādhito jagannātho devaścakragadādharaḥ||27|| āsannaphalamūle'pi bahugorasasaṃyute|| kṣaudrayuktaśilāprāye samākṣikaphalairyute||28|| kevalāmbhośinā taptaṃ yattvayā paramaṃ tapaḥ|| tena te'haṃ varaṃ dadmi yadabhīṣṭaṃ tavānagha||29|| acireṇaiva kālena tvayā rājankṛtaṃ tapaḥ|| rūpārthaṃ rūpalābhāya prāptaṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu||1.154.30|| tadvrataṃ ye kariṣyanti manujeśvara mānavāḥ|| striyo vāpi naraśreṣṭha prāpsyante rūpamuttamam||31|| saubhāgyamatulaṃ loke lāvaṇyamapi cottamam|| dharmiṣṭatāṃ tathārogyaṃ kule janma tathottame||32|| janmāntaramathāsādya svargalokaṃ tathāvidham|| svargalokātparibhraṣṭā mānuṣye guṇasaṃyutāḥ||33|| brāhmaṇā dhanasampannā bhaviṣyantyathavā nṛpāḥ|| janmāntaramathāsādya sarvesyaiva phalapradāḥ||34|| rūpavaṃto mahārāja ihāmutra ca te'naghāḥ|| yasmāttvayā tapastaptaṃ keśavaścātha pūjitaḥ||35|| mayā samāgataścāpi gaṃdharvaiśca sahasraśaḥ|| ihaiva kṛtvā dharmajña rūpasatraṃ mahāphalam|| divyarūpadharo bhūtvā svarāṣṭraṃ gantumarhasi||36|| etāvaduktaḥ sa tu madranātho mahātmanā tena narendrasiṃha|| papraccha taṃ dharmabhṛtāmvariṣṭhaḥ satrasya tasyānuśayaṃ vidhānam||37|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde purūravaso'tridarśanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||154|| <1.155> purūravā uvāca|| śrotumicchāmi bhagavanrūpasatraṃ mahāphalam|| yatsamāptau bhaviṣyāmi divyarūpadharo mune||1|| atriruvāca || tatsatraṃ kartukāmena cānveṣyo brāhmaṇo guruḥ || jyotiṣaṃ yo vijānāti itihāsāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||2 || tatpradiṣṭena vidhinā pādarkṣātprabhṛti kramāt || upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ pratyekaṃ tannibodha me || 3 || phālgunyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī tu yā || samūlāṃ tāṃ tu samprāpya vrataṃ gṛhṇīta mānavaḥ || 4 || upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ nakṣatrasya ca daivatam | varuṇaṃ ca tathā candraṃ pūjayedvidhinā naraḥ || 5 || pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ janārdanam || upoṣya saṅgaṃ devasya prayatnena ca pūjayet || 6 || tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tathā gurum || upavāsastu kartavyo dvitīye'hani pārthiva || 7 || upoṣya ṛkṣe vigate snātvā sampūjya keśavam || kṛtvāgnihavanaṃ śaktyā pūjayitvā dvijottamān || 8 || haviṣyamannaṃ bhoktavyaṃ śṛṇu cāṅgakramaṃ mama || pādayoḥ kathitaṃ mūlaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu jaṅghayoḥ || 9 || āśvinaṃ jānuyugalaṃ coruyugmaṃ ca pārthiva || sahite dve tathāṣāḍhe guhye ca sahite smṛte || 1.155.10 || pūrvottare ca phālgunyau kṛttikāsu kaṭirbhavet || pārśvayoḥ kukṣiyutayornakṣatratritayaṃ matam || 11 || ubhe proṣṭhapade rājanrevatī ca tathā bhaveta || uro'nurādhāsu tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ niṣṭyāsu kīrtitam || 12 || bhujau jñeyau viśākhāsu haste proktau tathā karau || aṅgulyaśca tathā proktā rājasiṃha punarvasau || 13 || āśleṣāyāṃ tathā proktā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ nṛpa kandharā || śravaṇau śravaṇau jñeye mukhaṃ puṣye prakīrtitam || 14 || dantāḥ svātau śatabhiṣā hanū proktau tathā nṛpa || maghāyāṃ nāsikā proktā mṛgaśīrṣe ca locane || 15 || citrā lalāṭe vijñeyā bharaṇyaśca tathā śiraḥ || śiroruhāstathārdrāsu batasyānte narādhipa || 16 || māghaśuklāvasāne tu satraṃ parisamāpyate || yadyantarāyaṃ na bhavetkiñcicchaucanimittajam || 17 || antarāyaṃ mahārāja yadi śaucanimittajam || upoṣyamevopavasennakṣatramaparaṃ punaḥ || 18 || kramaprāptaṃ hi nakṣatraṃ cāśuddhyāmapavarjitam || ullaṅghayanmahīpāla pratyavāyaṃ samaśnute |||39||| aṅgakrameṇa sakalamṛkṣavargamupoṣitaḥ|| vratānte prayataḥ snātvā pūjayenmadhusūdanam || 1.155.20 || candanāgurukarpūramṛgadarpaiḥ sakuṅkumaiḥ || jātīphalaiḥ sakaṃkolairlavaṅgakusumaistathā || 21 || bolaguggulaniryāsaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ || dhūpo narendrāguruṇā candanena sugandhinā || 22 || dīpāśca deyā rājendra tilatailaprapūritāḥ || dīpeṣu vartayaḥ kāryyā mahārañjanarañjitāḥ || 23 || naivedyaṃ ca tathā kāryaṃ paramānnena bhūriṇā || dadhnā kṣīrāmṛtābhyāṃ ca madhunā ca guḍena ca || 24 || sitayā ca tathā bhakṣyaiḥ phalamūlairyathāvidhi|| apūpaiḥ pānakairhṛdyaiḥ śītalaiśca sugandhibhiḥ || 25 || lavaṇasya ca pātrāṇi kṛsaraṃ ca nivedayet || sarvabījāni rājendra bhūṣaṇāni ca śaktitaḥ || 26 || mahārhāṇi ca vastrāṇi bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ || tadviṣṇoḥ pagmamiti homaḥ kāryo hyanantaram || 27 || dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ strīśūdreṣu vidhīyate || ghṛtaṃ mākṣikasaṃyuktaṃ juhuyātttilataṇḍusam || 28 || tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā gurave nṛpasattama || nāgāśca madamattā vai grāmāśca vividhāstathā || 29 || turagāśca tathā mukhyā ratnāni vividhāni ca || brāhmaṇaśca pitā jñeyo rūpasatrapradarśakaḥ || 1.155.30 || rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyajanmabhogapradāyakaḥ || rājyasya vā dvijatvasya bahuvittasya dāyakaḥ |||| 31 || na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā gantuṃ dānena bhūriṇā || guruprasāda evātra dakṣiṇānāṃ tu kāraṇam || 32 || tasmātprasādamākāṅkṣedrūpasatra pradarśakāta || avaśyaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ tu bhājanam || 33 || catuṣpalaṃ tu kāṃsyasya suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasya ca || tataḥ paraṃ bhojanīyāḥ svaśaktyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ ||34|| lavaṇakṣīramadhvājyaguḍabhakṣyasitotkaṭam || bhojanaṃ pānakopetaṃ paścāddeyā ca dakṣiṇā || 35 || vastrayugmaṃ pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya navaṃ śubham || brāhmaṇāya ca dātavyaṃ mahārājatarañjitam || 36 || saptabījāni deyāni lavaṇaṃ rūpyameva ca || yaccānyadapyabhīṣṭaṃ syācchatropānatkameva ca || 37 || vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ satradāne mahīpate || avaśyadeyaṃ satre'sminghṛtapūrṇaṃ ca bhājanam || 38 || catuṣpalaṃ tu kāṃsyasya suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasya ca || vratenānena cīrṇena dehatyāge dinaṃ gataḥ ||39|| tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ mānuṣye yadi jāyate || rājā bhavati dharmātmā brāhmaṇo vā dhanānvitaḥ || 1.155.40 || kule mahati sambhūto rūpeṇā'pratimo bhuvi || ārogyaṃ mahadāpnoti saubhāgyamapi cottamam || 41 || lāvaṇyaṃ buddhi medhe ca matiṃ dharme ca śāśvatīm || sampūrṇacandrapratimaḥ sarvasattvavaśaṅkaraḥ || 42 || naro bhavati rājendra nārī cāpsarasopamā || subhagā darśanīyā ca lāvaṇyaguṇasaṃyutā || 43 || bahudhānyā bahudhanā bahubhūpaṇasaṃyutā || bhartuścātyantadayitā loke khyātā ca sadguṇaiḥ || nityārogyavatī śāntā sarvadoṣavivarjitā ||44|| candrānanā nīlasarojanetrā trailokyakāntā pativallabhā ca ||45|| bhavatyavaśyaṃ subhagā sunīlā lāvaṇyayuktā yaśasā śriyā ca || 46 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rūpasatravarṇanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 155 || <1.156> || purūravā uvāca || bhagavansarvadharmajña pitāmaha mahādyute || gurutvaṃ me vrate tasminkartumarhasi mānada || 1 || vratāvasāne ca tathā sāmagryaṃ dvijapuṅgava || evaṃ śakyosmyaraṇyesminkartuṃ brahmanmahadvratam || 2 || atriruvāca || tava prasādaṃ bhagavānsarvātmā madhusūdanaḥ || kurute'haṃ kariṣyāmi gurutvamaparājitaḥ || 3 || vratāvasāne ca tathā sāmagryaṃ dvijapuṅgavaiḥ || kāmāssannihitāścānyairdeśe'sminnṛpa sarvadā || 4 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā sa dharmātmā saptame ca dine tadā || jyeṣṭhāyāṃ saptamīyoge grāhayāmāsa taṃ vratam || 5 || pādarkṣāttu prabhṛtyevamṛkṣeṛkṣe narādhipaḥ || kārayāmāsa devasya kathitāṅgādipūjanam || 6 || snānaṃ nakṣatranirdiṣṭaṃ nakṣatrasya ca pūjanam || nakṣatradaivatasyāpi somasya varuṇasya ca || 7 || pūjanaṃ ca tathā viṣṇordevadevasya cakriṇaḥ || homaṃ tathaiva sarveṣāṃ yathāvanmanujeśvara || 8 || māghaśuklamaghāṃ prāpya dvādaśīṃ ca tathā tithim || atrirvratāvasāne tamāgato brāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 9 || vratāvasāne saṃpūjya kethavāṅgārcisomajāna || rājyaṃ nivedayāmāsa so'treḥ sakalameva hi || 1.156.10 || pratigṛhya ca tadrājyaṃ tasmādvai mantravinnṛpa || bhūyaḥ prādātsa tasyaiva vacanañcedamabravīt || 11 || na me rājyena kartavyaṃ kiñcidevāsti pārthiva || na dhanena na kāmena yājitā dhruvayājñiyāḥ || 12 || samatvaṃ rājaśārdūla svasti gaccha gṛhānprati || evamuktvā yayāvatrirantardhānamatheśvaraḥ || 13 || sarvairdvijagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tadā gatvā sa pārthivaḥ || devapuṣkāraṇītoye snātamātro babhūva ha || 14 || taptajāmbūnadākāro nīlakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ || pṛthuvakṣā mahābāhustanukukṣirmahākaṭiḥ || 15 || gandharvarājapratimaḥ sarvasattvavaśaṅkaraḥ || rūpaṃ tu tādṛśaṃ tasya dṛṣṭvā gandharvasattamāḥ || 16 || tathaivāpsaraso mukhyā diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti te'buvan || sabhājya pārthivaṃ tena pūjitāḥ prayayuḥ sukham || 17 || nītvā saṃvatsaraṃ tatra pūrṇe saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpaḥ || devatāṃścāpyathāmantrya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 18 || tathā puṣkariṇīṃ puṇyāṃ guhāṃ padmasarastathā || āśramaṃ śailamukhyaṃ ca tathaiva ca vanaspatim || 19 || gandharvāpsarasaścaiva prayayau svapuraṃ tataḥ || uccasaṅgamasamprāptā dṛṣṭo vaiṣayikaistataḥ || 1.156.20 || stuto devaprasādācca bhaktyā taiścābhinanditaḥ || sattvaraiśca tathā kaiścidamātyānāṃ niveditaḥ || 21 || amātyāścāgataṃ śrutvā labdhakāmaṃ narādhipam || niryayurnagarāttasmāccaturaṅgabalānvitāḥ ||22|| rājñaḥ pratigrahārthaṃ te gaṇamukhyapuraḥsarāḥ || taiḥ sametya sa rājarṣiryathāvanmanujeśvara ||23|| kalpitena gajendreṇa patākādhvajaśobhinā || praviveśa puraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ śākalaṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 24 || rājñaḥ praveśe tatpauraiḥ sitacandanavāriṇā || bahuvarṇaistathā puṣpaiyathāsthāne vibhūṣitam || 25|| candanāgurusārāṇāṃ dhūpanaiḥ surabhīkṛtam || mahocchritapatākāḍhyaṃ mālyadāmapariṣkṛtam|| 26 || mālyamodakahastaiśca paurajānapadairyutam || atīva janasaṃbādhamatīva sumanoharam || 27 || prāsādavarasaṃsthāśca gavākṣakagatāstathā || vedikāsthāśca paśyanti striyastaṃ manmathārditāḥ || 28 || sa muṣṇanyoṣitāṃ cittaṃ dṛśaśca manujādhipaḥ || lājācandanacūrṇaiśca kīryamāṇaḥ samantataḥ || 29 || puṣpaiśca strīkaronmuktaiḥ pūryamāṇo narādhipaḥ || abhigamya ca tatrāsau devatāyatanāṃstataḥ || 1.156.30 || praviveśa gṛhaṃ śrīmacchāradābhracayopamam || tatrābhigamanaṃ kṛtvā devatānāṃ yathāvidhi || 31 || saṃpūjya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā vividhairdhanasañcayaiḥ || sabhāsthaṃ sāntvayāmāsa paurajānapadaṃ janam || 32 || āśvāsya preṣayāmāsa gṛhānyodhajanaṃ tathā || janānurāgasaṃyuktastataḥ prabhṛti pārthivaḥ || 33 || rājaśāstropadeśena pālayāmāsa medinīm || reme ca saha rāmābhirgandharvapratimo yuvā || 34 || sa tu kālena mahatā rājā pañcatvamāgataḥ || uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surottamaiḥ || 35 || manvantare hyatīte tu cākṣuṣasya mahātmanaḥ || vaivasvate'tha samprāpte budhaputratvamāgataḥ || 36 || tatra tasya tu yadrūpaṃ saubhāgyādeva viśrutam || saśarīrasya ca tathā svarloke gamanaṃ nṛpa || 37 || svargato'pi sa rājarṣiḥ kṣīṇe vaivasvate'ntare || praviśyātipuraṃ viṣṇoścandramaṇḍalamadhyagam || 38 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ karmaṇā yena pārthivaḥ || avāpa tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyamapi cottamam || 39 || pūjayanti hariṃ devaṃ sāttvikāstu nirāśiṣaḥ || rājasāḥ kāmakāmāśca krūrakāmāśca tāmasāḥ || 1.156.40 || hariṃ sampūjya manasā rājasena purūravāḥ || saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau || 41 || svargaṃ sudurlabhaṃ prāpya sthānaṃ prāpsyati śāśvatam || nāsti viṣṇusamo nātho nāsti viṣṇusamā gatiḥ || 42 || nāsti viṣṇusamaṃ trāṇaṃ narasyārtasya bheṣajam || satkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ devasya cakriṇaḥ || 43 || ārātrikaṃ kṛtaṃ tena saṃprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam || yena saṃkīrtitaṃ rājanharirityakṣaradvayam || 44 || baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gaganaṃ prati || etatte budhaputrasya triṣu janmasu pārthiva || caritaṃ sakalaṃ proktaṃ yena sampūjito hariḥ || 45 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ca saubhāgyadaṃ puṣṭivivardhanaṃ ca || śrotavyametanniyataṃ ca sadbhirākhyānamūrjaskaramṛddhikāmaiḥ || 46 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasamvāde purūravasassvapuragamanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||156 || <1.157> || vajra uvāca || dvādaśīṣu kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sopavāsena pūjitaḥ || rājyapradaḥ syāddharmajña tanme tvaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ || 1 || paśya rājyasya māhātmyaṃ yatra dharmasakhāvubhau || śṛṇu tasya ca dharmasya phalabhāgdhārmiko nṛpaḥ || 2 || brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ || rājñā saṃrakṣitāḥ sarve śakyā dharmaṃ niṣevitum || 3 || mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa rājā devavapurdharaḥ || kṣattriyo'pi sadā pūjyo brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām || 4 || vinā rājyaṃ hi yā lakṣmīḥ paratantrā hi sā matā || tasmādrājyaṃ praśaṃsanti tatrājñā na vihanyate || 9 || tulyadhātuśarīrāṇāṃ tulyāvayavajīvinām || narendrāṇāṃ narairbrahmandevavadbhuvi manyate || 6 || rājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ tasmādvaktumarhati me bhavān || yāmupoṣya mahadrājyaṃ prāpnuyātsa tu vai dvijaḥ || 7 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanrājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ śubhām || yāmupoṣya naro loke rājyamāpnotyakaṇṭakam || 8 || mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣe narādhipa || daśamyāṃ prayataḥ kṛtvā snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam || 9 || upavāsasya saṃkalpaṃ śvobhūtasya tu kārayet || devāgāre kuśāstīrṇāmekavastrottaracchadām ||1.157.1 0|| adhyāsīta mahīṃ tatra tāṃ rātriṃ prayato nayet || dvitīye'hni tataḥ kuryādbahiḥ snānamatandritaḥ || 11 || pūjanaṃ devadevasya sarvaṃ śuklena kārayet || karpūraṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ mallikā śvetayūthikā ||12|| jātyā ca śuklā rājendra dhūpe karpūrameva ca || ghṛtena dīpā dātavyā śuklavartisamanvitā | || 13 || ghṛtaudanaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ paramānnaṃ tathaiva ca || ikṣumikṣuvikārāṃśca devadeve nivedayet || 14 || kālodbhavaṃ mūlaphalaṃ varṇaṃ tatra na cintayeta || yathālābhena taddeyaṃ śuklaṃ cetsyādviśeṣataḥ || 15 || havanaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ paramānnena pārthiva || tadviṣṇoḥ paraṃ ityevaṃ homamantro vidhīyate || 16 || dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ strīśūdrasya vidhīyate || tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā sampūjya ca dvijān || 17 || sitaraṃgena kartavyā bhūmiśobhā surālaye || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gīta nṛtyaṃ ca pārthiva || 18 || karmaṇā caiva devasya kartavyaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā || dvādaśyāṃ vidhinā'nena bhūyaḥ pūjyo janārdanaḥ ||| || 19 || rājaliṅgaṃ pradātavyamekaṃ viprāya dakṣiṇā || tatastu paścādbhoktavyaṃ haviṣyaṃ pārthivottama ||1.157.20|| ekādaśī yathā madhye snānayorantare nṛpa || kaṣṭaṃ maunaṃ tu kartavyaṃ japyaṃ kāryaṃ tu mānasam || 21 || dvādaśīṣveva śuklāsu sarvāsvevāviśeṣataḥ || vidhistavāyaṃ nirdiṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāsveva ca kārayet || 22 || viśeṣaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || raktavarṇena kartavyā devapūjā yathāvidhi || 23 || raktaṃ ca deyaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpagandhānulepanam || tilatailena dīpāśca mahārañjanarañjitāḥ || 24 || dīpeṣu vartayo deyā homaḥ kāryastathā tilaiḥ || bhūmiśobhā ca kartavyā raktairbhūpālavarṇakaiḥ || 25 || anena vidhinā kṛtvā rājansaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ || kārtikyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet || 26 || vratāvasāne tasyāṃ tu mahāvartiṃ tu dāpayet || vāsasā ca samagreṇa tulayā ca ghṛtasya vai || 27 || brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā dhenuḥ kāṃsyopadohanā || hemaśṛṅgrī raupyakhurā muktālāṃgūlabhūṣitā || 28 || vastrottarīyā dātavyā śaktyā draviṇasaṃyutā || saṃvatsareṇa rājā syānnaraḥ parvatagahvare || 29 || tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ pūrṇairjāyate saphalaṃ tataḥ || tathā dvādaśabhiḥ pūrṇe rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ || 1.157.30 || rājyapradā te'bhihitā mayaiṣā sudvādaśī pāpaharā variṣṭhā || upoṣya yāṃ bhūmitale narendro bhavatyajeyaśca raṇe'risaṃghaiḥ || 31 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rājyapradadvādaśīvidhirnāma saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 157 || || cha || <1.158> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣājjanādhipa || āra'bhyābhyarcayeddevaṃ dvādaśīṣu sadaiva tu || 1 || pakṣayorubhayornityaṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || phalaiḥ puṣpairyathākāmaṃ naivedyairhomakarmaṇā || 2 || pūjane brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śaktyā dānaṃ ca pārthiva || abhīṣṭanāmajapyena pūrṇātsaṃvansarānnaraḥ || 3 || tadevāpnoti rājendra yatra gatvā na śocati || akāmāḥ sāttvikā devaṃ pūjayanti janārdanam || 4 || tasmādakāmena narendracanda saṃpūjanīyo bhuvanasya goptā || tyaktvā vaṇijyaṃ naradeva loke deveśvaro viṣṇurupāsanīyaḥ || 5 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kāmadvādaśīvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭa pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 158 || || cha || <1.159> || vajra uvāca || || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi dvādaśīṣu pṛthakpṛthak || upoṣya ki phalaṃ loke śuklapakṣe vidhīyate || 1 || anekajanmasāhasrairyeṣāṃ pāpaṃ kṣaya gatam || akāmāste pravartante devadevārcane narāḥ || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya śuklapakṣe upoṣitaḥ || nāmnā keśavamabhyarcya vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 3 || nārāyaṇaṃ tathābhyarcya pauṣe māse jagatpatim || atyagniṣṭomamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 4 || māghe mādhavamabhyarcya dvādaśābdaphalaṃ labhet || govindaṃ phālgune māsi pūjayitvā mahī dhara || 5 || atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || caitre viṣṇumathābhyarcya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || 6 || dvādaśyāṃ māsi vaiśākhe sampūjya madhusūdanam || gosavasya tu yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam || 7 || jyeṣṭhe māse tathābhyarcya devadevaṃ trivikramam || puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ || 8 || āṣāḍhe vāmanaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā jagatpatim || kṣiprameva samāpnoti yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇakam || 9 || śrīdharaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi pūjayitvā maheśvaram || vaiṣṇavasya tu yajñasya phalaṃ vindatyasaṃśayam || 1.159.10 || māse bhādrapade devaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ samarcayan || aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet || 11 || āśvine māsi saṃprāpte padmanābhaṃ samarcayan || rājasūyamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 12 || dāmodaramathābhyarcya kārtike māsi yādava || sarvamedhamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati || 13 || māsoktena sadā nāmnā śuklapakṣe hyupoṣitaḥ || dvādaśīṣu sadā kuryājjapyahomānsamāhitaḥ || 14 || saṃvatsarānte dātavyaṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ca bhājanam || kāṃsyasya vainateyaṃ ca rukmapatraniveśitam || 15 || kramopavāsatastvete proktā yajñaphalā nṛpa || pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratametannarādhipa || 16 || svargalokamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet || devarāmāgaṇasthena vīṇāgurujanādinā || 17 || haṃsasārasayuktena vimānenārkavarcasā || kiṅkiṇīśataghoṣeṇa viharatyamaraprabhaḥ || 18 || yāvajjīvaṃ naraḥ kuryādvratametatsamāhitaḥ || śvetadvīpamavāpnoti yatra candraprabhā narāḥ || 19 || caturbhujā mahāsattvā nityatṛptāḥ sugandhinaḥ || aniṣyandā nirāhārāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ || 1.159.20 || tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ narendra bhittvārkabimbaṃ sahasā prayāti || sthānaṃ puro devavarasya viṣṇornityasya tasyānagha sarvagamya || 21 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śuklapakṣadvādaśīvidhirnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 159 || <1.160> vajra uvāca || kevalaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśīṣu janārdanam || kadāprabhṛti dharmajña vidhinā kena cārcayet || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || mārgyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ dvādaśī yā bhavennṛpa || tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyaṃ vratamevamupoṣitaḥ || 2 || dvādaśīṣu ca kṛṣṇāsu nāma kṛṣṇasya kīrtayet || tenaiva nāmnā kartavyau japahomau tathaiva ca || 3 || tilairnivedanaṃ kāryaṃ homaḥ kāryastathā tilaiḥ || pauṣyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet || 4 || tasyāṃ vratāvasāne tu tilāndadyāddvijātiṣu || suvarṇaṃ ca mahīpāla raktavastraṃ tathaiva ca || 5 || samvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ manujapuṅgava || tiryagyoniṃ na cāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati || 6 || yāvajjīvaṃ vratamidaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ || na sa dukhaṃ samāpnoti narakaṃ na narādhipa || 7 || yatra vaitaraṇī durgā kṣuradhārāśca parvatāḥ || pāpānāṃ yātanā yatra tatrāsau na gamiṣyati || 8 || yasyāṃ gaṇāḥ bhīmabalā mahogrā daṃṣṭrākarālā vikaṭograveṣāḥ || vidrāvaṇāḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇāṃ na yena tasyā nṛpa yanti mārgam || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde pratikṛṣṇapakṣadvādaśīvidhirnāma ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 160 || <1.161> vajra uvāca || upavāsāsamarthānāṃ śuklapakṣe dvijottama || ekā yā dvādaśī puṇyā tāṃ vadasva mamānagha ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā|| mahatī dvādaśī jñeyā upavāse mahāphalā || 2 || saṅgame saritoḥ puṇye dvādaśīṃ tāmupoṣitaḥ || ayatnādevamāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam || 3 || budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saiva ceddvādaśī bhavet || atyantamahatī yasyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtamathākṣayam || 4 || dvādaśī śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati pārthiva ||| saṅgame tu tadā snātvā sattīrthasnānajaṃ phalam ||5|| sopavāsaḥ samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || vāridhānīṃ tadā dattvā jalapūrṇāṃ dvijātaye ||6|| channāṃ vastrayutāṃ rājañchatropānahasaṃyutām || svargalokamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam || 7 || svargaṃ samāsādya ciraṃ ca bhogānbhuktvā mahendropama devatulyān || mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo dhanānvito dharmaparo manasvī ||8|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrāvaṇādvādaśīpraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||161|| <1.162> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || mahatyaraṇye yadvṛttaṃ bhūmipāla purātanam ||1|| deśā dāśerakā nāma teṣāṃ bhāge tu paścime || asti rājanmarurdeśaḥ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ ||2|| sutaptasikatā bhūmiryatra duṣṭa mahoragā || svalpacchāyāsamākīrṇā mṛtaprāṇisamākulā||3|| śamīkhadiraphullāsakarīrāḥ pailubhiḥ saha || tatra bhīmā drumagaṇāḥ kaṇṭakairāvṛtāḥ samam||4|| caṇḍaprāṇigaṇākīrṇā tatra bhūmistathā kvacit || atyantatāpaviṣamā nistṛṇā paruṣopalā || 5 || nāśrayastatra nāhāro jvalitāgnisame bhṛśam || tathāpi tatra jīvanti janāḥ karmanibandhanāt || 6 || nodakaṃ nodakadharā rājaṃstatra balāhakāḥ || kadācidapi dṛśyante deśe nirayasannibhe || 7 || tatra pakṣāntaragataistṛṣitaiḥ śiśubhiḥ saha || utkrāntajīvitā rājandṛśyante'tha vihaṅgamāḥ || 8 || utplutyotplutya sahasā mṛgāḥ saikatamālayāta || saikateṣveva naśyanti jale saikatasetuvat ||9|| tasmiṃstathāvidhe deśe kaściddaivavaśādvaṇik || vanamātapavibhraṣṭaḥ praviṣṭastu paribhraman ||1.162.10|| sa tatra dadṛśe pretānkṣuttṛṣṇāvyākulendriyān || utkacānmalinānrūkṣānnirmāṃsānbhīmadarśanān || 11 || snāyubaddhasthirākāyāndhāvamānānitasstaḥ || kañcitsamāṃsaṃ tatraikaṃ pretaskandhagataṃ tadā || 12 || dadarśa bahubhiḥ pretaiḥ samantātparivāritam || tatskandhādaparaṃ skaṃdhaṃ nīyamānaṃ kramātkamāt ||13|| preto'pi dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ghorāmaṭavīṃ naramāgatam || pretaskandhānmahīṃ gatvā tasyāntikamupāgamat || 14 || so'bhivādya vaṇikachreṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || asminghore mahāraṇye praveśo bhavataḥ katham || 15 || tamuvāca vaṇigdhīmānsārthabhraṣṭasya me vane || praveśo daivayogena pūrvakarmakṛtena tu || 16 || tṛṣṇā me bādhate'tyarthaṃ kṣutkṣāmaśca bhṛśaṃ tathā || prāṇāḥ kaṇṭhamanuprāptā vadanaṃ bhraśyate ca me || 17 || atropāyaṃ na paśyāmi dhriye'haṃ yena kena cit || ityevamuktaḥ pretastu vaṇijaṃ vākyamabravīt || 18 || punnāgamimamāśritya pratīkṣasva kṣaṇaṃ mama || kṛtātithyo mayā yāvadgamiṣyasi yathāsukham ||19 || evamuktastadā cakre sa vaṇiktṛṣṇayānvitaḥ || madhyāhnasamaye prāpte pretastaṃ deśamāgamat || 1.162.20 || punnāgavṛkṣācchītodāṃ vāridhānīṃ manoramām || dadhyodanasuyuktena vardhamānena saṃyutām || 21 || avatārya tatastvagraṃ pradadāti ca yattadā || tato'gramātreṇa vaṇikparāṃ tṛptimupāgataḥ || 22 || vitṛṣṇo vijvaraścaivaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata || tataḥ preteṣu sarveṣu kramādbhāgaṃ tadā dadau || 23 || dadhyodanātsapānīyātte'pi tṛptiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ || atha santarpayitvā tu pretāṃstānsa tu sarvaśaḥ || 24 || pretādhipaḥ sa bubhuje paścādannaṃ yathāsukham || tasya bhuktavatastvannaṃ pānīyaṃ ca kṣayaṃ yayau || 25 || pretādhipaṃ tatastṛptaṃ vaṇigvacanamabravīt || āścaryametatparamaṃ vane'sminpratibhāti me || 26 || annapānasya samprāptiḥ paramasya kutastava || stokena ca tathānnena bibharṣi ca bahūnkatham || 27 || tṛptā api kathaṃ sarve nirmāṃsā bhinnakukṣayaḥ || kaścittvamasyāṃ ghorāyāmaṭavyāṃ tu kṛtālayaḥ || 28 || etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || evamuktaḥ sa vaṇijā preto vacanamabravīt || 29 || vāṇijyasaktasya purā kālo 'tīto mamānagha || śākale nagare ramye nāstikasya durātmanaḥ || 1.162.30 || dhanalobhānmayā tatra na kadācidapi prabho || dattāsīdbhikṣave bhikṣā kṛpaṇena kathañcana || 31 || prātiveśyaśca tatrāsīdbrāhmaṇo guṇavānmama || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tadā || 32 || sa kadācinmayā sārdhaṃ tauṣīṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau|| tasyāśca saṅgamaḥ puṇyo yatrāsīccandrabhāgayā ||33|| candrabhāgāsaricchreṣṭhā yatra śītāmalodakā || mahādevajaṭājūṭe gaṅgā nipatitā purā ||34|| candreṇa bhāgato nyastā candrabhāgā smṛtā tataḥ || tatkālataptasalilā tauṣī tatrārkanandinī || 35 || śītoṣṇe codake tasminsaṃgame sumanohare|| taṃ sa deśaṃ samāsādya prātiveśyamasau dvijaḥ||36|| śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snānārcana upoṣitaḥ|| cāndrabhāgasya toyasya vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā ||37|| dadhyodanayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ sampūrṇairvardhamānakaiḥ || chatraiścopānahai ramyairvastraiśca vividhairyutā|38|| pradadau vipramukhyebhyo rahasyajño mahīpatiḥ|| cittasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya tasyāpi ca tadā mayā ||39|| sopavāsena dattaikā vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā|| cāndrabhāgasya toyasya dadhyodanayutā tadā||1.162.40|| gatvā gṛhamanuprāpya tataḥ kālena kenacit|| pañcatvamahamāsādya nāstikyātpretatāṃ gataḥ||41|| asyāmaṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ yo vā hyakuśalastadā || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge dattā yāsau mayānagha|| |42| dadhyodanayutā ramyā vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā|| seyaṃ madhyāhnasamaye divase divase mama||43|| upatiṣṭhetsadaiveha yathā dṛṣṭā tvayānagha || brahmasvahāriṇastvete pāpāḥ pretatvamāgatāḥ ||44|| paridāraratāḥ kecitsvāmidroharatā pare|| mitradroharatāḥ keciddeśe'sminbhṛśadāruṇe||45|| mamānuyānaṃ kurvanti annapāna kṛte'nagha || akṣayo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ||46|| tamuddiśya tu yaddattaṃ tadakṣayyaṃ prakīrtitam|| akṣayyena tathānnena tṛptā api hi mānada || 47 || pretabhāvena daurbalyaṃ na vimuñcanti karhicit || ahaṃ ca pūjayitvā tvāmatithiṃ samupasthitam || 48 || pretabhāvādvinirmukto yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim || mayā vihīnāḥ pretāstu vane'sminbhṛśadāruṇe || 49 || pīḍāmanubhaviṣyanti dāruṇāṃ karmayogajām|| eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga bhadanugrahakāmyayā || 1.162.50 || pratyekaṃ gotranāmāni gṛhṇīṣva likhitena ca || asti kakṣyāgataveṣā tava sā pustikā śubhā || 51 || himavantamathāsādya tatra tvaṃ lapsyase nidhim || gayāśīrṣe tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate ||52|| ekaikaṃ tvamathoddiśya pretaṃ pretaṃ yathāsukham || tatastu te vimokṣyanti preta bhāvamasaṃśayam || 53 || ityevaṃ sa vadanneva taptajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ || vimānavaramāsthāya svargalokaṃ tato gataḥ || 54 || svarcite pretanāthe tu pretānāṃ sa vaṇikkramāt || nāmagotrāṇi saṅgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himālayam || 55 || tatra prāpya nidhiṃ gatvā nikṣipya ca tathā gṛhe || dhanaṃ kiñcidupādāya gayāśīrṣaṃ tato yayau || 56 || pretānāṃ kramaśastatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dinedine || yasyayasya yadā śrāddhaṃ karoti sa mahānvaṇik || 57 || sasa tasya tadā svapne darśayatyātmanastanum || bravīti ca mahābhāga prasādena tavānagha || 58 || pretabhāvo mayā tyaktaḥ prāpto'smi tridivaṃ dhuvam || kṛtvā sa dhanadānena pretānāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ vaṇik || 59 || jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tadā || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam || 1.162.60 || dhanaṃ ca dattvā viprebhyaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || puṇyeṣu satataṃ rājannadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ||61|| gaṅgāsarayvorgaṅgāyāḥ śoṇasya ca mahāmatiḥ || ikṣumatyāśca gaṅgāyā gaṅgāyamunayostathā || 62 || gomatyāśca sarayvāśca kauśikīgaṇḍakyostathā || vipāśayā devahradā yatra yogaṃ prapadyate || 63 || vipāśā ca tathā yogaṃ yatra yāti śatadruṇā || irāvatī tathā yogaṃ yatra vrajati sindhunā || 64 || candrabhāgā ca vrajati yatra yogaṃ vitastayā || mahāsindhuśca saṃyogaṃ yatra yāti vitastayā || 65 || pratyabdaṃ yāvadeteṣu saṃgameṣu mahāvaṇik || karoti vidhivaddānaṃ yāvaddiṣṭāntamāgataḥ || 66 || avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ yattu jantubhiḥ || yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ || 67 || śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoharāḥ || suvarṇasikatā rājanmaṇisopānabhūṣitāḥ ||68|| ānantyāya sa saṃprāpto deśaṃ taṃ bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || taṃ deśamāsādya vaṇiṅmahātmā sutaptajāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgaḥ || kalpaṃ samagraṃ mudito yadātmā reme sa rāmābhiyutaḥ kṛtātmā || 69 || vimānairapsarobhiśca siddhagandharvasevitaḥ || viṣṇulokamavāpnoti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam||1.162.70|| rājasūyādibhiryajñairyatphalaṃ samavāpyate || śravaṇadvādaśīṃ kṛtvā tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ||71|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde piśācamokṣaṇe śravaṇadvādaśīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||162|| <1.163> vajra uvāca|| ekāmupoṣya kṛṣṇāṃ yāṃ dvādaśīṃ vidhinā naraḥ || mahatphalamavāpnoti tāṃ samācakṣva bhārgava ||1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pauṣyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā || dvādaśī yā bhavetkṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī || 2 || tilaiḥ snānaṃ tilairhomaṃ naivedyaṃ tilamodakaiḥ || dīpāśca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakam || 3 || tilāśca deyā viprebhyastasminnahani pārthiva || upavāsadine rājanhotavyāśca tathā tilāḥ || 4 || upoṣitenāpare'hni hotavyāśca viśeṣataḥ || indhanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastathā'nagha ||5|| tilaprasthaṃ tadā hutvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || na durgatimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||6 || tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || pauruṣaṃ ca tā sūktaṃ śrīsūktena ca saṃyutama||7|| homaḥ kāryo'tha rājendra sāvitryā ca yatātmanā || etatproktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ strīśūdreṣu tathā śṛṇu || 8 || dvādaśāṣṭākṣaro maṃtrasteṣāṃ prokto mahātmanām || hitau tau ca dvijātīnāṃ mantraśreṣṭhau narādhipa || 9 || tābhyāmabhyadhiko mantro vidyate neha kutracit || vajra uvāca || dvādaśāṣṭākṣarau mantrau kathayasva mamānagha || 1.163.10 || puṇyau pavitrau maṅgalyau sarvapāpapraṇāśanau || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya|| oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya || 11 || etau mayā te kathitau pavitrau mantrottamau pāpaharau vareṇyau || pārāyaṇau sarvatapasvināṃ ca rahasyabhūtau bhuvaneṣu nityam || 12 || yathā tithiste śravaṇena yuktā māghasya māsasya tathā tavoktā || kāryā tatheyaṃ nṛpate viśeṣādyoge pavitre saritordvayasya || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tiladvādaśīpraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭyadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 163 || <1.164> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || māgadheṣu tu yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa || 1 || babhūva māgadho rājā caṇḍavega iti śrutaḥ || tasyāsīdrūpasaṃpannā bhāryā nayanasundarī || 2 || sarvadharmānparityajya pratasaṃvatsaraṃ tu sā || tilānhomayate viprairjuhoti ca tathā svayam || 3 || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māghe māsi hutāśane || devasya caiva naivedyaṃ karoti tilamodakaiḥ || 4 || arcanena ca vāsobhiḥ pūjayatyapi mādhavam || mahārañjitaraktāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || 5 || brāhmaṇīnāṃ ca geheṣu visarjayati tatparā || mahāvartipradānaṃ ca vidhatte keśavālaye || 6 || tāṃ kadācitsukhāsīnāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ tu vasantikā || papraccha sakhibhāvena rahasyaṃ nirjane sthitā || 7 || vasantikovāca || sarvadharmānparityajya māghe māsi śubhānane || dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya kasmādarcayase harim || 8 || kasmāttathā bahutilaṃ hāvayasyanale tathā || etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi rahasyaṃ cenna te śubhe || 9 || nayanasundaryuvāca || rahasyametatparamaṃ na rahasyaṃ tathā tvayi || tvaṃ me sakhīśvarī prāṇastvaṃ me prāṇadhaneśvarī || 1.164.10 || asti vaitastiko nāma deśaḥ paramadhāmikaḥ || tatra grāmavaraṃ cāsīdvasatirme suśobhanā || 11 || caṇḍavegaśca vipro'bhūdbhartā me pūrvajanmani || nāstiko niranukrośastarkaśāstrarataḥ sadā ||12|| tatraiva viṣaye rājā babhūva dadhivāhanaḥ || tasya bhāryāṃ vayasyā me babhūva kamalā śubhā || 13 || sā kadācinmāmuvāca rahasyaṃ varavarṇinī || nārī bhartṛkṛtādardhaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti sundarī || 14 || nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthagyajño na vrataṃ nāpyupoṣitam || patiṃ śuśrūṣate yā tu tena svarge mahīyate || 15 || kartavyaṃ yoṣitā puṇyaṃ pṛthagvāpi tadicchayā || patiste nāstiko bhadre kiñcinnācarate śubham || 16 || na cācarasi dharmaṃ tvaṃ tathā ca tadanujñayā || kā gatiḥ paraloke te bhaviṣyati śubhānane ||17|| iha yatkriyate karma pretya tatropabhujyate || yenoptaṃ phalakāle tu sa evāśnāti bhāmini || 18 || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya vidyutsampātacañcalam || nācaranti śubhaṃ ye tu teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam || 19 || kadācidapi vāmoru yoniṣvatha paribhraman || mānuṣyaṃ nāma jāyeta yatrāyattaṃ śubhāśubham || || 1.164.20 | caṇḍālatve'pi mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā sakhi durlabham || ātmā śakyastayā trātuṃ mānuṣyānnānyataḥ śubhe || 21 || tavopari tathā jātā sakhī bhāvena me kṛpā || kadaryyasyāsya bhāryā tvaṃ susvabhāvā pativratā || 22 || tatra te'nugrahaṃ kiñcitkariṣyāmi nibodha tat || harasya dayitā bhāryā śailendratanayā umā || 23 || vistāritamahākūlā sā vitastā mahānadī || avṛttikarṣitaḥ pāpaṃ kṛtvaiva ṛtupañcakam || 24 || snānenaikena sakalaṃ śaiśireṇa vyapohati || yasyāṃ yasyāṃ tithau snātaḥ svargamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 25 || tasyāṃ samvatsaraṃ snātvā mokṣopāyaṃ tu vindati || yā ca susvādusalilā yā ca pāpakṣayaṅkarī || 26 || tasyāstīre mayā nityaṃ prati samvatsaraṃ śubhe || upoṣya māghakṛṣṇasya dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe tathā || 27 || pūjito bhagavānviṣṇurbrāhmaṇāśca hutāśanaḥ || tilaistasmāttu te khyātaṃ brāhmametadvrataṃ mama ||28 || tasmātskannaṃ tilaṃ yacca yadagnau patitaṃ na ca || tataḥ puṇyaphalaṃ sarvaṃ tvamāpnuhi varānane || 29 || ityevamuktayā gatvā bhartā pṛṣṭastadā mayā || hasatā tena cāsmyuktā gaccha gṛhṇīṣva tatphalam || 1.164.30 || svayaṃ kṛtvā śubhaṃ karma kamalā sā sakhī mama || saha bhartrā viśālākṣi viṣṇulokamito gatā || 31 || tallokamakṣayaṃ tasyāḥ śrutaṃ vaivasvatānmayā || tasmāddṛṣṭaphalaṃ bhadre karomi tiladvādaśīm || 32 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchasi sundari || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ brāhmaṇyapi vasantikā || 33 || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayāmāsa keśavam || māghakṛṣṇe mahābhāga tilairnityamatandritā || 34 || pūjayitvāpi sā devaṃ śvetadvīpamito gatā || sāpi rājño mahābhāgā tathā nayanasundarī || 35 || amalaṃ sthānamāsādya virarāja śaśiprabhā || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tadā pūjyo janārdanaḥ || 36 || tilairnityaṃ mahābhāga hotavyāśca tathā tilāḥ || tilāśca deyā viprebhyastasminnahani pārthiva || 37 | ekaikasmāttilādrājaṃstilabījodbhave yathā || sukṛṣṭakṣetrajāddṛṣṭaṃ deve kālapravarṣiṇi || 38 || ekaikasmāttilāttadvatphalamakṣayyamaśnute || svarloke viṣṇuloke vā mānuṣye yadi vā nṛpa || akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti ekaikasmāttilāttilāt || 39 || tasmātprayatnena narendracandra tasyā samabhyarcaya vāsudevam || upoṣitaḥ prītamanā yathāvattrāṇaṃ sa devaḥ prathito narāṇām || 1.164.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde caṇḍavegopākhyāne tiladvāda śīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 164 || <1.165> || vajra uvāca || hotavye viṣṇudaivatye sāvitrī me tvayoditā || homakarmaṇi sandeho mahānme bhṛgunandana || 1 || savitā daivataṃ tasyāḥ sāvitrītyucyate tataḥ || tayā kathaṃ tu kartavyaṃ homakarma ca vaiṣṇavam || 2 || prabhāvamārṣeśca tathā tasyāstvaṃ mama kīrtaya || vedamātā tu sā proktā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||3|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ravimadhye sthitaḥ somaḥ somamadhye hutāśanaḥ || tejomadhye sthitaṃ sattvaṃ sattvamadhye sthito'cyutaḥ || 4 || aṃguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvameva mayeritaḥ || śaṅkareṇa tadā dṛṣṭaḥ prabhavaḥ sarvatejasām || 5 || sa viṣṇurbhuvanādhāro yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || vareṇyaṃ tacca saviturbhargavācyaṃ tu yoginām ||6|| yeyaṃ paraṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ bahirantaśca yādava || dhīśabdavācyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pracodayati yaḥ sadā || 7 || sṛṣṭyarthaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ savitā sa prakīrtitaḥ || sarvalokaprasavanātsavitā sa tu kīrtyate || 8 || yatastaddevadevatyā sāvitrītyucyate tataḥ || gānādvā trāyate yasmādgāyatrī vā tadā smṛtā || 9 || etasmātkāraṇādrājansāvitrī kīrtitā mayā || tava dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha nityaṃ vaiṣṇavakarmasu || 1.165.10 || savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha || ye japanti sadā teṣāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 11 || daśakṛtvā prajaptā sā rātryahnā yatkṛtaṃ laghu || tatpāpaṃ praṇudatyāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 12 || śataṃ japtā tu sā devī pāpopaśamanā smṛtā || sahasrajaptā sā devī copapātakanāśinī || 13 || lakṣajāpena ca tathā mahāpātakanāśinī || 13 || koṭijāpyena rājendra yadicchati tadāpnuyāt || 14 || vidyādharatvaṃ yakṣatvaṃ gandharvatvamathāpi vā || devatvamathavā rājyaṃ bhūrloke hatakaṇṭakam || 15 || koṭisāhasrajāpyena niṣkāmaḥ puruṣottama || vidhinā rājaśārdūla prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 16 || yathā kathañcijjaptaiṣā devī paramapāvanī || sarvakāmapradā proktā vidhinā kimpunarnṛpa || 17 ||| || vajra uvāca || vidhinā kena japtavyā gāyatrī pāpanāśinī || mahāpavitrā paramā sarvakalyāṇakāritā| || 18 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kuśaśayyāṃ niviṣṭastu kuśapāṇi jitendriyaḥ || arkamadhyagataṃ dhyāyetpuruṣaṃ taṃ mahādyutim || 19 || athavārkaṃ mahīpāla bahiḥ snātastvatandritaḥ || ananyacitto medhāvī pūrvāhne tu viśeṣataḥ || 1.165.20 || bhaikṣyayāvakaśākāśī payomūlāśano'thavā || phalapuṣpāśano vāpi naktaṃ vāpi haviṣyabhuk || 21 || anena vidhinā japyaṃ yaḥ karoti mahīpate || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān || 22 || akāmaḥ kāmakāmastu kāmamāpnotyabhīpsitam || savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa || 23 || api bhrūṇahaṇaṃ māsātpunantyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ || savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha || 24 || triḥ paṭhedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kāryaṃ kalyamutthāya vai dvijaḥ || 25 || ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttakṣaṇādeva mucyate || sarvadoṣaharaṃ proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ dvijanmanām || 26 || tatastvabhyadhikaṃ nāsti rājanparamapāvanam || prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ māsaṃ kuśāgracyutabindunā || 27 || yaḥ kuryādambhasāṃ pānaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tu tatsamam || nirodhājjāyate vāyustasmādagnistato jalam || 28 || tribhiḥ śarīraṃ sakalaṃ prāṇāyāmaiśca śudhyati || ākeśāgrānnakhāgrācca tapastapyetsa uttamam || 29 || ātmānaṃ śodhayedyastu prāṇāyāmaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || 1.165.30 || prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || antarjale trirāvartya gāyatrīṃ prayato japan || 31 || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairyadi na brahmahā bhavet || nāsti satyātparo dharmo nāsti kṛṣṇasamā gatiḥ || 32 || gāyatryāśca paraṃ nāsti divi ceha ca pāvanam || hutā ca varadā devī sarvakāmaphalapradā || 33 || gāyatryāḥ sutilairhomaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryādāyuṣkāmo ghṛtena ca || 34 || karmaṇāṃ siddhikāmastu kuryātsiddhārthakairnaraḥ|| brahmavarcasakāmastu payasā sa samācaret || 35 || putrakāmastathā dadhnā dhānyakāmastu śālibhiḥ || kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca grahapīḍāpraśāntaye || 36 || dhanakāmastathā bilvaiḥ śrīkāmaḥ kamalaistathā || ārogyakāmaḥ kṣīrāktaiḥ kuryāddūrvāṅkuraiḥ śubhaiḥ || 37 || deśopasarge saṃprāpte tadeva ca vidhīyate || guggulorgulikābhistu kṛtvā homamatandritaḥ || 38 || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || pāyasena tathā hutvā vidyāṃ samadhigacchati || yenayena tu kāmena lakṣahomaṃ samācaret || 39 || tadeva kāmamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || kṛcchreṇa śuddhimutpādya prāṇāyāmaśatena ca || 1.165.40 || antarjalena vā japtvā snāto nityamatandritaḥ || prāṇāyāmāṃstataḥ kṛtvā vidhinaiva sa ṣoḍaśa || 41 || pūrvāhṇe juhuyādvahnau susamiddhe yathāvidhi || bhaikṣyayāvakaśākāśī phalamūlāśano'thavā || || 42 || kṣīrasaktūghṛtāhārī bhavedatha vicakṣaṇaḥ || āhārāṇāṃ yathoktānāmekāhāraṃ samāśrayet || 43 || yāvatsamāptirbhavati lakṣahomasya pārthiva || lakṣahomāvasāne tu brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dakṣiṇā || 44 || deyā bhavati rājendra gāvo vastrāṇi kāñcanam || sarvotpātasamutpattau brāhmaṇairanupūjitaiḥ || 45|| pañcabhirdaśabhirvāpi lakṣahomaṃ samācaret || asaṅkīrṇaistathā hārairnṛpatistatpraśāntaye || 46 || nāsti loke sa utpāto yo hyanena na śāmyati || maṅgalaṃ paramaṃ nāsti yattasmādatiricyate || 47 || koṭihomaṃ tu yo rājā kārayetpūrvavaddvijaiḥ || na tasya śatravaḥ saṅkhye jātu tiṣṭhanti karhicit || 48 || na tasya maraṇaṃ deśe na vyādhirjāyate tathā || ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirmūṣakāḥ śalabhāḥ śakāḥ || 49 || rākṣasāśca praśāmyanti sarvāstatra tathetayaḥ || rasavanti ca toyāni sasyāni svāduvanti ca || 1.165.50 || jāyante tasya deśe tu dharmiṣṭhaśca jano bhavet || koṭihome tu varayedbrāhmaṇānviṃśatīnnṛpa || 51 || śataṃ vātha sahasraṃ vā ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ || koṭihomaṃ svayaṃ yastu kuryādbrāhmaṇasattamaḥ || 52 || kṣatriyo vāthavā vaiśyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat || yadyadicchati kāmānāṃ tattadāpnotyasaṃśayam || 53 || saśarīro'pi cedgantuṃ divamicchettadāpnuyāt || sāvitrī paramā devī sāvitrī pāvanī param || 54 || sarvakāmapradā devī sāvitrī kathitā tathā || abhicāreṣu tāṃ devīṃ viparītāṃ prayojayet ||55 || kāryā vyāhṛtayaścātra viparītākṣarāstathā || viparītākṣaraṃ kāryaṃ śiraśca manujeśvara || 56 || ādau śiraḥ prayoktavyaṃ praṇavānte ca yādava || svāhāsthāne ca phaṭkāraṃ sādhyanāmasamanvitam || 57 || gāyatrīṃ cintayettatra dīptānalasamaprabhām || ghātayantī ca śūlena keśeṣvākṛṣya vairiṇam || 58 || nirdahantīṃ ca taṃ krodhādbhrukuṭībhīṣaṇānanām || uccāṭane ca tāṃ devīṃ vāyubhūtāṃ vicintayet || 59 || vahamānāṃ tathā sādhyaṃ tasmāddeśātsudūrataḥ || abhicāre ca hotavyā rājikā viṣamiśritāḥ ||1.165.60 || svaraktamiśraṃ hotavyaṃ kaṭutailamathāpi vā || tatrāpi ca viṣaṃ deyaṃ homakāle ca yatnataḥ||61 || madhye jahyādyadi krodhaṃ dhruvaṃ naśyetsa eva tu || anāgasi na kartavyamabhicāramato budhaiḥ || alpāgasi na kartavyamabhicāraṃ tathaiva tu || 62 || mahāparādhaṃ balinaṃ devabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakam || abhicāreṇa yo hanyānna sa doṣeṇa lipyate || 63 || dharmapradhāne tu nare alpāgasi tathaiva ca || abhicāraṃ na kurvīta bahūpāyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 64 || bahūnāṃ kaṇṭakaṃ yaṃ tu pāpātmānaṃ sudurmatim || hanyātprāptāparādhaṃ tu tasya puṇyaphalaṃ labhet || 65 || ye bhaktāḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam || na tānabhicarejjātu tatra tadviphalaṃ bhavet || 66 || na hi keśavabhaktānāmabhicāreṇa karhicit || vināśamabhipadyeta tasmāttatra samācaret || 67 || seyaṃ dhātrī vidhātrī ca sāvitryaghavināśinī || prāṇāyāmena japyeta tathaivāntarjalena ca || 68 || savyāhṛtīkapraṇavā japtavyā śirasā saha || praṇavena tathā'bhyastā vācyā vyāhṛtayaḥ pṛthak || 69 || daivataṃ savitā tvasyā gāyatraṃ chanda eva ca || viśvāmitra ṛṣiścaiva procyate vasudhādhipa || 1.165.70 || karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva pañca buddhīndriyāṇi ca || pañcendriyārthānmahatāṃ bhūtānāṃ caiva pañcakam || 71 || mano buddhistathaivātmā avyaktaṃ ca yadūttama || caturviṃśatyathaitāni gāyatryā akṣarāṇi tu || 72 || praṇavaṃ puruṣaṃ viddhi sarvagaṃ pañcaviṃśakam || saptalokāni yānīha mahāvyāhṛtayastathā || 73 || śirasaśca tathā vācyaḥ puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ || evaṃvidhā sā sāvitrī japtavyā satataṃ budhaiḥ || 74 || hotavyā ca tathā śaktyā sarvakāmasamṛddhidā || gāyatrīmātraśaraṇo varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ || 75 || nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī || gāyatrīṃ japate yastu kalyamutthāya vai dvijaḥ || 76 || lipyate na sa pāpebhyaḥ padmapatramivāmbhasā || kāmakāmo labhetkāmaṃ gatikāmastu sadgatim || akāmastadavāpnoti yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 77 || evaṃ prabhāvā varadā pavitrā gāyatryathoktā tava rājasiṃha || japanti ye tāṃ paramaṃ prayānti sthānaṃ parasyā'pratimasya puṃsaḥ || 78 || iti śrīviṣṇu dharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gāyatrīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 165 || || cha || <1.166> || vajra uvāca || mahāvartipradānasya yatphalaṃ bhṛgunandana || tanmamācakṣva tattvena vidhiṃ kālaṃ tathaiva ca || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || mahāvartiḥ sadā deyā bhūmipāla mahāphalā || kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa tatrāpi ca viśeṣataḥ || 2 || amāvāsyā ca nirdiṣṭā dvādaśī ca mahāphalā || āśvayujyāmatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya yā bhavet || 3 || amāvasyā tadā puṇyā dvādaśī vā viśeṣataḥ || devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve deyā tailatulā nṛpa || 4 || palāṣṭakayutāṃ rājanvartiṃ tatra tu dāpayet || mahārajanaraktena samagreṇa tu vāsasā || 5 || vāmapārśve ca devasya deyā ghṛtatulā nṛpa || palāṣṭakayutāṃ śuklāṃ vartiṃ tatra tu dāpayet || 6 || vāsasā tu samagreṇa sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || mahāvartidvayamidaṃ sakṛddattvā mahīpate || 7 || svarlokaṃ suciraṃ bhuktvā jāyate bhūtale yadā || tadā bhavati lakṣmīvānrūpasaubhāgyamāśritaḥ || 8 || rāṣṭre ca jāyate yasmindeśe ca nagare'thavā || kule ca rājaśārdūla tatra syāddīpavatprabhā || 9 || atyujjvalaśca bhavati yuddheṣu kalaheṣu ca || khyātiṃ yāti tathā loke sajjanānāṃ ca sadguṇaiḥ || 1.166.10 || ekāmapyatha yo dadyādabhīṣṭamanayordvayoḥ || mānuṣye sarvamāpnoti taduktaṃ te mayā'nagha || 11 || svarge tathārdhamāpnoti bhāgaṃ kālaṃ ca yādava || sāmānyasya tu dīpasya rājandāne mahatphalam || 12 || kiṃ punarmahato yasya phalasyānto na vidyate || dīpadānaṃ paraṃ puṇyamanyadeveṣvapi dhruvam || 13 || kiṃ punardeva devasya tvanantasya mahātmanaḥ || giriśṛṅgeṣu dātavyā nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca || 14 || catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛheṣu ca || vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca || 15 || dīpadānena sarvatra mahatphalamupāśnute || yāvantyakṣinimeṣāṇi dīpaḥ prajvālito nṛpa || 16 || tāvantyeva sa rājendra varṣāṇi divi modate || dīpadānena rājendra cakṣuṣmāniha jāyate || 17 || rūpasaubhāgyayuktāśca dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ || dīpamālāṃ prayacchanti ye narāḥ śārṅgiṇo gṛhe || 18 || bhavanti te candrasamāḥ svargamāsādya mānavāḥ || dīpāgāraṃ naraḥ kṛtvā kūṭāgāranibhaṃ śubham || 19 || keśavālayamāsādya nāke bhāti sa śakravat || yathojjvalaḥ sadā dīpo dīpadātāpi yādava || 1.166.20 || tathā nityojjvalo loke nākabhraṣṭo'bhi jāyate || samīpe tu yathā loke cakṣūṃṣi phalavanti hi || 21 || tathā dīpasya dātāro bhavanti saphalekṣaṇāḥ || yathaivordhvagatirnityaṃ rājandīpaśikhā śubhā || 22 || dīpadātustathaivordhvagatirbhavati śobhanā || tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīpā deyā nareśvara|| 23 || āśvayujyāmatītāyāṃ yāvadrājendra kārtikī || tāvaddīpapradasyoktaṃ phalaṃ rājanviśeṣataḥ ||24|| tāvatkālaṃ prayacchanti ye tu dīpaṃ sadā niśi || tuṃge deśe mahatteṣāṃ bahiḥ puṇyaphalaṃ bhavet || ||25|| yasyāndhakāre gahane prākāśyaṃ tena jāyate| prākāśye yaduśārdūla tena yānti hi tatsukham ||26|| śravaṇe dīpakaṃ dattvā nadīdvitayasaṃgame || tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca rūpavānabhijāyate || 27 || dīpā nadīṣu dātavyāḥ kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣasya yā tu pañcadaśī bhavet || 28 || bilvadvāreṣu dātavyāstathā dīpā yathāvidhi || anyatrāpi tadā dīpairmahatpuṇyaphalaṃ labhet || 29 || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge kṛṣṇapakṣe tathaiva ca || ghṛtena dīpā dātavyāstilairvā yadunandana || 1.166.30 || vasāmajjādibhirdeyā na tu dīpāḥ kathañcana || dattvā dīpaṃ na kartavyaṃ tena karma vijānatā || 31 || nirvāpaṇaṃ ca dīpasya hiṃsanaṃ ca vigarhitam || yaḥ kuryāttena karmāṇi syādasau puṣpitekṣaṇaḥ || 32 || dīpahartā bhavedandhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpako bhavet || dīpadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 33 || dīpadānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vipraveśmasu paṇḍitaiḥ|| dvijaveśmani yo dadyātkārtike māsi dīpakam || 34 || agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || prāṇijāṃ nīlaraktāṃ ca dīpe vartiṃ vivarjayet|| 35 || viśeṣeṇa pradātavyā padmasūtrabhavā nṛpa || padmasūtrodbhavāṃ vartiṃ gandhatailena dīpake || 36 || virogaḥ subhagaścaiva dattvā bhavati mānavaḥ || dātavyaṃ devadevasya karpūreṇa ca dīpakam|| aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet||37|| etanmayoktaṃ tava dīpadāne phalaṃ samagraṃ yaduvaṃśacandra || śrutvā yathāvatsatataṃ tu deyā dīpāstvayā viprasurālayeṣu || 38 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dīpadānapraśaṃsānāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 166 || <1.167> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || dīpadānāllalitikā yadavāpa purā nṛpa || 1 || āsīccitraratho nāma vidarbheṣu mahīpatiḥ || tasya putraśataṃ rājño jajñe pañcadaśottaram || 2 || ekaiva kanyā tasyāsīllalitā nāma nāmataḥ || sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi || 3 || tāṃ dadau kāśirājāya sa pitā cārudharmiṇe || śatāni tasya bhāryāṇāṃ trīṇyāsaṃścātra dharmiṇaḥ || 4 || tāsāṃ madhye'gramahiṣī lalitāsya tadā'bhavat || viṣṇorāyatane tasyāḥ sahasaṃ rājasattama || 5 || pradīpānāṃ prajvalati divārātramarindama || tāmisramāśvayukpakṣaṃ śuklapakṣaṃ ca kārtikāt || 6 || tasyāḥ prajvalitaṃ dīpamuccasthānakṛtaṃ tathā || tasminkāle tathā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu sā ||7|| nityaṃ bhavati sāyāhne dīpapreṣaṇatatparā || catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu devatāyataneṣu ca || 8 || caityavṛkṣeṣu goṣṭheṣu parvatānāṃ ca mūrdhasu || pulineṣu nadīnāṃ ca kūpamūleṣu yādava || 9 || tasminbhavati sākāle dīpadānaparāyaṇā || tāṃ sapatnyo'tha saṅgamya papracchuridamādṛtāḥ ||1.167.10|| sapatnya ūcuḥ || sarvāndharmānparityajya lalite tvaṃ sadaiva tu || viṣṇorāyatane subhrūrdīpadānaparāyaṇā|| 11 || tadetatkathayāsmākaṃ lalite kautukaṃ param || manyāmahe tvayāvaśyaṃ dīpadānaphalaṃ śrutam || 12 || lalitikovāca || nāhaṃ matsariṇī bhadrā na ca rāgādidūṣitā || ekapatyāśrayā yātā bhavatyo mama mānadāḥ || 13 || apṛthagdharmacaraṇāḥ śṛṇvantu gaditaṃ mama || mayaitaddīpadānasya yathā vai bhujyate phalam || 14 || harasya dayitā bhāryā śailarājasutā varā || umādevīti madreṣu devikā yā saridvarā || ||15|| narāṇāmanukampārthaṃ brāhmaṇairavatāritā || tīrayorubhayostasyāḥ kṣetraṃ krośacatuṣṭayam || 16 || tasmim̐stīrthe tu pānīyaṃ sarvatīrthaprakalpitam || tasmiṃstīrthe mṛtā martyāḥ prāpnuvanti śubhāṃ gatim ||17|| śrutābhilāṣitā dṛṣṭā devikā pāpanāśinī || tasyāṃ snātvā sakṛnmartyo gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt||18|| tasyāstīrthaṃ nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam|| nṛsiṃhavapuṣā snānaṃ kṛtaṃ yatra purā śubhā||19|| sauvīrarājasya purā maitreyo'bhūtpurohitaḥ|| tasmim̐stīrthe tadā tena viṣṇorāyatanaṃ kṛtam || 1.167.20 || ahanyahani śuśrūṣāṃ puṣpadhūpādilepanaiḥ || dīpadānādibhiścaiva cakre tatra sa vai dvijaḥ ||21|| kārtike dīpakāstatra pradattāstena caikadā || āsīnnirvāṇabhūyiṣṭho devārcāpurato niśi || 22 || devatāyatane cāsaṃ tathāhamapi mūṣikā|| pradīpa vartiharaṇe kṛtabuddhirvarānanā ||23|| gṛhītā ca mayā vartirvṛṣadaṃśo rurāva ca || naṣṭā cāhaṃ tadā tasya mārjārasya bhayāttadā || 24 || vartiprāntena naśyantyā dīpakaḥ prerito mayā || jajvāla pūrvavaddīptyā tasminnāyatane punaḥ || 25 || mṛtā cāhaṃ tadā jātā vidarbharājakanyakā || jātismarā mahīpasya mahiṣī cārudharmiṇaḥ || 26 || eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya kārtike māsi śobhanāḥ || dattasyāyatane viṣṇoryasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiruttamā || 27 || yadi vo nāsti mātsaryaṃ dīpo deyaḥ sadā śubhāḥ || asaṅkalpitamapyetatpreraṇaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mayā || 28 || keśavālayadīpasya tasyedaṃ bhujyate phalam || etasmātkāraṇāddīpānahametānaharniśam || 29 || prayacchāmi harerdhāmni jñātasya ca hi yatphalam || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktāḥ sapatnyastā dīpadānaparāyaṇāḥ || 1.167.30 || babhūvurdevadevasya keśavasya sadā gṛhe || tataḥ kālena mahatā tena rājñā mahātmanā || viṣṇulokamanuprāptāḥ pañcatvaṃ prāpya mānada || 31 || taṃ lokamāsādya nṛpeṇa sārdhaṃ sā rājaputrī kamalābharūpā || reme mahīpāla mudā sametā dīpapradānāccyavanādvimuktā || 32 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasamvāde dīpamāhātmye lalitikopākhyānaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 167 || <1.168> vajra uvāca || upavāsāsamarthānāṃ hīnānāṃ draviṇena ca || karmaṇā kena dharmajña toṣamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| santi puṣpāṇyaraṇyeṣu mūlāni ca phalāni ca || svayaṃ grāhyāṇi rājendra yaistuṣyati janārdanaḥ || 2 || candraḥ sāmānyadīpo'yaṃ vibhavaiḥ kimprayojanam || yathālabhyena rājendra yaistuṣyati janārdanaḥ ||3|| phalamūlāśano'raṇye kusumairmadhusūdanam || sampūjya satataṃ kāmānabhīṣṭānpratipadyate || 4 || akāmastadavāpnoti yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || araṇyeṣu naraḥ kṛtvā devadevasya cārcanam ||5|| atītamuddharedrājanphalena sa śataṃ nṛṇām || bhaviṣyāṇāṃ śataṃ caiva narāṇāṃ yadunandana || 6 || nagare'pi vasanyastu
