bhaikṣyāśī saṃśitavrataḥ || araṇyādāhṛtaiḥ puṣpairmūlapatraphalāṅkuraiḥ||7|| yathopapannaiḥ satatamabhyarcayati keśavam || sarvakāmaprado devastasya syānmadhusūdanaḥ || 8 || tasyāpyakāmakāmasya paraṃ sthānaṃ prakīrtitam || yatra gatvā na śocanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padama|||||| svayamāhṛtya puṣpādyaibhaikṣyāśī keśavārcanam || kṛtaṃ yena sa rājendra vaṃśānuddharate śatam || 1.168.10 || vaṃśānatītānpañcāśattāvataścāpyanāgatān || uddharedātmano rājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 11 || gṛhastho'pi naro rājandharmāgatadhanāgamaḥ || araṇyādāhṛtaiḥ puṣpairyaḥ kuryātkeśavārcanam || 12|| etadeva samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || dharmārjitadhanaḥ krītvā yaḥ kurvankeśavārcanam || 13 || svayamuptaiśca kusumairyaḥ kuryātkeśavārcanam || uddhariṣyatyasandehaṃ saptapūrvāparānnarān || 14 || yathākathañcidāhṛtya kathañcitpūjayeddharim || nākapṛṣṭhamavāpnoti na me'trāsti vicāraṇā || 15 || mānuṣye ca parāṃ rājañchriyamāpnotyasaṃśayam || vanādāhatya kusumaiḥ kartavyaṃ devatārcanam || 16 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ dūrvāṅkuramathāpi vā || nivedayitvā kṛṣṇāya bhoktā nākamavāpnuyāta || akṣamaistūpavāsānāṃ tathā dhanavivarjitaiḥ || 17 || vanādāhṛtya kusumaiḥ kartavyaṃ devatārcanam || araṇyādāhṛtaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sampūjya madhusūdanam ||18|| pūrvajanmani samprāptaṃ rājyaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa || nṛgo yayātirnahuṣo viṣvagaśvaḥ karandhamaḥ || 19 || dilīpo yavanāśvaśca ṛtuparṇo bhagīrathaḥ || somakaḥ sahadevaśca mahāmālo mahāhanuḥ ||1.168.20|| revakaḥ kālakākhyaśca kṛtavīryo guṇākaraḥ || devarātaḥ kakutsthaśca vinīto vikrame raghuḥ || 21 || mahotsāho vītabhayo niramitraḥ prabhākaraḥ || kapotaromā parjanyaścandrasenaḥ parāntakaḥ || 22 || bhīmaseno dṛḍharathaḥ kuśanābhaḥ prabhadrakaḥ || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pūrvajanmani keśavam || 23 || pūjayitvā kṣitāvasyāṃ prāpū rājyamakaṇṭakam || yakṣatvamatha devatvaṃ gandharvatvaṃ tathaiva ca || 24 || vidyādharatvaṃ nāgatvaṃ ye gatā manujottama || bahutvātte kathaṃ śakyā mayā vaktuṃ tavānagha || 25 || tasmādyatnaḥ sadā kāryaḥ puruṣaiḥ kusumārcane ||26|| araṇyajātaiḥ kusumaiḥ sadaiva saṃpūjayitvā svayamāhṛtaistu || sarveśvaratvaṃ phalamāpnuvanti rājendra tadvarṇayituṃ na śakyam || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde puṣpāharaṇaphalavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 168 || <1.169> vajra uvāca || aṭavyo dāruṇā brahmansiṃhavyāghraniṣevitāḥ || taskarācaritā ghorāḥ sarīsṛpavimiśritāḥ || 1 || nityotthitasya cādhvānaṃ dāhakṣayakaraṃ param || ataḥ svalpataraṃ karma brūhi me keśavārcane || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ataḥ svalpataraṃ rājandevaveśmānulepanam || mahāphalaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ || 3 || sammārjanaṃ tu yaḥ kuryātpuruṣaḥ keśavālaye || rajastamobhyāṃ nirmuktaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 || pāṃsūnāṃ yāvatāṃ rājankuryātsammārjanaṃ naraḥ || tāvantyabdāni sa sukhī nākamāsādya modate ||5 || abhyukṣaṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryātpānīyena surālaye|| sa śāntapāpo bhavati nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||6|| kṛtvopalepanaṃ viṣṇornarastvāyatane sadā || gomayena śubhām̐llokānayatnādeva gacchati || 7 || hastapramāṇaṃ bhūbhāgamupalipya narādhipa || devarāmāśataṃ nākaṃ labheta satataṃ naraḥ || 8 || tato'nusāreṇa phalaṃ vistṛtāyāṃ kṣitau smṛtam || nityāsamarthastu tathā devaveśmopalepane || 9 || triḥ pakṣasya tu kurvīta devaveśmopalepanam || pañcamīṃ daśamīṃ caiva tathā pañcadaśīṃ nṛpa || 1.169.10 || triḥ pakṣasya sadā kṛtvā devaveśmopalepanam || saṃvatsarāttadāpnoti yatphalaṃ tannibodha me ||11 || janmāntaramathāsādya gṛhaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam || sarvopabhogasaṃyuktaṃ gṛhaprāsādasaṅkulam ||12|| vṛkṣodyānalatāgulmatoyavāpīvibhūṣitam || gavāśvadhanadhānyāḍhyaṃ sarvopakaraṇairyutam || 13 || priyaṃvadābhirhṛdyābhiḥ svarūpābhiśca pārthiva || vṛtaṃ ca bahubhiḥ strībhiścāruvaṃśābhireva ca || 14 || gārhasthyaṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ tatra sa cāpnoti mahītale || na ca pracyavanaṃ tasmājjīvannāpnoti karhicit || 15 || tasya ye bāndhavāstatra sarve te dīrghajīvinaḥ || bhavanti na bhavantyasya ādhayo vyādhayastathā ||16|| na tasya mṛtaniṣkrāntirgṛhe bhavati karhicit|| yāvajjīvatyasau tatra gṛhe śrīmānmudā yutaḥ || 17 || caurajaṃ na bhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhayam || vyālabhūpālajaṃ vāpi na ca tasya phalaṃ bhavet || 18 || svarūpaḥ sarvasiddhārtho dīrghāyurvyādhivarjitaḥ || ājñāvidheyabhṛtyaśca dhruvaṃ syānmanujeśvara || 19 || bhuñjāno yaḥ sadā kuryāttasyaitatkathitaṃ phalam || naktabhojī tathā kṛtvā dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 1.169.20 || upoṣitastu riktāsu pūrṇāsu tu harergṛhe || kṛtvopalepanaṃ nityaṃ cānantyaṃ phalamaśnute || 21 || upalepanakṛdyastu kṛṣṇasyāyatane bhavet || pāpasaṃmārjanaṃ tasya śīghrameva bhaviṣyati || 22 || niṣpādyametatsasukhaṃ narendra ārādhanaṃ devavarasya viṣṇoḥ || proktaṃ mayā te dhanavarjitānāṃ dhanānvitānāṃ saphalaṃ viśeṣam || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde upalepanaphalapraśaṃsano nāmaikonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 169 || <1.170> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || phalamāsādya yadgītaṃ devaveśmopalepane || 1 || babhūva śūdrajātīyaḥ kaścidbhāgyavivarjitaḥ || kṛtavānsa tu vāṇijyaṃ dhanaśeṣeṇa kenacit || 2 || tasminvipanne sa kṛṣiṃ cakāra nṛpasattama || tasyāmapi vipannāyāṃ cakre sevāṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 3 || tato'pyanāsādya phalaṃ siddhiṃ tīramupāśritaḥ || gaṅgāyāḥ saptamo bhāgaḥ sindhurnaranarottama || 4 || śītalāmalapānīyaḥ svargalokapradāyakaḥ || yatra snātvā gatiṃ yānti brāhmaṇāśca tapasvinaḥ ||5|| tasya tīre varāhārcā purāṇarṣivinirmitā || tāṃ samāsādya śūdrastu nityaṃ bhaikṣyaparāyaṇaḥ || 6 || nityopalepanaparastadarcādevaveśmani || uvāsa bhāryayā sārdhaṃ tatra nityānuraktayā || 7 || etasminneva kāle tu varāhārcādidṛkṣayā || sauvīrarājaḥ samprāptastaṃ deśaṃ citravāhanaḥ || 8 || sindhau snānaṃ samāsādya pūjayitvā jagatpatim || sabhāryaḥ pṛthivīpālaḥ prāyādrājanyathāgataḥ || 9 || śriyaṃ tasya tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa śūdro bhāryayā saha || bhūpālatvaspṛhāṃ kṛtvā kālātkālavaśaṅgataḥ || 1.170.10 || vanātkāṣṭhānyupāhatya kṛtvā bhartustataścitim || anvāruroha taṃ bhāryā śūdraṃ pañcatvamāgatam || 11 || sa śūdro bhāryayā sārdhaṃ nākapṛṣṭhamito gataḥ || satataṃ dharmaśīlastu devaveśmopalepanāt || 12 || etasminneva kāle tu yuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ || viṣṇuṃ sampūjayāmāsa putrīyeṇa vratena tu || 13 || rājñastasya vratasyānte svapne prāha janārdanaḥ || bhārgavaṃ cyavanaṃ gaccha tataḥ putramavāpsyasi || 14 || yuvanāśvastathoktastu svapne devena cakriṇā || prātaḥ padbhyāṃ yayau tasya cyavanasyāśramaṃ śubham || 15 || sampūjayitvā cyavanaṃ cyavanena ca pūjitaḥ || vratasvapnāvubhau tasya jagāda nṛpasattamaḥ || 16 || ṛṣisaṅghānupādāya cyavano'pi mahātapāḥ || avijñātaṃ narendreṇa putrīyaṃ kṛtavāñjalam || 17 || kalaśasthaṃ jalaṃ tacca sthāpayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || tato niśīthe saṃprāpte tṛṣārtaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || 18 || ṛṣimadhye tu sa suptānṛṣīnvākyamathā'bravīt || tṛṣārto'smi bhṛśaṃ viprāḥ pānīyaṃ me prayacchata ||19 || ṛṣistasya na śuśrāva kaścidbhāvyarthacoditaḥ || tataḥ khinno mahīpālaḥ kalaśasthaṃ jalaṃ papau || 1.170.20 || pītvā suṣvāpa ṛṣayaḥ prātaḥ sarve samutthitāḥ || apaśyamānāḥ kalaśaṃ papracchuste para sparam || 21 || putrīyaṃ kalaśaṃ rājñaḥ kṛtaṃ yattadgataṃ kva nu || tadovāca sa rājendrastānṛṣīnsaṃśitavratān || 22 || tṛṣārtena mayā pītaḥ kalaśastvapavāhitaḥ || te hocustaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ bhāvyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tvayā || 23 || bhāryā pītvaiva tattoyaṃ putraṃ te janayiṣyati || ityevaṃ mantrakalaśaḥ so'smābhirbhūpate kṛtaḥ || 24 || putrīyamudakaṃ tacca tvayā pītamabuddhinā || tasmāttvameva tanayaṃ svakukṣau janayiṣyasi || 25 || nāvāpsyasi tathā mṛtyuṃ varadānāddvijanmanām || evamuktastu sampūjya brāhmaṇānsvagṛhaṅgataḥ || 26 || rājñaḥ kukṣiṃ vinirbhidya jajñe bālārkasannibhaḥ || punaḥ putravatāṃ śreṣṭha śūdro'sau nākavicyutaḥ || 27 || jātamātrasya tasyendro dadau prādeśinīṃ mukhe || āsādya yāṃ sa bālatvaṃ śiśustatyāja tatkṣaṇāt || 28 ||||| kukṣiṃ pasparśa rājñastu rājasiṃhaśatakratuḥ || rājā śakrakarāmṛṣṭo vijvaraścāvraṇo'bhavat || 29 || yuvanāśvaḥ sa tasyāpi nāma cakre śatakratuḥ ||| māṃ dhāsyatīti māndhātā khyātiṃ tribhuvane gataḥ ||1.170.30 || tamāviveśa bhagavāṃstejasā svena mādhavaḥ || sāpi svargacyutā bhāryā tasya śūdrasya yādava || 31 || kāśirājasutā jātā bhīmavegasya mānada || nāmnā prabhāvatī subhrūstryailokyasyaikasundarī || 32 || yuvanāśvastu tāṃ vavre māndhāturlakṣaṇānvitām || sa rājā pradadau tāṃ tu māndhātuścitravāhanaḥ || 33 || ekaiva bhāryā sā tasya babhūvātyantasundarī || rūpayauvanasampannā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || kṛtvodvāhamayodhyāyāmabhiṣicya sa taṃ nṛpam || 34 || yuvanāśvo vanaṃ prāyādvanādapi triviṣṭapam || rājyastho'pi sa māndhātā trailokyaṃ saptabhirdinaiḥ || 35 || rathenaikena vaśagaṃ cakāra khaḍgadarpitaḥ || pātāle gagane śaile samudre ca mahātmanaḥ || 36 || āsīttasyāpratihatā gatiścakrasya pārthiva || cakravartī sa dharmātmā vaiṣṇavaśca tathā'bhavat || 37 || samāyutānāṃ bubhuje sa rājyaṃ daśa mānada || brahmāṇḍamaṇḍapaṃ yāvatsūryastapati raśmibhiḥ || tāvatkṣetraṃ mahībharturyuvanāśvasya kīrtyate || 38 || evaṃ sa rājā vijitāripakṣo devājirālepanakṛdbabhūva ||| bhāryā ca sā tasya babhūva bhāryā loke variṣṭhā pramadāvarābhyaḥ || 39 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde māndhātrupākhyānaṃ nāma saptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 170 || <1.171> || vajra uvāca || || sa tu rājā mayā brahmanmāṃdhātā bhuvaneśvaraḥ || māheśvareṇa śūlena lavaṇena hataḥ śrutaḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ajeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejastatra nityaṃ ca jantuṣu || nāśamāyānti te sarve hīnā vaiṣṇava tejasā ||2 || avināśi jagatyasminna kiñcidatha vidyate || ṛte tu mahatastasmāttejaso nṛpa vaiṣṇavāt || 3 || tejastasya sudurvāhyaṃ dehibhirnapa sarvadā || tasmāttena vihīnāste kṣayaṃ gacchanti mānada || 4 || matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ || brahmā śambhustathaivārkaścandramāśca śatakratuḥ || 5 || evamādyāstathaivānye yuktā vaiṣṇavatejasā || gajacchāyānumānena viyujyante ca tejasā || 6 || vitejasaśca te sarve pañcatvamupayānti ca || pañcabhūtātmakaṃ sthūlaṃ yatkiñcijjagatīgatam || 7 || sarvaṃ vināśi tajjñeyaṃ tvayā pārthivasattama || avināśi tu tadviddhi yena viśvamidaṃ tatam || 8 || yattu gandhaguṇairhīnaṃ rūpasparśavivarjitam || śabdahīnaṃ ca virasaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvagaṃ ca yat || 9 || nirguṇaṃ tadguṇātītamantikasthaṃ ca dūragam || sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam || 1.171.10 || sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || sarvendriyaguṇaṃ devaṃ sarvataḥ parameśvaram ||11|| avināśi tadevaikaṃ yasyodaragataṃ jagat || sadāśiveti taṃ kecidāhurdevaṃ jagatpatim ||12|| vāsudeveti cāpyanye kālamityeva cāpare|| devamityapare taṃ ca svabhāvamiti cāpare || 13 || karmeti cāpare prāhuḥ puruṣeti tathā pare || praṇavākhyaṃ tathā taṃ ca vidurvedavido janāḥ || 14 || tadekamajamavyaktamavināśaṃ narādhipa || ṛte tamekamīśānamaṃtavatsakalaṃ jagat || 15 || etattavoktaṃ bhuvanasya patyurmayā svarūpaṃ yaduvaṃśacandra || bhaktiṃ vinā buddhimatāpi yasya śakyaṃ na vaktuṃ grahaṇaṃ nareṇa || 16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasamvāde puruṣa svarūpavarṇanaṃ nāmaikasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 171 || <1.172> || vajra uvāca || prādurbhāvā varāhādyāḥ sarveśasyāmitātmanaḥ || mahābhūtacayāḥ sarve janmamṛtyuyutāśca ye || 1 || yadyevaṃ prāṇibhisteṣāṃ ko viśeṣo bhṛgūttama || etattvaṃ saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sarve jīvā mahīpāla karmabandhanibandhanāḥ || jāyante ca mriyante ca paratantrāḥ sadaiva ca || 3 || īśvarapreritairnityaṃ karmabandhaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ || janmāntarakṛtairbhūpa sukhaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ || 4 || vāsudevastu dharmātmā prādurbhāveṣu yādava || ātmanaḥ svecchayā janma vidhatte maraṇaṃ tathā || 5 || karmāṇi na ca limpanti prādurbhāveṣvapi prabhum || karmasvapi sadā saktaṃ padmapatramivāmbhasā || 6 || phalānāṃ karmajātānāṃ bhogaṃ tatrāpi yādava || nṛṇāṃ darśayate mithyā maryādābhedabhīrnṛpa || 7 || yadāyadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati yādava || abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjatyasau || 8 || devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu gandharvoragapakṣiṣu || yoniṣvanyeṣvapi tathā buddhvā kāryabalābalam || 9 || yasyāṃ yasyāṃ yadā yonau prādurbhavati kāraṇāt || tadyonisadṛśaṃ tatsa tadā loke viceṣṭate || 1.172.10 || saṃhartuṃ jagadīśānaḥ samartho'pi tadā nṛpa || tadyonisadṛśopāyairvadhyānhiṃsati yādava || 11 || hārdaṃ tamastathā naiśaṃ mūrtaṃ ca puruṣottamaḥ || eka eva sa lokānāṃ nāśayatyamaladyutiḥ || 12 || hārdaṃ dhvastaṃ tamastena jagato devamūrtinā || jyotīrūpeṇa ca dhvastaṃ tamo naiśaṃ sudāruṇam || 13 || tamo nāśayituṃ mūrtaṃ prādurbhāvagataḥ sadā || mūrtaṃ tamaśca rājendra daityadānavarākṣasāḥ || 14 || vandhyānāmapi daityānāṃ dehastho'pi janārdanaḥ || na vimuñcati dehāni yuktyā tāṃśca jighāṃsati || 15 || daivatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca dvijānāṃ ca gurupriyaḥ || śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā bhavatyārādhane rataḥ || 16 || na ca tasyāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana || naivānāptamavāptavyaṃ vartate'tha ca karmasu || 17 || sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca sarvaśaktirapi prabhuḥ || tathāpyadhīte yajate tapastapyati pārthiva || 18 || maryādāsthāpanārthāya jagato hitakāmyayā || karoti rājankarmāṇi kīnāśa iva durbalaḥ || 19 || yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ || sa yatpramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanu vartate || 1.172.20 || etatkāraṇamāsthāya sadā karmasu vartate || prādurbhāvakṛto viṣṇuryathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā || 21 || devebhyaśca ṛṣibhyaśca varānprārthayate sadā || varāṃśca varadasteṣāṃ mānayatyapi pāṇḍava || 22 || prādurbhāvaratastasmātparo'yamiti mānavāḥ || puruṣaṃ nādhigacchanti mohitāstasya māyayā || 23 || prādurbhāvaṃ gato'pyevaṃ saṃhatya sa carācaram || nimeṣāntaramāttreṇa śaktimāñjagataḥ prabhuḥ ||24 || prādurbhāvagatasyāpi tasya sarvagatā smṛtā || svatantratā ca sarvatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 25 || mahadviśeṣametatte prāṇibhiḥ prāṇināṃ pateḥ || mayoktaṃ tasya devasya sarvagasya svayambhuvaḥ || 26 || ākṣiptāḥ karmabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ kaiścidyaduvarottama || teṣāmāviśate devastejasā tena sarvaśaḥ || 27 || āviṣṭāstejasā tena devena parameṣṭhinā || tadvatkarmāṇi kurvanti pūjyamānā maharṣibhiḥ || 28 || tathā tu kāle saṃnyastāstena vaiṣṇavatejasā || diṣṭāntavaśamāyānti tasyaiva rucitaṃ yathā || 29 || ye ca kecana loke'smindṛśyante tejasānvitāḥ || teṣāṃ tadvaiṣṇavaṃ tejastvayā jñeyaṃ mahīpate || 1.172.30 || yaccandramasi yaccāgnau yacca sūrye jagatpatau || tejaḥ paśyati tatsarvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viddhi pārthiva || 31 || agastyaprayukhānāṃ ca yā ca śaṃktiratīndriyā || tatsthasya rājansā jñeyā tvayā vaiṣṇavatejasā || 32 || yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā || tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ yuktaṃ vaiṣṇavatejasā || 33 || brāhmaṇānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca tathā gavām || jagatāṃ dhāriṇīṃ śaktiṃ viddhi tāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ vibho ||34|| rājānastejasā yuktā vaiṣṇavena vasundharām || pālayanti mahīpāla vīryodagrā yaśasvinaḥ || 35 || ṛṣayaśca tathā viprā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ || pālayanti jagatkṛtsnaṃ yuktā vaiṣṇavatejasā ||36|| tretāyugādau ye kecijjāyante cakravartinaḥ || guruṇā viddhi tānsarvānsaṃyuktānviṣṇutejasā ||37|| ājānubāhavaḥ sarve nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalāḥ || jihvayā sakalaṃ vaktraṃ parimārjanti te tathā ||38|| ṣaṣṭyā dantaiśca saṃyuktā daṃṣṭrābhiśca tathāṣṭabhiḥ || aurṇeyaṃ ca śubhaṃ teṣāṃ bhavatyantarbhruvornṛpa||39|| cakrāṅkitaiḥ pādatalaiḥ karaiścāpi śarāṅkitaiḥ || jālapādakarāścaiva tathā turagamehanāḥ ||1.172.40|| rūpavantaḥ prabhāvanto vapuṣmantaśca yādava || atīndriyajñānabalāḥ pṛthivyāṃ cakravartinaḥ||41|| teṣāṃ tu sapta ratnāni bhavantīha mahītale|| hastyaśvaratharatnāni bhāryāratnaṃ tathaiva ca ||42|| tathaivāyudharatnaṃ ca maṇiratnanidhistathā || catasraścāpratihatāsteṣāṃ tu gatayastathā||43|| pātāle gagane śaile samudre ca mahīpate|| samudraḥ stambhitajalaḥ prayāṇe cakravartinām || 44 || bhūsamāśca tathā śailā mārge teṣāṃ bhavanti tu || bhūmirdadāti vivaraṃ pātālamupayāsyatām || 45 || na viṣīdanti gagane tathā teṣāṃ turaṅgamāḥ || śrutena tapasā yajñairvīryeṇāstrabalena ca || 46 || sarvebhyaste'tiricyante prāṇibhyo manujeśvara || ārādhitajagannāthāḥ prāpnuvantīha tatpadam || 47 || varṣāyutāni jīvanti ṣaḍaṣṭau sapta vā nṛpa || teṣāṃ ca tejasā viṣṇuḥ karotyāpyāyanaṃ sadā || 48 || yena te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnuvanti guṇodayam || sthānāntaragatenāpi te'pi vaiṣṇavatejasā || 49 || saṃhāramupagacchanti kṣayakāla upasthite || kṣayakāle ca māndhātustejastadatiduḥsaham || 1.172.50 || vaiṣṇavaṃ śūliśūlāgramāśrayāmāsa yādava || arjunasya narendrasya yuktasya haritejasā || 51 || harirevāntakṛccāsīdrāmo bhṛgukulodvaha || bhārgavasya ca rāmasya tejastadatiduḥsaham || 52 || ādatte vaiṣṇavaṃ ghoraṃ rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ || kāñcittanumadhiṣṭhāya tena ghoreṇa tejasā || 53 || karoti devakāryāṇi kṛtakarmā tataḥ prabhuḥ || ādānaṃ tejasastasya vidhatte sa svatejasā || 54 || nānyaḥ śamayitā loke nṛpa vaiṣṇavatejasaḥ ||55|| tasyāvatāreṣu mayā svarūpametattavoktaṃ bhuvanasya patyuḥ || rahasyametatparamaṃ munīnāṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ kalmaṣanāśakāri || 56|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasamvāde prādubhāvasvarūpavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 172 || <1.173> vajra uvāca || yuvanāśvena yadrājñā putrīyaṃ tu kṛtaṃ vratam || tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi janānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || putrīyaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ bhūpāla sattama || anantavratamityuktaṃ sevatāṃ putrajanmadam || 2 || māsimāsi tu nakṣatraṃ māsanāmnā tu cihnitam || samprāpya pūjayeddevaṃ sopavāso narottama || 3 || ekaikamaṅgaṃ devasya pratimāsaṃ viśeṣataḥ || pūjayetprayataḥ śuddhaḥ śṛṇu cāṅgakramaṃ mama || 4 || mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya vratametatsamārabhet || devasya mārgaśīrṣe tu vāmaṃ jānuṃ samarcayet||5 || kaṭibhāgaṃ tathā vāmaṃ pauṣe māsi samarcayet || māghe maghāsu vāmaṃ ca bhujaṃ devasya pūjayet ||6|| uttarāphalgunīṛkṣe skandhaṃ vāmaṃ prapūjayet || caturṣveteṣu vāmeṣu gomūtrasnānamācaret || 7 || pūjanaṃ devadevasya raktaiḥ puṣpādibhistathā || homo ghṛtena kartavyastiladānaṃ dvijātiṣu || 8 || tāmrasya ca tathā dānaṃ gomūtraprāśanaṃ tataḥ || haviṣyānnena cāhāraṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ vijānatā || 9 || devasya dakṣiṇaṃ skandhaṃ caitre citrāsu pūjayet || vaiśākhe ca viśākhāsu bāhuṃ devasya dakṣiṇam || 1.173.10 || dakṣiṇaṃ kaṭibhāgaṃ ca jyeṣṭhe jyeṣṭhāsu pūjayet || dakṣiṇaṃ ca tathā jānumāṣāḍhe vaiśvadevake 51 1|| caturṣveteṣu māseṣu kṣīrasnānaṃ vidhīyate || pītapuṣpādipūjā ca devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 12 || homaṃ ca śālibhiḥ kuryādyavā deyā dvijātiṣu || rajataṃ ca tathā deyaṃ yathānnena bhujikriyā ||13|| tathā kāryā manuṣyendra śrāvaṇeśrāvaṇe tataḥ || pādādau pūjayettasya yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || 14 || guptaṃ bhādrapade māsi āśvine hṛdayaṃ tataḥ || śirasaḥ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ kārtike kṛttikāsu ca || 15 || caturṣveteṣu eteṣu māseṣu dadhnā snānaṃ vidhīyate || pūjanaṃ devadevasya śuklaiḥ puṣpādibhistathā || 16 || kṣīreṇa homaḥ kartavyo ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ dvijātiṣu || suvarṇaṃ tu tathā rājandadhnā kāryāṃ bhujikriyā || 17 || anantanāma japtavyaṃ sarvamāseṣu pārthiva|| tenaiva nāmnā devasya homakarmāṇi nirdiśet || 18 || vratāvasāne dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastu bhojanam || dānaṃ śaktyā ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipa || 19 || saṃvatsarādavāpnoti sarvāneva manorathān || putrārthibhirvṛttikāmairbhṛtyadāradhanepsubhiḥ || 1.173.20 || prārthayadbhiśca kartavyaṃ balamārogyasampadam || etadvrataṃ mahārāja puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ param || 21 || anantavratamityuktaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || vratametatpurā kṛtvā yuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ ||22 || māndhātāraṃ sutaṃ lebhe rājānaṃ cakravartinam || kṛtavīryasya rājendra bhāryā śīladharā tathā || 23 || vratenānena sā lebhe putraṃ bāhusahasriṇam || kārtavīryārjunaṃ nāma rājānaṃ cakravartinam || 24 || yamāviveśa bhagavāṃstejasā svena mādhavaḥ || namaste kārtavīryāya arjunāya mahātmane || 25 || saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ medinyāmīśvarāya ca || etāvaduktā puṇyena tilaprasthasya yujyate ||26|| rājandattasya vidhivadbrāhmaṇāya yatātmane || yasya vai jātamātrasya pravavāvanilaḥ śubhaḥ || 27 || nīrajaskamabhūdvyoma mudaṃ prāpākhilaṃ jagat|| samāśrayārthaṃ nṛpatiṃ daityā mānuṣyatāṃ gatāḥ ||28 || āśrayāmāsuravyagrāśśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || yasminrājanvatīvārtā bhūmirbhārāvapīḍitā || dadhāra kṛcchreṇātmānaṃ jalāvilavapurnṛpa ||29|| putrīyametattava rājasiṃha mayā vrataṃ te kathitaṃ purāṇam || kartavyametadbhuvi putrakāmaiḥ pāpāpahaṃ dharmavivardhanaṃ ca||1.173.30|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'nantavratamāhātmyavarṇano nāma trisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||173|| <1.174> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || idamanyatpravakṣyāmi māsanakṣatrapūjanam || yatphalaṃ devadevasya puruṣaḥ samupāśnute || 1 || ārabhya kārtikādetadvrataṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā || pāraṇatritayenaitadvrataṃ parisamāpyate || 2 || cāturmāsyaṃ tathaivātra pāraṇaṃ nṛpa kīrtitam || pāraṇepāraṇe rājanpratimāsavidhiṃ śṛṇu || 3 || pañcagavyajalasnānaṃ sadaiva ca samācaret || puṣpādipūjā kartavyā yathālābhamupāhṛtaiḥ || 4 || naivedyaṃ kṛsaraṃ pūrvamatra māsacatuṣṭayam || yāvakena tathā kāryaṃ madhyamaṃ ca catuṣṭayam || 5 || catuṣṭaye tṛtīye ca naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ bhavet || tenaivānnena rājendra brāhmaṇānbhojayedbudhaḥ || 6 || naktaṃ naivedyamaśnīyādvāgyataḥ susamāhitaḥ || saṃyatastāṃ bhavedrātriṃ tathā sthaṇḍilaśāyakaḥ || 7 || evaṃ kuryātpunastāvadyāvatkārtikakṛttikā || tatra sampūjya deveśamārambha vidhinā nṛpa || 8 || bhājanaṃ ghṛtasaṃpūrṇaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ dvijātaye || dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 9 || saṃvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ puruṣa sattamaḥ || labdhvā sthānaṃ ca modeta tathā nārī ca yādava || 1.174.10 || sthirāṃ śriyaṃ dharmamatiṃ balaṃ ca saubhāgyamojaḥ sthirasattvatāṃ ca || āsthāṃ sudīrghāṃ tridive ca kuryādvrataṃ nṛṇāmetadatīva puṇyam || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde māsanakṣatrapūjanaṃ nāma catussapta tyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 174 || <1.175> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atra te varṇayiṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || svarge vṛttāṃ samāśritya māsanakṣatra pūjanam || 1 || pūrvaistu caritaṃ śakra nāhaṃ jānāmi kiñcana || bhavataḥ samakālīnaṃ viddhi māṃ surasattama ||2 || iyaṃ siddhā vijānāti prakhyātā śāmbarāyaṇī || evamuktastataḥ śakraḥ papraccha balasūdanaḥ || 3 || jagāda sā ca śakrasya pūrvendracaritaṃ mahat || śakrāṇāṃ sā vyatītānāṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 4 || jagāda tatra caritaṃ kalpeṣvanyeṣvapi prabho || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || sarveṣāmapi śakrāṇāṃ ye tu dāyādabāndhavāḥ || 5|| sarve vināśitāstena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || sarve śakrāstathā yuktāstena vaiṣṇavatejasā || 6|| bhūtebhyastvatiricyante tena te guṇasampadaḥ || dānena yajñaiḥ śauryeṇa tapasā ca balena ca || 7 || śrutena dharmiṣṭhatayā devadaityamahoragān || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstepi pārthivasattama || 8 || varaṃ sampāvanaṃ taiśca kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || parājayaṃ yataḥ prāptā dāyādebhyaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 9 || sarveśvarā vīryabalopapannā dharme niviṣṭā jagataḥ pradhānāḥ || tyaktādhikārāśca tataḥ krameṇa sarve gatā viṣṇusahāyatāṃ ca ||1.175.10|| iti viṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakracaritākhyānaṃ nāma pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 175 || <1.176> || indra uvāca || yasminkāle vyatītā ye ṣaḍindrā bhūritejasaḥ || teṣāṃ caritamicchāmi śrotuṃ vistaraśaḥ śubhe || 1 || prati śakraṃ manuṃ bhadre manuputrāṃstathaiva ca || devānsaptaṛṣīṃścaiva tathā dāyādabāṃdhavān || 2 || śakrasya teṣāṃ ca vadhaṃ tathā devājjanārdanāt || tvattohaṃ śrotu micchāmi sarvaṃ tvaṃ vetsi sundari ||3|| śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca|| brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putraḥ prathamastu manuḥ smṛtaḥ || daśa putrāśca tasyeme khyātāstribhuvaneśvara || ||4|| agnīdhraścātibāhuśca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ || jyotiṣmāndyutimānhavyaḥ savanaḥ satra eva ca ||5|| marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || vasiṣṭhaśca mahātejā ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ ||6|| jayākhyāścājitākhyāśca śukrayāmāstathaiva ca || gaṇā dvādaśakā ete catvāraḥ somapīthinaḥ || 7 || viśvabhuṅnāma devānāṃ teṣāmindro babhūva ha || āsaṃstasyāsurā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || 8 || babhūva nṛpatiryeṣāṃ bāṣkalo nāma nāmataḥ || yasya hastādubhau lokau vāmanena hṛtau purā || 9 || kramadvayena tu hṛtaṃ pātālaṃ ca sureśvara || yasya putravatastvāsītkeśī nāma balotkaṭaḥ || 1.176.10 || jahāra bhūyastrailokyaṃ śakrasyākramya durmatiḥ || tamāhūya raṇe viṣṇustārkṣyapravaravāhanaḥ||11|| dvidhā cakāra cakreṇa trailokyahitakāmyayā ||12|| evaṃ hatastena purārimukhyo mahātmanā kālasamaprabhāvaḥ ||. śakrapriyārthaṃ jagatāṃ hitārthaṃ deveśvareṇāpratimena tena ||13|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śāmbarāyaṇīvākye prathamamanvaṃtaravarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 176 || <1.177> || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || manuḥ svārociṣo nāma babhūva tadanantarama || yasyāsansumahābhāgāḥ putrā bhūmaṇḍaleśvarāḥ || 1 || caitraḥ kavirutaścaiva kṛtānto vidyuto raviḥ || bṛhadgraho nabhaścaiva mahābalaparākramaḥ || 2 || ūrjastasya tathā prāṇa ṛṣabho niścalastathā || dantobhiḥ śākvarīvāṃśca ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 3 || bhūṣitā dvādaśa proktāstathā pārāvatāśca ye || teṣāmindro vipaścicca mahātmā lokaviśrutaḥ || 4 || āsaṃstasyāsurā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || teṣāmāsīttadā rājā purukutso balādhikaḥ || 5 || śakrasya vipriyāsakto mṛgayāyai vanaṅgataḥ || vyadhamatkuñjarānmattānbahuvīryasamāśrayaḥ || hastī bhūpālasacivaḥ sa jaghāna harīnvane || 6 || jaghāna saḥ śaila ivātivarṣmā nīlāñjanābho racitāgrahastaḥ || jaghāna taṃ daityavaraṃ prasahya devāsurāṇāṃ samareṣvavadhyam || 7 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakramprati śāmbarāyaṇyupākhyāne dvitīyamanvantarakathāvarṇanannāma saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 177 || <1.178> || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || || auttamasya manoḥ putrāstṛtīyasya nibodha me || ajaśca paraśuścaiva devadevo vṛdho nayaḥ || 1 || devāvṛdhaścāpratimo mahotsāho gajastathā || vinītaśca suketuśca sumitraḥ subalaḥ śuciḥ || 2 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ṛṣayaḥ sapta vai tadā || rajobāhūrdhvabāhū ca savanaścānaghaśca yaḥ || 3 || sutapāḥ śaktirityete ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || vaśavartinaḥ svadhāsāno vaśā satyahā matārdanāḥ || 4 || pañca devagaṇāḥ proktāḥ sarve dvādaśakāstu te || teṣāṃ sucittirnāmā'bhūcchakraḥ parapurañjayaḥ||5|| āsaṃstasyāsurā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || yeṣāmāsīdbalī rājā pralambo nāma nāmataḥ || 6 || śakrasya vipriyāsaktaṃ taṃ samudrāmbuvāhinam || matsyarūpadharo viṣṇurgrastavānbalavattaram || 7 || kālānalābhaṃ tu videśaśatruṃ rūpeṇa mātsyena jagatpracāraḥ || jaghāna taṃ parvatakūṭamātraṃ samudra madhye śaradānatṛptam || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tṛtīyamanvantaravarṇanannāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 178 || <1.179> ||śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || || tāmasasya manoḥ putrāṃścaturthasya nibodha me || jānujaṅghaḥ śāntabhayo naraḥ khyātirnarastathā || 1 || priyabhṛtyo hyavikṣicca prasthilaśca dṛḍheṣudhiḥ || kṛtaśca kṛtagandhaśca tāmasasya manoḥ sutāḥ || 2 || ṛṣirvanaḥ kaṭhīyānvai gātraścaitro'gnireva ca || jyotirvāsāḥ pṛthuḥ kārya ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 3 || satyāḥ supādāḥ surihā haraśceti prakīrtitāḥ || devatānāṃ gaṇā ete catvāraḥ pañcaviṃśakāḥ ||4|| satyānāmapi bhedau dvau satyā viśvāśca kīrtitāḥ || satyā dvādaśa nirdiṣṭā viśvā proktāstrayodaśa||5|| teṣāmāsīnmahātejā śibiriṃdraḥ pratāpavān|| āsaṃstasyāsurā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ ||6|| yeṣāmāsīnmahātejā rājā bhīmarathaḥ prabhuḥ || prasādya yena brahmāṇamavadhyatvaṃ sthale vṛtam || ||7|| jalaṃ sa varjayāmāsa tataḥ prabhṛti durmatiḥ || sa dadarśa marau kūrmaṃ parvatākāradarśanam || 8 || tamāruroha durbuddhiḥ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ || samārūḍhaṃ mahākāyamādāya bhagavānhariḥ || 9 || kūrmarūpadharo vegātpātālajalamāviśat || pātālajalamānīya majjayitvā jaghāna tam || ākramya taṃ mahākāyaṃ mahatā kūrmavarṣmaṇā || 1.179.10 || evaṃ sa kūrmeṇa jale prasahya deveśvarasyāpratimasya śatruḥ || nipātitaḥ sarvasurapradhānaḥ sarveśvareṇā pratimena tena || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde caturthatāmasamanvantaravarṇanannāmaikonāśītyadhikaśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 179 || <1.180> śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || raivatasya manoḥ putrānpañcamasya nibodha me || mahāpurāṇaḥ sambhāvyaḥ pratyaṅgaḥ parahā śuciḥ || 1 || calabindurnirāmitraḥ ketuśṛṃgo dṛḍhavrataḥ || raivatasya manoḥ putrā ṛṣayastasya vacmi te || 2 || vedaśrutirvedabāhurūrdhvabāhuryajustathā || hiraṇyaromā parjanyaḥ satyanetrastathaiva ca || 3 || ābhūtarājasaścaiva tathā devāḥ sumedhasaḥ || vaikuṇṭhāścāmṛtāścaiva catvāro devatāgaṇāḥ || 4 || ekaikasmingaṇe devāḥ kathitāstu caturdaśa || teṣāmindro vibhurnāma loke vikhyātavikramaḥ || 5 || āsaṃstasyāsurā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || teṣāmasīnmahātejāḥ śaṃbhurnāma maheśvaraḥ || 6 || brahmalokena maraṇaṃ vṛtaṃ yena pitāmahāt || sa kadācinmahākāyaṃ samudrajalacāriṇam || 7 || haṃsaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva jagrāha tañcārohati durmatiḥ || ārūḍhamātramādāya brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ || haṃsarūpeṇa tatraiva jaghāna bhagavānhariḥ || 8 || evaṃ sa haṃsena hato mahātmā sarveśvareṇāpratimena tena || mahābalaḥ parvatamātrakāyaḥ surāntakārī samareṣvajeyaḥ || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde indraśāmbarāyaṇīyasaṃvāde pañcamaraivatamanvantaravarṇanannāmāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 180 || <1.181> || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || cākṣuṣasya manoḥ putrānṣaṣṭhasya śṛṇu vāsava || ūruḥ pūruḥ śatadyumnaḥ tapasvī satyavāndhṛtiḥ || 1 || agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaśca tathānagha || haviṣmānunnataḥ śrīmānsudhāmā vijayastathā || 2 || abhimānaḥ sahiṣṇuśca madhuśrīrṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ || āḍhyāḥ prasūtā bhāvyāśca lekhāśca pṛthukāstathā || 3 || aṣṭakāśca gaṇāḥ pañca tadā proktā divaukasām || teṣāṃ manojavo nāma babhūvendraḥ pratāpavān || 4 || āsaṃstasyāsurā ghorāstadā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || yeṣāṃ babhūva nṛpatirmahāmālo balādhikaḥ || 5 || sa kadācidvanaṃ yāto mṛgayāṃ pāpaniścayaḥ || tatra candrāṃśusaṃkāśaṃ dadarśāśvaṃ manoharam || 6 || tamāruroha durbuddhirmṛgāghātacikīrṣayā || tamārūḍhaṃ samādāya tadā vegātturaṅgamaḥ || 7 || gatvā pāre samudrasya cikṣepopari durmatim || kṣiptamātraḥ sa durbuddhiḥ pavanenāpavāhitaḥ || 8 || anāsāditatoyaśca pavanena sa tṛhyate || adyāpi sumahātejā lokālokasya bāhyataḥ || 9 || amṛtyuvaradānena sa tu pāpaḥ svayambhuvaḥ || vāyumārgaṃ samāśritya na tu prāṇairviyujyate || 1.181.10 || evaṃ sa ghoro varadānadarpādamṛtyurastīti kṛtāparādhaḥ || devadvijānāṃ hayarūpadhārī cikṣepa viṣṇuḥ pavanapravāhe || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajra saṃvāde paṣṭhacākṣuṣamanvantaravarṇanannāmaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 181 || <1.182> || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || athānyasya bhaviṣyasya manovairvasvatasya ca || saptamasya pravakṣyāmi tava putrānyaśasvinaḥ||1|| ikṣvākuratha nābhāgo viṣṇuḥ śaryātireva ca || avṛdhyatustathā prāṃśurmahātmā diṣṭa eva ca || 2 || karūṣaśca pṛthudhraśca sudyumnaśca manoḥ sutāḥ || atrirvasiṣṭho bhagavāñjamadagniśca kaśyapaḥ || 3 || gautamaśca bharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha saptamaḥ || devā hyekonapañcāśanmarutaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 4 || dvāvaśvinau vinirdiṣṭau viśvedevāstathā daśa || daśaivāṅgiraso devā hyevaṃ devagaṇā nava || 5 || yeṣāṃ śakrastu mojaṃbī nāmnā śatrukṣayaṅkaraḥ || ghorāstathāpi ye tvāsandaityā dāyādabāndhavāḥ || 6 || teṣāṃ babhūva nṛpatirhiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ || nṛvarāheṇa vapuṣā taṃ jaghāna hariḥ purā ||7|| daityeśvaraṃ taṃ surasaṃghabhīmaṃ mahābalaṃ parvatamātrakāyam || jaghāna cakreṇa hariḥ prasahya rūpaṃ samāsthāya varāhaśīrṣam ||8|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde saptamavaivasvatamanvantaravarṇanannāma dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || ||182 || <1.183> śakra uvāca || asminkalpe mahābhāge bhaviṣyā manavastu ye || teṣāṃ putrānnṛṣīndevāñchakra dāyādabāndhavān || 1 || tasya ghātaṃ tathā kṛṣṇātsarvametatprakīrtaya || sarvajñakalpā bhavatī divyajñānā matā mama || 2 || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || aṣṭamasya bhaviṣyasya sāvarṇasya manoḥ sutān || kathayiṣyāmi te śakra mahābalaparākramān || 3 || vijayaścāvarīvāṃśca nirdohassatyavākkṛtiḥ || cariṣṇuścāpyadhṛṣṇuśca vācaḥ samatireva ca || 4 || sāvarṇasya manoḥ putrānṛṣīṃścaiva nibodha me || aśvatthāmā kṛpo vyāso gālavo dīptimānatha || 5 || ṛṣyaśṛṅgastathā rāma ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || sutapā amṛtābhāśca ātreyāśca gaṇāstrayaḥ || 6 || sarve viṃśatibhirdevagaṇairyuktā mahātmanām || yeṣāmindro bhaviṣyastu balirdānavasattamaḥ || 7|| tvatkṛte devadevena baddho yastridaśeśvaraḥ || dāyādā bāndhavāstasya na bhaviṣyanti vāsava || 8 || śakratvaṃ tena kartavyaṃ manvantaramakaṇṭakam || devadevakaranyastaṃ dānameta nmahāsuraḥ || 9 || trailokyarājā bhavati sāvarṇasyāntare manoḥ || || tasminmanvantare prāpte himaśailālayo balī || 1.183.10 || bhaviṣyati durācāro nānolo nāma rākṣasaḥ || brahmalabdhavaro raudrastrailokyotsādane rataḥ || 11 || taṃ vadhiṣyati dharmātmā viṣṇurgaruḍavāhanaḥ || cakreṇa śatadhāreṇa jagatāṃ hitakāmyayā || 12 || daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ vikaṭograveṣaṃ nīlāñjanābhaṃ bhayadaṃ triloke || cakreṇa devaḥ pravidārya kartā lokaṃ samagraṃ bhayaviprayuktam || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakraśāmbarāyaṇīsaṃvāde'ṣṭamasāvarṇimanvantaravarṇanannāma tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 183 || <1.184> śāṃbarāyaṇyuvāca || brahmaputrasya tu manornavamasya sutāñchṛṇu || dhṛtiketurdīptiketuḥ pañcahasto nirākṛtiḥ || 1 || pṛthuśravā bṛhaddyumna ṛcīko bṛhatāṃ gaṇaḥ || brahmaputrasya te putrā ṛṣayaśca nibodha me || 2 || medhātithirdyutiścaiva savano vasureva ca || jyotiṣmānhavyasatyau ca ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 3 || pārā marīcigarbhāśca svadharmāṇaśca te trayaḥ || gaṇā dvādaśakāḥ proktā yeṣāmindro bhaviṣyati || 4 || vibhurnāma mahātejāḥ sarvadeveśvaro valī || dāyādā bāndhavāstasya ye bhaviṣyanti dhārmikāḥ || 5 || kālakakṣa iti khyātāsteṣāṃ rājā bhaviṣyati || tasminmanvantare rājā vasunābho bhaviṣyati||6|| putrastu bhāvatā tasya vāsudevo mahīpatiḥ || cakravartī mahātejāḥ padmanābha iti śrutaḥ || 7 || devāsure tu saṃgrāme kālakākṣaṃ raṇotkaṭam || naravadhyaṃ mahātejāḥ padmanābho vadhiṣyati|| 8 || śareṇa jāmbūnadabhūṣitena brahmāstrayuktena raṇapracaṇḍam|| hatvāsuraṃ kālasamaprabhāvaṃ rājā sa lokasya bhayaṃ nihantā || 9 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakraśāmbarāyaṇī saṃvāde navamabrahmaputramananvantaravarṇanannāma caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||184|| <1.185> śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || dharmaputrasya tu manordaśamasya sutāñchṛṇu || sukṣetra uttamaujāśca bhūriśoṇaśca vīryavān || 1 || śatānīko nimirmitro vṛṣaseno jayadrathaḥ || bhūridyumnaḥ suvarmā ca dharmaputramanoḥ sutāḥ || 2 || āpomūrtirhaviṣmāṃśca sṛtikiścāvyayastathā || nābhāgaḥ pramitaścaiva saurabhā ṛṣayastathā || 3 || prāṇākhyāḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca devatānāṃ gaṇāstathā || bhavitā tasya bhavitā śāntirindraḥ pratāpavān || 4 || dāyādābāndhavāstasya bhaviṣyantyasurāśca ye || teṣāṃ ca bhavitā rājā bālī nāma mahāsuraḥ || 5 || dyotayiṣyati taṃ viṣṇurgadayā bhīmavegayā || devāsure tu saṃgrāme devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 6 || gadānipātābhihate surendre mahābale devavareṇa tena || trailokyametadbhavitā samagraṃ vinaṣṭadoṣaṃ suraviprajuṣṭam || 7 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakraśāmbarāyaṇīsaṃvāde daśamadharmaputramanvantvavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 185 || <1.186> śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || rudraputrasya te putrānvakṣyāmyekādaśasya tu || dharmanityānmahābhāgāṃstrailokyasya parāyaṇān || 1 || sarvartugaḥ suśarmā ca senānīkaḥ puroddhataḥ || kṣemadhanvā dṛḍhendraśca cādarśaḥ puṇḍrakastathā ||2|| manuputrāḥ smṛtā hyete ṛṣayaśca nibodha me|| haviṣmāṃśca vapuṣmāṃśca varuṇābdhiśca nistaraḥ ||3|| viṣṇuścaivāgnitejāśca ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || nirmathyā rathayaścaiva kāmagāśca gaṇāstrayaḥ || 4 || triṃśattriṃśattathā devā ekaikasmingaṇe smṛtāḥ || teṣāmindro vṛṣo nāma bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ || 5 || dāyādā bāndhavāścaiva bhaviṣyanti surāśca ye || teṣāṃ tu bhavitā rājā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān || 6 || ghātayiṣyati taṃ viṣṇustraiṇaṃ rūpamupāśritaḥ || śūlāgreṇa vinirbhidya raṇe devā'sure tadā || 7 || tamavadhyaṃ durādharṣaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ svayambhuvā || gataṃ tapaḥprabhāve sā viṣṇustaṃ ghātayiṣyati || 8 || nīlotpalābhaṃ tapanīyavarṇaṃ suvṛttajānūruyugaṃ svarūpam || rūpaṃ striyāṃścārutaraṃ sa kṛtvā surārimugraṃ sahasā'rihantā || 9|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathama khaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakraśāmbarāyaṇīsaṃvāde ekādaśamanvantaravarṇanannāma ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 186 || <1.187> śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || manostvaṃ dakṣaputrasya dvādaśasyātmajāñchṛṇu || devavānupadevaśca devaśreṣṭho vidūrathaḥ||1|| mitravānmitradevaśca mitrasenaśca vīryavān|| mitrabāhuḥ suvarcāśca dakṣaputramanoḥ sutāḥ || 2 || sattamo dyaurdyutiścaiva tapanaḥ sutapāstathā || taporatistapasvī ca ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 3 || suśarmāṇaḥ sutapaso haritā rohitāstathā || sutārākhyā gaṇāḥ pañca pratyekaṃ daśako guṇaḥ || 4 || ṛtadhāmā ca dharmātmā teṣāmindraḥ pratāpavān || dāyādā bāndhavāstasya bhaviṣyantyasurāśca ye ||5|| teṣāṃ ca bhavitā rājā narako nāma nāmataḥ || strīpuṃsoḥ sattvavadhyaśca varadānātsvayambhuvaḥ ||6 || harirnapuṃsako bhūtvā ghātayiṣyati taṃ tadā ||7|| devāntakaṃ kālasamaprabhāvaṃ mahāsuraṃ klībavapurmahātmā || nihatya taṃ lokamidaṃ samagraṃ bhītyā vihīnaṃ bhagavānsa kartā || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dvādaśasya dakṣaputrasya manorvaṃśānukīrtanannāma saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 187 || <1.188> śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || trayodaśasya raucyasya manoḥ putrannibodha me || citraseno vicitraśca nayo dharmabhṛto dhṛtiḥ ||1|| sunetro vṛkṣavṛddhiśca sunayo dharmayo dṛḍhaḥ || raucyasyaite manoḥ putrāḥ śṛṇuṣva ṛṣayo mama||2|| dhṛtimānavyayaścaiva niḥprakopo nirutsukaḥ || nirmāṇastattvadarśī ca davayāyata kīrtitāḥ ||3|| sutrāmāṇaḥ sudharmāṇaḥ śubhakarmāṇa eva ca || ete śakra tadā proktā devatānāṃ gaṇāstrayaḥ||4|| ekaikasmingaṇe devā ekādaśa tadā śubhāḥ|| devendraśca tadā teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati bṛhaspatiḥ || 5 || dāyādā bāndhadāstasya ye bhaviṣyanti vāsava || ṭiṭṭibho nāma duṣṭātmā teṣāṃ rājā bhaviṣyati || 6 || tasyāpi bhavitā mṛtyurdevadevājjanārdanāt || māyūreṇa ca rūpeṇa satataṃ pannagāśinā || 7 || sa tu devāsure yuddhe sarparūpeṇa durmatiḥ || yuddhaṃ kṛtvā nirutsāhānsarvāndevagaṇāṃstathā || 8 || niṣprayatneṣu deveṣu māyūraṃ rūpamāśritaḥ|| ghātayiṣyati taṃ duṣṭaṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ||9|| mahākalāpaḥ saśikhī mahātmā prabuddhanīlotpalacārukaṇṭhaḥ || taṃ dānavaṃ tatra raṇe prasahya hatvā trilokīṃ muditāṃ hi kartā || 1.188.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde trayodaśaraucyamanvantaravarṇano nāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 188 || <1.189> śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || caturdaśasya bhautyasya śṛṇu putrānmanormama || taraṅge bhedabhidbudhnyastarasvānugra eva ca || 1 || abhimānī pravīraśca jiṣṇuḥ saṃkrandana stathā || tejasvī sulabhaścaiva bhautyasyaite manoḥ sutāḥ || 2 || agnīdhraścātibāhuśca māgadhaśca tathā śuciḥ || ajito yuktagośakyaṃ ṛṣayaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 3 || cākṣuṣāśca kaniṣṭhāśca pavitrā bhajirāstathā || vayovṛddhā devagaṇāḥ pañca proktāstu saptakāḥ || 4 || teṣāmindraḥ śucirnāma tasya dāyādabāndhavāḥ || ye bhaviṣyanti bhavitā rājā teṣāṃ mahāsukhaḥ || 5 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu yuddhaṃ devāsuraṃ tadā || bhaviṣyati mahāghoraṃ tasyānte taṃ mahāsuram || 6 || āsthitaṃ tāmasīṃ māyāṃ ghātayiṣyati keśavaḥ || ārūḍhaḥ kuñjaraṃ divyaṃ caratparvatasannibham || 7 || utkhātaparvatasamaṃ cakreṇa madhusūdanaḥ || rathasthaṃ taṃ mahādaityaṃ ghātayiṣyati durmatim || 8 || tasminhate vāsavadevaśatrau mahābale kālasamaprabhāve || trailokyametadvirujaṃ samantāttadā bhaviṣyatyamalapratāpam || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde caturdaśabhautyamanuvarṇanannāma navāśītyadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 189 || <1.190> śakra uvāca || asminmanvantare bhadre garuḍasya ca sambhavaḥ || mayā dṛṣṭamatīteṣu kathaṃ garuḍavāhanaḥ || 1 || asurānghātayāmāsa bhaviṣyeṣu tathaiva ca || garuḍaṃ tu samāruhya ghātayiṣyati tatkatham || 2 || manvantarānte sarveṣāṃ kṣayo yasmātprakīrtitaḥ ||| tasmādetanmamācakṣva kuśalā hyasi dhārmikā || 3 || śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca pratimanvantaraṃ yathā || sambhavastridaśaśreṣṭha gandharvāṇāṃ tathā smṛtaḥ || 4 || nāgānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca yakṣāṇāmatha pakṣiṇām || suparṇānāṃ tathā śakra prāṇināmapyaśeṣataḥ || 5 || suparṇānāṃ pradhānastu tatra manvantare tadā || sadaiva rājanbhavati garuḍaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ || 6 || vāhanatve tathā tasya deveśasya prapadyate || prādurbhāvāṇyathoktāni yathā viṣṇormayā tava || 7 || tathaiva tasya jñeyāni garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ || devāstu kṛtakarmāṇaḥ śakra manvantarakṣaye || 8 || tyaktādhikārā gacchanti paralokamitaḥ prabho || talliṅgāśca tathā mantrāstaireva sahitāḥ suraiḥ || 9 || samūhaścaiva mantrāṇāṃ devastridaśapūjitaḥ || śarīrī brahmasadane sa tu nityaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 1.190.10 || yāvajjīvati vai brahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || tadā tu puruṣaṃ brahmā devadevaṃ prapadyate || 11 || tyaktvā śarīraṃ devo'pi puruṣaṃ pratipadyate || puruṣo'pi mahāsṛṣṭiṃ mahābhūtagaṇaṃ tathā || 12 || karoti tadvadeveha devaḥ prāgvacchatakrato || evaṃ sarvamidaṃ nityaṃ tvanityaṃ vā taveritam || 13 || nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ || ubhayorapi dṛṣṭo'ntastvanayostattvadarśibhiḥ || 14 || avināśi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidaṃ tatam || vināśamavyayasyāsya na kaścitkartumarhati || 15 || tasyāvināśinaḥ śakra sūkṣmasyāpi mahātmanaḥ || prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi samatītānyanekaśaḥ || 16 || bhūyaścaiva bhaviṣyati nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || vaivasvate'smindeveśa yathā manvantare śubhe || 17 || prādurbhāvāni dṛṣṭāni mayā tasya mahātmanaḥ || varāhaṃ vāmanaṃ caiva tathā śakra trivikramam || 18 || nārasiṃhaṃ tathā mātsyaṃ kūrmaṃ haṃsaṃ tathaiva ca || nṛvarāhaṃ tathā rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca surasattama || 19 || māndhātāraṃ pṛthuṃ caiva kārtavīryārjunaṃ tathā || dhātāraṃ ca tathā mitraṃ cāṃśumaryamaṇaṃ tathā || 1.190.20 || pūṣaṇaṃ ca bhavantaṃ ca varuṇaṃ bhagameva ca || tvaṣṭāraṃ ca vivasvantaṃ savitāraṃ tathaiva ca || 21 || viṣṇuṃ candramasaṃ rudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ yamameva ca || hutāśanaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ śeṣaṃ nāgeśvaraṃ tathā || 22 || grahamukhyaṃ budhaṃ caiva apaḥ khaṃ pṛthivīṃ tathā || vāyustejaśca deveśa tathaivānyāni vāsava || 23 || prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi tasya dṛṣṭāni yāni te || manvantareṣvatīteṣu tasyātītānyanekaśaḥ || 24 || bhaviṣyanti bhaviṣyeṣu śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || manvantaramathāsādya caikamekaṃ tathā tava||25|| prādurbhāvamidaṃ proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ yataḥ || prādurbhāvānyaśeṣeṇa vāsudevasya cakriṇaḥ || kaḥ samartho bhavedvaktumiha varṣaśatairapi || 26 || ekaḥ sa devo bhuvanasya goptā paraḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣo mahātmā || tasyāṃśamātraṃ bhuvanaṃ samagraṃ bhāgāstrayastasya na varṇanīyāḥ || 27 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakaśāṃbarāyaṇīsaṃvāde'nekaviṣṇuprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma navatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 190 || <1.191> || śakra uvāca || || kena karmavipākena svargatā tvaṃ varānane || dīrghakālamihasthāsi tathā caivāpyanāgatān || 1 || kathaṃ manvantarānvetsi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || tvatsamā divi naivānyā kācidasti cirantanī ||2|| ekarūpaḥ kathaṃ kartā tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ sureśvari || manvantarāṇāṃ jānāsi bhaviṣyāṇāṃ tathā gatim ||3|| śāmbarāyaṇyuvāca || tridive saptamaḥ kalpo mamāyaṃ tridiveśvara|| devadevaprasādena vasantyā vartate'nagha || 4 || parārdhaśca tathā brāhmyo janaloke gato mama || ekarūpāstathā kalpā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ sureśvara || 5 || manvantarāṇāṃ jānāmi bhaviṣyāṇāṃ tathā gatim || mayā mānuṣyamāsādya māsanakṣatrapūjanama || 6 || pratimāsaṃ kṛtaṃ viṣṇoryāvajjīvaṃ sureśvara || tena karmavipākena tridive vasatiściram || mayeyaṃ samanuprāptā devadevaprasādajā || 7 || asmādapi mahābhāga brahmalokaṃ nayatyuta ||8|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etaduktvā mahābhāga śakraṃ sā śāmbarāyaṇī || jagāmādarśanaṃ rājaṃstatraiva surapūjitā ||9 || māsarkṣapūjāmadhikṛtya viṣṇormayā tavedaṃ kathitaṃ samagram || tasmātprayatnena narendracandra māsarkṣapūjāṃ prayateta kartum || 1.191.10 || śrotavyametatprayatena vajra pāpāpahaṃ dharmavivṛddhidaṃ ca || saṃvādamagryaṃ tridaśeśvarasya siddhāṅganāyāśca paraṃ pavitram || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakraśāmbarāyaṇīkathānakaṃ nāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 191 || <1.192> || vajra uvāca|| śrutavānasmi dharmajña devaveśmopalepane || phalaṃ gadati te brahmañchrotumicchāmyahaṃ punaḥ || 1 || lepanādapi yatsvargaphaladaṃ ca yathā bhavet || tanme karma tvamācakṣva sarvajño'si bhṛgūttama ||2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || stutirlaghutarā tasya lepanādapi yādava || tathā bahuphalā proktā tāṃ kuruṣva yadīcchasi || 3 || ye stuvanti mahādevaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || teṣāṃ na durlabhaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca || 4 || vāsudevaṃ stuvanmartyaḥ sarvapāpaṃ vyapohati || svargaṃ cānantyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā||5|| dharmārthī prāpnuyāddharmamarthārthī cāpnuyāddhanam || kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī prajārthī prāpnuyātprajāḥ || 6 || rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt || bhayānmucyeta bhītaśca mucyedāpanna āpadaḥ || 7 || durgāṇyatitaratyāśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam || stuvanmanujaśārdūla nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 8 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena divyairṛṣikṛtaiḥ stavaiḥ || stūyānnarendra satataṃ devadevaṃ subhāṣitaiḥ || 9|| kamalapatraśubhāmalalocanaṃ harimarighnamacintyaparākramam || śaraṇametya mahābhayapīḍitā bhuvi bhavanti narā bhayavarjitāḥ || 1.192.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde stutimāhātmyavarṇano nāma dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 192 || <1.193> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || stutena devadevena gajendrasya tu yatkṛtam || 1 || purā vajra mahābāhū gandharvau yau hāhā hūhū || gītaiḥ parasparaṃ spardhāṃ cakratustau parantapa ||2 || spardhamānau paraṃ rājaṃścakratustau parasparam || āvayoḥ prāśnikaḥ sādhuḥ ko'smim̐lloke bhaviṣyati || 3 || tayorathāhurgandharvā devalo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || evamuktau tatastau tu necchetāṃ devalaṃ munim || 4 || nāyaṃ jānāti gītasya viśeṣamiti mohitau || tau śaśāpa mahākruddho devalaḥ sumahātapāḥ || 5 || avajñā jānato yasmādbhavadbhyāṃ mama vai kṛtā || tasmācchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi yuvayordevagāyanau || 6 || hāhā bhaviṣyati karī hūhū nakro bhaviṣyati || nakraṃ ca devadeveśo gajākarṣaṇatatparam || 7 || nāgastutastu cakreṇa dvidhā kartā tadā yuvām || ubhau sva lapsyatho rūpaṃ śāpasyānte tu gāyanau || 8 || śāpena tau tasya tatastu jātau mayā yathoktau tava rājasiṃha || gajastu tenāpi janārdanena sammocitau tau dvijavaryaśāpāt || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gandharvayorgajanakrīkaraṇaṃ nāma trinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 193 || || <1.194> || vajra uvāca || || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi gajendrasya vimokṣaṇam || vistareṇa mahābhāga śāpānnakrasya cobhayoḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || astyasmiñchṛṅgavānnāma jambūdvīpe kulācalaḥ || mahādhātusamunnaddhairyutaḥ śṛṅgairnabhaṅkaṣaiḥ || 2 || yasya śṛṅgatrayaṃ madhyaṃ bhāti rājanviśeṣavat || brahmārkasomanilayaṃ manohāri divaṃ gatam || 3 || teṣāmathaikaṃ sauvarṇamaparaṃ rājataṃ mahat || sarvaratnamayaṃ caikaṃ madhyamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kṣayam || 4 || kāñcanaṃ sūryanilayaṃ rājataṃ śaśinaḥ kṣayam || trikūṭaṃ śailarājābhaṃ ratnapakṣadrumairyutam || 5 || na tatkṛtaghnāḥ paśyanti na nṛśaṃsā na nāstikāḥ || nātaptatapasaḥ kecinnaiva pāpakṛto janāḥ || 6 || tasya sānumataḥ pṛṣṭhe saro vyākośapaṅkajam || kāraṇḍavasamākīrṇaṃ rājahaṃsopaśobhitam ||7|| saccittamiva gambhīraṃ saccittamiva nirmalam || bahūpayogyaṃ ca tathā satānniṣkṛtikṛnnṛpa || 8 || mīnacchinnābhraśakalasphuṭakahlāratārakam || mahākumudarātrīśaṃ dvitīyamiva cāmbaram || 9 || utphullapadmarajasā madhupaiḥ pari piñjaraiḥ || samantādvyāpya satpadmaṃ tapanīyasamairiva || 1.194.10 || cyutena padmādrajasā haṃsaiḥ keśaramanthanaiḥ || vāyunā bhrāmyamāṇena durvibhāvyodakombujam || 11 || mahāntaḥ padminīpatrā vāyubhrastābhraśīkaraiḥ || yuktā muktāphalākārairyatra bhānti sahasraśaḥ || 12 || nṛtyanti kamalā yatra śapharī sphuraṇāhatāḥ || bhramarodgītasaṃghoṣai rasatsārasanādikam || 13 || hasantamiva haṃsaughairnṛtyantamiva cormibhi || udgīthamiva kurvāṇaṃ kāraṇḍavaravaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 14 || madhye tvagādhaṃ caturaḥ pratīhārairivoddhataiḥ || utsārayantaṃ kallolairvāyukṣiptadrumodbhavān || 15 || bhramarāntarasaṃlīnakahlārakusumākṣubhiḥ|| paśyantamiva śailasya śṛṅgāṇāṃ tanmahocchrayam || 16 || yatrātiśītalaṃ toyaṃ laghu svādu sudhānibham || anyacchraṅgaṃ manohāri bhṛṅganāda nināditam || 17 || tasminsarasi duṣṭātmā virūpo'ntarjaleśayaḥ || hūhūrjagāma grāhatvaṃ śāpādvai devalasya tu || 18 || tasminneva tathā śaile hāhā gandharvasattamaḥ || babhūva yūthapo hastī calatparvatasannibhaḥ || 19 || atha dantojjvalavapuḥ kadācidgajayūthapaḥ || ājagāma mahīpāla cotphulla kamalaṃ saraḥ || 1.194.20 || vaṃśadaṇḍaiḥ sa kalabhairvṛtaścaiva karareṇubhiḥ || vāsayanmadagandhena taṃ trikūṭaṃ mahīdharam || 21 || sa gajo'ñjanasaṃkāśo madākuñcitalocanaḥ || salīlaṃ paṅkajavane yūthamadhyagato vrajam| 22 || gṛhītastena raudreṇa grāheṇāvyaktamūrtinā || paśyataḥ sarvayūthasya krośataścāti dāruṇam || 23 || sa cakāra mahāyatnamātmanaḥ parimokṣaṇe || grāho'pi yatnamātiṣṭhatkuñjarākarṣaṇe mahān || 24 || grāho'pi balinaṃ nāgaṃ na śaśāka mahāmbhasi || ākraṣṭuṃ na ca nāgo'pi tathātmānaṃ vimokṣitum || 25 || visphūrjya ca yathāśakti vikruṣya ca mahāravān || vyathitaḥ sa nirudyogaḥ paścimāmāgato daśām ||26|| sa tu nāgavaraḥ śrīmānnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva ca parantapaḥ||27|| gṛhītvā sa karāgreṇa sarasaḥ kamalottamam || nivedya bhaktyā kṛṣṇāya gajaḥ stotramudīrayat ||28|| gaja uvāca || namonamaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya nārāyaṇāyāsuradāraṇāya || śrīśārṅgacakrāsigadādharāya namo'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya || 29 | ādyāya vedanilayāya mahoragāya siṃhāya daityanilayāya caturbhujāya || brahmendrarudramunicāraṇasaṃstutāya devottamāya varadāya namo'cyutāya || 1.194.30 || nāgendrabhogaśayanāsanasupriyāya gokṣīrahemaśukanīlaghanopamāya || pītāmbarāya madhukaiṭabhanāśanāya bhaktapriyāya varadīptasudarśanāya || 31 || nābhiprajātakamalasthacaturmukhāya kṣīrodakārṇavaniketayaśodharāya || nānāvicitra mukuṭāṅgadabhūṣaṇāya sarveśvarāya vijayāya namo varāya || 32 || viśvātmane paramakāraṇakāraṇāya phullāravindavipulāyatalocanāya || devendrabhāvana parīkṣitapauruṣāya yogīśvarāya vijayāya namo varāya ||33|| lokāyanāya tridaśāyanāya brahmāyaṇāyātmaguṇāyanāya || dharmāyaṇāyaikajanāyanāya mahāvarāhāya sadā nato'smi||34|| acintyamavyaktamanantarūpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāraṇamādidevam || yugāntaśeṣaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ taṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || || 35 || adṛśyamacchedyamanādimadhyaṃ maharṣayo brahmanidhiṃ sureśam || vadanti yaṃ vai puruṣaṃ sanātanaṃ taṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 36 || yamakṣaraṃ brahma vadanti sarvagaṃ niśamya yaṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate || tamīśvaraṃ dṛptamanuttamairguṇaiḥ parāyaṇaṃ viṣṇumupaiti śāśvatam || 37 || kāryakriyākāraṇamaprameyaṃ hira ṇyanābhaṃ kanakāravindam || mahābalaṃ vedanidhiṃ surottamaṃ vrajāmi viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ janārdanam || 38 || vicitrakeyūramahārhaniṣkaṃ ratnottamālaṅkṛtasarva gātram || pītāmbaraṃ kāñcanabhakticitraṃ mālādharaṃ keśavamabhyupaimi || 39 || bhavodbhavaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭhaṃ yogātmanāṃ sāṅkhyavidāṃ variṣṭham || ādityacandrāśvivasuprabhāvaṃ prabhuṃ prapadye'cyutamātmabhūtam || 1.194.40 || śrīvatsāṅkaṃ mahādevaṃ vedaguhyamanuttamam || prapadye sūkṣmamacalaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || 41 || prabhavaṃ sarvalokānāṃ nirguṇaṃ ca guṇātmanām || prapadye muktasaṅgānāṃ yatīnāṃ paramāṃ gatim || 42 || bhagavantaṃ surādhyakṣamakṣaraṃ puṣkarekṣaṇam || śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhaktyā prapadye brāhmaṇapriyam || 43 || brahmādeśaṃ trilokeśamādyamekamanāmayam || bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ prapadye madhusūdanam || 44 || kṣetrajñaṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ triguṇātītamavyayam || nārāyaṇamaṇīyāṃsaṃ prapadye śaraṇaṃ harim || 45 || ekāya lokatantrāya parataḥ paramātmane || namaḥ sahasraśirase anantāya mahātmane || 46 || vareṇyamanaghaṃ devamṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ || kīrtayantyabhavaṃ sarve taṃ prapadye sanātanam || 47 || namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa bhaktānāmabhayaprada || subrahmaṇya namaste'stu trāhi māṃ śaraṇā'gatam || 48 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bhaktiṃ tasya tu sañcintya nāgasyā'moghasaṃstavaḥ || prītimānabhavadrājansadyaścakragadādharaḥ || 49 || sānnidhyaṃ kalpayāmāsa grāhaṃ cakreṇa mādhavaḥ || mokṣayāmāsa ca gajaṃ pāśebhyaḥ śaraṇāgatam || 1.194.50 || sa hi devalaśāpena hāhā gandharvasattamaḥ || gajatvamabhavattyaktvā mokṣaṃ prāpya divaṃ gataḥ ||51|| grāhādvimuktaḥ sadyastu gajo gandharvatāṃ gataḥ || grāho gandharvatāṃ prāpto yaḥ kṛṣṇena nipātitaḥ || || 52 || tasyāpi devalakṛtaḥ śāpadoṣo'bhavatpurā || prītimāṃstrāyate viṣṇuḥ sadyaḥ saṃsārasāgarāt || || 53 || kuddho'pi nighnandevatvamarātīnāṃ prayacchati || tau ca svaṃ svaṃ vapuḥ prāpya praṇipatya janārdanam || 54 || gandharvādhipatī śīghraṃ parāṃ nirvṛtimāgatau || idaṃ caiva mahābāho purā devo'bhyabhāṣata || 55 || dṛṣṭvā muktau gajagrāhau bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || yo'grahīnnāgarājaṃ ca māṃ caiva praṇidhānavān || 56 || smariṣyati saraścedaṃ yuvayormokṣaṇaṃ tathā || gulmaṃ kīcakaveṇūnāmimaṃ śailavaraṃ tathā || 57 || aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṅgāṃ naimiṣāraṇyameva ca || prayāgaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ ca daṇḍakāraṇyameva ca || 58 || saṃsmariṣyanti ye martyā samyakchroṣyanti cāpi ye || na te duḥsvapnapāpasya bhoktāro matparigrahāt || 59 || sarvapāpairvimokṣyanti kalyāṇānāṃ ca bhāginaḥ || bhaviṣyanti tathā puṇyāṃ gatiṃ yāsyanti mānavāḥ || 1.194.60 || duḥsvapnaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ teṣāṃ susvapnatvaṃ prayāsyati || kaurmyaṃ mātsyaṃ ca vārāhaṃ vāmanaṃ tārkṣyameva ca || 61 || nārasiṃhaṃ tathā rūpaṃ sṛṣṭipralayakārakam || etāni prātarutthāya saṃsmariṣyanti ye narāḥ || 62 || sarvapāpairviśuddhāste yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamuktvā tu rājendra devadevo janārdanaḥ || 63 || aspṛśadgajagandharvaṃ grāhagandharvameva ca || tena spṛṣṭau tu tau sadyo divyamālyāmbarānvitau || 64 || vimāne'bhimate prāpte jagmatustridaśālayam || tatra devapatiḥ kṛṣṇo mokṣayitvā gajottamam || 65 || ṛṣibhistūyamānastu guhyairvedapadākṣaraiḥ || gataḥ sa bhagavānviṣṇurdurvijñeyagatirvibhuḥ || 66 || gajendramokṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve sendrapurogamāḥ || brāhmaṇānagrataḥ kṛtvā sarve prāñjalayo'bhavan || 67 || gajendramokṣaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavimocanam || śrāvayanprātarutthāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 68 || śraddhayā hi yaduśreṣṭha smṛtena kathitena ca || gajendramokṣaṇenaiva dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt || 69 || mayā te kathitaṃ divyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || kīrtayasva mahābāho mahāduḥsvapnanāśanam || 1.194.70 || kīrtyamānaṃ ca viprebhyaḥ śṛṇu bhaktyā yathoditam ||71|| varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varapadmanābhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ padmanidhiṃ sureśam || taṃ devaguhyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ vavandire brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhāḥ || 72 || etatpuṇyaṃ yaduśreṣṭha narāṇāṃ pāpakarmiṇām || duḥsvapnadarśane ghore śrutvā pāpātpramucyate || 73 || bhaktimānpuṇḍarīkākṣe gajo duḥkhādvimocitaḥ || tathā tvamapi rājendra prapadya śaraṇaṃ harim || 74 || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prāpsyase paramāṃ gatim ||74||| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gajendramokṣaṇaṃ nāma caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 194 || <1.195> || vajra uvāca || bhagavankīdṛśīṃ rakṣāṃ sa cakāra dvijottamaḥ || yathā nirdhūtavīryo'sau nistaro rajanīcaraḥ || 1 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ekāgracitto govinde tajjapam̐statparāyaṇaḥ || sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ praviṣṭo viṣṇupañjaram || 2 || vajra uvāca || viṣṇupañjaramicchāmi śrotuṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || sadā sarvabhayebhyastu rakṣāyāṃ paramā bhavet || 3 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tripuraṃ jaghnuṣaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇupañjaram || śaṅkarasya yaduśreṣṭha rakṣaṇāya nirūpitam || 4 || vāgīśena tu śakrasya balaṃ hantuṃ prayāsyataḥ || tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi tannibodha mahīpate || 5 || viṣṇuḥ prācyāṃ sthitaścakrī viṣṇurdakṣiṇato gadī || pratīcyāṃ śārṅgabhṛdvipṇurviṣṇuḥ khaḍgī mamottare || 6 || hṛṣīkeśo vikoṇeṣu tacchidreṣu janārdanaḥ || kroḍarūpī harirbhūmau hantuṃ pretaniśācarān||7|| gadā ceyaṃ sahasrāṃśurudvamatpāvakolbaṇā || rakṣobhūtapiśācānāṃ ḍākinīnāṃ ca śātanī || 8 || śārṅgavisphūrjitaṃ caiva vāsudevasya madripūn || tiryaṅmanuṣyakūṣmāṇḍapretādīnhantvaśeṣataḥ || 9 || khaḍgadhārāmalajyotsnā nirdhūtā ye samāhitāḥ || te yāntu saumyatāṃ sadyo garuḍeneva pannagāḥ || 1.195.10 || ye kūṣmāṇḍāstathā yakṣā ye daityā ye niśācarāḥ || pretā vināyakāḥ krūrā manuṣyā jambukāḥ khagāḥ || || 11 || siṃhādayo ye paśavo dandaśūkāśca pannagāḥ || sarve bhavantu te saumyāḥ kṛṣṇaśārṅgaravāhatāḥ || 12 || cittavṛttiharā ye me ye janāḥ smṛtihārakāḥ || balaujasāṃ ca hantāraśchāyāvibhraṃśakāśca ye || 13 || ye copabhogahartāro ye ca lakṣaṇanāśakāḥ || kūṣmāṇḍāste praṇaśyantu viṣṇucakrarayāhatāḥ || 14 || buddhisvāsthyaṃ manaḥsvāsthyaṃ svāsthyamaindriyakaṃ tathā || mamāstu devadevasya vāsudevasya kīrtanāt || 15 || pṛṣṭhe purastānmama dakṣiṇottare vikoṇataścāstu janārdano hariḥ || tamīḍyamīśānamanantavikramaṃ janārdanaṃ praṇipatito na sīdati || 16 || yathā parambrahma haristathā paraṃ jagatsvarūpaṃ ca sa eva keśavaḥ || satyena tenācyutanāmakīrtanātpraṇāśametu trividhaṃ mamāśubham || 17 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde viṣṇupañjarastotravarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 195 || <1.196> vajra uvāca || ātmarakṣā tvayoktā me sarvabādhāvināśinī || kṛpānvitaiḥ kathaṃ kāryā pararakṣā bhṛgūttama || 1 || etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ vijñānamayo nidhiḥ || vaiṣṇavāni rahasyāni sarvāṇi viditāni te || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || stotreṇānena dharmajña kuśāgrairmārjayannaram || upaspṛśya śuciḥ kuryādrakṣā pārthivasattama ||3|| sopavāsena sampūjya devadevaṃ janārdanam || amoghaiṣā bhavedrakṣā kṛtā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||4|| yathākathañcitkṛtvaināṃ naro mocayate rujaḥ || ādhivyādhigṛhītānāṃ rakṣaiṣā bheṣajaṃ param || 5 || oṃ namaḥ paramārthāya puruṣāya mahātmane || 6 || arūpabahurūpāya vyāpine paramātmane || niṣkalmaṣāya śuddhāya dhyātṛpāpaharāya ca||7|| namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ || varāhanārasiṃhāya vāmanāya mahātmane || 8 || vakṣyāmi tvāṃ namaskṛtya yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ || trivikramāya rāmāya vaikuṇṭhāya narāya ca ||9|| vakṣyāmi tvāṃ namaskṛtya yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ || 1.196.10 || varāha narasiṃheśa vāmaneśa trivikrama || 11 || hayagrīveśa sarveśa hṛṣīkeśa harā'śubham || aparājita cakrādyaiścaturbhiḥ paramāyudhaiḥ || 12 || akhaṇḍitānubhāvaistvaṃ sarvaduḥkhaharo bhava || harā'mukasya duritaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ durupoṣitam || 13 || mṛtyubandhātibhayadaṃ duriṣṭasya ca yatphalam || parāpadhyānasahitaṃ prayuktaṃ cābhicārikam || 14|| garasparśamahārogaprayogaṃ jarayājara || oṃnamo vāsudevāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya śārṅgiṇe || 15 || namaḥ puṣkaranetrāya keśavāyādicakriṇe || namaḥ kamalakiñjalkapītanirmalavāsase || 16 || mahāhavaripuskandhapṛṣṭhacakrāya cakriṇe || daṃṣṭroddhṛtakṣitibhṛte trayīmūrtimate namaḥ || 17 || mahāyajñavarāhāya śeṣabhogoruśāyine || taptahāṭakakeśāya jvalatpāvakalocana || 18 || vajrādhikanakhasparśa divyasiṃha namo'stu te || kāśyapāyātihrasvāya ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpiṇe || 19 || tubhyaṃ vāmanarūpāya kramate gāṃ namonamaḥ || varāhā'śeṣaduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni vai || 1.196.20 || mardamarda mahādaṃṣṭa mardamarda ca yatphalam || narasiṃha karālāsya dantaprāntānalojjvala || 21 || bhañjabhañja ninādena duṣṭānbhaktārtināśana || ṛgyajuḥsāmagarbhābhirvāgbhirvāmanarūpadhṛk || 22 || praśamaṃ sarvaduḥkhāni nayaitasya janārdana || ekāhnikaṃ dvyahnikaṃ ca tathā tridivasajvaram || 53 || cāturthikaṃ tathātyugraṃ tathaiva satatajvaram || doṣotthaṃ sannipātotthaṃ tathaivāgantukaṃ jvaram || 24 || śamaṃ nayatu govindaśchittvā chittvāsya vedanām || netraduḥkhaṃ śiroduḥkhaṃ duḥkhaṃ codarasambhavam || 25 || anucchvāsamatiśvāsaṃ paritāpaṃ ca vepathum || gudaghrāṇādirogāṃśca kuṣṭharogaṃ tathā kṣayam || 26 || kāmalādīṃstathā rogānpramehāṃścātidāruṇān || bhagandarātisārāṃśca mukharogaṃ savalgulim|| 27|| aśmarīmūtrakṛcchrāṃśca rogānanyāṃśca dāruṇān || ye vātaprabhavā rogā ye ca pittasamudbhavāḥ || 28 || kaphodbhavāśca ye kecidye kecitsānnipātikāḥ || āgantavaśca ye rogā lūtāvisphoṭakādayaḥ || 29|| te sarve praśamaṃ yāntu vāsudevāpamārjitāḥ || vilayaṃ yāntu te sarve viṣṇoruccāraṇena ca||1.196.30 || kṣayaṃ gacchantu cāśeṣāste cakrābhihatā hareḥ|| astutānantagovindanāmoccāraṇabheṣajāt || 31 || naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmyaham || sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṛtrimaṃ cāpi yadviṣam || 32 || dantodbhavaṃ nakhabhavamākāśaprabhavaṃ viṣam|| lūtādiprabhavaṃ yacca viṣamatyantaduḥkhadam || 33 || śamaṃ nayatu tatsarvaṃ kīrtito hi janārdanaḥ || grahānpretagrahāṃścaiva tathā caivāryakagrahān || 34 || mukhamaṇḍalikānkrūrānrevatīṃ vṛddharevatīm || vṛddhikākhyāngrahāṃścogrāṃstathā mātṛgrahānapi ||35|| bālasya viṣṇoścaritaṃ hantu bālagrahānimān || vṛddhānāṃ ye grahāḥ kecidye ca bālagrahāḥ kvacit ||36|| narasiṃhasya dṛṣṭyā te dagdhā ye cāpi yauvane || saṭākarālavadano narasiṃho mahāravaḥ || 37 || grahānaśeṣānniḥśeṣānkarotu jagato hitaḥ || narasiṃha mahāsiṃha jihvājvālojjvalānana || 38 || grahānaśeṣānsarveśa khādakhādāgnilocana || ye rogā ye mahotpātā yadviṣaṃ ye mahāgrahāḥ || 39 || yāni ca krūrabhūtāni grahapīḍāśca dāruṇāḥ || śastrakṣateṣu ye doṣā jvālāgardabhikādayaḥ || 1.196.40 || tāni sarvāṇi sarvātmanparamātmañjanārdana || kañcidrūpaṃ samāsthāya vāsudevāśu nāśaya || 41 || kṣiptvā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ jvālāmālāvibhīṣaṇam || sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ kuru devavarā'cyuta || 42|| sudarśana mahājvāla cchindhicchindhi ca māraya || sarvāṇi duṣṭarakṣāṃsi kṣapayā'tivibhīṣaṇa || 43 || prācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi dakṣiṇottaratastathā || rakṣāṃ karotu sarvasmānnarasiṃhaḥ svagarjitaiḥ || 44 || bhuvyantarikṣe ca divi pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhato'grataḥ || rakṣāṃ karotu bhagavānbahurūpī janārdanaḥ || 45 || yasmādviṣṇurjagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || tena satyena duṣṭāni śamamasya vrajantu vai || 46 || yathā viṣṇusmṛtau sadyaḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yāti pātakam || satyena tena sakalaṃ duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu || 47 || paramātmā yathā viṣṇurvedānteṣvabhigīyate || tena satyena sakalaṃ yanmayoktaṃ tathā'stu tat || 48 || śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu praṇaśyatvasukhaṃ ca yat || vāsudevaśarīrotthaiḥ kuśaiḥ saṃmārjito mayā || 49 || apāmārjati govindo naro nārāyaṇastathā || tathāstu sarvaduḥkhānāṃ praśamo vacanāddhareḥ || 1.196.50|| śāntāḥ samagrarogāste grahāḥ sarve viṣāṇi ca || bhūtāni ca praśāntāni saṃsmṛte madhusūdane || 51 || etatsamastarogeṣu sarvabhūtabhayeṣu ca || apāmārjanakaṃ śastraṃ viṣṇunāmā'bhimantritam || 52 || śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu || yadasya duritaṃ kiñcittatkṣiptaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi || 53 || svāsthyamasya sadaivā'stu hṛṣīkeśasya kīrtanāt || yata evā''gataṃ pāpaṃ tatraiva pratigacchatu || 54 || etadrogādipīḍāsu jantūnāṃ hitamicchatā || viṣṇubhaktena kartavyamapāmārjanakaṃ param || 55 || anena sarvaduḥkhāni praśamaṃ yāntyasaṃśayam || sarvabhūtahitārthāya kuryāttammātsadaiva hi || 56 || nādyantavantaḥ kavayaḥ purāṇāssūkṣmā bṛhanto hyanuśāsitāraḥ || sarvajvarāndyantu tavāniruddhapradyumnasaṃkarṣaṇavāsudevāḥ || 57 || ete kuśā viṣṇuśarīrasambhavā janārdano'haṃ svayameva cāgataḥ || hataṃ mayā duṣṭamaśeṣamasya svastho bhavatveṣa yathā vaco hareḥ || 58 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sattvabādhāpraśamanaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||196|| <1.197> vajra uvāca || jagatsaṣṭiprasaṃgena corvaśīsambhavastvayā || kathitastu mahābhāga tatprasaṅgena cāparāḥ||| ||1|| kathitāśca kathā brahmandharmayuktā manoharāḥ || viṣṇormāhātmyasaṃyuktāḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahāḥ ||2|| kaśyapasya tu yā patnī khaśānāmnī tvayeritā|| yasyāḥ putrau mahātmānau kathitau yakṣarākṣasau || 3 || tayorutpattimicchāmi śrotuṃ vaṃśaṃ tathaiva ca || prastutā jagadutpattiṃ nikhilena prakīrtaya ||4|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || rākṣasaṃ pūrvasandhyāyāṃ janayāmāsa sā khaśā || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ piṅgalodbaddhalocanam || 5 || ākarṇadāritā'syaṃ ca sthūlanāsāgramulbaṇam || vikacaṃ vikaṭāṭopaṃ śaṅkukarṇaṃ vibhīṣaṇam || 6 || tathaivāparasandhyāyāṃ saiva yakṣaṃ vyajāyata || tādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa yādṛśenaiva rākṣa sam || 7 || kṣiṇomi mātaraṃ yakṣaḥ kṣubhitastāmabhāṣata || rakṣeti mātaraṃ tāṃ tu yakṣaṃ vai rākṣaso'bravīt || 8 || rakṣaṇādrākṣasaḥ proktaḥ kṣaṇādyakṣaḥ sa ucyate || bhāryā babhūva yakṣasya devarāmā kṛtasthalā || 9 || yakṣo rājatanābhākhyastasyāstasya sutaḥ smṛtaḥ || anurhrādasutā bhāryā tasyāsīnnṛpa guhyakā ||1.197.10|| vīro maṇicaraścaiva vīrabhadrastathaiva ca|| tasyāḥ putrāvubhau khyātau devatulyau manīṣiṇau ||11|| kakutsthatanaye bhārye tayorāstāṃ narādhipa||| rājanpuṇyajanīnāma prathamasya babhūva sā ||12|| tathā devajanīnāma dvitīyasyā'pi yādava || tasyāḥ puṇyajanā yakṣā deva devajanāstathā || kathitā bahusāhasrā mahābalaparākramāḥ || 13 || śubhairvivāhairnṛpa yakṣavaṃśairyakṣāstu jātā bahuśīlayuktāḥ || dharmasthitāḥ satyaparā vinītā mahānubhāvā varadā vareṇyāḥ || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde yakṣotpattirnāma saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 197 || <1.198> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ajaḥ ṣaṇḍaḥ piśācau dvau bhūpāla kapiśāsutau || piśācī brahmadhānākhyā tatrājasya sutā matā ||1|| piśācī yātudhānākhyā ṣaṇḍasya tanayā matā || ajaśca rājaṣaṇḍaśca niśīthe kṣudhitāvubhau ||2|| bahirbhṛtyau tu sahitau dṛṣṭavantau nareśvara || rākṣasaṃ kṣudhitākāraṃ patantaṃ kṣudhitaṃ niśi ||3|| gṛhītaḥ sa piśācābhyāṃ kṣudhitābhyāṃ yadā balī || pṛṣṭaḥ sa tābhyāṃ yatnena dṛṣṭvā tasya tadā balam || 4 || jagāda bhūmipaśreṣṭha cobhayorjanmakāraṇam || janma karma ca tau tasya śrutvā piśitabhojanau || 5 || dadatuḥ kanyake tasya rākṣasasya narāśinaḥ || bhāryādvayasya vaṃśau dvau rākṣasasya prakīrtitau || 6 || brahmadhānānvaye tasya brahmadhānā niśācarāḥ || yātudhānānvaye tasya yātudhānāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 7 || brahmadhānānvaye jātānādau vakṣyāmi rākṣasān || yajñahā nirdhanikṣepā brahmapūto'tha nighnavān || 8 || śvānakṛtkuntalaḥ sarpo brahmadhānātmajāḥ smṛtāḥ || teṣāmanvayasambhūtāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 9 || śleṣmātakavanasthānāḥ kathitā brahmarākṣasāḥ || hetiḥ prahetirugraśca pauruṣādo vadhastathā || 1.198.10 || vidyutsphūrjaśca vātaśca naso vyāghrastathaiva ca || susakṛcca karālaśca yātudhānātmajā daśa || 11 || sūryasyānucarā hyete saha tena bhramanti vai || teṣāmanvayasambhūtā yātudhānāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 12 || hetiprahetivaṃśau dvau tava vakṣyāmi yādava || hetiputraḥ smṛto laṅkuryasya sālakaṭaṅkaṭāḥ || 13 || sandhyāsutā smṛtā bhāryā sukeśastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ || mālī sumālī ca tathā mālyavāṃśca mahābalaḥ || 14 || sukeśatanayā hyete devāsurabhayaṅkarāḥ || tapasā taiḥ samārādhya devadevaṃ janārdanam || 15 || vīryamapratimaṃ prāptaṃ laṅkā caiva mahāpurī || sumālitanayā tatra kaikasī nāma rākṣasī || 16 || bhāryā viśravasaḥ putro yasyā rāvaṇasaṃjñakaḥ || trilokavijayī tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ || 17 || sumālī vasunā yuddhe dhareṇa vinipātitaḥ || mālī ca devadevena keśavena nipātitaḥ || 18 || mālyavāṃstatra varṣātmā jīvatyadyāpi yādava || śrāvitau bhrātarau yena purā devaraṇotsukau || 19 || hitaṃ dharmyaṃ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ na ca tātasya cakratuḥ || tena tau nidhanaṃ prāptau rākṣasau samaradvaye || 1.198.20 || saṃśrāvitastena tathaiva vākyaṃ sa rāvaṇo nāma virodhakāle || ullaṃghya vākyaṃ nidhanaṃ jagāma dharme sthitasyā pratimaprabhāvaḥ ||21|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde hetivaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ |||198|| <1.199> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || prahetitanayo rājanpulomā nāma viśrutaḥ || krodhadṛṣṭyā tu yaḥ śīghraṃ cyavanena vināśitaḥ ||1|| vajra uvāca || cyavanena kimarthaṃ vai pulomā rākṣaso hataḥ || kathaṃ ca bhṛguśārdūla tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pulomno dānavendrasya dve kanye bhuvi viśrute|| pulomā bhṛgave dattā śacī dattā ca vāsave ||3 || kanyābhāve rudantīṃ tu kadācidyadunandana || pulomāmuktavānrājanpulomā dānaveśvaraḥ || 4 || he rakṣaḥ kanyakāmetāṃ gṛhṇīṣva rudatīṃ balāt || etasminneva kāle tu pulomno bhavanājire || 5 || chidrānveṣī durācāraḥ pulomā sa vyatiṣṭhata || anusṛtya ca jagrāha tāṃ kanyāṃ cārulocanām || 6 || nirbhartsya taṃ durācāraṃ pulomā dānavottamaḥ || kālena pradadau kanyāṃ bhṛgave tāṃ sumadhyamām || |7 || antarvatnīṃ tu rahitāṃ bhṛguṇā tāmaninditām || agnihotragatāṃ dṛṣṭvā pulomāgnimathābravīt || 8 || paulomī yadi matpūrvā seyaṃ pāvaka śaṃsa me || tāmagnirabravīttasya seyaṃ patnī bhṛgoḥ śubhā || 9 || evamagnerbhṛgoḥ śrutvā tāṃ jahāra sa rākṣasaḥ || tasyāṃ tu dṛśyamānāyāṃ garbhaḥ kukṣestadā cyutaḥ || 1.199.10 || cyavanāccyavano nāma babhūva sa mahātapāḥ || dṛṣṭamātrastu tenā'sau pulomā bhasmasādgataḥ || 11 || pulomāśrunipātena nadī jātā vadhūvarā || vahniśca sarvabhakṣyatvaṃ bhṛguśāpādupāgataḥ || 12 || hutāśanastu saṃkuddhaśśāpaṃ prāpya dvijottamāt || lokakāryaratirbrahmā svayaṃ vacanamabravīt || 13 || vahne tavārcibhiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ śuci sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || śucibhūtaṃ tataḥ paścādbhakṣayiṣyatyasaṃśayam || 14 || etattavoktaṃ cyavanasya janma nāśastathā rākṣasapuṅgavasya || vahneḥ śucitvaṃ ca tathārciṣāṃ vai vaṃśaṃ pulomno'tha nibodha rājan || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde cyavanotpattivarṇano nāma navanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 199 || <1.200> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || pulomnastanayaḥ śrīmānmadhurnāma niśācaraḥ || viniṣkṛṣya svakācchūlācchūlaṃ prādādvṛṣadhvajaḥ || 1 || tapasā toṣito yasya saputrasya mahātmanaḥ || trailokyavijayāsakte tena rājendra rāvaṇe ||2 || dīkṣite meghanāde ca tathā yāte nikumbhilām || antarjalagate vīre tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇe || 3 || nidrāvaśagate rājankumbhakarṇe suradviṣi || mālinastanayā tena rāvaṇasya svasā hṛtā || 4 || kumbhīlasī mahābhāgā rūpadraviṇasaṃyutā || yasyāmasya suto jajñe lavaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ || 5 || yena śūlaprabhāveṇa māndhātā vinipātitaḥ || na tasya putro bhāryā vā babhūvātidurātmanaḥ || 6 || prāṇināṃ puruṣādyānāṃ sahasrairdaśabhirnṛpa || āhāramāhnikaṃ tasya bhavatyaudarikasya tu || 7 || rāmājñayā tasya babhūva rājanrāmānujo mṛtyuradīnasattvaḥ|| śatrughnanāmā bhuvanasya vīro mahāntarastho hariraprameyaḥ || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde prahetivaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 200 || <1.201> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || yakṣe rākṣase jāte tataḥ kālena kenacit || eṣā suṣāva gandharvaṃ śailūṣamiti viśrutam ||1 || koṭyastisrastu putrāṇāṃ tasyāsansudurātmanaḥ || etasminneva kāle tu visṛṣṭāsu prajāsu ca || 2 || brahmādideśa rājyāni jātyāṃ jātyāṃ yathākramam || gandharvāṇāmadhipatiṃ cakre citrarathaṃ tathā || 3 || śailūṣaputrā gandharvā saṃghaśaḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ || śāsanenaiva tiṣṭhanti tasya citrarathasya tu || 4 || sindhorubhayakūleṣu deśamutsādya te tadā || hatvā ca manujāṃstatra nivasanti gatavyathāḥ || 9 || utsādayanto rāṣṭrāṇi rājñāṃ vipriyakārakāḥ || tāñśaśāpa sa gandharvarājaścitrarathaḥ prabhuḥ || 6 || adharmaniratāḥ sarve mānuṣādvadhamāpsyatha ||7|| śāpena tasyāpratimena rājangandharvarājāti balasya saṃkhye || babhūva mṛtyurbharatastu teṣāṃ dehāntarastho hariraprameyaḥ || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣavaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 201 || <1.202> vajra uvāca || śailūṣaputrā gandharvā bharatena kathaṃ hatāḥ|| kimarthaṃ tu mahābhāga tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ayodhyāyāmayodhyāyāṃ rāme daśarathātmaje || kaikeyādhipatiḥ śrīmānyudhājinnāma pārthivaḥ || 2|| rāmāya preṣayāmāsa dūtaṃ bharata mātulaḥ || vṛddhaṃ purohitaṃ gārgyaṃ yena kāryeṇa tacchṛṇu ||3|| sindhorubhayakūleṣu rāmadeśo manoharaḥ || hatvā raṇe manuṣyendrāngandharvairviniveśita||4|| gandharvāste ca rājendra rājñāṃ vipriyakārakāḥ || lakṣmaṇaṃ bharataṃ vāpi śatrughnamathavā nṛpa || 5 || visarjayitvā gandharvāṃstānvināśaya rāghava || rājāno nirbhayāḥ santu deśaścāstu tathā tava || 6 || dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ || meghanādavadhe karma lakṣmaṇena mahatkṛtam || 7 || śatrughnena kṛtaṃ karma lavaṇaṃ ca vinighnatā|| preṣayiṣyāmi bharataṃ gandharvasya ca nigrahe ||8|| ityevaṃ manasi dhyātvā rāmo bharatamabravīt || gaccha gārgyaṃ puraskṛtya vatsa rājagṛhaṃ svayam ||9|| mātulena samāyuktaḥ kaikayendragṛhāttataḥ || jahi śailūṣatanayāngandharvānpāpaniścayān || 1.202.10 || evamuktaḥ sa dharmātmā bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ || rāmasya pādau śirasā cābhivandya kṛtāñjaliḥ || 11 || gṛhaṃ gatvā cakārātha sarvaṃ prāsthānikaṃ vidhim || oṣadhīnāṃ kaṣāyeṇa tadotplāvitavigrahaḥ || 12 || gaurasarṣapakalkena prasāditaśiroruhaḥ || tīrthasārasanādeyaiḥ salilaiśca sa sāgaraiḥ || 13 || candanasrāvasammiśraiḥ kuṃkumākṣodasaṃyutaiḥ || sarvauṣadhisamāyuktaiḥ sarvagandhasamanvitaiḥ || 14 || mantrapūtairmahātejāḥ sasnau rāghavavardhanaḥ || śaṅkhabherī ninādena paṇavānāṃ svanena ca || 15 || ānakānāṃ ca śabdena nisvanena ca bandinām || sūtamāgadhaśabdena jayakāraistathaiva ca || 16 || tuṣṭavuḥ snānakāle taṃ stavairmaṅgalapāṭhakāḥ || tathopatasthurgītena gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 17 || snātaḥ sa bharato lakṣmyā yuvarājābhirūpayā || vilipya cārusarvāṅgaṃ candanena sugandhinā || 18 || ahatāmbarasaṃvītaḥ śvetamālyavibhūṣaṇaḥ || kuṇḍalī sāṅgadī maulī sarvaratnavibhūṣitaḥ || 19 || antasthaṃ pūjayāmāsa devadevaṃ trivikramam || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpādikarmaṇā||1.202.20|| pūjayitvā jagannāthamupatasthe hutāśanam || suhutaṃ brāhmaṇendreṇa rāghavāṇāṃ purodhasā || 21 || gobhirvastrairhiraṇyaiśca turaṅgakaripuṅgavaiḥ || modakaiḥ saphalairdadhnā gandhairmālyaistathākṣataiḥ || 22 || svastivādyāṃstathā viprānmahātmā bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || vyāghracarmottare ramye sūpaviṣṭo varāsane || 23 || āyudhānantaraṃ cakre dhvajacchatrābhipūjanam || svastikānvardhamānāṃśca nandyāvartāstathaiva ca || 24 || nadyaḥ kāñcanavinyastāḥ śaṅkhaḥ satkamalāñjanam || pūrṇakumbhaṃ gajamadaṃ dūrvāḥ sārdraṃ ca gomayam || 25 || ratnānyādāya bilvaṃ ca cāpamādāya satvaraḥ || saśaraṃ rāghavaśreṣṭhaḥ padadvātriṃśakaṃ yayau || 26 || śreṣṭhamaśvaṃ sucandrābhaṃ hemabhāṇḍaparicchadam || āruhya niryayau śrīmāñjayakārābhipūjitaḥ || 27 || paurajānapadāmātyairvādyaghoṣeṇa bhūriṇā || hrādena gajaghaṇṭānāṃ bṛṃhitena punaḥpunaḥ || 28|| heṣitena turaṅgāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ kṣveḍitena ca || dvijapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa prayāto bhūridakṣiṇaḥ || 29 || bharatasya prayāṇe tu devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vāca ūcuḥ śubhāstathā || 1.202.30 || eṣa vigrahavāndharma eṣa satyavatāṃ varaḥ || eṣa vīryavatāṃ śreṣṭho rūpeṇāpratimo bhuvi || 31 || anena yatkṛtaṃ karma rāme vanamupāgate || na tasya kartā loke'smindivi vā vidyate kvacit || 32 || anena rājyaṃ santyaktaṃ gṛhaṃ dagdhamivāgninā || anena duḥkhaśayyāsu śayitaṃ samahātmanā || 33 || nityamāsannabhogena jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇā || phalamūlāśinānena rāmarājyaṃ hi pālitam || 34 || śṛṇvansuvākyāni sureritāni rāmānujo rāmagṛhaṃ jagāma || śūrāryavidvatpuruṣopakīrṇaṃ ratnairyathā sāgaramaprameyam || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bharataprasthānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 202 || <1.203> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || gṛhātprayāte bharate prasthānārthini yādava || prāgeva lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo nityodyuktamabhāṣata || 1 || anuyānaṃ kumārasya bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || preṣayāśvasahasrāṇāṃ śatāni trīṇi rāghava || 2 || daśa dantisahasrāṇi rathānāṃ ṣaḍguṇāni ca || koṭyaḥ pañca padātīnāṃ samareṣvanivartinām || 3 || dhanādhyakṣāstathā vatsamanugacchantu lakṣmaṇa || gorathaiśca tathā puṣṭairgobhiruṣṭraistathaiva ca || 4 || vyāyataiḥ puruṣairaśvairgardabhaiśca tathā varaiḥ || vastrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ maṇīnāmapi bhāgaśaḥ || 5 || visargāya kumārasya paripūrṇā yathāsukham || brāhmaṇāḥ kathayā mukhyāstathaiva naṭavartakāḥ || 6 || gīte nṛtte tathā lāsye pravīṇāśca varāṅganāḥ || prāsthānikāśca ye kecitpānavikrayiṇaśca ye || 7 || rūpājīvāśca vaṇijo nānāpaṇyopajīvinaḥ || nānārūpamupādāya bahupaṇyaṃ vrajantu vai||8|| viṣavaidyāḥ śalyavaidyāstathā kāyacikitsakāḥ || karmantikā sthapatayo mārgiṇo vṛkṣaropakāḥ || 9 || kūpakārāḥ sudhākārā vaṃśakarmakṛtastathā || vāṇikkārāśca ye kecitkūrcakārāśca śobhanāḥ || 1.203.10 || parikarmakṛtaścaiva tathā vastropajīvinaḥ || māyūrikāstaittirikāścetakā bhedakāśca ye || 11 || rañjakā dantakārāśca tathā dantopajīvinaḥ || eraṇḍavetrakārāśca kaṭakārāśca śobhanāḥ || 12 || ārakūṭakṛtaścaiva tātrakūṭāstathaiva ca || bhūrjakūṭāḥ khaḍgakārā guḍasīdhuprapācakāḥ || 13 || aurabhrakā māhiṣakāstunnavāyāśca lakṣmaṇa || ye cābhiṣṭāvakāḥ kecitsūtamāgadhabandinaḥ || 14 || cailanirṇejakāścaiva carmakārāstathaiva ca || aṅgārakorāśca tathā lubdhakā ye ca dhīvarāḥ || 15 || kabandhadhāriṇo ye ca ye ca kāṣṭhaprapāṭakāḥ || vastrasīvanasaktāśca gṛhakārāśca ye narāḥ || 16 || kumbhakārāśca ye kecicchmaśruvardhakinaśca ye || lekhakā gaṇakā ye ca tathā tandulakārakāḥ || 17 || saktukārāśca ye kecicchākapaṇyopajīvinaḥ || tailikā gāndhikāścaiva tīrthasaṃśuddhikārakāḥ ||16|| citrakarmavido ye ca ye ca lāṅgūlikā janāḥ || sūtāḥ paurogavāścaiva sauvidallāśca lakṣmaṇa || 19 || gopā vanacarā ye ca nadītīravicāraṇāḥ || gosaṃghairmahiṣīsaṃghaiste'nuyāntu yathāsukham || 1.203.20 || śreṇīmahattarā ye ca grāmaghoṣamahattarāḥ || tathaivāṭavikā ye ca ye ca śailavicāriṇaḥ || 21 || saumitre sarva evaite subhṛtāśca supūjitāḥ || anuyāntu kumāraṃ me bharataṃ bhrātṛvatsalam|| 22 || ityevamuktaḥ sa tu tānsamastānājñāpayāmāsa narendravākyāt || āmantrya rāmaṃ śirasā ca sarve viniryayuste nagarātprahṛṣṭāḥ ||23|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ānuyātrikavarṇanannāma tryadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 203 || <1.204> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etasminneva kāle tu rāmaḥ śuśrāva tanmahat|| śaṅkhavādyaravonmiśraṃ bharatasyānuyātrikam || 1 || rājadvāramupāgatya bharato'pi mahāyaśāḥ || padabhyāṃ jagāma rājānamavatīrya turaṅgamāt||2|| sa dadarśa tadā rāmaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam|| anuliptaṃ parārdhyena candanena sugandhinā||3|| sūkṣmaṃ vasānaṃ vasanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitama|| tejasā bhāskarākāraṃ saundaryeṇoḍupopamam || 4 || kṣamayā pṛthivītulyaṃ krodhe kālānalopamam || bṛhaspatisamaṃ buddhyā viṣṇutulyaṃ parākrame ||5|| satye dāne'pyanaupamyaṃ dame śīle ca rāghavam || purohitairamātyaiśca yutaṃ prakṛtibhistathā || 6 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ bharataḥ śrīmāñjagāma śirasā mahīm || bharataṃ yuvarājānaṃ rāmāya viditātmane || 7 || nyavedayata dharmātmā pratīhāraḥ salakṣmaṇam || utthāya kaṇṭhe jagrāha rāmo'pi bharataṃ tadā || 8 || mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya ādideśāsya śāsanam || bharataṃ tu sukhāsīnaṃ rāmo vacanamabravīt || 9 || gandharvaputrāṃstānhatvā kartavyaṃ nagaradvayam || sindho rubhayapārśve tu putrayorubhayoḥ kṛte || 1.204.10 || abhiṣicya tadā vatsa putrau nagarayostayoḥ || yudhājiti parīdhāya kṣipramāgantumarhasi ||11|| tvayā vinā naravyāghra nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe || kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya tatra tvaṃ preṣito mayā ||12|| sa tvaṃ gaccha mahābhāga mā te kālātyayo bhavet || svastyastu tentarikṣebhyaḥ pārthivebhyaśca gacchataḥ || 13 || divyebhyaścaiva bhūtebhyaḥ samare ca tathānagha || 14 || svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya dikpālā dīptatejasaḥ || pālayantu sadā tubhyaṃ dīptavigrahadhāriṇaḥ || 15 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sādhyāśca samarudgaṇāḥ || ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca bhiṣagvarau || 16 || bhṛgavoṅgirasaścaiva kālasyāvayavāstathā || saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi ca || 17 || daityadānavagandharvā piśācoragarākṣasāḥ || devapatnyastathā sarvā devamātara eva ca || 18 || śastrāṇyastrāṇi śāstrāṇi maṅgalāya bhavantu te || vijayaṃ dīrghamāyuśca bhogāṃścānyāndiśantu te || 19 || iti svastyayanaṃ śrutvā rājñā sa samudīritam || rāmasya pādau śirasā tvabhivandya dhanurdharaḥ || 1.204.20 || nirgatya rājabhavanādrāmājñākalpitaṃ jagata || himādrikūṭasaṃkāśaṃ cārudaṃṣṭrojjvalānanam || 21 || madena siñcamānaṃ ca nṛpaveśmājiraṃ nṛpa || samākrāntakaṭaṃ cāpi pānalubdhaśilīmukhaiḥ || 22 || stabdhacārumahākarṇaṃ madhupakṛpayaiva tu || dīrghāgramadhvakṣakṛtaṃ kṛtaśṛṅgāvataṃsakam || 23 || svāsanaṃ vyūḍhakumbhaṃ ca tathodagraṃ mahābalam || nakṣatramālāṃ śirasā dhārayānaṃ tu kāñcanīm || 24 || paṭusvane tathā ghaṇṭe darśanīye manohare || kuthaṃ vicitraṃ ramyaṃ ca kovidāraṃ mahādhvajaṃ || 25 || vaijayantyaḥ patākāśca kiṅkiṇījālamālitāḥ || samārūḍhaṃ nayavidā mahāmātreṇa dhīmatā || 26 || vaiḍūryadaṇḍatīkṣṇāgra kāñcanāṅkuśadhāriṇā || jaghanasthena cānyena varatomaradhāriṇā || 27 || tathā vaijayikairmantrairdevajñenābhimantritam || āruroha mahātejā jayatkārābhinandinaḥ ||28|| pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ rukmadaṇḍaṃ manoharam || chatramādāya taṃ premṇā cāruroha sa lakṣmaṇaḥ || 29 || cāmarau dvau samādāya candraraśmisamaprabhau || ārūḍhaṃ yoṣitoryugmaṃ rūpeṇā'pratimaṃ bhuvi || 1.204.30 || taṃ samāruhya nāgendraṃ madalekhābhigāminam || jagāma saha gārgyeṇa rathārūḍhena yādava || 31 || tamanvayau mahābhāga caturaṅgamahābalam || patākādhvajasambādhaṃ kalpayantaṃ vasundharām || 32 || śyenāḥ kākavahāḥ kaṅkāḥ piśācā yakṣarākṣasāḥ || yayuḥ puraḥsarāstasya bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || 33 || gandharvaputramāṃsānāṃ lubdhā māṃsopajīvinaḥ || tūryaghoṣeṇa mahatā bandināṃ niḥsvanena ca || 34 || vāyunā cānulomena sevyamānaḥ sugandhinā || | maṅgalānāṃ ca mukhyānāṃ darśanāddhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 39 || niryayau rājamārgeṇa janasambādhaśālinā || tejasvināṃ ca tejāṃsi hṛdayāni ca yoṣi tām || 36 || ādadāno mahātejā nagarātsa viniryayau || krośamātraṃ tato gatvā same deśe ca sodake || 37 || praśastadrumasaṃkīrṇe śibiraṃ prāṅniṣevitam || senādhyakṣaiḥ sunipuṇairviveśa bharatastadā || 38 || sa praviśya mahātejāḥ śibiraṃ svaṃ niveśanam || maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā varāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ || 39 || paurajānapadaṃ sarvaṃ preṣayāmāsa yādava || pariṣvajya tataḥ paścāllakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam || 1.204.40 || mūrdhni caivamupāghrāya preṣayāmāsa dharmavit || prāyāṇakaṃ ca śvobhūte dundubhistāḍyatāṃ mama || 41 || daiśikāḥ purato yāntu ye ca vṛkṣāvarohakāḥ || ājñāpya sakalaṃ caiva śibiraṃ ca tathāvidham || 42 || avṛkṣeṣu tu deśeṣu ropayantu drumāñjanāḥ || drumāḥ kaṇṭakinaścaiva ye ca mārgaprarodhakāḥ || 43 || chindantu gatvā tānadya tīkṣṇaiḥ śīghraṃ paraśvadhaiḥ || toyahīneṣu deśeṣu kūpānkurvantu me tathā || 44 || viṣamāṃśca tathā deśānsamānkurvantu me pathi || tīrāṇi saritāṃ caiva kurvantu pulināni ca || 45 || na bhavedyena saṃghaṭṭo janasya pathi yāsyataḥ || puraḥ prayāntu sainyena vijaye rativardhanāḥ || 46 || nīlaśca nakradevaśca vasumānmunayastathā || madhyaprayāṇe gāndhāro jayanābho raṇotkaṭaḥ || 47 || suśīlaḥ kāmapālaśca yāntu sainyena daṃśitāḥ || jaghanaṃ kaṭakasyāhaṃ pālayāno yathāsukham || 48 || sainyena saha yāsyāmi vijayāya nṛpasya tu || paśyantu daiśikāḥ sthānaṃ prabhūtayavasendhanam || || 49 || sodakaṃ ca samaṃ yatra senāvāso bhavenmama || evamājñāpya bharato vijahāra yathāsukham || 1.204.50 || suṣvāpa ca niśāṃ tatra gharmakāle manoharām ||51|| suptasya sā tatra raghūdvahasya puṇyā yayau rātriradīnasattvā || sampūrṇacandrābharaṇā pratītā jyeṣṭhasya māsasya raṇotsukasya || 52||
