iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bharataniryāṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 204 || <1.205> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ dundubhiḥ samahanyata || prayāṇiko mahārāja bharatasya mahāsvanaḥ || 1 || tasya śabdena mahatā vibuddhaḥ kaṭake janaḥ || avaśyakaraṇīyāni kṛtvā rājaṃstvarānvitāḥ || 2 || tvaritā gamanārthāya samāhūyetaretaram || paṭaveśmāni ramyāṇi sahantumupacakramuḥ || 3 || mahānti sumanojñāni vartitorṇākṛtāni ca || cakrustāni ca rājendra sukhavāhyānyayatnataḥ || 4 || tatastvāropayāñcakruḥ karabheṣu khareṣu ca || goratheṣu tu mukhyeṣu tathā dantiṣu satvarāḥ || 5 || bhāṇḍamuccāvacaṃ caiva śayanāni mṛdūni ca || āsanāni ca mukhyāni bhāṇḍaṃ yacca mahānase || 6 || peyaṃ ca yavasaṃ caiva śastrāṇi vividhāni ca || kavacāni turaṅgāṇāṃ śilpabhāṇḍāni yāni ca || 7 || dhanaṃ ca vividhaṃ rājansarvopa karaṇāni ca || āropyamāṇe bhāṇḍe tu karabhāṇāṃ vikṛṣyatām || 8 || śuśruve tumulaḥ śabdaḥ kharāṇāṃ ca kharasvanaḥ || gajānāṃ yujyamānānāṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ rathaiḥ saha || 9 || vādyānāṃ hanyamānānāṃ śuśruve tumulaṃ svanam || nādena gajaghaṇṭānāṃ bṛṃhitena ca pārthiva || 1.205.10 || hreṣitena turaṅgāṇāṃ babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ || prāyāṇikamupādāya tāḍayanneva dundubhim || 11 || agre prayāṇamānyena yayau dundubhibhiḥ saha || paṇyāni ca samādāya vaṇijastvaritā yayuḥ || 12 || grahītukāmāścānyāni sodakāni samāni ca || sthānāni varamukhyānāṃ yayuścāgresarā narāḥ || 13 || mahānasikamukhyāstu tvaritāśca tathā yayuḥ || sukhayānāsu ramyāsu tathaivāśvatarīṣu ca || 14 || āropya yoṣito jagmuḥ pratyūṣe muditā janāḥ || ārūḍhāścāparā nāryaḥ savitānāḥ kareṇavaḥ ||15|| kañcukoṣṇīṣibhirguptā guptā varṣavaraistathā || yayuḥ sasainyā rājendra gītavādya purassarāḥ || 16 || dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāthāṃstarpayantyo dhanena tāḥ || narendrayoṣito rājñāṃ divyālaṅgārabhūṣitāḥ || 17 || tathānye baddhanistriṃśāḥ puruṣāśca kalāpinaḥ || ādīpya tṛṇaveśmāni jagmustvaritamānasāḥ || 18 || bharato'pi samāruhya śibikāṃ ratnabhūṣitām || viniryayau mahātejā stūryaghoṣapuraḥsaraḥ || 19 || śūnyaṃ ca śibirasthānaṃ gṛdhramaṇḍalasaṃkulam || bahukravyādasaṅkīrṇaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata || 1.205.20 || gajoṣṭragardabhāśvānāṃ śarīrāvayavairyutam|| bhagnabhāṇḍasamākīrṇaṃ śarīrāvayavairyutam||21|| bahukravyādasaṅkīrṇaṃ karīṣotkarasaṃyutam || khātairmahānasasthānairdagdhamṛttikayā yutaiḥ || |||22|| samaṇḍakardamopetairmakṣikāsahitairyutam || saṃtyajya niryayuḥ sarve bharatasya tu sainikāḥ||23|| prayāṇe tasya sainyasya balīvardāñchramānvitān || nāgānutthāpayāmāsurupaviṣṭānprayatnataḥ ||24|| keciduṣṭraparitrastātāngārdabhena nipātitān || bhāṇḍamāropayāñcakrurbhūya eva narottamāḥ || 25 || nadyuttāreṣu mahiṣānkecitsūryāṃśutāpitān || niṣaṇṇānsaha bhāreṇa tāḍayāñcakrire janāḥ || 26 || kecidaśvatarāṃstrastānnāgabṛṃhitanisvanaiḥ || ārūḍhayoṣito yatnājjagṛhurnṛpa raśmiṣu || 27 || kecidaśvairgajatrastairākṣiptā bhuvi mānavāḥ || jānuviśramaṇārthāya vājigrīvakṛtāṅaghrayaḥ || 28 || turaṅgāṃśca tadodbhrāntānsrastacarmāśca sādinaḥ || kecidākramya vegena jagṛhustatra yādava || 29 || viśaśramustathā kecidvṛkṣacchāyāsu mānavāḥ || keciccodakatīreṣu cakrire bhojanakriyām || 1.205.30 || kecitsantrastaturagasannikṛṣṭasamutthitaiḥ || drutānkāpiñjalairyatnājjagṛhustāṃsturaṅgamān || 31 || kecitkaṭakasaṃtrastānmṛgayūthānpradhāvataḥ || vegenākramya viśikhairjaghnuryadukulodvaha || 32 || kecicca yavasaṃ cakruḥ keciccakrurathendhanam || tathānyairdviguṇībhūtaṃ tathā dundubhinisvanam || 33 || prāyāṇikaṃ jahuḥ śīghraṃ śramaṃ yadukulodvaha || kecidāpaṇavīthyagramahāvaṃśasamucchritam ||34 || sapatākaṃ narā dṛṣṭvā prāptāḥ sma iti menire || cakruḥ kecicca cchandāṃsi sahāyānāṃ punaḥpunaḥ ||35 || purogatānāṃ rājendra sthānalabdhicikīrṣayā || kecitpaṭakuṭīṃ dṛṣṭvā svakīyāṃ tvaritā yayuḥ || 36 || vartitorṇākṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhāṃścānye yayurdrutam || keṣāñcittatra veśmāni tīrṇāni nṛpasattama || 37 || kṛtāni kriyamāṇāni dadṛśustatra mānavāḥ || drumairviśrāmyamāṇaiśca kriyamāṇaistathā kaṭaiḥ || 38 || gṛhairāropyamāṇaiśca paṭorṇātṛṇasaṃskṛtaiḥ || śuśubhe tanmahārāja kaṭakaṃ śubhakarmaṇaḥ || 39 || śastreṇa saṃśodhayatāṃ bhuvaṃ bhūmipate nṛṇām || rājasākrāntavapuṣāmaprakāśaṃ vapurbabhau || 1.205.40 || pārśvasthatoyasampūrṇadṛtayaśca tathā janāḥ || dhāvamānāḥ pradṛśyante vardhitā gṛhaśodhane || 41 || abhyukṣayanti cāpyanye tṛṇaveśmāni pārthiva || taptānāṃ śītakāmānāṃ dṛtivaktrodgatairjalaiḥ || 42 || abhiśrayeṇa dhūpena samantādākulīkṛtam || babhūva tasya kaṭakaṃ nīhāreṇaiva saṃyutam || 43 || avaropitabhāṇḍānāṃ dāntānāṃ yadunandana || pṛṣṭhānyabhyukṣayāmāsurgomayena jalena ca || 44 || kharoṣṭrasabalīvarda caraṇārthe vinirgatam || 45 || dadṛśe bahusāhasraṃ kaṭake bharatasya tu || rathebhyasturagānanye vimucya hayakovidāḥ || 46 || avaropitabhāṇḍāni sāntvayāñcakrire śanaiḥ || samutthāya rajo bhaumaṃ turaṅgaparivartanaiḥ || 47 || khamāruroha rājendra kapotāruṇapāṇḍuram || sthāpayāñcakrire cānye jalasthāne ca vājinaḥ || 48 || śreṇī cakrustathaivānye kaṭacchāyāsu pārthiva || vitānādhastathā kecitsthāpayāñcakrire hayān || 49 || hayebhyo yavasaṃ dattvā kecidbubhujire janāḥ || kaṭacchāyāśca nāgānāṃ cakruścānye sahasraśaḥ ||1.205.50 || vitānāni ca mukhyāni sūryatāpapraśāntaye || snātāñjalāśaye nāgām̐llabdhatoyāñjanādhipa || 51|| sacchannānsvaparīdhānakumbhānninyuḥ svamālayam || kaṭakāddūrataścakrurālānaṃ nṛpadantinām|| 52|| ālānāni mahārāja mahāvṛkṣeṣu mānavāḥ || ādāya gopinastatra kaṭakācca vidūrataḥ || 53 || gosaṅghānmahiṣīsaṅghāṃścakrurvyastānyathāsukham || kaṭake ca tathā ninyurgorasāni narādhipa || 54 || kaṭakāpaṇyavīthīṃ ca sarvapaṇyavibhūṣitām || dadṛśuḥ puruṣāstatra ayodhyāmiva cāparām || 55 || sthānāni sarvavaidyānāṃsadhvajāni narādhipa|| sāgadāni ca dṛśyante kaṭake bharatasya tu||56|| senādhyakṣeṇa vīreṇa vijayena mahātmanā|| kṛtaṃ śāstrānusāreṇa skandhāvāraniveśanam || 57 || viveśa bharataḥ śrīmāṃścaturaṅgabalānvitaḥ || anvīyamāno vīrābhyāṃ putrābhyāṃ yadunandana || 58 || puṣkareṇa ca vīreṇa takṣeṇa sumahātmanā || balamukhyaistathaivānyaiḥ sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ || 59 || śaṅkhavāditraśabdena paṭahānāṃ svanena ca || bharatasya gṛhadvāratoraṇāntikamāgatāḥ || 1.205.60|| babhūburbalamukhyāste dikṣu ye yadunandana || santyajya madhyamāṃ vīthīṃ praveśāya mahāmanāḥ || 61 || bandibhiḥ khyāpyamānāṃstānnāmakarmāvadānataḥ || śiraḥkampena bharataḥ prairayatsvānniveśanān || 62 || balamukhyānviveśātha svagṛhaṃ sarvaṛddhimat || dviyojanādhvanā śrāntā bharatasya tu sainikāḥ || 63 || viviśurbhavanānsvānsvānbhejire śayanāni ca || praviśya veśmapravaraṃ bharato'pi yathāsukham ||| || 64 || vijahāra mahārāja devarājasamadyutiḥ || krameṇānena dharmātmā bhūmipāla dinedine || āsasāda vrajanneva gaṅgāṃ tripathagāṃ nadīm || 65 || surāṅganāpīnapayodharasthasaccandanakṣālanalabdhalakṣmīm || grīṣmārkatāpādvigalattuṣāravivṛddhaśītodapaṭottarīyām || 66 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde prayāṇavarṇano nāma pañcādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 205 || <1.206> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || niveśamakarodrājan gaṅgātīre sa rāghavaḥ || bharatasya tadā cakrurgaṅgāyāṃ jalamaṇḍapān || 1 || tathaiva balamukhyānāṃ prādhānyena narādhipa || sainikaśca janastasya prāpya tāṃ suranimnagām || 2 || sāphalyaṃ janmano mene tatyāja ca tathā klamam || sasnau papau payaḥ kāmaṃ harṣeṇa mahatā yutaḥ || 3 ||| snāpayāñcakrire tatra turagāṃsturagapriyāḥ || kuñjarānsnāpayamāsurmahāmātrāstathaiva ca || 4 || majjadbhirbahusāhasraiḥ kuñjarairjāhnavī nadī || kirātaviṣayaiḥ saiva virarāja yathopalaiḥ || 5 || samutthitamahāmātrāndṛṣṭvābhyukṣaṇachadmanā || cikrīḍurdṛtibhiḥ kecidviviśurbāhubhistathā || 6 || gaṅgāmāsādya saṃhṛṣṭā bharatasya tu sainikāḥ || bharato'pi tathā snātaḥ kṛtadaivatapūjanaḥ ||7|| śrāddhaṃ cakre mahātejā dadau dānaṃ tathaiva ca || dattvā tatra mahādānānājñāpayati yādava ||8|| śilpino mama kurvantu kūṭāgārānmanoramān || rātrau dīpaniveśārthaṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||9|| ānīyantāṃ tathā nāvaḥ sainyasya taraṇāya me || kriyantāṃ carmanāvaśca plavāśca śataśastathā ||1.206.10|| uttaraṃ pāramāsādya niveśaḥ kriyatāṃ tathā || paraṃ pāraṃ janā yāntu udayāstamayāntare ||11|| evamājñāya bharato vijahāra yathāsukham || prasāritakaro rājansarvatraiva divākaraḥ || 12 || yayāvadarśanaṃ tatra bharatasyaiva lajjayā || padmapatradalāgrābhā pratīcī cābhavatkṣaṇāt ||13|| ādityestamanuprāpte sandhyārāgānurañjitā || tatastu tamasā vyāpte na prājñāyata kiñcana || 14 || bharatājñākṛtānpūrvaṃ kūṭāgārānsadīpakān || dhvajamālāparikṣiptāṃścikṣipurjāhnavījale ||15|| sainikaiśca tathā mukhyairbharatasya pṛthakpṛthak | gaṅgāmbhasi parikṣiptā dīpavṛkṣāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||16|| sā dīpamālinī gaṅgā tīradyotitavigrahī || jahāsa phenahāsena jihveva gaganapriyā || 17 || jalāntarāgatai rdīpairdīpavṛkṣairmanoharaiḥ || tathā kallolasaṃkrāntairgaṅgā dīpteva lakṣyate || 18 || evaṃ hi krīḍatāṃ tatra gaṅgātīre tathā nṛṇām || rātrāvevāñjasā jagmurnāvo bahuvidhā nṛpa || 19 || śaśāṅkarājahaṃsena dṛṣṭvā khasarasīṃ janāḥ || ākramyamāṇā suṣupurniśīthe nidrayānvitāḥ || 1.206.20 || śaśāṅkodayasaṃsuptabalaṃ padmavanopamam || nibodhayāmāsa tathā divākarakarotkaram || 21 || cakṛṣuste tadā nāvaḥ karṇadhārā yathā svakāḥ || balaṃ ca sakalaṃ pāraṃ tārayā ñcakrire tadā || 22 || nāvastāṃ kiṅkiṇījālaiḥ patākābhiśca rājitā || ninyurbalaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ karṇadhārasphigāhatāḥ || 23 || bhāṇḍaiḥ pūrṇāstathā kāścitkāścitpūrṇā janena ca || turaṅgamaistathā pūrṇā gokharoṣṭraistathā parāḥ || 24 || kāścitsakuñjarā nāvo yayuḥ pāraṃ tadā param || tathā padmadalākṣīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ nāvaśca pūritāḥ || 25 || vimānābhāḥ pradṛśyante gaṅgāmbhasi nareśvara || karṇadhāravaropetā daṇḍibhiḥ puruṣairvṛtāḥ || 26 || lokasantāraṇārthāya bhūyo jagmustathā parāḥ || carmanaubhistathā kecitplavaiḥ kecitsuyantritaiḥ || 27 || jagmurādāya bhāṇḍāni dṛtibhiśca tathā kvacit || narairdṛtisamārūḍhaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇāsturaṅgamāḥ || 28 || jagmuḥ kecitparaṃ pāraṃ bāhubhirmanujeśvara || jagmuranye paraṃ pāraṃ saṃgṛhītāśca raśmibhiḥ || || 29 || nausthaireva paraiḥ śīghraṃ turagā nṛpabāhubhiḥ || mahiṣīṇāṃ ca saṅghāni gavāṃ ca yadunandana || 1.206.30 || jagmurgopālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ ca bāhubhiḥ || uṣṭragardabhasaṃghāni tāryamāṇāni bāhubhiḥ || 31 || bhūyobhūyo nyavartanta tatra rāvo mahānabhūt || tīrṇasya tāryamāṇasya narasya yadusattama || 32 || āsītkolāhalo ghorastīrayorubhayorapi || bharato'pi mahātejāḥ snāto hutahutāśanaḥ || 33 || matsyarūpadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ paṭe sampūjya yādava || svastivācyāṃstato viprāngobhirvastrairdhanena ca || 34 || sampūjya jāhnavīṃ devīṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || sampūjayāmāsa tadā bhūya eva dvijottamān|| 35 || gobhiraśvaistathā niṣkairvastrairgandhaistathaiva ca || āruroha tadā nāvaṃ pāṇḍukambalasaṃvṛtām ||36|| kiṅkiṇījālavitatāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm || bharate tu samārūḍhe karṇadhārasphigāhatā || 37 || jagāma sā paraṃ pāraṃ naurvimānopamā nṛpa || samprāpya sa paraṃ pāraṃ sampūrṇakaṭakastadā || uvāsa rājaṃstatraiva divi deveśvaro yathā || 38 || devīṃ mahādevajaṭātaṭasthāṃ śaśāṅkasaṃsargavivṛddha śītām || uttīrya rājā bharataḥ sa caināṃ ninye kṣayaṃ śakrasamaprabhāvaḥ || 39 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gaṅgāvataraṇa varṇano nāma ṣaḍuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 206 || <1.207> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || bharate tu samuttīrṇe gaṅgāṃ gaganamekhalām || viveśa kaṭakaṃ tasya tamanyaḥ kauravo nṛpa || 1 || balena caturaṅgeṇa samudrābhena saṃyutaḥ || īśvaraśca kirātānāṃ damano nāma pārthivaḥ || 2 || gandhināṃ bahusāhasrairbalairyukto vyadṛśyata || yathārhaṃ pūjayitvā taṃ bharato dharmavatsalaḥ || 3|| āsasādārkatanayāṃ yamunāṃ pāpanāśinīm || yamasya bhaginīṃ puṇyāṃ nīlamālāṃ manoharām || 4 || yatra kvacana nadyāṃ hi kṛtvā śrāddhannarādhipa || akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti nākapṛṣṭhe ca modate||5|| yatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ snātaḥ sampūjya bhānujām || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairnākalokaṃ sa gacchati || 6 || anarkābhyudite kāle māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśīm || yasyāṃ snātastu sampūjya dharmarājaṃ tilāṃbhasā || 7 || na durgatimavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet || yatra kvacana nadyāṃ hi māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśīm || 8 || nādeyāmbhasi sarvasminsnātaḥ pāpairvimucyate || yamunā tu viśeṣeṇa yamasya bhaginīti sā || 9 || snātaśca yāmune toye santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || na durgatimavāpnoti nākalokaṃ ca gacchati || 1.207.10 || tāṃ samāsādya yamunāṃ yathā gaṅgājalaṃ tathā || vihṛtya bharatastadvaduttatāra mahānadīm || 11 || samuttīrṇasya yamunāṃ bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || viveśa kaṭakaṃ rājā matsyānāṃ surathastadā || 12 || gorasenaśca sālvānāṃ śibīnāṃ ca prabhadrakaḥ || sa tairnṛpatibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kurukṣetramupāyayau || 13 || yadarthameṣā carati loke gāthā purātanī || pāṃsavo'pi kurukṣetre vāyunā samamīritāḥ || 14 || api duṣkṛtakarmāṇo nayanti paramāṃ gatim || samantapañcake puṇye ye mṛtā manujeśvara || 15 || te sarve nākamāsādya rājante divi devavat || sannītiryatra rājendra tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 16 || tīrthasannayanādeva sannītiriti viśrutam || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudrasarāṃsi ca || 17 || māsānte satataṃ tatra nityamāyānti yādava || tatra śrāddhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādrāhugraste divākare || 18 || aśvamedhaśatasyāgraṃ phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ || bharatastu samāsādya tatrovāsa sukhī tadā ||19|| papraccha brāhmaṇāṃstatra tīrthasannītikāraṇam || pṛṣṭastu bharatenātha brāhmaṇastu ghaṭodaraḥ || 1.207.20 || uvāca bharataṃ tatra kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || ghaṭodara uvāca || śakre vṛtravadhākrānte trailokye daityasādgate || 21 || sabrahmakāḥ surāḥ sarve viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ || tānuvāca harirdevaścyavanasyātmasambhavaḥ || 22 || bhārgavo brāhmaṇaḥ śrīmāndadhīca iti viśrutaḥ || asthibhiḥ kriyatāṃ tasya devendrasya varāyudham || 23 || praviśya devāṃstatrāhaṃ hantā vṛtramasaṃśayam || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve dadhīcasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 24 || dadṛśuśca mahābhāgaṃ dadhīcaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim || pūjayitvā mahābhāgaṃ tamūcuḥ saṃhatāḥ surāḥ || 25 || tvadasthibhiḥ kariṣyāmo vajraṃ daityanibarhaṇam || anyāni ca tathāstrāṇi surakāryārthasiddhaye || 26 || tatra tvaṃ devakāryārthaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ dvija rocaya || evamukto dadhīcastu pratyuvāca sa tānsurān || 27 || tīrthayātrā pratijñātā sarvatīrtheṣu vai mayā || tāṃ tu kṛtvā kariṣyāmi dehanyāsaṃ surottamāḥ || 28 || devā ūcuḥ || śaktastvaṃ sarvatīrthānāmāhvāne dvijapuṅgava || ihādyaiva samāyāntu sarvatīrthāni te'nagha || 29 || tejasā ca tvadīyena tathāsmākaṃ ca bhārgava || ghaṭodara uvāca || evamuktaḥ suraiḥ sarvaistīrthāni saritastathā || 1.207.30 || sarāṃsi ca samudrāśca tatrājagmurnarādhipa || kāmyena mahatā rājanyogena parameṇa ca || 31 || jñātvā ca teṣāṃ sānnidhyaṃ tatra snāto dvijottamaḥ || tarpaṇaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā surāṇāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha || 32 || uvāca devāṃstatrasthānidaṃ vacanamarthavat || dadhīca uvāca || adya prabhṛti māsānte bhavadbhiḥ satataṃ surāḥ || 33 || sānnidhyamiha kartavyaṃ tīrthaiścaiva yathāgataiḥ || ghaṭodara uvāca || evamuktaistathetyukto devaistīrthaiśca sa tvatha || 34 || tyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ yāto dadhīcaḥ svena tejasā || viśvakarmā ca tasyāsthnāṃ bhāgairvajramathā karot || 35 || āyudhāni ca devānāṃ tathaiva ca pṛthakpṛthak || tena vajreṇa mahatā vṛtraṃ hatvā mahāsuram || 36 || jaghāna daityamukhyānāṃ navatirnavatistathā || tataḥ prabhṛti māsānte nityameva raghūdvaha || 37 || sānnidhyamiha tīrthānāṃ devatānāṃ ca kalpitam || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etacchrutvā mahātejā dattvā dānāni rāghavaḥ || 38 || yayau sainyena mahatā bharato'marakaṇṭakam || tatra viṣṇupadaṃ prāpya pūjayitvā ca rāghavaḥ ||39|| āsasāda nadīṃ gaurīṃ puṇyāṃ pāpabhayāpahām || viśvāmitrājñayā rakṣaḥ praviveśa purā nṛpam || 1.207.40 || kaśāhatena mārgasthaṃ śaptaṃ bhūpāla śaktinā || saudāsaṃ sa praviṣṭastu bhakṣayāmāsa śaktinam || 41 || tataḥ putraśataṃ rājanvasiṣṭhasyaiva satvaraḥ || hṛte putraśate dukhādvasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 42 || viveśa nimnagāṃ gaurīṃ prāṇatyāgacikīrṣayā || viprasya bhūpa yātasya vidrutā sā tadābhavat || 43 || tataḥ prabhṛti loke'smiñchatadruriti śabditā || śatadru sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvakalyāṇakāriṇī||44|| snātānāṃ ca tathā rājandaśadhenuphalapradā || tāṃ samāsādya tatrāpi dattvā dānaṃ sa rāghavaḥ||45|| uttīrya tāṃ yayau tatra sā cāntyā yatra nimnagā || yasyāṃ snātvā vimucyante sarvapāpabhayairnarāḥ ||46|| yasyāṃ snānādavāpnoti daśagodānajaṃ phalam || āṣāḍhe ca tathā kṛtvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 47 || gaurītoyādvinirmukto vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || pāśabandhabharairyasyāṃ papāta sahasā nṛpa ||48|| vipāśaśca tathā devyā kṛtvā tīre visarjitaḥ || vipāśā śaktiputraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭho'pi parāśaram || 49 || asti santānamityuktvā maraṇādvinivartata || sā cāntyā ca tathā loke vipāśetyabhidhīyate || 1.207.50 || vipāśāṃ ca samuttīrṇe bharate dharmavatsale || viveśa kaṭakaṃ tasya kuṇideśo mahodayaḥ || 51 || traigarto vasudhānaśca kulūtādhipatirjayaḥ || dāśerakastathā rājā govāśana iti śrutaḥ || 52 || irāvatīṃ śīghragamāṃ bharato'pi tadā yayau || daśadhenuphalaṃ yatra snāta eva samaśnute || 53 || ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi vahatyekā irāvatī || aṣṭamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa yatra yujyeta revatī || 54 || tatra dattvā bahuvidhaṃ dānaṃ raghukulodvahaḥ || uttīrya tāṃ yayau śīghraṃ devikāṃ pāpanāśinīm || 59 || dṛṣṭamātraiva yā devī sarvakalmaṣanāśinī || śarīrabahulā sā tu harasya dayitā umā || 56 || tatrāpi dattvā dānāni pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram || bharate cātha tatrasthe viviśuḥ pañca pārthivāḥ || 57 || pārvatīyā mahārāja padātigaṇasaṅkulāḥ || kumāraḥ śreṇimāñchūro balabandhuḥ suyodhanaḥ || 58 || madrarājoṃ'śumāṃścaiva tathaiva ca mahābalaḥ || pūjito madrarājena śākalena narottamaḥ || 59 || trirātramuṣitaḥ śrīmāṃścandrabhāgāṃ nadīṃ yayau || candrāṃśuśītalajalāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm || 1.207.60 || bahutīrthasamāyuktāṃ snānātsarvapradāṃ nṛṇām || | viśeṣeṇa mahārāja māghapuṣyatrayodaśīm || 61 || bharate tāṃ samuttīrṇe viveśa kaṭakaṃ tataḥ || etacchrutañjayaḥ śrīmānabhicāraḥ kṛtañjayaḥ || 62 || | kāśmīrakaśca dharmātmā subāhuriti viśrutaḥ || āsasāda sa taiḥ sārddhaṃ vitastāṃ tu mahānadīm ||63|| svargalokapradāṃ snāne sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm || proṣṭhapādasya māsasya śuklapakṣatrayodaśīm || 64 || viśeṣeṇa mahārāja puṇyāṃ paramapāvanīm || bharatastāṃ samuttīrya sudāmāṃ caiva nimnagām || 65 || āsasāda mahātejāḥ kaikeyānyadunandana || balena caturaṅgeṇa yudhājitkaikayādhipaḥ || 66 || niryayau bharataṃ prāptaṃ śrutvā bharatamātulaḥ || nāgarāśca tathā mukhyā rājagṛhanivāsinaḥ || 67 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣattriyā vaiśyā ye ca varṇavarā janāḥ || yānairuccāvacaiḥ sarvai nagarāttu vinirgatāḥ || 68 || vāditrānpurataḥ kṛtvā gaṇikāśca vinirgatāḥ || pratigrahanimittaṃ tu rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ || 69 || bharato'pi mahātejāḥ sa sametya yudhājitā || abhyadhāvata tatprītyā mātulaṃ kaikayādhipam ||1.207.70|| kaṇṭhe gṛhītvā bharataṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt || bharato'pi samādāya rājagehamupāgamat||71|| || same manorame deśe prabhūtayavasendhane || śibiraṃ bharataścakre nagarasyāvidūrataḥ || 72 || pṛthakpṛthaktadā cakruḥ skandāvāraniveśanam || manaḥpriyeṣu deśeṣu nānādeśyā narādhipāḥ || 73 || kṛtvā niveśānmanujeśvarāṇāmādiśya bhogānsakalānsa teṣām || viveśa nāgena sa mātulasya puraṃ prahṛṣṭo raghuvaṃśacandraḥ || 74 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rājagṛhagamano nāma saptottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 207 || <1.208> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tataḥ svalpaparīvāro bharato dharmavatsalaḥ || abhyadhāya tataḥ prītyā mātulaḥ kekayādhipaḥ || 1 || kaṇṭhe gṛhītvā bharataṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt || bharato'pi samādāya rājan gṛhamupāgatam||2 || praviveśa puraṃ hṛṣṭo mātulasya yudhājitaḥ || patākādhvajasaṃbādhaṃ siktaṃ candanavāriṇā ||3 || dhūpenā'gurusārāṇāṃ samantādākulīkṛtam || kṛtopahāraṃ sarvatra kusumaiḥ pañcavarṇakaiḥ || 4 || sarvapaṇyavisaṃyuktaṃ samālaṃkṛtabālakam || khamullikhadbhiḥ prāsādaiḥ śvetameghagaṇairyutam ||5 || vinyastabalipūjañca devatāyataneṣu ca || mahāvāditraghoṣeṇa samantātkṛtaniḥsvanam ||6|| paurairdidṛśrubhiḥ savairrākīrṇāpaṇavīthikam || rājamārge mahārāja piṇḍīkṛtamahājanam ||7|| rājamārgādapākṛṣṭaśūnyasarvaniveśanam || yoṣidvṛndasamākrānta rājamārgamahāgṛham || 8 || praviveśa puraṃ śrīmānbharato nāgadhūrgataḥ || tasya kāmābhavapuṣaḥ praveśe bharatasya tuṃ || 9 || gṛhakāryāṇi saṃtyajya yayurnāryo gavākṣakān || kāścidardhānuliptāṃgyaḥ kāścidekāñjitekṣaṇāḥ || 1.208.10 || keśaiḥ saṃyamitaikārdhaiḥ kāścidardhaniveśitaiḥ || ekasmiṃścaraṇe kāścidgṛhītvā kāṣṭhapādukāḥ ||11|| tvaritāśā yayurnāryo dvitīye carmapādukāḥ || tathā parāḥ samākṣipya pūrvākrāntagavākṣakāḥ ||12|| vrajantīṣu tathānyāsu kāścinnāryo gavākṣakāt || vegavatyo yayuḥ śīghraṃ saṃtyaktvā carmapādukāḥ || 13 || nāryaḥ svavadanaiścakruḥ suvaktrām̐stāngavākṣakān || ardhapraviṣṭasatkambupāṇivārijakuḍmalāḥ || 14 || dvitīyapāṇisaṃdarśasamākrāntairyayuḥ karaiḥ || nīvībandhanaviśleṣasamākulitacetanāḥ || 15 || yayurevāparāstatra pāṇisaṃśliṣṭanīvayaḥ || kusumaprakaraṃ kāścidūhamānāḥ śirogataiḥ || 16 || yayurevāṃśukaidīrghaistvaramāṇā gavākṣakān || sitāsitena rāmāṇāṃ ramaṇīyena rāghavaḥ || 17 || yayau dṛṣṭinipātena rajyamāna ivāṃśumān || sa cakarṣa tadā tāsāṃ patitairnetraraśmibhiḥ ||18 || hṛdayānnigṛhītveva gacchamānaḥ sa rāghavaḥ || sa tu dṛgviṣaye yāsāṃ yāsāṃ tasmātparāgataḥ||19|| na tā bubudhire kāñcitkriyāṃ citragatā iva || bharate dūrayāte'pi niśceṣṭāḥ kāścideva tāḥ || 1.208.20 || ākṛṣṭāstā yayuḥ kṣoṇīṃ preryamāṇaiḥ sakhījanaiḥ || pradyumnāṃśasamutpannaḥ pradyumnasamadarśanaḥ || 21 || ādāya tāsāṃ cetāṃsi yayau gajagṛhaṃ drutam || tasminrājagṛhe rājanrāghavo rājamandiram || 22 || āsasāda mahātejāḥ kailāsamiva cāparam || praviśya sa gṛhaṃ mukhyaṃ preṣayāmāsa bhūbhujam || 23 || pānabhojanavāsāṃsi sainikānāṃ ca yādava || uvāsa sa sukhaṃ tatra pūjitaśca yudhājitā || jagāma cāstaṃ savitā japāpuṣpotkaraprabhaḥ || 24 || jāmbūnade ratnasahasracitre sa rājaputraḥ śayane vicitre || suṣvāpa rātrau bhavane vicitre nidāgharātriṃ pavane vicitre || 25 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bharatasya rājagṛhapraveśavarṇano nāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 208 || <1.209> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tasminrātryavasāne tu bhūmipānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || kaṭakeṣvabhyahanyanta saṃjñātūryāṇi yādava || 1 ||| bahūnāṃ balamukhyānāṃ nānāliṅgāni bhāgaśaḥ || teṣāṃ kolāhalaḥ śabdo babhūva gaganaṅgamaḥ || 2 || viviśurbharatasyāpi tataḥ prābodhikā janāḥ|| veṇikā gāyanā mukhyā vaṃśavādyavidaśca ye || 3 || mārdaṅgikā pāṇavikāḥ śaṅkhavādanakāśca ye || raktakaṇṭhāḥ sumadhurā ye ca maṅgalapāṭhakāḥ || 4 || sūtamāgadhamukhyāśca bandinaśca narādhipa || tuṣṭuvurbharataṃ vīraṃ sukhasuptaṃ mahāmatim || 5 || suprabhātaṃ samuttiṣṭha prabhātā rajanī śubhā || dikprācī raghuśārdūla vartate'ruṇarañjitā || 6 || nūnamasyāṃ hi velāyāṃ mātalistridaśādhipam || vibodhayati rājendra sukhāya jagatāṃ vibhum || 7 || tvayi supte jagatsuptaṃ vibuddhe ca sukhānvitam || tasmāduttiṣṭha lokānāṃ śivāya raghunandana || 8 || tvaṃ hi sarvaguṇārāmo yathā rāmo mahīpatiḥ || guṇaiḥ śaśāṅkaraśmyābhaistvayā vai rañjitaṃ jagat ||9|| atyāścaryaṃ mahābāho yaśasā susitena te || mukhānyarātivṛndānāṃ kriyante malināni yat ||1.209.10|| kṛpāṇadhārāpānīyaṃ dṛṣṭvā'rātigaṇastava || tṛṣṇayaiva bhavatyāśu rañjitānilayo bhayāt || 11 || akṣobhyaścātigambhīro bhavānratnākarastathā ||||| agrāhyatvātsamudreṇa na samaḥ pratibhāti naḥ ||12|| saumyaḥ kalāvām̐llakṣmīvānnayanānandakārakaḥ || doṣākareṇa kṣayiṇā naupamyaṃ te narādhipa ||13|| bāhubhojyātivistīrṇā sarvāśrayavatī dṛḍhā || naupamyaṃ yāti te samyak kṣoṇī vindhyena kampinā || 14 || yatte'sti tadavaśyaṃ tvaṃ dadāsi ripusūdana|| avidyamānā bhīrdattā bhavatārigaṇe kutaḥ ||15 || nimeṣamapi yo dṛṣṭastvayāpāṅganirīkṣaṇaiḥ || samagradṛṣṭyā ya dṛṣṭo nityamevekṣaṇaiḥ śriyaḥ | || 16 || kṣuraparyantadhāreṇa cakreṇārigaṇasya te || śirāṃsyapaharatyājau devadevo janārdanaḥ || 17 || kapālamālī khaṭvāṅgī śaśāṅkakṛtabhūṣaṇaḥ ||| vāmārdhadayitākāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ śaṃ karotu te ||18|| padmāsanaḥ padmajanmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || ṛddhiṃ medhāṃ dhṛtiṃ lakṣmīṃ balaṃ ca vidadhātu te || 19|| nabhaścaro'mbujo devo digvadhūkarapūrakaḥ || brahmāṇḍamaṇḍape dīpaḥ suprabhātaṃ karotu te || 1.209.20 || keśayakṣeśadeveśapreteśvaraniśācarāḥ || sarvadevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ suprabhātaṃ diśantu te || 21 || ṛṣayaḥ saritaḥ śailāḥ sāgarāśca diśo daśa || kālasyāvayavāścaiva suprabhātaṃ diśantu te || 22 || iti śṛṇvangiraṃ puṇyāmeṣāṃ maṅgalavādinām || mahāpuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa tatyāja śayanaṃ tadā ||23|| āyavyayaṃ sa śuśrāva lekhakairgaṇakaiḥ saha || vegotsargaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā yayau snānagṛhaṃ śubham || 24 || snānārambhaṃ tataścakre dantadhāvanapūrvakam || utsāditaḥ kaṣāyeṇa balavadbhirnaraistadā || 25 || sukhaṃ bhadrāsanāsīnaḥ sūkṣmāmbaradharaḥ prabhuḥ || sasnau sa vividhaistoyairnadīsāgarajaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 26 || kumbhaiḥ suvarṇamāheyaistāmrai raupyamayaistathā || śatādhikairmahārāja sarvauṣadhi samanvitaiḥ || 27 || kṣīrapravāhasaṃyuktairmālyakaṇṭhaiḥ supūjitaiḥ || āvarjitairmahīpāla susnātālaṅkṛtairnaraiḥ || 28 || candanasrāvasampūrṇairdvijamantrānumantritaiḥ || babhāra vasanaṃ cāru snānatoyaughasaṅkulam || 29 || śaśāṅkamaṇḍalaṃ pūrṇaṃ tanvabhrairiva saṃvṛtam || vādyapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa tathā gītasvanena ca || 1.209.30 || snātvopaspṛśya vidhivatpūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ samāhitaḥ || dadarśa vadanaṃ cāru darpaṇe cātha sarpiṣi || 31 || sa suvarṇe mahārāja daivajñenābhimantrite || dineśaṃ tithinakṣatraṃ tataḥ śuśrāva rāghavaḥ || 32 || sāṃvatsaramukhodgīrṇaṃ kaliduḥsvapnanāśanam || cakārābhyarcanaṃ cātha devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 33 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpūdīpānnasampadā || stavairbalipradānaiśca gītavādyasvanena ca || 34 || saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ viveśāgnigṛhaṃ śubham || tatrāgniṃ samupasthāya hutaṃ pūrvaṃ purodhasā || 35 || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ karma siddhivṛddhijayapradam || prāgeva tasya kṛtavānvidvānnṛpapurohitaḥ || 36 || tatastvaupasame vahnau bharataḥ prītamānasaḥ || śrīsūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ juhāva prayatastadā || 37 || ājyena mantrapūtena vidhinā susamāhitaḥ || dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ cāgnau kṛtajapyo mahāmatiḥ || 38 || udakenārcanaṃ cakre devānāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha || tataḥ sa niryayau tasmādbharato vahniveśmanaḥ || 39 || niṣkramya pūjayāmāsa brāhmaṇānvasunā tadā || gobhiraśvaiḥ suvarṇena dadhipuṣpaphalānvitaiḥ||1.209.40|| modakaiśca tathā ratnairvastraiśca raghunandanaḥ || pūjitānāṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ bharatena mahātmanā || 41 || puṇyāhaghoṣastridivaṃ jagāma madhurasvaraḥ || sa pūjayitvā viprendrānpraviśya ca tathā gṛham || 42 || nityakarma ca kṛtvedaṃ candanena sugandhinā || sūkṣmaśuklaparīdhāno varadhūpena dhūpitaḥ|| 43 || ābhūṣya sarvagātrāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇāni raghūdvahaḥ || śuklaṃ sugandhi mālyaṃ ca srajaśca vividhāstathā || 44 || maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā niścakrāma sabhāgṛham || klṛptaṃ śayyāsanaṃ tatra vararatnavibhūṣitam || 45 || mahārghatoraṇopetaṃ sottaracchadamṛddhimat || vitānañca tathā dattaṃ tasyopari maharddhimat || 46 || āsīnamāsane tasnnibharataṃ satyasaṃgaram || prāṃśavo baddhanistriṃśāḥ kavacottamabhūṣitāḥ || 47 || raktāmbaradharā vīrā rarakṣuḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitāḥ || tathaivobhayapārśvasthāḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ || 48 || vāramukhyāḥ suveśāstamupāsāṃcakrire tadā || bālavyajanadhāriṇyastālavṛntakarāḥ parāḥ || 49|| tāmbūlabhāṇḍadhāriṇyo nīlanīrajalocanāḥ || kuṇḍalī baddhanistriṃśo daṇḍapāṇiḥ suveśavān || 1.209.50 || uvāca bharataṃ kṣattā bhūmivinyastajānukaḥ|| didṛkṣavaste saṃprāptā brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśayacchidaḥ || 51 || śreṇīmahattarā ye ca balamukhyāstathaiva ca || praveśayainānityukto dvāsthānkṣattā tato'bravīta || 52 || brāhmaṇānbalamukhyāṃśca praveśayata satvaram || āśīrbhirabhinandyainaṃ saṃpraviṣṭā dvijottamāḥ || 53 || bṛsīṣu dantapīṭheṣu viviśuśca yathāsukham || tatastu balamukhyānāṃ namatāṃ bharataṃ tadā || 54 || kṣattā jagrāha nāmāni kaṇṭhāraktasvarānvitaḥ || tatasteṣūpaviṣṭeṣu dvāreṣu vivṛteṣu ca || 55 || praviveśa janaḥ sarvo na nyavāryeta kaścana || etasminneva kāle tu śuśruve tumulo dhvaniḥ || 56 ||| bharataṃ draṣṭukāmānāṃ bhūmipānāṃ mahātmanām || hrādena gajaghaṇṭānāṃ bṛṃhitena tathaiva ca || 57 || hreṣitena turaṅgāṇāṃ rathanemisvanena ca || nāmabhiḥ kīrtyamānaiśca bandibhiḥ pṛthivīkṣitām || 58 || śaṅkhavāditraghoṣeṇa paṭahānāṃ svanena ca || ājagmurbharataṃ draṣṭuṃ narendrāḥ priyadarśanāḥ || 59 || toraṇādavatīryaiva vāhanebhyo mahīkṣitaḥ || sarve svalpaparīvārā viviśuste sabhāṃ śubhām || 1.209.60 || śiraḥkampena bharataṃ namaskṛtya niveditāḥ || pratīhāreṇa dakṣeṇa tena cakurvarāsanam || 61 || siṃhāsanasthānnṛpatīnbharatastvanurūpayan || girā papraccha kuśalaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāpyatha || 62 || tuṣṭuvurvandinastatra nānādeśyānnarādhipān || nivedayantaḥ stutyante bharatāya mahātmane ||63|| stuvatāṃ bharataṃ tatra bandināṃ sa mahāsvanaḥ || prāsādabhogasaṃruddho vipulaḥ samapadyata || 64 || kṣmāpālamaulimāṇikyamarīcivikaṭojjvalam || bālātapāṃśucchuritaṃ babhūva ca sabhāgṛham || 65 || tataḥ sa bharataḥ śrīmānvisasarja narādhipān || svahastadattatāmbūlānpratīhāraniveditān || || 66 || tataḥ samutthāya yayau dvitīyagṛhamuttamam || tatra cakre tadā mantraṃ mātulena yudhājitā || 67 || purodhasā ca gārgyeṇa svena kālavidā tathā || yudhājiduvāca || kāle tvamīpsite prāpto gandharvāṇāṃ vadhecchayā || 68 || tatra yāvanna jānanti gandharvāste tvadāgamam || avaskandena tānadya tāvadrātrau jahi prabho || 69 || avaskandena nidhanaṃ sukhaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati || kālaviduvāca || supte pramatte viśvaste tathā rājañcchramā nvite || 1.209.70 || avatīrṇe bale caiva saritaṃ vahatīṃ tathā || rātrau jāgaraṇaśrānte chadmayuddhaṃ vidhīyate || 71 || rātrau vihāraśīlāste gandharvāḥ satataṃ prabho || na te'vaskandamarhanti rātrau kaikeyinandana || 72 || vijayaśca divā yuddhe bharatasya pradṛśyate || gārgya uvāca || ādau dūtena vaktavyaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ prayojanam || 73 || yathā deśamimaṃ tyaktvā vrajadhvaṃ tuhinācalam || gandharvāṇāṃ nivāsastu himavatyacalottame || 74 || pūrvameva kṛtastena yenedaṃ nirmitaṃ jagat || sthānametanmanuṣyāṇāṃ tyaktumarhatha mā ciram || 75 || te ca dūtavacaḥ śrutvā sthānaṃ dadyurnarādhipa || asaṃśayamupāruhya caitanmama mataṃ bhavet || 76 || bharata uvāca || rāghavāḥ satyasandhāstu kūṭayuddhaṃ na śikṣitāḥ || tasmātteṣāṃ vadhaḥ kāryaḥ suyuddhena mayā nṛpa || 77 || gārgyavākyaṃ tathā buddhyā rocate'tiśayena me|| prayātu teṣāṃ dautyena gārgya eva mahāyaśāḥ || 78 || yudhājiduvāca || gaccha gārgya mahābhāga gandharvādhipatiṃ prati || taṃ ca śrāvaya vākyāni tvayoktānīha yāni me || 79 || akriyāyāṃ tathā teṣāṃ śrāvayā'gryāṇi mā ciram || asyaiva nāmnā dharmajña bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || 1.209.80 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evamastvityathokto'sau yayau gārgyo mahāyaśāḥ || rathena kāñcanāṅgena gandharvanagaraṃ prati || 81 || gate purohite gārgye bharato'pi mahāśayāḥ || hastipṛṣṭhe rathe cāśve śastre śāstre tathaiva ca || 82 || vyāyāmaṃ ca tathā cakre niyuddhe ca yadūttama || utsāritastathā padabhyāṃ dhāvadbhiḥ kuśalairjanaiḥ ||83|| snātaiḥ saṃpūjito viṣṇurvidhivatsāttvatottamaiḥ || namaskṛtya tathaivāgniṃ hutaṃ suṣṭhu purodhasā || 84 || tathā bhuktavatāṃ śrutvā pūjitānāṃ dvijanmanām || puṇyāhaghoṣaṃ vittena bhūmipāla visarjya tān || 85 || parārdhyacandanāktāṅgastanucārusitāmbaraḥ || sarvālaṅkaraṇopetaḥ sragvī dhūpena dhūpitaḥ || 86 || āsīnastvāsane divye bubhuje svajanairyutaḥ || mātulasya mahārghāṇi śucīni guṇavanti ca || 87 || aparīkṣitapūrvāṇi puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ || narapakṣimṛgāṇāntu liṅgairvahnau tathaiva ca || 88 || bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca peyaṃ coṣyaṃ tathaiva ca || pātreṣu rukmaraupyeṣu tathā maṇimayeṣu ca || 69 || bhuktvānnaṃ gītaśabdena cāptaiḥ katipayaiḥ saha || tathopaspṛśya dharmātmā dantadhāvanapūrvakam || 1.209.90 || cakrasya śayanaṃ bheje vāmapārśvena śatruhā || itihāsaṃ sa śuśrāva tatrasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 91 || tataḥ sa śayanaṃ tyaktvā śāstrābhyāsaṃ mahāyaśāḥ || cakāra raghuśārdūlaḥ satāṃ mārgamanuvrajan || 92 || etasminneva kāle tu saha gārgyo yudhājitā || viveśa bharataṃ draṣṭuṃ rathareṇupariplutaḥ || 93 || sukhāsīnaśca bharataṃ vākyametattato'bravīt || gārgya uvāca || tato vākyāni sarvāṇi śailūṣaḥ śrāvito mayā || 94 || na tāni tasya rocante saṃgrāmastasya rocate || bharatena samāgamya śvobhūte dvijapuṅgava || 95 || bharataṃ nāśayiṣyāmi nīhāraṃ candramā yathā || ityuktvā sa tu māṃ rājā preṣayāmāsa satvaraḥ || 96 || āhvānadundubhistatra niṣkrānte mayi cāhataḥ || etajjñātvā sa yuddhāya prātaḥ sajjo bhavettava || 97 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || iti gārgyavacaḥ śrutvā bharato gārgyamabravīt|| gaccha śīghraṃ gṛhaṃ brahmañchrānto rathabalādhvataḥ ||98|| ahamājñāpayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ sāṃgrāmikaṃ vidhim || etāvaduktvā vijayaṃ senādhyakṣamathā'bravīt||99|| mamoṣṭravāhibhiḥ śīghraṃ śibireṣu mahīkṣitām || yodhānājñāpayatvadya śvobhūtāya raṇāya vai || 1.209.100 || yuddhāvadhānikaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ ca tathā tvayā || evamājñāpya nāgānāṃ turagāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 101 || pratyāvekṣāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sandhyāmanvāsya paścimām || rahogataḥ sa śuśrāva narāṇāṃ mūḍhabhāṣitam ||102 || āruroha tadā śrutvā prāsādaṃ himapāṇḍuram || kailāsaśikharākāraṃ nirvātaṃ rajanīmukhe || || 103 || tatastu sainikaḥ kaścicchibire bharatasya tu || talaṃ talenābhyahanatpavanārthaṃ yadṛcchayā || 104 || tatastu sainikaiḥ sarvaistalatālairmahāsvanam || cakrire puruṣavyāghra tasminkāle divaṃ gatam || 105 || pravavau ca tadānīto vāyurmanujapuṅgava || etasminneva kāle tu madrarājastadāṃśumān || 106 || prāsādavaramārūḍho jñātavānbharataṃ tadā || dīpālokena lakṣmyā ca prāsādasya vivṛddhayā || 107 ||| sa jagāma tadā rājā prahasansainikaṃ janam || bharatasya pradāsyāmi yuktyaiva baladarśanam || 108 || tṛṇamuṣṭimupādīpya sarvo'pi kaṭake janaḥ || pāṇāvādāya muditaḥ kṣveḍāśabdaṃ karotu vai || 109 || pārthivenaivamukte tu kaṭake tasya dhīmataḥ || solkāhasto janaḥ sarvaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata || || 1.209.110 || śibiraṃ madrarājñastu dvitīyamiva cāmbaram || babhūva tārakācitramulkāhastaistadā naraiḥ || 111 || tadbalaughamaparyantaṃ solkāhastairjanairvṛtam || dṛṣṭvā jagāma dharmātmā parāṃ prītiṃ raghūdvahaḥ || 112 || kṣveḍāḥ kilakilāścaiva śrutvā harṣamupāgataḥ || tasminpraśānte jvalane mandībhūte ca nisvane || 113 || abhyahanyanta bhūpānāṃ śibireṣu pṛthakpṛthak || saṃjñātūryāṇi ramyāṇi nānāliṅgāni cāpyatha || 114 || subahūni mahārāja tena kolāhalaṃ mahat || babhūva prītijananaṃ bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || 115 || mantrayitvā tataḥ śrīmānkṣaṇamātraṃ yudhājitā|| tenaiva saha bhuktvā ca suṣvāpa śayanottame || madhureṇa sugītena vīṇāveṇuraveṇa ca || 116 || himāvadāte varamālyacitre vitānakādhovihite manojñe || suṣvāpa rātriṃ sa mahānubhāvo bhogīndrabhoge madhujidyathaiva || 117 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde yuddhaprasaṅgavarṇanonāma navottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 209 || <1.210> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || āhvānadundubhiṃ śrutvā śailūṣatanayāstataḥ || āseduḥ pārthivaṃ sarve śailūṣaṃ taṃ samāgatāḥ || 1 || namuciḥ kāmapālaśca gaveṣaṇasudarśanau || vīrabāhuḥ subāhuśca vāyuvegasuvarcasau ||2|| nikumbhaḥ kumbhanāmā ca balāko balakastathā || harikeśo mahojāśca sūryaraśmiprabhaṅkaraḥ || 3 || vṛndārako jyautiṣiko dṛḍhasyuraparājitaḥ || kumudaḥ kumudāpīḍo vasunāthaḥ sulocanaḥ || 4 || candrāpīḍo gadī maulī kinnaro'jagaro ruhaḥ || kesarī varavāṇaśca bhānurāgāvaho rayiḥ ||5|| ekalavyo viśālaśca kalaviṅkaḥ kalāpriyaḥ || bhīmanādo mahānādo vāsukiḥ panaso gadaḥ || 6 || candravarmā mahāvarmā vasuṣeṇo'grajārakaḥ || ete cānye ca gandharvāḥ śailūṣasya sutāḥ prabhoḥ || 7 || divyamālyāmbaradharā divyacandanabhūṣitāḥ || āsaneṣu mahārheṣu sabhāyāṃ viviśustadā || 8 || śailūṣasya sutairguptā sabhā sā ratnacitritā || rarāja tārakā citrā niśeva nṛpa śāradī || 9 || teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ śailūṣastānathābravīt || gārgyasya vacanaṃ sarvamanumānaṃ tathā svakam || 1.210.10 || te'bhiyogaṃ tadā śrutvā mānuṣānmanujeśvara || cakrurnānāvidhāśceṣṭā manyunā krodhacetasaḥ || 11 || gandharvarājaputrāste krodhādaśrupravarṣiṇaḥ || rejuryugāntameghābhā acirābhāsadṛgdṛśā || 12 || babhāra namucirvaktraṃ krodharāgānurañjitam || diksaumyeva diśādāhaṃ mahāsaṃgrāmasūcakam || 13|| kāmapālalalāṭasthā triśikhā bhrukuṭī babhau || tribhiḥ prapātairgaṅgeva nipatantī himācalam || 14 || kṛṣṇe sa śuklaparyante krodharāgānurañjite|| kumudāpīḍanetre tu sandhyā tāmre babhūvatuḥ || 15 || krodhākrāntena vapuṣā kumudaḥ kumudaprabhaḥ || raktotpalanibhākāraḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata || 16 || candrāpīḍamukhaṃ cāru krodhadhūmrānukāritam || babhāra rūpaṃ tanvabhrasaṃbhṛtasya niśābhṛtaḥ || 17 || krodhaniśvāsadhūmena bhānorvaktramathāvṛtam || babhūva bhānoḥ sadṛśamuparāge yadūttama || 18 || karaniṣpeṣasaṃjātadhūmadhūmramukhāṅgakaḥ || anvarthanāmatāmāpa tasminkāle sudarśanaḥ || 19 || gaveṣaṇapravegena vahnigarbhojjvalātmanā || tārābhivarṣaṇenaiva sūcito bhūpatikṣayaḥ || 1.210.20 || vīrabāhubhujāghātaratnaniṣpeṣareṇunā || vijṛmbhitamathāsthāne krodheneva vapuṣmatā || 21 || subāhubāhuniṣpeṣo babhūvāśaninisvanaḥ || nirghāta iva gambhīro rājñāṃ nidhanasūcakaḥ || 22 || vāyuvegamahāvegacaraṇollikhitā kṣitiḥ || vidadre pṛthivīpāla vināśabhayaśaṃsinī || 23 || āyāsajātasaṃsvedapulakodgamabhūṣitam || suvarcā dhārayāmāsa lalāṭataṭapaṭṭakam || 24 || prasvinnagātrasaṃkrāntakāñcanastambhapiṅgalaḥ || babhūva kumbhanābhastu krodho vigrahavāniva || 25 || suviniḥsṛtaromāgnijvālākesaramālinā || nṛsiṃhavapuṣaścakre raviṇānukṛtirhareḥ || 26 || prasvitragātrasaṃkrāntasarvagandharvamaṇḍalaḥ || viśvarūpadharaṃ maulaḥ prajahāsa janārdanam || 27 || gandharvarājaputrāste manyunā hṛtacetasaḥ || tadā babhūvurbhūpāla sarva eva viśeṣataḥ || 28 || itthaṃ sutānāṃ prasamīkṣya kopaṃ saṃsmṛtya vākyāni purohitasya || jagāma manyuṃ sutarāṃ sa rājā sandaṣṭadantacchadabhīmavaktraḥ || 29 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gandharvasabhākṣobhavarṇano nāma daśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 210 || <1.211> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || dṛṣṭvā gandharvarājasya krodhenākulitaṃ manaḥ || tamūcurnṛpa gandharvāḥ svabāhubaladarpitāḥ || 1 || aparājita uvāca || sarvamālabhate rājannaśokaḥ śūrabāhuṣu || tasmācchauryeṇa nidhanaṃ raghūṇāṃ mama rocate || 2 || nikumbha uvāca || yo'yaṃ manyuḥ samudbhūtaḥ kākutsthānprati me prabho || avināśi jagatkṛtsnaṃ vināśaṃ samupaiṣyati || 3 || || kinnara uvāca || yā lakṣmīranuliptāṅgī vairiśoṇitakuṅkumaiḥ|| kāntāpi sarasāṃ prītiṃ na sā dhatte manasvinām|| 4 || vasunābha uvāca || kṛpāṇadhārāvidhvastaśatrusaṅghasamudbhavā || na yā śrīḥ kiṃ tayā kāryaṃ rājansattvavatāṃ nṛṇām || 5 || || ajagara uvāca || ajitārigaṇopāntasampado bhūṣaṇakriyā || vipadvarīyasī tābhiryā na sampadvibhūṣaṇā || 6 || || ruha uvāca || śobhante karkaśāḥ śūrāḥ stanā iva samunnatāḥ || śūrāṇāṃ ca stanānāṃ ca parāvajñākarī ratiḥ || 7 || ||keśa uvāca || tejasvināmabhyudayaṃ vandanīyaṃ jagattraye || yathā bhāskaramudyantaṃ janaḥ sarvo'bhinandati || 8 || || paravāraṇa uvāca || sattvādhikasya siṃhasya līlonmathitapādapāḥ || na śaktāḥ purataḥ sthātuṃ śailakūṭopamā gajāḥ || 9 || || ābhāvaha uvāca || na jātu śamanaṃ yasya tejastejasi tejasām || vṛthā jātena kiṃ tena māturvārddhakya kāriṇā || 1.211.10 || ekalavya uvāca || nāmni saṃkīrtite yasya na bhavantyarayo bhayāt || vivarṇavadanacchāyāḥ kā dayā tasya jīvane || 11 || viśāla uvāca || lakṣmīsaṅgamalubdhānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ ca raṇodbhavā || kīrtirbhavati saivāśu saṃyogakaraṇā sakhī || 12 || || kalipriya uvāca || ripuraktaparā siktā ripustrīnetravāriṇā || na yasya siñcitā kīrtiḥ kā spṛhā tasya jīvane || 13 || || bhīmanāda uvāca || tejasaiva samākrāntasamastabhuvano raviḥ || karoti padavinyāsaṃ sarveṣāmeva mūrdhasu || 14 || ||mahādharma uvāca || śatrumastakavinyastapadakramavilāsinī || kavidattakarālambā kīrtiryātu divaṃ tava || 15 || || vāsukiruvāca || māyānihatamātaṅgamadhyadvīpavidāritām || kṣitiṃ bhittvāviśatkanyā kīrtito vasudhātalam || 16|| || panasa uvāca || hatārilakṣmīsaṃyogavikasadvadanasya te || prayātu tvaritā kīrtiḥ krodhaneva diśo daśa ||17|| gada uvāca||| satoyatoyadākārairnāgairdānapravarṣibhiḥ || ākrāntadiṅmukhe yuddhe vidyuttvamme karotvasiḥ || 18 || mahānāda uvāca || madīyasiṃhanādena vitrāsitagajākulam || balaṃ nipātayārīṇāṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || 19 || vasuruvāca || gajāśvarathapādātacaraṇollikhitaṃ rajaḥ || draṣṭāsi praśamaṃ yātaṃ paritastvariśoṇitaiḥ || 1.211.20 || vṛndāraka uvāca || gajakumbhasamudrasthamuktāphalavikāsiṣu || tiṣṭhatsu rājankhaḍgeṣu kaḥ saheta parābhavam || 21 || || jyotiṣika uvāca || kāpiśabhrūlatābhaṅgakuṭiladvayakoṭiṣu || vidyamāneṣu cāpeṣu kaḥ saheta parābhavam || 22 || dṛḍhasyuruvāca || rājaṃstīkṣṇāḥ santi yasya viśikhāḥ pañca māninaḥ || kimanyaistasya kartavyaṃ pakṣapātibhirāhave || 23 || candrāpīḍa uvāca || kimāyudhaiḥ sattvavatāṃ cārudordaṇḍa śālinām || sadyaḥ sañjātamanyūnāṃ yuddhavyākṣepakārakaiḥ || 24 || gadyuruvāca || khaḍgāstiṣṭhantu me tucchā bhuktabhaṅgāṭṭahāsinaḥ || ekadordaṇḍaśeṣo'pi kaḥ saheta parābhavam || 25 || kalaviṅka uvāca || madbāhumandarakṣubdhavairisainyamahārṇavāt || bhuṅkṣva lakṣmīṃ samutpannāṃ cirāya jagatīpate || 26 || || gaja uvāca || kimāyudhaiḥ sattvavatāṃ kupuṃsāṃ ca kimāyudhaiḥ || arātiśastrāṇyekeṣāmanyeṣāmaphalāni hi || 27 || balaka uvāca || durbalotkhāta śakrebhadaśanābhihate harau || mayādya surarāḍastu bhavāṃstribhuvaneśvaraḥ || 28 || || pranaṣṭadevatāpūjaṃ balihīnaṃ sudurdaśam || mayā kṛtamathādyāstu trailokyamapi suprabho || 29 || harika uvāca || kīnāśamahiṣeṇādya harasya vṛṣabheṇa tu || ayodhyāṃ vāhayiṣyāmi śeṣāherlāṅgalena ca || 1.211.30 || mahodara uvāca || nirastamayamārtaṇḍe mayā loke carācare || yamasya mahiṣaṃ paśya kramantaṃ sūryavājiṣu || 31 || sūrya uvāca || niḥśeṣadevatāsaṃghe mayā lokatraye kṛte || durgāsiṃhavinirbhinnaṃ paśyādya maghavadgajam || 32 || prabhasa uvāca || nirastāmbupipāsena samākṛṣṭa dhaneśvarāḥ || praṇamantu tavādyaiva devasaṃghā hatatviṣaḥ || 33 || bhadraka uvāca || skandaśaṅkaraśūnye'sminmayā tribhuvane kṛte || śikhī saṃbhakṣayatvadya śarvābharaṇapannagān || 34 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || krodhāndhakārakaluṣīkṛtacāruvaktrāngandharvarājatanayānprasamīkṣamāṇaḥ || jagāda rājānamadīna sattvo nāḍāyanākhyastu tadā purodhāḥ || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gandharvagarjanaṃ nāmaikādaśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 211 || <1.212> || nāḍāyana uvāca || || ekayā dve viniścitya trīṃścaturbhirvaśīkuru || pañca jitvā vijitvā ṣaṭ sapta hitvā sukhī bhava || 1 || ekayā prajñayā rājankāryākāryadvayaṃ naraḥ || viniścitya tu yaḥ kuryātkāryaṃ tatra sa paṇḍitaḥ || 2 || madhyasthaṃ yadi vā mitraṃ śatruṃ vā kāryagauravāt || jñātvā deśaṃ ca kālaṃ ca hyupāyairabhyupakramet || 3 || sāmabhedapradānāśca upāyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || upāyaśca caturtho 'tra daṇḍastvagatikā gatiḥ || 4 || pañcendriyajayo yena kṛta ādau jigīṣuṇā || trilokavijayaṃ tasya na dūre pratibhāti me || 5 || pañcendriya jayaṃ kṛtvā guṇaṣaṭkamupāśrayet || buddhvā balābalaṃ samyagātmanaścāparasya ca || 6 || rājadoṣāḥ parityaktā yena sapta narādhipa || siddhiṃ tasya samāyānti yathākālaṃ guṇā nṛpa || 7 || mṛgayāyānamukhyāśca striyaśca puruṣā giraḥ || arthasandūṣaṇaṃ caiva daṇḍapāruṣyameva ca || 8 || rājadoṣaiḥ parityaktā rāghavāstatra pārthiva || guṇāśrayavibhāgajñā vigrahastairna rocate || 9 || bharatena vayaṃ sāmnā bale mahati tiṣṭhatā || prathamaṃ samupākrāntaṃ tadeva tava rocatām || 1.212.10 || bharatasya vayaṃ sāmnā yadi gacchema parvatam || hitaṃ tatsyānmahābhāga sakulasya tavā'nagha || 11 || tvayā kṛtvā samucchedaṃ rājñāṃ jananivāsinām || akāraṇānmahadvairaṃ kṛtaṃ bhūpatibhiḥ saha || 12 || jane nivāsādasmākaṃ kevalaṃ laghutā bhavet || mānuṣaiḥ saṃgamaścaiva vigrahaśca punaḥpunaḥ || 13 || na kṛṣirna ca vāṇijyaṃ jano'smākaṃ prayojanam || te vayaṃ sajanāṃ bhūmiṃ tyaktvā yāmaḥ śiloccayam || 14 || apekṣya deśakālau ca saṃdhiṃ vigrahameva ca || phalaṃ ca buddhvā yaḥ kuryātsa rājanpaṇḍito naraḥ || 15 || bhūmirhiraṇyaṃ mitraṃ ca trividhaṃ vigrahāspadam || svayaṃgrāho yadasmākaṃ meruḥ kanakaparvataḥ || || 16 || hiraṇyena tadā kāryaṃ na no'sti ripusūdana || kṛṣirnāsti yato'smākaṃ tato bhūrniṣprayojanā || 17 || tasmādbharatamanviccha mitraṃ sāmnā narādhipa || mitraṃ raghukulaṃ kṛtvā nivāsastu himācale || 18 || adṛśyaṃ devasainyānāṃ sukhaṃ ciramavāpnuhi || na mānuṣo'yamityevaṃ bharataṃ mantumarhasi || 19 || duṣṭānāṃ nigrahārthāya caturmūrtirjanārdanaḥ || jāto raghukule rājanputro daśarathasya tu ||1.212.20|| aṃśena vāsudevasya jāto rāmo mahāyaśāḥ || saṃkarṣaṇasya cāṃśena lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā || 21 || pradyumnasya tathāṃśena bharato dharmavatsalaḥ || aniruddhasya cāṃśena śatrughnaḥ sumahābalaḥ || || 22 || tatra rāghavasiṃhena rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || rāvaṇo'bhihataḥ saṃkhye sarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ || 23 || meghanādo nirastaśca saṃgrāme lakṣmaṇena ca || śatrughnena nirastaśca lavaṇo duṣṭarākṣasaḥ || 24 || manye viśiṣṭabhāvatvaṃ bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || yena mālī hataḥ pūrvaṃ laṅkāvāsī sa rākṣasaḥ || 25 || sa eṣa bharato viṣṇurasti te tu raṇaṃgamaḥ||26|| hite sthito yaḥ satataṃ surāṇāṃ daityendranāśāya niviṣṭabuddhiḥ || tenā'prameyeṇa janārdanena samaṃ vrajasvāśu mahānubhāva || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde nāḍāyanavākye śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanānuśāsanavarṇano nāma dvādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 212 || <1.213> || śailūṣa uvāca || sumālī viṣṇunā pūrvaṃ kathaṃ yuddhe nipātitaḥ || etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi śrūyate sa mahābalaḥ || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || katheyaṃ rājaśārdūla purāgastyena dhīmatā || rāmāya kathitā vīra tāṃ me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||2|| purā vinihate vṛtre daityā vigatanāyakāḥ || abdurgaṃ sāgaraṃ kṛtvā rātrau nighnanti vai prajāḥ || 3 || suraiḥ sarvaiḥ samāgamya tathā'yaṃ na parairvadham || samudrodakapānāya agastyaścoditastadā || 4 || devakarmapramuditastadāgastyamunirnṛpa || pītvā cakāra rājendra nistoyaṃ salilāśayam| || 5 || devaiśca nihatā daityā nistoye salilāśaye || tataḥ kadācidvindhyastu jagādārkaniśākarau || 6 || meruṃ tyaktvā mahābhāgau mama yāta pradakṣiṇam || ūcatustau tadā vindhyamāvayostu vaśaṃ gire || 7 || tena panthāḥ kṛto'smākaṃ yenedaṃ nirmitaṃ jagat || etacchrutvā tu vidhnyastu tapastaptvā pitāmahāt || 8 || iṣupātamathocchrāyaṃ pratyahaṃ samavāptavān || tataḥ katipayāhena diśamāvṛtya dakṣiṇām || 9 || āvṛtya tasthau panthānaṃ divākaraniśābhṛtoḥ || tato'ndhamabhavatsarvo bhūrlokaḥ pārthivottama || 1.213.10 || prerito devavākyena tato'gastyo mahātapāḥ || gatvovāca tadā vindhyaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ karomyaham || 11 ||| matkṛte hrasvatāṃ gaccha yena yāsyāmyahaṃ sukhī || jñātvā tataḥ prabhāvaṃ tu so'gastyasya mahāgiriḥ || 12 || jagāma hrasvatāṃ śīghramagastyo'pi tadā yayau || dakṣiṇāśāṃ parityajya na yāvadahamāgataḥ || 13 || saputradārastāvattvaṃ hrasva eva bhavā'cala || evamuktvā sa vindhyantu sadārāpatyabāndhavam || 14 || jagāma dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ tamuvāca pitāmahaḥ || devakāryaṃ mahadbrahmaṃstvayā kṛtamidaṃ śubham || 15 || tasmātsthānaṃ ca te dadmi vaiśvānarapathādbahiḥ || divyadeho bhavāṃstatra vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 16 || dakṣiṇāṃ bhūṣaya diśamastodayasamanvitaḥ || prasādamambhasāṃ śaityaṃ nirviṣatvaṃ tavodaye || 17 || bhaviṣyatyamalaprajña matprasādāttavaiva tu || śaratsu mudito vasantestamayaṃ vraja || 18 || prākāmyayuktaśca tathā samagrāṃ vasudhāṃ cara || pradhānamūrtiryāvattvaṃ sadārāpatyabāndhavaḥ || 19 || nākramiṣyati vai vindhyaṃ tāvadvindhyācalaḥ sthitaḥ || prākāmyamūrtiyukte tu yatra kvacana saṃsthite || 1.213.20 || tvayi vindhyo mahāśailo vṛddhiṃ na sa gamiṣyati || ilvalaścāpi durmedhā bhrātrā vai meṣarūpiṇā || || 21 || yadā bhojayate viprānbhuktavatsu dvijātiṣu || kukṣibhedantu vātāpī kṛtvā nirgacchate punaḥ || 22 || evaṃ vinighnatastasya brāhmaṇānyattvayā kṛtam || śaraṇaṃ tena tuṣṭo'smi vindhyasaṃstambhanena ca || 23 || śaratsamayamāsādya yasmādvipra navodaye || pūjāṃ tvamāpsyase loke matprasādāddvijottama || 24 || ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti gandhamālyaphalākṣataiḥ || dadhikāñcanaratnaiśca paramānnena bhūriṇā || 25 || pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sakūṣmāṇḍaiśchatropānahayaṣṭibhiḥ || dhenvā vṛṣeṇa bhakṣyaiśca vāsobhiḥ kanakena ca || 26 || saṃvatsaraṃ ca tyāgena phalasyaikasya cāpyatha || pūjanairbrāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ tvatkarmaparikīrtanaiḥ|| 27 || te prāpsyanti sadā putrāndhanamārogyameva ca || āyuragryaṃ tathā loke śatrubhiścāparājayam|| 28 || saubhāgyaṃ vipulānkāmāndharmavṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca || evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata || 29 || āsasāda tathā sthānamagastyo'pi mahātapāḥ || yena kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ tathā mahat || 1.213.30 || tena svatapasā sṛṣṭā lopāmudrā priyaṃvadā || vidarbharājatanayā dharmapatnī tathātmanaḥ || 31 || dṛḍhasyustanayastasya tapasvī ca mahātapāḥ || pramucurmumucuścaiva tanmucuśca mahātapāḥ || 32 || svastyātreyastathā vidvāṃstasya śiṣyo mahātmanaḥ || abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ dattaṃ tathā'kṣayye maheṣudhī || 33 || rāmalakṣmaṇayostena dhanuṣī ca mahābale || ghoreṇāpyatha saṃyuktaḥ sa ca vaiṣṇavatejasā || 34 || karmaṇā kīrtanaṃ yasya naro varṣaśatairapi || kartuṃ śakto na sahate prākāmye caiva rāvaṇe || 35 || ayodhyāṃ rāghavaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagāma tvarito muniḥ || tamāgatamabhiprekṣya pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ || 36 || pādyārghyācamanīyādyaiḥ sarvai rājyanivedanaiḥ || saṃpūjitastadā tena tatra cakre kathāḥ śubhāḥ || 37 || tataḥ kathānte kasmiṃścittamapṛcchattu rāghavaḥ || viṣṇunā mālinidhanaṃ tenoktaṃ tasya tacchrṛṇu || 38 || yaduktavānrāghavanandanasya candrārkavahnipratimaprabhāvaḥ || rakṣogaṇeśasya vadhaṃ sughoraṃ munirmahātmā tadidaṃ nibodha || 36 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde nāḍāyanavākye śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanoktāgastyamāhātmyavarṇano nāma trayodaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 213 || <1.214> agastya uvāca || mālī sumālī rājendra mālyavāṃśca raṇotkaṭaḥ || laṅkādurgamathāsādya citramūṣuḥ parasparam || 1 || mālī sumālī durvṛttau pīḍayantau ca devatāḥ || vāryamāṇāvapi sadā tena mālyavatā nṛpa || 2 || tayorbhītaiḥ surairbrahmā jñāpitaḥ saprayojanam || brahmaṇā sahitairgatvā jñāpitastripurāntakaḥ || 3 || brahmeśasahitā devā viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamīyuṣaḥ || jagmurlavaṇatoyasthaṃ vijñāpayitumacyutam || 4 || dadṛśuśca raghuśreṣṭha samudraṃ pītamambhasām || ūrmivargaiḥ pranṛtyadbhirvalgantamiva vāyunā || 5 || hasantamiva phenaughaiḥ skhalantaṃ kandarāsu ca || apāramiva garjantaṃ nānāyādogaṇāvṛtam || 6 || vīcihastaiḥ pracalitairāhvayānamivā'marād || phenavatyaḥ prakīrṇāśca saṃhatāśca samucchritāḥ ||7|| ūrmayaścāsya dṛśyante calanta iva parvatāḥ || timiṅgilāḥ kacchapāśca tathā timi timiṅgilāḥ || 8 || makarāścāpi dṛśyante jale magnā ivādrayaḥ || śaṅkhānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi magnānyapsu samantataḥ |||9|| dṛśyante sma yathā rātrau tārāstanvabhrasaṃvṛtāḥ || kvacitsuptaḥ kvacidgarjankvacidghūrṇankvacitskhalan|| 1.214.10 || kṣībopamaṃ taṃ dadṛśuḥ samudraṃ tridaśādhipāḥ || kvaciccāvāsitairdaityaiḥ kvaciddaityāriṇā tathā ||| 11 || kvacicca bhujagairbhīmairmahāgāmbhīryasaṃyutam || viṣṇorvarāhavapuṣā vikṣobhitajalāvilam || 12 || anāsāditabādhaṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ śatapatriṇā || tena devātidevena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||13|| nityamantarasaṃsthena nirmalīkṛtavigraham || śakravajrabhayatrasyamānaśailaśatā kulam || 14 || vidrumāmbaramāpluṣṭasadṛśākāravidrumam || pūrṇacandrakalaṅkasya kṣālanepsurivoddhataiḥ || 15 || khamākramati kallolaiḥ paurṇamāsīṣu yaḥ sadā || asaṃkhyātaṃ taraṅgaughaiḥ saṃkrāntaśaśimaṇḍalam || 16|| hasantaṃ vāntarikṣasya śriyamevendudhāriṇaḥ || digbhāgadānakāleṣu yuktaścandanavā riṇā || supyate ca yathā yatra satataṃ dānavāriṇā || 17 || tamantarikṣapratimaṃ viśālalolormimālākuladigvibhāgam || samudramāsādya divaukasasta mātasthurugraṃ tapasograsattvāḥ || 18|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye samudravarṇano nāma caturdaśo ttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||214|| <1.215> agastya uvāca || tapasā toṣito devairdevadevo janārdanaḥ || mahodavāsaṃ saṃtyajya surāṇāṃ darśanaṃ dadau ||1|| te ca taṃ vibudhārighnaṃ dharaṇīpātapāṃsulaiḥ || jānupāṇilalāṭāntaiḥ praṇemurmuditā harim||2|| tuṣṭuvuśca tathā vāgbhirathocuḥ svaprayojanam || vadhārthaṃ devadevasya sukeśatanayānprati || 3 || pratijajñe tadā teṣāṃ devo mālivadhaṃ hariḥ || yūyaṃ sumālinidhane śaktāḥ stha surasattamāḥ || 4 || mālyavānapyavadhyo'sau satataṃ dharmavatsalaḥ || evamuktvā tatastārkṣyamāhvayāmāsa keśavaḥ||5|| tamāruroha sarvātmā kāñcanaṃ vinatāsutam || śaṃkhacakragadāpadmalācchito madhusūdanaḥ|| ||6|| atasīkusumaśyāmaḥ kāñcane khagame sthitaḥ || śriyamūhe satoyasya toyadasya savidyutaḥ ||7|| kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ varabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || vihaṅga varamārūḍhamanujagmurdivaukasaḥ || 8 || sudhāvadātasatpakṣairvitatāmbaradhāvibhiḥ || haṃsaistamanvayādbrahmā jaṭāmaṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ || 9 || candraraśmipratīkāśanibiḍāṅgakakudmikaḥ || harastṛtīyanetrārcirvidāritanabho yayau || 1.215.10 || mahendranetrasaṃkāśakalāpāṭoparodhinā || skandastamanvayau tasmā nmayūreṇa ṣaḍānanaḥ || 11 || vināyakānkartumanā rākṣasendrānvināyakaḥ || vāyumaṇḍalamārūḍhaḥ prayayāvanumādhavam || 12 || vahrijvālāvalī puñjasamakesaramālinā || siṃhenānuyayau devī bhadrakālī janārdanam || 13 || varastrīkucasaṃkāśakumbhairāvaṇapṛṣṭagaḥ || kirīṭī vajrapāṇistamanvayau tridaśādhipaḥ || 14 || vahnistamanvayau devaṃ śukayānena pārthiva || sendragopagaṇākīrṇaśādvalasthalaśobhinā || 15 || girikūṭasamākāraṃ śṛṅga bhūṣitamastakam || vaivasvato'pi mahiṣamāruhyānuyayau harim || 16 || śaṅkukarṇo mahāgrīvo varebhaskandhasaṃsthitaḥ || paścādanuyayau devaṃ virūpākṣo mahābalaḥ || 17 || mahāyānena ramyeṇa manomārutaraṃhasā || varuṇo'nuyayau paścātsnigdhavaidūryasannibhaḥ || 18 || manaḥśīghragatirdevo vāyu maṇḍalamadhyagaḥ || vāyuścānuyayau paścādvāyupūrṇaśubhāṃśukaḥ || 19 || dhanado narayānena sarvaratnojvalātmanā || govindamanuvavrāja śriyā paramayā yutaḥ || 1.215.20 || saptāśvamekacakraṃ ca rathamāruhya bhānumān || tathaivānuyayau devaṃ prabhāmaṇḍaladurdṛśaḥ || 21 || candraścaṇḍaprabhāvāro daśabhisturago ttamaiḥ || manojavena ca tathā rathenānuyayau harim || 22 || turaṅgavaramāruhya bhāskarapratimākṛtiḥ || tamanvayau tadā rājanpracaṇḍo ravinandanaḥ || || 23 || caturbhiḥ kuñjarairyuktaṃ rathamāsthāya satvarā || tamanvayau dharādevī devaṃ tridaśapūjitam || 24 || saṅkalparathamāruhya vyavasāya puraḥsaraḥ || manorathenānuyayau kāmadevo'pi keśavam|| 25 || puṣpeṣorapi yasyājñāṃ bibharti sakalaṃ jagat || anālasyaṃ samārūḍhā tathā devī sarasvatī || || 26 || anyayā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalama || bhaumajñajīvaśukrāśca rāhuḥ ketūḥ śanaiścaraḥ || 27 || vājiyuktai rathaiḥ śīghraramanvayuḥ puruṣo ttamam|| devāścaikonapañcāśanmarutaścārumaṇḍalāḥ||28|| anujagmuḥ surāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vāyumaṇḍalamadhyagāḥ || anujagmustamādityā rathaiḥ kāñcana suprabhaiḥ || 29 || vasavo'ṅgirasaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāstathāśvinau || bhṛgavaścāśvasaṃyuktai rathaistaṃ devamanvayuḥ || 1.215.30 || rudrāścānuyayurdevaṃ balodagraiḥ kakudmibhiḥ || tathaivānye balodagrā devā devānuyāyinaḥ || 31 || gardabhaiḥ śiśumāraiśca mahoṣṭrairmahiṣoragaiḥ || siṃhavyāghratarakṣvṛkṣagajavānara markaṭaiḥ || 32 || camaraiḥ sṛmaraiścaiva godhāmārjāraśallakaiḥ || vividhaiḥ pakṣiyānaiśca te'nujagmurjanārdanam || 33 || siddhamārgeṇa siddhāśca prayayurmunayastathā || stuvantaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devasaṃghabhayāpaham || 34 || gītavādyaiḥ sumadhuraiḥ sevamānā janārdanam || prahṛṣṭāḥ prayayustatra gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 35 || tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dānaṃ vratāni vividhāni ca || yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi kālasyāvayavāstathā || 36 || saṃvatsarāstathā māsāḥ pakṣau ca karaṇaiḥ saha || yugāyanamuhūrtāśca śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || 37 || mūrtimanti tathāstrāṇi śastrāṇi ca jagatpateḥ || samudrapathataddvīpaśākhināṃ vigrahāṇi ca || 38 || varṣāṇāṃ ca śarīrāṇi pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā gaṇāḥ || nakṣatrāṇi diśaścaiva vidiśaśca mahīpate || 39 || devā vanaspatiścaiva yāśca lokasya mātaraḥ || devadaityagaṇā ye ca tathā pitṛgaṇāśca ye || 1.215.40 || gandharvayakṣanāgānāṃ gaṇā ye ca nareśvara || ghorā vyādhigaṇāścaiva kālapāśaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ || 41 || mṛtyurdaṇḍastathā krodho jarā ca manujeśvara || anvayuḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ rakṣogaṇavadhaiṣiṇam || 42 ||| jayaśrīragratastasya prayāti raghunandana || saritaśca tathā yānaiḥ sarvalokasya mātaraḥ ||43|| makareṇa yayau gaṅgā kālindī kacchapena tu|| sārasenāpi sarayūḥ śiśumāreṇa gomatī || 44 || godāvarī ca khaḍgena mayūreṇa sarasvatī || kakudminā śatadruśca vipāśā turageṇa ca || 45 || candrabhāgā ca siṃhena dantinerāvatī tathā || sindhurvyāghreṇa matsyena vitastā ca tathā yayau || 46 || devikā caiva haṃsena puruṣeṇa ca gaṇḍakī || mahiṣeṇa payoṣṇī ca kāverī vṛṣabheṇa tu || 47 || hiraṇvatī suparṇena cakreṇekṣumatī nadī || bhujagena ca pārṇāśā varāheṇa ca kauśikī|| 48 || vedasmṛtirmayūreṇa sāraṅgeṇa ca narmadā || jīvajīvakamārūḍhā sītāpi prayayau nadī || 49 || hrādinī ca sarorūḍhā sṛmareṇa ca pāvanī || śaśakenāpi lauhityā nadī sindhurgajena ca || 1.215.50 || urabhreṇa tathā cakṣuḥ sītā cājena rāghava || gautamī kukkuṭenāpi cāṣeṇa ca dṛṣadvatī || 51 || svaiḥ svairyānaistathaivānyāḥ prayayurnimnagā harima || devānuyātrāghoṣeṇa vāditrāṇāṃ raveṇa ca ||52|| stūyamāno dvijāgryaiśca prayayau kamalekṣaṇaḥ || tadbalo yamaparyantaṃ devagandharvasaṃkulam || 53 || ātapatraiḥ patākābhiḥ svacihnaiśca virājitam || kiṅkiṇīśatasaṃghoṣaṃ prayayāvanukeśavam || 54 ||| raśmyutkarairdevavibhūṣaṇānāṃ pradīpyamānaṃ kalanakādicitram|| balaṃ yayau tattridaśottamānāṃ nārāyaṇenā'pratimena guptam||55|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottara purāṇe prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde devaprayāṇavarṇano nāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||215|| <1.216> agastya uvāca || devatānāṃ samudyogaṃ śrutvā mālisumālinau || cakratuḥ pṛtanāṃ ghorāṃ tridaśairyuddhakāṅkṣiṇau || 1 || tau kruddhau bhrātarau śrīmānmālyavānvākyamabravīt || āśrayastridaśendrāṇāṃ sarvātmā madhusūdanaḥ || 2 || tena yuddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ sa tu pūjyo jagatpatiḥ || agre tu praṇipātena taṃ yajāmo jagatpatim || 3 || praṇipātaprasanno hi kāmāndāsyati keśavaḥ || viṣṇurhi maline citte'tvasmākaṃ nṛpa durjayaḥ || 4|| jīvema suciraṃ kālaṃ sthitā devasya śāsane || prasīda rājanmā yuddhaṃ vraja devena viṣṇunā||5|| yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca kuru śreyastathātmanaḥ || etaduktaṃ hitaṃ bhrātrā ruruce na ca tasya tat || 6 || mahatā ca sa sainyena prayayau yena keśavaḥ || tamanvayau mahātejā sumālī rākṣasādhipaḥ||7|| pitṛtulyaśca sādhūnāṃ jyeṣṭhabhrātā gururmataḥ|| ādau vācyaṃ hitaṃ tasya kāryaṃ tadanuceṣṭitam||8|| etāṃ buddhiṃ samāsthāya niryāto mālyavānapi|| te rākṣasā saha bhrātrā bhīmanetrāgnibhūṣaṇāḥ ||9 || koṭīśatena mukhyānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ vinirgatāḥ || nānāvidhogravasanā nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ || 1.216.10 || nānāvāditraghoṣeṇa prayātā rākṣasādhipāḥ || nānāprakārairvividhaiḥ prāṇibhirbalavattaraiḥ || 11 || vāhanaiḥ prayayurghorā rākṣasāstridaśādhipam || gacchatastu balaughasya tadā tasyottarāṃ diśama || babhūvā'bhimukhaṃ ghoraṃ vanaṃ tridaśapālitam || 12 || himācalasyottaradigvibhāge khasthe bale te puruṣau pravīra || jayārthamabhyudyatacāpadaṇḍau pracakraturyuddhamadīnasattvau || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanānuśāsane rākṣasasenāniryāṇavarṇano nāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 216 || <1.217> agastya uvāca || tataḥ prāvartata raṇaṃ khasthayorbalayostayoḥ || nānāpraharaṇodagrabhujayorjayamicchatoḥ || 1 || tadā balābhrasaṃcchanne gagane khaḍgavidyuti || tasminneva kṣaṇe jāto bhānumānnṛpa vidyatiḥ ||2|| calatkhaḍgalatāvidyutsamudyotitavigrahāt || raktavṛṣṭiḥ papātorvyāṃ balameghānuvigrahāt||3|| tataḥ śoṇitavarṣeṇa sicyamāne mahītale || grāvavṛṣṭirmahatyāsīcchāditaṃ bhūtalaṃ yayā || 4 || āsīdagamyā vasudhā śoṇitaughapariplutā || rajasvaleva yuvatistadā tatra narādhipa || 5 || sphuramāṇā vidṛśyante bāhavaścandanokṣitāḥ || khaḍgaprahārapatitāḥ pañcaśīrṣā ivoragāḥ || 6 || mukhāni danta pūrāṇi tathā sarudhirāṇi ca || virejurdāḍimānīva pākaprasphuritāni vā || 7 || nipatadbhistathā chatraiścāmarairvyajanaistathā || vicchinnavāhanāṅgaiśca khamāsītsaṃkulaṃ tathā || 8 || kirīṭaiḥ kuṇḍalairhāraiḥ keyūrairaṅgadaistathā || pātyamānaiḥ khamabhavadraśmipuñjavirājitam || 9 || kṣurapravinikṛttāni rudhirākte mahītale || luṭhanti nāgahastāni bhogibhoganibhāni ca || 1.217.10 || adṛṣṭvā patitānīha śirāṃsi vasudhātale || hatvā vaṃśānkhamājagmuranveṣanta ivāsavaḥ ||11|| śarīrairbhūtalaṃ prāptā divaṃ prāptā śarīribhiḥ || antarikṣe vinihitā lokatrayajigīṣavaḥ|| chinnarākṣasamūrdhāno galadrudhirabindavaḥ || nyapatannuttarādeva śyenairupahṛtāśayāt || 13 || śyenānāṃ bhramatāṃ tatra rākṣasāmiṣalipsayā || babhūva sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ śīrṣāṇāṃ bhramatāṃ tathā || || 14 || nikṛttāṅganipātena patitā bahavastadā || suṣupurgāṃ samāliṅgya kravyādā rudhirāvilāḥ || 15 || nipatanmattamātaṅaprasphuratkumbhani rgatā || muktāphalairjahāsorvī śūrāliṅgananirvṛtā || 16 || hṛtakuñjaradaṃtāgravinagnāṅgāsturaṅgamāḥ || āseduḥ sucireṇorvī nabhasyeva gatāsavaḥ ||17 || saṃprāptarudhirāṃ bhūmiṃ raktāsyāstu niśācarāḥ || yayuḥ śarīrairnihatāḥ samare rudhirapriyāḥ || 18 || vartamāne tathā bhīme yuddhe bhīrubhayaṃkare || lokapālaśaravrātanirbhinnā rajanīcarāḥ || 19 || dudruvurbhayasaṃvignāstadā rāma diśo daśa || vipradrutaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ divaukasaiḥ || 1.217.20 || sumālirmālyavadgupto mālī devānathābravīt || kirañcharaughairvimalaistailadhautaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ || 21 || sānujena raṇe muktā śaravṛṣṭirdurāsadā || saṃchādayāmāsa diśaḥ pradiśaśca divaukasām || 22 || yathāśaktiśaravrātānvārayanto'pi devatāḥ || rākṣasendraśarairbhinnāḥ keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 23 || sa nivārya tadā sarvaṃ devasainyaṃ patatriṇā || pratyudyayau yuge yodhāndhanuṣā sapatatriṇā || 24 || etasminneva kāle tu rakṣasāṃ pīnavakṣasām || vinivṛttaṃ balaṃ sarvamamaraiḥ samarotsukam || 25 || tadbalaṃ sakalaṃ cakre śaraiḥ śārṅgapracoditaiḥ || chādayāmāsa samare gobhiḥ sūrya ivāniśam || 26 || nānāpraharaṇodagragarjamāno janārdanam || saṃchādayāṃ tadā cakruḥ sarvaiḥ praharaṇotkaraiḥ || 27 || saṃchādyamānaistairghoraiḥ keśavo rajanīcaraiḥ || jahāra śīrṣāṇi tadā teṣāṃ sannataparvabhiḥ || 28 || rathanīḍe dhanurnyasya mālī rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ || suparṇaṃ tāḍayāmāsa gadayā bhīmavegayā || 29 || gadāprahārābhihatastārkṣyaḥ parapurañjaya || parāṅmukhaṃ raṇāccakre vedanārto janārdanam || 1.217.30 || parāṅmukhe tadā tārkṣye parivṛttānano hariḥ || śīrṣaṃ jahāra cakreṇa rākṣasendrasya mālinaḥ || 31 || sakuṇḍalaṃ cārukirīṭajuṣṭaṃ niśācareśasya śiraḥ pṛthivyām || nipātitaṃ vīkṣya mudānvitāntā nāryo babhūbustridaśottamānām ||32|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanānuśāsane mālirākṣasavadhavarṇano nāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 217 || <1.218> || agastya uvāca || hate mālini daivena sāntvitaḥ pakṣirāḍasau || jahāra pakṣavātena nivṛtto rakṣasāṃ balam ||1|| te tārkṣyapakṣavātena śuṣkaparṇacayo yathā || drutā rākṣasaśārdūlāstadā rāma diśo daśa || 2 || avindamānāste śarma vāsudevabhayārditāḥ || pātālatalamāseduḥ sarva eva pṛthakpṛthak || 3 || tridaśāntsāntvayitvā ca viṣṇustridaśapūjitaḥ || antardhānaṃ yayau tatra sarveṣāmeva paśyatām || 4 || laṅkāpi śūnyā rājendra dattā vaiśravaṇāya sā || svayaṃ viśravasastasyaḥ rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt || 5 || vibhīṣaṇāya sā dattā tvayā hatvā ca rāvaṇam || rāma viṣṇuḥ samutpannastvaṃ vadhāyeha rakṣasām || 6 || tvayaiva yuddhe nihatā ye tu mātulasaṅkaṭāḥ || paulastyarākṣasā ye tu te hatāḥ sammataṃ tvayā || 7 || hantā na vidyate rāma rakṣasāṃ keśavaṃ vinā ||| dṛṣṭo'smi bhāṣitaśceti prayayau sa yathāgatam || 8 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || evamuktvā tato'gastyo yathāgatamarindama || tasmādyuddhaṃ na me rājannadya vai tava rocate || 9 || utsāhaśaktyā sampanno mantraśaktyā ca rāghavaḥ || prabhuśaktyā tathā yukto devaśaktyā tathaiva ca || 1.218.10 || sādhusādhyeṣu kāryeṣu kaḥ kuryādvigrahaṃ budhaḥ || kevalaṃ kopamāsthāya vigrahaṃ nṛpadoṣadam || |1 || kāmakrodhau jitau yena tenātmā vijitastathā || yenātmā vijitastena vijiteyaṃ vasundharā || 12 || rājño'vijitacittasya paracakrajayaḥ kutaḥ|| na cakasya jayaṃ kartuṃ śaknotyavijitendriyaḥ||13|| nāvajñā kasyacitkāryā'balo vā bahumanyate || nityaṃ loke hi dṛśyante śaktebhyaḥ śaktimattarāḥ || 14 || yathāśakti cikīrṣanti yathāśakti ca kurvate || na kaścidavamanyante narāḥ paṇḍitabuddhayaḥ || 15 || dvāvimau kaṇṭakau tīkṣṇau śarīrapariśoṣaṇau || yaścādhanaḥ kāmayate yaśca kupyatyanīśvaraḥ || 16 || dvāvimau puruṣau loke svargasyopari tiṣṭhataḥ || prabhuśca kṣamayā yukto daridraśca pradānavān || 17 || kaḥ kuryāddurbale krodhaṃ svabhāvādeva nirjite || balavatyapi kaḥ krodhaṃ kuryātprāṇaharaṃ naraḥ || 18 || apahārapravṛttasya kopastejasvitocyate || yasmāttasmādbudhaiḥ kopaḥ kopaṃ kṛtvā vinirjitaḥ ||19|| trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ || kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet||1.218.20|| anubandhaṃ ca saṃprekṣya vipākaṃ caiva karmaṇām || utthānamātmanaścaiva tataḥ karmasamārabhet || 21 || na rājyaṃ labdhamityevaṃ vartitavyaṃ ca sāmpratam || śriyaṃ hyavinayo hanti jarārūpamivottamam || 22 || tyaktvā janapade vāsaṃ yāhi rājanhimācalam || aviṣahyatamaṃ hatvā rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam || laṅkāṃ tyaktvā dhanādhyakṣaṃ paśya kailāsamāśritam || 23 || sa rāvaṇo rāghavasāyakārttastyaktvā śriyaṃ bhūmipate vipannaḥ || dhanādhipo'dyāpi viśāla kīrtiḥ karoti rājyaṃ kṣaṇadācarāṇām||24|| iti śrīviṣṇu0 pratha0 mā0saṃ0 rākṣasapātālapraveśavarṇano nāmāṣṭādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||218|| <1.219> || śailūṣa uvāca || || kathaṃ vaiśravaṇe dattā purā laṅkā dvijottama || kathaṃ cāpahatā tasya rāvaṇena mahātmanā || 1 || caritaṃ rāvaṇasyāhaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || trailokyaṃ vijitaṃ yena tapasā pauruṣeṇa ca || 2 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || || brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putraḥ pulastyo viditastathā || tasyāsīdviśravā nāma putrastrailokyaviśrutaḥ || 3 || pautrī bṛhaspateḥ patnī bharadvājasutā śubhā || babhūva tasya rājendra nāmnā vai devavarṇinī || 4 || tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa putraṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum || ārādhitaḥ sutapasā prādāttasya pitāmahaḥ || 5 || yakṣeśatvaṃ dhaneśatvaṃ lokapālatvameva ca || puṣpakaṃ ca tathā yānaṃ kāmagaṃ kāmarūpiṇam || 6 || putraṃ labdhavaraṃ rājanviśravā abhyabhāṣata || trikūṭe parvataśreṣṭhe nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || 7 || laṅkā nāma purī ramyā devarājakṛte purā || hṛtvā tāṃ devarājasya sukeśatanayaiḥ purā || 8 || āyāsitā mahārāja teṣāṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tu mālinam || nipātya vāsudevena te tu vidrāvitāstataḥ || 9 || pātālatalamāśritya te vasantīha nirbhayāḥ || 1.219.10 || tāṃ tvaṃ laṅkāṃ samāsādya vasa yakṣasamanvitaḥ || dharmeṇa pālayanrājyaṃ satataṃ rākṣaseśvara || 11 || dharme te dīyatāṃ buddhiḥ sarvāvasthasya sarvadā || dharmādarthaśca kāmaśca dharmamūlamidaṃ jagat || 12 || śrutvā piturvākyamadīnasattvo laṅkāṃ samāsādya dhanādhināthaḥ || dharmeṇa lokaṃ sa tu rañjayānaścakāra rājyaṃ kṣaṇadācarāṇām || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanānuśāsane laṅkākathāyāṃ vaiśravaṇākhyānaṃ varṇano nāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 219 || <1.220> || nāḍāyana uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu sumālī vasudhātalam || cacārādāya tanayāṃ kaikasīṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 1 || caransa vasudhāṃ sphītāṃ dadarśātha narādhipam || puṣpakaṃ yānamārūḍhaṃ śriyā paramayā yutam || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā kaikasīṃ vākyaṃ covāca rajanīcaraḥ || putri pradānakālaste na kaścittvāṃ vṛṇoti mām || 3 || aprārthitapradānaṃ ca dharṣaṇābhayaśaṅkayā || na karomi viśālākṣi tavārthaṃ varavarṇini || 4 || kaṣṭaṃ kanyāpitṛtvaṃ hi narāṇāṃ mānakāṅkṣiṇām || dhruvaṃ kanyāpitṛtvaṃ hi śakrasyāpi pradharṣaṇam || 5 || mātuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulaṃ yatra kanyā pradīyate || kulatrayaṃ saṃśayitaṃ kanyā kṛtveha tiṣṭhati || 6 || tenāhaṃ tvāṃ na dāsyāmi sā tvaṃ gaccha svayaṃ śubhe || bhartāraṃ varayasvāśu muniṃ viśravasaṃ vibhum || 7 || yataḥ so'yaṃ dhanādhyakṣaḥ śriyā paramayā yutaḥ || tādṛśaṃ tanayaṃ tasmājjanayiṣyasi bhāmini || 8 || jagāma kaikasī rājaṃstato viśravasaṃ munim || raudre muhūrte saṃprāpte sandhyāyāṃ nṛpasattama || 9 || sābhivandya tataḥ pādau tasya viśravaso muneḥ || babhūva puratastanvī vrīḍamāneva lajjayā || 1.220.10 || uvāca tāṃ muniḥ prahvāṃ kaikasīṃ cāruhāsinīm || vijñātastvadabhiprāyo mayādya varavarṇini || 11 || putrārthaṃ tvamanuprāptā matsamīpamanindite || raudre kāle yathā prāptā tādṛśaṃ janayiṣyasi || 12 || evamastvityathoktā sā tatrovāsa sukhaṃ tadā || tataḥ kālena sā putraṃ janayāmāsa bhāminī || 13 || daśāsyaṃ viṃśatibhujamekadehaṃ mahābalam || nāma tasya pitā cakre daśagrīveti buddhimān || 14 || tato dvitīyaṃ tanayaṃ mahākāyaṃ suṣāva sā || kumbhakarṇeti tasyāpi nāma cakre tadā pitā || 15 || tatra śūrpaṇakhāṃ kanyāṃ janayāmāsa sā tadā || tataḥ kadācitsā putraṃ kaikasī jyeṣṭhamabravīt || 16 || darśayantī dhanādhyakṣaṃ savrīḍeva parantapa || paśya svīyāgrajasyāsya śriyaṃ bhrāturdaśānana || 17 || sa tvaṃ yatnamathāsthāya bhava vaiśravaṇopamaḥ || evamuktastu gokarṇaṃ prayayau bhrātṛbhiḥ saha || 18 || śīrṇaparṇāśanastatra cakāra sumahattapaḥ || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu śiraśchitvā daśānanaḥ || 19 || juhāvāgnau mahābhāga ekaikaṃ tapasā kṛśaḥ || grīṣme pañcatapā bhūtvā varṣāsvākāśaśāyikaḥ || 1.220.20 || ārdravāsaśca śiśire kumbhakarṇo'pyatapyata || vibhīṣaṇastataḥ kāle ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe phalāśanaḥ || 21 || paricaryāṃ tadā teṣāṃ cakre śūrpaṇakhā svasā || daśavarṣasahasrānte tadā kāle daśānanaḥ || 22 || daśamaṃ mastakaṃ vahnau juhūṣati yadā prabho || tatastaṃ deśamāgamya brahmā vacanamabravīt || 23 || || brahmovāca || varaṃ varaya bhadrante parituṣṭo'smi putraka || tapasā te sutaptena sattvena vipulena ca || 24 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || devādīni sa bhūtāni kīrtayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ || sarvāṇyevāviśeṣeṇa varjayitvā tu mānuṣam || 25 || saṃkīrtya tebhyo'vadhyatvaṃ varayāmāsa bhūmipa || trailokyaviṣayaṃ caiva tacca tasya dadau prabhuḥ || 26 || chandayitvā vareṇā'tha daśagrīvaṃ niśācaram || nyastvā sarasvatīṃ vaktre kumbhakarṇaṃ sa rākṣasam || 27 || vareṇacchandayāmāsa tadāgatya vibhīṣaṇam || sa vavre nityakālaṃ tu matiṃ dharme sanātanīm ||28|| tena tasya tadā tuṣṭastvamaratvaṃ dadau prabhuḥ || vareṇacchandayitvā tānbrahmā svabhavanaṃ gataḥ|| 29|| varalabdhaṃ daśagrīvaṃ jñātvā rakṣogaṇastadā || pātālāttu viniṣkramya mahārājye'bhyaṣecayat ||1.220.30|| sa tu rājyaṃ tadā labdhvā preṣayāmāsa rākṣasān || kuberāya tadā dūtaṃ prahasta nāma nāmataḥ ||31|| rākṣasānāmadhīvāso laṅkeyaṃ nirmitā purā || tāṃ tyajasva dhanādhyakṣa sāmnaiva mama mā ciram|| 32 || prahastavacanaṃ śrutvā dhanādhyakṣo mahāmatiḥ || daśagrīvaṃ varonmattaṃ jñātvā tatyāja tāṃ purīm ||33|| kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatvā tadā cakre purīṃ śubhām || alakāṃ nāma rājendra yatrāste sa sukhī sadā ||34|| daśagrīvo mahārāja trilokavijayaṃ tathā || cakre laṅkāmathāsādya varadānātsvayambhuvaḥ ||35|| mandodarīṃ nāma bhāryāṃ tadā lebhe mayātmajām || tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa meghanādaṃ tathā sutam || 36 || trilokavijayī śrīmāndevabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakaḥ || nihataḥ sa tu kālena viṣṇunā nararūpiṇā|| 37 || rāghaveṇa mahārāja rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || laṅkāṃ tyaktvā dhanādhyakṣaḥ kailāse parvatottame || 38 || adyāpi pālayannāste rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam|| tasmāttvamapi rājendra tyaktvā deśamimaṃ svayam|| himavantamathāsādya vasa vaiśravaṇopamaḥ ||39|| tasmānna kāryaṃ bharatena vairaṃ mahābalāstrā raghavaḥ pratītāḥ|| prasīda jīvantu saputrapautrāḥ putrāstaveme tuhinādrisaṃsthāḥ ||1.220.40|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāvaṇavaraprāptivarṇano nāma viṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||220|| <1.221> śailūṣa uvāca || śrotumicchāmyahaṃ tasya daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ || trilokavijayaṃ brahmaṃstatra me saṃśayo mahān || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || varapradānātsaṃmatto daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ || devagandharvadaityānāṃ nāgendroragarakṣamām||2|| ākramyā'kramya ratnāni sa jahāra tadā balāt || patnyaśca rājaśārdūla tadā duhitaraḥ śubhāḥ|| 3 || narendrāndharmasaṃsaktānbrāhmaṇāṃśca jighāṃsati || ayodhyāvāsinaṃ vīramanaraṇyaṃ ca jaghnivān || 4 || saṃgrāme nihatastena daśagrīvaṃ sa śaptavān || utpatsyati kule nīca puruṣo mama vīryavān || 5 || yastavādāsyati prāṇānsamare samarapriya || yuyudhe ca tathā rājñā māṃdhātrā raṇaśālinā || 6 || tatrainaṃ vārayāmāsa nārado munisattamaḥ || mayūrasya tato yajñe bhakṣayāmāsa vai dvijān || 7 || indro mayūrarūpeṇa tasmādyajñādapākamat || mayūrasya varaṃ prādānmeghe varṣati sarvadā || 8 || gamiṣyasyatulāṃ prītiṃ mama netragaṇākṛtim || dhārayiṣyasi loke'sminkalāpaṃ sumanoharam || 9 || kṛkalāsasya rūpeṇa dhanādhyakṣo vyapākramat || varṇaṃ tasya suvarṇābhaṃ sadravyaṃ ca tathā śiraḥ || 1.221.10 || prādāddvayamameyātmā rājarājena dānava || varuṇaśca tadā rājanhaṃsarūpeṇa nirgataḥ || 11 || haṃsasya ca varaṃ prādāttoye ratimavāpsyasi || varṇataścandraraśmyābho bhaviṣyasi tathaiva ca || 12 || yamo vāyasarūpeṇa tasyādyajñādapākamat || vāyasasya varaṃ prādādamaratvaṃ vinā vadhāt|| 13|| yuṣmaddattena cānnena ghorā madviṣaye sthitāḥ || parāṃ tṛptiṃ gamiṣyanti tadā puṇyena yokṣyase || 14 || vakṣyadhvaṃ balidātṝṇāṃ digdeśagataceṣṭitaiḥ || śubhāśubhaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tatrātithyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||15|| vajratuṇḍāśca ye kākā ghorā madviṣaye sthitāḥ || balipiṇḍām̐śca dātṝṇāṃ bhaviṣyanti tataḥ śivam || 16 || maruttayajñe vitrāsaṃ janayitvā divau kasām || babhrāma vasudhāṃ rājā rākṣasānāṃ pratāpavān || 17 || dadarśa sa tadā kanyāṃ tapasyantīṃ mahattapaḥ || rūpeṇāpratimāṃ loke yauvane prathame sthitām||18|| daśagrīvaḥ sa papraccha tāṃ kanyāṃ lokasundarīm|| kā tvaṃ kimarthaṃ suśroṇi cāsthitā yauvane tapaḥ||19 || śrutvā tasya tu sā kanyā satyaṃ vacanamabravīt || bṛhaspatisuto vidvānpitā mama kuśadhvajaḥ ||1.221.20|| vedābhyāsapravṛttasya tasyāhaṃ nṛpabāndhavā|| sutāparā samutpannā tatpatnyā viditā tathā || 21 || nāmnā vedavatītyevaṃ khyātā lokeṣu rākṣasa || viṣṇormayeyaṃ dātavyā tasyāsīnme piturmatiḥ || 22 || madyācanā nirastena daityanāthena śambhunā || pitā mama hato rātrau tamāliṅgya vibhāvasum || 23 || praviṣṭā janayitrī me yathāhaṃ vidhṛtā ciram || svargasthasya pituḥ kāmaṃ sāhaṃ satyamabhīpsatī || 24 || ārādhayāmi tapasā patyarthaṃ madhusūdanam || tatastāmabravīdrakṣo mā tvaṃ kleśe matiṃ kṛthāḥ ||25 || bhavasva me varārohe bhāryā trailokyasundarī || rūpasya vayasaścaiva nānurūpaṃ tapastava || 26 || tvāṃ kṛtvoparato manye rūpaṃ kṛtvā sa viśvakṛt || na hi rūpopamā tvanyā tathāsti sadṛśī yataḥ || 27 || saṃpūrṇakāntimatsaumyaṃ vadanaṃ te varānane || sakalaṃkena candreṇa kathamopamyamarhati || ||28|| bhava bhūṣaṇajātānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ tvaṃ śucismite || vṛṇuṣva māṃ varārohe patitve varavarṇini || 29|| ākramyākramya lokasya pradhānā yā mayā hṛtāḥ|| striyaḥ kuruṣva sarvāsāṃ tāsāṃ svāmyamanindite ||1.221.30|| jaṭāmālājinadharī tvamevaṃ rativardhinī || na jāne maṇḍanāṃ prāpya kathaṃ bhīru bhavi ṣyasi || 31 || rūpeṇa vayasā lakṣmyā tathaiva guṇasampadā || vikrame me varārohe na samo hi janārdanaḥ || 32 || janma tasya na jānanti parebhyo ye pare janāḥ || tena tvamakulīnena kiṅkariṣyasi sundari || 33 || anindraṃ lokamicchantī surāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā || hatā yenānuvṛttena yoṣitkāvyā raṇiḥ purā || 34 || purāṇā ye jagatyasmim̐stebhyaḥ pūrvatarāśca ye || tebhyo'pyati purāṇaṃ taṃ bhartāraṃ kathamicchasi || 35 || brahmaṇo varadānena yastvavadhyo divaukasām || te daityanāthāḥ sabalāśchadmanā tena ghātitāḥ || 36 || tatpratāpaniviṣṭena cetasā rakṣasāṃ śriyam || yo bibhartyapi tāṃ tena kiṃ kariṣyati bhāmini || 37 || vṛddhebhyo na śrutaṃ tasya tvayā rūpamanindite || viditaṃ sarvalokānāṃ viśvarūpadharastvasau || 38 || śepāhibhogaparyaṅke tena tvaṃ śayitā saha || saviṣairbhoganiśvāsaiḥ parāṃ glānimupaiṣyasi || 31||| kaṇṭhagraheṇa nihatau yena tau madhukaiṭabhau || kathaṃ kaṇṭhagrahaṃ tasya samupaiṣyasi sundari || 1.221.40 || hiraṇyakaśipuryena nakhairutkāntajīvitaḥ || kathaṃ ratyantare tasya nakhāghātaṃ sahiṣyasi || 41 || tasmādbhāvaṃ samutsṛjya cārugātri janārdane || bhajasva bhajamānaṃ māṃ ciraṃ prītimavāpnuhi || 42 || || vedavatyuvāca || guṇā eva sureśasya doṣāste rajanīcara || jagatprakāśakā bhānorulūkasyeva raśmayaḥ || 43 || kiṃ tvayā saha vādena varaṇīyaḥ sa me prabhuḥ || yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi patitve rajanīcara || 44 || iti vedavatīvākyaṃ śrutvā kopasamanvitaḥ || kāmena rākṣasendrantāṃ keśapāśe parāmṛśata || 45 || tvayā saṃdharṣitā pāpa pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam || ayonijā bhaviṣyāmi vadhārthaṃ na tathā tava || 45 || evamuktvā citāṃ kṛtvā praviṣṭā jātavedasam|| bhūya sītā samutpannā janakasya mahātmanaḥ || 47 || ayonijā mahābhāgā karṣato yajñamedinīm || bhartāraṃ tapasā viṣṇuṃ rāmaṃ labdhavatī yathā || 48 || yasyā arthe sa rāmeṇa daśagrīvo hato raṇe || lokāpavādabhītena daśagrīvagṛhoṣitā || 49 || ataḥ patnī parityaktā sītā bhūyo janeśvara || vālmīkerāśrame sā tu prasūtā dārakadvayam || 1.221.50 || kuśaṃ lavaṃ ca vikrāntau yayoḥ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kṛtāḥ || vālmīkinā mahābhāgau vedamadhyāpitā yathā || 51 || prakarṣaṃ ca dhanurvede pāraṃ nītā tu tau śiśū || vālmīkinā tathā kṛtvā rāmasya caritaṃ śubhama || 52 || adhyāpito viśālākṣau dārakau priyadarśanau || agāyatāṃ tatastau tu rāmayaje kumāgkā || 53 || rāmasya caritaṃ kṛtsnaṃ rāmasya purataḥ sthitau || tasmātkāvyāttu vijñāya putrau tau priyadarśanau || 54 || yajñe tāṃ ca tathābhūtāmānayāmāma satvaraḥ || uvāca ca varārohāṃ pratyayaṃ kuru me śubhe || 55 || rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sītā vacanamabravīta || yathā'haṃ rāghavādanyaṃ manasāpi na kāmaye || 56 || tena satyena me devī vivaraṃ saṃprayacchatu || etasminneva kāle tu bhuvaṃ bhittvā samutthitam || 57 || dhṛtaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ nāgaistatraināmupaveśayat || svayaṃ vasumatī devī pātālaṃ sā tato gatā || 58 || avicchinnena patatā puṣpavarṇena pārthiva || tasyāṃ bhūmipraviṣṭāyāṃ rāghavaṃ krodhasaṃyutam || 59 || sāntvayāmāsa vai brahmā sarvalokanamasrkṛtaḥ || rāmo'pi kṛtvā sauvarṇīṃ sītāṃ patnīṃ yaśasvinīm || 1.221.60 || īje yajñairbahuvidhaiḥ saha bhātṛbhiracyutaḥ || nāpadbhayaṃ na vidhavā na ca vyālakṛtaṃ bhayama || 61 || na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ kiñcidrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati || ājānubāhurdharmātmā siṃhaskandho nareśvaraḥ || 62 || pṛthvī sasāgarāṃ rāmo dharmeṇānvaśipatprabhuḥ || devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 63 || yakṣāśca bhūtāni tathā kinnarāścaiva rākṣasāḥ || mānuṣyāṇāṃ darśanaṃ te saumyāḥ santo yayussadā || 64 || yadarthameṣā carati gāthā loke purātanī || ājānubāhuḥ siṃhāsyaḥ kambugrīvo mahābalaḥ || 65 || sarvabhūtaśaraṇyaśca viṣṇurmānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ || satyavānanṛśaṃsaśca jāto bhaktajanapriyaḥ || 66 || dhṛtiyukto dayāśīlo dharmayukto jitendriyaḥ || mitavāgapi kāryeṣu vaktā vācaspateḥ samaḥ || 67 || vīryavānna ca vīryeṇa mahatā tena vismitaḥ || tejasā bhāskagsamaḥ kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ || 68 || maheśvarasamaḥ krodhe nītāvuśanasā samaḥ || evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu guṇairdāśarathirbabhau || 69 || varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca na sāṅkaryaṃ nṛpottame || dharmiṣṭhāśca janāḥ sarve rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati || 1.221.70 || nirdasyurabhavalloko nānarthaḥ kiñcidaspṛśata || nākālavarṣī parjanyaḥ sarvasasyadharā dharā || janānurāgaśca mahānrāmasya viditātmanaḥ ||71|| na te kṣamaṃ tena narendracandra vairaṃ mahātmā sa tu lokapūjyaḥ || tasyāstravegasya raṇe ca vegaṃ soḍhuṃ na śaktāstridaśāḥ saśakrāḥ ||72 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye rāvaṇasya bhūrlokavijayaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||221|| <1.222> śailūṣa uvāca || vahnipraviṣṭāṃ saṃprekṣya tadā vedavatīṃ dvija || kiṃ cakāra mahātejā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān||1|| nāḍāyana uvāca|| jagāma sa tadā laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ || tatrasthaṃ prerayāmāsa dūtaṃ dhanapatiḥ svayam || 2 || akāryādvinivartasva suraiste cintyate vadhaḥ || dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dūtaṃ hatvā niśācaraḥ ||3|| gatvā vijigye dhanadaṃ vijahārā'sya puṣpakam || puṣpakeṇa vimānena kailāsaṃ sa tadā yayau || 4 || puṣpakasya gatiṃ ruddhāṃ tatra vīkṣya niśācaraḥ || dadarśa śailaśṛṅgasthaṃ nandinaṃ vānarākṛtim || 5 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuce hāsaṃ nandī taṃ śaptavāṃstataḥ || girāvasmindaśagrīva svayaṃ krīḍati śaṅkaraḥ ||6|| vimānena yadā tasya samīpamupayāsyasi|| karoṣi cāvahāsyaṃ māṃ tasmācchapsyāmyahaṃ tava || 7 || madvaktrasadṛśā ghorāḥ pulahasya prajāpateḥ || utpatsyanti kule bhīmāḥ kṣayārthaṃ vānarāstava || 8 || śrutvainaṃ nandino vākyaṃ sakailāsaṃ trilocanam || netukāmastadā laṅkāṃ bhujāñcikṣepa parvate || 9 || paulastyabhujasaṃkṣubdhakailāsacalitāsanā || jagrāha nirbharaṃ kaṇṭhe tadomā tripurāntakam || 1.222.10 || tato garjanmahādevo devānāṃ pravaro haraḥ || pādāṅguṣṭhena taṃ śailaṃ pīḍayāmāsa līlayā || 11 || rakṣasā tena roṣācca bhujānāṃ rujayā tathā || mukto virāvaḥ sumahāṃstrailokyaṃ yena rāvitam || 12 || menire vaktraniṣpeṣaṃ tasyāmātyā yugakṣayam || āsanebhyaḥ pracalitā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 13 || tena śabdena vitrastā sutarāṃ parvatātmajā || harasyāliṅganaṃ cakre bhayalolekṣaṇā bhṛśam || 14 || akṛtrimāliṅganajāṃ prītiṃ prāpya tadā haraḥ || muktvā cāsya bhujānrājanprāha vākyaṃ daśānanam || 15 || prīto'smi tava vīryaiśca śauṇḍīryaiśca daśānana || yasmādarākṣaso rāvastvayā mukto bhayaṅkaraḥ || 16|| tasmāttvaṃ rāvaṇo nāma bhaviṣyasi jagattraye || tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ || 17 || śātakumbhamayaṃ liṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ || sampūjayati rājendra nityaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||18|| yatrayatra yathā yāti tatratatrāsya pārthiva || sauvarṇaṃ tasya devasya liṅgaṃ tadanu nīyate || 19 || tatastu rāvaṇo rājā yayau saṃyamanīṃ purīm || yuyudhe kālapāśebhyo yāgaiśca saha mṛtyunā ||1.222.20|| jitvā pitṛgaṇāṃścaiva mokṣayitvā ca nārakān || yamena yuyudhe sārdhaṃ krodhādvaivastastataḥ || 21 || hantumicchanmahīpāla daṇḍāstreṇa niśācaram|| vārayāmāsa taṃ brahmā vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 22 || amoghastava daṇḍoyamavadhyaścaiva rāvaṇaḥ || ekasminnapi niṣkrānte bhūyāmanṛtavāgaham || 23 || pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā devasso'ntardadhe tataḥ || rāvaṇaḥ saha sainyena yayau kailāsaparvatam || 24 || uvāsa śarvarīṃ tatra yoddhukāmo divālayaiḥ || sa tu candrodaye rātrau bhrātṛputrābhisārikām || 25 || dadarśa rambhāṃ rājantīṃ meghasyeva śatahradām || akāmāṃ kāmasaṃtapto vidhvaṃsya surayoṣitam || 26 || adyaprabhṛti mūrdhā te śatadhā tu gamiṣyati || prabhātasamaye gatvā surasadma sa rākṣasaḥ || 27 || meghanādena sahitaḥ kumbhakarṇena rakṣasā || devānāṃ kadanaṃ cakre tathānye rākṣasottamaiḥ || 28 || tasminraṇamukhe ghoro sāvitreṇa tadā'nagha || sumālī nihataḥ saṃkhye rāvaṇasyārbhako balāta || 29 || ajeyānrākṣasāñjñātvā pulomā nāma dānavaḥ || jayantamindratanayaṃ dauhitraṃ svaṃ raṇājirāt || 1.222.30 || rakṣārthamanayacchrīmānsvagṛhaṃ vasudhātale || apaśyamānaṃ putraṃ svaṃ śakraṃ vihvalacetasam || 31 || babandha meghanādastu brahmalavdhavaraḥ śanaiḥ || anayacca tathā laṅkāṃ tato devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || 32 || gatvā taṃ mocayāmāsa śakraṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || meghanādasya cāstrāṇi māyāśca vividhāstathā || || 33 || amaratvaṃ tadā prādādvahnikarmāntaraṃ vinā || nāma cakre tadā cāsya śakrajittvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
