|| 34 || meghanādaṃ sāntvayitvā mocayitvā śatakratum || uvāca bhagavānbrahmā devaṃ daśaśatekṣaṇam || 35 || gautamasya priyā bhāryā manasā nirmitā mayā || rūpeṇāpratimā śakra tvayā vidhvaṃsitā yadā || 36 || tadā gautamaśāpena viphalatvaṃ gataḥ svayam || devaiḥ kṛtastvaṃ sambhūya śepastambhaḥ purandara || 37 || ahalyā ca tadā śaptā gautamena mahātmanā || adṛśyā sarvabhūtānāṃ vicariṣyasi duḥkhitā || 38 || paradārarataścāsau dve pāpaṃ samavāpsyati || tena śāpena saṃyogā paradāraiśca vāsava || 39 || bandhanaṃ tattvayā prāptaṃ tasya pāpasya karmaṇaḥ || phalāttribhuvanaśreṣṭha samareṣu parājayam || 1.222.40 || tasmāddharmeṇa dharmajña tpālayasva jagattrayam || dharmo dhārayate lokānyato dharmastato jayaḥ || 41 || gate svalokaṃ bhuvanapradhānaṃ padmodbhave dānavapūgahartā || triviṣṭapaṃ prāpya śaśāsa rājyaṃ mahānubhāvastridaśādhināthaḥ || 42 || iti śrīvipṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde svargavijayo nāma dvāviṃśatyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 222 || <1.223> || śailūṣa uvāca || || pātālavijayaṃ tasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ || śrotumicchāmi tattvena tatra kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || tataḥ sa gatvā pātālaṃ yuyudhe daityasattamaiḥ || kālakhañjairmahābhāgaiḥ kālakeyaiśca dāruṇaiḥ || 2 || nivāta kavacaiścaiva saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ || patiṃ śūrpaṇakhāyāstu vidyujjihvaṃ tu dānavam || 3 || ajāvaktravatastatra jaghāna raṇagarvitam || tatrāgamya tadā brahmā nivātakavacaiḥ saha || 4 || cakāra sakhyaṃ sarvātmā daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ || tatastu yuyudhe nāgairghorarūpairviṣolbaṇaiḥ || 5 || vaśī kṛttvā tato nāgānvaruṇasya puraṃ yayau || brahmalokagate rājanvaruṇe sumahātmani || 6 || puṣkaraḥ pradadau yuddhaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ || varuṇasya sutaḥ śrīmāñjāmātā balinastathā || 7 || somaputryā mahārāja jyotsnayā yaḥ svayaṃ vṛtaḥ || arthaśāstraṃ vijānāti yaḥ samagraṃ mahāyaśāḥ || 8 || astragrāmaṃ samagraṃ ca tathā śastrāṇyanekaśaḥ || rūpadākṣiṇyalāvaṇyadharmacaryaiḥ samanvite || 9 || bale śaurye tathā dāne tulyo yasya na vidyate || bhrātṛbhirbhrātṛputraiśca sainyena mahatā yathā || 1.223.10 || dattvā yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ sāntvayāmāsa rākṣasam || tataḥ sa nagaraṃ jitvā varuṇaṃ sumahābalam || 11 || sainyairviśravasaḥ putro mānuṣyaṃ punarāgataḥ || kiṣkindhāṃ sa tato gatvā purīṃ vānarapālitām || 12 || papraccha vānarāṃścaiva kvāsau vālī mahābalaḥ || taṃ jagāda mahātejā tāro gahanagocaraḥ || 13 || kiṃ syātte vālinā kāryaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || rāvaṇa uvāca || yuddhātithyamahaṃ tasmātprārthayāmi valīmukhāta || 14 || balavāñśrūyate rājā jijñāsā tasya me bale || tāra uvāca || jijñāsito yadā vālī tvatto'nyairbalavattaraiḥ || 15 || nihatāḥ śataśastena tvatto vīryabalādhikāḥ | idānīmeva nihato dundubhistena rākṣasaḥ || 16 || praviśya vivaraṃ ghoraṃ māyāvī tena ghātitaḥ || bile praviṣṭasya tadā rājansaṃvatsarasaṃ gatam || 17 || sugrīveṇa tadā tasya dvāraṃ pihitamātmanā || sa tu saṃvatsarasyānte hatvā māyāvinaṃ raṇe || 18 || dadarśa rājansugrīvaṃ kiṣkindhāyāṃ tadā'nujam || svapatnyā rumayā sārdhaṃ vālipatnyā ca tārayā||19|| krīḍamānaṃ yathā śakraṃ krodhasya vaśamanvagāt || rumāṃ tārāṃ tathā hṛtvā tena nirvāsitastvasau || 1.223.20 || nirvāsite tu sugrīve paścāttāpa samanvitaḥ || hantukāmastu sugrīvaṃ vālī paryacaranmahīm ||21|| tadā vālibhayatrastaḥ sugrīvo'pi palāyitaḥ || na sa lebhe sadā trāṇaṃ tadā sasmāra rākṣasam || 22 || mataṅgaśāpaṃ rājendra vālinaḥ sa tathā svayam || hatvā tu dundubhiṃ vālī pādāḍuṣṭhena yojayat| 23 || cikṣepa rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ mataṅgasyāśramaṃ prati || mataṅgasyāśramaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudhireṇa samanvitam || 24 || śaśāpa vālinaṃ roṣāttasyāsminme mahadvane || sadyaḥ praviṣṭamātrasya jīvitaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 25 || agamyaṃ vālino jñātvā mataṅgasya mahadvanam || caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ sugrīvastamupāśritaḥ || 26 || nalena rājannīlena tāreṇa ca hanūmatā || hanūmānsacivastasya devānāmapi nirbhayaḥ || 27 || jātamātrastu yo bālye vīkṣya sūryaṃ khamāplutaḥ || bhakṣyārthī tasya pārśvasthaṃ rāhuṃ dṛṣṭvā niśācaram || 28 || sūryamutsṛjya bhakṣyārthī tadā rāhuṃ pradudruve || rāhurjagāma śaraṇaṃ bhayādbhītaṃ ca vāsavam || 29 || tasyānu prayayāveva sa tu bālo mahābalaḥ || sa dadarśa mahākāyaṃ tadā śakrasya dantinam || 1.223.30 || taṃ pradudrāva bhakṣyārthī saśakraṃ kuñjarottamam || prāharattvarayā vajraṃ tatastasya surādhipaḥ || 31 || tasya vajraprahāreṇa vāmo hanurabhajyata || hanumāniti tenāsya nāma cakre pitāmahaḥ || 32 || kruddhaṃ ca jagatāṃ vāyuṃ sāntvayitvā pitāmahaḥ || vareṇa cchandayāmāsa hanumantaṃ mahābalam ||33|| sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sāpi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || ajarāmaratāṃ tasya ajeyatvaṃ tathā raṇe ||34|| pradadurdevatāḥ sarve balaṃ cāpratimaṃ tathā || svayaṃ bhagavatā tasya sūryeṇa sumahātmanā ||35|| … … <1.224> <1.225> vināyakaṃ tu tuṣṭāva tataḥ śambhustrilokadhṛk || purāṇāṃ saṅgamārthāya avidyeneti mānada || 1 || śaṅkara uvāca || namasyāmi mahābāhuṃ devadevaṃ gaṇeśvaram || hastivaktraṃ mahākāyaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaracchadam || 2 || candraraśmipratīkāśaṃ cārudaṃṣṭrojvalānanam || bhaktānāṃ vighnaśamanaṃ surādyaṃ pārvatīsutam ||3|| paraśvadhadharaṃ vīramakṣamālā vibhūṣitam || brahmaṇyaṃ varadaṃ saumyaṃ vighnānāṃ patimūrjitam ||4|| pīnāsyaṃ lambajaṭharaṃ hārabhārārpitodaram || aṣṭamī ca caturthī ca vṛtā yena caturdaśī ||5|| kulmāṣotklopikāpūpairmodakairodanena ca || pūjayanti janā loke dhūpamālyā'nulepanaiḥ || 6 || svastivācanakaiścaiva teṣāṃ nāstīha durlabham || putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī dhanamuttamam || 7 || vyādhitaśca tathārogyaṃ baddho mucyeta bandhanāt || tvāṃ tu saṃpūjayitvā vai varadaṃ kāmarūpiṇam || 8 || iṣṭānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || yaścādhīte stavamimaṃ tava nityaṃ gaṇeśvara || 9 || tasyāpi sarvakāmānāṃ sadā dātā bhaviṣyasi || nāḍāyana uvāca || ityevaṃ saṃstutaḥ śrīmāñśaṃkareṇa vināyakaḥ || 1.225.10 || ekasthānagataṃ cakre vinā vighnaṃ puratrayam || ekasthaṃ tripuraṃ viṣṇuḥ śarāgrastho dhanuścyutaḥ || śaṃkarapreritaḥ śīghraṃ tadā cakre sa bhasmasāt || 11 || puratraye devavareṇa tena vinirmite'bhūjjagatāṃ praharṣaḥ || jagmustadā devagaṇāḥ prahaṣṭāḥ sthānāni rājendra tathā svakāni || 12 || iti śrīvipṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye tripuradāhavarṇano nāma paṃcaviśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 225 || <1.226> || nāḍāyana uvāca || || tasyaiva devadevasya śṛṇu karmedamuttamama || āsīddaityondhako nāma bhinnāñjanacayopamaḥ || 1 || tapasā mahatā yuktastvavadhyaśca divaukasām || sa kadācinmahādevaṃ pārvatyā sahitaṃ prabhum || 2 || krīḍamānaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā hartuṃ devīṃ pracakrame || tasya yuddhaṃ tadā ghoramabhavatsaha śaṃbhunā || 3 || rudravarṇavinirbhede rudhirādandhakasya tu || aṃdhakāśca samutpannā śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || 4 || teṣāṃ ca dāryamāṇānāṃ rudhirādapare punaḥ || 5 || babhūvuraṃdhakā ghorā yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat || evaṃ māyāvinaṃ dṛṣṭvā devadevastadāndhakam || 6 || pānārthamaṃdhakāsrasya sasṛje mātarastathā || māheśvarīṃ tathā brāhmīṃ kauberīṃ cānalīṃ tathā || 7 || sauparṇīmatha vā yavyāṃ śākrīṃ vai nairṛtīṃ tathā || saurīṃ saumyaṃ śivāṃ dūtīṃ cāmuṃḍāmatha vāruṇīm || 8 || vārāhīṃ nārasiṃhīṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ ca lalatthikām || śatānandāṃ bhagānandāṃ picchilāṃ bhagamālinīm || 9 || balāmatibalāṃ raktāṃ surabhīṃ mukhamuṇḍikām || mātṛnandāṃ sunandāṃ ca viḍālīṃ śākunīṃ tathā || 1.226.10 || revatīṃ ca mahāraktāṃ tathaiva pilipicchikām || jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva jayantīṃ cāparājitām || 11 || kālīṃ caiva mahākālīṃ kāladūtīṃ tathaiva ca || subhagāṃ durbhagāṃ caiva karālīṃ dehanīṃ tathā || 12 || aditiñca ditiñcaiva mālinīṃ mṛtyumeva ca || karṇamoṭīṃ tathā yāmyāṃ ulūkīṃ ca ghaṭodarīm || 13 || kapālīṃ vajrahastāṃ ca piśācīṃ rākṣasīṃ tathā || bhuruṇḍīṃ hāṅkarīṃ caṇḍāṃ śaivāṃ ca kaṭakīṃ tathā || 14 || ghaṃṭāṃ sulocanāṃ dhūmrāmekavālīṃ kapālinīm || viśālāṃ daṣṭikāṃ śyāmāṃ trijaṭīṃ kukuhaṃ tathā || 15 || vināyakīṃ ca vaitālīmunmattāṃ śubhanāṃ tathā || siddhiñca lelihānāṃ ca kekarāṃ gardabhīṃ tathā || 16 || tarkaṭīṃ bahuputrāṃ ca pretayānāṃ viṭaṃpurām|| krauñcīṃ sūkaramukhīṃ ca vitatāṃ saramāṃ danum || || 17 || uṣāraṃbhāṃ pinākāṃ ca lalitāṃ citrarūpiṇīm || svadhākārāṃ vaṣaṭsvāhāṃ dhṛtiṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ kapardinīm || 18 || māyāvicitrarūpāṃ ca kāmarūpāṃ vaśaṃgamām || svakaṃbilāṃ siñjikāṃ ca mahānāsāṃ mahāmukhīm || 19 || kaumārīṃ rocanāṃ bhīmāṃ sadāhāsāṃ madoddhatām || āraktākṣīṃ kālakarṇīṃ bharttukarṇīṃ mahāsvanīm || 1.226.20 || keśinīṃ śikhinīṃ lambāṃ piṃgākṣīṃ lohitāmukhīm || ghaṇṭāravāṃ ca daṃṣṭrālāṃ locanāṃ kācajaṅghikām ||21 || gokarṇikāṃ gomukhikāṃ mahāgrīvāṃ mahāmukhīm|| ulkāmukhīṃ dhūmraśikhāṃ kavanāṃ parikaṃpitām || 22 || mohinīṃ kuṇḍinīṃ tveḍāṃ nirbhayāṃ bāhuśālinīm || śūrpakarṇīṃ tathaikākṣīṃ viśokāṃ nandinīṃ rucam || 23 || jyosrāmukhīṃ varaparāṃ nikumbhāṃ raktakampanām || avikārāṃ mahācitrāṃ citrasenāṃ manoramām || 24 || sudarśanāṃ haratpāpāṃ mātaṅgīṃ laṃbamekhalām || subālāṃ bālatarkārīṃ premodāṃ lāṅgalāvatīm||25|| cittāṃ vittāṃ jaḍāṃ koṇāṃ śāntikāṃ bhasitāśanīm || laṃbastanīṃ laṃbaghaṇṭāṃ visatāṃ vāmacūḍinīm ||26|| svalatirdīrghakeśī ca sulatā sundarī samā || adhomukhī kaṭumukhī krodhanī vasuvāśinī || 27 || virāviṇī vatsarutā māṣābhājinaśālinī || kuṭumbikā śuktikā ca caṇḍikā balamohinī || 28 || māṃsānyahāsinī lambā govidhārī samāgadhī || etāścānyāḥ sa devendra sasṛje mātarastadā || 29 || andhakānāṃ mahāghoraṃ papustadrudhiraṃ tadā || tatondhakāsṛjā sarvāḥ parāṃ tṛptimupāgatāḥ ||1.226.30|| tāstu tṛptāḥ susambhūtā bhūya evāṃdhakāsrajā || arditoyairmahādevaḥ śūlamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ || 31 || tataḥ sa śaṅkaro devastvandhakairvyākulīkṛtaḥ || jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum || 32 || tatastu bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sṛṣṭavāñchuṣkarevatīm || sā papau satvaraṃ teṣāmandhakānāmasṛkkṣaṇāt || 33 || yathāyathā ca rudhiraṃ pibatyandhakasambhavam || tathā tathā'dhikaṃ devī saṃśuṣyati janādhipa || 34 || pīyamāne tadā teṣāmandhakānāṃ tathāsṛji || andhakāstu kṣayaṃ nītā sarve te tripurāriṇā || 35 || mūlāndhakaṃ tu vikramya tadā sarvatra lokakṛt || cakāra vegāñchūlāgre tadā tuṣṭāva śaṅkaram || 36 || andhakaḥ sumahāvīryaḥ tasya tuṣṭo'bhavadbhavaḥ || sāmīpyaṃ pradadau nityaṃ gaṇeśatvaṃ tathaiva ca || 37 || tato mātṛgaṇāḥ sarve śaṅkaraṃ vākyamabruvan || bhagavan bhakṣayiṣyāmaḥ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 38 || tvatprasādājjagatsarvaṃ tadanujñātumarhasi || śaṅkara uvāca || bhavatībhiḥ prajāḥ sarvā rakṣaṇīyā na saṃśayaḥ || 39 || tasmādghorādabhiprāyānmanaḥ śīghraṃ nivartyatām || nāḍāyana uvāca || ityevaṃ śaṅkareṇoktaṃ tvanādṛtya vacastu tāḥ || 1.226.40 || kṣobhayāmāsu'vyagrāstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram | | trailokye bhakṣyamāṇe tu tadā mātṛgaṇairnavaiḥ || 41 || nṛsiṃhamūrtiṃ devaṃ ca pradadhyau bhagavāñchivaḥ || anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ sarvalokabhavodbhavama || 42 || daityendravakṣorudhiraprokṣitorumahānakhama || vidyujjihvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ sphuṭakesarasaṅkaṭam || 43 || kalpāntamārutakṣubdhasaptārṇava mahāsvanama || vajrāgratīkṣṇanakharamākarṇāddāritānanam|| 44 || maruśailapratīkāśamudayārkasamekṣaṇama || himādriśikharākāraṃ cārudaṃṣṭrojjvalānanam || 45 || khavinissṛtaromāgniṃ jvālākesaramālinam || baddhāṅgadaṃ sumukuṭaṃ cārukeyūrabhūṣaṇama || 46 || śroṇīsūtreṇa mahatā kāñcanena virājitama || nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ vāmoyugavibhūṣitama || 47 || tejasākrāntasakalaṃ brahmāṇḍāntaramaṃḍapama || sādarabhrāmyamāṇānāṃ hutahavya ghanārciṣām || 48 || āvarttaiḥ sadṛśākāraiḥ saṃyuktaṃ daihalomajaiḥ || sarvapuppavicitrāṃ ca dhārayānaṃ mahāsrajama || 49 || sa dhyātamātro bhagavānpradadau tasya darśanam || yādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa yāto rudreṇa bhaktitaḥ || 1.226.50 || tādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa durnirīkṣyeṇa daivataiḥ || praṇipatya tu deveśaṃ tadā tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ || 51 || śaṅkara uvāca || namastestu jagannātha narasiṃhavapurdharaḥ || daityanāthāsthisaṃpūrṇa nakhaśuktivirājita || 52 || tadasrakaṇasaṃlagnahemapiṅgalavigrahaṃ || meroḥ sapadmarāgasya śobhāṃ dhatse jagadguro || 53 || kalpāntāmbhodanirghoṣa sūryakoṭisamaprabha || sahasrayama saṃkrodha sahasrendraparākrama || 54 || sahasradhanadasphīta sahasravaruṇātmaka|| sahasrakālacarita sahasraniyatendriya||55|| sahasrabhūmisaddhairya sahasrānantamūrttimat || sahasracandrapratima sahasraharivikrama || 56 || sahasrarudratejaska sahasrabrahmasaṃstuta|| sahasravāyuvegogra sahasrajyotirīṣaṇa||57|| sahasrayantramathana sahasrābādhamocana || andhakasya vināśāya sṛṣṭā yā mātaro mayā || 58 || anādṛtya tu madvākyaṃ bhakṣayaṃtyaśca tāḥ prajāḥ || kṛtvā tāśca na śakto'haṃ saṃhantumaparājita||59|| svayaṃ kṛtvā kathaṃ tāsāṃ vināśamapi rocaye || nāḍāyana uvāca || evamuktaḥ sa rudreṇa nārasiṃha vapurdharaḥ || 1.226.60 || sasarja devīṃ jihvātaḥ tadā vāgīśvarīṃ hariḥ || hṛdayācca tathā māyāṃ guhyācca bhagamālinīm || 61 || asthibhyaśca tathā kālī sṛṣṭā pūrvaṃ mahātmanā || yayā tadrudhiraṃ pītamandhakānāṃ mahātmanām || 62 || yā tvasminkathitā loke nāmataḥ śuṣkarevatī || dvātriṃśanmātaraḥ sṛṣṭā gātrebhyaścakriṇā tataḥ || 63 || tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu || sarvakliṣṭā mahābhāgā kaṇṭhakarṇī tathaiva ca || 64|| trailokya mohinī puṇyā sarvasattvavaśaṅkarī || tathā ca cakrahṛdayā pañcamā vyomacāriṇī ||65|| śaṃkhinī lekhinī caiva kālasaṅkarṣiṇī tathā || iti devyaṣṭakaṃ rājanvāgīśyanucaraṃ smṛtam || 66 || ajitā sūkṣmahṛdayā vṛkṣāveśāśmadarśanā || nṛsiṃhabhairavā cillā garutpakṣahṛdānayā || 67 || bhagamālinya 'nucarā ityaṣṭau nṛpa mātaraḥ || ākarṣiṇī ca bhārūṭī tathaivottaramālikā || 68 || jvālāmukhī bhīṣaṇikā kāmadhenuśca bālikā || tathā padmakarā rājanrevatyanucarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 69 || aṣṭau mahābalāḥ sarvā devagātrasamudbhavāḥ || trailokyasṛṣṭisaṃhārasamarthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 1.226.70 || tāḥ sṛṣṭamātrā devena kruddhā mātṛgaṇasya tu || pradhāvitā mahārāja krodhavisphūrjitekṣaṇāḥ || 71 || aviṣahyatamaṃ tāsāṃ dṛṣṭvā tejaḥ sudāruṇam || bhayena śaraṇaṃ prāptā deveśaṃ pūrvamātaraḥ || 72 || śaraṇārthamanuprāptā nṛsiṃho vākyamabravīt || narasiṃha uvāca || yathā manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ pālayanti varānanāḥ || 73 || yajanti taiśca paśubhiḥ tathā vai devatāgaṇān || bhavatyaśca tathā lokānpālayantu mayeritāḥ ||74 || manujaiśca tathā devaṃ yajadhvaṃ tripurāntakam|| ye ca māṃ saṃsmaraṃtīha te ca rakṣyā sadā narāḥ ||75|| balikarma kariṣyaṃti yuṣmākaṃ ye sadā narāḥ || sarvakāmapradāsteṣāṃ bhaviṣyadhvaṃ tathaiva ca||76|| tatsādanādikaṃ ye ca kariṣyaṃti hareritam || te ca rakṣyā sadā loke rakṣitavyaṃ ca śāsanam||77|| raudrāṃ caiva parāṃ mūrtiṃ mahādevaḥ pradāsyati|| yuṣmabhyaṃ samayā sārdhaṃ tena sārdhaṃ varasyatha ||78|| mayā mātṛgaṇaḥ sṛṣṭo yoyaṃ vigatasādhvasaḥ || eṣa nityaṃ viśālākṣyo mayaiva saha raṃsyati ||79|| mayā sārdhaṃ tathā pūjāṃ vīrebhyaścaiva lapsyasi || pṛthak ca pūjito loke sarvānkāmānpradāsyati || 1.226.80 || śuṣkāṃ saṃpūjayiṣyanti ye tu putrārthino janāḥ|| teṣāṃ putrapradā devī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ||81|| nāḍāyana uvāca|| etāvaduktvā bhagavānsaha mātṛgaṇena ca || jvālāmālākulavapustatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||82|| samātṛvargopi harasya mūrti sadā yajaṃstiṣṭhati tatsamīpe || deveśvarasyāpi nṛsiṃhamūrteḥ pūjāṃ vidhatte tripurāntakārī || 83 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye andhakajayavarṇanonāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 226 || <1.227> || śailūṣa uvāca || mātṛdoṣapraśamanānmaheśvaramukhodgatān || prayogāñchrotumicchāmi vadataste dvijottama || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || cocakaṃ tu vacā kuṣṭaṃ brahmabhūtajaṭe śubhe || kālamañjā haridre dve yavacūrṇavimiśritam||2|| udvartanamidaṃ proktaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam || ariṣṭāriṣṭapatrāṇi tālajītakayostathā || 3 || śiṃśipāmalakībilvakapitthānāṃ tathaiva ca || bahukāratvacaṃ pūrvāṃ tathaiva ca punarnavām || 4 || bhārṅgīkvāthamidaṃ snānaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam || ariṣṭakaṃ tathā bilvaṃ padmākṣaṃ phalinīphalam || 5 || vacā kuṣṭaṃ ca mustañca vālakaṃ rajanīdvayam || candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva nāgadānaṃ ca rocanā || 6 || etāni sarvāṇyāhṛtya pūrṇakumbhe vinikṣipet || snānametatprayoktavyaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam || 7 || kusumaiḥ pañcavarṇaistu dhūpairniryāsajaistathā || kuṃkumāgurukarpūracandanaiśca manoramaiḥ || 8 || dīpairbhakṣyaistathā kṣīraiḥ kulmāṣollopikāguḍaiḥ || pāyasairmadhusaṃmiśraiḥ palalenodanena ca || ||9|| baliḥ suvihito rājanmātṛdoṣavināśanam || dūrvāpravālamañjiṣṭhānāgaraṃ nāgakeśaram||1.227.10|| rocanākuṃkumaṃ caiva candanaṃ ca tathā vacā || vilepanamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mātṛdoṣavināśanam || 11 || gajāśvakapivārāhanakhāni ca ghṛtaṃ tathā || śreṣṭho'yaṃ kathito dhūpo mātṛdoṣavināśanaḥ || 12 || siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpyatha pañcagavyaṃ purāṇamaśnanti hi ye narendra || teṣāṃ bhayaṃ naiva hi mātṛjātaṃ bhāvyaṃ kadācidgrahasaṃbhavaṃ vā || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathama khaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 mātṛbādhāpratiṣedhonāma saptaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 227 || <1.228> || nāḍāyana uvāca || tasya devādidevasya prabhāvamaparaṃ śṛṇu || kathyamānaṃ mayā rājansarvakalmaṣanāśanam || 1 || śaṅkaraḥ pārvatī caiva spardhamānau parasparam || cakraturmaithunaṃ rājansāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ kila|| 2 || tayoranyatarasyāsīdyadā naiva parājayaḥ || tatastu devatā khinnāḥ parasparamathābruvan || 3 || atrotpatsyati yo garbhastrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || tejasā mohitaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 4 || tasmāttvamatra praviśa devadeva hutāśana || evamuktastadā vahniḥ praviveśa surottamam|| 5 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃbhramādeva samuttasthau trilocanaḥ || tejobhiḥ kṣubhitaṃ tatra vahnerāsyamathāviśat ||6|| śaśāpa pārvatī devī bhāryāsu svāsu devatāḥ || naivāvāpsyatha putrānvai matkodhakaluṣīkṛtāḥ || 7 || hutāśanopi śarvasya dahyamāno hi tejasā || tatyāja garbhaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ sāpi kālena kenacit || 8 || tatyāja parvate śvete garbhaṃ vahnisamaprabham || tena jātena saṃvṛttaṃ sauvarṇaṃ śvetaparvatam || 9 || suvarṇaretasastasya śaṃkarasya tu tejasā || dadṛśuḥ kṛttikā bālaṃ saṃtyaktaṃ tatra gaṅgayā || 1.228.10 || stanāni pradadustasya kṛpayā rājasattama || ṣaḍānanastadā bhūtvā ṣaṇṇāmeva stanaṃ papau || 11 || tāsāṃ kṣīreṇa dharmātmā vivṛddhaścārutejasā || kṛttikānāṃ varaṃ prādādyattadvakṣyāmi te nṛpa || 12 || nāḍāyana uvāca || yadā candrasamāyogaṃ gamiṣyatha śubhānanāḥ || tadā pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti bhavatīnāṃ tu ye narāḥ || 13 || vahneścandramasaścaiva varuṇasya tathā mama || gandhamālyaistathā puppairdhūpairdīpaistathaiva ca || 14 || gandhodakena puṇyena lājābhirmadhunā saha || apūpaiḥ paramānnena dadhnā gavyena cāpyatha| || 15 || kulmāṣaiḥ saphalairbhakṣyairmodakaiḥ pānakaistathā || prāpsyantyabhimatānkāmāniha loke paratra ca || 16 || naktāśanastathā bhūtvā yuṣmatpūjāparāyaṇaḥ || krīḍitvā suciraṃ nāke mānuṣye tu bhaviṣyati || 17 || rūpānvitaḥ satyaparo dyāvāndharme sthitaḥ sanbahubhṛtyayuktaḥ || kulena śīlena samanvitaśca nārīviśeṣātsubhagā bhavitrī || 18 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kṛttikāpūjāvidhirnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 228 || <1.229> || nāḍāyana uvāca || tatastu prayayau gaṅgā kumāro yatra pāvakiḥ || mayā tvaṃ janitaḥ putra tamuvāca sureśvaram || 1 || asahantyā mahātejastvadīyaṃ parvatottame || mayā skanda parityaktaṃ tadā garbhagataṃ mama || 2 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pāvakirvākyamabravīt || || skanda uvāca || nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ te yāsyāmi śambhurme daivataṃ pitā || 3 || anugrahaṃ kariṣyāmi tavāhaṃ suranimnage || vaiśākhamāsaśuklasya tṛtīyāyāṃ varānane || 4 || mānuṣyamavatīrṇāsi tadā pūjāmavāpsyasi || taminnahani yaḥ snānamācaripyati te śubhe || 5 || rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalena sa tu yokṣyati|| tasminnahani yaḥ pūjāṃ yatra tatra vyavasthitaḥ ||6|| gandhamālyopahārādyairdhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā || kartā tava mahābhāge tvattoyasnānajaṃ phalam || 7 || dhruvamāpsyati dharmajñe nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || tasminnahani yatkiñcitpradadyācchraddhayānvitaḥ || 8 || akṣayaṃ tatphalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || akṣayā sā tithirjñeyā kṛttikābhiryutā yadi || 9 || bhaviṣyati mahābhāga viśeṣeṇa phalapradā || 1.229.10 || tasmindine ye tava cārugātri pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti tatheritāṃ prāk || te nākaloke suciraṃ nirupya lokāngamiṣyanti jalādhipasya || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavacane akṣayatṛtīyāmahālayaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 229 || <1.230> nāḍāyana uvāca || tatastu jātakarmādyāḥ kriyāstasya mahātmanaḥ || viśvāmitrastu kṛtavānmaṅgalāni tathaiva ca || 1 || etasminneva kāle tu devanāthāya vajriṇe || śvetajātamathācakhyuḥ kumāraṃ dīptatejasam || 2 || nidhanāya matiṃ cakre tadā tasya purandaraḥ || daivataiḥ pitṛbhiryajñaiḥ prabhurdānavarākṣasaiḥ || 3 || bhūtanāgapiśācaiśca pitṛgandharvamānuṣaiḥ || saṃmantrya nidhane tasya sṛṣṭavānsa mahāgrahān || 4 || devadaityagrahānghorānpitṛdānavarākṣasān || yakṣagandharvanāgānāṃ nṛṇāṃ ca piśitāśinām || 5 || te grahā bahusāhasrā nānāpraharaṇodyatāḥ || abhijagmuḥ śvetagiriṃ kumāravadhakāmyayā || 6 || te grahā bahusāhasrā grahāṃśca śataśaḥ śivaḥ || skaṃdo grahānvai sasṛje pūrvagrahaniśācarān || 7 || mahābalānmahāvīryānkāmagānkāmarūpiṇaḥ || anekaśatasāhasrānnānāveśānmanojavān || 8 || teṣāṃ pradhānānvakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || skaṃdo viśākhaśca tathā naigameyastathaiva ca || bhīmo bhīmakaraḥ kravyo nirataḥ krośa eva ca || 9 || kravyādotha havirbuddhiḥ koṭimudgarikaḥ pṛthuḥ || kālaścāpyupakālaśca siddhārthaḥ puṣpakastathā || 1.230.10 || puṣpamitraḥ kokilakaḥ siddho laṃbodarastathā || khalyūḥ kapoto lamboṣṭhaḥ tathā nāyāsa eva ca || 11 || yadaṇḍo gṛddhranāsāśca gṛddhravṛttuka eva ca || kṣudrakaḥ kālakālaśca kālastatpuruṣastathā ||12|| vidyudbhūto'tha saṃvarto vartaścāvarta eva ca || śitikaṇṭhaḥ kapardī ca kacchapaḥ parikaṇṭakaḥ || 13 || pariprakāśo mattaśca mātaṅgavasanastathā || gadarākṣaḥ piśācaśca vīranāśo valīmukhaḥ || 14 || mahābhūtaśca nandaśca somānandaḥ pramodakaḥ || ānando vyavasāyaśca niścayo'tha parākramaḥ || 15 || jayaśca vijayaścaiva sañjayaḥ kalpa eva ca ||| puṣpadanto dantavakro heguṇḍirbhīṣaṇastathā || 16 || vasubhūtirvasustrāto jīvakastāpasastathā || vīrabāhuḥ subāhuśca sundaro gaṇḍa eva ca || 17 || tuṇḍā vicelā godaṃtaḥ kalaśaḥ kalaśocaraḥ || śīryagrāho lalāṭastho grīvāgrābharato grahaḥ || 18 || parilepakajātyandhau karālaḥ kuñjanāmanau || anyedyukaḥ satatagastraitīyakacaturthakau || 19 || vyarocako netrarogaḥ kāsaśvāsānugastathā || dhūtapāpaḥ pāpahitaḥ pāpācārastathaiva ca || 1.230.20 || kāṇḍo dhanañjayaścaiva śaṭho naiṣkṛtikastathā || vasudhātā vasumanā gauraḥ śotho galagrahaḥ || 21 || bhramaśca cittamohaśca tathā kāryavighātakaḥ || sarvakāryakaraścaiva jṛṃbhakaścāryakastathā || 22 || ete cānye ca balinaḥ kāmarūpā vihaṅgamāḥ || trailokyasṛṣṭisaṃhārasamarthā vividhāyudhāḥ || 23 || nānārūpadharā vīrā nānāvividhavāsasaḥ || prādudravanmahānghorānpūrvadevairvisarjitān ||24|| aviṣahyatamātmāno grahāḥ skandagrahāstathā || skandaṃ devavaraṃ sarve tadā śaraṇamāgatāḥ ||25|| tāṃstu vai śaraṇaṃ prāptānskaṃdo vacanamabravīt || skaṃda uvāca|| śaraṇaṃ vai prapannānāṃ varaṃ dāsyāmahaṃ grahāḥ ||26|| varayadhvaṃ yathākāmaṃ pūjyā me śaraṇārthinaḥ || grahā ūcuḥ || bhagavanbhakṣayiṣyāmastvatprasādena mānuṣān ||27|| etadvaramabhīṣṭaṃ naḥ sarveṣāṃ dīptavigraha || skaṃda uvāca || durācārāṃstathā loke gandhamālyānulepane||28|| teṣāṃ śarīre ratyarthaṃ vasadhvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| ye bhaktāstryambake deve tathā deve janārdane||29|| āstikāñchraddhadhānāṃśca varjayadhvaṃ prayatnataḥ || varārthamapi saṅgṛhya nyastā karmādibhiḥ kramaḥ || 1.230.30 || tyakṣadhvaṃ puruṣāñśīghraṃ mama vijñāya śāsanam || || nāḍāyana uvāca || evamuktā grahāḥ sarve svāmye cakrustadā śiśum || 31 || kumāraṃ śarvatanayaṃ mahābalaparākramam || skandenaiva yathoktaṃ tu skandaṃ skandagrahāstadā || 32 || sametā sarve vacanamidamucurnarādhipa || asmākamapi deveśa prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 33 || evamukto'tha dharmātmā grahā nskandastvabhāṣata || yāvatṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi mānavānāṃ bhavantyuta || 34 || tāvadbhavanto bādhantu manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā prajāḥ || tatrāpi balikarmādyaiḥ kṣemaṃ teṣāṃ kariṣyatha || tataḥ pūrvaṃ grahāṇāṃ tu pūjyā loke bhaviṣyatha || 35 || etāvaduktvā bhagavānkumāro dadau grahāṇāmaparaṃ śarīram || dehānsvakānnāyaka ugrasattvo lokasya rakṣārthamatīva hṛṣṭaḥ || 36 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye triṃśa duttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 230 || <1.231> || śeṣa uvāca || || nṛṇāṃ grahagṛhītānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāśu me || pratiṣedhaṃ ca dharmajña tatra me saṃśayo mahān || || 1 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || || devarṣipitṛbhūtānāṃ satataṃ cāvamānanāt || guruvṛddhadvijācāryasiddhatāpasamardanāt || 2 || balimaṃgalahomādi niyamācāravarjanāt || vratādhyayanadharmādidhyānayogavyatikramāt || 3 || guḍāmiṣatilakṣaudramedhyairuccheṣitasya vā || śmaśānāyatanābhyāsaviṇmūtrotsarjanādapi || 4 || rātrau catuṣpathāraṇyaśūnyaveśmaniveśanāt || bhojanādbhinnabhāṇḍeṣu tathā maṃtracchalādapi || 5 || śmaśānacaityavṛkṣādi maithunādiniṣevaṇāt || avamānādabhīghātānmaṅgalānāmadarśanāt || 6 || īrṣyayā bandhuśāpācca rathyāvaskandhasevanāta || aiśvaryanāśācchokācca darpotsekātiharṣaṇāt || 7 || nirlajjanāstikānāṃ hi trāsitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || gurubhiḥ samparityāgātkārttaghnyātsādhunindanāt || 8 || duḥkhātprajananātstrīṇāṃ mithyā caiva prabhāṣaṇāt || tuṣakeśakapālāsthikārpāsādiṣvadhiṣṭhitāt || 9 || prāṇināṃ sukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mṛtakasūtake || atyarthanaktasnāneṣu grahā gṛhṇanti mānavān || 1.231.10 || balaiśvaryavisaṃyogāddehamāviśati grahaḥ || jīvaḥ kukṣiṃ yathā dṛśyaḥ praviśanneva dṛśyate || 11 || vanaspatīnvā ṛtavo vijñeyāśca tathā grahāḥ || kāraṇairnavabhidehaṃ graho gṛhṇāti dehinām ||12|| raudrasvabhāvāddhiṃsārthī ratyarthī balikāmukaḥ || vitrāsārthī balodrekādraudrātprāgdaihikādbhayāt || 13 || prayuktonyena mantraiśca graho gṛhṇāti mānavān || kāraṇāni tavoktāni yadyapyetāni pārthiva || 14 || tathāpi traya evātra vijñeyāni vipaścitā || teṣāmantarbhavantyete yasmātpārthivasattama || 15 || balikāmastu ratyarthī hiṃsārthī ca tathā grahaḥ || asādhyaṃ balikāmaṃ tu kṛcchrasādhyaṃ ratigraham || 16 || hantukāmamasādhyantu vinā mantrabalaṃ mahat || sāṃtvapūrvaṃ graho viṣṭo madhuraṃ yaḥ prajāyate || 17 || tataścāntaramāsādya vicitraṃ yācate balim || pānamālyānulepāṃśca vaidyaṃ dṛṣṭvā namasyati || 18 || balikāmasya liṅgāni proktānyetāni vai mayā || ramate nṛtyati śucistathā hasati gāyati || 19 || gaṃdhamālyāmbarasnānadhūpodvarttanasevakaḥ || kathā vicitrāḥ kurute madhuraṃ samprabhāṣate || 1.231.20 || alaṃkṛtaṃ cāviśati varjayatyanalaṃkṛtam || ratikāmasya rūpāṇi jñeyānyetāni buddhinā || 21 || yaścāviṣṭo vidravati siṃhavyāghratarakṣupam || yuddhamārabhate karttuṃ gajādibhirabhītavat || 22 || bhṛśaṃ tāḍayati svāṅgaṃ patatyagnau pataṅgavat || rājadveṣāṇi kurute vijane ramate'dhikam || 23 || karoti maraṇopāyānhantuṃ kāmārdito naraḥ || lomaharṣoṅgamāṃdyaṃ ca chāyāvaikṛtyameva ca || 24 || amānuṣotsāhabalaṃ vihārāhāraceṣṭitam || dvau vā trayo vā netre'sya saṃpaśyante kumārakāḥ || 25 || nimīlitākṣitātyarthaṃ raktādivamanaṃ tathā || sāmānyametaduddiṣṭaṃ gṛhītasya tu lakṣaṇam || 26 || muktasya lakṣaṇaṃ cātaḥ pravakṣyāmi nibodhata || bhūmau vinipatatyāśu tathā saṃjñāṃ prapadyate || 27 || parāmṛśati keśāṃśca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca || śubhāśubhaṃ cātmakāryaṃ pṛcchati sma suhṛjjanam || 28 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi devādigrahalakṣaṇam || cikitsitena saṃyuktaṃ tannibodha janādhipa || 29 || nadīkūlādriśikhararuciḥ prāsādameva ca || śuciśīla samācāro jñeyo devagrahārdditaḥ || 1.231.30 || devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tasya puṣpadhūpaphalākṣataiḥ || gandhadīpapradānaiśca vahnisantarpaṇaistathā || 31 || gorasaiśca sa śālyannairbrāhmaṇaiḥ svastivācanaiḥ || karttavyaṃ viduṣā nityaṃ tataḥ saṃpadyate sukhī || 32 || ucchiṣṭānbhairavānrāvānvirasaṃ kurute'dhikam || tasmiṃstathotsavānyakṣānvratānadhyayanāni ca || 33 || bahuśo vaṭucāśnāti vastraṃ pāṭayati svakam || asuragrahaduṣṭasya rūpametadvinirddiśet || 34 || daityasaṃpūjanaṃ tasya kāryaṃ māṃsasurāsavaiḥ || raktaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpaistathā bījasamudbhavaiḥ || 35 || gandharvavādyanirghoṣaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ pranṛtyati || tīrthodyānanadītīragandhamālyādisevanāt || 36 || yathākāmaṃ vicarati gandharvonmādito naraḥ || gandhairmālyaiśca vividhairgītavādyaistathaiva ca || 37 || gandharvapūjanaṃ kāryaṃ tena saṃpadyate sukhī || nidrāluralaso duṣṭo darvīvatkurute karau || 38 || garbhavāsaguhāsevī naronmattaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || nāgānāṃ pūjanaṃ tasya kāryaṃ kulmāṣaparpaṭaiḥ || 39 || pāyasollopikāpūpaiḥ padmotpalabisaistathā || amatsarī mṛdurvīraḥ priyavāgbahubhojanaḥ || 1.231.40 || pṛthuvihvalatāmrākṣaḥ tathā vai gorasapriyaḥ || bhūtonmādasamāviṣṭo liṅgairetairvinirdiśet || 41 || kusumairbahuvarṇaiśca gorasairvividhaistathā || bhūtapūjā tu karttavyā tena sampadyate sukhī || 42 || śūnyāgāraśmaśānādricatuṣpathaniṣevakaḥ || rātrau carati yocchiṣṭaḥ piśāconmādito naraḥ || 43 || piśācayajanaṃ tasya karttavyaṃ palalāmiṣaiḥ || kaṇṭakīsambhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaistathaiva ca || 44 || avyaktabhāṣī raktākṣo hāsye coccasvarastathā || raudraṃ nirīkṣate'tyarthaṃ yakṣenonmādito naraḥ ||45|| kulmāṣaghṛtapiṇyākapalalollopikāguḍaiḥ || yakṣāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ doṣaśāntaye || 46 || udvignacetāḥ śītaśca nātiśokaparāyaṇaḥ || rākṣasena gṛhītaśca bhavatyoṣṭhavilehakaḥ || 47 || pakvāmiṣeṇa māṃsena rudhireṇa tathaiva ca || rākṣasānāṃ baliḥ kāryastasya doṣapraśāntaye || 48 || bhasmapāṃśurajodhvasto malino malināmbaraḥ || pretagṛhīto bhavati vikṛto dhvastamastakaḥ || 49 || odanaṃ madhupānīyaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrasamanvitam || 1.231.50 || pretānāṃ tatra dātavyaṃ tena saṃpadyate sukhī || śuciḥ śucisamācāraḥ sandhyācārī tilapriyaḥ || 51 || pitṛgrahagṛhītasya rūpametadvinirdiśeta || tilagorasapuṣpānnamadhumūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 52 || dīpairdānaistathā nityaṃ praṇipātena cājñayā || pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tasya karttavyaṃ doṣaśāntaye || 53 || adhīte japate caiva śucistiṣṭhati cāpyatha || yogāsaktastathārṣeṇa gṛhīto mānavo bhavet || 54 || havirgorasapuṣpādyaistathā'dhyayanasaṃstavaiḥ || ṛṣīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ tasya doṣapraśānnaye || 55 || karmaprasakto bhavati na nidrāṃ bhajate divā || pauruṣeṇa gṛhītasya lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtama || 56 || brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra miṣṭamannaṃ susaṃskṛtam || gandhamālyojvalānrājaṃstasya doṣapraśāntaye || 57 || skandagrahagṛhītānāṃ bālānāṃ śṛṇu lakṣaṇama || roditi stanati dhyāti bhūmau svapiti cāsakṛt || 58 || asambaddhapralāpī vā jñeyaḥ skandagrahārdditaḥ || raktaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairmūlaiḥ bālakrīḍanakaistathā || 59 || ghaṇṭā ca kukkuṭaiḥ pūjā balinā vividhena ca || patākābhiśca karttavyā kumārasya mahātmanaḥ || 1.231.60 || ataḥ paraṃ lokahitaṃ tavādya sarvagrahaghnānnipuṇānprayogān || vakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ hi niṣevaṇena grahairvimucyanti narā narendrān || 61 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyana vākye grahaliṅgāni nāmaikatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 231 || <1.232> || nāḍāyana uvāca || abhyaṅgotsādanaṃ snānaṃ dhūpo rakṣābalirghṛtama || netrāñjanaṃ pradhavanaṃ navagrahaharāḥ kriyāḥ || 1 || sarpagandhā vacā kuṣṭhamustākṣepaṇacandanaiḥ || sakṣīramūtrairvipacettailaṃ sarvagrahāpaham || 2 || bilvamadhyaṃ brahmadatta gavākṣībṛhatīphalam || utsādanamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaṃ jalena tu || 3 || uśīrakuṣṭhamañjiṣṭhādevadārumanaḥśilāḥ || śrīveṣṭakastathā kauntī haritālailavāluke || 4 || etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pañcagavyāṃśamiśritam || sarvagrahapraśamanaṃ snānamāyuṣyamuttamam ||5|| sarṣapāśca khuraṃ kuṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhallātakaṃ vacā|| pūtīkamajamodā ca dhūpaḥ sarvagrahāpahaḥ ||6|| śastraṃ vā rocanaṃ śastaṃ suvarṇaṃ maṇimauktikam || viṣaṃ savatsāṃ dhenuṃ ca mattaṃ chāgaṃ tathaiva ca || 7 || pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca maṃtrāśca vīṇā candanameva ca || mayūrapakṣānrajataṃ samārgaṇaguṇaṃ dhanuḥ || 8 || bhallātakāni sarpiśca rakṣārthaṃ dhārayedgṛhe || puṣpairdhūpaistathā gandhairbhakṣyairnānāvidhaistathā || 9 || pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sakulmāṣairgorasaiścandanena ca || dhūpairannaprakāraiśca baliḥ kāryo vijānatā || 1.232.10 || kāyasthāṃ ja ṭilāṃ vīrāṃ vayasthāṃ nakulīdvayam || jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva mānāṃ parpaṭakambarīm || 11 || markaṭīṃ sūkarīṃ chatrāmaticchatrāṃ palaṅkaṣām || rāmāṃ pūtanakāṃ keśīṃ māraṭāṃ kaṭukāṃ vacām ||12|| caurakāṃ viṣṇudattāṃ ca vṛṣṭikāṇḍīṃ ca cūrṇayet || purāṇamebhirvipacedghṛtaṃ toye caturguṇe || 13 || mahāpaiśācakaṃ nāma sarvagrahanivāraṇam || rasāñjanaṃ trikaṭukaṃ mañjiṣṭhā samanaḥśilā || 14 || samāni cchāgamūtreṇa piṣṭvā vartintu kārayet || chāyā śuṣkaṃ tu taṃ kuryādañjanaṃ grahanāśanam || 15 || śvetajyotiṣmatīṃ vyoṣaṃ vastrasūtreṇa veṣṭitam || chāyāśuṣke punaḥ piṣṭaṃ jñeyaṃ praśamanaṃ hitam || || 16 || saṃpūjanaṃ devagurudvijānāṃ bhaktiḥ parā cakragadādharasya || yeṣāṃ na teṣāṃ prabhavanti dīpā grahodbhavā bhūmipatipradhāna || 17 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde grahabādhāpratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 232 || <1.233> || śailūṣa uvāca || || skandasya śaraṇaṃ prāptāngrahāñśrutvā śatakratuḥ || yaścakāra mahābhāga tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || skandasya śaraṇaṃ prāptāñśrutvā śatamakho yayau || devadevagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ skando yatra vyavasthitaḥ || 2 || skandaṃ deveśvaro dṛṣṭvā dīptatejaḥsamadyutim || tuṣṭāva rājaśārdūla prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ || 3 || || śakra uvāca || || devadevaṃ namasyāmi kumāraṃ varamacyutam || kārtikeyaṃ durārādhyaṃ vahnitejaḥ samudbhavam || 4 || umāśaṅkarajaṃ bhīmaṃ gaṅgayā jaṭhare dhṛtam || śaktihastaṃ viśālākṣaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ dīptatejasam || 5 || bhaktānukampinaṃ dāṃtaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ varadaṃ prabhum || kākapakṣadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ śikhaṇḍakavibhūṣitam || 6 || raktāmbaraṃ mahābāhuṃ mayūravaragāminam || ghaṇṭāpriyaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ mahābalaparākramam || || 7 || devasenāpatiṃ devaṃ sarvalokahitepsayā || ṣaṣṭhyāntu śuklapakṣasya ye ca tvāṃ bhaumavāsare ||8|| kṛttikāsvarcayiṣyanti yathālābhaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || na teṣāṃ durllabhaṃ kiñcidbhaviṣyati surottama || 9 || dviyoge dviguṇaṃ teṣāṃ phalaṃ skanda bhaviṣyati || triyoge pūjanaṃ kṛtvā bhavataḥ surasattama || 1.233.10 || akṣayaṃ phalamāpsyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || vaiśākhamāsādārabhya pañcamyāṃ ya upoṣitaḥ || 11 || bhavantaṃ pūjayetṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ || putrārthī labhate putrāndhanakāmo dhanāni ca || 12 || mṛtaśca prāpnuyātsvargaṃ tvayi tuṣṭe harātmaja || stotreṇa ca madīyena ye stoṣyanti tava prabho || || 13 || lokadvaye'pi te kāmānprāpsyanti manasepsitān || || skanda uvāca || || pitā me daivataṃ śakra mahādevaḥ pratāpavān || 14 || tasyājñayā kariṣyāmi yanmāṃ vakṣyati vāsava || || nāḍāyana uvāca || || tataḥ prādurabhūttatra devadevastrilocanaḥ || 15 || abhyaṣiñcatkumāraṃ ca brahmaṇā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || senāpatyena devānāṃ so'bhiṣiktastadā prabho || 16 || jaghāna mahiṣaṃ nāma dānavaṃ devakaṇṭakam || mahiṣena samānvīrye jaghānāyutaśo'parān || 17 || bahutvāddānavānvīraḥ skandaḥ parabalārddanaḥ || yadā hantuṃ na śaknoti tadā devastrilocanaḥ || 18 || jaghāna manasā tatra tataḥ śūlavarāyudhaḥ || jaghāna dānavānanyāñśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 19 || bhaktā'nukampī bhagavāṃstrinetro devārisaṃghānvinipātya saṃghe || kṛtvā trilokīṃ ca tadā prahṛṣṭāṃ jagāma kailāsagiriṃ mahātmā || 1.233.20 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakāṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde mahiṣavadho nāma trayastriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 233 || <1.234> || nāḍāyana uvāca || || tasyaiva devadavasya prabhāvamaparaṃ śṛṇu || yaṣṭukāmaiḥ suraiḥ pūrvaṃ yajñe bhāgo na kalpitaḥ || 1 || yadā rājaṃstrinetrasya tadā kruddhena śaṃbhunā || yajñavāṭaṃ tato gatvā devā vitrāsitā balāt || 2 || puroḍāśaṃ bhakṣayitvā pūṣṇo dantānaśātayata || bhagasya nayanaṃ vāmaṃ babhañja paravīrahā || 3 || kruddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ mṛgarūpadharastadā || prādravatsahasā yajño naranārāyaṇāśramam || 4 || tamanvayo mahātejā bāṇacāpadharo haraḥ || yajñānusāriṇaṃ prāptaṃ haraṃ bāṇadhanurdharam || 5 || nārāyaṇastu taṃ cakre vihvalaṃ kaṇṭhapīḍanāt || vihvale tu mahādeve yajño divamathāśritaḥ || 6 || haro'pi labdhasaṃjñastamanvayau divi sattvaraḥ || na śaśāka mṛgaṃ veddhuṃ yadā dharmaśca tejasā || 7 || tatastaṃ bodhayāmāsa brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || bhagasya pūrṇaṃ ca tadā prasādamakarotpunaḥ || 8 || yajñasya cābhayaṃ dattvā krīḍayānveti taṃ punaḥ || tārāmṛgaśca gagane mahādevānugaḥ sadā || 9 || dṛśyate sa mahābhāga rātrau gaganabhūṣaṇaḥ ||1.234.10|| kruddhena rudreṇa surā nirastāḥ svasthāḥ prasannena kṛtāśca bhūyaḥ || tasmātprasannāstu bhavāya loke kruddhaśca lokāntakaraḥ pradiṣṭaḥ || 11 || iti śrīvipṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde yajavidhvaṃsano nāma catustriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāya ||234|| <1.235> || nāḍāyana uvāca || tasyaiva devadevasya prabhāvamaparaṃ śṛṇu || tena vidhvaṃsito yajño yadā dakṣasya dhīmataḥ || 1 || dakṣasya yajamānasya gaṅgādvāre purā prabho || anāhvāne ca śarvasya devīprakupitā'bhavata || 2 || devyāḥ prakopācca tathā kruddhaḥ śūladharastadā || vīrabhadreti vikhyātaṃ krodhajaṃ sṛṣṭavāngaṇam || 3 || bhadrakālī svakāddehātsṛṣṭavatyatha pārvatī || gaṇairanugato rājanvīrabhadro mahāyaśāḥ || 4 || bhadrakālīṃ tathā gatvā dakṣayajñamaśātayat || vidhvasyamānaṃ yajñantu pārvatyā sahitaḥ śivaḥ || 5 || dṛṣṭavāṃstatra rājendra bhadrakarṇeśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || vidhvasyamāne yajñe tu dakṣo vacanamabravīt || 6 || vīrabhadraṃ mahābhāgaṃ bhadrakālīṃ tathaiva ca || kau bhavantāviha prāptau mama yajñopaghātakau || 7 || vīrabhadra uvāca || kruddhena śaṅkareṇāvāṃ bhāgasyāparikalpanāt || yajñavidhvaṃsanārthāya preṣitau te parantapau || 8 || bhadrakarṇeśvaraṃ śarvaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ prasādaya || nāḍāyana uvāca || vīrabhadravacaḥ śrutvā gatvā tuṣṭāva śaṅkaram || 9 || aśvamedhasahasrāgryaṃ phalaṃ lebhe trilocanāt || trilocanastadā tuṣṭo vīrabhadramabhāṣata || 1.235.10 || yatrasthena tvayā yajño dakṣasyādya vināśitaḥ || tatra sthāne tu satataṃ sānnidhyaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi || 11 || pūjāṃ ca vipulāṃ tatra prāspyase matprasādajām || ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti vīrabhadra gaṇeśvara || 12 || te nākapṛṣṭhaṃ yāsyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || dakṣeṇa ca samāhūtā bhadrakarṇeśvare tvayā || 13 || sarasvatī mahābhāgā praviṣṭā jāhnavījalam || saṅgame ca tayoḥ snātvā pūjāṃ mama kariṣyati || 14 || yaḥ pumānsa gaṇeśatvaṃ mama prāpsyatyasaṃśayam|| gaṅgādvāraṃ kuśāvartaṃ bilvakaṃ nīlaparvatam ||15|| tathā kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapramocanam || bhaviṣyati mahābhāga tathaiva ca manoharam || 16 || prajāpateryajñabhuvaṃ samāsādya yatastataḥ || mokṣyate pātakaṃ sarvaṃ tridivaṃ ca gamiṣyati || 17 || bhūmiṣṭhamuddhṛtātpuṇyaṃ tasmātprasravaṇodakam|| tasmādapi tathā puṇyaṃ sārasaṃ parikīrtitam || sārasānnairjharaṃ puṇyaṃ nādeyamapi nairjharāt || 18|| tasmādapi ca gāṅgeyaṃ tadihāpi viśeṣataḥ || sarvatra durlabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā|||19|| gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame|| gaṅgādvāre kuśāvartte bilvake nīlaparvate ||1.235.20|| snātvā kanakhale tīrthe na punarjanmabhāgbhavet || tīrthapañcakametaddhi yatraiva gaṇanāyakaḥ || 21 || tatra sannihito brahmā tatrāhaṃ tatra keśavaḥ || tatra devagaṇāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ || 22 || tatsamīpe ca te sthānaṃ tvidaṃ dattaṃ mayā tava || tatra tvaṃ satataṃ vatsa lokātpūjāmavāpsyasi || 23 || evamuktvā mahātejā vīrabhadraṃ maheśvaraḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ devo bhadrakālīṃ maheśvaraḥ ||24 || maheśvara uvāca || namostu te mahābhāge varade kāmarūpiṇi || aṣṭādaśabhuje svasti śūlamudgaradhāriṇi || 29 || pītakauśeyavasane śaśāṅkasadṛśānane || nīlotpaladalaśyāme gajakumbhopamastani || 26 || varade cārusarvāṅgi sarvābharaṇabhūṣite|| kamaṇḍaludhare devi devāribalanāśini||27|| aditiśca ditiścaiva vanitā siddhireva ca|| rātrirnidrā prabhā kāntirbuddhirlakṣmīḥ sarasvatī||28|| dhṛtiḥ kīrtiḥ svadhā svāhā tvameva varavarṇinī || tvāṃ janāḥ pūjayiṣyanti sarvakāmapradāṃ śubhām||29|| navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya lokātpūjāmavāpsyasi || navamyāṃ pūjayiṣyanti ye tvā samyagupoṣitāḥ||1.235.30|| teṣāṃ tvaṃ kāmyadā saumye bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || kandareṣu ca śailānāṃ vanānāṃ gahaneṣu ca || 31 || raṃsyase tvaṃ viśālākṣi tadā pūjāmavāpsyasi || ye ca tvāṃ matprabhāvajñāḥ pūjayiṣyanti mānavāḥ ||32|| na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiñcidihaloke paratra ca || ye cedaṃ matkṛtaṃ stotramabhidāsyanti bhaktitaḥ||33|| te sarve bhayanirmuktā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || nāḍāyana uvāca|| etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata||34|| dakṣopi ca varaṃ labdhvā mudaṃ lebhe trilocanāt||35|| evaṃ prabhāvo varadaḥ sa devo bhaktānukampī jagato nivāsaḥ || kasyāsya vaktuṃ nṛpavarya tasya guṇānpravaktuṃ sakalā hi śaktiḥ || 36 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsano nāma pañcatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 235 || <1.236> || nāḍāyana uvāca || prabhāvamaparaṃ tasya śṛṇu devasya śūlinaḥ|| yathā vimokṣitastena śveto mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ || 1 || śveto nāma mahātejā ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmmikaḥ || pūjayāmāsa satataṃ liṅgaṃ tripuraghātinaḥ || 2 || tasya pūjāprasaktasya kadācitpṛthivīpate || ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ kālaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ || 3 || raktavṛttatrinayanaḥ sarpavṛścikaromavān || daṃṣṭrākarālo vikaṭaḥ cūrṇitāñjanasaprabhaḥ || 4 || raktavāsā mahākāyaḥ sarpābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || pāśahastastathābhyetya śvete pāśamathāsṛjat || 5 || kaṇṭhārpitena pāśena śvetaḥ kālamathābravīt || kṣaṇamātraṃ pratīkṣasva mama tribhuvanāntaka || 6 || nivarttayāmyahaṃ yāvatpūjanaṃ manmathadviṣaḥ || tamabravīttadā kālaḥ prahasanvasudhādhipa || 7 || na śrutaṃ tu tvayā manye vṛddhānāṃ śveta jalpitam || śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇike || 8 || na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vā syānna vā kṛtam || garbhe vāpyatha bālye vā yauvane vārdhakepi vā || 9 || āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe loko'yaṃ nīyate mayā || nauṣadhāni na maṃtrāśca na homo na punarjapaḥ || 1.236.10 || trāyanti mṛtyunopetṃ jarayā vāpi mānavam || bahūnīndrasahasrāṇi pitāmahaśatāni ca || 11 || mayā nītāni karttavyo nātra manyustvayānagha || vidhatse pūjanaṃ yasya mahādevasya śūlinaḥ || 12 || dehanyāsaṃ sa bahudhā mayā vai śveta kāritaḥ || svayaṃ prabhurna caivāhaṃ karmāyattā matirmama || 13 || karmaṇāṃ hi tathā nāśaṃ nāsti bhūtasya kasyacit || karmamārgānusāreṇa dhātrāhaṃ saṃpracoditaḥ || 14 || nayāmi sarvamākramya trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || evamuktastu kālena nīyamānastrilocanam || 15 || jagāma sarvabhāvena śaraṇaṃ bhaktavatsalam || śvete tu śaraṇaṃ prāpte liṅgasya tripurāntakaḥ || 16 || bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyadbhiḥ prādurbhāvaistu śārṅgiṇaḥ || ātmanaḥ kavacaṃ kṛttvā kṛtarakṣo maheśvaraḥ || 17 || bhittvā liṅgaṃ samuttasthau krodhavisphāritekṣaṇaḥ || tṛtīyalocanajvālāprakāśitajagattrayaḥ ||18|| dṛṣṭamātrastadā tasya kālo jajvāla tejasā || sa śānto bhasmabhūtaśca sarvabhūtavidhirgrahaḥ || 19 || śvetasya dattvā sāmīpyaṃ gaṇeśatvaṃ tathaiva ca || kṛtvā vidhigrahaṃ kālaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata || 1.236.20 || tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra kālaḥ sa kalayanprajām|| na kaiściddṛśyate loke videhatvājjagattraye ||21 || || śailūṣa uvāca || || vaiṣṇavaṃ kavacaṃ brahmansarvabādhānivāraṇam || tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra me saṃśayo mahān || 22 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || adṛśyametatparamaṃ pavitraṃ pūrveritaṃ kalmaṣanāśanaṃ ca || duḥkhāpahaṃ te kavacaṃ bravīmi rakṣā kṛtā yena maheśvareṇa || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathama khaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde kāladāraṇo nāma ṣaṭatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 236 || <1.237> || maheśvara uvāca || || praṇamyājaramīśānamajaṃ nityamanāmayam || devaṃ sarveśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvavyāpinamavyayam || 1 || badhnāmyahaṃ pratisaraṃ namaskṛtya janārddanam || amoghamapratihataṃ sarvaduḥṣṭanivāraṇam || 2 || viṣṇurmamāgrataḥ pātu kṛṣṇo rakṣatu pṛṣṭhataḥ || harirme rakṣatu śiro hṛdayaṃ ca janārddanaḥ || 3 || mano mama hṛṣīkeśo jihvāṃ rakṣatu keśavaḥ|| pātu netre vāsudevaḥ śrotre saṃkarṣaṇastathā || 4 || pradyumnaḥ pātu me ghrāṇamaniruddho mukhaṃ mama || vanamālī galaṃ pātu śrīvakṣo rakṣatātpuraḥ || pārśvaṃ tu pātu me cakraṃ vāmaṃ daityavidāraṇam || 5 || dakṣiṇaṃ tu gadā devī sarvāsuranivāriṇī || udaraṃ musalī pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ pātu ca lāṅgalī || 6 || ūrū rakṣatu śārṅgī me jaṅghe rakṣatu carmakī || pāṇī rakṣatu śaṃkhī ca pādau me caraṇāvubhau || sarvakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ pātu māṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ ||7|| varāho rakṣatu jale viṣameṣu ca vāmanaḥ || aṭavyāṃ narasiṃhastu sarvataḥ pātu keśavaḥ || 8 || hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānhiraṇyaṃ me prayacchatu || sāṃkhyācāryastu kapilo dhātusāmyaṃ karotu me || 9 || śvetadvīpanivāsī ca śvetadvīpaṃ nayatvajaḥ || sarvāñśatrūnsūdayatu madhukaiṭabhasūdanaḥ || 1.237.10 || vikarṣatu sadā viṣṇuḥ kilbiṣaṃ mama vigrahāt || haṃso matsyastathā kūrmaḥ pātu māṃ sarvato diśam || 11 || trivikramastu me devaḥ sarvānpāśānnikṛntatu || naranārāyaṇo devo buddhiṃ pālayatāṃ mama || 12 || śeṣo śeṣāmalajñānaḥ karotvajñānanāśanam || vaḍavāmukho nāśayatu kalmaṣaṃ yanmayā kṛtam || 13 || vidyāṃ dadātu paramāmaśvamūrddhā mama prabhuḥ || dattātreyaḥ pālayatu saputrapaśubāndhavam || 14 || sarvānrogānnāśayatu rāmaḥ paraśunā mama || rakṣoghno me dāśarathiḥ pātu nityaṃ mahābhujaḥ || 15 || ripūnhalena me hanyādrāmo yādavanandanaḥ || pralambakeśicāṇūrapūtanākaṃsanāśanaḥ || 16 || kṛṣṇo yo bālabhāvena sa me kāmānprayacchatu || andhakāraṃ tamo ghoraṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam || 17 || paśyāmi bhayasaṃtaptaḥ pāśahastamivāntakam|| tato'haṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 18 || yogīśamatirūpasthaṃ śubhaśītāṃśunirmalam || dhanyo'haṃ vijayī nityaṃ yasya me bhagavānhariḥ || 19 || smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam || vaiṣṇavaṃ kavacaṃ baddhvā vicarāmi mahītale || 1.237.20 || apradhṛṣyosmi bhūtānāṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇumayo hyaham || smaraṇāddevadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 21 || siddhirbhavatu me nityaṃ tathā maṃtra udāhṛtaḥ || yo māṃ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ yaṃ ca paśyāmi cakṣuṣā || 22 || sarvāsāṃ samadṛṣṭīnāṃ viṣṇurbadhnātu cakṣuṣā || vāsudevasya yaccakraṃ tasya cakrasya ye arāḥ || 23 || te ca cchindantu me pāpaṃ mā me hiṃsantu hiṃsakāḥ || rākṣaseṣu piśāceṣu kāntāreṣvaṭavīṣu ca || 24 || vivāde rājamārgeṣu dyūteṣu kalaheṣu ca || nadīsantaraṇe ghore saṃprāpte prāṇasaṃśaye || 25 || agnicauranipāte ca sarvagrahanivāraṇe || vidyutsarpaviṣodyoge khātode ripusaṅkaṭe ||26|| tathyametajjapennityaṃ śārīre bhaya āgate|| ayaṃ bhagavato mantro maṃtrāṇāṃ paramo mahān ||27|| vikhyātaṃ kavacaṃ guhyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || svamāyākṛtanirmāṇaṃ kalpāṃtagṛhalopakṛt || anādyaṃ tajjagadbījaṃ padmanābha namostu te || 28 || oṃkālāya svāhā || oṃkālapuruṣāya svāhā || oṃpracaṇḍāya svāhā || oṃpracaṇḍapuruṣāya svāhā || oṃsarvāya svāhā || oṃsarvasarvāya svāhā || oṃnamo bhuvaneśāya trilokadhāmne itiṭipiriṭi svāhā || oṃuttamenaaghe tu me vāyu tu me ye sattvāḥ pāpānucārāsteṣāṃ daityadānava yakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśāca kūṣmāṇḍāpasmāronmādanajvarāṇāṃ ekāhika dvitīyaka tārtīyaka cāturthika mauhūrttika dinajvara rātrijvara satatajvara sandhyājvara sarvajvarādīnāmutsādana lūtākīṭakakaṃṭakakaṭapūtanābhujagasthāvaraviṣaviṣamaviṣādīnāmidaṃ śarīraṃ mamāpradhṛṣyaṃ bhavatu oṃ sukāre prakarotkaṭakavikaṭadraṃṣṭrapūrvato rakṣa || oṃ haiṃ haiṃ haiṃ haiṃ dinakarasahasrakāntasamogratejaḥ paścimato rakṣarakṣa || oṃ niriniripradīptajvalana jvālākālamahākapilajaṭila uttaratto rakṣa || oṃ cilicili milimili cekaḍi gaurigāṃdhāri viṣohani viṣaṃ māṃ mohayatu svāhā || dakṣiṇato rakṣa māmamukasya sarvabhūtabhayopadravebhyaḥ svāhā || jayati vijayadānaṃ jāyatāṃ ripupurahāsanunavadhyate bhayahṛdayabhayadobhayebhayaṃ diśatu mamāyamudāramacyutaḥ|| yadudaramakhilaṃ viśanti raśmayaḥ || ādyantavantaḥ kavayaḥ purāṇāḥ sūkṣmā bṛhanto hyanuśāsitāraḥ || sarvajvarānghnantu mamāniruddhapradyumnasaṃkarṣaṇavāsudevāḥ||29|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye viṣṇukavacaṃ nāma saptatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||237|| <1.238> || vajra uvāca || śrutvā kālāṅgadahanaṃ brāhmaṇena samīritam || kiṃ papraccha tadā brahmañśailūṣo mṛtyucoditaḥ||1|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| śrutvā kālāṅgadahanaṃ brāhmaṇena samīritam || rāvaṇasyaiva caritaṃ bhūyaḥ papraccha taṃ tadā || 2 || śailūṣa uvāca || caritasyāvaśeṣaṃ yaddaśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra me saṃśayo mahān||3|| nāḍāyana uvāca || tato'sya nagaraṃ bhūyaḥ paricakrāma rāvaṇaḥ || sa dadarśa tadā tatra prāsādaṃ sarvakāñcanam||4|| muktājālaparikṣiptaṃ tathā vidrumatāraṇam || gāruḍena ca raktena samantātkṛtavedikam || 5 || vaiḍūryarucirastambhaṃ padmarāgaprabhojjvalam || indranīlaprabhācchannaṃ niryūhaśataśobhitam || 6 || mahābhuvanasaṃbādhaṃ mahodyānavibhūṣitam || sukhārohaṇasopānaṃ dīrghikāśatasaṃkulam || 7 || sarvartu kusumairvṛkṣaiḥ samantādupaśobhitam || sarvāsanayutaṃ ramyaṃ mahendrabhavanādhikama || 8 || tantu dṛṣṭvā gṛhaṃ rājanprahastaṃ vākyamabravīt || prahasta śīghraṃ jānīhi kasyedaṃ bhavanottamam || 9 || evamuktaḥ prahastastu praviveśa gṛhottamam || saṃprāptāyāṃ ca kakṣāyāṃ bhinnāñjanacayopamam ||1.238.10 || sarvābharaṇasaṃvītaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || gṛhītvā lohamusalaṃ dvāradeśe vyavasthitam || 11 || dadarśa puruṣaṃ bhīmaṃ jvālāmaṇḍaladurdṛśam || taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ sa viveśa daśānanaḥ || 12 || samāptāyāṃ ca kakṣāyāṃ sa dadarśa tameva hi || tamuvāca mahātejā niśācaragaṇeśvaraḥ || 13 || yuddhārthyahamanuprāpto yuddhātithyaṃ prayaccha me || atha vā tasya śaṃsa tvaṃ gṛhe yosminvyavasthitaḥ || 14 || tato rākṣasarājasya puruṣo vākyamabravīt || tiṣṭhatyasmingṛhe rājā dānavānāṃ balirbalī || 15 || tena cedyotsyase vīra praviśedaṃ gṛhottamam || yoddhuṃ nārhasi tena tvaṃ sa mahātmā mahābalaḥ || 16 || brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca śūraḥ satyaparākramaḥ || vīro bahuguṇopeto balavāndṛḍhavikramaḥ || bālārka iva tejasvī samareṣvanivarttakaḥ || 17 || priyaṃvadaḥ saṃvibhāgī gūḍha sākṣyāya tatparaḥ || evamukto daśagrīvaḥ praviveśa gṛhottamam || 18 || atha saṃdarśanādeva balinā sumahātmanā || śīghramutsaṅgamāropya pṛṣṭastvāgamanaṃ tataḥ || 19 || tasyovāca mahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ || śrutaṃ mayā mahābhāga baddhastvaṃ kila viṣṇunā || 1.238.20 || so'haṃ mocayituṃ śakto bandhanāttvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || evamuktastato hāsaṃ balirmuktvedamabravīt || 21 || ete me kuṇḍale divye mahāratnopaśobhite || anayorekamānīya cātropaviśa mā ciram || 22 || atropaviṣṭasya ca te vyākhyāsye viṣṇuvikramam || evamukto daśagrīvaḥ kuṇḍalānayane tataḥ||23|| cakāra paramaṃ yatnaṃ na śaśāka ca śatruhā || yadā cālayituṃ sthānānna śaśāka sa kuṇḍalam || 24 || prasvinnasarvagātrastu saṃdaṣṭadaśanacchadaḥ || bhrakuṭīsaṃkaṭamukhaḥ paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ || 25 || utsaṅge tadavasthe tu baliḥ kṛtvedamabravīt || hiraṇyakaśipurnāmābhavanme prapitāmahaḥ || 26 || yadā babhūva tasyeme kuṇḍale vai babhūvatuḥ || etābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ tu so'bhūtpūrva vibhūṣitaḥ || 27 || ūrvorāropya nakharaiḥ karaistena vidāritaḥ || kathamadya mahābhāgaṃ taṃ tvaṃ jetuṃ vyavasyasi || 28 || sa eva puruṣaḥ śyāmo dvāri tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ || etena dānavendrāśca tathānye baladarpitāḥ || 29|| vaśaṃ nītā balavatā pūrvapūrvatarāśca ye || baddhaścāhamanenaiva kālo'yaṃ duratikramaḥ ||1.238.30 || ka enaṃ puruṣaṃ loke vañcayiṣyati rākṣasa || lokatrayasya sarvasya kartā hartā tathaiva ca || 31 || saṃharatyeṣa bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca || punaśca sṛjate sarvamanādyanto maheśvaraḥ || 32 || iṣṭaṃ caiva hutaṃ caiva tapastaptaṃ tathaiva ca || sarvasyeva hi lokeśo dhātā goptā na saṃśayaḥ || 33 || sarvadevamayaścaiva sarvabhūtamayastathā || sarvalokamayaścaiva sarvajñānamayastathā || 34 || sarvarūpī mahārūpī mahābālo mahābhujaḥ || smṛtvā stutvā tatheṣṭvā ca sarvamasmādavāpnuyāt || 35 || etacchrutvā ca vacanaṃ rāvaṇo niryayau tadā || na ca taṃ puruṣaṃ tatra dadarśa rajanīcaraḥ || 36 || sametya rakṣodhipatiḥ sahāyaścacāra bhūyaḥ pṛthivīsamagrām|| na cāpyasau kañcidapaśyatānyaṃ lokeṣu dhīraṃ tridaśārimukhyaḥ || 37 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye balirāvaṇasamāgamo nāmāṣṭatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 238 || <1.239> || nāḍāyana uvāca || || sa kadācinmahīṃ sarvāṃ vicarandhanadānujaḥ || paścime sāgaradvīpe dadarśa puruṣaṃ śubham || 1 || jāṃbūnadasamaprakhyaṃ jvalitānalasuprabham || viśvarūpadharaṃ devaṃ varadaṃ kāmarūpiṇam || 2 || dharmastasya tapaścaiva jagataḥ siddhihetuke || ūrū cāśritya tasthāte manmathaḥ śiśnamāśritaḥ || 3 || viśvedevāḥ kaṭībhāge maruto bastiśīrṣake || pādayośca dharādevī piśācāśca nakhāśritāḥ || 4 || madhyeṣṭau vasavastasya samudrāḥ kukṣimāśritāḥ || pārśveṣu ca diśaḥ sarvāḥ sarvasa ndhiṣu mārutaḥ || 5 || pitaraścāśritāḥ pṛṣṭhe hṛdaye ca pitāmahaḥ || godānāni pavitrāṇi bhūmidānāni yāni ca || 6 || suvarṇasya ca dānāni yakṛllomāntarāṇi ca || asthibhāgeṣu śailāśca śirāsu saritastathā || 7 || maṇivakṣo'bhavattasya śarīre dyaurava sthitā || kṛkāṭikāyāṃ sandhyāśca talavāhāśca ye ghanāḥ || 8 || bāhū dhātā vidhātā ca bhagaḥ pūṣā tathā karau || nāgā ghoraviṣāḥ sarve karajeṣu vyavasthiyatāḥ || 9 || agnirāsyamabhūttasya skandhau rudrairadhiṣṭhitau || dantā māsartavaścaiva daṃṣṭrāstasya tu vatsaraḥ || 1.239.10|| nāsāyāṃ cāpyamāvasyā tacchi dreṣu ca vāsarāḥ || grīvā tasyābhavadvedī vāṇī cātha sarasvatī || 11 || nāsatyau śravaṇau cobhau netre śaśidivākarau || vedāṅgāni ca yajñāśca tārā rūpāṇi yāni ca || 12 || etāni nararūpasya tasya dehāśritāni vai || tenātikāyena tadā rākṣasaḥ pāṇipīḍitaḥ ||13|| mumūrccha sacivāścāsyā palāyanta diśo daśa || ṛgvedapratimaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ padmamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 14 || krameṇa ca viveśātha pātālaṃ girisannibhaḥ || utthāya ca daśagrīvaścāhūya sacivatrayam||15|| kva gataḥ sahasā brūta prahastaśukasāraṇāḥ|| evamukte rākṣasendre rākṣasāstamathābruvan||16|| praviṣṭaḥ sa narotraiva devadānavadarpahā|| talena tenaiva tataḥ praviveśa niśācaraḥ|| 17 || eka eva mahātejā varadānātsvayaṃbhuvaḥ || praviśya dadṛśe tatra sarvābharaṇabhūṣitān || 18 || nityo tsavācchāṃtabhayānniṣkalānpāvakaprabhān || caturbhujānmahārūpāñchrīvatsakṛtalācchanān || 19 || ekarūpadharānyarvānraktamālyānulepanān || rāgadveṣavinirmuktānsarvaśaktīñjagatprabhūn || 1.239.20 || nṛtyena gītavādyena sevamānāñjanārdanam || mānuṣyaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 21 || samīpaṃ samanuprāptāstasyaiva parameṣṭhinaḥ || dṛṣṭāḥ koṭyaḥ sahasrāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca rajanīcaraḥ || 22 || ūrdhvaromāstatastasmāddeśāddeśamapāsarata || jagāma dadṛśe'pyatrāpyanaupamyaguṇaṃ gṛham || 23 || dadarśa ca tadā tatra puruṣaṃ śayane sthitam || pāṇḍureṇa mahārgheṇa śayanāsanavāsasā || 24 || śete sa puruṣavyāghraḥ pāvakenāvaguṇṭhitaḥ || divyagandhānu'liptāṃgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||25|| divyāmbaradharā sādhvī trailokyasyaikabhūṣaṇam || bālavyajana hastā vai rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi || 26 || pādāvutsaṃga āropya tasya devasya cakriṇaḥ || jighṛkṣuḥ sahasā sādhvīṃ rākṣasebhyo'patadbalāt || 27 || avaguṇṭhanamātraṃ vai dṛṣṭaṃ tena mahātmanaḥ || jahāsoccaistadā devo dṛṣṭvā taṃ rākṣaseśvaram || 28 || tejasā sa tu daivasya rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ || kṛntamūlo yathā śākhī nipapāta mahītale || 29 || patitaṃ rākṣasendraṃ taṃ devo vacanamabravīt || uttiṣṭha maraṇaṃ nāsti sāmprataṃ te niśācara || 1.239.30 || prajā pativaro rakṣo yena jīvasi sāmpratam || tamabravīttadā rājā rākṣasānāṃ tu vihvalaḥ || 31 || ko bhavācchayane śete yugāntānalasannibhaḥ || evamuktaḥ sa tenātha pratyuvāca niśācaram || 32 || ki te mayā daśagrīva vadhyosi na cirānmama || evameva ca mṛtyuste bhaviṣyati daśānana || 33 || yāṃ jighṛkṣasi mohāttvaṃ bhūyaścaināṃ hariṣyasi || mānuṣyamahamāsādya tvāṃ vadhiṣyāmi rāvaṇa || 34 || asyāḥ kṛte viśālākṣyāḥ sāmprataṃ gaccha rākṣasa || śrutvaitadvacanaṃ devādrāvaṇo vākyamabravīt || 35 || nāsti dhanyataro loke mayā lokatraye vinā || tvaddhastānmaraṇaṃ yasya bhaviṣyati jagatprabho || || 36 || yaśasyaṃ ślāghanīyaṃ ca tvaddhastānmaraṇaṃ mama || athāsya gātre saṃpaśyadrāvaṇo bhīmavikramaḥ || 37 || trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ rājanviśvarūpadharasya tu || dṛṣṭvaitadrāvaṇo rājanvismayotphullalocanaḥ || 38 || bahumene tathātmānaṃ nirjagāma tathaiva ca || devadevābhyanujñātaḥ sa jagāma tadā gṛham ||39|| tasya devo vadhārthāya caturmūrttirjanārdanaḥ || mānuṣyamāgataṃ rājaṃstena mā vigrahaṃ kṛthāḥ || 1.239.40 || rāmo janārdanaḥ sākṣātsītā lakṣmīstathaiva ca || tathā bharataśatrughnau lakṣmaṇo'pi mahāyaśāḥ || 41 || viṣṇorbhāgāstvayā jñeyā viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥ || śatrughnena mahatkarma lavaṇasya vadhe kṛtam || tasmādabhyadhikaṃ manye bharataṃ dharmavatsalam || 42 || na devasaṅghairmanujairna yakṣairna rākṣasairnāgavarairna daityaiḥ || raṇe vijetuṃ raghavastu śakyā yeṣāṃ sa nātho hariraprameyaḥ || 43 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye rāvaṇasya mahāpuruṣadarśanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 239 || <1.240> || śailūṣa uvāca || || lavaṇasya vadhaṃ brahmañśrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || śatrughnena kathaṃ yuddhe lavaṇo vinipātitaḥ ||1|| || nāḍāyana uvāca || || ayodhyāyāmayodhyāyāṃ rājandāśarathau sthite || anatīte kadācittu vasante rativardhane||2|| nātyuṣṇaśīte sasukhe sarvaprāṇimanohare || utphullaśākhisaṃlīnacārusvanaśilīmukhe || 3 || kokilārāvabahule sapravālavanaspatau || sukhārkakiraṇe kāle vibhūṣitadharātale || 4 || patracūtāgraśākhāsthaparapuṣṭaninādite || gantukāmāḥ pravasitāḥ panthā bhūyo nivartitāḥ || 5 || mañjaryaḥ sahakārāṇāṃ yatra lagnā śilīmukhāḥ || kāmanāmāṅkitā bāṇāḥ kāmasyeva śarīriṇām || 6 || kāminyaḥ kāmināṃ kāmaṃ yatra tyajayato dṛḍham || samīraṇena dākṣiṇyaṃ sarvatra prakaṭīkṛtam || 7 || mṛdupravātasaṃnunnaprasūnayavaśālinī || kṣveḍapaṅktiḥ sururuce vahamāneva nimnagā || 8 || āliṅgitāstu madhunā samantādvanarājayaḥ || phullaiḥ palāśaiḥ prakaṭaṃ rāgaṃ babhrustadā svayam || 9 || samīraṇena mṛdunā puṣpapatrārcitā mahī || rātrau vyabhrasya nabhasaḥ śriyamūhe saśādvalā || 1.240.10 || vañcitairnavajātānāṃ vatsānāṃ mṛdubhāṣiṇām || goṣṭheṣu śobhā mahatī yasmingaṃdharvasattama || 11 || hambhāravavirāviṇyaḥ stvaramāṇapadakramāḥ || yasminvatsotsukā gāvaḥ praviśanti dinakṣaye ||12|| stanaṃ pibadbhirmātṝṇāṃ vatsairutkṣiptapucchakaiḥ || muhurmudaṃ parāṃ yatra mātṛlīḍhaistu gopinaḥ ||13|| yatra puṣpoccayaṃ cakruḥ kāminīpāṇipallavāḥ || pallavānāṃ tu sādṛśyādvijñātā naiva kāmibhiḥ ||14|| ṛtukokilasaṃgītau dvirephadhvanivallakīm || śrutvaiva nanṛturyatra mṛduvātahatā latāḥ ||15|| tasminvyatīte tu madhau narendra saṃtāpayāmāsa jagatsamagram || nidāghakālo lavaṇopamastu saṃruddhamārgo'tibṛhatpalāśaḥ || 16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣvayodhyāvasanta varṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||240|| <1.241> || nāḍāyana uvāca || vartamāne tadā grīṣme vikasanmallikākule || nivṛttapānthasaṃcāre saṃtaptasikatotkare||1|| praphulladāḍimākrānte jvalitābhavanāntare|| cārucampakapuppāḍhyavanarājivirājite||2|| pāṭalāpuṣpasaṃlīnadvirephagaṇamaṇḍite|| saṃtaptamahiṣīkroḍaluṭhatpaṅkajabhūṣaṇe || 3|| pārvatottuṅgamātaṅgaviloḍitajalāśaye || svādugāvaca salile nīhārāvṛtaparvate ||4 || karpūracandanārdrāṃgyo mṛṇālavalayāḥ priyāḥ || ramayanti priyānyatra vanamālākṛtasrajaḥ ||5|| sevyāścandrāṃśavo yatra kāmināṃ kāmavardhanāḥ || ramaṇīyapradoṣāśca sutarāṃ yatra rātrayaḥ || 6 || rātryante śītalānvātānkusumāśayagandhinaḥ || samāghrāyābhijāyante kāminastu riraṃsavaḥ || 7 || rātrayaḥ śīghragāminyo divasā mandagāminaḥ || mithunopagamādbhānoḥ saṃprataptā bhṛśaṃ karāḥ || 8 || vilīnahimatoyaugha phenapuñjasamākulāḥ || atyarthaśītāḥ saritastathā haimena parvatāḥ || 9 || tathā bahulaniryāsasurabhīkṛtacandanaiḥ || vardhayanti tathā kāmaṃ kāminīnāṃ tu kāmukāḥ || 1.241.10 || ratyantarasamutpannamāyāsaśramajaṃ jalam || karpūrarajasā yatra nāśayanti sma kāminaḥ || 11 || yasminnidāghe saphalāmravṛkṣe vibhūṣaṇāḍhyo nṛpa vatsarasya || didṛkṣavastaṃ raghuvṛnda mukhyaṃ tadā prayātā punayastvayodhyām || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣvayodhyā darśane grīṣmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 241 || <1.242> nāḍāyana uvāca || tataḥ sabhāgataṃ rāmaṃ dvāḥstho vacanamabravīt || dvāri tiṣṭhanti munayo yamunātīravāsinaḥ ||1|| bhārgavaṃ tu puraskṛtya cyavanaṃ dīptatejasam || mahānubhāvā varadāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ || 2 || dvāḥsthāttu vacanaṃ śrutvā tadā rāmaḥ purodhasā || sahitastvarayā draṣṭuṃ tāpasām̐stānvinirgataḥ || 3 || so'bhigamya mahātejā ṛṣisaṅghāṃstapasvinaḥ || abhivādya praṇamyaitānpuraskṛtya tadā gṛham || 4 || prāveśayattatasteṣāṃ pādyārghyācamanādikam || āsanaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tathā rājyaṃ nyavedayat || 5 || pratigṛhya tu te sarve rājyaṃ tasmai punardaduḥ || tadvacca tīrthatoyāni phalāni vividhāni ca || 6 || pratigṛhya ca rāmastānpṛṣṭvā kuśalamavyamam || papraccha tānmahābhāgastatastvāgamanakriyām || 7 || rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cyavano vākyamabravīt || rākṣaso lavaṇo nāma rājanmadhuvane vasan||8|| lokāṃstāpayate sarvāṃstasya yatnaṃ vadhe kuru || daśaprāṇisahasrāṇi cāhārastasya naityikaḥ || 9 || vadhārthaṃ bharataṃ tasya śatrughnaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam || samā diśa mahābhāga lokāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ || 1.242.10 || tathā madhuvane sphīte deśaṃ rāma niveśaya || nagarīñca yathā puṇyāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||11 || tvayā sa bhājyo rakṣyāśca munisaṃghā mahāmate || evamuktastadā rāmaścintayāmāsa dharmavit || 12 || lakṣmaṇena mahatkarma kṛtaṃ nivasatā vane || rājyaṃ pālayatā karma bharatena mahatkṛtam || 13 || śatrughnaṃ prerayāmyadya lavaṇasya vadhepsayā || ityevaṃ cintayitvā tu rāmaḥ śatrughnamabravīt || 14 || munīṃścaitānpuraskatya gaccha śatrughna mā ciram || ghātayasva durācāraṃ lavaṇaṃ pāpakāriṇam || 15 || ghātayitvā ca lavaṇaṃ janāṃstatra niveśaya || nagarī ca tathā tatra tvayā kāryā manoramā || 16 || tasyāṃ vasa mahābhāga pālayam̐stvaṃ vasundharām || tatrāhamabhiṣekṣyāmi rājye tvāmṛṣibhiḥ saha || 17 || etāvaduktvā rāmastadvākyaṃ ṛṣigaṇānvitam|| abhiṣekena divyena yojayāmāsa taṃ tadā || 18 || uvāca ca mahātejā bhrātaraṃ dīptatejasam || imānyaśvasahasrāṇi catvāri bhavato'nagha || 19|| rathānāṃ dve sahasre ca dvipottamaśataṃ tathā || ayutaṃ ca padātīnāṃ suvarṇasya ca sañcayam || 1.242.20 || antarāpaṇavīthyaśca nānāpaṇyopaśobhitāḥ || ādāya gaccha śatrughna paryāptabalavāhanaḥ || 21 || balaṃ ca subhṛtaṃ vīra tuṣṭapuṣṭamanuddhatam || vaśaṃ ca sāntvadānābhyāṃ kuruṣva raghunandana || 22 || na hyarthāstatra tiṣṭhanti na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ || suprīto bhṛtyavargastu yatra tiṣṭhati rāghava || 23 || sa tvaṃ duṣṭajanākīrṇāṃ saṃsthāpya mahatīṃ camūm || eka eva dhanuṣpāṇiryodhayethā madhoḥ sutam || 24|| yathā ca tvāṃ na jānāti gaccha taṃ yuddhakāṅkṣiṇam || lavaṇaḥ sa madhoḥ putrastathā niḥśaṅkano vraja || 25 || ākhyāto na ca tasyāsti kaścinmṛtyubhayānvitaḥ || darśanaṃ yo'bhigaccheta hanyate lavaṇena saḥ || 26 || māheśvareṇa śūlena viyuktaṃ mṛgayāgatam || dvāramāvṛtya lavaṇaṃ yudhyasva raghunandana || 27 || māheśvaramamoghaṃ tu śūlaṃ ca parivarjitam || gṛhāṇemaṃ śaraṃ vatsa sarvāyudhavināśanam || 28 || anena lavaṇaṃ yuddhe ghātayiṣyasyasaṃśayam || gaccha tvaṃ grīṣmaśeṣeṇa lavaṇasya jighāṃsayā || 29 || kāle tathā prāvṛṣi saṃpravṛte vivṛddhatoyāsu saridvarāsu || maddattabāṇena niśācarasya vyasuṃ kṣiptau pātaya tasya deham || 1.242.30 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu lavaṇavadhe śatrughnaṃ prati rāmānuśāsanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 242 || <1.243> rāma uvāca || saṃprāpya prāvṛṣaṃ vatsa bhīmatoyadaniḥsvanām || niṣiddhapānthasaṃcārāṃ vidyutkṣubhitatoyadām || 1 || meghaistoyabharānamraiḥ sthagitārkaniśākarām || pravarṣaṇajalāghātavikāsitasaroruhām || 2 || yasyāṃ ghanavaratrāsātpīnotkampipayodharāḥ || kurvantyāliṅganaṃ kāntāḥ kāntānāṃ manasaḥ priyam||3|| bhūmirnavatṛṇacchannā śakragopādyabhūṣitā|| bhīmaughanādavistīrṇā phenavatyaśca nimnagāḥ ||4|| satoyatoyadākrāṃtaṃ snigdhanīlaṃ nabhastalam || balākāḥ śobhayanti sma śāradaṃ tārakā iva || 5 || ghanā ghanāgamārūḍhā dhṛtavāsavakārmukāḥ || toyaughabāṇadhārābhiḥ pravavarṣurmahītalam || 6 || dhārākadambabakulakuṭajārjunaśobhitāḥ || pakvajambvāmraśālinyo vanarājyo manoharāḥ || 7 || nidāghatāpasaṃtaptā navatoyasamukṣitā || mahī visṛjate yasyāṃ gandhamālyaguṇaṃ svakam || 8 || garjamāneṣu megheṣu mṛdaṅgadhvanisannibham || asyāṃ mayūrā nṛtyaṃti vikasatsatkalāpinaḥ || 9 || samīraṇena mṛdunā nunnāḥ khe ca payodharāḥ || mahiṣyaśca visarpanti payaḥpūrṇapayodharāḥ||1.243.10|| pratyūṣe saṃcarantīnāṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ tadā samam || ghaṇṭāninādo madhuraḥ śrūyate tṛṇagahvare||11|| sthalayaḥ kṛṣṇasāraṅgakṣetrairanimiṣairiva || yasyāṃ paśyanti śatrughna jalapūrṇamahītalam || |12 || meghapātena hadyena pṛṣatotkaraśālinā || kāminyaḥ kāmināṃ sārdhaṃ tyājitā raghunandana || 13 || apāragamyāḥ sarito rājāno gatavigrahāḥ || balāhakagaṇacchatrā dyaustathaiva savigrahā || 14 || na nirvṛtasukhodvāhakāmyākāmyakriyā mahī || prahṛṣṭapaurānugataiḥ saṃvatsarapurohitaiḥ || 15 || vyagrā bhavanti rājanaḥ śakrayaṣṭipraveśane || śailairnavatṛṇacchannaistathā nīlābhraśekharaiḥ || 16 || kāntimadbhirviśeṣeṇa virājati vasundharā || tāṃ prāvṛṣaṃ prāpya nadatpayodapranartitāśeṣaśikhaṇḍivṛndām || dvāraṃ samāśritya madhostanūjaṃ dhanurdharastvaṃ jahi rājaputra ||17|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye prāvṛḍvarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 243 || <1.244> rāma uvāca || hatvā prāvṛṣi taṃ pāpaṃ yamunātīragocaraḥ || naya tvaṃ śāradaṃ kālaṃ yāvatsupto janārdanaḥ || 1 || ramaṇīyatarā yatra nadyaḥ prakaṭasaikatāḥ || susvāduśītasalilā ssārasairupaśobhitāḥ || 2 || bālārkasadṛśaiḥ padmaiḥ padminyo yatra bhūṣitāḥ || sarasāṃ vimalaṃ yatra toyaṃ madhuraśītalam ||3|| varastrīnayanākāracārupatra vibhūṣaṇaiḥ || paśyaṃtīvotpalairvyoma utpalinyaḥ sunirmalam || 4 || nabhaḥsarasi vistīrṇe tārānuguṇacitrite || śobhate ca niśītheṣu haṃsavadvicarañśaśī || 5 || ādadhāno mahaccāpaṃ saṃdadhānaśca dṛśyate || yāvatsaṃpūra ityeva bāṇairbhūmitalaṃ śarat ||6|| jātīkusumahṛdyāsu bandhujīvojjvalāsu ca|| manaḥ prasādamāyāti hṛdyāsu vanarājiṣu || 7 || pakvasasyā vasumatī parāṃ dhārayati śriyam || kalaviṅkāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca pakvakedārapaṅktiṣu || 8 || nimnagā kāthavasanāścakravākayugastanāḥ || sārasārāvahāsinyaḥ sutarāṃ rativarddhanāḥ || 9 || haṃsaiḥ saṃghaṭṭanopetakahlārarajasotkaraiḥ || sarāṃsi durvibhāvyāni kuśalairapi mānavaiḥ || 1.244.10 || pāṇḍurābhrakṛtanyāsāḥ sarva eva śiloccayāḥ || śriyaṃ viḍambayaṃtīva tuṣārādreḥ samujjvalām || 11 || śaratprabhūtotpalacārupadmāṃ vipakvakedāravibhūṣitorvīm|| nītvā tataḥ prāpya himasya kālaṃ kāryastvayā pattanasanniveśaḥ||12|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathama khaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu śatrughnaṃ prati rāmānuśāsane śaradvarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||244|| <1.245> || rāma uvāca || prabuddhe puṇḍarīkākṣe hemante vaiṣṇave ṛtau || kāryaḥ puraniveśaste tathā janapadasya vā || 1|| pakvanāraṅgasubhage nīhārāvṛtanimnage || pralūnadhānyakedāre gatatundaśilīmukhe || 2 || kṛtasaṃgrahaṇe kāle pravṛttanṛpavigrahe || vipaṅkavasudhe ramye svāduśītajalāśaye || 3 || viśālā yatra yāminyaḥ sutarāṃ suratakṣamāḥ || bhṛśaṃ manoharā yūnāṃ pīḍitāliṅganakṣamāḥ || 4 || yatra śītāpadeśena māninībhirapi svayam || kriyate tyaktamānābhiḥ priyakaṇṭhagrahotsavaḥ || 5 || sukhoṣṇodakagāndharvaramyaprasravaṇodake || prarūḍhapavanodbhūte kāle nīladharātale || 6 || vāsodgamanasaṃruddhadurvibhāvyanadītaṭe || sārasārāvavijñeye kāle kāmijanapriye || 7 || yatrekṣupīḍayantrāṇāṃ yaṣṭyaḥ puruṣacoditāḥ || bhāgyānīva manuṣyāṇāmunnamanti namanti ca || 8 || kṛtāgrāyaṇapūjāśca hutahavyā dvijātayaḥ || yatra praveśahṛṣṭāśca tathā yatra ca karṣakāḥ || 9 || gṛheṣu ca sukhoṣṇeṣu gavāṃ niḥśvāsa mārutaiḥ || svādhyāyaghoṣo viprāṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ yatra sukhāvahaḥ || 1.245.10 || sitābhiḥ pacyamānābhiḥ kriyamāṇaistathā guḍaiḥ || ramyaḥ suśītalaḥ kālaḥ prāṇipriyahutāśanaḥ || 11 || vicaranti narā yatra guruprāvaraṇāmbarāḥ || kuṃkumenānuliptāṅgā dhaninaḥ priyadarśinaḥ || 12 || aśvāyāmakṣame kāle yatra yūnāṃ viśeṣataḥ || mṛgayā dayitā vatsa mandaraśmau divākare || 13 || rohitāśanapuṣṭānāṃ sādhunāraṅgavāsitam || mahiṣīṇāṃ tu mathitaṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam || 14 || ikṣavaśca vidāryaśca tathaiva mūlakāni ca || rasavanti viśeṣeṇa yatra piṣṭakṛtāni ca || 18 || pravṛttamekhalābandhavivāhādikriye jane || prabuddhe puṇḍarīkākṣe pravṛtte yajñasaṃstare || 16 || kāle prahṛṣṭāśvakarīndramukhye kāryā tvayā rāghava vāstupūjā || ārambhaṇīyaṃ nagarasya karma śivāya sarvasya janasya vatsa ||17 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu śatrughnaṃ prati rāmasamupadeśe hemantavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 245 || <1.246> rāma uvāca || tatastu śaiśire prāpte kāle tapanavallabhe || himālīpaṭalacchannadurvibhāvyadiśāmukhe ||1|| supakvamātuluṅgāḍhyavanarājisugandhini || praphullavṛttakusumacārurāgojjvalatviṣi || 2 || himaprayātasañjātasarvaratnatṛṇolbaṇe|| atyarthaśītakusume kuṅkumāguruvallabhe||3|| kāminyaḥ kuṅkumārdrāṅgyaḥ pīnonnavapayodharāḥ || āliṅganena kāntānāṃ yatra śītabhayāpahāḥ ||4|| puṣpitairatasīvāṭairnīlanīrajanirmalaiḥ || pūrṇatoyāśayāśaṅkā jāyate sudhiyāmapi ||5|| mādhyakundakapuṣpāḍhyā vanarājyo manoharāḥ || suśīrṇaparṇasaralānamerukavibhūṣaṇāḥ ||6|| saṃtyaktvā dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ vrajamāne tathottarāma || sūrye mumoca pavanaṃ niḥśvāmamiva dakṣiṇā||7|| ramyāśca gaṃdhamaṃjaryaḥ śobhayanti vanasthalīḥ || manmathasya śarāḥ kāṃtā kāmimanmathavardhanāḥ || 8 || hayānāṃ madhuraḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate daśanodbhavaḥ || śabdo yavabhujāṃ yatra svāmināṃ rativardhanaḥ || 9 || nirmalānāṃ tu sarasāṃ viniviṣṭā jalecarāḥ || bruvantau madhuraṃ pāṃthā janayanti parāṃ mudam||1.246.1 0|| janayanti parāṃ prītiṃ kāminīnāṃ tu kāmukāḥ || yatra medhyairnavairvatsa mātuluṅgādhivāsitaiḥ || 11 || vāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu hradaprasravaṇeṣu ca || yatra kāle raṭantyāpaḥ kampayantyaḥ purīṃ mahat || 12 || tasmiṃstvaṃ śiśire kāle kṛtvā gṛhavare svake || prāveśayatu vidhinā śilpibhiryantra nirmitaiḥ || 13 || dharmeṇa pālayankṣoṇīṃ vasa rājīvalocana || hṛdi kāryastvayā dharmo nityameva narottama || 14 || uttiṣṭha śīghraṃ vijayāya gaccha dīptāṃ śriyaṃ prāpnuhi rājaputra || rakṣantu devāstava sarvakālaṃ padaṃ vidhatsvārigaṇasya mūrdhni || 15 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu śatrughnaṃ prati rāmānuśāsane lavaṇaṃ prati śatrughnaprasthānaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 246 || <1.247> || nāḍāyana uvāca || || iti rāmavacaḥ śrutvā bāḍhamuktvā sa satvaraḥ || abhivādya vasiṣṭhasya pādau rāmasya cāpyatha || 1 || puraskṛtya mahābhāgānbhārgavapramukhānṛṣīn || yathoktasenyānugataḥ prayayau bhīmavikramaḥ || 2 || vālmīkerāśramaṃ prāpya tāmuvāsa tadā niśām || pūjayitvā tu vālmīkimṛṣiṇā pratipūjitaḥ || 3 || yasminnahani śatrughno vālmīkerāśramaṃ gataḥ || ubhau prasūtau tanayau tasminnevāhni jānakī || 4 || sītāprasavasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ krameṇa raghunandanaḥ || nidāghaśeṣeṇa nadīmuttatāra sa sūryajām || 5 || śibiraṃ samavasthāpya yathāvadyamunātaṭe || eka eva dhanuṣpāṇiḥ praviveśa madhorvanam || || 6 || praviśya ca yudhā tatra lavaṇasya niveśanam || tasthau dvāramathāśritya vīro vitatakārmukaḥ || 7 || etasminneva kāle tu mṛgānhatvā sahasraśaḥ || bahunā mṛgabhāreṇa sa dadarśa madhoḥ sutam || 8 || vṛttākṣamutkaṭaṃ bhīmaṃ dantotkṛttottaracchadam || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ daṃtivatparuṣacchavim || 9 || sa tu dṛṣṭvaiva śatrughnamuvāca paruṣaṃ bahu || vipradhāvata duṣṭātmā śatrughnavadhakāmyayā || 1.247.10 || tyaktvā mṛgasahasrāṇi drumavikṣepatatparaḥ || drumavṛṣṭiṃ sughorāṃ tāṃ lavaṇena visarjitām || 11 || ciccheda bāṇaiḥ saumitriḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || chinne drumamahāvarṣe lavaṇaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ || 12 || jaghāna suraśatrughnaṃ śatrughnaṃ muṣṭinā bhṛśam || muṣṭiprahāraniśceṣṭaṃ śatrughnaṃ lavaṇastadā || 13 || na jagrāha ca tacchūlaṃ mṛtyupāśavaśaṅgataḥ || praveśayāmāsa gṛhaṃ mṛgasaṃghānanekaśaḥ || 14 || etasminneva kāle tu labdhasaṃjñaḥ sa rāghavaḥ || vitatya kārmukaṃ tasthau dvāramāvṛtya veśmanaḥ || 15 || tataḥ pādapavarṣeṇa cchādayantaṃ niśācaram || cakāra vimukhaṃ bāṇaiśchittvāśchittvā mahīruhān || 16 || rāmadattaṃ tato bāṇaṃ sandhāya varakārmuke || nirbibheda mahātejā lavaṇaṃ raghunandanaḥ ||17|| sandhīyamāne bāṇe tu trastaṃ tribhuvanaṃ tadā || āśvāsayāmāsa vibhurbrahmā kamalasambhavaḥ ||18|| tena bāṇaprahāreṇa nirbhinnahṛdayaḥ kṣitau || vyasuḥ papāta medinyāṃ śailo vajrāhato yathā || 19 || tasminnipatite bhūmau daitye devabhayaṅkare || trailokyaṃ vigatātaṅkaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata || 1.247.20 || taṃ ca deśamathājagmuḥ surāḥ sabrahmakāstadā || pūjitāstena vīreṇa śatrughnaṃ vākyamabruvan || 21 || || devā ūcuḥ || varaṃ varaya śatrughna yatte manasi kāṃkṣitam || apanītaṃ tvayāsmākaṃ bhayaṃ śūlavarāyudhāt || 22 || tvayā tu nihate tasmim̐llavaṇe pāparākṣase || paśya śūlavaraṃ yāṃtamenaṃ śārvaṃ vihāyasā || 23 || || śatrughna uvāca || || asmindeśe kariṣyāmi purīṃ rāmājñayā tvaham || māse samāpyatāṃ śīghraṃ varametatpradīyatām || 24 || || devā ūcuḥ || || niṣpattiṃ yāsyate dhīra sthirā caiva bhaviṣyati || puṇyā ca ramaṇīyā ca mathurā nāmataḥ śubhā || 25 || || nāḍāyana uvāca || || evamuktvā surāḥ sarve jagmurnākamataṃdritāḥ || ājagāma sa taṃ deśaṃ sainyena cyavanaḥ saha || 26 || saṃvarddhayitvā śatrughnaṃ jagāmāśramamaṃjasā || sarvaṃ rāmavacaścakre śatrughno'pi mahāyaśāḥ || 27 || kṛtvā purīniveśaṃ ca gṛhaprāveśanaṃ tathā || uṣitvā dvādaśa samāḥ samprāpte surakarmaṇi || 28 || jagāma bhrātaraṃ draṣṭuṃ vālmīkerāśramaṃ punaḥ || tatra śuśrāva dharmātmā śubhāṃ rāmakathāṃ kṛtām || 29 || vālmīkinā prahṛṣṭena gīyamānāṃ kuśīlavaiḥ || tatroṣya rajanīmekāṃ rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathaiva ca || 1.247.30 || tatroṣya pañcarātraṃ ca bhūyo rāmavisarjitaḥ || mathurāyāṃ ca vasudhāṃ pālayāmāsa dharmavit || 31 || evaṃvidhaḥ sa śatrughno bharato'pyadhikastataḥ || mā tena vigrahaṃ gaccha bharatena mahātmanā || ajeyā raghavo yeṣāṃ sahāyā vānarottamāḥ ||32|| sugrīvanīlāṅgadavāyuputrasuṣeṇamaindadvividapradhānāḥ || mahābalāḥ parvatamātrakāyāḥ surāsurairyuddhagatā ajeyāḥ || || 33 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu lavaṇavadho nāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 247 || <1.248> || śailūṣa uvāca || || pulahasya prajāsargaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || yasya vaṃśe samutpannā vānarā baladarpitāḥ || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || || mṛgā ca mṛgamaṃdā ca haristāmrā tathā irā || bhūtā ca kapiśā daṃṣṭrī surasā saramā tathā||2|| kaśyapo janayāmāsa krodhāttu daśa kanyakāḥ || kaśyapena ca tā dattāḥ pulahāya mahātmane || 3 || prajāstāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāsāṃ tvaṃ nibodha me || mṛgāyāstu mṛgā jātā hariṇaiṇāḥ śaśāstathā|| 4 || rurava pṛṣataścaiva nyaṅkavaḥ śaśakāstathā || sṛmarā mṛgamaṃdāyā gavayā mahiṣāstathā||5|| camaroṣṭravarāhāśca khaḍgā gaurakharāstathā || haryāśca vānarā jātā golāṅgūlā sakinnarāḥ || 6 || maṇḍūkā nakulāścaiva ye cāpyanye bileśayāḥ || pañca kanyāśca tāmrāyāḥ patnyastā varuṇasya ca || 7 || prādāddharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pulahastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || śyenī bhāsī tathā krauñcī dhṛtarāṣṭrī śukī tathā || 8 || śyenī tu janayāmāsa putraṃ saṃpātinaṃ tathā || jaṭāyuṣaṃ ca rājānaṃ gṛdhrāṇāṃ baladarpitam || 9 || saṃpātī janayāmāsa śyenagṛdhravaṭāṃstathā || bhāsīputrāḥ smṛtā bhāṇāḥ krauñcāḥ krauñcīsutāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.248.10 || dhṛtarāṣṭrīsutā haṃsā dhārttarāṣṭrāstathaiva ca || cakravākamukhāścānye tathā ye jalacāriṇaḥ || 11 || śukīputrāḥ śukā jñeyāḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi kīrtitāḥ || kaśyapasya tu yā patnī irā nāma prakīrtitā || 12 || kuñjaraṃ janayāmāsa surakāryodyataṃ sadā || bhūtāputrāstathā bhūtā mahādevamanuvratāḥ || 13 || upavīrolūkhalikā āsyakarṇā kuṣaṇḍikā || pāṃsavaḥ pāṇipātrāśca caitanyāni punastathā || 14 || sūcīmukhā śoṣaṇikāḥ kulānyetāni ṣoḍaśa || kuleṣvetepu jāyante nānākāraviceṣṭitāḥ || 35|| niṣkuṭeṣu pratolīṣu catvareṣu guhāsu ca || teṣāṃ prādāttadā sthānamantardhānaṃ pratāpitāḥ || 16 || aṇimā laghimā prāptiryatra kāmāvasāyitā || daṃṣṭrīputrāstathāloke daṃṣṭriṇo ye prakīrtitāḥ || 17 || saramāyāstathā sarpāḥ kīṭajātyaśca sarvaśaḥ || śyāmaśca dhavalaścaiva sārameyau tathā śunau || 18 || yamasyānucarau tau ca mahābalaparākramau || iti krodhāduhitṝṇāṃ prajātiḥ kīrtitā mayā|| 19 || kaśyapasya tu yā patnī surabhirnāma viśrutā || kanīyasaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ tasyāsīdduhitṛdvayam || 1.248.20 || rohiṇī caiva bhadraṃ te gandharvī ca mahīpate || pulahāyaiva te datte kaśyapena mahātmanā || 21 || surupā hemarūpā ca sarvakāmadughā tathā || rohiṇyāṃ janayāmāsa pulahaḥ sa mahātapāḥ || 22 || brahmacaryavratāstāstu dhenavo daśa kīrtitāḥ || mānasī tu prajā tāsāṃ yathāsaṃkhyena me śṛṇu || 23 || gāvaścaiva mahiṣyaśca ajāścaivāvayastathā || gandharvī janayāmāsa turagānvātaraṃhasaḥ || 24 || garuḍī ca mayūrī ca dve tu kanye manorame || pulahena tu te datte garuḍāya mahātmane || 25 || garuḍī janayāmāsa suparṇānbhīmavikramān || mayūrī janayāmāsa mayūrādyānvihaṅgamān || 26 || garuḍānvayasambhūtāḥ sarve pannagabhojinaḥ || pakṣiṇastu vayā jñeyāḥ suparṇāngaruḍāñchṛṇu || 27 || suvarṇacūḍo nāgaśca dāruṇaścūḍatuṇḍakaḥ || anilaścānalaścaiva viśālākṣo'tha kuṇḍalī || 28 || karkaśo dhvajaviṣkambhī vinato vāmanastathā || vātavego diśācakṣu rnimiṣo'nimiṣastathā || 29 || trivāraḥ saptavāraśca vālmīkirvipukistathā || daityadvīpaḥ sariddvīpaḥ sārasaḥ padmaketanaḥ || 1.248.30 || sumukhaścitraketuśca citrabarhastathānagha || meghaḥ satkumudo dakṣaḥ sarvabhuksāmabhojanaḥ || 31 || gurubhāraḥ kapotaśca pūrvanetraścirātakaḥ || viṣṇugandhāḥ kumāraśca paribarho harastathā || 32 || aśvāmbaro madhuparkaśca hemavarṇastathaiva ca || malayo mātariśvā ca niśākaradivākarge || 33 || ete pradeśamātreṇa mayoktā garuḍātmajāḥ || kulametatsuparṇānāṃ dhanyānāṃ nṛpasattama || 34 || sarva ete śriyā yuktāḥ sarve śrīvatsalakṣaṇāḥ || kulametaddhi śailūṣa ślādhyaṃ viṣṇuparigraham || 35 || daivataṃ viṣṇureteṣāṃ viṣṇureva parāyaṇam || hṛdi yeṣāṃ sadā viṣṇurviṣṇuryeṣāṃ parā gatiḥ || || 36 || etattavoktaṃ pulahasya vaṃśaṃ putraiḥ sutābhiśca samanvitaṃ yat || vaṃśe tu sarvottamavīryayuktā jātā khagendrā harayaśca vīrāḥ || 37 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu pulahavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadu ttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 248 || <1.249> || vajra uvāca || kathāprasaṅgairbahubhirbhavatā mama kīrtitam || sambhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ||1|| teṣāṃ vikāreṣvācakṣva rājāno mama bhārgava || pālayanti dvijaśreṣṭha sakalaṃ ye jagattrayam || 2 || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || evaṃ prajāsu sṛṣṭāsu svayameva pitāmahaḥ || nikāyeṣunikāyeṣu so'bhyaṣiṃcata pārthivān || 3 || oṣadhīnāṃ dvijātīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva somaṃ rājye 'bhiṣecayat||4|| prajāpatīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ dakṣaṃ prācetasaṃ yathā || valīmukhānāṃ śvetānāmṛkṣāṇāṃ dhūmra eva ca||5|| manaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ ca surastrīṇāṃ ca manmatham || prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā yamam||6|| apāṃ tu varuṇaṃ rājye tathaiva jalavāsināma || yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca pārthivānāṃ dhanasya ca||7|| putraṃ viśravaso jyeṣṭhaṃ kuberaṃ naravāhanam|| vipracittiṃ ca rājānaṃ dānavānāṃ mahābalam||8|| sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ girīśaṃ śūlapāṇinam|| śailānāṃ himavantaṃ ca nimnagānāṃ ca lāvaṇam ||9|| bhārataṃ sarvavarṣāṇāṃ dvīpānāmatha madhyamam || svādūdakaṃ samudrāṇāmaśvatthaṃ sarvaśākhinām || 1.249.10 || karmaṇāṃ vyavasāyaṃ ca meruṃ sarvaśilābhṛtām || gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaṃ garuḍaṃ ca patatriṇām || 11 || uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ govṛṣaṃ ca tathā gavām || suvarṇaṃ sarvaratnānāmoṣadhīnāṃ tathā yavam || 12 || satyalokaṃ ca lokānāṃ pātālānāṃ rasātalam || śāstrāṇāṃ ca yajurvedaṃ sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ || 13 || gāyatrīṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ chandasāṃ ca yadūttama || mṛgāṇāmatha śārdūlaṃ pannagānāñca takṣakam || 14 || airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ dharmaṃ sarvasukhasya ca || vāsukiṃ sarvanāgānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathā bhṛgum || 15 || vidyādharāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm || utpātānāṃ tathā rāhuṃ grahāṇāṃ ca divākaram || 16 || kālasyāvayavañcaiva kālaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā || vyādhīnāṃ ca jvaraṃ rājye nṛṇāmarkaniśākarau || 17 || abhiṣikto narendrendra brahmaṇā svayameva hi || bhārate'sminpurā varṣe prāpte vaivasvatentare || 18 || tasmādadyāpi ca tayoraṃśajātāśca pārthivāḥ || tato'bhiṣikto devānāṃ rājye devaḥ śatakratuḥ || saṃbhūya rājabhiḥ sarvaistrailokyapatirūrjitaḥ || 19|| vajra uvāca || rājye'bhiṣiktaḥ sa kathaṃ mahātmā sambhūya sarvaistridaśāriharttā || etanmamācakṣva bhṛgupradhāna bhaktirmameyaṃ tridaśendraśatrau||1.249.20|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye pratisamūhe rājakīrtanaṃ nāmaikona ṇñcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 249 || <1.250> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sumerau parvataśreṣṭhe nānāratnojvalatviṣi || prajāpatirathādāya rājasaṃghānprakīrtitān || 1 || abhyaṣiñcata devānāṃ rājye kaśyapanandanam || tejasvinamathādityaṃ jajñe nirdhūtakalmaṣam || 2 || tasyābhiṣeke pradadau viśvakarmā manoharam || ratnojjvalaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ kāmarūpadharaṃ śubham||0|| atraivamupadiśyātha svayaṃ brahmā jagadguruḥ || abhyaṣiñcata devānāmādhipatye śatakratum ||4|| brahmā viṣṇuśca śambhuśca sādhyāśca samarudgaṇāḥ|| ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ|| 5 || bhṛgavo'ṅgirasaḥ sādhyā aśvinau ca bhiṣagvarau || ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstraikālyāmaladarśinaḥ||6|| yāni toyānyupādāya samudraḥ saritastathā || sarāṃsi ca satīrthāni gandharvāpsarasastathā ||7|| tasyendumaṇḍalākāraṃ chatraṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ || śvetau ca bālavyajanau tathā candradivākarau || 8 || bhṛṅgāraṃ yādasāṃ bhartā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ || menakā caiva raṃbhā ca tālavṛntau manoharau || 9 || vidhivacca juhāvāgniṃ devācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ || tatastasya dadau prītyā vāhanārthe madotkaṭam || 1.250.10 || airāvaṇaṃ caturdantaṃ nāgaṃ ca pulahaḥ svayam || pulahaḥ svasutaṃ prādācchvetaṃ turagameva ca || 11 || turagāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca harīṇāṃ vātaraṃhasām || śriyā dattaṃ tataḥ prītyā rathavāhanamuttamam || 12 || tamagniryojayāmāsa kāñcanena rathena ca || indrāyudhasavarṇābhiḥ patākābhiranantaram || 13 || vāyustaṃ yojayāmāsa dhvajaṃ nāgena śaṅkaraḥ || babandha mukuṭaṃ tasya svayaṃ brahmā jagadguruḥ || 14 || upānahau dadau tasya virūpākṣastathānagha || khaḍgaśca vimalodattastasya śukreṇa yādava || 15 || candanāni ca mukhyāni gandhāni vividhāni ca || himālayaḥ svayaṃ tasya prādāllokagururguruḥ || 16 || ratnāni suvicitrāṇi samudraḥ svayameva hi || daduśca ṛtavastasya puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca || 17 || nanṛtudevagandharvā jaguścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || hṛṣṭaṃ pramuditaṃ cāsīttrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 18 || sarvagandhānupādāya surabhirmāruto vavau || mahatā sa varaughena tarpayitvā bṛhaspatim || 19 || varaughaistarpayāmāsa sarvāneva dvijottamān || saptāhaṃ mānasīṃ siddhiṃ prādātsarveṣu jantuṣu || 1.250.20 || vyādhimṛtyujarāśokavinivṛttā jagattrayī || saptāhaṃ narakasthānāṃ naiva sarvāśca yātanāḥ ||
