21 || sarvaṃ muditamevāsīttrailokyaṃ sacarācaram || kirīṭī svanuliptāṅgaḥ kuṇḍalottamabhūṣitaḥ || 22 || kauśeyavasanastatra śvetamālyavibhūṣaṇaḥ || śriyaṃ dadhāra somasya śvetasthasya śatakratuḥ || 23 || bhadrāsanagataṃ śakraṃ praṇemuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || khyāpyamāno mahārāja tadā devena daṇḍinā || 24 || ṛṣayastuṣṭuvustaṃ ca gandharvāpsarasastathā || maṅgalālaṃbhanaṃ cakre tataḥ śakraḥ surārihā || 25 || pūrṇakumbhaṃ sumanaso ratnānyājyaṃ tathā dadhi || phalāni śrīphalaṃ caiva udbhṛtāni vasuṃdharā || 26 || svastikānrucirāṃścaiva nandyāvartāṃśca kāñcanam || kāṃcanollikhitāścaiva yāśca mukhyāḥ saridvarāḥ || 27 || udagdānaṃ tathā dūrvāṃ darpaṇaṃ cājyameva ca || dharmaḥ satyaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca balaṃ ca yadunandana || 28 || upāsanta mahābhāgaṃ saśarīrāḥ śatakratum || kāṃtirlakṣmīrdhṛtiḥ śraddhā puṣṭirmedhā kriyā matiḥ || 29 || buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntiranasūyā tathaiva ca || upāsanta tadā devaṃ sarvarājeśvaraṃ vibhuma || 1.250.30 || tato vavande pitaraṃ mātaraṃ śaṅkaraṃ harim || brahmāṇaṃ varadaṃ saumyamṛṣīṃśca yadunandana || 31 || tato rathena śukreṇa sa tu mātaliyaṃtriṇā || vināśayāmāsa raṇe devatānāmarātayaḥ || 32 || pālayāmāsa sakalaṃ tathaiva ca jagattrayam || śakrābhiṣekametatte kathitaṃ yadunandana || 33 || śrotavyamabhiṣekaṃ tu yātrākāleṣu cāpyatha ||| gṛhapraveśe vaivāhye puṇyāheṣu pareṣu ca || 34 || etatpavitraṃ maṅgalyaṃ dhanyaṃ śrutisukhāvaham || pāpmālakṣmīpraśamanaṃ duḥsvapnakilbiṣāpaham || 39 ||| puṇyāhakāleṣu narendracandra śrutvābhiṣekaṃ balasūdanasya || dharmārthakāmānpuruṣā labhante vyādhipraṇāśaṃ ca yaśastathāgryam || 36 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śakrābhiṣeko nāma pañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 250 || <1.251> vajra uvāca || pulahasya prajāsargaṃ śrutvā gandharvarāṭ tadā || papraccha kiṃ tadā bhūyastatra nāḍāyanaṃ dvijam || 1 || śrotrāmṛtaṃ kathayato nandasyāpi tavānagha || tvaṃ hi jñānanidhirvipraiḥ procyase vedapāragaiḥ ||2|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || pulahasya prajāsargaṃ śrutvā gandharvasattamaḥ || bhūyaḥ papraccha taṃ vipraṃ gajotpattiṃ savistarām ||3|| śailūṣa uvāca || kuñjarāṇāṃ samutpattiṃ śrotumicchāmi vistarāt || kuñjarā hi mahābhāga bhṛśaṃ ca dayitā mama ||4|| nāḍāyana uvāca || yadā prasūtā mārttaṇḍamaditirbhāskarāraṇiḥ || 5 || tadā tadaṇḍamutpādya dṛṣṭavānkaśyapaḥ svayam || tejo'dhikatvādaṃḍasthaṃ nāpaśyata yadā śiśum || || 6|| uvāca devyā aṇḍe'sminkimasau bālako mṛtaḥ || tataḥ sa bhāsaḥ sakalaṃ tejasā bhāsayajjagata ||7|| tena mārttāṇḍatāthāsya kathitā dvija sattamaiḥ || tatastvaṇḍakapāle dve gṛhītvā tu prajāpatiḥ||8|| pṛthakpṛthagavasthāpya rathantaramagāyata || mandaḥ praveśayāmāsa irāyāstau prajepsayā || 9|| udare pulahāntena janayāmāsa sā gajān || aṣṭau mahāvalānnāgāṃsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 1.251.10 || airāvaṇastathā padmaḥ puṣpadantaśca vāmanaḥ || sapratīkoñjano nīlaḥ kumudaśca mataṅgajaḥ || 11 || śakrādyānāṃ digīśānāṃ yathāsaṃkhyena vāhanāḥ || catvāro jātayasteṣāmekaikasyānvaye smṛtāḥ || 12 || bhadrā mandā mṛgā caiva saṃkīrṇā ca janādhipa || bhadrā śreṣṭhā bhavettāsāṃ mandā madhyā kanīyasī || 13 || mṛgā jñeyā ca bāhulyātsaṃ kīrṇā pārthivottama || bhadramandamṛgāṇāṃ ca tathā vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 14 || saṃkīrṇānāṃ ca saṃkīrṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavitā tathā || gūḍhoṣṭhamastakaḥ svakṣaḥ pṛthvāyatamukhāṅguliḥ ||15|| udagraścograsattvaśca samasādhyo mahākarī || tāmratālvīkṣaṇaḥ snigdhaḥ sahiṣṇuḥ svāsanastathā ||16|| anvarthavedī balavānbhadro jñeyo mataṅgajaḥ || gambhīravedī niḥśaṅkastīkṣṇasādhyo mahodaraḥ || 17 || dīrghameḍhrāṅguliścaiva suvibhaktaśirodharaḥ || sthiraḥ kacabalasthūlo dīrghabāladhipuṣkaraḥ || 18 || haryakṣaḥ sūkṣmanābhiśca mando jñeyo mataṅgujaḥ || hrasvaḥ śuṣkavaṭuhanurbhīrrurbahvāśanastathā || 19 || hrasvoptanakhī durmedhā yūthasyānucarastathā || dīrghajihvaviṣāṇaśca dīrghakakṣāsanastathā || 1.251.20 || kleśākṣamaśca dīrghāśī mṛgo jñeyo mataṅgajaḥ || saṃkīrṇalakṣaṇo nāgaḥ saṃkīrṇaśca nigadyate || 21 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi gajānāṃ te vanāṣṭakam || himavatprayāgalauhitya gaṅgāmadhye mahadvanam || 22 || prācyāme rāvaṇasyoktaṃ vanaṃ yatra mataṅgajāḥ || kiñcitkamalavarṇābhāścapalāḥ pṛthumastakāḥ || 23 || kunakhā rūpavantaśca tathā mandamadāgajāḥ || unmattagaṅgā stripurī daśārṇaṃ mekalāstathā ||24|| teṣāṃ madhye karūṣākhyaṃ vanaṃ padmasya kīrtitam || hrasvāścaṇḍāstathā śyāmāḥ śītrodagramahāsvanāḥ||25|| sūkṣma binducitāstatra bhavantyatyarthavedinaḥ|| bilvaśailaṃ vetravatī daśārṇaṃ ca mahāgirim||26|| teṣāṃ daśārṇakaṃ madhye puṣpadantasya kānanam || savṛttajaghanaśyā māḥ sūkṣmabinduvicitritāḥ||27|| sthūlahastaśirogrīvāstatra jātā mataṅgajāḥ|| pāriyātrakavaideśyanarmadābrahmavardhanam ||28|| vāmanasya vanaṃ madhye teṣāṃ vai mārgareyakam|| supramāṇāśca madhyākṣāḥ śīghragāśca suvigrahāḥ||29|| kareṇunāmadheyāśca tatroktāśca sugandhinaḥ|| vindhyasahyotkalānāṃ ca dakṣiṇasyārṇavasya ca||1.251.30|| vanaṃ ca madhye kāleśaṃ supratīkasya kīrttitam || cāpavaṃśāvṛtanakhāḥ pīnahrasvaśirodharāḥ || 31 || tanutvaguttarā dīrghāḥ padmābhāstatra dantinaḥ|| sevādeśaḥ samudraśca premahāraṃ ca narmadā ||32|| teṣāṃ madhyeñjanākhyasya vanaṃ khalvaparāntakam || pīnāyataviṣāṇāsyā mahākāyā balādhikāḥ || ||33|| raktatālvoṣṭhajihvāśca jāyante tatra dantinaḥ || kuśasthalī mahīpāla avantyarbudanarmadāḥ||34|| teṣāṃ madhye tu saurāṣṭraṃ vanaṃ nīlasya kīrttitam|| tasya vaṃśe tu jāyante caṇḍāścaivālpadehakāḥ || 35 || sūkṣmarūkṣatvaco vyālāstathā śikṣātyajā gajāḥ || himavatkālikāsindhakurujāṅgalameva ca|| || 36 || teṣāṃ pañcanadaṃ madhye kumudasya mahadvanam || sphuṭitāgradvijāstatra jāyante malavidviṣaḥ || 37 || dānaśīlāśca bhūtāśca durvidheyāśca vāraṇāḥ ||38|| etattavoktaṃ tu mataṅgajānāṃ kulāṣṭakaṃ caiva vanāṣṭakaṃ ca || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa || 39 || iti śrī viṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākyeṣu gajotpattirnāmaikapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 251 || <1.252> śailūṣa uvāca || || vistareṇa samācakṣva vānarāṇāṃ tu saṃbhavam || alaṃkṛta ivābhāti yairvaṃśaḥ pulahasya ca || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || kāśyapeyī harirnāma yā bhāryā pulahasya ca || pulahājjanayāmāsa śvetaṃ nāma valīmukham || 2 || śvetastadordhvadṛṣṭiṃ ca janayāmāsa vānaram || ūrdhvadṛṣṭistathā vyāghraṃ vyāghraśca śarabhaṃ tathā||3|| śarabhaśca tathārkṣaṃ ca siṃhamṛkṣaśca vānaram || ṛkṣī ca janayāmāsa ṛkṣāṃścaiva janādhipa||4|| vānarāṃśca mahākā yāñśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || yeṣāmanvayasambhūtā devaputrā mahābalāḥ ||5|| utpannā rāmasāhāyye rāvaṇasya vadhaiṣiṇaḥ || ṛkṣasya bhaginī ṛkṣī prajāpatisutāvubhau || 6 || dhūmraṃ ca jāmbavantaṃ ca janayāmāsa ṛkṣajau || jāmbavāñjanayāmāsa mārjāraṃ bhīmavikramam || 7 || mārjārasya ca mārjārā kule jātā mahābalāḥ || ṛkṣasya vānarendrasya duhitāṃ mānasīṃ svayam || 8 || dadau prajāpatiḥ śrīmānrūpayauvanasaṃyutām || kāmayāmāsa tāṃ śakrastato vālirajāyata || 9 || tāmeva kāmayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ svayameva tu || sugrīvaṃ janayāmāsa bhāskarātsā sumadhyamā || 1.252.10 || tatra vānararājo'bhūdvālirvikrāntapauruṣaḥ || yastu rāmeṇa nihataḥ sugrīvastvabhiṣecitaḥ || 11 || tasyāsanvaśagāḥ sarve vānarā devayonayaḥ || vāliputro'ṅgado nāma hanumānvāyunandanaḥ || 12 || nīlo vahnisutaḥ śrīmānviśvakarmasuto nalaḥ || dharmaputraḥ suṣeṇaśca ṛṣabho garuḍātmajaḥ || 13 || dvāvaśvina sutau vīrau maindo dvivida eva ca || dhūmraśca jāmbavāṃścaiva vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ || 14 || mṛtyoḥ putrā mahāvīryā mṛtyutulyaparākramāḥ || gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ || 15 || yamasya tanayāḥ pañca golāṃgūlā mahābalāḥ || śveto jyotirmukhaścānyo bhāskarasyātmajāvubhau || 16 || varuṇasyāvaraḥ putro hemakūṭaḥ pratāpavān || devaputrāstathaivānye ṛkṣagopucchavānarāḥ || 17 || śatasāhasrayūthānāṃ rājāno bhīmavikramāḥ || himavanmerunilayāḥ śvetanīlanivāsinaḥ || 18 || śṛṅgavanmālyavadvindhyaṛkṣavantanivāsinaḥ || ye vasanti sadā sahye ṛṣabhe gandhamādane || 19 || sāgarānūpaparyante tathā dvīpeṣu saptasu || brahmaṇyā balavanta śūrā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || 1.252.20 || nītiśāstreṣu kuśalāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || sunītāḥ sattvavantaśca dṛptā nītigrahe ratāḥ || 21 || sakhāyo rāmabhadrasya rāvaṇasya vadhaiṣiṇaḥ || hastivānarasaṃgrāme purā rudhirakardame || 22 || girikūṭanibhā nāgā vijitā yaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || sahāyā rāmabhadrasya te vīrā bharatasya ca || mā gaccha saṃyugaṃ tasmādbharatena mahātmanā || 23 || sarvāstravijñānaviśāradena saṃgrāmaśauṇḍena jitendriyeṇa || dharmācca rāmasya parāyaṇena śakrādhikena tvatipauruṣeṇa || 24 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyana vākyeṣu vānarotpattirnāma dvipañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 252 || <1.253> || śailūṣa uvāca || kiṃnimittamabhūdvairaṃ vānarāṇāṃ tu kuñjaraiḥ || kīdṛśaṃ cābhavadyuddhaṃ tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || nāḍāyana uvāca || vanāṣṭakaṃ karīndrāṇāṃ yanmayoktaṃ purā tava || taduktaṃ bhāratādvarṣādbhāgasya navamasya ca || 2 || dvīpeṣu rājansarveṣu varṣeṣu ca pṛthakpṛthak || vaneṣu nivasantyete karīndrā vānarāstathā || 3 || rakṣanti vānarāstatra kānaneṣu ca śākhinaḥ || pātayanti drumānnāgā līlayaiva janādhipa || 4 || drumeṣu pātyamāneṣu kuñjarāṇāṃ tarasvinām || vānarāḥ kadanaṃ cakuḥ krodhāviṣṭāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 5 || hanyamāneṣu nāgeṣu karīndrāśca valīmukhān || pātayanti mahārāja śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 6 || evaṃ pravṛddhe vaire tu vānaraiḥ kuñjaraistathā || rājñe niveditaṃ gatvā ṛkṣairāvaṇayostadā ||7|| tatastau pārthivau kruddhau cakraturyatnamuttamam || vānarāstu mahākāyā vīrāḥ paramaraṃhasaḥ ||8|| ṛkṣāścaiva sagopucchāḥ kiṣkindhāṃ punarāgatāḥ || airāvaṇājñāṃ ye nāgāḥ sapakṣāḥ parvatottamāḥ || 9 || prācyāṃ vanamathājagmuḥ sarvataḥ pṛthivīpate || balārṇavāvubhau kṣubdhau krodhāviṣṭau parasparam || 1.253.10 || antarvedī tadā tau tu jagmaturbaladarpitau || tataḥ prāvartata raṇaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam || 11 || bhūmau caivāntarikṣe ca nāgānāṃ saha vānaraiḥ || drumaprahārābhihatāḥ kuñjarā vānarottamaiḥ || 12 || patanto gaganādbhūmiṃ cālayanti muhurmuhuḥ || khureṣu vānaraṃ gṛhya dvau nāgau gagane tathā || 13 || pātayanti mahārāja bhindanti daśanaistathā || mamanthurapare pādairdehenātāḍayam̐stathā || 14 || vṛkṣānkarairathonmūlya cukṣubhuryena vānarāḥ || airāvaṇena nihatāḥ koṭiśastatra vānarāḥ || 15 || padmena supratīkena vāmanenāñjanena ca || kumudena ca nīlena puṣpadantena cāpyatha || 16 || teṣāmanvayasambhūtaistathaivānyaiśca kuñjaraiḥ || bhadreṇa cātha mandena mṛgeṇa ca mahīpate || 17 || bhadramandena miśreṇa sārvabhaumena vedhasā || rājñā sumanasā rājaṃstathaiva ca suvarcasā || 18 || balāhakena mattena bhīmenendīvareṇa ca || hemakūṭena kūṭena śaṃkhena niṣadhena ca || 19 || śvetena rājanraktena kāñcanenāṃṅga supraja || virūpākṣeṇa cogreṇa ṣaḍdantenāsitena ca || 1.253.20 || caturdantena yakṣeṇa rakṣasā bhīmamālinā || ṛkṣeṇa vānarendreṇa koṭiśaḥ kuñjarā hatāḥ || 21 || śarabheṇa gavākṣeṇa tathā kanakabindunā|| ṛkṣarājena dhūmreṇa tathā jāmbavatā nṛpa ||22 || suṣeṇadadhivaktrābhyāṃ tathā kesariṇā raṇe || raṇacaṇḍena vīreṇa vānarendreṇa jānunā || 23 || tathā śatabaliryaśca tenāpi kadanaṃ kṛtam || panasena viśālena gajena gavayena ca ||24|| hemakūṭena vibhunā bhānuromṇā niśābhṛtā || gandhamādananāmnā ca vijayena jayena ca ||25|| kumudenātha padmena kanakākṣeṇa śambhunā || ityevaṃ dṛśyamāneṣu vānareṣu gajeṣu ca ||26|| cacāla medinī rājam̐stasminkāle muhurmuhuḥ || khasthairbhūsthaiśca vikrāntairvānaraiḥ kuñjaraistathā || 27 || hataiśca hanyamānaiśca ghoramāyodhanaṃ babhau || śarīrairyatra saṃruddhā sravanto rudhirāpagāḥ || 28 || vānarāṇāṃ gajānāṃ ca mahāśailopamairnṛpa || tasmiṃstathāvidhe yuddhe gajavānarasaṃkṣaye || 29 || ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ svayaṃ devaḥ śatakratuḥ || abhyetya vārayāmāsa vānarām̐ścaiva kuñjarān || 1.253.30 || tataśca vānarāḥ sarve śakragauravayantritāḥ || saṃnyavartanta saṃgrāmātprahvāḥ prāñjalayaḥ sthitāḥ || 31 || tyaktayuddhānraṇe jaghnurvānarānkuñjarāṃstathā || kuddhasteṣāṃ mahendrastu vajreṇa śataparvaṇā || 32 || pakṣām̐ściccheda nāgānāṃ nihatā yairvalīmukhāḥ || chinnapakṣām̐stadā nāgānvāhanārthaṃ mahītale || 33 || pradadau lomapādāya tadāṅgeśāya pārthiva || lomapādo'pi nṛpatistadā teṣāṃ cikitsitam || 34 || śikṣāṃ svastyayanaṃ caiva cakre sūtranibandhanam || tataḥ prabhṛti loke'sminvāhanatvaṃ gatā gajāḥ || 35 || gurviṇībhirvanasthābhiḥ kariṇībhirjaneśvara || vane vivardhitā vaṃśāḥ kuñjarāṇāṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 36 || vaneṣvapi tadā jātā vipakṣāḥ kuñjarottamāḥ || chinnapakṣeṣu jāteṣu prabhāveṇa śatakratoḥ || 37 || vānarāśca jayaṃ labdhvā praṇipatya purandaram || sthānāni jagmuḥ svānyeva rājñā ṛkṣeṇa pūjitāḥ || 38 || evaṃvidhairabhūtteṣāṃ vānarāṇāṃ tu kuñjaraiḥ || yuddhamāsīnmahāghoraṃ vijitā yatra kuñjarāḥ || 39 || vānarāśca mahābhāgā vānarendrapramardanāḥ || daivayogena vijite bharate'pi yadṛcchayā || kṣipramevoddhariṣyanti tvāṃ sametya sabāndhavam || 1.253.40 || tasmānna yuddhaṃ mama rocate te raghūdvahenāpratimena rājan || nayātmanā ca pratipūruṣeṇa dharmābhirāmeṇa janapriyeṇa || 41 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣaṃ prati nāḍāyanavākye gajavānarayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 253 || <1.254> śailūṣa uvāca || śrutametanmayā sarvaṃ yattvayoktaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || praṇipātamahaṃ kartuṃ na śakto bharatāya tu ||1|| udyacchedeva na namedudyamaścaiva pauruṣam || adya sarvanirudyogaṃ na name ceha kasyacit || 2 || atikleśena ye'rthāḥ syurdharmasyātikrameṇa ca || arervā praṇipātena māsma teṣu manaḥ kṛthāḥ || 3 || ājñāphalaṃ yadā rājyaṃ praṇipatya tadā param || kiṃ no rājyena karttavyaṃ sāmānyajanadharmiṇā || 4 || praṇipatya naraḥ śatruṃ mānī śauṇḍīryavarjitaḥ || kathaṃ śaknotyavasthātuṃ bhāryādṛgviṣayeṣvapi || 5 || arervā praṇipātasya saṃgrāme maraṇasya ca || yadantaraṃ tadbhavati brahmahatyāśvamedhayoḥ ||6|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || śailūṣavacanaṃ śrutvā tadā nāḍāyano dvijaḥ || jagāma svagṛhāyaiva hataṃ matvā janeśvaram ||7|| nāḍāyane tadā yāte rājā gandharvasattamān || samāhūyābravītkāścitkāścittatra kṛtāñjalīn || avajñāya naraḥ śatruṃ kṣiprameva vinaśyati || 8 || tasmātkāryamavajñānaṃ na kadācidarātiṣu || kecidayodhyāṃ gacchantu gandharvā baladarpitāḥ || 9 || ānayantu striyaḥ śīghraṃ tatra gatvā ca māyayā || ye mukhyāḥ sainikāstasya bharatasya samatviṣaḥ ||1.254.10|| sainikānāṃ striyasteṣāṃ kṛtvā pramukhato raṇam || evaṃ vimanasāṃ teṣāṃ kartāsmi kadanaṃ mahat || 11 || ghātayiṣyāmi bharataṃ hatasainyamanantaram || śibiraṃ cāpare yāntu bharatasya suvidviṣaḥ || 12 || nighnantu yodhānsaṃsuptānrātrau tasya sahasraśaḥ || hatasainyaṃ haniṣyāmi tato'haṃ bharataṃ raṇe || 13 || rājño gṛhaṃ tathaivānye praviśantu mahābalāḥ || nighnantu tatra saṃsuptānsainikām̐stu yudhājitaḥ || 14 || hatasainyaṃ haniṣyāmi bharataṃ sayudhājitam || adṛśyairmāyayā gatvā gandharvairbaladarpitaiḥ || 15|| yathoktametatkartavyaṃ vacanaṃ mama satvaraiḥ || evamuktāstu gandharvāḥ praṇipatya mahīpatim||16|| rājājñāṃ śirasā''gṛhya jagmustvaritavikramāḥ|| dinaśeṣeṇa saṃprāpya yathoddiṣṭaṃ mahīkṣitā || 17 || vyaceṣṭanniśi rājendra yathājñaptaṃ cikīrṣavaḥ || visarjayitvā gandharvāñśailūṣo'pyatha satvaraḥ||18|| ājñāpayata sainyāni śvo yuddhamiti pārthiva || jagāma cāstaṃ savitā kamalāni viśīlayan || chādite tamasā loke pravṛttā yāminī tathā ||19|| gandharvarājo'pi tadā vijahre strībhiḥ sahāntaḥpurametya sākam || gandharvaputrāśca tathā vijahruḥ śvo yuddhamityeva vivṛddhadarpāḥ || 1.254.20 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gandharvapreṣaṇaṃ nāma catuṣpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 254 || <1.255> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ājñaptā ye tvayodhyāyāṃ gandharvāstena bhūbhujā || ayodhyāṃ te samāsedurniśīthe laghuvikramāḥ || 1 || māyācchannaśarīrāśca viceruste mahīpate || ayodhyāya mahārāja parāñca dadṛśuḥ śriyam || 2 || śaśāṅkakanśubhrāṇi bahubhaumāni yādava || dadṛśurgṛhamukhyāni śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 3 || sarvaratnopapannāni śayanāsanavanti ca || suvarṇadāmacitrāṇi muktājālacitāni ca || 4 || prajvaladbhirmahādīpairdīpitāni samantataḥ || bahumālyāni mukhyāni dīpodgāreṇa pārthiva || 5 || praviṣṭā gṛhamukhyeṣu dadṛśusteṣu mānavān || candanāgurudigdhāṅgānsarvābharaṇabhūṣitān || 6 || krīḍamānānsaha strībhirdivi devagaṇāniva || bharatānugatānāñca sainikānāṃ gṛheṣu ca || 7 || strīṇāṃ bhartṛvihīnānāṃ dadṛśurbalaceṣṭitam || kācinna lebhe śayane nidrāmudbhrāntalocanā || 8 || ākulaṃ śayanaṃ cakre kācidbhūyo vivarttanaiḥ || mṛṇālaśayane kācitkadalīparṇasaṃstare || 9 || candanaṃ candrapādeṣu mṛṇāla valayeṣu ca || kāmāgnināśāśakteṣu kāciccakre tathā ruṣam || 1.255.10 || aśrudhārā nipatitāḥ kāmāgniparīdīpite || ambarīṣe yathā nāśaṃ kasyāścidyāti vakṣasi || 11 || kācinmumoha śayane varṇayantī sakhījane || labdhanidrā tadā daivātkāntasambhogajaṃ sukham || 12 || tālavṛntānilaiḥ śītairvījyamānā sakhījanaiḥ || dahyatābhyadhikaṃ kācitsvaniḥśvāsavinissṛtaiḥ || 13 || svapne'pi kāntasaṃyogakāriṇyāṃ hi sakhī mama || daivānmayi hatā nidrā sāpi kācidabhāṣata || 14 || keyūrasthānasaṃprāptā varāṅgadavibhūṣaṇā || kāmakṣāmavapuḥ kācijjagāma sakhi śocyatām || 15 || dattadhyānatayā kānte śocyamānā sakhījanaiḥ || avijñānāttathā kācinnābhāṣata sakhījanam || 16|| citrabhittigataṃ kāntaṃ kāciccānimiṣekṣaṇā|| babhūva citranyasteva paśyantī vigatakriyā || 17 || iti gandharvamukhyānāṃ paśyatāṃ rajanīmukhe || nāsītstrīharaṇe śaktiḥ prabhāvādrāghavasya ca||18|| hitecchurāsāṃ sa yadā niviṣṭo deveśvaraścakradharo nṛrūpī || tataḥ prabhāvo na babhūva teṣāṃ hartuṃ striyaścāruśaśāṅkavaktrāḥ || 19 || || iti śrīviṣṇudhamottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde virahiṇīvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 255 || <1.256> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || gandharvāḥ kaṭakaṃ kecidviviśurbharatasya tu || puraskṛtya nṛpasyājñāṃ sainikānāṃ vadhepsavaḥ || 1 || māyācchannaśarīrāste dadṛśurniśi ceṣṭitam || prātaḥ samarakāmānāṃ kāntotkaṇṭhitacetasām || 2 || manoratharathārūḍhaḥ kaścitprāṇeśvarīṃ vrajan || na lebhe śayane nidrāṃ kalye raṇasamutsakaḥ || 3 ||| kaściccandrakarasparśādviśeṣaparipīḍitaḥ || dadarśa candraṃ divyākṣipriyāvadananirjitam || 4 || kaścicca cintayanneva priyāṃ prāṇadhaneśvarīm || uttāna śayanaṃ cakre tārakāgaṇakaṃ divi || 5 || paśyannāniṣkṛtaṃ diśyaṃ patracchedaṃ visarjitam || priyayā svakṛtaṃ kaścinmudā nayati śarvarīm || 6 || nirvedamatiramyeṇa dahyate candraraśmibhiḥ || kaścidvihīnastanvaṅgyā śayanīye'pi khidyate || 7 || svapnopalabdhatanvaṅgisamāgamamanorathaḥ || supto'numito gandharvaiḥ kaścidromāñcasambhavāt || 8 || priyāṃ saṃpreṣitā preṣya samālāpaparāyaṇaḥ || na veda kaścidrājendra gatāmapi vibhāvarīm || 9 || jvalantamaniśaṃ kaściccharīre virahānalam || sahasā śamayāmāsa dhyāyam̐ścandramukhīṃ priyām || 1.256.10 || śyāmāṃ vikañcukāṃ tanvīṃ yūnāṃ prāṇāpahāriṇīm || priyāṃ ca khaḍgayaṣṭiṃ ca kaścitsmarati sūtsukaḥ || 11 || saguṇāṃ tanumadhyāṃ ca navakāñcanabhūṣaṇām || sasmāra dayitāṃ kaściccāpayaṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca ||12|| vicintānapi gandharvā bharatasya ca sainikān || na śekurādharṣayituṃ bharatasya samāśrayāt || 13 || anye'pi ye devavarasya viṣṇoḥ smaraṃti nityaṃ yadunāthapādau || gandharvayakṣāsurarākṣasebhyo bhayaṃ na teṣāṃ bhavatīha kiñcit || 14 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde virahivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 256 || <1.257> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || atha rājagṛhākhyaṃ tu nagaraṃ ye visarjitāḥ || gaṃdharvā dadṛśustatra puraśriyamanuttamām || 1 || candrasāpatnyabhūtāni gṛhamukhyāni sarvaśaḥ || dadṛśurbahuratnāni vahudhānyadhanāni ca || 2 || purodyānāni ramyāṇi dadṛśuśca samantataḥ || alaṃkṛtāni vāpībhirdrumakhaṇḍaiśca yādava || 3 || udyāneṣu vicitreṣu naramukhyānugāminām || paśyanti tatra saṅghāni gaṃdharvāḥ pānapāyinām || 4 || vallakīnāṃ ninādena gītena madhureṇa ca || ekatāmiva saṃyātaṃ cāruṣaṭpadaśiñjitam || 5|| veśyāścaivopanṛtyanti kvacittatra ca kāmukān || kvacitsābharaṇāḥ suptāḥ kāntaiḥ saha madotkaṭāḥ || 6 || suptānāṃ naranārīṇāṃ gandharvāstatra ceṣṭitam || dadṛśurbahudārāṇāṃ māyācchāditavigrahāḥ || 7 || gāyantyanye rudantyanye hasantyanye tathaiva ca|| āśliṣyanti tathaivānye madamattāḥ parasparam || 8 || bhāṣante kecidavyaktaṃ vihvalārtāḥ padepade || śayane bhramamāṇaiśca kvacidasthitadṛṣṭayaḥ || 9 || kāminīskandhavinyastabāhavaśca tathā pare || kalahaṃ cakrire cānye stuvantyanye nirarthakam || 1.257.10 || skhalamānapadā yānti sthānaṃ hṛdyanavasthitam || āhvayanti gaṇānkecitpraṇamanti tathā pare || 11 || evaṃ santajanākīrṇe nagare gītanādite || dadṛśurgṛhamukhyeṣu naranārīviceṣṭitam || 12 || sañcodyamānā dūtībhistvarākṛta mṛjāḥ dhiyaḥ || yānti kāntāsu sambhrāntā madapānasamutsukāḥ || 13 || papuḥ kāścitpriyaiḥ sārdhaṃ pānaṃ madasamīraṇam || pāyayantyaparāḥ kāntānbhojayantyaparāḥ priyān || 14 || prāsādeṣu vicitreṣu tathā vātāyaneṣu ca || ratiśrāntāstathā suptāḥ kāścitkāntaiḥ saha striyaḥ || 15 || kācidgaurī priyaṃ śyāmamāliṅgya śayane sthitā || utpalasragivābhāti yuktā jātisrajā saha ||16|| gaurīgaurasamāśliṣṭā kācidābhāti sundarī|| āliṅgitā candrakaraiścandrakāntaśilā yathā || 17 || śyāmā śyāmasamāśliṣṭā kācidābhāti pārthiva || payodapaṅktirgagane yathā pārthiva sodakā || 18 || alīkasuptamaprauḍhā kāciccumbayate priyam || priyeṇa gāḍhamāśliṣṭā vilakṣamuditābhavat || 19 || kācicca vanitā prauḍhā karpūra rajasā svayam || avākirati kāntāṅgaṃ ratisvedapariplutam || 1.257.20 || paśyemāṃ tārakāṃ candro hyaṅkenāliṅgya tiṣṭhati || ityāha dayitaṃ kācitprauḍhā ratisukhārthinī || 21 || kācidūruparāmarśādviditvā suratārthinī || kāntenāliṅgitā gāḍhaṃ muditena riraṃsunā || 22 || kāntena kāciddaṣṭauṣṭhī cumbanāyārpite mukhe|| na yāsye tava viśvāsaṃ bhūyaścedanyathākṛthāḥ || 23 || kācitprasuptā kāntena parāmṛṣṭā ratārthinī || kāntamāliṅgatātyarthaṃ tyaktanidrā sasambhramā || 24 || ityevamapi viśvastānsainikām̐stānyudhājitaḥ|| hartuṃ na śekurgandharvā bharatasya samāśrayāt || 25 || eṣāṃ pure sannihitaḥ sa viṣṇurmahānubhāvo raghuvaṃśagoptā || teṣāṃ pure nāsti bhayaṃ narendra gandharva yakṣāsurapannagebhyaḥ || 26 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde niśopabhogavarṇano nāma saptapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 257 || <1.258> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ayodhyātastadābhyetya gandharvāḥ śibirāttathā || tathā rājagṛhātsarve śailūṣāya nyavedayan || 1 || na vigrahakathā tatra na rakṣā kācidīdṛśī || kevalaṃ tu prabhāveṇa rāmasya bharatasya ca || 2 || nāsmābhiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ rājanprahartuṃ kvacidityapi || yattatra śeṣaṃ karttavyaṃ tatkarotu mahīpatiḥ||3|| evamuktaḥ sa gandharvairyāminīvigame tadā || yogayogamatikṣipramājñāpayata satvaraḥ ||4|| bherī sānnāhikī caiva tataḥ śīghramahanyata || yasyāḥ śabdena gandharvā rājadvāramupāgatāḥ || 5 || gajavāreṇa mahatā turagāṇāṃ balena ca || rathaiśca meghasannādaiḥ pattibhiśca madotkaṭaiḥ || 6 || kṣveḍitāsphoṭitaravaiḥ śaṅkhabherīnināditaiḥ || hrādena gajaghaṇṭānāṃ gajānāṃ caiva bṛṃhitaiḥ || 7 || hreṣitaisturagāṇāṃ tu babhūva tumalaṃ mahata || śailūṣo'pi tadā snātvā hutvāgniṃ dvijapūjanam || 8 || kṛtvā viniryayau śrīmānvaracandanabhūṣitaḥ || maulī vapuṣmānsannaddhaḥ sragvī rucirabhūṣaṇaḥ || 9 || āmapātrapratīkāśaisturagairyojitaṃ ratham || āruroha mahātejā vimānaṃ sukṛtī yathā || 1.258.10 || yathoktasya rathasyāsītpuro raṇaviśāradaḥ || naraketuriti khyātastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 11 || ketau tasya rathe bhāti vasanto mūrtimānkṛtaḥ || tataḥ sa saha sainyena niryayau nagarādbahiḥ || 12 || vyūhaṃ ca sarvatobhadraṃ samādhāya balaṃ tathā || kṛtvā pratyaikṣata tadā bharatāgamanaṃ ruṣā || 13 || sainyena mahatā rājanbhāskarasyodayaṃ prati||14|| āttāyudhāḥ kṣveḍitaśaṅkhanādairānandayantaḥ suhṛdāṃ manāṃsi || gandharvamukhyā raṇacaṇḍavegāḥ pratīkṣamāṇā bharatasya tasthuḥ || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde gandharvasainyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 258 || <1.259> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || vibuddhā yāminīśeṣe sarva eva mahīkṣitaḥ || niryayurnagarākārai rathaiḥ saṃgrāmalālasāḥ ||1|| balena caturaṅgeṇa nānāvāditravādinā || bandibhiḥ stūyamānāśca vandyamānāśca sainikaiḥ || 2 || pṛthakpṛthaksusannaddhā nagaradvāramāgatāḥ || kṛtvā cāvaśyakaṃ sarvaṃ bharato'pi mahāyaśāḥ || 3 || rathena kāñcanāṅgena niryayau nagarādbahiḥ || yantā rathasya tasyāsīdyudhājinmātulaḥ svayam|| || 4 || virarāja dhvajaṃ tasya kovidāramahādrumam || sa tena rathamukhyena bahirnirgamya pārthivaḥ || 5 || sametya pārthivaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūjayitvā ca tānnṛpān || vajraṃ kṛtvā mahāvyūhaṃ prayayau laghuvikramaḥ || 6 || prayāṇe tasya sainyasya kampantīva vasundharā || śabdena mahatā tasya dīryate ca nabhastalam || 7 || babhūva rajasaivānyaḥ niśākālaḥ sudāruṇaḥ|| nṛpābharamāṇikyatejasā bhuvi rājitā || 8 || rajondhakāre'pi camūḥ sā prayāti yathāsukham || sa gatvā dūramadhvānaṃ sūryasyodayanaṃ prati|| 9 || āsasāda mahatsainyaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ duratyayam ||1.259.10|| tau sainyatoyaughamahādurantau saṃhāranāgāviva tulyarūpau || balārṇavau gāḍhamatha prahāraṃ pracakraturmanyuvaśānuyātau || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bharatasainyaniryāṇaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||259|| <1.260> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca|| tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || śūrāṇāṃ harṣajananaṃ bhītānāṃ bhayavardhanam||1|| senāvinirgame tatra rajasācchāditaṃ jagat|| na prajñāyata rājendra kiñcideva samantataḥ || 2 || kūjatāṃ dhanuṣāṃ śabdaḥ śrūyate tumulo mahān|| śaṅkhabherīninādaśca kuñjarāṇāṃ ca bṛṃhitam ||3|| hayānāṃ hreṣamāṇānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ caiva garjatām || śastrāṇāṃ pātyamānānāṃ yodhānāṃ kavaceṣvapi ||4|| tiṣṭhatiṣṭha na me jīvangantāsi raṇamūrdhani ||5|| sthito'smi praharasveti kiṃ na jānāti māṃ bhavān ||6 || praharasva tathā chindhi bhindhi ghātaya mā ciram || evamādīni vākyāni śrūyante raṇamūrdhani|| 7 || tathā tumulasaṃgrāme vartamāne sudāruṇe || praśaśāma rajo bhaumamutthitaṃ raṇaśoṇitaiḥ || 8 || pūrvotthitena rajasā megheneva nabhastalam || vyāptaṃ tadvirajaskena tadā rājanraṇāṅgaṇe ||9|| tato yuyudhire vīrāḥ paśyamānā parasparam || gotrāpadānanāmāni kīrtayantaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 1.260.10 || senānāṃ bhajyamānānāṃ sainyakhaṇḍairbalīyasām || bhūyaścāvartamānānāṃ śuśrave tamulaḥ svanaḥ ||11|| citrāṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ ca patākānāṃ ca bhūbhujaḥ || adṛśyata samāsiktaṃ rudhiraṃ raṇamūrdhani || 12 || svabhre tadā mahārāja rajomeghe kṣayaṃ gate || nirmalāsu tato dikṣu prāvartata mahāraṇam || 13 || tathā pravṛtte saṃgrāme devagandharvadānavaiḥ || siddhairvidyādharaiścaiva munisaṃghaiḥ samantataḥ ||34|| āvṛtaṃ sahasā vyoma vajrayuddhakutūhalaiḥ || vyadṛśyanta vimānāni teṣāṃ khe vimalānyapi || 15 || kiṅkiṇīśataghuṣṭāni patākāśobhitāni ca || śubhaṃ gandhamathādāya surabhirmāruto vavau || 16 || papāta puṣpavarṣaṃ ca yodhānāṃ tatra mūrdhani || tathā pravṛtte tumule kṣveḍitotkṛṣṭanādite || 17 || padātayastadā jaghnuḥ padātīni ca saṃyuge || khaṅgadhārānikṛttānāṃ padātīnāṃ padātibhiḥ || 18 || dvidhā kṛtāni gātrāṇi nipatanti mahītale || gṛhītvā khaṅgapātāni rejuḥ kecicca varmiṇaḥ || 19 || khaṅgamuddharatāṃ teṣāṃ cicchidurnṛpa vigrahān || kecidgadāvinirbhinnamastakā gadibhiḥ kṣitau || 1.260.20 || patitāstatra dṛśyante raṇe śatasahasraśaḥ || bhagnāsiśeṣanikṣepa nihatārātayastathā || 21 || siṃhanādaravāṃścakruḥ parasainyavidāraṇān || keśeṣvanyonyamākṛṣya khaḍgaiḥ kecitparasparam || 22 || āsedurvasudhāṃ kṛtvā gataprāṇāstathā pare || pṛṣṭhavinyastavarmāṇaḥ sannaddhāṃsturagāṃstathā || 23 || kṛtvā vipādānsamare nijaghnuḥ sādināṃ gaṇam || āruhya varmiṇaḥ kecidvegācchatrurathānraṇe || 24 || sārathīnvigataprāṇām̐ścakuryuddhaviśāradāḥ || cicchidurvāraṇendrāṇāṃ karānkecitpadātinaḥ || 25 || keciddaśanavinyastapādāścāruruhurgajān || sādinaśca tathā kecidviśiraskānraṇājire || 26 || cakruḥ padātino dhmātāḥ khaḍgairākāśasannibhaiḥ || kecicca sādinaḥ prāsaiḥ pañca sapta tathā śarān || 27 || śreṇīkṛtānvai bibhiduḥ śikṣayā raṇakovidāḥ || kecicchārṅgadhanurnyastabāṇajālākulīkṛtān || 28 || padātīnsamare cakrurvāyuvegaisturaṅgamaiḥ || sādinaśca tathaivānye sādibhiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ || || 29 || darśayanto raṇe bhikṣāṃ cakruryuddhamanekadhā || kecitpāśāgranirbhinnahatasārathināyakāḥ || 1.260.30 || vineduruccaiḥ sahasā siṃhanādaravānvanān || kuñjarairākulīkṛtya hayayānaviśāradāḥ || 31 || vipucchahastānsamare cakruḥ sādigaṇānraṇe || nihataṃ va śaravrātaiḥ pādātaṃ bahudhā raṇe||32|| rathibhirbhāti bhūpāla kamalotkarasannibham || turagāsturagārohā rathibhirvinipātitāḥ || 33 || āvavrurvasudhāṃ tatra śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || rathināṃ rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam ||34|| bāṇatomarapātaiśca gadākampanamudgaraiḥ || rathināṃ ca mahadyuddhamāsītkuñjaradhūrgataiḥ ||35|| prāsabāṇamahāpāta durnirīkṣyaṃ samantataḥ || nihataṃ bahu pādātaṃ kuñjaraistatra dṛśyate||36|| raṇe nṛpatiśārdūla vinikīrṇaṃ sahasradhā || sādināṃ saturaṅgāṇāṃ sumahatkadanaṃ kṛtam || 37 || mahāmātrapramuditaiḥ kuñjarairbaladarpitaiḥ || ākramya rathavṛndāni cūrṇitāni turaṅgamaiḥ||38|| vyadṛśyanta mahārāja viprakīrṇāni bhūtale|| evaṃ madhyāhnasamaye tīkṣṇaṃ tapati bhāskare || 39 || babhūvākulasaṃgrāmaṃ ghoraṃ rudhirakardamam || rathāśvakuñjaraiḥ sārdhaṃ pattayaśca samāgatāḥ || 1.260.40 || kuñjarāśca mahākāyā pattyaśvarathinastathā || pattibhiśca padātīnāṃ sādināṃ saha sādibhiḥ || 41 || rathināṃ rathibhiryuddhaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ ca kuñjaraiḥ || babhūva rājam̐stumule saṃgrāme śoṇitodake || 42 || śūrāṇāṃ raṇalubdhānāmamarṣākrāntacetasām || pattinā nihataḥ sādī gajena nihato naraḥ || 43 || rathinā nihato nāgaḥ kvacidāsīdaghātitaḥ || hatāḥ padātibhiścānye vyadṛśyanta raṇājire || 44 || padātirathanāgāśca sādibhirvinipātitāḥ || rathanāgahayā yuddhe nihatāśca padātibhiḥ || 45 || nareṇa ca hato hastī śūreṇa kṛtabuddhinā || sādinā ca hato hastī sādī caiva padātinā ||46|| rathinā ca hataḥ pattiḥ pattinā ca hato rathī || rathinā nihataḥ sādī saṃgrāme lomaharṣaṇe || 47 || reṇunā ca diśo vyāptāstumule bhṛśasaṃkule || vyarājanta mahārāja samare gatajīvitāḥ || 48 || patatāṃ bāṇajālānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ caiva kūjatām || mudgarāṇāṃ bhuśuṇḍīnāṃ tomarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||49|| paṭṭiśānāṃ ca ṛṣṭīnāṃ kṣepaṇānāṃ ca yādava || ayoguḍānāṃ prāsānāṃ carmaṇāmatha varmaṇām || 1.260.50 || aniśaṃ śrūyate śabdo ghorastasminraṇājire || hayaiśca vigatārohairdhāvamānairitastataḥ || 51 || bhagneṣākūbarākṣaiśca rathairvigatanāyakaiḥ || chinnadantaiśca mātaṅgairbhinnakumbhaghaṭānanaiḥ 52 || latāveṣṭita vṛkṣābhaiḥ śobhāṃ yāti raṇājiram || kuñjarairvigatārohaistrāsitairdṛḍhadhanvibhiḥ || 53 || mardyamānāni sainyāni śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ|| bhinnānsudantaiḥ puruṣāndantāsaktāṃstathā gajāḥ||54|| vahamānā vyarājanta karṇavyajanavījitāḥ || lagnāntrajālairdaśanairdantinaḥ parvatopamāḥ||55|| latāveṣṭitavṛkṣābhaiḥ śobhayanti raṇājiram || tasmim̐stathāvidhe raudre saṃgrāme ghoradarśane ||56|| narāśvanāgarudhirairvisasruḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ || khaḍgamīnā mahāchatrarājahaṃsavibhūṣitāḥ || yodhamastakapāṣāṇāḥ keśaśaivālabhūṣaṇāḥ||57|| mahāphenaughavatyaśca bhītānāṃ bhayavardhanāḥ || tāstaranti tadā yodhāḥ śūrā jayadhanaiṣiṇaḥ||58|| rājanvāhananaubhiste vyavasāyaparasparāḥ || chinnāni svāni gātrāṇi na jānanti raṇe paraiḥ || 59 || tatra śūrā mahābhāgāstvamarṣākrāntacetasaḥ || āyudhakṣayamāsādya muṣṭiyuddhāni cakrire || 1.260.60 || keśākeśi tathā keciddantādanti nakhānakhi || cakruryuddhaṃ mahārāja brahmalokajigīṣavaḥ ||61 || krandanto'nye pitṝnputrānbhrātṝnanye pitāmahān || mātulānbhāgineyāṃśca syālānsambandhinastathā || 62|| pitṛvyānāryakānanye dauhitrānapare tathā || dhāvantyanye patantyanye garjantyanye jigīṣayā || 63 || svanantyanye patantyanye mriyante cāpare tathā || śocantyanye tathā bandhūñśocyāstvanye tu bandhubhiḥ || 64 || yācante'nye mahārāja tṛṣṇārttāśca tathā jalam || vāhaneṣu samāropya nīyantyanye ca bandhubhiḥ || 65 || śibirāya mahārāja śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || anye saṃvṛtya cātmānaṃ bhītā jagmurupahvaram || 66 || jalārthamanye ca narā bāndhavaiśca pracoditāḥ || āgamya dṛṣṭvā ca mṛtaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ bhaṅtvā vicukruśuḥ || 67 || hatabandhumanādṛtya svāmikāryaikatatparāḥ || parānabhimukhāneva tatrāyudhyanta mānavāḥ || 68 || yudhyatāmeva teṣāṃ tu śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || utthitāni gaṇe yāni kabandhāni mahīpate || 69 || kaścinnanarta samare kabandhastu dhanurdharaḥ || gadāpāṇistathaivānyaḥ khaḍgacarmadharo'paraḥ || 1.260.70 || paraśvadhadharaḥ kaścitprāsapāṇistathā paraḥ || nṛtyatkabandhabhūyiṣṭhe devadundubhinādite || 71 || pravartamāne saṃgrāme śūrāṇāṃ svargalokade|| vyadṛśyanta mahārāja piśācā ghoradarśanāḥ ||72|| rākṣasāśca mahākāyāḥ kravyādāśca tathā pare || jagāma cāstaṃ savitā tadā raktavapurdharaḥ || saṃgrāmātsarvayodhānāṃ pītveva rudhiraṃ karaiḥ ||73|| tato'staśailaṃ bhagavatyathārke gate japāpuṣpakadambakābhe || senādvayaṃ tacchibirāya yānaṃ kṛtvāvarohaṃ parabāṇataptam || 74 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde saṃkulayuddho nāma ṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 260 || <1.261> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || niśāvasāne gandharvāḥ kṛtvā vyūhaṃ sudurjayam || saṃpratīkṣyanta bharatamāyāntaṃ raṇakovidam || 1 || bharato'pi ca rātryante vajravyūhena daṃśitaḥ || āsasāda mahatsainyaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sudurjayam ||| 2 || tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ yamarāṣṭravivarddhanam|| devāsurasamaprakhyaṃ trailokyabhayakārakama || 3 || pattīnāṃ pattibhiḥ sārdhaṃ sādināṃ caiva sādibhiḥ || rathināṃ rathibhiścaiva kuñjarāṇāṃ ca kuñjaraiḥ || 4 || bhāṣatāṃ nāmagotrāṇi śūrāṇāṃ caiva garjatām || dhanuṣāṃ kūjatāṃ caiva śabdaḥ samabhavattadā || 5 || tataḥ pravṛtte saṃgrāme bhāratiḥ puṣkaro raṇe || āsasāda viśālākṣaṃ gandharvaṃ raṇagarvitam || 6 || takṣaśca bhāratiḥ śrīmānyuyudhe vīrabāhunā || senānīrvijayaḥ śrīmānnamuciśca tamāgataḥ || 7 || bhūmanyuḥ kauravaḥ śrīmānkāmapālena saṃgataḥ || kirātarājo damanaścandrāpīḍena saṃgataḥ || 8 || prabhadrakeṇa śibinā tathaivājikaro raṇe || mahodayaḥ munirdeśo harikeśena saṃgataḥ || 9 || traigarto vasudānaśca sūryaraśmiśca saṃgatau || gandharvaḥ kumudāpīḍaḥ kulūtādhipatirjayaḥ || 1.261.10 || cakratustumulaṃ yuddhaṃ devāsurasamaṃ tadā || dāśerakastathā rājā yavano vāśanaḥ paraḥ || 11 || ekalavyaśca saṃgrāme tenāsītsumahātmanā || kumudaḥ śoṇimā śūro balabandhuḥ suyodhanaḥ || 12 || gandharvaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañca pārvatīyāḥ samāgatāḥ || balākābalakābhyāṃ tu gadinā maulinā tathā || 10 || kumudena tu vīreṇa sadasīṣvanivarttinā || madrarājoṃ'śumānnāma caturbhiḥ saṃgato raṇe || 14 || bhīmanādamahānādavasuṣeṇagajākaraiḥ || dārvaḥ śrutañjanaḥ śrīmānabhimānaḥ kṛtañjayaḥ || 15 || yuddhaṃ tau cakraturghoraṃ sahitau candravarmaṇā|| kāśmīrakaḥ subāhuśca gandharveṇa subāhunā || 16 || cakāra tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavarddhanam || bharatasyāparaṃ yodhā gandharvaibhīmavikramaiḥ || 17 || samāgatāstadā yuddhe śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || bharataśca mahātejāḥ śailūṣeṇa samāgataḥ || 18 || cakāra tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaram || parvatābhena nāgena tridhā prasravatā madam || 19 || bādhamānamarīnsaṃkhye mahendramiva dānavān || viśālo varayāmāsa rathenābhyetya puṣkaram||1.261.20 || bāṇaughena raṇe bhittvā vegaṃ puṣkaradantinaḥ || puṣkaraṃ tāḍayāmāsa nārācairbahubhistadā || 21 || ripubhistāḍyamānastu bhāratirbhīmavikramaḥ || vavarṣa śarasaṃghātairviśālaṃ senayā saha || 22 || puṣkarasya viśālo'tha madhye ciccheda kārmukam || chinnadhanvā viśālasya sa jaghānātha sārathim || 23 || ākramya yodhayāmāsa viśālasya mahāratham || yadā raṇe mahārāja puṣkarasya rathottamam || 24 || hantuṃ sa rathamutsṛjya viśālopi mahīpateḥ || gadayā yodhayāmāsa puṣkarasya tu vāraṇam || 25 || puṣkaro'pi gadāpāṇirviśālābhimukhaṃ yayau || gadābhistau tato vīrau parasparajigīṣayā || 26 || savyadakṣiṇatastatra maṇḍalāni viceratuḥ || prajahratustathānyonyamanyonyasya vadhaiṣiṇau || 27 || puṣkareṇa raṇe yogādviśālasya gadā hatā || mumoca pāvakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ sasphuliṅgaṃ mahīpate || 28 || viśālena tato yuddhe gadayā puṣkaro hataḥ || himavatsannikāśastu na cacāla padātpadam ||29|| puṣkareṇa mahārāja viśālo gadayā hataḥ || tataḥ śailūṣavacanānmahāmātrapracoditam || 1.261.30 || āruroha mahānāgaṃ viśālo raṇadarpitaḥ || āruroha rathaṃ śrīmāngandharvasya ca puṣkaraḥ || 31 || tāvekarathamārūḍho tadā rājendrapuṣkarau || nijaghnaturviśālasya saṃgrāme varavāraṇam || 32 || yasyāvarji tan sya kuñjarānnipatiṣyataḥ || cicchedātha viśālasya śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam|| 33 || hatvā viśālaṃ saṃgrāme rathamāruhya cāparam || chādayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ śarotkaraiḥ || 34 || viśālaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā ruhaḥ paramakopanaḥ || sādī jaghāna prāsena gāndhāraṃ raṇagarvitam|| 35 || tasya ciccheda gāndhāraḥ saprāsaṃ tu bhujadvayam || śiraśca saśirastrāṇaṃ kṣurapreṇa mahīpate || 36 || takṣo rathena śubhreṇa kiṅkiṇījālamālinā || āsasāda mahābāhuṃ vīrabāhuṃ raṇājire || 37 || ekacchāya ivākāśastayorāsīccharotkaraiḥ || na vāti pavanastatra na vibhrājati bhāskaraḥ || 38 || takṣaḥ sapuṅkhamākṛṣya bāṇaṃ bhāskaraprabham || ciccheda sārathestasya śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam || 39 || niryantṛṇā rathenāsau samarādapavāhitaḥ || tasminraṇājirānnīte takṣaṃ kuñjaradhūrgataḥ || 1.261.40 || ājagāma mahārāja gandharvastu sudarśanaḥ || tasyāpatitamātrasya śareṇa nataparvaṇā || 41 || ciccheda nāgamūrdhānaṃ bhāratirbhīmavikramaḥ || senānīrvijayaḥ śrīmānnamuciśca samāgatau || 42 || sārathiṃ turagānketumadṛśyaṃ cakratuḥ śaraiḥ || anyo'nyasya mahārāja samare bhīmavikramau || 43 || caturbhiḥ sāyakairhatvā namuceḥ sa turaṅgamān || pañcamena śiraḥ kāyājjahāra rathasāratheḥ || 44 || namucirvirathaḥ khaḍgamādāya paravīrahā || jagāmābhimukhastūrṇaṃ senāpatimarindama || 45 || vegenāpatatastasya cakramādāya bhāsvaram || vivṛttākṣantu ciccheda tasya mūrdhānamañjasā || 46 || bhūmanyuḥ kāmapālaśca cakraturyuddhamuttamama || yathā devāsure yuddhe balaśakrau mahābalī || 47 || tāvubhau kuñjarārūḍhau paraspagvadhaiṣiṇau || tomaraiścakraturyuddhaṃ sūryāṃśusadṛśaprabhaiḥ || 48 || yudhyatāmeva teṣāṃ tu bhūmanyurvaravāraṇaḥ || pārśve jaghāna dantābhyāṃ kāmapālasya vāraṇam ||49|| sahitastena nāgena kṛtvā rāvaṃ bhayānakam ||1.261.50|| āsītparāṅmukho yuddhe varttamānaḥ svakaṃ balam || kāmapālaṃ raṇe jitvā bhūmanyurbhīmavikramaḥ ||51|| gandharvasenāṃ sahasā jaghāna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || kirātarājo damanaścandrāpīḍaśca saṃgatau || 52 || cakratustumulaṃ yuddhaṃ samare rathadhūrgato || candrāpīḍaśaravrātanihatau pārṣṇisārathī || 56 || kirātarājasturagāṇāṃ svayaṃ raśmigraho'bhavat || vivyādha sa śaravrātaiścandrāpīḍaṃ raṇe tadā || 54 || candrāpīḍaśaravrātaiḥ kṛtāpīḍo raṇājire || jaghāna turagāstasya damanasya mahīpateḥ || 55 || śaktyā vegācca vivyādha tadā taṃ bhīmavikramam || śaktyā vibhinnahṛdayaḥ papāta vasudhātale || 56 || jaghāna bhārataṃ sainyaṃ candrāpīḍo'pi sāyakaiḥ || āropya svarathe vīraṃ madhumāndamanaṃ tathā || 57 || cakāra virujaṃ śīghramavraṇaṃ ca mahauṣadhaiḥ || yuyudhe ca nikumbhena matsyarāṭ sarathastathā || 58 || rathasthitau mahāvīrau varacāpamahākarau || anyo'nyaṃ śaravarṣeṇa chādayetāṃ ghanāviva || 59 || surathastu nikumbhasya śareṇa nataparvaṇā || cāpamṛṣṭau praciccheda bhujadaṃḍaṃ tathāhave || 1.261.60 || nikumbho'pi praciccheda surathasya tu kārmukam || tāvanye dhanuṣī sajye kṛtvā vīrau parasparam || 61 || chādayetāṃ tathānyo'nyaṃ vīrau sāyakavṛṣṭibhiḥ || anyo'nyasya hayānhatvā ciccheda dhanuṣī tataḥ || 62 || hayānrathābhyāṃ kālasya nirjityāvaśamojasā || dhanuṣo madhyabhāge tu anyo'nyasya nyakṛntatām || 53 || virathāvasiyuddhāya cakraturyatnamuttamam || ādāya vipulaṃ carma śatacandraṃ ca bhāsvaram || 64 || ādadhāte khaṅgavarāvanyo'nyavadhakāṃkṣiṇau || khaḍgamākāśasadṛśamanyo'nyaṃ pravijaghnatuḥ || 65 || maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi gatapratyāgatāni ca || kaiśikāni tu mārgāṇi darśayāmāsatustadā || 66 || bhrāntamudbhrāntamāviddhamāplutaṃ visṛtaṃ sṛtam || saṃpātasamudīrṇaṃ ca khaḍgavarmavidāraṇama || 67 || īkṣitṛprītijananaṃ yuddhamāsīttayostadā || kṛtvā tau suciraṃ yuddhaṃ paraspararaṇe hatau || 68 || jagmaturvasudhāṃ vegācchakracāpasamāvubhau || tataḥ svarathamāropya suratho rathivardhanaḥ || 69 || tasmāddeśādapovāhya sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ || nikumbhe cātha samare surathena tadā ruṣā || 1.261.70 || govāsanena sālvena tvaramāṇaḥ samāgataḥ || bāṇajālena samare cakruryuddhaṃ subhairavam || 71 || tāvubhau rathagau vīrau rejaturdivyadhanvinau || tatakṣatuḥ śaravrātaistadānyo'nyaṃ tathānvitau ||72|| anyonyasya hayānhatvā chittvā ca dhanuṣī tathā|| virathau cakraturyuddhaṃ gadābhiritaretaram || 73|| viceratustau saṃgrāme gadāhastau madoddhatau || vāsitārthe vane mattau kuñjarāviva yūthapau ||74|| suciraṃ tau tadā yuddhaṃ kṛtvā vyāyāmakarṣitau || prahāravarasaṃtaptau jagmaturvasudhātalam || 75 || vihvalau rathayoḥ kṛtvā nītau tau svasvasainikaiḥ || virujau ca kṛtau bhūyo raṇaśīrṣamupāgatau || 76 || prabhadrakaśca saṃgrāmaṃ cakārājagareṇa ha || īkṣitṛprītijananaśarasaṃchāditāmbarama || 77 || sumukhe varttamānasya tadā gajāprabhadrakaḥ || cicchedājagarasyājau śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam || 78 || mahodayaḥ kuṇideśo harikeśasya saṃyuge || gajena pothayāmāsa surathaṃ sarathasārathim 79 || hatāśvarathamutsṛjya gadayā sudṛḍhaṃ raṇe || harikeśaṃ mahābāhuṃ cakāra gatajīvitam || 1.261.80 || traigarto vasudhānaśca sūryaraśmiśca saṃgatau || cakratustumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bali śakrāvivāparau ||81|| kṛtvā tau suciraṃ yuddhaṃ parasparasamāhatau || vicetasau rathopasthe niṣedaturarindamau || 82|| visaṃjñau tu tadā nītau sārathibhyāṃ raṇājirāt || gandharvaḥ kumudāpīḍaḥ kulūtādhipatirjayaḥ ||83|| cakratustumulaṃ yuddhaṃ devāsurasamaṃ tadā || anyo'nyasya hayānhatvā chittvā ca dhanuṣī dṛḍhe || 84 || khaḍgayuddhaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā chinnakhaḍgau parasparam || niyuddhaṃ cakraturvīrau bāhudraviṇaśālinau || 85 || niyuddhasyāvasāne tu kulūtādhipatiṃ jayam || gandharvaḥ kumudāpīḍo niṣpipeṣa mahītale || 86 || tataḥ khaḍgaṃ rayādgṛhya śiraśchettuṃ samudyataḥ || nṛśaṃsaṃ taṃ samālocya senāpatimarindama || || 87 || vijayastasya mūrdhānaṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale || dāśerakastathā rājā yaśca govāśanośanaḥ || 88 || ekalavyasya saṃgrāmaṃ tairāsītsumahātmanaḥ || tasyaikalavyasturagāñjaghānātha śilīmukhaiḥ || 89 || gadayā ghātayāmāsa sa ca tasya turaṅgamān || tayorvirathayorbhṛtyairupanītau turaṅgamau || || 1.261.90 || pṛṣṭhataśca tathā rūḍhau varaprāsadharāvubhau || prāsavibhrāmaṇotkṣepaparivarttavivarttanau || 91 || cakratustumulaṃ yuddhaṃ citraṃ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca || maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi tayoścakrusturaṅgamāḥ || 92 || īkṣitṛprītijananaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā tato raṇam || anyonyavegābhihatau petatussa turaṅgamau || 93 || bhṛtyaiśca rathamāropya samarādapavāhitau || kumāraḥ śreṇimāñchūro balabandhuḥ suyodhanaḥ || 94 || gandharvaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañca parvatīyāḥ samāgatāḥ || balākā balakābhyāṃ tu gadinā mālinā tathā||95|| kumudena ca vīreṇa samareṣvanivarttinā || caturbhiḥ sāyakaistīkṣṇaiḥ kumāro baladarpitaḥ ||96|| hayām̐ścakāra nirjīvānbalākasya mahātmanaḥ || hatāśvarathamutsṛjya balākābhrāturañjasā||97|| āruroha rathaṃ śrīmadbalākasya susaṃyutam || tāvekarathamārūḍhau bhrātarau samarapriyau ||98|| chādayāmāsa viśikhaiḥ kumāro baladarpitaḥ || balakastu kumārasya madhye ciccheda kārmukam || 99 || sa cchinnadhanvā vegena gadāmādāya vegavān|| tāmādāya jaghānātha balākaṃ samarapriyam||1.261.100|| balākaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā roṣādaśru nivartayan || kumāraṃ prati cikṣepa balakaścaiva tomaram||101|| tomareṇa ca nirbhinno rathopastha upāviśat || taṃ visaṃjñamathovāha sārathirhayayānavit || 102 || śroṇimānatha saṃkruddho balakasya tadā raṇe || kṣuraparyantadhāreṇa cakreṇāpaharacchiraḥ || 103 || nipātito'tha tatraiva śareṇa gadayā gadī || taṃ nihatya tadā śūro maulinaḥ sārathiṃ raṇe||104|| gadayā pothayāmāsa merugauravayā tadā || kumudasya jaghānātha gadayā sa turaṅgamān || 105|| hatāśvaṃ rathamutsṛjya kumudo gadino ratham || āruroha tadā śīghraṃ khaḍgabāṇadhanurdharaḥ || 106 || rathārūḍhasya tasyātha balakaśca mahārathaḥ || jaghāna caturo vāhāṃścaturbhissāyakaistadā || 107 || jahāra pañcamenātha śirastasya sakuṇḍalam || sārathiṃ tu rathāttasmānmaulino rathamuttamam || 108 || hatasārathinaṃ pūrvamāruroha mahāraṇe || maulī yuddhāya tasthau ca mahābalaparākramaḥ || 109|| āruhya sarathaṃ divyaṃ kiṅkiṇījālanāditam || tataḥ sa maulinākrāntaḥ suyodhanaratho raṇe ||1.261.110|| avākiradameyātmā śaraissannataparvabhiḥ || suyodhano'pi vikramya maulinaṃ maulibhūṣitam || 111 || jahāra saśirastrāṇaṃ śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam || madrarājoṃśumānnāma caturbhiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ || 112 || bhīmanādamahānādavasumeṣarujākaraiḥ || catvāraste mahārāja madrarājasya sāyakaiḥ || 113 || nijaghnuścaturo vāhānsārathiṃ ca tathā raṇe || aṃśumānrathamutsṛjya gadāmādāya vīryavān || 114 || jaghāna caturo vāhānbhīmanādasya saṃyuge || sārathiṃ pothayāmāsa mahānādarathāṃstathā || 115 || gatāśvaṃ rathamutsṛjya gadāvegena yādava || mahodayasya taṃ nāgaṃ pothayāmāsa vīryavān || 116 || sārathirbhīmanādasya mahānādarathaṃ yayau || bhīmanādaṃ ca gadayā nijaghānātha madrarāṭ || 117 || sa madrarājo gadayā samare tāḍito bhṛśam || jagāma tridivaṃ rājam̐styaktvā dehaṃ raṇapriyaḥ || 118 || mahānādo'pi samare sāyakairlomavāhibhiḥ || bibheda madrarājānaṃ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || 119 || sa bādhyamāno nārācairmahānādabhujacyutaiḥ || āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ vasuṣeṇasya satvaraḥ || 1.261.120 || rathamāruhya vegena gadayā bhīmavegayā || cakāra yuddhe nirjīvaṃ vasuṣeṇaṃ samarapriyam || 121 || avaruhya rathāttasmādgadayā bhīmavegayā || gajākarasya turagānsārathiṃ cāhanadbhṛśam || 122 || hateṣu teṣu rājendra tadā vīro gajākaraḥ || rathaṃ taṃ tu samāruhya bhūya eva tadaṃśumān || 123 || cakāra yuddhe nirjīvaṃ gāndharvaṃ taṃ gajākaram || utplutya turagāttasmānmahānādarathaṃ gataḥ || 124 || gadayā pothayāmāsa mahānādaṃ tadā raṇe || roṣadīrghāṃkuśaṃ kṛtvā kuñjaraṃ bharatājñayā ||125|| āruhya nijaghānātha gandharvāñśataśo raṇe || dārvaḥ śrutañjayaḥ śrīmānābhisāraḥ kṛtañjayaḥ || 126 || yuddhaṃ tau cakraturvīrau sahitau candravarmaṇā || candravarmā mahātejāḥ śrutañjayarathāddhvajam || 127 || śareṇa pātayāmāsa vaṭavṛkṣamivocchritam || śrutañjayopi saṃkuddhaścandravarmakarasthitam || 128 || dvidhā cakāra tīkṣṇena sāyakena mahaddhanuḥ || taṃ chinnadhanuṣaṃ vīraṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || 129 || chādayāmāsa samare pārvatīyaḥ kṛtañjayaḥ || candravarmā samādāya tataḥ śaktiṃ sudāruṇām || 1.261.130 || bibheda samare rājanrājānaṃ taṃ kṛtañjayam || savibhinnastayā śaktyā rathopastha upāviśat || 131 || taṃ visaṃjñamapovāha saṃgrāmādatha sārathiḥ || kṛtañjayaṃ mahārāja raṇe dṛṣṭvā vicetasam||132|| sakuṇḍalaṃ samukuṭaṃ cārucandrasamaprabham || śiraściccheda tīkṣṇena sāyakena mahātmanā || 133 || samare yatamānasya subhṛśaṃ candravarmaṇā || kāśmīrakaḥ subāhuśca gandharveṇa subāhunā || 134 || cakāra tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhīrūṇāṃ bhayavarddhanam || ubhau tau taruṇau vīrāvubhau samaradurmadau ||135|| darśanīyāvubhau vīrāvubhau bāṇadhanurdharau || tāvubhau sadṛśau vīrye śambarāmararājayoḥ ||136|| ubhau prakāraiścalitau tathobhau dṛḍhavikramau || cicchiduste tathānyonyaṃ dhvajacchatre narādhipa || 137 || anyonyasya hayānhatvā tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī || anyonyaṃ dhanuṣī chittvā sudṛḍhe samarapriye||138|| kṛte pratikṛtaṃ caiva kurvāṇau bhīmavikramau || virathāvasiyuddhāya cakraturyatnamuttamam || 139 || asiyuddhaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā khaḍgamāvidhya satvaraḥ || pātayāmāsa mūrdhānaṃ gandharvasya narādhipa||1.261.140|| āruroha rathaṃ cānyaṃ suśīghraṃ bharatājñayā || tatrārūḍhassa gandharvāñjaghāna śataśo raṇe || 141 || etasminnantare kruddhaḥ śailūṣaḥ sa sahāyavān || cakāra yudhi nirjīvānnaranāgaturaṅgamān || 142 || babhūva bhāratī senā śailūṣeṇopamarditā || nidāghe puṣpaśabaladviradeneva padminī || 143 || etasminbhārate sainye kaścidāsīnmahārathaḥ || pratyudyayau yaḥ samare śailūṣaṃ raṇakarkaśam || 144 || śailūṣaśarasampātaruddhagomaṇḍale ravau || na prājñāyata rājendra tadā kiñcidraṇājire || 145 || aśrūyata mahācchabdastālānāṃ patatāmiva || naranāgāśvakāyebhyo visasruḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ || 146 || evaṃ tu bhārataṃ sainyaṃ kālyamānamitastataḥ || śailūṣeṇa mahārāja bharataṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau || 147 || bharato'pi mahātejā dṛṣṭvā śailūṣamāgatama || pratyudyayau rathenājau kiṅkiṇījālamālinā || 148 || tatastau cakraturyuddhaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam || trailokyavijayāsaktau yathobhau balivāsavau || 149 || gandharvarāṭ tataḥ kruddhaḥ siṃhavadvinadanmuhuḥ || bharatasya rathaṃ tūrṇaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat ||1.261.150|| krameṇa sarathastasya sahayaḥ saha sārathiḥ || śaravarṣeṇa mahatā saṃchanno na prakāśitaḥ || 151 || yudhājitkhalvasambhrānto dhairyamāsādya vīryavān || codayāmāsa tānaśvānvibhugnānripusāyakaiḥ || 152 || bharato'tha dhanurgṛhya divyaṃ jaladaniḥsvanam || śailūṣasya dvidhā cakre kṣurapreṇa mahaddhanuḥ || || 153 || gandharvaśchinnadhanvā sa punaranyanmahaddhanuḥ || nimeṣāntaramātreṇa sajjaṃ cakre mahābalaḥ || 154 || vicakarṣa tato dorbhyāṃ cikṣepa ca tataḥ śarān || athāsya tadapi kruddhaściccheda bharato dhanuḥ || 155 || tasya tatpūjayāmāsa lāghavaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ || śailūṣo'pi tataḥ kruddhaḥ pragṛ'hyānyanmahaddhanuḥ || 156 || mumoca samare bāṇānbharatasya rathaṃ prati || yudhājinmātulastasya saha yānena lāghavam || 157 || darśayāmāsa samare moghānkurvañśaravrajān || turagāścodyamānāste maṇḍalānīva babhramuḥ || 158 || yathāyathā śaravrātā moghā yānti mahītalam || bharato'pi mahātejā maṇḍalīkṛtakārmukaḥ|| 159 || vīraketuṃ śaravrātairvivyādha raṇamūrdhani || tāḍitaṃ sārathiṃ dṛṣṭvā vīraketuṃ tathā sutam || 1.261.160 || gandharvastāḍayāmāsa sāyakaistu yudhājitam || yudhājiti mahābāhau samare bhṛśavikṣate ||161|| ciccheda cchatraṃ bāṇena śailūṣasya tu rāghavaḥ || dvitīyena tu bāṇena lasantaṃ dhvajamucchritam || 162 || tṛtīyena dhanurmuṣṭau tathā jaladaniḥsvanam || sa cchinnadhanvā vegena śaktimādāya satvaraḥ || 163 || vivyādha bharataṃ vīraṃ bhuje vāme narādhipa || prahāravarabhinnasya bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || 164 || karātpapāta vegena cāpaścāpadharasya ca || avānyaddhanurādāya bharato raghunandanaḥ||165|| śarairanekasāhasrairgaṃdharvaṃ tamavākirat || pātayāmāsa ca tathā kavacaṃ ratnabhūṣitam||166|| āpadaṃ paramāṃ prāptaḥ śailūṣopyatha satvaraḥ|| āgneyamastraṃ cikṣepa bharataṃ prati vīryavān || 167 || vāruṇena tadastraṃ tu śamayāmāsa rāghavaḥ || vāyavyamastraṃ śailūṣastadā cikṣepa pārthiva || 168 || śailāstreṇātha bharataḥ śamayāmāsa tatpunaḥ || śailāstramatha cikṣepa gandharvanṛpatistathā || 169 || vajreṇāstreṇa tatkruddhaḥ śamayāmāsa rāghavaḥ || utsasarja tato rājā brahmāstraṃ prāṇasaṃśaye || 1.261.170 || kākutsthaḥ śamayāmāsa brahmāstreṇaiva tattadā || astrayuddhe vyatikrānte krodhādāraktalocanaḥ || 171 || jaghāna caturo vāhānbharatasya sa sāyakaiḥ || vīraketośca ciccheda śiro jvalitakuṇḍalam || 172 || tasya rājñaśca ciccheda mukuṭaṃ ratnabhūṣitam || uvāca bharataśreṣṭhaḥ śailūṣaṃ prahasaṃstadā || 173 || kṛtakarmā raṇaśrāṃto gacchādya svaṃ niveśanam || tatra gatvā tato yātaḥ parvataṃ gandhamādanam ||174|| anyathā śvo na me jīvangantāsi raṇamūrdhani || astaṃ ca savitā yāti kṛtakarmā dinakṣaye || 175 || vayañca śibirāyaiva gamiṣyāmo janādhipa || etāvaduktvā śailūṣaṃ cotsṛjya bharatastadā || kṛtvāvahāraṃ prayayau śibirāyaiva yādava || 176 || gandharvarājo'tha gṛhaṃ praviśya niścitya kāryaṃ maraṇāya buddhim || kṛtvā raṇāyaiva manaścakāra rātriṃ tathovāha gṛhe narendraḥ || 177 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0vajrasaṃvāde dvandvayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 261 || <1.262> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tato rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ || sannahyata vinā vyūhaṃ bharataṃ pratyudaikṣata || 1 || bharato'pi mahātejāḥ kṛtapūrvāhṇikakriyaḥ || nirgamya nagarātsarvānpārthivānidamabravīt || 2 || gandharvairbhavatāṃ yuddhaṃ mama buddhyā na rocate || eka eva samartho'haṃ yuṣmākaṃ tejasā nṛpāḥ || 3 || hantuṃ gandharvasainyaṃ tadbhavadbhiḥ paripīḍitam || yudhyamānā bhavantaśca rakṣitavyā mayā raṇe || 4 || sakalatrām̐stato bhūpānetāñśaknomi ghātitum| bhavatāmārjavaṃ yuddhe gandharvāḥ kūṭayodhinaḥ || 5 || adya tānsāyakaiḥ sarvāndivyāstrapratimantritaiḥ || ghātayiṣyāmi bhūpālāṃstadanujñātumarhatha || 6 || bharatenaivamuktāstu rājāno vākyamabruvan || tvayā kalatramasmākaṃ rakṣyaṃ svāminprayatnataḥ || 7 || bhavato rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ samastairvasudhādhipaiḥ || patracchede phalacchede vṛkṣaḥ śākhāvakartane || 8 || bhūyo vṛddhimavāpnoti mūlacchede vinaśyati || te vayaṃ bhavatāṃ vīryaṃ jānanto'pi raghūdvaha || 9 || naikaṃ saṃtyaktumicchāmo bhavantaṃ raṇamūrdhani || ekaikasya tathāsmākaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ mahadbalam || 1.262.10 || vayaṃ raṇe hi paryāptāḥ kiṃ punastava pārthiva || kintu bhṛtyeṣu tiṣṭhatsu svāmino garhitaṃ raṇam || 11 || te vayaṃ ghātayiṣyāmo gandharvānadya satvaram || evamukto mahātejā bharato nṛpasattamaiḥ || 12 || vārayāmāsa sāntvena tatastu vasudhādhipān || śāpitāḥ stha mama prāṇai rājño rāmasya cāpyatha ||13|| adyaiva vinivartadhvaṃ saṃgrāmātpṛthivīkṣitaḥ || saṃyataiśca mahadyuddhaṃ paśyadbhirmama pārthivaiḥ || 14 || ityevamuktāḥ kṛcchreṇa raṇaṃ muktvā narādhipāḥ || ekāntasthāḥ susannaddhā dadṛśustanmahadraṇam || 15 || ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca yamarāṣṭravivardhanam || rathena kāñcanāṅgena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā || 16 || yudhājitā gṛhītena satoyāmbudacāriṇā || cañcadbahupatākena kovidāradhvajena ca || 17 || āsasāda raṇe yakṣāngandharvānraṇakarkaśān| śaraiḥ sañchādayāmāsa gabhastibhirivāṃśumān || 18 || etasminneva kāle ca sahasā gaganacyutā || ulkā papāta madhyena bhittvā sūryasya maṇḍalam || 19 || āsīdghoro mahīkampaḥ śailūṣāṅgavidāraṇaḥ || ādityamaṇḍale rājankabandhaścāpyadṛśyata || 1.262.20 || vavarṣa ca tadā devo gandharvānraktavṛṣṭibhiḥ || gandharvāṇāṃ ca dīptāyāṃ diśyavāśanta pakṣiṇaḥ|| 21 || mṛgāśca ghorā rājendra śivāścāśivaniḥsvanāḥ|| pratilomastathaivāsīdvāyusteṣāṃ suśaṅkakṛt || 22 || nyalīyata tathā gṛdhaḥ śailūṣasya dhvajāgrataḥ || same pathi nirābādhe praskhalantasturaṅgamāḥ||23|| śatapatrāśca cāṣāśca haṃsāścaiva pradakṣiṇam || bharatasya tadā cakruḥ savyo bāhurathāsphurat || 24 || dṛṣṭvā nimittām̐stu śubhānyudhājitsumahāyaśāḥ || codayāmāsa turagāngandharvāṇāṃ camūṃ prati || 25 || bharato'pi śaravrātairghātayāmāsa vāhinīm || gandharvāṇāmudīrṇānāṃ ghoraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 26 || vadhyamānāstu gandharvā bharatena mahātmanā || tamevābhimukhā jagmuḥ śalabhāḥ pāvakaṃ yathā||27|| teṣāmāpatatāmeva śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || pātayāmāsa śīrṣāṇi bharato vāhinīpatiḥ || 28 || bharataṃ koṣṭhakīkṛtvā gandharvāḥ sumahārathāḥ || vavarṣurāyudhaistīkṣṇairmeghā vṛṣṭyeva parvatam || 29 || tānyāyudhāni mukhyāni gandharvairbharatastathā || ciccheda rājannārācairgandharvāṃścāvadhīdbalī || 1.262.30 || mastakānsaśirastrāṇānbāhūnapi ca sāṅgadān || hastihastopamanrūrūṃściccheda bharato raṇe || 31 || nāvadhāna na sandhānaṃ na muñcantaṃ ca sāyakān || dadarśa bharataṃ kaścillāghavādraṇamūrdhani || 32 || kevalaṃ dṛśyate yuddhe gandharvāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ || dahyamānā śaravrātairyugāntāgniriva jvalan || 33 || bāṇagocaramāyātānbharatasya vinighnataḥ || śātravānsāyakaistīkṣṇairjagāmāstaṃ divākaraḥ || 34 || raṇe jayaṃ prāpya tato nivṛttaḥ samāgataścāpi narendramukhyaiḥ || prāyānmahātmā śibirāya rājansaṃstūyamānastridaśadvijendraiḥ || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tṛtīyayuddhadivasavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 262 || <1.263> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || caturthe'hani saṃprāpte kṛtapūrvāhṇikakriyaḥ || śailūṣastu viniṣkramya gandharvānidamabravīt || 1 || yodhayadhvaṃ raṇe sarve bharataṃ ripumāgatam || ahaṃ madhye pravekṣyāmi bharatasya balārṇavam || 2 || tatra tānghātayiṣyāmi bharatasyānuyāyinaḥ || etadukte tathetyuktvā saṃpratīkṣanta rāghavam || 3 || bharato'pi mahātejā rathenaikena dṛśyate || bharatasyānusainyaṃ ca bhūbhujā samapadyata || 4 || tatsainyaṃ prāviśadaghoraṃ śailūṣo raṇadarpitaḥ|| cakāra kadanaṃ tatra naravāraṇavājinām || 5 || gandharvasainye ca tathā bharato'pi śarotkaraiḥ || cakāra kadanaṃ ghoraṃ vaiśvānarasamaprabhaiḥ || 6 || rājānaṃ koṣṭhake kṛtvā śailūṣaṃ vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ || chādayāmāsuravyagrā meghā iva mahīdharam || 7 || govāsanastu saptatyā bibheda samare śaraiḥ || dvijihvaśca trisaptatyā rājā dāśerakastu yaḥ || 8 || subāhustaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭyā daśabhistaṃ suyodhanaḥ || kumāraḥ saptasaptatyā śreṇimāndaśabhistribhiḥ ||9 || śūraḥ ṣaṣṭyā ca nirbhidya balabandhuḥ śatena ca|| dvāviṃśatyā tatastakṣaḥ puṣkaro navabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 1.263.10 || śatena vijayaścainaṃ jayo jitvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || pratyavidhyata tānsarvācchailūṣo daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 11 || nṛtyanniva rathopasthe mahābalaparākramaḥ || dhanuściccheda bhallena subāhoḥ sumahātmanaḥ || || 12 || hayām̐ścakāra nirjīvāṃstathaivāṃśumato nṛpa || padmaṃ rathasthaṃ ciccheda cihnaṃ govāsanasya tu || 13 || suyodhanarathātkṣipraṃ pātayāmāsa sārathim || balabandhostathā chatraṃ pātayāmāsa yādava || 14 || tathānyānvimukhām̐ścakre śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || tatastasya kṣurapreṇa dhanuściccheda puṣkaraḥ || 15 || athānyaṃ cāpamādāya puṣkarasya raṇe ruṣā || cakāra turagānsarvānnirjīvānsamarapriyaḥ || 16 || puṣkaraśca samāruhya takṣasya rathamuttamam || vavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa śailūṣaraṇamūrdhani || 17 || śailūṣopi jaghānāśvānrathāttakṣasya yādava || virathau tau gadāpāṇī bhrātarau yuddhadurmadau || 18 .|| śailūṣeṇa samārūḍhau gadāhastau tarasvinau || abhyāśe bhrātarau dṛṣṭvā jagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ || 19 || māyāvī sa tu gandharvo rathamutsṛjya yādava || śūnyaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathopasthaṃ vilakṣau bhrātarau tadā || 1.263.20 || āditye'stamanuprāpte vinivṛttau raṇājirāt || bharato'pi tathā kṛtvā gandharvāṇāṃ mahāhavam || nyavartata mahārāja sandhyākāle raṇājirāt || 21 || gatvaiva rājansa ca rājaveśma tatroṣya rātriṃ raghuvaṃśanāthaḥ || niśāvasāne punareva buddhaścakāra yuddhaṃ sahito nṛvīraḥ || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde caturthadivasayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 263 || <1.264> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tato'hni pañcame prāpte bharato yuddhadurmadaḥ || kalyamutthāya rājendra kṛtapūrvāhnikakriyaḥ || 1 || jagāma hantuṃ gandharvānbalamutsṛjya pṛṣṭhataḥ || śailūṣo'pi raṇaṃ tyaktvā narendranidhanepsayā || 2 || jagāmaikarathenaiva raṇakarmaviśāradaḥ || tayorāsīnmahāghoraḥ saṃprahāraḥ sudāruṇaḥ || 3 || devāsuraraṇaprakhyaḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ prati || tayostu yudhyato rājangandharvāṇāṃ balārṇavam||4|| chādayāmāsa bharataḥ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || tacca rājñāmudīrṇānāṃ balaṃ sāgarasannibham || 5 || chādayāmāsa gandharvaḥ śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ || balamedhe viniryāte śaravṛṣṭisadāruṇe ||6|| dhārayetāṃ mahārāja śailūṣabharatāvubhau|| antarikṣe śaravrātāṃścicchidaturarindamau ||7|| sainyayośca tathā cakruḥ kadanaṃ ghoradarśanam|| tayoścāpacyutairbāṇairnipātitahayadvipaiḥ ||8|| raṇe visasrurbhūpāla sravantyo raktanimnagāḥ || vahantyo naradehāni yakṣarākṣasevitāḥ || 9 || tābhyāṃ muktai śaravrātairgagane sūryaraśmayaḥ || na prākāśanta rājendra ekacchāye nabhastale || sainikānghātayantau tau rakṣamāṇau ca sārathī || 1.264.10 || chindamānau raṇe vīrau paramuktām̐stathāyudhān || janayāmāsaturvīrau sugaṇāmapi vismayam || 11 || tadyuddhaṃ pūjayāmāsa puṣpavarṣeṇa vāsavaḥ || tau prabuddhau dinaṃ sarvaṃ varabāṇadhanurdharau || 12 || nāsīdekatarasyapi raṇe tasmintparājayaḥ || tato'staṃ bhagavatyarke prayāte pṛthivīpate || parasparasyānumate śibirāyaiva jagmatuḥ || 13|| athoṣyarātriṃ gṛhayoḥ praviṣṭau rātryantamāsādya tadā raṇāya || bhūyo mahendropama saṃprayātau praharṣayantau svabalāni vīrau || 14 |||| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bharataśailūṣayuddhe pañcamadivasayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma catuṣṣaṣṭayuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 264 || <1.265> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tatastu ṣaṣṭhe saṃprāpte divase bhūridakṣiṇe || cakratuḥ samaraṃ vīrau śailūṣabharatāvubhau || 1|| sasainyau pṛthivīpāla śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ || śailūṣeṇa samāsakto bharato vāhinīpatiḥ ||2|| sūryaraśmeśśareṇājau śiraściccheda śatruhā || sūryaraśmiṃ raṇe hatvā ekalavyaṃ mahāratham || 3 || śareṇa pātayāmāsa rathopasthādariṃdamam || gandharvanṛpatirdṛṣṭvā pradhānau tau sutau hatau || 4 || śaktyā bibheda vijayaṃ tathā cakreṇa puṣkaram || tomareṇa tathā takṣaṃ gadayā ca suyodhanam || || 5 || viviśuste rathopasthaṃ visaṃjñāḥ sarva eva tu || niyantṛbhiśca samarātsarva evāpavāhitāḥ || 6 || tatastu bharataḥ kruddhaścaturbhistasya sāyakaiḥ || cakāra yudhi nirjīvāṃsturagāṃścaiva yādava || 7 || cakāra ca śaravrātairvimukhīkṛtavikramam || tato dhairyeṇa saṃdhārya śaravegaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 8 || āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ susannaddho mahābalaḥ || rathamāruhya vivyādha śareṇānataparvaṇā || 9 || bharato hṛdaye gāḍhaṃ mumoha sa ca tāḍitaḥ || etasminnantare mukto hāhākāraḥ surāsuraiḥ || 1.265.10 || aprahṛṣṭaiḥ prahṛṣṭaiśca vimūḍhe raghunandane || hāhākāreṇa mahatā labdhasaṃjñaḥ sa rāghavaḥ || 11 || ākṛṣya balavaccāpaṃ śailūṣasya mahaddhanuḥ || dvidhā cakāra rājendra śailūṣaṃ cāhanadbhṛśam || 12 || sa cchinnadhanvā vegena gadāmādāya satvaraḥ || preṣayāmāsa dharmajña bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || 13 || āpatantīṃ gadāṃ dṛṣṭvā bharato raṇamūrdhani || dvidhā cakāra cakreṇa sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ || 14 || tataḥ sa parighaṃ śīghraṃ cikṣepa bharataṃ prati || tamāpatantaṃ ciccheda caturbhiḥ sāyakairdṛḍham || 15 || tato'nyaddhanurādāya sāyakānekaviṃśatim || cikṣepa sa mahārāja bharatasya rathaṃ prati|| 16 || chittvā tānbharataḥ sarvānnavadhīttasya sārathim || tathā ca caturo vāhānanayadyamasādanam || 17 || śailūṣaṃ virathaṃ dṛṣṭvā gandharvāṇāṃ mahācamūḥ || vavarṣāyudhavarṣeṇa megho vṛṣṭyeva parvatam || 18 || sa mohayitvā bharataṃ mokṣayāmāsa pārthiva || mokṣayitvā ca rājānaṃ gate'staṃ ravimaṇḍale ||19|| kṛtvāvahāraṃ tu gataḥ śibirāya narādhipaḥ ||1.265.20|| hatvā rathe nāgarathāśvayodhānsaṃprāpya madhye niśitaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ || raghupravīro'pi gṛhāya yātaḥ saṃpūjyamāno bhuvi mānavendraiḥ || 21 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍa mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣabharatayuddhe ṣaṣṭhayuddhadivaso nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 265|| <1.266> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tatastu saptame prāpte divase yuddhadurmadau || samīyaturmahātmānau śailūṣabharatāvubhau || 1 || tatastu bharataḥ prāha śailūṣaṃ yuddhadurmadam || āvayoḥ prastutaṃ sainyaṃ kimetaissainikairmṛtaiḥ || 2 || nivārayasva sainyaṃ svaṃ vārayiṣyāmyahaṃ svakam || āvayordvairathaṃ yuddhaṃ paśyantu vasudhādhipāḥ || 3 || tvadīyāḥ sainikā ye ca suranāthāḥ sahāmaraiḥ || hate mayi madīyanta sainyaṃ kāmaṃ prayudhyatām || 4 || saṃgrāmaṃ vā karotvājau tvadīyantu hate tvayi || evamuktastathetyuktvā vārayāmāsa sainikān || 5 || gandharvarāṭ sa śailūṣo bharato'pi tathā svakān || tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tayordevāsuropamam || 6 || paśyatāṃ sarva sainyānāṃ devānāmapi paśyatām || śarajālena mahatā chāditārkakare raṇe || 7 || tatakṣatustāvanyo'nyaṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ || parasparaśarāghāta visaracchoṇitokṣitau || 8 || virejatustau rājendra puṣpitāviva kiṃśukau || ubhau mahārathau vīrau cobhau viśrutapauruṣau || 9 || tathobhau varadhānuṣkau cobhau samaradurmadau || kāñcanāṅgarathasthau tau cobhau saddhvajaśobhitau || 1.266.10 || vījyamānau tathaivobhau yodhābhyāṃ varacāmaraiḥ || chatrayostau tadādhastācchuśubhāte mahārathau || 11 || ubhāvastrapratāpena cakratustumulaṃ raṇam || astrayuddhaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā śarayuddhaṃ pracakratuḥ || 12 || śarayuddhe vyatikrānte astrayuddhaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || evaṃ tau divasaṃ kṛtvā yuddhaṃ saṃśrāntavāhanau || 13 || ropayantau śramaṃ rājansamareṣu jitaśramau || tato gandharvarājastu lambamāne divākare || 14 || cakāra tāmasīṃ māyāṃ yayāndhamabhavajjagat || andhakāre tato jāte vāco'śrūyanta dāruṇāḥ || || 15 || bharato hanyatāṃ śīghraṃ bhakṣyatāṃ pātyatāṃ tathā || abhyavartanta bharataṃ sarpavṛścikakarkaṭāḥ || 16 || markaṭā vānarā ghorāḥ sṛgālā dvīpinastathā || siṃhavyāghravarāhāśca kravyādā ye ca jātayaḥ || 17 || ardyamānaḥ sa dharmātmā bharatastaiḥ sudurmukhaiḥ || saureṇāstreṇa tāṃ māyāṃ babhañja paravīrahā || 18 || tatastu mahatīṃ māyāṃ sa cakāra mahābhujaḥ || uttasthau sumahānmeghaśchādayitvā nabhastalam||19|| pravavarṣa ca ghorāṇi śastrajālānyanekaśaḥ || nārācānardhanārācām̐stathaiva caṣakānanān || 1.266.20 || vatsadantām̐stathā vallānkarṇinālīkagomukhān || kṣuraprānardhacandrāṃśca varāhavadanāṃstathā || 21 || gadābhuśuṇḍīḥ prāsāṃśca bhiṇḍipālānparaśvadhān || huḍānguḍānsalaguḍām̐ścakrakhaḍgāṃstathā parān | || 22 || etānanyāṃśca vividhānvavarṣa paramāyudhān|| patadbhirāyudhairghorairvādhyamānaḥ sa rāghavaḥ || 23 || vāyavyāstreṇa tāṃ māyāṃ nāśayāmāsa śatruhā || tato babhūva rājendra gandharvaḥ parvato mahān || 24 || kṣaratprasravaṇo ghoraḥ śikharaiśca samucchritaiḥ || māyāṃ tāṃ pārvatīṃ śrīmānvajrāstreṇa raghūdvahaḥ || 25 || nāśayāmāsa rājendra sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ || hanyamānāsu māyāsu rūpām̐ścakre sudāruṇān || 26 || yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca piśācānāṃ patattriṇām || siṃhavyāghratarakṣūṇāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 27 || babhañja tasya māyāstā divyāstrairbharato ruṣā || hanyamānāsu māyāsu lāghavādbharataṃ raṇe || 28 || mohayāmāsa rājendra śailūṣo raṇadarpitaḥ || bharato'pi dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ śarāgre ca nilīyate||29|| dhvajāgre ca rathāgre ca turagāgre punaḥ punaḥ || sāyakānbhāratāñśaighryāddhvaṃsayāmāsa yādava || 1.266.30|| rāghavāstutuṣustasya devadaityāśca saṃghaśaḥ || asurā mumucurghoramaṭṭahāsaṃ sudāruṇama ||31|| daityānāmaṭṭahāsena bharataḥ kupito bhṛśam || nārāyaṇāstraṃ saṃyojya śareṇānataparvaṇā||32|| iyeṣa hantuṃ taṃ krodhādgandharvaṃ raṇagarvitam || astraṃ tatsaṃhṛtaṃ jñātvā jagāma svaṃ rathaṃ tvaran ||33|| iyeṣa hantuṃ taṃ cāstraṃ rudrāstreṇa tu dāruṇam|| etasminneva kāle tu mumoca bharataḥ śaram||34|| kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ sapuṅkhaṃ saphalaṃ tathā || rājitaṃ vainateyasya pakṣaiḥ śatruvināśanam || 35 || hatvā rudrāstravegantu rathasthasya mahīpateḥ || bibheda hṛdayaṃ rājanvarma bhittvātha kāñcanam || 36 || rājñaśca hadayaṃ bhittvā bhittvā ca vasudhātalam || snātvā rasātalāmbhaḥsu tūṇaṃ punarupāgamat ||37|| gandharvarājo'bhihataḥ śareṇā nataparvaṇā || rathanīḍe dhanustyaktvā mamāra paravīrahā || 38 || pitaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā śailūṣatanayā raṇe || krodhaduḥkhaparītānte bharataṃ raṇakarkaśam || || 39 || vivyadhurbhūpatiśreṣṭha bāṇairāśīviṣopamaiḥ || āyudhairvividhākāraistadā te vai raṇājire || 1.266.40 || māyāśca vividhāścakrurbharatasya vipattaye || antarikṣaṃ ca tairvyāptaṃ nānāhetipravarṣibhiḥ || 41 || astraiśca kecidbharataṃ pravavarṣurmahārathāḥ || bhūribhāvātsa yodhānāṃ mahāstrāṇāṃ mahābalāt || 42 || pratāpādastrajālānāṃ saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || kālāstramatha sāṃvartaṃ mumoca bharatastadā || 43 || tasmādastrātsahasrāṇi śastrāṇāṃ niryayustadā || gandharvasainyaṃ sakalamastraistaiḥ pratyahanyata || 44 || śastraiḥ kecidviśirasaḥ kṛtvā gandharvasattamāḥ || vivāhāśca kṛtāḥ kaicitkecidrājandvidhā kṛtāḥ || 45 || kecidvivāhavaścaiva kecidvyaṅgāśca yādava || gandharvāṇāṃ ca tāḥ koṭyastisraḥ saṃgrāmaśālinām || 46 || kṣaṇenāstraprapātena bharatena nipā titāḥ || gandharvasainye nihate pravavurmārutāḥ śivāḥ || 47 || puṣpavarṣaṃ papātātha bharatasya tu mūrdhani || diśaśca nirmalībhūtā devānāṃ vigataṃ bhayam || 48 || tato devaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ samam || vimānastho babhāṣedaṃ bharataṃ dharmavatsalam || 49 || indra uvāca || || pitāmahavarodrekādavadhyaṃ devatāgaṇaiḥ || hatavānasi śailūṣaṃ devabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakam || 1.266.50 || yasmāttasmādvaraṃ matto gṛhāṇa raghunandana || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || śatakratorniśamyaitadbharato vākyamabravīt || 51 || || bharata uvāca || || tvamīśaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tavedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || acireṇaiva maraṇaṃ tvadājñābhaṅgakāraṇāma || 52 || bhavaṃtīha sadā loke nimittaṃ madvidho janaḥ || prajāpatikṛtaṃ bhedaṃ ko moktuṃ jagati kṣamaḥ || 53 || varaśca yadi me deyastvayā deva pradīyatāma || sindhorubhayakūleṣu kariṣyāmi puradvayam || 54 || gaṃdharvarakṣite deśe putrayorubhayoḥ kṛte || nirveśaṃ tadavāpnotu prasādena śatakrato || 55 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || evamastvityathoktvaiva svarlokaṃ vāsavo yayau || vāsave tu gate nākaṃ rājā citrarathastataḥ || 56 || gaṃdharvāṇāṃ mahātejā bharataṃ vākyamabravīt || || citraratha uvāca || || gaṃdharvā nihatā vīrā madājñābhaṅgakāriṇaḥ || 57 || tvayā te dharmanityena devabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakāḥ || tanme samuddhṛtaṃ śalyaṃ devānāñca priyaṃ kṛtam || 58 || tasmātsabhājayitvā tvāṃ yāsyāmi tridivaṃ punaḥ || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || bharatastamuvācātha gandharvā nihatā mayā || 59 || tata enaṃ janaṃ teṣāṃ striyaśca paripālaya || gandharvāḥ paripālyāste teṣāṃ tvaṃ paripālakaḥ || 1.266.60 || madīyenānurodhena viśeṣātkartumarhasi || sarveṣāñca tathā sthānaṃ parvate gandhamādane || 61 || prayātāstava tatrasthāḥ pālayiṣyanti śāsanam || evaṃ kariṣya ityuktvā pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam || 62 || sarvajñaṃ bharataṃ śrīmāngandharvastridivaṃ yayau || 63 || raghupravīro'pi raṇe maghonaḥ śatrūnnihatvā varadānayuktama || virājamāno yaśasā pareṇa jagāma rājansvapuraṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ ||64|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śailūṣavadho nāma ṣaṭṣaṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 266 || <1.267> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || āditye'stamanuprāpte sandhyākāle sudāruṇe || nivartayāmāsa rathaṃ yudhājidbharatasya ca || 1 || nivartayānaśca rathaṃ bharataṃ vākyamabravīt || saṃgrāmamedinīṃ paśya svakṛtāṃ raghunandana || 2 || gandharvāṅgasamākīrṇāṃ hatakuñjarabhūṣaṇāma || turaṅgamagaṇākīrṇāṃ varāyudhadharāṃ dharām || 3 || saṃpūrṇacandrapratimairdaṣṭoṣṭhai ścārukuṇḍalaiḥ || bhṛkuṭītaṭaduṣprekṣyairmastakairbhāti medinī || 4 || pañcaśīrṣoragākārairvarāṅgadavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || bāhubhirbhāti śūrāṇāṃ vasudhā vasudhādhipa || 5 || padmapatradalākārairgendharvāṇāṃ tathā karaiḥ || bhāti sāyakavicchinnaiḥ sapadmeva vasundharā || 6 || hastihastasamākārairgandharvāṇāṃ tathā karaiḥ || vibhāti vasudhākīrṇā varacandanabhūṣitaiḥ || 7 || tvadekaśaranirbhinnairgaṇḍaśailopamairgajaiḥ || udbhrāntajīvitaiḥ paśya vinikīrṇadharātalam || 8 || āviṣkṛtaradaiścāśvairvivṛtākṣaistathaiva ca || patitairāvṛtā paśya turaṅgairmedinī raṇe || 9 || ātapatreḥ śaśāṅkābhaiścāmaraiśca virājitām|| yoktraiḥ khalīnaiḥ palyāṇaiḥ kuthābhiḥ kambubhistathā || 1.267.10 || keśairdaṇḍaistathā cāpaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍagaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ || śarairnānāprakāraiśca nānānāmāṅkitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 11 || mukuṭairaṅgadairhāraiḥ kuṇḍalairapi śobhitām || raghunātha bhuvaṃ paśya kāruṇye'pi manoharām || 12 || gandharvānbhakṣyamāṇāṃśca kravyādbhirmṛgapakṣibhiḥ || paśya tvaṃ cārusarvāṅgaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitama || 13 || ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ nimneṣu kravyādbhiḥ kuṇavadraṇe || gātraiścaladbhirdṛśyante jīvantairiva pārthiva || 14 || sannidhānaṃ tu yodhānāṃ vidrutaṃ karapaṅkajam || dhanurgrāhājjātakiṇaṃ bhakṣitena patatribhiḥ || 15 || ardhasambhakṣitairvaktraistathā sampūrṇabhakṣitaiḥ || durvṛttānpaśya gandharvāñśāpādiva mahīkṣitāma || 16 || anāgasāṃ narendrāṇāṃ gandharvairyatpurā kṛtam || bhūyastadeva samare gandharvāṇāṃ tvayā kṛtam || raṇājire piśācānāṃ gandharvānpaśya rāghava || 17 || yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || gandharvamāṃsalubdhānāṃ satataṃ kṣatajāśinām || 18 || samudradārāḥ samprāptāḥ kravyādāḥ kṣudhitā bhṛśam || tvayaiteṣāṃ parā tṛptiḥ kṛtādya raṇamūrdhani || 19 || nānāvidhāni rūpāṇi paśya kravyabhujāṃ raṇe || kecitsthūlāḥ kṛśāḥ kecitprāṃśavo laghavo'pare ||| || 1.267.20 || lambabhrūjaṭharāḥ kecittathā cipiṭanāsikāḥ || vṛttākṣāḥ kekarākṣāśca danturāḥ suvibhīṣaṇāḥ || 21 || tathā caivordhvaromāṇo mahādaṃṣṭrā mahāmukhāḥ || purastātpārśvayorghorāḥ paścādaṅgadayoḥ pare || 92 || nānāvidhānāṃ sattvānāṃ sadṛśaiśca tathānanaiḥ || nānāveśadharā raudrā nānāvikṛtadarśanāḥ || 23 || siṃhacarmāmbaradharā vyāghracarmāmbarāstathā || āhūyante daśantyanye harantyanye'sṛguttamam || 24 || anye skandaṃ samāropya māṃsaṃ raktaṃ tadāgaman || raktāpagāsu krīḍanti tvatkṛtāsu yathāsukham || 25 || snapayanti rudhiraiścānye pāyayanti pare' sṛjam || raktaṃ kṛtvā kapāleṣu kṛtvotsaṅge punaḥpunaḥ || 26 || bhāryābhiśca sahaivānye pibanti rudhiraṃ raṇe || pāyayanti tathaivānye rāmā rāmānujaḥ svayam || 27 || bhāryākaradhṛteṣvanye kapāleṣu pibantyasṛk || kauñjareṣu kapāleṣu pibantyanye'sṛgulbaṇāḥ || 28 || śiśūnskandhagatānkṛtvā tṛptā nṛtyanti cāpare || hastamādāya patnīnāṃ nṛtyantyanye tathaiva ca || 29 || nṛtyantyanye hasantyanye vikṛtaiśca tathā svaraiḥ || gāyantyanye svapantyanye kalahāyanti cāpare || 1.267.30 || kuṇapām̐śca tathaivānye tyajantyanye mahītale || anyāṃścādātumicchanti gṛhṇanti ca tathāparān || 31 || kurvanti kalahām̐ścānye kuṇapārthāya kutsitāḥ || utkṛtya māṃsānyaśnanti kecidgātrairvibhūṣitāḥ || 32 || bhuktvā cāsthīni majjāśca kecidaśnanti rāghava || bharatasya prasādena tṛptāḥ sma iti cāpare || 33 || parasparañca bhāṣante paraṃ harṣamupāgatāḥ || nityaṃ bhavatu rājñāñca yuddhaṃ vairaṃ nṛśaṃsatā || || 34 || balaṃ sahāyāḥ puṣṭiśca yena tṛpyāmahe vayam || evamete vadantaśca svaraiśca vividhairjaguḥ || 35 || rathaṃ tathānye vīkṣante sasnehā bhṛśadurdṛśāḥ || evaṃ sa bharataḥ śrīmānmātulena pradarśitam || 36 || paśyanraṇājiraṃ prāyādyena rājagṛhaṃ punaḥ || so'paśyannagarābhyāśe vāyavyāstravimohitam|| 37 || sainyaṃ tatpārthivendrāṇāṃ vrajantaṃ samarādimam || dṛṣṭvā te bharataṃ sarve raṇareṇusamukṣitama || 38 || saṃgrāme jayinaṃ vīramabhyanandanta pārthivāḥ || sa sametya mahābhāgaiḥ pariṣvajya ca pārthivān || sāntvayitvā ca dharmātmā śibirāṇi vyasarjayat || 39 || tataḥ sa tāṃ mātularājadhānīṃ prahṛṣṭayodhāryajanābhirāmām || viveśa rātrau raghuvaṃśanāthaḥ saṃstūyamānaḥ stutibhirnṛsiṃhaiḥ || 1.267.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde raṇabhūmivarṇano nāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamau'dhyāyaḥ || 267 || <1.268> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ gandharvanagarājjanāḥ || gandharvaputradārāśca rājapatnyastathaiva ca || 1 || raṇājiraṃ tu saṃprāpya rurudurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ || aho kṛtānto balavānyena no baladarpitāḥ ||2|| ajeyāḥ surasaṃghānāṃ saṃgrāme vinipātitāḥ || nātibhāro'sti daivasya nāśakyaṃ tasya vidyate || 3 || yena nāgāyutaprāṇā gandharvatanayā hatāḥ || ye purā śayanīyeṣu parārdhyeṣu madotkaṭāḥ || 4 || na nidrāmabhigacchanti śerate te'dya bhūtale || tālavṛntānilairye ta varastrībhiśca vījitāḥ ||5|| vījyante patitāste'dya gṛdhrapatrairmahītale || parārdhyacandanāktāṅgā ye virejuḥ samāgatāḥ ||6|| na rājante'dya te sarve śoṇitāktā mahātale || āliṃgya suṣupuḥ pūrvaṃ varorujaghanāḥ striyaḥ ||7|| ye te'dyabhūmimāliṅgya duḥkhaśayyāsu śerate || hā rājandevadarpaghna hā rājanbhṛtyavatsala || 8 || hā rājam̐ścāru sarvāṅga hā rājansūtavatsala || bāhucchāyāmupāśritya vayaṃ kasya janeśvara ||9|| nirbhayā devadaityānāṃ nivatsyāmo yathāsukhama || saṃpūrṇacandravadanaṃ putra koṭibhirāvṛtam || 1.268.10 || viṣamasthamito dṛṣṭvā yāsyāmo yamasādanam || sabhāsthaṃ tvāmapaśyanto yāsyāmo yamasādanama || 11 || evaṃ jane tu śokārte karuṇaṃ vilapatyatha || gandharvarājaputrāṇāṃ patnyastāḥ sumanoharāḥ || 12 || tatastā duḥkhaśokārtāḥ kāruṇye mahati sthitāḥ || bhartāraṃ śirasā hīnaṃ kācidbāhuvinākṛtam || 13|| dvidhā kṛtaṃ tathaivānyā kācitkravyādabhakṣitam || dṛṣṭvā ruroda duḥkhārtā kācinnāsādayatyapi || 14 || kuṇapeṣu skhalantyastā babhramustatra duḥkhitāḥ || urāṃsi pāṇibhirghnantyo lūnayantyaḥ śiroruhān || 15 || nāvāpa yāsāṃ bhavane purā sūryo'pi darśanam || duḥkhitā muktakeśāstā janaḥ sarvo'tha paśyati || 16 || patantyupari bhartṝṇāṃ samāliṅganti cāparāḥ || rudantyanyāstathā rājannutkṛtyamadhurasvarāḥ || 17 || rudantīnāṃ tathā tāsāṃ rājapatnyaḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || ruruduḥ karuṇaṃ rājanviprakīrṇaśiroruhāḥ || 18 || hā kānta hā mahārāja hā mahājanavallabha || hā sureśvaradarpaghna hā śaśāṅkanibhānana || 19 || he bhartaḥ kena te buddhirmaraṇaṃ prati gāhitā || hā rājam̐stvamimāṃ bhūmiṃ samāliṅya priyāmiva || 1.268.20 || vasudhāṃ priyabāhubhyāṃ samāje kiṃ na lajjase || kiṃ śeṣe purato'smākaṃ viśeṣeṇa rajasvalām ||21|| khecarasyāpi te rājansatataṃ vasudhā priyā ||22|| nāḍāyanavacastaddhi tvayānarthāya na śrutam || priyā te yadyapi mahī tathāpyasmāsu pārthiva|| yuktaṃ hi kartuṃ dākṣiṇyaṃ yatastvaṃ matkulodbhavaḥ||23|| atarkitaprayāṇena tvayā sma paripīḍitāḥ || vāṅmātreṇa kuruṣvāsmānsāntvanaṃ ripusūdana ||24|| rājño na yuktaṃ śayanaṃ vivṛte vasudhātale || tasmāduttiṣṭha rājendra śayanaṃ bhaja mā ciram ||25|| nunnā vayaṃ mahārāja madanena madena ca || kaṇṭhe nu kaṃ gṛhīṣyāmastvayā hīnā janeśvara || 26 || kṛtānto balavānrājanyenākṛṣyādya nīyase || nāḍāyanasya vacanaṃ tvayā yadi kṛtaṃ bhavet || 27 || nābhaviṣyadviyogastu tvayāsmākaṃ janādhipa || niśceṣṭāṅgaḥ kathaṃ tvadya rājansvapiṣi bhūtale || 28 || utthāya vīra cāsmākaṃ pariṣvajya na cumbase || vijitya samare vīrānhatvā ca vasudhādhipān || 29 || kathamekena yuddhe tvaṃ mānuṣeṇa nipātitaḥ || kva te vapuḥ kva te tejaḥ kva sā lakṣmīḥ kva te balam || 1.268.30 || kva te tadvimalaṃ chatraṃ kva ca te varacāmaram || kva tatpīṭhañca śṛṅgāraṃ kva ca te tanayā vibho || 31 || kva sā līlā kva sā lakṣmīḥ kva ca te varavandinaḥ || varacāmaradhāriṇyaḥ kva ca tāḥ paramāṅganāḥ || 32 || adyaivasmastvayā hīnā adyaiva spṛhayāmahe|| adyaiva smaraṇīyastvaṃ gato'sijanavallabha || 33 || nūnaṃ kāntataraḥ svarge rājendra pramadājanaḥ || yattyaktvā svajanaṃ tasya ratirbaddhā tvayānagha || 34 || svacchandacāriṇā kena matiḥ śūraniṣevitā || tvayā prārthayatā loke yuddhaśraddhā vivarddhitā ||35|| vallabhasya janasyāsya lālitasya tathā tvayā || dīrghaprayāṇe kartavyo vāṅmātreṇāpyanugrahaḥ||36|| visarjaya janaṃ rājankrīḍāmaḥ sahitāstvayā || udyāneṣu vicitreṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca ||37|| vayamīrṣyāṃ na kurumaḥ sarvalokasya paśyataḥ || vajrasāramidaṃ nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtam||38|| gatāsumapi dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ śatadhā yanna dīryate|| karpūracandanārdrāṅga mahārhaśayanocita ||39|| virājase na rājendra rudhirākto mahītale || kva te bhinnaghaṭā nāgāsturagāḥ kva ca te gajāḥ || 1.268.40 || kva te yodhā gatā rājañśakravispardhino raṇe || sainye mahati tiṣṭhantaṃ khaḍga bāṇadhanurdharam || 41 || kathaṃ tvāmanayadrājanparalokāya rāghavaḥ || kṛtāntasamadṛṣṭyaiva vepathuste janeśvara || 42 || sa kathaṃ mānuṣeṇādya saṃgrāme vinipātitaḥ || tadvayaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmo nirāśāstava jīvite || 43 || na mesti kalpo dṛṣṭirvā me nasordṛṣṭisaṅgatiḥ || evaṃ vilapamānāstāḥ śailūṣasya tu yoṣitaḥ || 44 || āliṅgyāliṅgya taṃ rājannipatanti mahītale || śirāṃsi ca vinighnanti tāḍayanti bhujāstathā || 45 || paśyanti bhūyastaṃ vīraṃ bhūmāvutkrāntajīvitam || dṛṣṭvā bhūyaśca niḥsaṃjñā nipatanti mahītale || 46 || tāsāṃ rodanaśabdena samākrāntamahītalam || tāsāmāśvāsanaṃ cakre vidvānnāḍāyano dvijaḥ || 47 || etasminneva kāle tu taṃ deśamaparājitaḥ || gandharvendraḥ samabhyāgādbharatena pracoditaḥ || 48 || sa tatsthānamathābhyetya janaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvidhi || āśvāsayāmāsa tadā rājā citrarathaḥ śanaiḥ || 49 || satkāraṃ lambhayāmāsa śailūṣaṃ tanayaiḥ saha || rājñā citrarathenātha gandharvāste pracoditāḥ || 1.268.50 || rājñaścakruścitāṃ kāṣṭhaiḥ suśuṣkairbahubhistadā || putrāṇāmasya sarveṣāṃ yodhānāmapyaśeṣataḥ || candanāgurukāṣṭhaiste tathā kālīyakasya tu||51|| citāṃ gandhaiśca tailaiśca prajvālya ca ghṛtena te || saṃskārayitvā tānsarvānnagarāya pravavrajuḥ || 52 || gandharvarājavacasā tataḥ sarvo mahājanaḥ || nāḍāyanaṃ puraskṛtya prayayau gandhamādanam || 53 || niveśaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra rāmaparvatarodhasi || kṛtvā niveśanaṃ tatra sarve citrarathājñayā || sukhamūṣurmahārāja pālyamānā mahātmanā || 54 || babhūva tatrāpi purapradhāne śailūṣapautrastu janasya rājan || gandharvarājastu cakāra tasya saṃrakṣaṇaṃ rāghavamukhyavākyāta || 55 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde gandharvastrīvilāpo nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 268 || <1.269> || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || athāṣāḍhasya māsasya śuklapakṣāvasānikam || utsavaṃ tridaśendrāṇāṃ samāptaṃ dinapañcakama || 1 || kṣīrodatheṣaśayanaṃ bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || yoganidrāṃ tadā bheje lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || || 2 || bharato'pyutsavaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā janārdanam || mahīdānaṃ tathā kṛtvā naktāśī dinapañcakam || 3 || cāturmāsye nivṛtte ca madhumāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt || visarjayāmāsa gṛhātpūjayitvā mahīpatīn || 4 || uktvā bahuvidhaiḥ sāntvaiḥ pariṣvajya supīḍitam || gandharvanagarāvāptairvibhajya dhana saṃcayaiḥ || 5 || saṃpūjya varṣārātrau tu svakīyaṃ sainikaṃ janama || saṃmaṃtrya preṣayāmāsa sotkaṇṭhaṃ dayitājane || 6 || preṣayitvā janaṃ prāyātkiñcicheṣaṃ svasainikaiḥ || uvāsa mātulagṛhaṃ bharatāṃ devarājavata || 7 || avasaccaturomāsānprītyā rāghavasattamaḥ || tataḥ kārtikamāsādya śuklapakṣāvasānikam || || 8 || utsavaṃ vipulaṃ cakre saṃprāpya dinapañcakama || prabodhaṃ devadevasya tridaśānāṃ mahotsave || 9 || teṣu dattvā mahādānaṃ kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 1.269.10|| śubhe dine sunakṣatre pūjayitvā dvijottamān || sāṃvatsaraṃ puraskṛtya sthapatīṃśca sa rāghavaḥ || 11 || siṃdhorubhayapārśve tu sa cakāra puradvayama || puṣkaraṃ puṣkarāvatyāṃ takṣaṃ takṣaśilāṃ prati || 12 || ārambhaṃ purayoḥ kṛtvā sobhiṣicya sutāvubhau || puradvaye mahārāja vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ|| 13 || puṣkare puṣkaraṃ putraṃ tadā takṣaṃ ca yādava || purudvaye samākīrṇe vaṇigbhirbrāhmaṇaistathā || 14 || śilpibhiśca mahārāja nānāśilpopajīvibhiḥ || gṛhapuñjasamākīrṇe devāyatanabhūṣaṇe || 15 || pratiṣṭhite tadā rājye putrayorbharatastadā || dhanaratnāśvanāgaiśca vibhajya tanayāvubhau || 16 || yudhājiti parīdāya gate saṃvatsare tadā || atīte kārtike māse nakṣatre tu guṇānvite || 17 || jagāma bharataḥ śrīmānrāmaṃ draṣṭuṃ narādhipa || sonuyātaḥ sutairvīro mātulena yudhājitā || 18 || tīre svadhāmnastau putrau mātulaṃ tu yudhājitam || | visarjayāmāsa gṛhānpariṣvajya ca pīḍitam || 19 || bharataḥ sāśrunayano balena caturaṅgiṇā || stokena kāñcanāṅgena rathena ca tathā yayau || 1.269.20 || saṃrudhya ca rathātte tu gacchantaṃ bharataṃ tadā || dadṛśurdīnamanasaḥ kiṃcidāgatavibhramāḥ || 21 || muhurmuhuḥ parāvṛtya bharataḥ kathamapyagāt || parasparamapaśyanto tvarāvantastathā gatāḥ || 22 || bharatopi tathā deśānsarāṃsi saritastathā || grāmapattanasaṃgādyānvyatikramya purīṃ yayau || 23 || athāsasāda cāyodhyāṃ dīrghakālapravāsakaḥ || praviśya nagaraṃ tatra patākādhvajasaṅkulam || 24 || sudhāvadātabhavanaṃ siktaṃ candanavāriṇā || kṛtaṃ rāmājñayā sarvaṃ pūjitāmarabālakama || 25 || niryayau puratastasya caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ || rāmājñayā mahātejā nāgaraiḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ || 26 || bharataṃ lakṣmaṇo dṛṣṭvā cirakālapravāsakam || abhyavādayata prītyā śiraḥ kṛtvā mahītale || 27 || bharato mūrdhnyupāghrāya sampariṣvajya pīḍitam || sarvatra kuśalapraśnaṃ tatra kṛtvā yathāvidhi || 28 || yathārhaṃ pūjayāmāsa janaṃ nagaravāsinam || kuśalapraśnayogena smitapūrvābhibhāṣitā || 29 || sa tena janavṛndena pūjyamāno muhurmuhuḥ || viveśa nagaraṃ śrīmānbharato nāgadhūrgataḥ || 1.269.30 || vimānaharmyaprāsādagavākṣakagatena tu || strījanena mahātejā vīkṣyamāṇastu saspṛham || 31 || āsasāda mahātejā narendradvāramāyatam || tatra vāditranādo'bhūnmahānkalakalastathā |||32 || rājadvāramathāsādya sovaruhya gajottamāt || ādāya lakṣmaṇaṃ pāṇau praviveśa tadā sabhām ||33 || tatra siṃhāsane rāmaṃ sa dadarśa mahābhujam || candanenānuliptāṅgaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 34 || saṃpūrṇacandravadanaṃ nīlotpaladalekṣaṇam || dṛṣṭvaiva rāmaṃ bharataḥ kṛtvā bhūmigataṃ śiraḥ || 35 || nipapāta mahātejā lakṣmaṇena viśeṣataḥ || rāmopi bharataṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāpya mahābhujam || 36 || jagrāha pīḍitaṃ kaṇṭhe mūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt || ādideśāsanaṃ tasya pṛṣṭvā kuśalamavyayam ||37|| nivedya ratnamukhyāni gandharvāṇāṃ sa rāghavaḥ || rāmāya dharmanityāya yathā bheje varāsanam || 38 || pṛṣṭassa rāmeṇa nivedayitvā vṛttaṃ yathāvatpuruṣapravīraḥ || visarjitastena gṛhāya gatvā saṃpūjayāmāsa tadā sa viṣṇum || 39 || svapne tathovāsa sa rāmapādau cāsādya vīraḥ samareṣvajeyaḥ || rāmopi rājyaṃ sahitastu tena cakāra samyaṅnihatāripakṣaḥ || 1.269.40 || tataścaturthe parivatsare tu śuśrāva rāmaḥ purayoḥ pratāpam || kṛtvā sutābhyāṃ bharatasya viṣṇormudañca lebhe paramāṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ || 41 || eṣo'dya prokto vijayo mayā te raṇājire rāghavanaṃdanasya || śrotavyametanniyamena puṃsā vijñānadharmārthayaśobhirāmam || 42 || iti śrīviṣṇumahāpurāṇe dvitīyabhāge śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde śrīrāmacaṃdrabharatasamāgamo nāmaikonasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 269 || || || samāptaścāyaṃ prathamakhaṇḍaḥ ||
